title: Murakami’s Dream
text: # Murakami’s Dream ## Quantum invariants and actual hyperbolic volume The question driving this project is whether the original quantum invariant of a hyperbolic knot has exponential growth determined by the volume of its complement: $$\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N}\log|K_N(K)|=\operatorname{Vol}(S^3\setminus K).$$ We pursue this through the pointed quantum A-structure, exact finite source formulas, positive energies, and hyperbolic angle optimization. The original marked source and peripheral factors stay part of the problem. The current target allows every fixed bridge width $k\geq2$: start with an essential hyperbolic augmented plat, then put independently sufficiently many signed twists into each designated region. The diagram and twists stay fixed as $N$ grows. The [frontier](frontier.md) separates the exact formulas and geometric certificates already available from the general quantum asymptotic still needed. **The general conjecture remains open in this repository.** The notes now include a whole-source equality for connected certified augmented links with arbitrary retained half-twist patterns at arbitrary fixed width, as well as the specified knot families, general identities and obstructions. Internal proof review, finite checks, and exploratory calculations are distinguished throughout this guide. ![The general route: exact source, local complex amplitudes and a marked geometric branch under a positive gluing certificate; global selection and estimates remain open.](../figures/research-map.png) ## Read the argument in order The [research library](../library.html) organizes the work by question: equality results, quantum sources, geometry, torsors, Fourier methods, the cube, and the general frontier. Each route gives a main argument, its scope, and supporting notes. The [figure gallery](../figures.md) introduces the main objects visually. Start with [the equality results](results.md) for the exact knot and link families and their quantifiers. Then read [the mechanism](mechanism.md): what the source formulas do, where weighted Cauchy enters, and why a local scalar estimate does not finish the problem. [The geometry chapter](geometry.md) explains what certifies the volume of the actual complement. [The current frontier](frontier.md) identifies the remaining general steps. [Notation](notation.md) and [reproducing audits](audits.md) are reference chapters. The searchable archive contains the full technical notes, scripts, and recorded results; it is not a second reading list to complete before understanding the project. ## Where the evidence stands | Part of the argument | Current scope | | --- | --- | | Volume limit of the original invariant | Signed Conway families with mixed seeds $h^s$, $s\geq3$, arbitrary fixed trees and constructible knot patterns, after sufficiently long signed full fillings; isolated $C(h^s)$ for $s\geq4$; specified pretzel and belt-stack families | | Exact finite source identities | Original complete source as one positive face coefficient at each folded label, with exact support, measure and even-level carries; all-color compilers and Fourier identities retained | | Boundary first-normal defect | An explicit two-insertion formula from the full root channel; finite Plancherel gives polynomial cost $O(N^2)$, without determining the scalar derivative or estimating that channel by the geometric volume | | Local quantum action | Selected ordinary amplitude on full physical complex compacts; fixed generic jets for all integer-grid physical columns and divided pairs; subexponential complex paired-normal bounds in shrinking channel windows | | General geometric branch | Under the labeled certificate, the complete-image period now selects the actual marked geometric action, including its boundary flags and primitive peripheral words; its whole-source extension requires the stated corridor hypotheses | | Common geometric framing | Exactly two prescribed physical-support failures for the certified right-angled cut; every other ordinary factor is on the selected full physical packet, at arbitrary bridge width | | Exceptional matching block | Exact generic Casimir polynomial and original resolvent period; selected scalar character relation, strict-support Green action and endpoint jets; contributing contour and joint contraction remain open | | Whole complete source limit | Every connected certified augmented plat with any retained half-twist pattern, at arbitrary fixed width and both level parities; exact face coefficients, a nonzero signed Gaussian and actual polyhedral volume | | Complete-image external colors | A nonzero asymptotic on a fixed complex neighborhood; its limiting action is the actual marked geometric regulator, with the necessary complex boundary correction | | Whole mixed source near completeness | Actual marked representation-volume limit at any set of untwisted varied ports, with exponentially small relative error against the geometric core; one varied signed port has a sufficient local curvature test | | General signed long-filled knot equality | Bounds for every remaining reflected color term and the combined far aliases remain unresolved | The cube, Fourier, torsor, and alternative approaches are preserved. A failed intermediate estimate is useful evidence about the argument; it is retained beside the corrected scope. ## About this edition This guide organizes the research snapshot of 30 October 2026. Its chapters explain the current argument; linked technical notes contain the detailed proofs and qualifications. Historical checkpoints remain in the archive and should be read with their dates and later corrections in mind.

title: Equality results and their scope
text: # Equality results and their scope The project seeks equality for broad classes of hyperbolic knots, with the right side established as the volume of the actual complement. The results below are research proofs recorded and internally reviewed in this repository. They are not claims of external peer review. ## Complete signed augmented links at arbitrary width The [general signed source theorem](../../notes/general_signed_augmented_source_volume.md) covers every fixed connected augmented plat carrying a labeled convex ideal right-angled polyhedron for its actual projection and crossing-disk cut. There is no restriction on bridge width, matching graph, or a Conway grammar. For any fixed pattern of retained half twists $\epsilon_i\in\{0,1,-1\}$, the original marked complete-circle source satisfies $$\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N}\log|A_{D,N}^{\boldsymbol\epsilon}|=2\operatorname{Vol}(Q_D)=\operatorname{Vol}(Y_D^{\boldsymbol\epsilon}).$$ Both level parities and composite levels are included. The proof converts the whole finite source into positive face coefficients, proves a global coefficient saddle and an all-channel upper bound at shared geometric radii, and computes the absolute action by coning the actual facets. A uniform relative estimate from the original continuants then sums the retained phases to a nonzero Gaussian coefficient. Every original scalar, support condition and marked measure remains in the identity. The [untwisted proof](../../notes/general_untwisted_augmented_source_volume.md) remains a shorter entry to the positive argument. This is a complete augmented-link result, including patterns whose main strands form one component. The external-color complex packet and full complementary-region estimate needed for independently long fillings remain open in this generality. The theorem also requires the labeled geometric certificate; it does not assert that every reduced plat supplies one. The [coverage comparison](../../notes/general_untwisted_augmented_source_literature_coverage.md) credits earlier overlapping link results and checks the parallel-belt parity obstruction. ## Full original-source equalities The Conway results start with a crossing-circle box, turn it by a quarter turn, and call the resulting piece $h$. Stack $s$ such pieces to form a seed $A_s=h^s$. The [arbitrary-width extension](../../notes/actual_conway_arbitrary_width_seeds.md) allows every fixed $s\geq3$, including mixtures of widths. Build larger tangles by stacking previously built tangles or rotating them by a quarter turn $R$, retaining every auxiliary crossing circle. The grammar $E::=A_s\mid RE\mid EE$ records those operations. A cylindrical closure joins corresponding top and bottom endpoints around the outside; cap closure instead pairs endpoints on each end. The [signed Conway filling theorem](../../notes/actual_odd_conway_long_filling_volume.md) now gives a knot and link result across arbitrary finite branching and turn depth. Take a cylindrical closure $C(FG)$ with both children robust. Independently retain a positive half twist, a negative half twist, or no half twist at every leaf, then fill any subset of crossing circles with sufficiently long fixed signed integral full twists. The full original invariant satisfies $$\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N}\log|K_N(L)|=\operatorname{Vol}(S^3\setminus L).$$ For **every such expression**, a constructive parity assignment joins the main strands into one component; filling every auxiliary circle then gives knots. Both level parities and composite levels are included. No fixed diagram width is imposed, but the diagram and slopes remain fixed before the limit. The width extension also covers isolated closures $C(h^s)$ for $s\geq4$. The minimal $C(h^3)$ remains excluded from this mixed-color filling theorem. The result does not identify the grammar with all alternating or all arborescent knots. The proof keeps the entire changed source, including the aliases introduced by half twists. Its selected action is the calibrated primitive of the actual marked peripheral branch, and the filling equation uses the primitive meridian of the changed link. This establishes the volume of the intended filled complement. The [cylindrical positive Conway theorem](../../notes/actual_positive_conway_hyperbolic_volume.md) covers arbitrary finite branching and turn depth in this grammar. After the exact cap-sum boundary reduction, every retained cylindrical factor has a complete hyperbolic complement and $$\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N}\log Z_{E,N} =2\max_{P_E}V_E=\operatorname{Vol}(S^3\setminus L_E).$$ This uses the whole original source at both parities and composite levels. Its geometric proof constructs the actual link complement from ideal pyramids and prisms and verifies complete cusps. These are retained-circle links. The long-filling extension is stated below; arbitrary short fillings and coverage of every alternating link are not asserted. The [coverage comparison](../../notes/positive_conway_literature_coverage.md) records relevant antecedents without substituting external proofs. The long pretzel argument covers every fixed odd width $s\geq9$, with independently sufficiently large **fixed signed** twist integers in the recorded diagram convention. The corresponding specified single-cut two-component link result holds at fixed even widths $s\geq10$. Width and slopes are fixed before $N$ tends to infinity. Both level parities are retained. Widths $3,5,7$ are outside the present alias estimate. The proof combines control of the entire quantum source, a nonzero geometric period, and a separate geometric certificate. Its precise statements and conventions are in the [width extension](../../notes/actual_pretzel_all_width_extension.md) and [source-to-volume proof](../../notes/actual_long_pretzel_casson_rivin_equality.md). Signed octahedral belt stacks provide another complete family. Every fixed nonempty stack, with arbitrary fixed signs and the specified outer crossing power, has an all-level limit equal to its explicitly constructed complete hyperbolic volume. Any subset of the auxiliary circles can then be filled along independently sufficiently long fixed signed integral slopes. Filling every auxiliary circle gives knots for odd outer crossing power and two-component links for even outer crossing power. The [full filling assembly](../../notes/actual_long_filled_octahedral_belt_stack_volume.md) records the diagram, peripheral slopes, and quantifiers. The signed marked theta link has original-source limit $4v_8$, with a separate sixteen-tetrahedron angle certificate for the actual four-octahedron complement. This is a complete augmented-link result; it does not include arbitrary fillings or arbitrary graphs. See the [theta geometry and equality](../../notes/actual_marked_theta_link_and_angle_geometry.md). ## Long fillings of the Conway links For every retained cylindrical robust Conway factor, the [long-filling theorem](../../notes/actual_conway_long_filling_source_limit.md) proves the full original-invariant limit equals the actual filled hyperbolic volume. Any subset of auxiliary circles may be filled along independently sufficiently long fixed signed integral slopes. Both parities and composite levels are included. The proof controls every source color and constructs the actual marked peripheral representation, including its absolute regulator. These pure fillings always remain links: each pure seed $h^s$ has $s-1\geq2$ internal main components that full twists cannot join. The signed-coupon theorem above changes the strand pattern and supplies the required new source proof, giving the broader knot subfamily. It does not alter this component obstruction for the pure diagrams. ## General identities with a smaller conclusion The [polynomial generating-action theorem](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_polynomial_geometric_action.md) now establishes a general local four-parabolic character relation from the actual selected finite-source polynomial. Its exact operator is retained by the [continuant period formula](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_continuant_operator_period.md). The [rectangle theorem](../../notes/actual_matching_circle_rectangle_bound.md) places every actual certified target at or below $-2$. These results apply beyond a named knot family; they still require a contributing coherent period to yield the general volume equality. For arbitrary fixed plat width, the [complete source compiler](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_phase_compiler.md), [all-color compiler](../../notes/actual_mixed_augmented_plat_compiler.md), and [entire Fourier core](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_entire_core_color_packet.md) now give explicit finite formulas retaining the original phases and normal terms. The [geometric certificate](../../notes/general_augmented_plat_matching_geometry.md) supplies the actual complete complement when a positive labeled realization is available. Neither result alone proves a volume asymptotic for arbitrary plats. The [general long-twist conjecture](../../notes/general_augmented_plat_long_twist_target.md) records the intended broader statement and its remaining source estimates. For the two ends of one crossing-circle matching edge, the [specialized scalar theorem](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_racah_positive_scalar.md) proves a positive finite formula with polynomial fixed generic derivative costs for every target channel. The complete-circle [marked block identity](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_marked_four_port_block.md) cancels the original row normalization. The [completed-projector formula](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_completed_projector_block.md) cancels the target scalar factor too and retains the full normal through regular paired operators and their first derivatives. These are general local results; the native projector and complementary-network estimates needed for a global volume equality remain open. The [native-energy estimate](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_native_projector_energy.md) bounds all fixed projector derivatives by a polynomial times explicit magnetic energies, for every physical degree and both parities. An exact simple-channel example proves that these energies can grow exponentially. A sharp bound for their joint contraction, with the original wire constraints, remains necessary. The [exact Fourier energy theorem](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_magnetic_energy_profile.md) computes the full folded boundary rate: $5v_3/\pi$ for the odd simple projector and the even completed pair, in operator and Hilbert–Schmidt norms. The local physical-degree maximum is retained. This is a boundary-cost theorem; it does not give the original network's volume limit. The [shrinking-fold extension](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_shrinking_fold_native_energy.md) gives this real norm rate for every sequence $j/N\to1/2$. The [complete-circle shared-cycle source formula](../../notes/actual_matching_graph_shared_cycle_fourier_compiler.md) applies at arbitrary fixed width, with bounded integer flows and the original marked Fourier charge. Its [positive local coefficients](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_fourier_coefficient_variational.md) have a uniform interior variational rate. These results retain the global phase and geometry questions. The [positive partition theorem](../../notes/actual_matching_graph_positive_fourier_partition.md) gives a polynomial-loss Cauchy upper bound for the complete-circle source with all shared constraints retained. Its sharp geometric rate and a matching lower bound remain unproved; the [radial-frame obstruction](../../notes/actual_positive_fourier_radial_geometric_obstruction.md) limits one proposed direct geometric interpretation. The [general four-port theorem](../../notes/actual_general_four_port_single_racah_kernel.md) evaluates actual inverse recoupling coefficients by one finite Racah sum, with the true normalization and normal terms. It is an exact local identity, not a global growth theorem. For supported folded colors, the [local hyperideal-volume theorem](../../notes/actual_four_port_hyperideal_angle_volume.md) proves $$\log W_N=\frac{N}{\pi}\operatorname{Vol}_{\mathrm{ext}}(T)+O(\log N),$$ uniformly across the stated color domain, including boundary sequences. The metric-normalized scalar $W_N$ is essential. The bare factorial sum has a different action. Relevant prior coverage is recorded separately; the local volume relationship is not claimed to be new. For every fixed expression $E$ in the specified positive Conway class, the [whole-source variational theorem](../../notes/actual_positive_conway_variational_limit.md) proves $$\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N}\log Z_{E,N}=2\max_{P_E}V_E.$$ Here $P_E$ is the exact rational support polytope and $V_E$ a concave sum of ideal-tetrahedron volumes. The cylindrical factors now have the actual geometric interpretation above. Cap products retain their exhibited connected-sum decomposition, with additive limits; they are not asserted to have one complete hyperbolic metric. ## Cube sectors are kept separate The cube provides a useful test of shared geometric cores and sewing estimates. The central odd-level sector and the four-rung sum have the stated actual geometric rate. The latter sums all four rung labels while keeping eight cycle labels fixed. Projected chains retain analogous restrictions. ![Cube channels: four blue rungs are summed; eight orange cycle edges remain fixed in the proved four-rung packet.](../figures/cube-channels.png) Removing these cycle projections, controlling the full invariant, and treating even-level cube growth are unresolved. The [four-rung proof](../../notes/actual_cube_four_rung_positive_source.md) and [projected-chain theorem](../../notes/actual_three_port_cauchy_transport_and_cube_kernel.md) preserve those distinctions. The full-cube computations are diagnostics, not a proof of dominance or cancellation control.

title: From the original source to a volume limit
text: # From the original source to a volume limit ## Preserve the source before taking a limit The invariant is a specified contraction of quantum operators, cups, caps, and a marked functional. A formula with the same classical A-curve can still represent a different quantum solution or select a different period. The pointed structure keeps the source, lattice, peripheral data, and marked normal information together. At a root of unity, paired spectral channels can merge. Terms that vanish at the root can contribute to the required derivative. In the current Racah formulas, this includes a retained $[2N]T$ term. Evaluating first and then differentiating a truncated formula loses information. The [torsor status note](../../notes/a_polynomial_torsor_status.md) explains how this viewpoint relates to earlier work in the repository. A classical A-polynomial alone has not supplied the selected period or its absolute geometric normalization. ## Exact finite functions at arbitrary bridge width The [complete-color](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_phase_compiler.md) and [all-color](../../notes/actual_mixed_augmented_plat_compiler.md) formulas now apply to every fixed plat. They specify the physical columns, normal terms, inverse measures and phases before any asymptotic estimate. Their [entire core function](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_entire_core_color_packet.md) has the explicit form $$C_N(\chi)=\sum_{\mathbf j} A_N(\mathbf j)\prod_i\cos(\pi m_{j_i}\chi_i),\qquad m_j=N-2j-1.$$ Here $\chi$ is the auxiliary color deficit divided by $N$. The coefficients are actual marked channel contractions. This finite function has exact Fourier reconstruction and Parseval identities at both parities, including the odd zero-frequency endpoint. At physical high colors it is the source's core; the full source also contains the explicitly retained alias terms. Thus the Fourier proposal has a concrete object to estimate. Parseval controls a norm, while the desired invariant is a particular coherent contraction. A uniform complex asymptotic, physical alias suppression and survival of the geometric contribution still require proof for a general plat. ## The finite polynomials select a local complex action After its forced zero is removed, every actual physical q-Hahn polynomial has simple negative real roots. The [proof](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_negative_root_source_polynomial.md) uses an exact sine recurrence, interlacing and sine coefficient operators; the numerical root checks only test the implementation. Consequently its logarithm, real on the positive axis, is holomorphic on the slit plane. Real factorial estimates first identify its strictly concave positive-axis variational limit. Uniform bounds from the negative roots and the identity theorem then continue the limit to a [uniquely selected holomorphic action](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_selected_complex_action.md). On the physical Fourier arc, the corresponding continued saddle is nondegenerate. This proves the actual local exponential rate while retaining its cancellations. The [actual amplitude theorem](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_uniform_complex_amplitude.md) now strengthens this to a nonzero prefactor and uniform relative error $O(N^{-1})$. Its proof uses the exact finite difference equation and a real normalization, retaining both original integer offsets. The scaled parameters are the actual values at level $N$, so no rate of convergence of those parameters is assumed. The [fixed-degree magnetic corridor](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_magnetic_complex_corridor.md) places every magnetic zero outside the physical strip. The new [joint determinant theorem](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_joint_accretive_determinant.md) goes further: the literal kernel is an explicitly normalized determinant $\det(zI+cD+K)$, with $D>0$ and $K^*=-K$. Its positive Hermitian part excludes zeros in a fixed joint domain, including at folded channels. The [joint amplitude theorem](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_joint_complex_amplitude.md) therefore permits the pair degree and magnetic coordinate to vary together complexly. Exact normalization removes sampling aliases; two original finite shift equations control both derivatives and fix a nonzero amplitude with relative error $O(N^{-1})$. The channel stays an integer. An explicit principal-square-root test identifies the selected local sheet on the central domain. The [full physical packet theorem](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_full_physical_complex_packet.md) now removes the central-domain restriction on fixed physical compacts. A second determinant uses two positive Hermitian matrices to put its zeros in an angular cone outside the physical sector. This supplies uniform inverse and logarithmic bounds. The source characteristic stays simple, so the same exact two-shift proof gives the selected action and nonzero amplitude throughout the full tube. The necessary finite-level boundary correction is retained. ![The joint domain in the real parts of the two physical wire coordinates, with its degree seam excluded.](../figures/joint-kernel-domain.png) The [small-channel normal theorem](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_small_channel_generic_normals.md) retains the original generic source and bounds every fixed derivative by a polynomial times its root value. The [large-partner collision theorem](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_partner_normal_collision.md) expresses the actual paired first normal as a transverse derivative, with its full finite tail. That tail has extra poles, so the ordinary-column domain does not automatically serve the paired normal. The [near-fold complex theorem](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_near_fold_complex_partner_bound.md) now gives subexponential relative cost on a fixed complex compact for $(l-j)\log N=o(N)$. It includes the actual large-channel tail. Fixed nonzero scaled channel shifts and a nonzero normal amplitude remain unresolved. On the physical integer grid, the [paired-normal bound](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_physical_partner_normal_bound.md) is now proved for every complete double channel: $|w/C|\leq N^6/256+N^2/8$, with $O(N^4)$ cost when the scaled degree stays away from one. This includes the original large-channel contribution. The proof uses a positive imaginary part and the exact double-node reflection; integer samples alone do not extend the bound to a fixed complex neighborhood. The [physical generic-jet theorem](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_physical_generic_jet_bound.md) controls every fixed q derivative of all admissible physical columns and genuine divided pairs. It uses the actual forward and backward generic recurrences, retaining their distinct offdiagonal coefficients. This supplies higher physical jets without differentiating a root-only identity. It is separate from the complex-domain theorem and from a completed target tensor norm. The [common-framing criterion](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_physical_framing_criterion.md) gives finite inequalities for one rank-one projector. The new [right-angled obstruction](../../notes/actual_right_angled_selected_framing_obstruction.md) rules out an all-central selected frame for the certified right-angled decomposition. Generic oriented-strip flags localize the weaker physical-support failures to any two prescribed distinct factors, at any bridge width, including the pair adjacent to the original mark. The [selected-factor localization](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_selected_factor_localization.md) now puts every other ordinary factor on the selected full physical packet. A contributing global cycle and sharp control of the completed contraction remain open. Choosing the exceptional pair at one crossing-circle edge gives four physical outside ports. The [matching-edge scalar](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_racah_positive_scalar.md) is then positive for every target channel, including high partners. The complete-circle [typed block identity](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_marked_four_port_block.md) keeps the original cup, turn, circle measure and marked trace normal. The circle measure cancels its exponential row factor exactly. Only Taylor orders through two are needed after clearing the simple poles. The [completed-projector identity](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_completed_projector_block.md) now cancels the remaining target scalar normalization exactly. It combines colliding channels before specialization, retaining both their regular projector and nilpotent term. Only first derivatives of these completed operators and the complement remain; the scalar divided difference still includes the necessary second derivatives of the original weights. The resulting upper estimate is a positive scalar sum weighted by the native completed-projector and complementary-network costs. These costs are not assumed to be subexponential. This makes the remaining norm problem explicit without supplying a lower bound or changing the selected period. The [native-energy theorem](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_native_projector_energy.md) expresses the first of these costs through original columns and their exact bilinear measures. Every fixed derivative adds only a polynomial factor. The energy itself can grow exponentially: the degree-$t=m$ block of the simple midpoint projector at odd level $N=2m+1$ has rate $v_8/(2\pi)$. The full operator combines its physical degrees in one maximum or square sum; the wire constraints must remain shared when these operators are joined. This rules out dropping the energy as a normalization cost. The [full matching-graph identity](../../notes/general_matching_graph_full_normal_source.md) is a complementary exact assembly tool: all folded sectors form one generic network with the original physical trace normal retained. It holds at both parities and uses the graph of the actual crossing-disk cut. No vanishing channel norm is inverted. ## The exceptional block is an actual operator period The [generic polynomial theorem](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_geometric_target_polynomial.md) writes the completed block as $D_a^{-1}p_a(\Omega)$, before every normal extraction. Its [zeros are all above two](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_racah_root_location.md), so the finite polynomial selects a canonical logarithm and scalar action. The [general generating relation](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_polynomial_geometric_action.md) matches the actual four-parabolic character equation, including the inverse-turn sign and the source's additive scalar anchor. The target is fixed by the original ports: $z=\operatorname{Tr}(B_{\rm in}^{-1}B_{\rm out})=2-4/c^2$. The [marked-word theorem](../../notes/actual_matching_circle_rectangle_bound.md) proves $c\leq1$ for the actual certified complete geometry, including half twists. Thus a nonparabolic target lies below $-2$; a formal real rectangle with $c>1$ cannot supply that complete marked quotient. A polynomial of degree proportional to $N$ still cannot be replaced by its scalar value inside a contraction. The [exact period](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_continuant_operator_period.md) is $$p_a(\Omega)=\frac{1}{2\pi i}\oint_\Gamma p_a(z)(zI-\Omega)^{-1}\,dz.$$ Its original Green entries retain both continuants and the full characteristic denominator. The [strict-support theorem](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_cross_central_green_action.md) proves their selected leading action and bounds every fixed generic derivative when the two physical rows straddle the midpoint and $z$ lies in the stated common prefix domain, including fixed compact real intervals below $-2$. On the anti-diagonal they are exactly negative for real $z<-2$. The actual surrounding state is not thereby a positive functional or a continuant eigenstate. The [finite-propagation identity](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_polynomial_finite_propagation.md) does give exact scalar action on a forward continuant in rows $u\leq t-a$, and on a backward continuant in rows $u\geq a$. These precise windows can leave a central gap. The environment and any complex magnetic continuation remain additional input. Separate [polynomial](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_polynomial_endpoint_control.md) and [full-resolvent](../../notes/actual_casimir_endpoint_resolvent_bound.md) bounds control the closing point $+2$ and its genuine normals on shrinking neighborhoods. They do not settle the possible geometric parabolic target $-2$, or the contour between the endpoint neighborhood and the candidate saddle. The remaining task is an estimate of the actual period and its coherent sewing. ## Exact shifts transport finite quantum jets The [moving-period factorial](../../notes/actual_moving_period_factorial_normals.md) is a specified meromorphic function that equals the original quantum factorial at every supported integer index. With $P=\pi i/\log\zeta$, it satisfies two exact equations: $$\widehat F_P(z+1)=(1-e^{2\pi i(z+1)/P})\widehat F_P(z),\qquad \widehat F_P(z+P)=(1-e^{2\pi i z})\widehat F_P(z).$$ At $P=N$, the second equation is also the cyclotomic product of the first $N$ shifts. Their multipliers satisfy the commuting-shift identity. The Gamma product fixes the actual section and its logarithmic marks; the shift equations alone are not a uniqueness theorem. Put $\Delta=N-P$ and $c(z)=1-e^{2\pi i z}$. The exact fixed-$N$ transport is $$\widehat F_P(z+N)=e^{\Delta\partial_z}\bigl(c(z)\widehat F_P(z)\bigr).$$ Modulo the $(J+1)$st power of the quantum deformation parameter, this exponential stops after $J$ derivatives. Away from $c=0$, conjugating by $c$ gives a unipotent operator whose difference from the identity has nilpotence index at most $J+1$. The connection has explicit poles at the integers. They account for genuine normal residues and cannot be removed by root specialization. The [specified exceptional lift](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_generic_deficient_operator_lift.md) uses this same factorial and the original large white numerators to bound the full generic operator near the actual complex geometric frame. The [boundary theorem](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_degree_cycle_boundary.md) computes what is added when its contour crosses the channel poles. These statements organize the exact source transport; selecting a surviving geometric contribution to the whole period remains the global task. The [tensor-source connection](../../notes/actual_tensor_source_finite_jet_connection.md) gives a rational gauge for the assembled summand itself. Put $g(z)=e^{2\pi iz}/(1-e^{2\pi iz})$. Its shift ratio is exactly the nonconstant cup multiplier. Products of $g$ and its inverse at the actual ordered cup and cap arguments give a specified gauge $G$. On a primitive free head lattice, the transport in direction $b$ is $$T_b=\chi(b)\,G\,e^{(N-P)D_b}\,G^{-1},$$ where $\chi$ is the retained parity character and $D_b$ is the directional derivative. These operators commute. On order-$J$ jets, every product of $J+1$ normalized differences from the identity vanishes. Constant head arguments require no gauge factor. The source remains undivided in its original period integral: $G$ can have zeros or poles on the physical lattice, whose boundary terms must still be computed. The [adjoint connection on the actual period](../../notes/actual_tensor_source_translated_cycle_normals.md) follows by finite-order integration by parts on that unchanged closed cycle. It acts on the original cotangent density multiplied by $G$, producing the required finite-part and double-pole terms. It is an exact relation between specified translated periods, with no claim that a translated head lies in the physical basis or that a geometric contour has been reached. The [complete local marked-density theorem](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_local_marked_density.md) then assembles the selected factors with the original unrestricted mark. Their absolute normalization gives a nonzero fixed-channel density. At the complete geometric point, the channel Hessian is diagonal with entries $-4\pi i/\tau_i$, where $\tau_i$ are the actual primitive cusp shapes. After retaining the exact integer characters, the local sum over the original folded nodes is a nonzero Gaussian at both level parities. This establishes a local complete-source coefficient; the framing integral and its appearance in the original global cycle remain to be proved. The [braided change of cut](../../notes/actual_braided_two_cut_source_adapter.md) keeps this global question within the original source. Transporting a matrix-unit insertion by the recorded braid gives an exact second functional extracting the same marked scalar, with its genuine generic pivot and every derivative retained. The construction is independent of bridge width and permits different Morse levels. It does not eliminate the remaining two-cut array or evaluate the framing integral. Two further calculations specify that remaining integral. The [local source Ward theorem](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_framing_density_source_ward.md) proves that its framing density is $-c_D\,dr\wedge ds/[s(1+s)]$, with a nonzero framing-independent coefficient and the original mark retained. The [finite residual-current theorem](../../notes/actual_braided_residual_framing_current.md) supplies the corresponding source-defined off-diagonal bands and exact interval boundary terms. These are distinct results: transporting the actual finite chain to the geometric relative boundary, and evaluating its coefficient there, is still required. The [common charged head chart](../../notes/actual_matching_graph_common_band_ward_current.md) now constructs the Ward currents meromorphically before contraction, retaining the distinct band-support cycles. At the resonant boundary, [factorial estimates for growing head indices](../../notes/actual_moving_period_factorial_logarithmic_escape.md), [root polynomial packets](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_resonant_hard_edge.md), and the [genuine moving-parameter packet](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_generic_resonant_hard_edge.md) give controlled pieces of the required matching calculation. Their scope is explicit: the whole source and its selected relative cycle still need to be assembled. ## Exact recoupling exposes a local geometric scalar Four external objects can be paired in two ways. The actual change of basis is computed before root specialization, with its genuine pivotal turn. ![The two pairings of four ports. The internal labels E and G are summed in the actual basis change.](../figures/four-port.png) The resulting finite Racah sum admits a positive, face-normalized scalar on the supported folded chamber. Its logarithmic rate is the volume of a specific hyperideal tetrahedron. This closes a local algebra-to-geometry step. It does not yet bound every entry of the completed physical transport in the required metric. A source normalization can have poles or zeros at the root, and complementary channels carry additional normal currents. The [scalar and normal theorem](../../notes/actual_supported_racah_common_phase_and_normal_metric.md) states what is controlled and what remains. An [exact partner-reflection theorem](../../notes/actual_racah_partner_reflection_identity.md) now proves that all 64 complementary color choices have the same normalized root value. It uses the actual reciprocal source coefficients and residues of channel projectors on a regular invariant lattice. The same work gives an exact counterexample to equality of first normal derivatives. Root-value symmetry therefore helps organize the source without removing the normal-transport problem. The [all-partner first-normal theorem](../../notes/actual_all_partner_first_normal_bound.md) now controls every supported reflected branch. A positive finite presentation of the complete generic source, combined with the exact Ward and Fourier identities, gives $|K'_B(q)|\leq C N^2(1+\log N)W_N^2$ and a logarithmic relative bound for the coherent tail itself. The earlier two-current obstruction remains valid for those earlier relations alone; the new source presentation supplies the missing information. General higher normal orders and the completed physical transport metric remain open. ## Weighted Cauchy needs the right energy For a single complete physical column, the [exact Plancherel theorem](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_magnetic_energy_profile.md) now proves $$\frac{N}{j+1}|\widehat f(t/2)|^2\leq\sum_{u=0}^t|C_j(t,u)|^2\leq N|\widehat f(t/2)|^2.$$ The unused Fourier nodes vanish in the original polynomial, so the full discrete Fourier norm equals the actual physical norm. This works at both parities, including a half-integral midpoint. Combined with the exact bilinear measure, it gives the complete-channel energy profile and the full folded operator rate $5v_3/\pi$. Shared magnetic sums and phases remain when these operators are joined. The [shrinking-fold theorem](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_shrinking_fold_native_energy.md) extends that full real operator rate to every integer sequence $j/N\to1/2$. Fixed generic derivatives add only polynomial cost. This real norm statement permits a wider channel window than the separate complex-normal theorem; it supplies no complex confluent amplitude. There is also an exact [Fourier compiler for the complete-circle matching source](../../notes/actual_matching_graph_shared_cycle_fourier_compiler.md). Its matching magnetic indices are bounded integral Kirchhoff flows on the graph of physical cycles. The actual cups and caps make every cycle frequency even at both level parities, so its Fourier sums impose coupled congruences. The original mark supplies a one-unit charge. All source phases remain in this finite formula. Cauchy then gives a joint positive comparison of coherent cycle periods with the matching labels still shared. The [coefficient-duality theorem](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_fourier_coefficient_variational.md) controls the positive Fourier coefficients themselves. Their log-concavity gives $$p_k\leq\inf_{w>0}P(w)w^{-k}\leq(j+1)p_k.$$ The actual selected source action supplies the corresponding coefficient rate and an explicit positive minimizing radius on compact interior slope families. This is a two-sided local estimate. To use it globally, the actions must be joined on the compiler's flow and charge constraints, with its remaining phases retained. The [positive Fourier partition](../../notes/actual_matching_graph_positive_fourier_partition.md) now supplies an explicit full-source comparison. If $R$ is the number of matching circles and $C$ the number of restored physical cycles, its exact original scalar weights give $$|A_{D,N}|^2\leq N^{4R+2C-2}Z_F(N).$$ Every Kirchhoff equation, Fourier congruence and the original marked charge remains in $Z_F$. Its summands are products of positive coefficients and explicit sine-factorial weights. The equality before Cauchy retains all phases; this upper bound does not establish their survival. The [radial reconstruction obstruction](../../notes/actual_positive_fourier_radial_geometric_obstruction.md) explains a remaining difficulty. At a strict positive radial saddle, all ordinary source factors would lie in the central selected domain. They therefore cannot all assemble into the complete geometric representation of the certified right-angled cut in one frame. This is a conditional geometric obstruction, with no asserted numerical rate gap. The exact phases and the exceptional matching-block route remain essential to investigate. A useful inequality has the form $$|K_N|^2\leq e^{o(N)}Z_N.$$ Weighted Cauchy can prove such an estimate once the inner product, original source cost, and dual cost are explicit. Choosing a positive form alone does not make those costs small. The repository contains exact counterexamples to proposed unmarked norms and to replacing a full magnetic tensor by its scalar rate. The whole-support boundary Gram theorem gives polynomial costs on each supported local cell. The next step is to transport this control through the actual global composition. Correlated seam labels must remain shared; maximizing local factors independently can change the answer. For specified planar three-port reflection doubles, there is now a stronger [exact full-source identity](../../notes/actual_planar_three_port_reflection_double.md): $$Z_N^{\mathrm{double}}=\sum_{\mathbf a\in\mathcal D_N}\frac{|Z_N^{\mathrm{half}}(\mathbf a)|^2}{\theta_N(\mathbf a)}\geq0.$$ Every interior color is already coherently summed inside the half-packet. This includes the actual normals at both level parities. Since there are at most $N^3$ boundary triples, the doubled source differs from its largest squared weighted packet by at most that polynomial factor. Its asymptotic is therefore reduced to estimating the half-packets, whose internal cancellations have not disappeared. Positivity here allows zeros and is not a nonvanishing theorem for arbitrary plats. The retained Fourier phase now has an [exact integer quadratic form](../../notes/actual_matching_graph_centered_fourier_phase.md). The [holomorphic Legendre transport](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_holomorphic_fourier_legendre_transport.md) restores that phase and the original winding characters in the selected ordinary action. Its [global chart](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_global_fourier_legendre_chart.md) is one-to-one on the full physical tube. These are action and coordinate theorems; they do not analytically continue individual finite Fourier coefficients or select the global source cycle. ## An upper bound is only half of equality For sources with phases, a matching lower bound requires survival of the geometric contribution. A large positive comparison partition does not exclude cancellation in the original invariant. The [local energy geometry](../../notes/actual_native_magnetic_energy_local_geometry.md) makes this distinction explicit. The highest-weight block at the fold has the volume action of a variable ideal octahedron. Away from the fold, its actual measure forces a signed boundary term. Even at the real energy maximum, the marked complex phase need not be stationary. A global argument must use the original incidence and peripheral conditions to address those phases. For the specified positive Conway expressions, positivity supplies a different route. Exact support is an additive integer semigroup, which approximates a maximizing configuration along every sufficiently large level. Uniform factorial estimates prove the whole-source variational limit. The new geometric argument then proves that the reduced maximum is strict, matches the actual quadrilateral faces, and reconstructs the complete complement of every retained cylindrical factor. The new mixed-color proof supplies the additional filling estimates: exact leaf aliases lie in a square-zero radical, a strict seed-level gap survives arbitrary positive composition, and a finite complex lattice window has a nonzero Gaussian amplitude. This proves the long-full-twist source limit. The separate exact face-map and peripheral construction now identifies its rate with actual filled volume. The unchanged pure grammar still cannot produce knots by those fillings. Signed half twists change that source and its connectivity. The new [supporting-plane argument](../../notes/actual_odd_conway_uniform_mixed_source_gap.md) bounds any number of propagated aliases by adding tangents to the same global action; the linear terms cancel under the actual wire constraints. A separately checked finite complex packet supplies the nonzero contribution. This works for every fixed $C(FG)$ with robust children, and the corresponding marked geometry gives the filled knot and link equality stated in the results chapter. The next boundary pieces now use the same original geometry: [literal prefix signs](../../notes/actual_right_angled_resonant_prefix_signs.md), [generic complemented heads and the outgoing determinant](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_complementary_hard_edge.md), and the [finite negative-clock boundary rate](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_negative_clock_boundary.md). The finite-current theorem also supplies an exact family of band weights that extracts the original root scalar after explicit bounded normalization. At the complete root this functional reduces to the existing coherent cut after a parameter change, so the residual framing freedom remains. The global internal-period comparison is still open.

title: Why the right side is hyperbolic volume
text: # Why the right side is hyperbolic volume ## The current general construction For a connected labeled right-angled augmented plat at any fixed bridge width, the [signed complete-source theorem](../../notes/general_signed_augmented_source_volume.md) identifies the original source rate with the actual complete volume. The [fixed complex core theorem](../../notes/actual_complete_core_complex_packet.md) now gives a nonzero analytic asymptotic for its complete-image external-color term. The older local and operator routes below retain their separate scopes. The [marked circle-pattern theorem](../../notes/actual_marked_deformed_circle_pattern.md) reconstructs the two exceptional boundary faces as parallel lines and solves simultaneously for all finite circle centers and radii. The original positive face Hessian, followed by elementary rigidity of the center triangles, proves that this system has an invertible Jacobian. Its unique nearby solution has exactly the stationary radii of the source action, with one shared strip width and the selected boundary eigenlines retained. ![The actual marked lines retain their shared width and the selected eigenlines as matching tangencies deform.](../figures/marked-circle-strip.png) The [primitive collar theorem](../../notes/actual_deformed_circle_primitive_collar.md) computes the actual side pairing, selected eigenflag and half-twist shear, including a common marked-line limit. The [global geometric assembly](../../notes/actual_complete_core_geometric_deformation.md) verifies the full original group presentation and identifies the core's limiting action with the marked geometric deformation. For complex meridian logs it retains the boundary correction $\tfrac12\sum_i\operatorname{Re}U_i\operatorname{Im}V_i$; for real external deficits this correction vanishes. The full filling theorem still requires the other reflected-color terms and the combined far-alias bounds described in the [frontier](frontier.md). For an identity-smoothed source, the [block capacity theorem](../../notes/actual_smoothed_source_capacity_blocks.md) removes the need to assume an attained positive-radius minimum. It splits degenerate angle problems along two-edge cycles and constructs each simple block's actual polyhedron. The [block representation and volume theorem](../../notes/actual_smoothed_block_representation_volume.md) then retains the original face pairings and realizes their volume sum as a regulator of the original group. Its deleted meridians lie in the kernel, so the [strict-kernel theorem](../../notes/general_representation_volume_kernel_strictness.md) proves strict loss for every nonempty connected untwisted smoothing with finite capacity. Loop-infeasible cases already have an arbitrarily low capacity bound. The chain argument uses a controlled finite degeneration: cut corners have a common horospherical height and mutual distance $O(T^{-1})$. A uniform short-edge tetrahedron estimate makes the added volume vanish. Arbitrary ideal vertices merely approaching one another would not justify this step. The [near-maximal-volume corollary](../../notes/general_representation_volume_peripheral_gap.md) also gives uniform gaps from fixed marked peripheral trace conditions; applying those gaps to the remaining quantum color complement is still a source-estimate problem. ## A local tetrahedron is a genuine geometric result In the supported four-port theorem, the exact half-shifted color coordinate is $$a_e=\frac{j_e+1/2}{N},\qquad \alpha_e=\pi-2\pi a_e.$$ The normalized scalar action is identified with the volume of the truncated hyperideal tetrahedron with these dihedral angles. The proof constructs its Lorentzian face Gram matrix, recovers edge lengths, checks the volume differential, and fixes the additive constant by an ideal calibration. Boundary values are continuous volume extensions. ![A truncated tetrahedron in a combinatorial projection. Blue triangles indicate polar truncation faces; the hyperbolic metric comes from the Gram matrix.](../figures/truncated-tetrahedron.png) This is stronger than observing that a factorial action resembles a dilogarithm. It is also local: a collection of such tetrahedra does not automatically form the knot complement. ## The global angle slice carries the topology An actual ideal triangulation specifies which faces are glued, which tetrahedron edges belong to each manifold edge, and which peripheral curves represent meridians and longitudes. Its angle constraints must retain this incidence. At a candidate maximum, stationarity must hold in every allowed angle direction. The corresponding shape and length equations must make adjacent cells agree. The resulting developing map must have the intended winding and end behavior. Complete cusps, or the specified filled peripheral equations, are part of the certificate. The [source-volume certificate](../../notes/source_volume_casson_rivin_certificate.md) keeps these requirements explicit. An algebraic critical point can be isolated and still belong to the wrong component or have the wrong peripheral marking. ## A general certificate through volume maximization For an actual marked ideal triangulation with torus vertex links, the [positive gluing criterion](../../notes/general_marked_positive_gluing_certificate.md) gives a direct proof of the Casson–Rivin equivalence: an interior critical point of the ideal-tetrahedron volume function is exactly a complete positive gluing. Strict concavity makes it the unique maximum, including over the closed angle polytope, and its value is the actual complement volume. The proof keeps the geometry explicit. Lagrange multipliers prescribe one truncated length for each global edge. These lengths determine compatible corner horospheres; the face maps then match them, giving complete flat cusp tori. Conversely, compatible horospheres make the geometric volume stationary under all allowed angle variations. There is a finite algebraic certificate using positive upper-half-plane phases and positive multiplier variables. The unique optimum has algebraic shapes. Neither its dilogarithm volume nor the original quantum period is asserted to be an algebraic number. Existence of an interior optimum on a proposed triangulation, and selection of its period by the quantum source, remain distinct questions. For fixed critical shapes, the positive multiplier solutions form a concrete torsor: one independent positive horosphere scale per cusp acts freely and transitively. This accounts for the decoration freedom in the algebraic certificate. It does not yet determine the quantum period, and extending the action to complex scalars requires retaining its sign kernels. For augmented plats, the [actual matching-graph construction](../../notes/general_augmented_plat_matching_geometry.md) is one way to supply this certificate: a positive labeled right-angled polyhedron gives the marked complete exterior and an explicit positive ideal triangulation. The general gluing criterion does not require that particular polyhedral decomposition or a bound on bridge width. ## The general endpoint action has the actual volume normalization The original augmented-plat coupon now has an [exact local critical-character map](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_local_critical_character_map.md). It preserves the whole ordered meridian product, recovers the actual crossing-circle transport and retains both physical degree charts and signed half twists. On a correctly marked stationary branch, the original Fourier coupling gives $d(2\pi i\phi)=\tfrac12\sum_i V_i\,dU_i$ in its specified peripheral convention. A [generic-framing theorem](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_regular_geometric_phase_chart.md) places the complete geometric representation in regular charts for every coupon simultaneously. It also solves the unrestricted integral degree-lifting problem. It does not put that candidate into a contributing physical support chamber or choose a contributing Poisson sector. The [endpoint regulator theorem](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_endpoint_regulator.md) fixes the absolute constant. The fully normalized q-Hahn action and the original crossing-circle diagram have the same rational wedge. Their Bloch–Wigner regulators agree at a real point and hence throughout the connected regular chart. The original diagram cycle has degree one on each cusp, so its regulator is the actual augmented-link volume. The full stationary-action identity then gives $$2\pi\operatorname{Re}\phi(0)=\operatorname{Vol}(Y_D).$$ This holds at a regular, correctly marked full geometric critical point; the fixed endpoint channel has purely imaginary logarithm and introduces no residual real contribution. The theorem fixes the geometric candidate's value. A quantum cycle coefficient, a nonzero amplitude and bounds for other contributions remain separate parts of the general conjecture. The same marked matrices now determine the [channel Hessian](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_channel_hessian.md), without assuming a deformation theorem. If the endpoint transport is $I+b_iH_i$ with $H_i^2=0$, the actual primitive cusp shape is $\tau_i=(b_i-\epsilon_i/2)^{-1}$. After the two internal q-Hahn variables are eliminated on their marked critical sheets, $$\frac{\partial^2 F}{\partial\xi_i\partial\xi_j}=-\delta_{ij}\frac{4\pi i}{\tau_i},\qquad \frac{\partial^2 F}{\partial\xi_i\partial y}=0.$$ Here $y$ denotes the remaining magnetic variables. Since $\operatorname{Im}\tau_i>0$, this channel block has negative real part. Eliminating those channels gives the color Hessian $\pi i\operatorname{diag}(\tau_i)$, with the factor of two in the transfer convention retained. The [marked multi-cusp rigidity theorem](../../notes/general_marked_multicusp_gluing_rigidity.md) supplies a direct deformation proof from an actual positive ideal gluing certificate. Positive polarization makes the marked gluing Jacobian invertible; the developing-map inverse retains exact peripheral eigenflags, including infinitesimal data. The [actual critical-scheme theorem](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_critical_scheme.md) then reconstructs the whole ordered representation from the stationary magnetic variables and conversely. The magnetic Hessian has exactly two null directions, both from framing. After taking a transverse slice, there is a nearby holomorphic geometric stationary branch, with the displayed peripheral differential and absolute volume anchor. This classical existence statement is general in plat width under the certificate. Selecting it from the original quantum sum remains a separate unresolved theorem. There is now an explicit [physical framing test](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_physical_framing_criterion.md) for the domain of the joint kernel theorem. One rank-one projector records the common frame; traces of the original prefix words give finite strict inequalities for every input and output. The theorem distinguishes these inequalities from mere avoidance of algebraic chart poles. The [local sheet test](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_joint_complex_amplitude.md) then checks which characteristic root the finite source selects. Neither test asserts that a common solution or a contributing global cycle always exists. The [right-angled framing obstruction](../../notes/actual_right_angled_selected_framing_obstruction.md) now rules out an all-central selected common frame for the certified right-angled plats. In the Lorentz model, the white face normals form a convex polyhedron whose facets correspond to the original shaded triangles. Under the oriented geometric strip conditions, the two flags determine a line through its interior. At each facet crossed by that line, a nonnegative relation among the three actual prefix diagonals violates strict physical support. Generic flags cross exactly two facets, so the obstruction involves exactly two local factors at every bridge width. Any two distinct facets can be prescribed, including the pair incident to the original marked physical edge. The [selected-factor corollary](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_selected_factor_localization.md), using the [full physical packet](../../notes/actual_q_hahn_full_physical_complex_packet.md), now proves that every other ordinary factor is physical and source-selected. The selected square root is continued from the original source; the old pointwise principal-root test is not assumed outside the central domain. The completed contraction and global quantum cycle remain unresolved. ![A schematic section of the white-normal convex polyhedron: the polarization line crosses two facets, locating the two strict physical-support failures.](../figures/two-exceptional-factors.png) For the complete-circle source, the pair at a crossing-circle matching edge now has an [exact four-port source rewrite](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_marked_four_port_block.md). Its four outside objects are all physical, so the [positive scalar estimate](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_racah_positive_scalar.md) applies to every target channel, independently of bridge width. The original row measure cancels its exponential factorial gauge. The target tensor, remaining network and global cycle still require control; the geometric localization alone supplies none of those estimates. The [finite selected-critical certificate](../../notes/actual_augmented_plat_selected_local_certificate.md) combines the positive gluing, common-frame and local-sheet tests, retaining the original logarithmic characters. When supplied, it identifies the geometric stationary germ with the source-selected local principal phase. At completeness the sheet tests also have an exact interpretation as oriented regions between the two actual disk circles. For other geometric realizations, existence of that simultaneous certificate remains open. Selection of a contributing global quantum cycle is unresolved. The same deformation coordinates give a [geometric long-filling corollary](../../notes/general_augmented_plat_long_filling_quantifiers.md) without a quantum input. Write $V_i(U)=U_i t_i(U)$ and set $e_i=1/p_i$ at filled cusps, $e_i=0$ at unfilled ones. The equations $V_i(U)+e_iU_i=-2\pi i e_i$ have an invertible Jacobian at completeness and a solution in one fixed polydisk. Their exact factorization bounds each $|U_i|$ by a constant times $|e_i|$. The existing geometric completion argument therefore applies to all independently long signed slopes. This proves the geometric threshold, while the volume-limit threshold still requires the quantum estimates. ## The local maximum can be the wrong global maximum The four face-support inequalities alone are insufficient. In the local hyperideal theorem, differentiating the normalized action with respect to a color gives the corresponding edge length. Increasing every color preserves those support inequalities and pushes the maximum to an octahedral boundary configuration. A manifold saddle therefore requires the actual global edge constraints or additional boundary contributions. This is a concrete obstruction to deriving the complement volume by multiplying separately maximized local estimates. There is now an exact [geometric interpretation of a native magnetic energy](../../notes/actual_native_magnetic_energy_local_geometry.md). At the folded color, the highest-weight degree block gives four positive ideal tetrahedra forming a convex ideal octahedron, whose maximum is $v_8$. The full boundary operator has the larger rate computed in the [Plancherel theorem](../../notes/actual_matching_edge_magnetic_energy_profile.md). Away from the fold the normalized summands require a signed face term. These are local comparison geometries; placing their cells in the actual complement and matching the remaining phase equations still requires proof. The [positive radial Fourier obstruction](../../notes/actual_positive_fourier_radial_geometric_obstruction.md) makes the phase issue concrete for the general certified right-angled source. Its retained cycle congruences close particular local momentum characters, including the cup signs and marked charge. They do not supply the real magnetic-coordinate matching equations carried by the discarded coefficient phases. An all-ordinary strict radial reconstruction would contradict the common-frame theorem above. This excludes that proposed geometric assembly, without asserting a strict gap between positive and coherent exponential rates. ## Shared cores explain the cube test For the certified augmented graph geometry, the actual volume has the form $$4b\,v_8+2\operatorname{Vol}(Q),$$ where $Q$ is the supplied positive ideal right-angled core and the precise cut, face, and cusp identifications are checked. The core is shared by the graph; it is not a sum of independent vertex constants. The cube is a useful nontrivial example of this phenomenon. Its projected quantum calculations recover the shared core contribution. Extending those estimates to the full source is still a quantum problem, even after the geometric complement has been constructed. ## The Conway maximum now builds the actual complement The [global Conway geometry theorem](../../notes/actual_positive_conway_hyperbolic_volume.md) supplies the missing face-pairing certificate for every retained cylindrical robust factor. A leaf is an ideal quadrangular pyramid. A multiplication gate is a convex ideal triangular prism. Their volumes are exactly the source actions, and their ordered quadrilateral metrics are exponentials of the action derivatives. ![The source's leaf pyramid and multiplication prism. Blue faces are ordered quadrilateral ports; the shaded leaf triangles retain the actual crossing-disk pairing.](../figures/conway-cells.png) Stationarity makes the shared ports isometric under the literal stack maps. A boundary barrier proves that every unforced cell at the maximum is strict. The cells assemble into a convex ideal polyhedron; the actual cylindrical closure leaves only right-angled boundary edges. Reversing the projection and crossing-disk cuts reconstructs the original link. Four-step edge cycles give angle $2\pi$ with identity return, and matched rectangular horosphere links prove cusp completeness. Thus the two-copy volume is the volume of the actual complement. The [closed bowtie-cut proof](../../notes/actual_conway_bowtie_projection_cut.md) identifies every oriented white and shaded face from the literal original wires. It corrects an earlier overstatement about open cells: a quadrilateral port alone is not half of the physical four-punctured tangle boundary. The closed reconstruction uses the entire labeled ribbon graph and reversible disk cut. It also gives each complete crossing-circle cusp its primitive shape $2i\cot(\pi x_i)$. The final product gate is forced flat and is removed from the geometric cell list using its exact unit source coefficient. This does not delete a quantum contribution or a link component. The [local cell proof](../../notes/actual_newton_ideal_prism_and_associativity.md) also identifies source associativity with two triangulations of one actual ideal cube. The [cap-sum reduction](../../notes/actual_conway_cap_sum_reduction.md) goes further: an actual two-punctured separating sphere splits every cap-closed product into componentwise connected sums. The quantum source factors and the angle polytope splits with it. This gives connected sums of theta links with strictly positive rate $4k v_8$, although the whole complement is not hyperbolic for $k\geq2$. ## The maximum now has an algebraic source class The [algebraic optimizer theorem](../../notes/positive_source_algebraic_volume_period.md) applies to every rational affine ideal-angle problem with positive rational weights. On the smallest face containing the maxima, flat atoms contribute zero. The remaining Hessian is definite after quotienting by the rational directions that leave all nonflat angles unchanged. Exponentiated stationarity then proves that the nonflat shapes are algebraic, including boundary and nonunique maxima. The [Bloch regulator calculation](../../notes/actual_positive_source_bloch_regulator.md) proves that the conjugate-antisymmetrized shape sum is a rational Bloch class with regulator equal to the source maximum. For the retained cylindrical factors, the new actual cell realization supplies its geometric interpretation. The class comparison takes place after passing to a common finite conjugation-stable number field containing the source shapes and all glued ideal vertex coordinates. The two copies have opposite mirror orientations, producing precisely the shape symbols $[z]-[\overline z]$ of the geometric fundamental chain; no identification with the geometric trace field is claimed. For every fixed robust positive Conway expression, the proved full-source statement is $$\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N}\log Z_{E,N} =R_{F_E}(B_E),\qquad B_E=\sum_j([z_j]-[\overline{z_j}])\in B(F_E)_{\mathbb Q}.$$ Here $F_E=\mathbb Q(z_j,\overline{z_j})$ is the conjugation-stable source shape field. The regulator uses the specified complex embedding. For a retained cylindrical factor its value is now proved to be the actual complement volume. The theorem does not establish a generic-meridian knot quantum A-operator or volume limits for arbitrary short fillings. The [boundary profile theorem](../../notes/actual_conway_boundary_volume_relation.md) also gives a full limit for every coefficient approaching any output $b\in[0,1]$. On $(0,1)$ its optimizer is unique and analytic, and its boundary conjugate is the actual quadrilateral modulus $\exp(-v'_E(b)/\pi)$. This is a geometric meaning for the source boundary relation; the variable is not yet the knot's peripheral holonomy. ## The deformed source has actual peripheral holonomy The [marked deformation theorem](../../notes/actual_conway_marked_peripheral_deformation.md) constructs a representation of the actual link group for the auxiliary-color critical branch. Exact Möbius identities establish every white seam and shaded edge relation, including translations. All main cusps stay parabolic. For each auxiliary circle the primitive logarithms are $$U_i=-2\pi i\chi_i,\qquad V_i=-2\partial_i\phi(\chi).$$ Thus the source primitive $G=2\pi i\phi$ satisfies $dG=\tfrac12\sum_i V_i\,dU_i$, with its constant fixed by the complete fundamental-chain volume. Exponentiated source stationarity gives an algebraic marked peripheral branch; the selected branch is locally a Lagrangian graph in the auxiliary peripheral coordinates, with the main cusps held parabolic. The displayed peripheral multipliers are squared SL eigenvalues, and no entire A-polynomial is inferred merely by elimination. At the original filling saddle, $U_i+p_iV_i=-2\pi i$ holds in the primitive disk marking. The actual nearby representation and the boundary-corrected regulator then identify the full quantum rate with the volume of the correctly filled complement. This applies to every retained robust factor and independently sufficiently long fixed signed integral fillings of any selected auxiliary circles. The component theorem keeps its link-only scope explicit. ## Half twists preserve the marked action through a shear The [odd-coupon deformation](../../notes/actual_odd_conway_marked_peripheral_deformation.md) changes the shaded face pairings and checks their edge words at general complex parameters. The original odd-link peripheral paths give $$U_i^\epsilon=U_i^0-\frac{\epsilon_i}{2}V_i^0,\qquad V_i^\epsilon=V_i^0,\qquad G_\epsilon=G_0-\sum_i\frac{\epsilon_i}{8}(V_i^0)^2.$$ These are also the exact derivatives and quadratic correction of the selected finite-source action. On the marked double cover $\ell_i^2=L_i$, the half-longitude change becomes the integral monomial map $M_i^\epsilon=M_i^0\ell_i^{-\epsilon_i}$. The source selects the square root and its logarithm. This is a concrete torsor carrying the required peripheral information. ![Left: a primitive filling slope on a schematic cusp torus. Right: local sheets of the peripheral square-root cover, with the selected branch and integral shear.](../figures/peripheral-torsor.png) The square is a fundamental domain, not a metric cusp shape. Its amber segments form the single primitive curve $\mu+2\lambda$ after opposite sides are identified. The two sheets on the right are a local picture of $\ell^2=L$; the cover is not asserted to split globally. The selected logarithm retains the primitive filling equation $U+pV=-2\pi i$. Smooth filling uses the primitive basis of the **changed link**. Substituting a half-integer slope into the pure-link formula would double the primitive rotation angle when denominators are cleared. The actual odd-link construction avoids that error, keeps main cusps parabolic, and fixes the regulator at its complete volume. Together with the full changed-source estimates it yields the [general signed Conway knot and link theorem](../../notes/actual_odd_conway_long_filling_volume.md).

title: The current general frontier
text: # The current general frontier The target remains a volume theorem at **every fixed bridge width**, with independently long signed twists. The general filled-knot conjecture is open. There is now a complete-source equality for a broader intermediate class: augmented links with any fixed retained half-twist pattern whose actual diagram carries the labeled right-angled polyhedral certificate. ## The class and the order of quantifiers Fix an essential $2k$-strand plat diagram $D$, $k\geq2$, with a hyperbolic augmented exterior $Y_D$ and its actual primitive cusp markings. The [general target](../../notes/general_augmented_plat_long_twist_target.md) asks for a threshold $T(D)$ such that $$\min_i |m_i|>T(D)\quad\Longrightarrow\quad \lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N}\log|K_N(K_{D,\mathbf m})| =\operatorname{Vol}(S^3\setminus K_{D,\mathbf m}).$$ The diagram and every signed full-twist number $m_i$ are fixed **before** the quantum level $N$ tends to infinity. The prescribed parity pattern must give a knot. The threshold may depend on the diagram; no threshold depending only on $k$ is asserted. Under a positive marked gluing certificate, the [geometric filling theorem](../../notes/general_augmented_plat_long_filling_quantifiers.md) supplies a geometric threshold for independently long signed fillings. The quantum threshold in the displayed implication remains unproved for general plats. ## A whole-source equality at arbitrary fixed width The [signed augmented-source theorem](../../notes/general_signed_augmented_source_volume.md) proves $$\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N}\log|A_{D,N}| =2\operatorname{Vol}(Q_D)=\operatorname{Vol}(Y_D).$$ Here $A_{D,N}$ is the original marked complete-circle source, with its actual normalization and retained exterior framing factor. The input is a connected original plat projection and a **labeled convex ideal right-angled polyhedron** realizing its actual cut and face pairings. Each retained half-twist exponent may independently be $0,+1,-1$. The width and matching graph are arbitrary and fixed; both level parities and composite levels are included. This is a theorem about complete augmented **links**, including patterns whose main strands form one component. Filling their crossing circles still requires the external-color estimates below. The theorem does not assert that every reduced plat has the required geometric certificate. Parallel belts producing a white bigon fail this certificate; the [coverage check](../../notes/general_untwisted_augmented_source_literature_coverage.md) explains why their known even-level zeros are compatible with the theorem. The proof is recorded and independently reviewed within this project. That is distinct from external peer review. ## The exact coefficient that makes the global proof possible Let $R$ be the number of crossing circles, $d=N-1$, and $a_i$ the original internal channel labels. At each circle, the [literal source identity](../../notes/actual_complete_circle_positive_face_polynomial.md) gives two determinant polynomials and one forced-zero polynomial: $$D_a(x,b,y)=\det\!\left[bI+\frac{x}{2}H_-+\frac{y}{2}H_+\right],\qquad \widetilde P_s(x,y)=\sum_{j=0}^{s}\frac{S_s}{S_jS_{s-j}}x^{s-j}y^j, \quad s=d-2a.$$ The matrices are the original positive Hermitian matrices, and $S_j=\prod_{r=1}^j2\sin(\pi r/N)$. These polynomials have nonnegative coefficients for **every** folded label. Their combined degree at a circle is $2a+s=d$. The [exact marked coefficient theorem](../../notes/actual_original_marked_face_coefficient.md) then converts the actual finite head sum into one coefficient: $$A_{D,N}=\chi_{D,N}N^R\sum_{\mathbf a} \left(\prod_i k_{a_i}\beta_{a_i}^2\omega_{a_i}^{\epsilon_i}\right) \left[\prod_{f\ne u,v}L_f^d\right] \left.\prod_i D_{a_i,\mathrm{in}}D_{a_i,\mathrm{out}} \widetilde P_{s_i}\right|_{L_u=L_v=0}.$$ Every scalar is specified by the original source. The mark removes exactly the two face exponents $u,v$. The other $R$ target exponents already use the entire degree $dR$, so there is no additional Fourier alias. Local polynomial zeros enforce the original unwrapped support; the primitive face grid supplies the exact power $N^R$. Even-level carries cancel only after the whole marked expression is assembled. For $\epsilon_i=0$, this is a positive sum after removing the common unit phase $\chi_{D,N}$. With half twists, the same coefficients remain positive and their channel phases are summed explicitly by the signed theorem. ## Why the coefficient has the actual geometric rate The proof uses one circle-packing radius for each shared white face. It does not independently maximize the tensor factors. 1. The [rank and curvature theorem](../../notes/actual_original_boundary_transverse_rank.md) leaves exactly two flat framing directions. Removing the two marked faces and fixing the common scale gives a positive Hessian of size $N$. 2. The [global coefficient theorem](../../notes/actual_positive_face_coefficient_saddle.md) bounds the entire coefficient torus. A finite positive-matrix contraction gives exponential decay away from its unique angular maximum, followed by a nonzero relative Gaussian asymptotic. 3. The [absolute action calculation](../../notes/actual_original_boundary_stationary_character.md) cones the marked ideal vertex to the actual white and shaded facets. Their Lobachevsky contributions give $2\operatorname{Vol}(Q_D)$, with the additive constant fixed by the original determinant normalization. 4. The [uniform channel-rate theorem](../../notes/actual_positive_face_channel_rate.md) controls every internal label at those same radii. Its circle rate increases strictly to the fold. This bounds the whole source from above; one positive folded coefficient supplies the matching lower bound in the untwisted case. 5. The [signed extension](../../notes/general_signed_augmented_source_volume.md) proves a uniform relative Gaussian estimate from the original finite continuants. It sums the actual half-twist phases and bounds all remaining labels. Its leading coefficient is nonzero at both level parities. More precisely, put $M=\lfloor(N-1)/2\rfloor$, $s_0=N-1-2M$ and $t_i=M-a_i$. If $F_N(\mathbf a)$ denotes the positive sector coefficient including its $\beta$ factors, the actual shared-radius saddle gives $$\frac{F_N(\mathbf M-\mathbf t)}{F_N(\mathbf M)} =\exp\!\left[-\sum_i C_{i,N}\frac{t_i(t_i+s_0)}{N}\right](1+o(1)),\qquad C_{i,N}>0.$$ The exact phase ratio is $\omega_{M-t}/\omega_M=\exp[\pi i t(t+s_0)/N]$.
