title: An exact entire Fourier color packet for every augmented plat core
text: # An exact entire Fourier color packet for every augmented plat core 30 October 2026. The original high-color core of ANY fixed augmented plat has an explicit finite, separately-even ENTIRE interpolation in its auxiliary deficit colors. Its frequencies are the centered actual complete-circle channels. It is regular at the odd simple endpoint and has exact tensor Fourier reconstruction and Parseval identities. This supplies the finite function itself, not its required exponential asymptotic. The full original source also contains explicit alias subsets. Their coherent gap, the core's selected complex saddle and its geometric period remain unproved for an arbitrary plat. ## 1. The full-algebra split, including normals Use the original circle polynomials L_n=(-1)^(n-1)U_(n-1)(Omega/2), L_0=0, and P_N(Omega)=2T_N(Omega/2)+2=0. Here T is the standard first Chebyshev polynomial, T_0=1 and T_1(z/2)=z/2. For each integer 0<=h<N, the already proved exact identity is L_(N-h)=(-1)^h T_h(Omega/2)L_N+(-1)^N L_h. (1) It follows from U_(N-h-1)=T_h U_(N-1)-T_N U_(h-1) and the FULL polynomial quotient T_N=-1. Thus (1) keeps the Casimir first normals and the odd simple endpoint. It is not a nodal-value identity inserted before the complete circle acts. Let L_(N,j) denote the actual component of L_N at its distinct node c_j=2cos((2j+1)pi/N), j=0,...,M=floor((N-1)/2), in every physical degree. These are the rank-one physical matrices of the [complete compiler](actual_augmented_plat_phase_compiler.md), with their exact normal-derived coefficients. Multiplication by T_h acts on each such IMAGE by its value at c_j: the derivative term times the complete-circle square-zero normal vanishes. Consequently (-1)^h T_h(Omega/2)L_N =sum_j cos(pi h m_j/N) L_(N,j), m_j=N-2j-1. (2) The centering is exact because h is an integer. All m_j are nonnegative, have parity N-1, and are distinct. The odd self-node has m_M=0, so its coefficient in (2) equals one. ## 2. The actual whole-core function Fix the original augmented 2k-plat skeleton, with b retained auxiliary regions and fixed signed coupons R_i^(epsilon_i)L_(N-h_i). Let A_N(j_1,...,j_b) be its literal marked contraction after replacing each coupon by R_i^(epsilon_i)L_(N,j_i). This includes its ORIGINAL cups, ordinary caps, unrestricted marked cap, pivots and external scalar. The exact source-degree argument is the one in the compiler. No favorable boundary vector or unknown source normalization enters the definition of A_N. Define, for complex chi in C^b, C_N(chi)=sum_(0<=j_i<=M) A_N(j) product_i cos(pi m_(j_i) chi_i). (3) This is a finite separately-even entire function. On every physical high-color tuple h_i=N-n_i with 0<=h_i<=M, its value at chi=h/N is EXACTLY the original all-core source obtained from (1). In particular C_N(0) is the full original complete-color scalar: every alias L_0 vanishes there. Both parity classes are included literally. The full physical high-color source has the exact expansion Z_N(h)=C_N(h/N) +sum_(nonempty alias subsets S)(-1)^(N|S|) Z_(N,S)(h), (4) where the coupons in S are R_i^(epsilon_i)L_(h_i), and all others are the complete-image cosine factors of (2). Each term in (4) is explicit by the [all-color Hermite compiler](actual_mixed_augmented_plat_compiler.md). Equation (4) is an identity, not an assertion that those alias terms are smaller. No alias is deleted by a change of norm. For low ordinary colors n<=floor(N/2), use the usual physical split with core ZERO and the full ordinary coupon as alias. The mathematical function (3) still has values at the other grid points; these are its Fourier extension, not a new definition of physical low-color core. ## 3. Exact two-parity Fourier reconstruction Put w_j=1/2 when m_j>0 and w_j=1 when m_j=0. Direct finite geometric summation gives (1/N) sum_(h=0)^(N-1) cos(pi h m_j/N) cos(pi h m_l/N)=w_j delta_jl. (5) To check it, expand the product into exponentials. The differences m_j-m_l are even integers with absolute value below 2N. The sum m_j+m_l is also even; its only zero or 2N multiple is zero at the odd self-node j=l=M. This gives exactly the weights above. No prime-level assumption is made. By tensoring (5), the original channel coefficients can be recovered from this finite function: A_N(j)=1/[N^b product_i w_(j_i)] sum_(h_i=0)^(N-1) C_N(h/N) product_i cos(pi h_i m_(j_i)/N). (6) Its exact positive Parseval identity is (1/N^b) sum_h |C_N(h/N)|^2 =sum_j product_i w_(j_i)|A_N(j)|^2. (7) The transform therefore has only a fixed polynomial cost in N at fixed b. All exponential behavior is still in the ACTUAL coherent coefficients A_N; (7) does not manufacture positivity of their sum C_N(0), nor a nonzero geometric coefficient. The same function satisfies exactly C_N(chi+e_i)=(-1)^(N-1)C_N(chi), C_N(-chi_i,chi_others)=C_N(chi_i,chi_others). (8) It is periodic at odd levels and antiperiodic at even levels. In particular values near h=N mirror those near h=0. Thus this symmetry carries every proved near-zero value to the opposite end. IF a fixed-neighborhood analytic corridor asymptotic with complete rate F0 and nonzero amplitude GERM is established, choose arbitrarily small fixed positive real colors where that amplitude is nonzero. Their nearby grid values have rates arbitrarily close to F0 and reflect outside the corridor. This precludes a fixed whole-cube gap for the extension. If the amplitude is a UNIT at zero, h=1 already gives the complete rate and reflects to h=N-1. The unit assumption is needed for that particular h=1 argument with an absolute remainder. Periodicity ALONE is not an obstruction. In one variable the exact reproducing kernel is sum_j w_j^-1 cos(pi m_j chi) =sum_(r=0)^(N-1) exp[pi i(N-1-2r)chi] =sin(N pi chi)/sin(pi chi). (8a) Its values at chi=h/N are N delta_(h,0), for 0<=h<N, at BOTH parities. Multiplying it by exp(N F0)/N exhibits a complete rate F0 and zero at every other physical sample. It has no fixed-scale analytic corridor of the required form. The distinction after (4) is essential when combining a corridor theorem with a physical color-complement bound. An elementary entire growth bound is |C_N(chi)|<=exp(pi(N-1) sum_i |Im chi_i|) sum_j |A_N(j)|. (9) It is an exact upper bound, much weaker than the quadratic complex corridor estimate required for long-filling stationary phase. ## 4. The remaining analytic issue is now concrete Unlike a direct nonintegral-color substitution into sin(n theta)/sin theta at theta=pi, (3) is regular at the odd self-node and specifies every finite-N continuation exactly. Its extension is the unique one in the stated finite cosine span; no generic-q germ of the whole pointed invariant is replaced. A general filling theorem would still require a uniform asymptotic of (3) on a FIXED complex neighborhood, a source-preserving selected saddle/period, the entire physical alias and color-complement bounds, and the actual marked hyperbolic regulator. The exact complete and mixed compilers expose those quantities at arbitrary fixed bridge width, but do not prove their exponential estimates. The relevant large twisting threshold T(D) concerns a fixed diagram D; the Fourier frequency scale N here remains the quantum level. Audit: [full-algebra split and exact tensor Fourier identities](../experiments/audit_actual_augmented_plat_entire_core_color_packet.py). Independent analytical review and fresh audit replay: PASS. The review checked the physical high-color range, full-algebra normal identity, two-parity frequency norms, reconstruction and Parseval. It corrected the periodicity inference: the obstruction needs the stated analytic corridor, and the exact reproducing-kernel example now has its own finite audit. The primary-agent read and fresh replay also passed all 162 signed split identities, 204 centered characters, and 27 tensor Fourier packets.

title: The actual marked framing density from Casimir-source Ward currents
status: Original marked framing density from source Ward currents
text: # The actual marked framing density from Casimir-source Ward currents 30 October 2026. Reviewed local source theorem. This concerns the leading LOCAL density of the actual complete-color augmented-plat source after transverse Gaussian elimination. It retains the original mark, all finite offsets and the actual magnetic top-form. The invariant ordered-flag form alone is not its density: the marked cut supplies a meromorphic factor. No coefficient of this local density in the original global period is asserted. ## 1. Exact white Ward identities on the specified complex-head source Write Q=zeta^2, d=N-1, m=d-a, B=Q^(-N), and use the actual LARGE polynomial H=H_m^B(U,V) of the [generic white-source theorem](actual_generic_boundary_gauge_and_source.md). With A0=Q^d=1/(BQ), it satisfies the two exact identities (1-U)H(U/Q,V)+U(1-V)H(U,V/Q) =(1-UV Q^(-m))H(U,V), (1) A0(U-A0)H(QU,V)+U(V-A0)H(U,QV) =(Q^m UV-A0^2)H(U,V). (2) They are polynomial identities in independent complex U,V and generic Q,B, before root specialization. Thus the actual raising and lowering intertwiner equations continue to the selected complex head chart; they are not inferred from agreement on a finite root grid. Here is an elementary finite proof. Put P_j(X)=product_(r=0)^(j-1)(X-Q^r), N_b=V^b P_b(U)P_(m-b)(V), H=sum_(b=0)^m c_b N_b. Each N_b individually satisfies (1), by canceling the endpoint factors in P_j(X/Q). For (2), subtract its right side and apply the resulting operator L to one N_b. With M_b=V^b P_b(U)P_(m-1-b)(V), direct factor cancellation gives L N_b=-UV { Q^b(A0-Q^(m-b-1))(Q^(m-b)-1) M_b +A0(A0-Q^(b-1))(Q^b-1) M_(b-1) }. (3) The out-of-range endpoint terms have their displayed zero coefficient. The ACTUAL finite coefficients obey c_(b+1)/c_b =-B Q^(b+1)(1-Q^(m-b))(1-BQ^(m-b)) /[(1-Q^(b+1))(1-BQ^(b+1))]. (4) Substituting A0=1/(BQ) into (3) makes the coefficient of each M_b zero by (4). This proves (2) and its endpoints, with every generic coefficient retained. To check the source convention, the actual white is W_a(i,j;r)=(-1)^m zeta^[-dr+di-m(m-1)] H(Q^i,Q^j)/F_m, i+j=m+r. title: The complete geometric disk character is a folded-channel endpoint
text: # The complete geometric disk character is a folded-channel endpoint 30 October 2026. There is a useful general restriction on the branch that the arbitrary-plat source must select. At every complete essential crossing-circle cusp, the ordered product of its two main puncture meridians has trace -2 in the common-trace lift. The classical symbol of the original pair Casimir is exactly this ordered trace. Hence the complete geometric character lies at the ENDPOINT of the folded real Casimir channels, not at a generic interior channel value. This is a geometric character and source-symbol statement. It does not prove that the quantum sum concentrates at that endpoint, that other channels have a gap, or that the complete geometric period has nonzero original coefficient. Those remain analytic tasks. ## 1. The actual crossing disk and its parabolic product Take an augmented plat with the labeled complete geometric certificate of [the matching-graph construction](general_augmented_plat_matching_geometry.md). Choose one actual twice-punctured crossing disk. Let A and B be its two puncture meridians, transported to a common basepoint in their original order, and put P=BA. The disk's boundary is the peripheral longitude of the crossing circle, up to the recorded orientation and central lift. In particular the auxiliary meridian C commutes with P. Both peripheral generators have nontrivial parabolic complete holonomy: their translation periods generate the actual cusp lattice. The two main puncture flags are distinct. Indeed one cut half disk is the nondegenerate shaded ideal triangle (O,C1,C2), with its two main punctures at C1 and C2. Restoring its disk pairing retains these distinct developed flags for the two based meridians. Consequently A and B are nontrivial parabolics with distinct fixed points. Use the same trace lift for both meridians, as in the original common-color source; its complete head trace is -2. A central sign change of both heads does not change Tr(BA). A nontrivial parabolic C is conjugate in PSL2 to z -> z+1. A determinant-one matrix that commutes projectively with C commutes with its trace-two lift: the alternative sign would change the nonzero trace of that lift. A determinant-one matrix commuting with its trace-two lift has the form P=[[a,b],[0,a]], a^2=1. Thus Tr P is either 2 or -2. To choose the sign, conjugate the two distinct main flags to infinity and zero. Their common negative trace lifts then have the form A=-[[1,s],[0,1]], B=-[[1,0],[t,1]], s t !=0, Tr(BA)=2+s t. (1) Trace 2 would force st=0, contrary to the distinct nontrivial flags. Therefore Tr P=-2, s t=-4. (2) This argument uses the actual complete cusp and the nondegenerate disk triangle. An arbitrary pair of parabolics, or an unmarked solution of a polynomial relation, would not supply those inputs. Half twists transport the pair by its original Hurwitz map, which preserves the ordered product up to conjugacy. Thus (2) is unchanged by the retained signed half-twist pattern. ## 2. The original quantum character fixes the relevant trace coordinate The [actual adjacent-character identities](actual_adjacent_twist_character_and_source.md) give, in the original ordered quantum flag algebra, Omega_(12)=tr_q(H_2 H_1). (3) Their principal q=1 symbol is the ordinary ordered trace Tr(BA). The heads are the actual prefix-based meridians, and the cap/Hurwitz presentation identifies their classical tuples with the marked plat representation scheme. Thus (2) imposes c=-2 on this geometric classical pair character. It is not a relabeling of a Newton output coordinate as a knot meridian. The complete-circle source compiler uses the ORIGINAL folded nodes c_j=2cos((2j+1)pi/N), 0<=j<=floor((N-1)/2). Set delta_j=N-1-2j. Then exactly c_j=-2cos(pi delta_j/N), c_j+2=4sin^2(pi delta_j/(2N)). (4) For any sequence of these real nodes, c_j -> -2 if and only if j/N -> 1/2. If delta_j=o(N), the exact relation further gives c_j+2=(pi delta_j/N)^2[1+O((delta_j/N)^2)]. (5) At odd N the last node has delta_j=0 and is the simple endpoint. At even N the last folded node has delta_j=1 and belongs to the paired repeated-root sector. Their original source weights and normal terms therefore cannot be replaced by one parity-blind endpoint evaluation. Equations (3)--(5) locate the complete GEOMETRIC character within the compiler's classical channel coordinates. They do not assert that the other physical wire variables are at endpoints, nor that a stationary phase analysis of the complete coherent sum is finished. Complex contour sectors also require their actual source coefficients. ## 3. The marked peripheral cover resolves the trace ramification Continue the actual preferred crossing-circle longitude from completeness, with centered projective logarithm V. Keep its selected square root ell=exp(V/2), so L=ell^2 is the projective multiplier. In the common head lift the eigenvalues of P are -ell and -ell^-1, up to the recorded inversion of the preferred longitude. Consequently c=Tr P=-(ell+ell^-1)=-2cosh(V/2), c+2=-(ell-1)^2/ell=-V^2/4+O(V^4). (6) The square-root cover ell^2=L is etale on the peripheral torus. The subsequent trace map ell -> -(ell+ell^-1) is ramified at ell=1: it forgets the sign of V and its first-order deformation there. These are different maps. A marked longitude branch carries more first-order information than its trace equation at c=-2. For the real root nodes in (4), one compatible local logarithmic lift is V=2pi i delta_j/N; the reciprocal sheet changes its sign. This matches (6) exactly. It is a coordinate comparison, not an assertion that this logarithm is the quantum source's selected filling cycle. The conclusion for the general plat program is concrete: analyze the complete geometric endpoint on its marked peripheral cover, retaining both level parities and the original repeated-root source. A strict interior real saddle in the raw folded channel coordinate cannot represent (2). The required global source selection is still open. Audit: [trace, ramification and both-parity endpoint identities](../experiments/audit_actual_augmented_plat_geometric_channel_endpoint.py). The all-plat statement follows from the labeled disk/cusp argument and the already proved original quantum character identity, not from the finite-level examples in the audit. Two independent analytical reviews and fresh audit replays: PASS. They checked the actual based disk flags, the peripheral commutation and common-trace sign, the original ordered Casimir symbol, both level parities, and the distinction between the etale square-root cover and the ramified trace map. All 17 endpoint parity checks passed. These checks establish no quantum concentration or gap.

title: The actual local source phase generates ordered character transport
text: # The actual local source phase generates ordered character transport 30 October 2026. The explicit augmented-plat phase has a direct algebraic map to the ORIGINAL ordered pair character. This note proves that map, including the full factorial normalization, its centralizer transport, and its regular parabolic limit on the longitude cover. It is a local critical-phase theorem, not a claimed full-source asymptotic or a new choice of quantum invariant. The remaining global issues are stated in section 6. In particular the local calculation does not assign the source action an absolute manifold regulator merely because its critical equations have the right character. Subsequent comparison: the [regular geometric chart](actual_augmented_plat_regular_geometric_phase_chart.md) supplies an unfolded complete geometric candidate, and the [endpoint regulator theorem](actual_augmented_plat_endpoint_regulator.md) fixes its absolute volume anchor under full marked stationarity. Those additional results do not supply the physical cycle or global source estimate left open in this local note. ## 1. Retain the complete normalized coupon phase Use the low physical degree chamber of the [actual compiler](actual_augmented_plat_phase_compiler.md). Let tau be the scaled pair degree, u and v its output and input first magnetic indices, xi the folded Casimir index, and alpha,beta the two internal q-Hahn variables. All logarithms have the compiler's actual factorial marks. The complete coupon, with retained half twist epsilon in {0,+1,-1}, has leading phase Theta_epsilon=H+Phi(tau,xi,u,alpha)+Phi(tau,xi,v,beta) +pi i[tau+(epsilon-1)(xi+xi^2)]. (1) Its already recorded external kappa^epsilon is not removed or replaced; its leading constant is a unit phase and has no derivative in these variables. The finite offsets and normal-derived coefficients remain those of the exact compiler. Equation (1) is their leading phase, not an equality of finite quantum germs. Write T=e^(2pi i tau), U=e^(2pi i u), V=e^(2pi i v), J=e^(2pi i xi), Z=e^(2pi i alpha), W=e^(2pi i beta). On a regular logarithmic chart the two internal equations are exactly P(U,Z)=0, P(V,W)=0, P(X,Y)=T(J-Y)^2(X-Y)+(Y-1)^2(TY-XJ). (2) Every formula below is localized only where its displayed denominators are nonzero. In particular these equations have not licensed deleting boundary strata. Their leading quadratic coefficients may be assumed nonzero for the symbolic certificate; the rational identities themselves hold wherever their displayed denominators are defined. ## 2. The actual Casimir equation, with its magnetic momentum Direct differentiation of Phi gives Y(X,Z)=e^(Phi_u)=(1-X)(TZ-XJ)/[J(X-Z)(T-X)]. (3) The principal symbol of the ORIGINAL symmetric Jacobi block is a(X)= (X-T)(1-X)/T, d(X)=2X(1+T-X)/T, Omega_cl=a(X)(y+y^-1)+d(X). For example its difference from the right side equals -X(J-T)P(X,Z)/[JT(X-Z)(JX-TZ)]. Thus the critical phase yields the actual ordered pair trace, not just an independently chosen quadratic with the same number of roots. The inverse change is explicit: Z=XJ[y(T-X)+(1-X)]/[yJ(T-X)+T(1-X)]. (5) On its regular chart, the Jacobi equation (4) conversely implies (2). The local root is therefore selected by the actual magnetic momentum y; one does not choose a root by its numerical size. ## 3. Full normalization preserves the ordered product Differentiating ALL terms of (1), including H and pi i tau, gives D=e^(Theta_tau) =JZW(T-J)(T-U)(T-V)/[(TJ-1)(TZ-UJ)(TW-VJ)]. (6) Omitting the inverse-measure factorials or their phase would change (6). Introduce an arbitrary nonzero common magnetic scale g. The actual incoming and outgoing raising-shift symbols are (S1_in,S2_in)=(g Y(V,W),g), (S1_out,S2_out)=(g/[D Y(U,Z)],g/D). (7) The signs in (7) follow from a kernel: right multiplication by a raising shift differentiates its input positively, and left multiplication differentiates its output negatively. Total-degree conservation supplies the common scale g. No Hermitian conjugation has been inserted. For a physical head define its ORIGINAL classical flag matrices by K=-1/X, F=S(1-X), E=(X^-1-1)/S, Lplus=[[K,E],[0,1]], Lminus=[[1,0],[-KF,K]], G=Lminus^-1 Lplus=[[K,E],[FK,FE+K^-1]]. (8) They have determinant one and trace -2. Prefix conjugation gives the ordered meridians A=G1 and B=Lminus1^-1 G2 Lminus1, exactly as in the proved quantum character identity. Their product is P=B A=[[T^-1,E_tot],[F_tot/T,F_tot E_tot+T]], F_tot=F1+K1^-1 F2, E_tot=E1 K2+E2. (9) Equations (2),(3),(6),(7) give F_tot,out=F_tot,in, K_tot,out=K_tot,in=T^-1, Tr P_in=Tr P_out=J+J^-1. (10) For F_tot nonzero, (9) then gives E_tot,out=E_tot,in as well. Hence the ENTIRE ordered matrix P is preserved. This is stronger than trace matching. The identity continues wherever the full rational expressions are defined; the present proof uses the stated regular F_tot chart. For reproducibility set g=1 and write f=(1-V)Y(V,W)+T-V. The first equality in (10) is the following explicit certificate: [(1-U)/Y(U,Z)+T-U]-D f = VZ(J-T)(T-U)P(V,W) /[(V-W)(JT-1)(JU-TZ)(JV-TW)]. (11) The scale g merely conjugates the common matrices and costs no source normalization. The HIGH-degree chamber has an equally literal adapter. (22) The finite -1 in m_j=N-2j-1 changes the amplitude, not (22). Section 6 proves the primitive differential on a correctly marked stationary branch; its existence and its actual degree-one complete-volume anchor remain necessary. text: # The complete source has a nonzero local marked density and folded Gaussian 30 October 2026. Fix a certified augmented plat, its original exposed mark, and the complete geometric chart with one exceptional matching edge. The proved ordinary and joint deficient packets give a nonzero LOCAL density of the actual complete root source. The paired-circle normal is already in this statement. Its folded channel sum has a nonzero local Gaussian coefficient at BOTH level parities. This is separate from the coefficient of a geometric saddle in the original global period. The two framing directions, the physical support cycles, crossed divisors and competing sectors remain. It is also a complete-color statement, not a mixed auxiliary-color or filling packet. ## 1. Start with the actual mark, rather than differentiating one coupon Write d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), x=q^d, M=floor(d/2), and let R be the fixed number of original complete-circle coupons. In a low physical degree t, the EXACT fixed-channel coefficient of the circle is C_(N,a)^epsilon(t;u,v) =kappa^epsilon x^(-t) nu_a^(epsilon-1) h_(t,a) f_a(t,u) f_a(t,v), h_(t,a)=k_a s_t^2/[s_(t-a)s_(t+a-d)], nu_a=(-1)^a q^[a(a+1)], k_a=1 if 2a=d, and k_a=2 otherwise. (1) Use the literal translated high block when needed. Equation (1) is the [complete root compiler](actual_augmented_plat_phase_compiler.md), including the full first-normal circle coefficient; it is not a value-only spectral projector. In particular the original scalar and its endpoint values are h0_a=k_a N s_(2a)/s_a^2, h0_M=N (N odd), h0_M=2N/sin(pi/N) (N even). (2) The latter formula follows from s_(N-2)=N/[2sin(pi/N)] and s_(N/2-1)^2=N/2. The vanishing paired retraction pi_a W_a=0 does NOT make (1) zero. The original nilpotent circle is h0_a W_a pi_a, whose displayed scalar already contains that circle's normal. In a 2k-head plat, keep all k original bottom cups, k-1 ordinary top caps, and the unrestricted original marked top row. Degree conservation forces the last pair to have degree d only AFTER the other caps act. Their product then has scale N^k N^(-(k-1)) N^-2=N^-1, (3) and an explicitly retained nonzero monomial in x. Thus the marked ROOT compiler is a finite sum of products of (1) and this monomial. It contains no further local q derivative. This direct use of the original mark is essential: nonzero E_a at one block would not by itself evaluate F_Delta'(0)/nu_N, the alternative whole-network ordinary-trace normal. That identity is proved only after the complete original closure. We do not differentiate one factor, assign a normal to each vertex, or move the bare mark. ## 2. The full normalization gives N^-1 per circle at the fold Put tau=t/N, alpha=a/N, eta=tau+alpha-1, zeta=tau-alpha. First work on a fixed ordinary physical compact, with alpha in a fixed real interval ending at 1/2. The finite source keeps its actual alpha. The original sine-factorial continuation G_N, on its marked strip, gives hhat_(t,a)=k_a G_N(N tau)^2/ [G_N(N zeta) G_N(N eta+1)]. (4) This is (1) on its supported physical grid. The endpoint +1 comes from d=N-1. The elementary uniform expansion G_N(Nw)=sqrt(2N sin(pi w)) exp[N J(w)](1+O(N^-1)) and the exact sine recurrence at N eta+1 give hhat_(t,a)=k_a b_h(tau,alpha) exp[N H(tau,alpha)] (1+O(N^-1)), H=2J(tau)-J(zeta)-J(eta), b_h=sin(pi tau)/[2sin(pi eta) sqrt(sin(pi zeta)sin(pi eta))]. (5) All sine factors here are units on the compact; their branches are the actual continued ones. In particular b_h remains nonzero and smooth at alpha=1/2. The large even value in (2) has canceled against the actual CD/column normalization. It is not an extra N in the coupon density. The [full ordinary packet](actual_q_hahn_full_physical_complex_packet.md) satisfies fhat_a=N^-1/2 B_alpha exp(N Phi_alpha)(1+O(N^-1)), where B_alpha is nowhere zero, uniformly through alpha=1/2. Hence (1) has the actual relative packet C_(N,a)^epsilon =kappa^epsilon k_a N^-1 b_epsilon exp[N Theta_epsilon^lit](1+O(N^-1)), Theta_epsilon^lit=H+Phi_alpha(tau,u/N)+Phi_alpha(tau,v/N) +pi i[-tau+(epsilon-1)(alpha+alpha^2)], b_epsilon=b_h B_alpha(tau,u/N) B_alpha(tau,v/N) exp[pi i(tau+(epsilon-1)alpha)]. (6) The exact kappa and retained outside framing line remain outside this formula. The -tau in (6) uses literal x^-t=q^-dt; the alternative +tau differs by the recorded degree character exp(-2pi i t). No character is discarded when comparing (6) to the marked stationary action. Every factor of b_epsilon is nonzero. Errors and fixed derivatives are uniform on smaller compacts, with smooth dependence on real alpha. The exceptional circle has the SAME assertion. Indeed its correctly restored [entire coefficient](actual_matching_edge_deficient_packet_regulator.md) is exactly C_a(t;r,s)=k_a beta_a^2 V_a(d-t) q^[d(r+s-t)] R_a(q^(t-2r);c_t) R_a(q^(t-2s);c_t). Its scalar-one reflection sends (t,r,s) to (N-t-2,r+N-t-1,s+N-t-1). At negative determinant arguments the reflected values lie in the ordinary physical packet (6). The [joint deficient theorem](actual_q_hahn_joint_deficient_degree_packet.md) then supplies a nowhere-zero relative packet for each ratio R_a(z)/R_a(z_*), uniformly for the actual real alpha through the fold. The remaining ratio is the EXACT nonzero monomial q^[d(r+s-r_*-s_*)]. Multiplying these ratios propagates (6)'s absolute N^-1 scale and nonzero amplitude to the actual exceptional geometric compact. Different bounded marked logarithmic lifts retain their exact monomials; no root of a squared character is chosen afresh. This argument includes both beta factors, the residual sine product, the finite reflection offset -2, and the original fold weight k_a. There is no assertion that the individually large beta factors have a smooth nonzero endpoint asymptotic before that cancellation. The [literal generic lift](actual_matching_edge_generic_deficient_operator_lift.md) has the additional root character exp(-2pi i v); restoring the actual physical turn cancels it, giving precisely C_a above. Thus it does not introduce an additional zero or unknown scalar in the restored density. ## 3. A nonzero fixed-channel marked density Use the proved actual geometric frame, slightly deformed if needed to make the exceptional degree nonreal. All ordinary factors are on their selected physical sheets, and the exceptional pair is in the joint deficient corridor on its reflected selected sheet. These conditions are strict and hold on a common neighborhood. The internal q-Hahn roots have already been summed by their actual finite relative packets. Choose the original free magnetic coordinates y after the affine wire constraints. Retain every finite d=N-1 offset and every original cup, cap, degree and Poisson character. For a fixed vector of actual channels alpha=(a_1/N,...,a_R/N) near (1/2,...,1/2), the continued marked ROOT summand therefore has D_N(y,alpha)=U_N N^(-R-1) product_i k_(a_i) b_N(y,alpha) exp[N F(y,alpha)](1+O(N^-1)). (7) Here U_N is only the explicitly recorded head-independent unit phase. The original external line, if any, is kept separately. The functions b_N are holomorphic in y, smooth in the real alpha, nowhere zero, and bounded above and away from zero with fixed derivatives on smaller compacts. They include the nonzero order-one exponentials from the finite affine offsets. Such offsets may be kept literally instead; expanding them changes only b_N and its relative O(N^-1) error. The proof is multiplication of the FIXED number R of packets (6), their exceptional continuation, and the exact marked factor (3). This proves nonzero local density for the complete fixed-channel source, not merely nonzero separate polynomial values. It uses a direct root marked compiler, rather than an unjustified inference about the derivative of an ordinary closed density. The specified meromorphic extension agrees with the original source on its supported grid; its local use does not move any support-dependent residue cycle. ## 4. The actual endpoint lattice has a nonzero local folded Gaussian Fix a point y0 of the complete geometric framing orbit in this chart. Use the FULL marked channel stationarity: the channel derivatives of the unadjusted phase are 2pi i n_i with fixed integers n_i. Subtract these exact characters. This changes no actual channel summand because exp(2pi i n_i a_i)=1. In these marked conventions, F_alpha(y0,1/2)=0, F_(alpha_i,alpha_j)(y0,1/2)=delta_ij H_i, H_i=-4pi i/tau_i, Re H_i<0, (8) where tau_i are the actual oriented primitive cusp shapes. Half twists are included: H_i=-2pi/c_i+2pi i epsilon_i in the rectangular convention. The [channel Hessian theorem](actual_augmented_plat_channel_hessian.md) also proves F_(alpha,y)=0 at the endpoint. Negative real part alone would not substitute for the first equality in (8). The selected branch here is fixed as a neighborhood germ by the full ordinary anchor and the scalar-one deficient reflection, not merely by matching endpoint magnetic momenta. Thus its channel derivatives are the derivatives of the same actual marked principal phase. Explicitly, F=F_raw-2pi i sum_i n_i alpha_i is unchanged in the exponential at every actual grid point; at alpha=1/2 its exponential includes the known unit exp(-pi i N sum_i n_i). Alternatively use the centered F_c=F_raw-2pi i sum_i n_i(alpha_i-1/2), and place that compensating unit in U_N. These conventions give the same (9); the unit is not erased. Let 0<delta<1/6, and sum (7) only over the actual folded labels with 0<N/2-a_i<=N^(1/2+delta). This is a sum of SPECIFIED local continued density values at y0, not the original magnetic period. It has sum_local D_N(y0,a/N) =U_N N^(-R/2-1) b_N(y0,1/2) exp[N F(y0,1/2)] *(2pi)^(R/2)/product_i sqrt(-H_i) *(1+O(N^-1/2)). (9) Each square root is selected by continuation from H_i<0 real; Re H_i<0 makes it nonzero. This coefficient is nonzero at both parities. Here is an elementary lattice proof retaining the endpoint weights. For odd N, the numbers w=N/2-a are 1/2,3/2,5/2,...; their weights are 1 at w=1/2 and 2 thereafter. For even N they are 1,2,3,..., all with weight 2. In either case, for Re H<0, N^-1/2 sum_w k_a exp[H w^2/(2N)] =2 integral_0^infinity exp(H z^2/2) dz+O(N^-1/2) =sqrt(2pi)/sqrt(-H)+O(N^-1/2). (10) The half-step shift and the one exceptional odd weight affect only the O(N^-1/2) error. A direct interval Riemann estimate, using the integrable derivative of the Gaussian, proves this uniformly on compact subsets of Re H<0. The omitted tail is exponentially small in N^(2delta). Taylor's formula gives the quadratic diagonal in (8); the error in N F is O(|w|^3/N^2). On the stated window it tends uniformly to zero. Its Gaussian-weighted absolute sum, and the corresponding variation of b_N, are O(N^-1/2) relative to N^(R/2). This proves (9), including complex H_i; no positivity of the complex terms is assumed. The actual half-twist phase has an independent exact lattice check. Set s=d-2a, s_min=0 at odd N and 1 at even N, and a_max=M. Then nu_a/nu_(a_max) =exp[pi i(s^2-s_min^2)/(4N)]. (11) Indeed the integer character in (-1)^a cancels the linear term in a(a+1) along this parity-restricted lattice. Thus a retained signed half twist contributes its specified quadratic phase, with no alternating nearest-channel factor. Formula (9) does not require an exact even extension of the finite density across the folded endpoint; its one-sided Riemann proof uses the actual two parity lattices directly. No finite noninteger-channel interpolation has been used. Only the proved uniform packet at ACTUAL discrete a_i, its smooth coefficient functions, and the original channel spacing enter. The window has s_i=d-2a_i=O(N^(1/2+delta)), so it is also inside the already proved s_i log N=o(N) generic-normal upper-bound window. That latter bound is not needed to obtain the root local coefficient (9). ## 5. What the magnetic quotient Hessian does and does not add At the certified geometric point the [actual critical scheme](actual_augmented_plat_critical_scheme.md), section 7, identifies the magnetic Hessian radical with exactly the two-dimensional T_diag\PGL2 framing tangent space. On a holomorphic slice transverse to this orbit the magnetic Hessian is nondegenerate. Together with (7) and a nonsingular coordinate Jacobian, this gives a nonzero transverse Gaussian density PER UNIT local framing volume: its coefficient divides the nonzero numerator by the chosen square root of the transverse Hessian determinant. A small local descending Morse cycle for those transverse variables has that nonzero coefficient. This does not integrate the framing orbit or assign its measure to the finite source. Nor does a local Morse cycle establish its coefficient in the original physical cycle. In particular every real forbidden integer degree slice of the exceptional source has zero original period, despite the nonzero continued density away from its real lattice. The degree/cotangent transport and its residue terms cannot be omitted. Thus the unresolved question is not an unspecified zero of a local complete-circle amplitude: fixed-channel density (7) and the marked local folded sum (9) are nonzero. The remaining global work includes the actual degree/magnetic cycle and framing integral, its boundary terms and competing contributions, and any mixed-color extension. No nonzero individual genuine q-normal density is claimed or required by this direct root marked-density theorem. Focused audit: [source normalizations and actual folded lattices](../experiments/audit_actual_augmented_plat_local_marked_density.py), [saved results](../experiments/actual_augmented_plat_local_marked_density_results.json). It checks 49 original h0 endpoint values, 674 exact fold half-twist ratios, five literal unrestricted marked plat contractions, eighteen signed full-coupon relative packets at both parities, and eighteen complex-Gaussian parity calibrations. The source comparisons use the literal terminating columns independently of their determinant formulas. The Gaussian calibrations test the elementary lattice lemma, not a global source period. Uniformity and the exceptional continuation follow from the proofs above and their already audited source dependencies. Primary-agent full analytical review: PASS. The reader independently checked the original marked boundary scale, the h/CD +1 correction, literal phases and exceptional reflected anchor, the actual endpoint weights and half-twist ratio, and the marked discrete Gaussian estimate.
