Thus if a phase calculation uses \(z=\Log H\) and \(G_z=\Log L_H\), its ratio with this auxiliary meridian is \(-2G_{zz}\), not \(+2G_{zz}\). The positive sign in the preceding comparison requires, for example, the dual longitude \(L_{\rm geom}=L_H^{-1}\). This is a coordinate/peripheral sign that must be proved; it cannot be hidden in the rectangle count. For coverage only, the statement of Theorem 1.1 in [Purcell--Reid--Stewart](https://users.monash.edu/~jpurcell/papers/GeometryAugLinksSfces.pdf) records that crossing-circle cusps have two rectangles, that the longitude uses two shaded sides, and that a half-twist meridian is a diagonal. No proof from that source is used above. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_augmented_pretzel_crossing_circle_cusp.py) checks the literal vertex images, labeled face translations, primitive areas and both half-twist/filling markings at 28 widths.

title: The geometric volume of the literal augmented pretzel source
text: # The geometric volume of the literal augmented pretzel source 29 October 2026. The link underlying the original \(s\)-box source \(B_i=R^{-1}L_N\), for odd \(s\geq3\), is a half-twist partner of the untwisted fully augmented pretzel link. It has \(s+1\) components, not one. Both complements have the volume \[ \boxed{\displaystyle V_s=8s\left[ \Lambda\left(\frac\pi4+\frac\pi{2s}\right) +\Lambda\left(\frac\pi4-\frac\pi{2s}\right)\right].} \tag{1} \] Here is an explicit face-labeled geometric construction and a direct volume calculation. No quantum invariant is changed. In particular, volume invariance of the half-twist partners does NOT permit deleting the retained half twists from their original quantum source. ## 1. A right-angled ideal antiprism constructed explicitly Put \(\alpha=\pi/s\), \(h=\tan(\alpha/2)\), and \(r=\sqrt{1-h^2}\). In the ideal boundary of the Klein ball take \[ A_k=(r\cos(2k\alpha),r\sin(2k\alpha),h), \quad B_k=(r\cos((2k+1)\alpha),r\sin((2k+1)\alpha),-h). \] Their convex hull is the \(s\)-antiprism \(\mathcal A_s\): two \(s\)-gonal faces and the \(2s\) staggered side triangles. For example the side face \((A_0,A_1,B_0)\), in coordinates rotated by \(\alpha\), has supporting plane \[ X+bZ=c,\qquad b=\frac{r(1-\cos\alpha)}{2h},\quad c=\frac{r(1+\cos\alpha)}2. \] Its spacelike Lorentz normal is \((c,\cos\alpha,\sin\alpha,b)\). The top face normal is \((h,0,0,1)\). Their Lorentz product is \(b-hc=0\), exactly because \(h^2=(1-\cos\alpha)/(1+\cos\alpha)\). The adjacent lower side face has normal \((c,1,0,-b)\); its product with the upper normal is \(\cos\alpha-b^2-c^2=0\). Rotations and the top/bottom symmetry give every other edge. Thus ALL dihedral angles are \(\pi/2\). All vertices are distinct and ideal, all the face planes are supporting, and their normals are spacelike. This constructs the metric directly. ## 2. The actual projection polyhedra are DOUBLES of antiprisms Double \(\mathcal A_s\) across one of its \(s\)-gonal faces. The adjacent triangle pairs become coplanar and merge to quadrilaterals. The resulting ideal right-angled polyhedron \(\mathcal P_s\) has vertices \[ Z_k,\ U_k^+,\ U_k^-,\qquad k\in\mathbb Z/s, \] and the following face cycles: \[ W_+=(U_{s-1}^+,\ldots,U_0^+),\quad W_-=(U_0^-,\ldots,U_{s-1}^-), \] \[ Q_k=(Z_k,U_k^+,Z_{k+1},U_k^-), \quad T_k^+=(Z_k,U_{k-1}^+,U_k^+),\quad T_k^-=(Z_k,U_k^-,U_{k-1}^-). \tag{2} \] The white faces are \(W_\pm,Q_k\), the shaded faces are \(T_k^\pm\). There are \(3s\) ideal vertices, \(6s\) edges, \(s\) white quads, two white \(s\)-gons and \(2s\) shaded triangles. Every edge separates a white and a shaded face. This is exactly the topological projection-plane cut of the untwisted pretzel port graph in [the original source theorem](actual_odd_pretzel_augmented_transfer_source.md). The \(k\)-th crossing disk meets the adjacent planar arcs labeled \(U_{k-1},U_k\); flattening its two sides gives the bowtie \(T_k^+,T_k^-\) with common ideal crossing-circle vertex \(Z_k\). Between consecutive disks, the planar arc gives the quad \(Q_k\). The two remaining planar regions follow the cycles \(W_+,W_-\). Thus cutting the two complementary balls along the crossing disks gives TWO copies \(\mathcal P_s^{(0)},\mathcal P_s^{(1)}\), with the displayed face identifications. This is a labeled cellulation of the literal link complement, not just a match of its cusp count. In the untwisted graph, white faces glue across the two copies by their labels, while each \(T_k^+\) glues to \(T_k^-\) WITHIN its own copy, fixing \(Z_k\) and matching each outer index to itself. Restoring a half twist changes that shaded gluing to \[ T_k^+\subset\mathcal P_s^{(\epsilon)} \longleftrightarrow T_k^-\subset\mathcal P_s^{(1-\epsilon)}, \quad Z_k\mapsto Z_k,\quad U_{k-1}^+\mapsto U_k^-,\quad U_k^+\mapsto U_{k-1}^- . \tag{3} \] The CROSS-COPY change in (3) is necessary: swapping the two outer labels inside the same oriented copy would give the wrong boundary orientation. Equation (3) is the actual exchange of the two punctures of the crossing disk. It realizes the retained odd half twist of \(R^{-1}L_N\); its sign affects the peripheral marking, not this metric volume. The ordinary circle is not filled or removed. Every edge cycle has FOUR right angles under either choice, including mixed choices at different disks. Symmetric small horospheres can be chosen at the two vertex orbits \(Z\) and \(U\). The white isometries preserve them. The two outer vertices of each shaded triangle have equal decorations by its reflection symmetry, so BOTH the untwisted and half-twisted shaded identifications preserve them. Thus the cusp rectangles glue without dilation to compact flat tori. This verifies completeness as well as the \(2\pi\) edge equations. The untwisted link has \(s\) planar main components and \(s\) crossing circles. With every half twist restored, following the main strands advances their labels by two modulo \(s\); for odd \(s\) these form one main component. The literal quantum base therefore has \(s+1\) cusps. It is an AUGMENTED LINK base, not the filled pretzel knot. We have constructed the same complete finite-volume metric from two copies of \(\mathcal P_s\), hence FOUR copies of \(\mathcal A_s\), for all these half-twist partners. No hyperbolic Dehn filling is used in this equality. ## 3. Direct volume of one antiprism Send the north ideal point to \(\infty\) in upper half-space by stereographic coordinates. For \(t=\tan(\pi/4-\alpha/2)\) and \(\rho=t^{-1/2}\), the vertices are \[ a_k=\rho e^{2ik\alpha},\qquad b_k=\rho^{-1}e^{(2k+1)i\alpha}. \] Cone the oriented boundary faces to \(\infty\), triangulating the two base polygons in matching fans. This is the ordinary signed pyramid volume identity, obtainable first with a finite cone point and then by taking its ideal limit. The two base-cone volumes cancel: the similarity \(z\mapsto\rho^{-2}e^{i\alpha}z\) takes one fan to the other, fixes \(\infty\), and their boundary orientations are opposite. No assertion that all these outside cones form a disjoint triangulation is needed. Each side pair gives the two oriented ideal tetrahedron shapes \[ z_+=\tfrac12+\tfrac i2 t,\qquad z_-=\tfrac12-\frac i{2t}, \] with net volume \(D(z_+)-D(z_-)\). Put \(\beta_\pm=\pi/4\pm\alpha/2\). Their Euclidean triangle angles give \[ D(z_+)=2\Lambda(\beta_-)-\Lambda(2\beta_-) =2\Lambda(\beta_+), \] \[ -D(z_-)=2\Lambda(\beta_+)-\Lambda(2\beta_+) =2\Lambda(\beta_-). \] The last equalities follow by differentiating the elementary Lobachevsky duplication identity and fixing its value at zero. Summing over the \(s\) side pairs proves \[ \operatorname{Vol}(\mathcal A_s) =2s[\Lambda(\beta_+)+\Lambda(\beta_-)], \] and multiplying by four proves (1). At \(s=3\), the explicitly constructed antiprism is a regular ideal octahedron, so \(V_3=4v_8\), not \(2v_8\). ## 4. Coverage and exact quantum scope For coverage only, Kellerhals's [abstract, introduction and Theorem C](https://homeweb.unifr.ch/kellerha/pub/Kellerhals-FAL.pdf) identify the untwisted pretzel FAL with the \(2s\)-chain-link family, state the four-antiprism decomposition, and state the same volume formula. The derivation above is independent of that paper's proof. The [Meyer--Millichap--Trapp abstract](https://nyjm.albany.edu/j/2020/26-8.html) also records the study of fully augmented pretzel link complements. No literature volume-conjecture proof is being used. Equation (1) is the genuine geometric right side for the unfilled source \(B_i=R^{-1}L_N\). It does not prove its quantum asymptotics, nonzero geometric coefficient, or the analogous assertion for its fixed-slope fillings. All retained half-twist phases, the original marked cut and the full peripheral line remain in the source theorem; they have not been replaced by the untwisted invariant. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_augmented_pretzel_geometric_volume.py) checks the normals/supporting planes, all labeled face pairings and edge cycles, cusp links and original half-twist component counts, and the independent ideal-tetrahedron volume calculation.

title: A finite algebraic dominant-root certificate for the actual backward cubic
text: # A finite algebraic dominant-root certificate for the actual backward cubic 29 October 2026. This is an exact spectral input for the next ORIGINAL Newton source packet in [the endpoint theorem](actual_twist_endpoint_gaussian_certificate.md). It proves a strict dominant-mode gap on every closed subinterval of 0<=u<pi/2 for its actual backward principal cubic. It does not infer the original source projection from two scalar endpoint sizes, nor claim a whole-word asymptotic without the exact backward source/current. ## 1. The cubic and the assertion Put Z=exp(-2iu) and f_Z(lambda)=lambda^3+(5Z-3)lambda^2 +(3-7Z+3Z^2)(1-Z)lambda-(1-Z)^5. (1) There is a continuous root mu(u), beginning at mu(0)=-2, which is the UNIQUE root of largest modulus for 0<=u<pi/2. It is nonzero and simple there. Consequently for every fixed u_0<pi/2 there are constants min_(0<=u<=u0)|mu(u)|>0, max_(0<=u<=u0,max other roots lambda)|lambda/mu(u)|<1. (2) The small roots may collide at u=0, but the isolated dominant line remains regular there. At u=pi/2 the largest moduli do tie; no strict gap at that endpoint is asserted. The discriminant is exactly disc f_Z=-Z^6(Z-1)^2(27Z^2-54Z+23). (3) The two zeros of its last factor are positive real numbers different from1. Thus all three roots are distinct on 0<u<=pi/2. Distinctness alone would not prove(2): the FORWARD cubic of this same source has an interior dominant-modulus switch. We instead exclude dominant ties by the finite real-algebraic calculation below. ## 2. An exact test for a pair of equal moduli For p(lambda)=lambda^3+a lambda^2+b lambda+c, c!=0, form the cubic T(t)=[a^3 c(t+2)-a^2 b^2-a b c(t^2+5t+4) +b^3(t+2)+c^2(t+1)^3]/c^2. (4) Its three roots, counted with multiplicity, are lambda_i/lambda_j+lambda_j/lambda_i, i<j. Indeed a direct resultant identity is Res_lambda(p(lambda),w^3 p(lambda/w)) =c^3(w-1)^3 w^3 T(w+w^-1). (5) Two nonzero distinct roots have equal modulus only if their root of T is REAL in[-2,2]. Conversely a real t in[-2,2] gives a unit-modulus ratio, by solving w+w^-1=t. This is an exact test, including an opposite root pair t=-2. Specialize(4) to a=5Z-3, b=(3-7Z+3Z^2)(1-Z), c=-(1-Z)^5. On the open lower unit semicircle put v=Z+Z^-1=2cos(2u), so -2<v<2. Write R=R_2/2 and R_2=2(v-2)^4 t^3 +(-3v^4+39v^3-166v^2+292v-184)t^2 +(15v^4-72v^3+141v^2-181v+134)t -7v^4+62v^3-87v^2-132v+220, I=(9v^3-57v^2+120v-84)t^2 +(-9v^3+120v^2-373v+339)t +9v^3-66v^2+235v-288. Exact expansion gives (T_Z+T_(Z^-1))/2=R/(v-2)^4, (T_Z-T_(Z^-1))/(Z-Z^-1)=I/(v-2)^4. (6) For real t, an equal-modulus pair must therefore satisfy R=I=0. Their resultant and linear subresultant are Res_t(R,I)=(v-2)^4 P(v), S_1=(v-2)^4[A(v)t+C(v)], (7) where P=19683v^13-275562v^12+1388745v^11-1804275v^10 -10052343v^9+44382411v^8-41161510v^7-136024030v^6 +409871548v^5-286814789v^4-449999851v^3 +1045577541v^2-804786993v+230409954, A=486v^6-3807v^5+8973v^4+4038v^3 -51728v^2+82608v-43461, C=-243v^6+3240v^5-12492v^4+6666v^3 +61295v^2-138366v+89982. These are displayed polynomial identities, independently replayed by exact symbolic arithmetic in the audit. No fitted spectral curve or floating-point root count is used. ## 3. Only one interior parameter can have an equal-modulus pair Exact Sturm counts show P has precisely TWO roots in(-2,2), one in each of the rational intervals J_-=[-1761026772/10^9,-1761026771/10^9], J_+=[ 1314531712/10^9, 1314531713/10^9]. (8) Horner evaluation with rational interval arithmetic proves A!=0 on both intervals. On J_-, 1<-C/A<2; on J_+, 4<-C/A<5. The latter root cannot give an equal-modulus pair because t must belong to[-2,2]. All possible interior ties are therefore at the single root v_* in J_-. Approximate values, used ONLY as labels, are v_*=-1.761026771989515..., t_*=1.479926424410411..., u_eq/pi=.421400986116556... . ## 4. That possible tie involves only the two smaller roots For v in J_-, the corresponding lower-unit-circle Z lies in the exact rectangle Re Z in J_-/2, -474021285/10^9 < Im Z < -474021281/10^9. (9) The imaginary bounds follow by squaring their positive absolute values against 1-v^2/4. Use the following rational centers and radius r=1/1000: z_1=(1168965+2383072 i)/10^6, z_2=(2467958+ 977085 i)/10^6, z_3=(3765644- 990050 i)/10^6. (10) For every Z in(9), exact rectangular arithmetic gives, for each center, |f_Z(z_j)|<1/50000, |f'_Z(z_j)|>1, |3z_j+(5Z-3)|<20. On |lambda-z_j|=r the Taylor remainder is consequently bounded by 1/50000+20r^2+r^3 < r < |f'_Z(z_j)|r. Rouche's theorem isolates exactly one root in each disk. The disks are pairwise disjoint, so they exhaust all three roots. Their centers satisfy the exact rational inequalities |z_1|,|z_2|<3-r, |z_3|>3+r. Thus the first two roots have modulus<3 and the third modulus>3. In particular a tie at v_* cannot be a tie for the largest modulus. At u=0 the isolated root -2 is strictly larger than the two zero roots. By(3) it continues without an eigenvalue collision. Dominance could be lost only at an equal-modulus pair, and sections2--4 have excluded every possible dominant tie in the open half-circle. This proves(1)--(2). ## 5. What the actual source still has to supply This certificate is a usable piece of a source-selection proof rather than a replacement for it. For the literal backward recurrence, retain its three-component initial vector and all inhomogeneous currents. On a prefix where its exact evolution is the homogeneous companion of(1) plus a uniform smooth O(1/N) matrix error, suppose its actual initial vector is a nonzero polynomial-scale multiple of the dominant vector plus a relative error epsilon_N=o(1). This allows the actual O(N^(-1/2)) initial error, not only O(1/N). Then(2) proves dominant transport on every strict half-prefix by the following direct iteration. Choose a smooth dominant/complement frame, divide each step by mu, and obtain a scalar block1+O(1/N) coupled by O(1/N) to a uniformly stable two-dimensional block B(u). For any fixed strict prefix its powers are uniformly exponentially bounded: the two-by-two Cayley--Hamilton formula bounds them by C(m+1)r^m for some r<1, including coincident fast eigenvalues. Hence H(u)=sum_(m>=0) (B(u)^m)^* B(u)^m converges with bounded first derivative, I<=H<=C I, and H-B^*HB=I. Thus the B norm contracts by at most sqrt(1-1/C)<1. The moving-frame/moving-H error per step is O(1/N). Write a_i,b_i for the scalar and complementary components after dividing out the accumulated mu factors. For a fixed sigma<1, a direct induction in these block equations gives ||b_i||/|a_i| <= C[sigma^i epsilon_N+1/N], a_i/a_(i-1)=1+O(1/N). The induction starts because a_0 is nonzero and epsilon_N tends to0; the stable block absorbs its O(1/N) errors for all sufficiently large N. Every scalar ratio is then nonzero, and its product is bounded above and below by fixed positive constants. The total scalar coupling from the initial transient is at most C epsilon_N/N, since sum sigma^i is bounded. Summed logarithms have O(1) error relative to the dominant primitive. The double FAST root at0 causes no problem: only the dominant projection must be smooth, and its complementary block is uniformly stable there. The hypotheses in that last paragraph concern the ACTUAL vector source. Two scalar endpoint magnitudes do not establish them. The exact Q^2 delta_(i,1) forcing and the second reset D_2=0 of the forward Ward equation cannot be deleted when deriving this backward vector. In particular an interior inhomogeneous current must either be retained as an additional state with its own estimate, or bounded directly; the spectral result(2) does not make it harmless. Regularity of the cubic or nonzero Gaussian endpoint values alone is not being called a whole-source theorem. Audit: [exact ratio identities, Sturm intervals and three rational root disks](../experiments/audit_actual_backward_cubic_dominant_source_certificate.py). It uses exact rational arithmetic throughout, with no sampled eigenvalue plot or numerical integral in its proof.

title: A regular balanced full-Psi Fourier kernel for the original crossing source
text: # A regular balanced full-Psi Fourier kernel for the original crossing source 28 October 2026. At the complete original color, independent finite Fourier frames turn the entire two-Newton/one-Rogers crossing into a regular, explicitly normalized full-Psi Fourier kernel. All three finite source norms vanish on this frame's Fermat multisection. The resulting operator is EXACTLY the original physical crossing. The proof first bounds every possible alias error to degree +N, then eliminates it with one exact ORIGINAL E-coproduct Ward identity. Consequently all original words, currents, caps and sources are retained. This is stronger than setting a central scalar to one inside the old co-source. The external frames and internal Fermat sampling are part of one specified finite source map. Every intermediate frame change, original cup/cap, pivot and scalar line remains. The theorem does not prove a nonzero global geometric intersection or scalar volume limit. ## 1. Original kernel and the finite frames Use q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2, d=N-1, x=-q^(-1), s=x^N, so s^2=1. Retain the ORIGINAL common Cartan scalar kappa. The exact [complete positive layer](actual_trivalent_layer_crossing_source.md) is the original physical finite block of kappa CT_t K(t), K=B_N(t/z1,x^(-1)t/z0) R_N(z6/z0,x^(-1)z6/t) B_N(x^(-1)z7/z6,x^(-2)z7/t). (1) The complete positive Gaussian cell has ALREADY been contracted in (1); this is its exact finite coefficient identity, not a pointwise discard of a continuous Gaussian. The finite polynomials are B_N(u,v)=sum_(j=0)^d product_(k=0)^(j-1)(u-Q^k v), R_N(u,v)=sum_(i+j<N) F_(i+j)/(F_i F_j) u^i v^j. For nonzero r define the normalized finite frame F(r)_(k,a)=N^(-1/2) (r Q^k)^a, F(r)^(-1)_(a,k)=N^(-1/2) (r Q^k)^(-a). (2) Choose nonzero central values A,B with B!=s A, and fixed roots r0^N=A, r1^N=B, r6=x r1, r7=x r0, t0^(-N)=r1^(-N)-r7^(-N). (3) The last quantity is nonzero. For each external pair of input/output Fourier labels evaluate z_i=r_i Q^(label_i), and set t_j=t0 Q^j. Define the TWO-HEAD Fourier matrix M_(k,l;i,j)=kappa/N^3 sum_(m=0)^d K(t0 Q^m), (4) at these four external grid points. Define its decoded physical operator by Rhat_+=(F(r6)^(-1) tensor F(r7)^(-1)) M (F(r0) tensor F(r1)). (5) The factor N^(-3) in (4) is exact: N^(-2) is the two-head Fourier kernel normalization and N^(-1) is internal root averaging. **Exact-operator theorem.** Rhat_+=R_+, including its ORIGINAL Cartan line. Section 2 first proves that their difference can only have degree +N in the ORIGINAL finite index basis. Section 5 then proves that this difference is zero, using the actual E current. ## 2. The exact degree/carry proof Expand the three factors of (1) with indices (i,j),(r,k),(h,l), respectively, each nonnegative pair having sum<N. A term has external input/output exponents a=j+r, b=i, c=r+k-h, e=h+l, t-power p=i+j-k-l, c+e-a-b=-p. (6) Consequently a in[0,2d], b,e in[0,d], c in[-d,d], p in[-2d,d]. Internal root averaging keeps precisely p=0 and p=-N. Its latter term is t0^(-N)[t^(-N)]K. For p=-N, the same inequalities show that a<N and c>=0: a>=N would force output total>=2N, while c<0 would force output total<d. Neither is possible. Thus these terms already have valid original head indices and change degree by N. External inverse Fourier extraction folds a,c modulo N. On p=0, an input a>=N folds to a-N and adds degree N; an output c<0 folds to c+N and also adds degree N. These two cases cannot coincide: the former has original input total>=N, the latter original output total<d. All remaining p=0 terms are exactly the ORIGINAL physical finite block of (1). This proves the theorem. All root radius factors are retained in the folding; they are nonzero scalars and do not alter the degree calculation. On b physical heads the ideal of strictly positive changes N,2N,... has b-th power zero. Every original signed crossing preserves degree. Thus a word in these completed blocks differs from its original word only by that source-null ideal. The full original pointed partial trace kills it entrywise, and the pointed plat source kills it by its actual ordinary-cap constraints. The marked row alone is not assumed fixed-degree: cups have total k d, ordinary caps require (k-1)d, and an error would force the last pair to degree d+N>2d. This is the same proved [integer-degree source mechanism](actual_crossing_euler_completion_and_weight_source.md). ## 3. ALL three original source norms vanish on this actual grid Write T=t0^N, and at a grid point put u=t/z1, v=x^(-1)t/z0, f=x^(-1)z7/z6, r=z6/z0, w=x^(-1)z6/t. Their central powers are independent of all the finite labels: u^N=T/B, v^N=s T/A, r^N=s B/A, w^N=B/T, f^N=s A/B, (fw)^N=s A/T. Equation (3) implies exactly 1-u^N+v^N=0, 1-r^N-w^N=0, 1-f^N+(fw)^N=0. (7) All factors are regular on the stated torus: r^N and w^N are nonzero and different from one; the same holds for the central arguments of the Newton full-Psi factors, 1/u and v/u (and 1/f and w). The bare v^N itself need not avoid one. Hence each original finite polynomial equals its FULL source-normalized homogeneous term on this multisection: B_N(u,v)=S_B(u,v), R_N(r,w)=T_R(r,w), B_N(f,fw)=S_B(f,fw). (8) These are consequences of the independently proved finite source identities and their exact Fermat normalizers, including the opposite-root Rogers current. No current is thrown away before the complete sampling map (1)--(5). The regular restrictions in (3) ensure that the currents in those identities are regular; at a collision their combined finite expression must instead be continued, as usual. ## 4. Explicit normalized full-Psi Fourier evaluation Use the exact notations and constants of [the complete Fourier source, Sections 5--6 and 11](actual_crossing_shared_face_fourier_source.md). Let a,b,c,d0 be the retained logarithms of z0,z1,z6,z7, respectively, X=Log x and tau0=Log t0. Put beta=b-a-X, f_log=d0-c-X, rho=c-a, z=h+b-tau0, lambda=d0-b+2pi*i. The original affine 2pi*i mark is retained. Define C_boundary=(N^2/phi_N) exp[N(f_log-b)](1-exp(Nrho)) *Psi_+(beta)Psi_+(h-f_log)/Psi_+(rho) *exp{[beta*b-(c-X)(f_log+rho)]/h}, H_bal=i sqrt(N) phi_N zeta_0 (1-exp(-Nlambda)) exp[(N+z/h)lambda]. (9) Then EVERY entry of (4) is exactly M=kappa/N^3 C_boundary *(1-exp[N(c-X-tau0)]) exp(lambda*tau0/h) *H_bal*F_ref(lambda). (10) F_ref is the independently normalized full-Phi Fourier function F_ref(lambda)=zeta_0/(i sqrt(N)) *exp[i sqrt(N)lambda c_b-iNlambda^2/(4pi)] *Psi_+(lambda+2pi*i+h). (11) Thus (10) has FOUR variable full-Psi factors and its explicitly known Gaussian and central norm factors. It is an evaluation of the continued Fourier function with its stated logarithmic marks; an unrecorded move to a convergent real contour is not asserted. For the proof, exact shared-face sewing first gives Psi_-(sigma-h)Psi_+(sigma)=1-exp(Nsigma). After separation the only internal full function is Psi_+(z-hj). Its orbit is sum_j Psi_+(z-hj)exp(lambda*j) =Psi_+(z)B_(Q^(-1))(exp lambda, exp(lambda+z-h)). Here the second Newton balance is automatic: exp(Nlambda)(1-exp(Nz))=1. (12) The fully normalized resonant identity of Section 11 therefore has zero closure current and equals H_bal F_ref. Substitution gives (10). Every prefactor and variable full-Psi value in (10) is finite and nonzero on the regular chart. Alternatively the finite balanced Newton Fourier recurrence proves directly that the final orbit sum is nonzero. Hence every entry of this actual FOUR-LEG Fourier kernel is nonzero. ### A root-independent four-function kernel and its controlled density All internal-root dependence in (10) cancels. In the same retained external logarithms set G=d0-a-X, R_c=exp(Nrho)=s B/A, E=N f_log+(N+1)lambda/2 +[G(b-c+X)+lambda^2/2]/h. Then (10) is the particularly simple exact expression M=kappa zeta_0^2/N *R_c(1-R_c)^2 exp(E) *Psi_+(beta)Psi_+(h-f_log) Psi_+(lambda+2pi*i+h)/Psi_+(rho). (14) To verify it, the powers in (10)--(11) multiply to kappa zeta_0^2/N. Balance gives 1-exp(Nrho)=1-R_c, 1-exp(Nsigma)=R_c, and 1-exp(-Nlambda)=1-R_c. In the exponent use z+tau0=h+b, i sqrt(N)c_b=-(N+1)/2, and beta+lambda=G+2pi*i. The term (2pi*i b)/h=N b cancels the -N b from the boundary prefactor. The remaining exponent is exactly E. No affine mark is removed. For central A,B in a fixed compact subset of A B(B-s A)!=0, with fixed bounded root logarithms, the entire density outside the FOUR full-Psi functions has sharp polynomial size: c_K/N <= |kappa zeta_0^2 R_c(1-R_c)^2 exp(E)/N| <=C_K/N, (15) uniformly for EVERY choice of the four finite labels and every N. Indeed each external logarithm has real part O_K(1/N) and imaginary part O_K(1). X is purely imaginary. Products in E/h therefore have bounded real parts, as do N f_log and (N+1)lambda/2. Also |kappa|=|zeta_0|=1 and R_c,1-R_c are uniformly bounded above and below. This proves (15). Thus the reference kernel has an explicit nonzero original-source local density, with no hidden exponential gauge or periodic normalizer. Its dilogarithmic action is in its four full functions and recorded Gaussian. This is a local normalization theorem; sewing and applying the original global source can still cancel. ### A genuine positive octahedral chart of this ACTUAL kernel The four classical shapes in (14), with their signed orientations, are u=-z1/z0, v=-z6/z7, w=z7/z1, and -(uvw), where the last minus denotes its coefficient in the Bloch sum, not multiplication of its shape by -1. Thus the signed regulator is D(u)+D(v)+D(w)-D(uvw). On the unit-angle chart let 0<theta1,theta2,theta3<pi, pi<theta1+theta2+theta3<2pi, theta4=2pi-theta1-theta2-theta3. Then u=exp(i theta1), v=exp(i theta2), w=exp(i theta3), and the negative fourth tetrahedron has positive quad shape 1/(uvw)=exp(i theta4). These are four positive ideal tetrahedra around an octahedral diagonal, with total angle 2pi. On every compact subset of this chart, the independently proved [full-Psi strip estimate](actual_modular_dilog_circle_and_boundary_source.md#a-uniform-geometric-phase-on-the-whole-selected-strip) and (15) give the actual kernel a nonzero analytic leading density. Recorded whole-turn shifts contribute their exact nonzero central factors; they are bounded on the stated central compacta. Its leading logarithmic modulus obeys the uniform two-sided estimate log|M|=N V(theta)/(2pi)-log N+O_K(1), (15a) with V equal to the volume of those four positive tetrahedra and theta the sampled angles in that compact chamber. The O(1/N) root-modulus and half-step changes alter the logarithm by O_K(1). This is a statement about the literal original finite Fourier kernel, not a newly chosen packet. The volume is strictly concave on this convex angle chamber. Indeed for L(theta)=D(exp(i theta)), L''(theta)=-cot(theta/2)/2, and Hess V=-diag(cot(theta_i/2))/2 +cot((theta1+theta2+theta3)/2) 11^t/2. Both terms are negative definite or negative semidefinite here, with the first strictly negative. Its unique maximum is theta1=theta2=theta3=theta4=pi/2, the regular octahedron. The existence of this local chart does not place the complete global geometric critical point on its sewn original source. ## 5. An exact ORIGINAL E-current eliminates every possible alias The degree +N allowance in Section 2 can be removed. Retain the ORIGINAL complete scaled head current and coproduct Ecal|a>=(Q^(-a)-1)|a-1>, Ecal|0>=0, K|a>=x Q^(-a)|a>, E_total=Ecal_1 K_2+Ecal_2. (16) The actual R_+ commutes with E_total. In the finite Fourier frame, put (Tf)(z)=f(Qz). Then EXACTLY, for every nonzero frame radius, Ecal=z^(-1)(T^(-1)-I), K=x T^(-1). There is no missing wrap: the coefficient of the input constant in the first expression is zero, and all other powers lower without crossing the finite top. Use z0,z1,z6,z7 for the four grid values, and let M denote (14). Its exact one-step full-Psi identities give the ratios R1=M(z6/Q,z7/Q)/M =-z6/z0 *(1-z7/z1)/(1-z6/(Qz0)), R2=M(z6,z7/Q)/M =q z6/z7 *(1-z7/z1)/(1-Qx z6/z7), M(z0 Q,z1 Q)/M=R1, R4=M(z0,z1 Q)/M =q z1/z0 *(1-z7/z1)/(1-z1/(xz0)). (17) All untouched arguments in each ratio are held fixed. Their denominators are nonzero on the regular central chart. Here q=-1/x and Q=x^(-2). Substituting (17) proves the rational identity x/z6*(R1-R2)+(R2-1)/z7 =x/z0*(Q^(-1)R1-R4)+(Q^(-1)R4-1)/z1. (18) This is precisely the matrix relation E_total,out M=M E_total,in. The factors Q^(-1) on the right come from transposing the finite input difference: z_j^(-1) at its shifted row becomes Q^(-1)z_input^(-1). Thus (18) is the ORIGINAL quantum-group current, not merely its commuting symbol. Decoding the four finite frames proves [Rhat_+,E_total]=0. For completeness, (17) can be checked without an operator claim. Under logarithmic shifts (delta a,delta b,delta c,delta d0) =h(Ai,Bi,Ci,Di), put dl=Di-Bi, dG=Di-Ai, dJ=Bi-Ci. The Gaussian in (14) has ratio x^(-dl) exp[dG(b-c+X)+dJ(d0-a-X)+dl lambda] *Q^(dG*dJ+dl^2/2). Apply Psi(z+h)=Psi(z)/(1-exp z) and its inverse to the four full functions. For the four shifts in (17) the displayed ratios result directly. Equation (18) is then an elementary rational identity; cross-multiplication uses only Qx^2=1. Finally E_total is INJECTIVE on each physical total-degree subspace t>=N. Its inputs have first index a=t-d,...,d, all positive. The first output (t-d-1,d) sees only the leftmost input, with nonzero coefficient (Q^(-(t-d))-1)K_d. Remove it and continue: the bidiagonal matrix forces every remaining input coefficient to vanish. Let Delta=Rhat_+-R_+. It has degree +N by Section 2 and commutes with E_total. On input degree zero, E_total Delta=0; injectivity at degree N implies Delta=0 there. Induct on input degree j: Delta E_total=0 follows from the preceding degree, hence E_total Delta=0, and injectivity at j+N implies Delta=0. At j>=N-1 the target degree exceeds 2d and Delta already vanishes. This proves Rhat_+=R_+ for EVERY level, including N=2, composite and even levels. ## 6. Signed words, adapters, source, and scope The negative block is obtained by the exact complete-color antiunitary mirror R_-=P overline(R_+)P, with its original Cartan factor and all frames/marks transported. Applying the same mirror to (5) gives the EXACT original negative operator. This does not balance the raw negative continuous Gaussian at a fixed value of its integration variable; that shortcut would be false. The literal inverse of (5) is consequently the original negative crossing as well. Independent frames at consecutive gates must be joined by their EXACT finite change of frame. On one shared head it is F(r')F(r)^(-1)_(j,k) =(1/N)sum_(a=0)^d (r'/r)^a Q^((j-k)a) =[1-C]/[N(1-(r'/r)Q^(j-k))], C=(r'/r)^N, (13) with its removable finite-sum values. If the central values and their fixed logarithmic marks stay in a compact nonzero set, r=exp(Log A/N), these frames and their inverses have uniformly bounded norms. The same holds for (13). All original cups/caps, pivots and scalar lines are transformed by those same frames. Their polynomial norms at the complete color remain polynomial. No matching of independent central values is required. In fact forcing direct same-grid closure on a one-component braid drives this local regular chart to t0=infinity; the adapters in (13) are what avoid that artificial restriction. Their off-diagonal tails are generally O(1/N), not exponentially small, and are part of the retained global gluing and co-source. After inserting these adapters, decoding the whole finite network recovers the EXACT original physical word, by Section 5. This retains arbitrary inserted original currents and coupons when they are transformed by the same finite frames. The global construction and its source are recorded in [the regular balanced word theorem](regular_balanced_fermat_word_source.md). This theorem resolves the local circle/current normalization by an actual finite polarization. It supplies a nonzero local Fourier kernel with the ORIGINAL closed scalar retained. Global selected geometric survival, source-angle bounds, and dominance still require control of the sewn finite Fourier sum and the retained adapters. The [audit](../experiments/audit_actual_balanced_fourier_crossing_kernel.py) checks independent original crossing matrices, exact finite-index folding, both signs, full original word/cap sources, the central balances, and the full-Psi/Fourier scalar at independent complex grid points.

title: Octahedral belt stacks and their marked outer collars
text: # Octahedral belt stacks and their marked outer collars 29 October 2026. There is an infinite family of actual augmented link diagrams, with unbounded numbers of complete crossing circles, whose original Kashaev volume limits follow from the complete-circle source packet. The balanced case has a direct positive nodal-energy proof; the general case uses its coherent complex Gaussian. The operation is CYCLIC stacking along one actual twice-punctured crossing disk. It is not branching scalar Frobenius multiplication. The source, the cut collars, and their complete metric are specified below. The later coherent boundary-packet theorem removes the balance restriction and allows every FIXED integer outer crossing power. Section 3a gives the literal collar certificate for this extension; section 4a links its original-source asymptotic. The filename retains the earlier balanced checkpoint, which remains the elementary positive special case. ## 1. The two typed pieces, before evaluating any invariant Let C be the literal auxiliary tangle [2,1,1,2] with its third top/bottom endpoints joined on the right. Its two physical input and two physical output ports stay open. It evaluates to L_N, with the original ordinary pivot and no extra trace denominator. Let X_+ and X_- be the original single checked crossings. Use the genuine quarter-turn F, with the duality adapters of [the physical turn theorem](actual_newton_turn_positive_gram.md). The positive piece D_+ is the two-strand tangle D_+ = F(X_+ C) X_- . (1) It is obtained by opening the OUTER auxiliary circle of the verified [two-octahedron source](actual_reflected_two_circle_octahedral_base.md). Its other auxiliary circle remains closed. Its two disk-side boundary collars are the two standard twice-punctured disks used to stack two-strand tangles. Define D_- as the mirror of D_+, followed by the 180-degree rotation reversing its input/output direction. This is a definition of an actual diagram, not a polynomial selected from an invariant. The rotation carries its two physical punctures and the belt-boundary collar along with it. The mirror of C is the negative crossing word [-2,-1,-1,-2], not a convention that silently keeps all four crossings positive. There is a direct unoriented/typed identification with the same crossing circle: draw its disk horizontally in D^2 times I around the two vertical physical strands. Reflection in the vertical plane containing those strands fixes the disk and its boundary AS SETS, and reverses the auxiliary boundary orientation. There is no curl or self-framing change. The reversed auxiliary is its genuine dual. For the complete balanced color its actual self-duality matrix is U_(a,b)=x^(-b) delta_(a+b,d), U=p/N, U unitary. Use the original dual cup/cap to identify that reversed closed leg; the two inverse U adapters and their original scalar normalizations cancel on the CLOSED auxiliary. Its pivotal factor is transported by this duality, not replaced by hand while leaving the crossings unchanged. No main-head conjugation remains. Hence the actual closed negative word has the same all-input operator L_N. This is the round crossing-disk reflection with its typed duality, not an inference solely from the real polynomial L_N. The focused audit also closes the negative universal-R word with the literal original pivot and checks its full matrix at five levels. Here is the all-port source reading. Write z=F(R^-1 L_N), so z#=F(R L_N). The operator/source of the two pieces is EXACTLY f_+ = z# R^-1, f_- = R z. (2) For f_+ this is the literal word (1), read in the source's product order. For f_-, reflection sends R to R^-1, L_N to L_N, and F to the same real unscaled turn. It first gives z R. Input/output reversal is the genuine 180-degree rotation: it REVERSES the stacking order and acts on each Hopf box by F^2. The full physical turn theorem proves F^2 h=h on the complete pair algebra, so it gives Rz. This argument retains all cups, caps, Cartan phases and Casimir normal coefficients. It does not derive the reflected port reading by first commuting two scalar polynomials. The full original matrix audit separately checks the rotations and (2). For any fixed word epsilon=(epsilon_1,...,epsilon_n), epsilon_i in {+,-}, stack these ACTUAL pieces in that order, retain ONE outer auxiliary circle C around their two physical strands, and take the original denominator/marked closure. Call this link L_epsilon. There is one inner circle per piece and one outer belt. Removing the circles leaves a stack of two-strand full twists: D_+ becomes X_-^2 and D_- becomes X_+^2. Its permutation is the identity. Consequently L_epsilon has n+3 components: two main components, n inner circles and one outer belt. No component identification is being inferred from an invariant value. ## 2. The literal disk cut and the geometric pieces Use the labeled cut certificate of the two-octahedron base. Its two regular octahedra P_+,P_- have opposite labeled orientations and opposite vertex pairs {X0,X1}, {Y+,Y-}, {Z+,Z-}. The OUTER disk has shaded triangles A=(X0,Y+,Z+), B=(X0,Y-,Z-). The other disk has C=(X1,Y+,Z-) and D=(X1,Y-,Z+). The original white identity face gluings join A+ to A- along all THREE edges. They similarly join B+ to B-. Thus S_A=A+ union A-, S_B=B+ union B- (3) are the two actual thrice-punctured sphere boundaries after cutting the outer disk. The original outer A-to-B shaded pairings are the only face identifications removed by this cut. The inner C-to-D pairings remain. The resulting piece is connected and contains exactly two complete regular octahedra. These pants are TOTALLY GEODESIC, not just intrinsically ideal triangulated surfaces. Every shaded face meets an adjacent white face at pi/2. Reflection in that white face therefore continues the shaded plane to itself. Across each of the three edges in (3) the two shaded triangles develop into a single plane. The metric on (3) is the complete ideal two-triangle pants metric. This is the geometric reading of the actual collar opening used in (1): a twice-punctured crossing disk has three ideal boundary ends, namely its outer belt and its two physical punctures. Its two sides are S_A,S_B with these same three labeled ends. Restoring the collars is the inverse of the base's proved disk cut. Therefore stacking the open diagram pieces joins an output copy of these pants to the input copy of the next piece. After the last piece, the single remaining outer circle closes this stack in a cycle. No additional complete circle is inserted at an intermediate seam. The reflected/reversed piece has the same geometric certificate. On its cut octahedra, reflection exchanges P_+ and P_-. The input/ output reversal exchanges Y+ with Y- and Z+ with Z-, fixing X0,X1. This interchanges A and B, C and D, and the corresponding white faces. This is exactly the collar reversal in the diagram definition of D_-. It is an octahedral symmetry on the vertex labels, and preserves the three actual boundary-end labels after transporting them with the piece. Thus its geometric boundaries are precisely those used by the source reading (2). ## 3. Complete hyperbolic metric after an arbitrary fixed stack Glue these geometric pieces by the actual cyclic collar maps. A three-puncture bijection is an isometry of the ideal two-triangle pants. In the present labeled construction it can be checked directly: the corresponding map of a shaded triangle extends to an octahedral symmetry. In normalized hyperboloid coordinates the ideal vertices are (1,+/-e1),(1,+/-e2),(1,+/-e3). The symmetry sends these light vectors EXACTLY, not merely their rays. Therefore it preserves the canonical horospheres and the two-triangle cusp sections. The same holds for the reflected/reversed collar maps above. Each seam joins two geodesic boundary half-neighborhoods by an isometry, giving an ordinary smooth hyperbolic neighborhood. In the regular-cell certificate each boundary edge has angle pi on its side, so the joined angle is exactly 2pi. There is no edge cone angle or undetermined axis dilation. Matched canonical horospheres give Euclidean torus cusp sections of the actual diagram; shrinking them gives disjoint sections. There are finitely many cells and the remaining truncated core is compact. Thus every end contains a full horoball cusp and the glued finite-volume metric is complete. This proves, for every fixed word epsilon of length n>=1, that the ACTUAL complement of L_epsilon is hyperbolic and Vol(S^3 minus L_epsilon)=2n v8. (4) The topology is obtained by reversing the literal disk/collar cuts, not by recognizing a census triangulation or matching a numerical volume. For all plus signs this is also the explicit cyclic cover obtained by taking n copies of the cut base and shifting the two outer A-to-B face pairings by one sheet. The metric proof does not need to identify mixed words with that particular peripheral cover. ### 3a. Any fixed integer outer crossing power Let L_(epsilon,a) be the same literal stack, but insert X^a in the OUTER disk collar between the retained C and the first piece. Here a is any fixed signed integer. Its placement is part of the actual diagram, and its source is phi(L_N R^a product_i f_(epsilon_i)). The belt component is RETAINED; none of its cusps is filled. A single X exchanges the two physical punctures of the standard twice-punctured disk. After passing to its complete ideal pants, this is the isometry that fixes the belt end, exchanges the two physical ends, and EXCHANGES its two ideal triangles. This last exchange is necessary: permuting two vertices in one fixed triangle alone would give the wrong oriented collar map. In the canonical labels of section 2, put the extra power at the last cyclic seam. Its exact face maps are | Parity of a | Source to target | Vertex map | | --- | --- | --- | | even | A_last^+ to B_first^-, A_last^- to B_first^+ | X0 fixed, Y+ to Y-, Z+ to Z- | | odd | A_last^+ to B_first^+, A_last^- to B_first^- | X0 fixed, Y+ to Z-, Z+ to Y- | This is obtained by tracing the two punctures through the actual single collar crossing. It is also the usual two-puncture half rotation of the disk. Its square is a full collar twist: as an ideal pants map it is isotopic to the identity, while the rotations at its ends record a change of the BELT PERIPHERAL MARKING. Thus adding two crossings changes that marking without changing the unmarked complete face quotient. Negative a has the same parity description with its opposite recorded twist. No preferred meridian is silently kept fixed while deleting R^a from the quantum source. Every displayed triangle map still extends to an octahedral symmetry preserving the normalized light vectors. In the explicit eight-tet subdivision, a last odd seam toggles the target cell P_+ versus P_- while exchanging Y and Z. These two changes cancel in local coordinates: its gluing permutation remains 0132. All tetrahedra keep their positive shape i, all edge products are one and all edge angles are 2pi. The same canonical cusp sections therefore match, without dilation, at either parity. The two main components of the untwisted stack merge exactly when a is odd: after the circles are removed, the physical two-strand permutation is that of X^(2(n_- - n_+)+a). Here n_+ and n_- count plus and minus pieces. Each of the n inner circles and the single outer belt remains distinct. Consequently components L_(epsilon,a) = n+3 for even a, n+2 for odd a. (4a) The exact cusp links of the modified cell quotient have precisely these counts. They are connected orientable flat tori; for an odd collar the former Y and Z main links become one. The compact-core and matched horoball argument of section 3 applies unchanged. We have proved the ACTUAL geometric statement Vol(S^3 minus L_(epsilon,a))=2n v8 for every fixed n>=1, epsilon and a in Z. (4b) This is a complete augmented exterior with its marked collar, not a Dehn-filled exterior or a volume-continuity assertion. ## 4. Balanced words give the full original volume limit Suppose n=2k and the word has exactly k plus and k minus pieces. By (2), the actual fixed-root source is Phi_epsilon,N = phi(L_N product_i f_(epsilon_i)). (5) The complete two-head Hopf commutant is the FULL algebra C[Omega], including its repeated-root normal directions. Consequently all the f_i commute there, and R^k R^-k cancels in the entire product: product_i f_(epsilon_i)=(z# z)^k. In an adjacent +- pair this is also the direct cancellation of the literal factors X_- X_+; the general reordered formula is a proved all-input source identity, not a claim that every different ordering is isotopic. The retained-belt theorem now gives Phi_epsilon,N=N sum_c m_c |z_N(c)|^(2k)>0, lim_N (2pi/N) log Phi_epsilon,N=4k v8. (6) All N, both parities and all composite levels are included. The [complete-source normalization](actual_complete_augmented_source_normalization.md) retains only its original unit framing/component phases (or the single recorded 1/N in the one-cut modified convention); it adds no modified dimension per circle. Combining (4),(6), the literal original reduced Kashaev evaluation satisfies lim_N (2pi/N) log |<L_epsilon>_N| =Vol(S^3 minus L_epsilon)=4k v8. (7) This proves a growing complete augmented LINK family. It does not prove arbitrary long fillings of these new bases, fixed knots, or arbitrary-bridge volume limits. The quantum gluing graph here is a cycle along ONE retained belt; a branched tree requires its actual six-port tensor and cannot be substituted into (5). ### 4a. Coherent source extension to every sign word and outer collar For n_+ plus and n_- minus pieces put n=n_+ + n_->0 and e=n_- - n_+. The full commutant/source calculation, with the actual typed pieces (2), is phi(L_N R^a product_i f_(epsilon_i)) =phi(L_N R^(e+a) (z#)^n_+ z^n_-). (8) There is no absolute value inside this unbalanced channel sum. The [coherent original belt-stack asymptotic](actual_coherent_octahedral_belt_stack_asymptotic.md) proves its nonzero all-N asymptotic from the actual complex complete-circle boundary packet. It retains the full crossing phase, endpoint multiplicities, ordinary pivots and marked source. Its complex Gaussian has coefficient n-i(e+a), whose real part n is positive, so it never vanishes for these fixed integers. In particular lim_N (2pi/N)log|phi(L_N R^(e+a)(z#)^n_+ z^n_-)|=2n v8. (9) Applying the SAME explicit original reduced normalization as above and the geometric collar certificate (4b) gives lim_N (2pi/N)log|<L_(epsilon,a)>_N| =Vol(S^3 minus L_(epsilon,a)) =2n v8. (10) The word, its length n and the signed outer integer a are fixed before N tends to infinity. Both parities and composite levels are included. The balanced positive source in (6) is a special case; the general theorem needs the coherent complex Gaussian and does not follow by taking magnitudes of individual channel terms. Arbitrary fillings of these new bases and genuinely branched multi-belt source graphs remain outside the statement. Coverage only: the abstract of Roland van der Veen's [Proof of the volume conjecture for Whitehead chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0611181) already states a volume-conjecture theorem for an infinite link family extending the Whitehead link and Borromean rings. The present literal belt stacks may lie in that family; no new literature-family claim is made without an exact clasp/port dictionary. Neither that paper's proof nor its asymptotic formula is an input above. The reusable result established here is the full original-source DCT energy bridge and its specified physical belt seam. Independent final publication review (29 October 2026) rechecked the actual opening, full mirror/F^2 source, and the odd outer collar's SIMULTANEOUS exchange of pants triangles and physical punctures. The resulting local permutation0132, canonical horospheres, component counts, marked collar and single retained belt agree with the complete source asymptotic, including its literal kappa square-root convention. No additional hypothesis or mathematical defect was found beyond the stated fixed nonempty word and fixed signed a before N tends to infinity. Fresh independent replays passed the exact source/cell audit at both collar parities (16 cell cases), the complete all-sign/outer-power source audit, and nine supplemental literal-diagram checks. The 860 phase checks in the source audit use high-precision arithmetic; the phase identities themselves are proved algebraically in its note. Software recognition and finite profiles remain supplemental, not premises for the topology or asymptotic theorem. Fillings, branched six-port gluing and literature novelty are outside this review's claim. Audit: [literal balanced sources and exact cyclic face certificate](../experiments/audit_actual_balanced_octahedral_belt_stack_volume.py). The optional literal-diagram/software comparison is supplemental; the proof is the reversible cut, matched pants collars, and exact regular-cell metric above. Reproducible local commands (no dependency installation): python3 experiments/audit_actual_balanced_octahedral_belt_stack_volume.py .venv/bin/python experiments/audit_actual_balanced_octahedral_belt_stack_volume.py --software-only The first uses NumPy for full original source matrices. The second uses the existing geometry environment, requires no NumPy, and adds only its separately labeled literal-diagram diagnostics.

title: Actual auxiliary-color packets through the complete-circle quarter transition
text: # Actual auxiliary-color packets through the complete-circle quarter transition 29 October 2026. This extends the complete-circle boundary packet to the ACTUAL inner auxiliary color j=N-h, rather than declaring its pair-Casimir argument to be a peripheral parameter. It proves an exact finite analytic inner packet on a fixed complex color disk, with a nonzero joint spectral/color asymptotic, and a full physical inner-color complement gap. Every original first Casimir normal and Cartan phase remains present. The final outer-circle color functional is a separate operation. The estimates below supply its inner inputs; they do not by themselves assert the hypotheses of the general long-filling theorem for the whole stack or identify a deformed representation. ## 1. The actual mixed circle, including its nonzero second band Use N,d,q,Q,kappa,M,F_r,s_r and the original continuants f_v from [the exact mixed two-band source](actual_pretzel_cusp_color_two_band_bound.md). For every physical 0<=h<=M, the FULL all-port identity is z_(N,h)=mathscrR(R^(-1)L_(N-h))=c_(N,h)+R P_(N,h), c_(N,h)=kappa^(-1) sum_(v=h)^M N^2 s_(2v) f_v/[s_v^2 s_(v-h)s_(v+h)]. (1) Here L_j is the literal ordinary mixed-color auxiliary trace and mathscrR is the genuine unscaled physical turn. For j<=N/2 the whole box is the pure alias (-1)^N R P_(N,j), including the even middle color. Thus all physical colors are accounted for. The reflected box is z_(N,h)^sharp. The sharp operation means coefficient conjugation, including kappa and the fixed root. Its complex-color continuation will be defined by Schwarz reflection of the specified analytic packet, not by conjugating its parameter inside an allegedly holomorphic expression. For the physical low core, interchanging its two finite sums gives c_(N,h)(c)=N^2 sum_(r=0)^M b_(N,r)(h) B_r(c), b_(N,r)=kappa^(-1) q^(h^2)(-1)^r q^(2r^2+r) A_(h,r)/F_r^3, A_(h,r)=sum_(v=max(h,r))^M Q^(-vr)F_(2v)/[F_v F_(v-h)F_(v+h)F_(v-r)], B_r(c)=product_(a<r)(c_a-c). (2) These are exact root identities with their ORIGINAL marked phases. No upper band, source normal or normalization is suppressed. ## 2. A source-selected complex-color channel THROUGH the quarter point Put tau=r/N, chi=pi h/N, H=exp(2i chi), Y=exp(2pi i tau), epsilon=1/N. On a fixed compact r-window about N/4, define A_(h,r) for COMPLEX h=N chi/pi by replacing F_(v-h),F_(v+h) in its finite sum v=r,...,M by the canonical marked Fhat_N. All these arguments remain in regular nonzero factorial strips after choosing a fixed small complex chi disk. The continuation is even in chi and equals the physical coefficient whenever h is an integer below the window. Normalize U_(h,r)=A_(h,r)/D_(h,r), where D_(h,r)=Q^(-r^2)F_(2r)/[F_r Fhat_N(r-h)Fhat_N(r+h)]. The [literal mixed Ward and high source](actual_pretzel_mixed_inner_source_wkb.md) prove, for THIS finite factorial continuation, U_r=p_N(tau,chi) U_(r+1)+q_N(tau,chi) U_(r+2), (3) p_N=-Q^(-2)Y^(-1)(2cos(2chi)Q^3Y^2+Q+1) /[(1-QY/H)(1-QYH)], q_N=-Q^(-4)Y^(-2)(1-Q^2Y)(1-Q^3Y^2)(1+Q^2Y) /[(1-QY/H)(1-QYH)(1-Q^2Y/H)(1-Q^2YH)]. The original source is U_M=1; its q_(M-1)=0 wall is exact at both parities and remains independent of complex chi. In particular the actual source, rather than an arbitrary solution of (3), is holomorphic and nonzero at a strict high-index anchor. Let mu_s,mu_f be the roots of the principal companion, continued from mu_s=-Y^(-1), mu_f=Y^(-1)cot(pi tau)^2 at chi=0. They are distinct and nonzero near tau=1/4 on a fixed complex neighborhood and small chi disk. Their relative multiplier in HIGH-to-LOW transport at chi=0 is -cot(pi tau)^2. Apply the supplied-eigenframe analytic diagonalizer from [the boundary-packet proof](actual_complete_circle_boundary_packet.md#2-the-exact-direction-of-transport-and-a-source-barrier), now holomorphically in chi. First fix its neighborhood and positive exponential remainder barrier sigma. Then choose a small fixed delta, anchor u_b=pi/4+2delta+O(1/N), and target |u-pi/4|<=delta/4. At chi=0 the relative fast action from anchor to ANY target is at most -gamma_0<0, while its entire intermediate action width is O(delta^2)<sigma/4. Continuity on the fixed complex chi disk preserves a strictly negative target action and width<sigma/2. Shrink chi AFTER delta; merely distinct roots do not imply this. The established high-index continued fraction supplies the exact anchor vector. Relative to its nonzero selected scalar, its slow coefficient is1+O(1/N), its fast coefficient O(1/N), uniformly for complex chi. Multiplying the exponentially diagonalized recurrence in its diagonal interaction frame bounds EVERY conversion error by exp[-N(sigma-width)]. The initially present fast source component is exponentially damped on the target. No source component or compensating current is deleted. This proves selection through the modulus crossing, uniformly on that fixed complex parameter disk. Optimal analytic Euler--Maclaurin of the slow diagonal product, anchored to the SAME exact high source coefficient, now gives a holomorphic zero-free Uhat_N(tau,chi) on a tube containing the whole anchor-to-target interval. On the target physical r-grid, U_(h,r)=Uhat_N(r/N,chi)[1+O(exp(-gamma N))]. (4) All statements are uniform in complex chi. The first transport coefficients are exactly the old rational expressions S(tau,chi)=integral_tau^(1/2) Log mu_s(t,chi)dt, C(tau,chi)=sqrt(mu_s(tau,chi)) exp[integral_tau^(1/2)nu/mu_s dt], nu=[p_1+q_1/mu_s-q_0(partial_tau mu_s)/mu_s^2] /[1+q_0/mu_s^2]. (5) The roots are continued from the original high interval to the target; the denominator is1-mu_f/mu_s and does NOT vanish at the quarter point. The normal-form diagonal and its first correction are holomorphic. Their explicit first-order scalar transport gives Uhat_N=C(tau,chi) exp[N S(tau,chi)] [1+O(1/N)]. (6) The constant is fixed by the old high source on the overlapping anchor tube, not by an unknown closed circle value. Formula (5) agrees there with the proved selected transport; the same analytic nonresonant transport equation continues it uniquely across the quarter point. This separates the algebraic leading error in (6) from the exponential original-grid error in (4). ## 3. Exact finite analytic inner packet and its joint asymptotic Choose a fixed index window I_N about the quarter point whose closure lies STRICTLY INSIDE the controlled target neighborhood in section2; for example use |u-pi/4|<=delta/8. Its endpoints may move by O(1/N) to the physical grid. It is nonempty for all sufficiently large N. Take the finite polynomial Z_N^win(c,chi)=N^2 sum_(r in I_N) kappa^(-1) q^(h^2)(-1)^r q^(2r^2+r) Ahat_(h,r) B_r(c)/F_r^3, (7) where Ahat is the EXACT finite factorial completion in section2. It is even holomorphic in chi on a fixed complex disk, with all Casimir derivatives literal. The reflected packet is Z_N^(win,sharp)(c,chi)=conjugate(Z_N^win(conjugate(c),conjugate(chi))). Both are holomorphic, with their separate typed source phases. Let J_sin(tau)=integral_0^tau Log(2sin(pi t))dt and define B(tau,chi)=S(tau,chi)-S(tau,0)+2J_sin(tau) -J_sin(tau-chi/pi)-J_sin(tau+chi/pi), D(tau,chi)=[C(tau,chi)/C(tau,0)] sin(pi tau) /sqrt(sin(pi tau-chi)sin(pi tau+chi)). (8) The marked factorial reflection shows these are precisely the exponential correction and amplitude ratio of q^(h^2)D_(h,r)/D_(0,r). In particular B(tau,0)=0,D(tau,0)=1, and D is nonzero. Put Psi(u,eta,chi)=[-Lambda(2u)+6Lambda(u)]/pi +(1/(2pi))integral_0^(2u)Log(2cosh eta+2cos v)dv +B(u/pi,chi). (9) The whole phase is even in eta and chi. At (eta,chi)=(0,0), its selected index is u=pi/4 and Psi_uu=-8/pi. The implicit function theorem gives a unique holomorphic u_*(eta,chi) nearby. Let j(eta,chi)=Psi(u_*,eta,chi), and a(eta,chi)=[sqrt(sin(2u_*))/sin(u_*)^(5/2)] exp(iu_*/2)D(u_*/pi,chi) /[4sqrt(pi)sqrt(-Psi_uu(u_*,eta,chi))]. (10) These are the SAME source-calibrated functions as the old mixed high-index theorem on its overlap eta>0; now both parameters range on fixed complex disks about zero. The exact finite packet satisfies Z_N^win(-2cosh eta,chi) =exp(-i pi d/4) a(eta,chi) exp[Nj(eta,chi)] [1+O(1/N)], (11) uniformly on smaller fixed complex disks. Its amplitude is nonzero. Proof: (4) supplies an exponentially accurate ORIGINAL-grid interpolant. Canonical factorials and the half-shift Newton factor are regular on this window and have the same optimal EM residual bound. The exact half-grid cotangent rectangle retains every vertical endpoint and horizontal nonzero-mode current. Its complete real phase has a fixed endpoint gap; the top/bottom cotangent errors have exp(-2Nd) while the phase increases O(d^2). Choose contour height first, then shrink the fixed eta,chi disks. All residuals are below the selected saddle by a fixed exponential rate. The two constant cotangent pieces give the same saddle integral with density N/pi. Analytic Gaussian expansion gives (10)--(11), including both original parity phases. This is the earlier exact cotangent proof with the newly justified source across the quarter point, not continuation of a merely pointwise leading formula. The rational principal quadratic gives, by differentiating in chi^2, j(eta,chi)=j(eta,0) -(1+exp(2iu_*(eta,0)))chi^2/(2pi i)+O(chi^4). Consequently at the complete spectral point, j(eta,chi)=j_0+eta^2/(4pi) +(-1+i)chi^2/(2pi)+O((|eta|+|chi|)^4), (12) with j_0=v8/pi. Reflection reverses the imaginary color coefficient, with its own explicit opposite complete-source phase. The real physical-color curvature is strictly negative. All fixed Casimir normals follow from the uniform holomorphic c-disk in (11); this does not assert moving-q normal derivatives of an unspecified off-root turn family. These estimates apply to the EXACT packet, not only its leading expression. Writing theta=s+it, chi=x+iy, and using eta=i theta, one may shrink the fixed disks so that |Z_N^win(-2cos theta,chi)| <=poly(N) exp N[j_0-a(s^2+x^2)+C(t^2+y^2)] (12a) for some a,C>0. The same holds for the typed reflected packet. The cross terms from the imaginary quadratic coefficient are absorbed by a fixed completion of squares; the quartic remainder is absorbed after shrinking. The uniform relative error in (11) changes only the prefactor. There is also a fixed angular gap away from theta=0. On the whole physical r-window the exact coefficient bound is |b_(N,r)(chi)|<=poly(N) [s_(2r)/s_r^6] exp(CN|chi|^2). It follows from (4)--(8) and their even analytic action perturbation. The old Newton arc-convolution has a strict angular gap uniformly on this compact r-window about pi/4. Therefore, on the remainder of the physical theta circle outside any fixed small central arc, the packet is bounded by poly(N)exp[N(j_0-g+C|chi|^2)]. The gap persists on a small fixed complex theta strip and chi disk. Cauchy on radius1/N then controls every fixed derivative with only an additional polynomial factor. These are bounds for the explicit finite polynomial (7), suitable before the outer-color transform. ## 4. Actual-source replacement on a full fixed cusp corridor Use the faithful original Hermite norm ||f||_H=max_double(|f(c)|+N^(-2)|f'(c)|), also including the odd simple value. It is submultiplicative; ||R||_H,||R^(-1)||_H<=9/8, and |phi(f)|<=3N^3||f||_H. For some fixed delta_0,gamma>0, uniformly for the ACTUAL integers 0<=h<=delta_0 N, ||z_(N,h)-Z_N^win(.,pi h/N)||_H <=poly(N)exp[N(j_0-gamma)]. (13) The proof includes two different retained source errors. First, the removed r-indices have the original all-index envelope J_1(u)+E(u)+C chi^2. Its unique maximum at chi=0 is pi/4, so the complement of I_N has a fixed gap. To obtain a uniform segment bound without a root singularity, enclose[-2,2] by a fixed small Bernstein ellipse: its uniform log-integral profile approaches the unit-radius profile, hence preserves that gap. The factorial and mixed-Ward bounds are polynomial times this exponential. A degree<=M complex Markov bound preserves it for the first normals. Second, the entire original upper band obeys ||RP_(N,h)||_H<=56^h. Shrink delta_0 until delta_0 log56<j_0-gamma. The finite errors in (13) are not zero; they are bounded before any exterior closure. This is why the actual even packet can replace the non-even full mixed source only with its explicit residual. For any fixed number n of stack pieces and fixed crossing power m, telescoping products in this faithful norm proves the same type of exponential replacement bound for the entire original stack, after an additional fixed shrink of delta_0. It is uniform for every physical outer color because max_(1<=j<=N)||L_j||_H=poly(N), ||R^m||_H<= (9/8)^|m|. (14) Indeed |U_(j-1)(c/2)|<=j on[-2,2] and Markov costs at most N^2/2 per derivative. No positive quotient of the radical or source-operator commutation beyond the actual full pair algebra is used. ## 5. A width-free gap for the ENTIRE physical inner-color complement For every fixed delta>0 with a nonempty physical complement there is gamma_delta>0 such that limsup_N N^(-1)log max_(0<=h<N)||z_(N,h)||_H<=j_0, limsup_N N^(-1)log max_(delta N<=h<N)||z_(N,h)||_H <=j_0-gamma_delta. (15) Here h=N-j labels EVERY actual auxiliary color, not just the low half. For j<=N/2, the entire box is a pure alias, bounded by the proved uniform rate B_alias=(1/2)log(4+sqrt15)<j_0. For j>N/2, keep both the low core and that alias. The uniform core upper rate j_0 follows from the global mixed-source spectral envelope. Its STRICT complement gap can be made uniform as the enclosing ellipse shrinks to the unit circle. Specifically choose ONCE 1/4<beta<1/2 and a closed contracting interval I subset(pi beta,pi/2). Every actual source propagating from the original terminal wall to r<=beta N crosses I. The exact spectral ellipse gives a uniform strict factor there for ALL delta N<=h<=M, including the repeated-root endpoint color. Frozen finite blocks turn it into a fixed exponential contraction, without choosing a root or assuming an eigenbasis. This factor is independent of the spectral radius R of the outer Newton estimate. For r>beta N, the complete profile J_R+E has a fixed gap from j_0 uniformly for R sufficiently close to1, since its maximizer converges to pi/4. Choose that R so small that j(log R)-j_0 is less than one quarter of the fixed contraction/gap budget. The maximum principle on the segment and complex Markov give the stated Hermite gap. Thus a vanishing gap in the limit R->1 has NOT been assumed away. The old uniform subexponential frozen- block cost is absorbed by half the fixed gap. This proves (15), including every color endpoint and its first normal. It follows immediately that for every fixed stack width n>=1, any fixed signed R power, and ANY physical outer color, the full original mixed scalar has a fixed exponential gap below n j_0 whenever at least one INNER deficit is at least delta N. The source cost in (14) is polynomial and one factor in (15) loses a fixed rate; the other fixed n-1 factors cost at most j_0+o(1). No minimum-width restriction is required: unlike the pretzel marked-period problem, the stack reference height is n j_0 with no outer Legendre loss. The separate complement in the OUTER auxiliary color remains the task of its exact Fourier-Hermite source transform. ## 6. The complete local input for the original outer-color source Fix n>=1 and m in Z. For physical inner deficits in the corridor, let F_phys(theta)=R(-2cos theta)^m product_i z_(N,h_i)^(typed i)(-2cos theta), where each type is z or its literal sharp. Its definition here means the original full-Hermite polynomial. On a fixed small central complex theta window take the EXACT finite analytic function F_win(theta,chi)=kappa^(m/2) exp[iNm theta^2/(4pi)] product_i Z_N^(win,typed i)(-2cos theta,chi_i), (16) with kappa^(m/2)=exp[i pi m d^2/(4N)], without a principal-root reset. This is separately even in theta and every chi_i. The replacement of R by its displayed Gaussian retains BOTH the value and first normal at every physical node in this window. Indeed, for theta_j=(2j-d)pi/N, the exact nodal phase is R(c_j)=kappa^(1/2)exp[iNtheta_j^2/(4pi)]. At every double node, the full original source derivative is R'(c_j)/R(c_j)=-(d-2j)/[2(q^(2j+1)-q^(-2j-1))], partial_theta log R(c_j)=iNtheta_j/(2pi). (17) The second identity follows using q^(2j+1)-q^(-2j-1)=-2i sin theta_j and dc/dtheta=2sin theta. At the odd simple node only its value is prescribed, as required. Thus (16) is not an arbitrary spectral extension of the physical crossing; it matches exactly the jets used in the original closure. Equations (12a),(13) and submultiplicativity now give, after a fixed shrink of the inner corridor, a gamma>0 with the following actual source estimates, uniformly on its physical grid: * On the central nodes, F_phys-F_win and their first theta derivatives are bounded by poly(N)exp[N(nj_0-gamma)]. * Outside any fixed smaller central theta window, F_phys and its first theta derivative obey the same exponential-gap bound. For the second assertion use the uniform angular gap of the finite packet on the compact r-window, the H-residual(13), and the fact that the original R^m has unit nodal values and at most a polynomial first-normal cost. Derivatives of the fixed n-factor product cost only another polynomial. Thus the ORIGINAL physical spectral complement, not just the interpolant, is estimated. On smaller fixed complex theta/color disks, the exact function (16) has a nonzero analytic asymptotic with phase n j_0 -[n-im]theta^2/(4pi) +sum_i[-1+i sigma_i]chi_i^2/(2pi)+O_4, sigma_i=+1 for z, -1 for z^sharp. (18) The unit kappa and complete source phases remain in its specified external factor. In particular, for theta=s+it and chi=x+iy, |F_win(s+it,x+iy)| <=poly(N)exp N[nj_0-a(s^2+||x||^2) +C(t^2+||y||^2)] (19) for some a,C>0 depending on n,m. The real quadratic coefficients at t=y=0 are n/(4pi) and1/(2pi); imaginary cross terms are absorbed by completing squares. Shrinking the fixed disks absorbs the quartic remainder. All fixed derivatives have polynomial additional cost on still smaller disks. These give the exact local holomorphic input, original-grid residual and spectral complement required BEFORE the outer-color Fourier-Hermite transform; no contour endpoint or alias is set to zero here. Audit: [actual mixed-circle operators, canonical complex quarter source and original crossing normals](../experiments/audit_actual_belt_stack_auxiliary_color_inner_packet.py). Fresh replay PASS: seven full physical mixed-circle finite-field families and seven entire low-color alias families; two canonical complex-Fhat source families across the quarter point; nine high-precision literal crossing/first-normal families; and six all-parity selected complex-source calibrations at N=32,33,64,65,128,129. The last checks compare the ACTUAL terminating finite U sum with its endpoint-normalized C exp(NS), not just a formal root. These finite calibrations supplement the analytic proof of its uniform domains, exponential interpolation residuals and source gaps. Independent analytical review by the global critical-path auditor passed the parameterized source/barrier argument, uniform R->1 strict inner-color gap, and the full-node local/spectral-complement interface in section6. The physical outer-color transform and geometric holonomy remain separate as stated.

title: A regular actual mixed-circle port chart at the belt boundary
text: # A regular actual mixed-circle port chart at the belt boundary 29 October 2026. The old diagonal pair chart for the actual mixed circle is singular at w=-1, precisely where the new belt packet is concentrated. This note resolves that local chart with bounded meridian matrices and preserves the FULL threaded-circle equations. It does not select a bare-crossing state/observable convention, nor identify the complete global stack representation from vertex flags. The later [typed global composition](actual_belt_stack_typed_character_composition.md) now completes the outer closed-leg/peripheral checks kept separate in this local note, and the [full filling assembly](actual_long_filled_octahedral_belt_stack_volume.md) records the resulting any-subset volume equality. The local calculations below remain the independent input to that global proof. The local all-port convention is the one in [the original literal port lift](actual_pretzel_port_lift_and_geometric_anchor.md): incoming rotated pair (g(z),h(z)), outgoing (g(Uz),h(Uz)), with h(z)g(z)=diag(w,w^(-1)), U=(wY-1)/(w-Y). (1) Here Y is the SOURCE-selected inner critical parameter. In the new [physical-color packet](actual_belt_stack_auxiliary_color_inner_packet.md) it is holomorphic near w=-1,Y=i,H=1. It is not the physical meridian. ## 1. A bounded irreducible pair Put c=w+w^(-1) and use a=-[[1,1],[0,1]], b=-[[1,0],[c-2,1]], A=ba=[[1,1],[c-2,c-1]]. (2) Both main meridians have trace -2 and determinant one. Their product has trace c. At c=-2 it is a NONCENTRAL trace-minus-two parabolic. The fixed flags of a,b are infinity and zero, so the pair stays irreducible for c near -2. This avoids diagonalizing the parabolic product and then calling a diverging diagonal frame bounded. For w!=+1,-1 this pair is simultaneously conjugate to the original g,h pair: their product eigenvalues and the two parabolic traces agree, and their distinct flags determine the conjugacy on the irreducible chart. The following formulas also give an explicit regular continuation of its rotated action. Choose sqrt(U) through 1 near w=-1,Y=i, and set beta=w(Y-1)/[(w-1)(w-Y)sqrt(U)], alpha=[sqrt(U)+1/sqrt(U)-beta*c]/2, K=alpha I+beta A. (3) All displayed denominators are nonzero in a fixed neighborhood. For w!=+1,-1 this equals beta=[sqrt(U)-1/sqrt(U)]/[w-w^(-1)]. (4) Indeed U-1=(w+1)(Y-1)/(w-Y). Thus K has determinant one and eigenvalues sqrt(U),1/sqrt(U) on the A-eigenflags w,w^(-1). It is exactly the conjugate of diag(sqrt(U),1/sqrt(U)), which sends g(z) to g(Uz) in the old chart. Consequently the ACTUAL rotated mixed-circle map is (a,b) -> (K a K^(-1), K b K^(-1)). (5) This is a local all-port statement, not an inference solely from a trace identity. Under w->w^(-1) one has U->U^(-1), and (4) and alpha are unchanged. The regular K therefore descends holomorphically to c near -2 when the selected Y is even in eta for w=-exp(eta). This is exactly the evenness supplied by the physical-color packet. ## 2. Original unrotated ports and the auxiliary meridian The literal bends, including their inverses, give the unrotated ports (a_orig,b_orig)=(K b K^(-1), b^(-1)), (r_orig,s_orig)=(K a^(-1)K^(-1), a). (6) Their common disk product is P=b_orig a_orig =b^(-1)K b K^(-1) =a K a^(-1)K^(-1). (7) The last equality uses [K,A]=0, with A=ba. Direct multiplication gives the REGULAR trace formula D=Tr P =2+(w-1)^2(Y-1)^2/[(w-Y)(wY-1)]. (8) For w!=-1 this is exactly the old formula ((w-1)/(w+1))^2(U+U^(-1))+8w/(w+1)^2; its apparent pole is removable on the SOURCE relation(1). Put Delta=1-YD+Y^2, choose sqrt(Delta) through 1+i, and define J=(I-YP)/sqrt(Delta), C=(YI-P)/sqrt(Delta). (9) They commute with P, have determinant one, and JC=-P. The original threaded half-twist equations remain EXACTLY r_orig=C^(-1)b_orig C, s_orig=C^(-1)b_orig a_orig b_orig^(-1) C. (10) One can verify them without roots by using I-YP and YI-P; their common scalar cancels from conjugation. Equivalently Ja_orig=aJ, together with(7) and JC=-P, proves(10). They are rational identities on the old nonsingular chart and both sides are regular here, so their continuation includes w=-1. No group relation is replaced by only its trace. On the full stationary mixed source, the previously proved identities give D=-(L+L^(-1)), L=(H-X)/(1-HX), and the marked auxiliary meridian C has eigenvalue H^(-1/2) on the P-eigenflag with eigenvalue -L^(-1). This is the same ACTUAL circle and preferred disk-word marking as [the typed longitude theorem](actual_mixed_crossing_circle_preferred_longitude.md). The eigenflag may move through the parabolic limit; the matrices in (2)--(10) remain bounded. Nothing here asserts a moving-q continuation. ## 3. Exact complete matrices and the six octahedral flags At w=-1,Y=i,H=1, A=[[1,1],[-4,-3]], K=I-(i/2)(A+I), P=[[-1+2i,-1],[-4,-1-2i]], C=I-(P+I)/(1+i). (11) The outer flag of A is -1/2; the inner flag of P and C is -i/2. The four actual rotated port flags are a:infinity, b:0, KaK^(-1):-(1+i)/2, KbK^(-1):-(1+i)/4. The HOLomorphic Möbius map M(zeta)=(zeta+1/2)/(zeta+i/2) (12) sends, in that order, the outer/inner flags to 0/infinity and the four port flags to 1,-i,i,-1. These are the six ideal vertices of a regular octahedron. In this exact frame one obtains M A M^(-1)=[[-1,0],[2-2i,-1]], M P M^(-1)=[[-1,-2+2i],[0,-1]], M C M^(-1)=[[1,-2i],[0,1]], M J M^(-1)=[[1,2],[0,1]]. (13) In particular the actual inner meridian translates by -2i, while the preferred disk product translates by 2-2i (its central sign has no projective effect). Their ratio is 1+i. This is a literal matrix/peripheral calculation, not a ratio guessed from a Hessian. The source prediction agrees: at eta=chi=0 its physical color action has j_chi_chi=(-1+i)/pi; with U_geom=-2i chi and the marked longitude log V_geom=-2 partial_(Log H)(2pi i j), the same ratio is 1+i. ## 4. The separate global geometric lift The old local source-to-character construction now extends regularly through the ACTUAL belt saddle and retains every port and auxiliary meridian. Its six complete ideal flags and the inner peripheral word are also explicit. These remove a genuine singular-chart problem. They do NOT alone identify the full global stack holonomy with its two-octahedron face quotient. The global argument additionally transports the actual bare R interfaces and bends in their literal orientation, composes the typed maps, imposes the outer auxiliary closure, and matches its primitive meridian/longitude. A bare R eigenphase can give the inverse of a state-versus-observable Hurwitz graph; it cannot select that convention by analogy. Matching six ideal flags is also weaker than checking all the face maps. The [separate typed composition proof](actual_belt_stack_typed_character_composition.md) now supplies that finite marked map, including the original nested head snakes, incident mixed coupons and untouched auxiliary pivot. That proof, the [uniform filling-existence theorem](finite_geometric_certificate_uniform_filling_existence.md) and general completion/calibration theorem identify the selected long-filling action with the actual filled hyperbolic volume. Neither the local regularization nor the quantum color packet substitutes for that independent marked-map proof. Section6 below checks the complete CUT-PIECE face anchor as well. The global outer collar and closed-leg peripheral dictionary are proved in the linked typed-composition note. ## 5. The opposite retained half twist, with its actual circle meridian There is an additional exact all-port statement using the SAME K and P. The positive unrotated half-Hurwitz rule with an auxiliary centralizer Q is r_orig=Q^(-1) a_orig^(-1)b_orig a_orig Q, s_orig=Q^(-1) a_orig Q. It is solved by Q=J^(-1). Indeed Ja_orig=aJ gives the second equation; the first then reduces to a^(-1)P=K a^(-1)K^(-1), which follows from(7). Thus the opposite retained half twist has circle meridian J^(-1), rather than silently using C unchanged. At completeness this meridian translates by -2 in the frame(12), whereas C translates by -2i. The SAME preferred disk product P translates by 2-2i. Its two primitive cusp ratios are consequently (2-2i)/(-2i)=1+i, (2-2i)/(-2)=-1+i. (14) These are the actual two half-twist meridians. On the full mixed branch the positive-circle color condition is imposed on J^(-1), not on C. Matching that flag condition to the typed reflected source is still required; one must not reuse the negative-half mixed parameter H without this check. This addition proves both complete typed matrices, not an unproved global sharp/reflection adapter. ## 6. Every complete white and inner shaded face map Use the normalized frame(12), now with the PRECISE labels X0=0, X1=infinity, Y+=1, Y-=-1, Z+=-i, Z-=i. The white faces of the existing literal two-octahedron cut table are W0=(0,1,i), W1=(0,-1,-i), W2=(infinity,1,-i), W3=(infinity,-1,i). Their reflections are the following antiholomorphic maps, with c0=(1+i)/2: r0(z)=c0+(1/2)/(conjugate(z)-conjugate(c0)), r1(z)=-c0+(1/2)/(conjugate(z)+conjugate(c0)), r2(z)=i conjugate(z)+1-i, r3(z)=i conjugate(z)-1+i. (15) Direct Gaussian-rational matrix multiplication gives the FULL PSL isometries (hats denote conjugation by M): a_hat=r2 r0, b_hat=r1 r2, a'_hat=r3 r0, b'_hat=r1 r3, A_hat=r1 r0.
