(16) Thus all white-face holonomies are matched, not only the fixed flags of the meridians. Develop the second octahedron as r0(P_+), using W0 as the face-tree pairing. The inner shaded faces are C_face=(infinity,1,i), D_face=(infinity,-1,-i). The literal threaded-port equations give the two shaded pairing maps gamma_+=J a', gamma_-=b'J^(-1)=J^(-1)a. In the M frame they are EXACTLY gamma_+=[[3i,1-i],[1+i,-i]], gamma_-=[[i,1-i],[-1-i,i]]. (17) They have the following complete three-vertex actions: gamma_+ r0(infinity,-1,-i)=(infinity,1,i), gamma_- r0(infinity,1,i)=(infinity,-1,-i). (18) These are r0(D_face)->C_face and r0(C_face)->D_face, precisely the TWO cross-copy shaded gluings of the actual retained half twist. They check the third vertex as well as the circle flag and one port. A holomorphic Mobius map is uniquely determined by three distinct ideal points; therefore these are the entire face isometries in the existing positive regular-octahedron certificate. Its matched canonical horospheres and edge/cusp completion are consequently the same ones. Equations(16)--(18), together with the reversible original disk cut, identify the COMPLETE local source representation with the actual geometric cut-piece holonomy. The reflected half twist uses the same unmarked cut quotient with its actual changed inner meridian J^(-1)=-C P^(-1); the preferred disk word P is retained. Bare outer R collars must still be read with their literal bends and primitive peripheral words. No global deformed-stack claim is deduced solely from this complete-point calculation. The [focused symbolic audit](../experiments/audit_actual_belt_stack_regular_parabolic_port_chart.py) checks EXACT rational-function/Gaussian-rational identities: the regular centralizer and reciprocal descent, both signed threaded port equations, complete matrices and flags, all five white identities, and BOTH three-vertex shaded maps. It does not replace the separate global outer collar/peripheral proof. ## 7. The oriented outer-pants boundary word There is a concrete boundary-path check that is useful for that last peripheral proof. The incoming pants has shaded triangle (X0,Y+,Z+)=(0,1,-i). The holomorphic map T(zeta)=((1+i)/2)(zeta-1)/zeta sends its three punctures to infinity, zero, one. Conjugating the EXACT white-face meridians in(16) gives a_T=[[-1,0],[-2,-1]], b_T=[[-3,2],[-2,1]], A_T=[[-1,-2],[0,-1]]. (19) Use the upper-half-plane orientation for its doubled ideal triangle. At punctures zero and one, the upper-half-plane cusp coordinates -1/zeta and -1/(zeta-1) make a_T and b_T each translation by -2. At infinity, A_T^(-1) is translation by -2 as well. They are therefore the consistently oriented boundary loops of a compact truncation of the pants: its oriented top horocycle goes to the left. Their based boundary relation is EXACTLY (A^(-1)) b a=I. (20) Thus the oriented OUTER boundary word of these actual puncture paths is A^(-1), not A. Reversing the pants orientation reverses all three paths together. This is an oriented face/path certificate, independent of any computed source Hessian. To call(20) the preferred POSITIVE auxiliary longitude, the actual closed auxiliary orientation and its original ordinary cup/pivot are transported to this pants boundary in the linked typed-composition proof. That operation also determines which A-eigenflag has the positive auxiliary meridian eigenvalue. Neither choice is inferred just from(19). The geometric boundary calculation supplies its explicit path, while preserving that distinction. Independent analytical review checked the regular signed local ports, all complete matrices and flags, and the oriented pants boundary word; the root independently checked the all-face anchor. The focused exact audit passes 52 checks. The global filled-volume assembly has its separate internal proof reviews; this local note does not replace them or describe an external peer-review process.

title: Typed belt-stack character composition and marked peripherals
text: # Typed belt-stack character composition and marked peripherals 29 October 2026. The actual mixed inner packet has a regular character lift through the complete pair-Casimir value -2. This note proves the signed crossing/box composition, including the sharp box's meridian flag, and the exact ordinary-cup outer dictionary. It constructs the marked deformed representation of the actual signed belt stack. Every incident mixed crossing is transported through the SAME original Hopf-duality adapters. The outer dictionary is NOT inferred from a Hessian or from relabeling indices while leaving coupons fixed. ## 1. Regular pair frame at the actual complete source Use the [regular local port chart](actual_belt_stack_regular_parabolic_port_chart.md). Set c=w+w^(-1), w=-exp eta, and a=-[[1,1],[0,1]], b=-[[1,0],[c-2,1]], A=ba=[[1,1],[c-2,c-1]]. (1) These main meridians have trace -2. The central signs do not affect their PSL classes; both signs in their product cancel. They form an irreducible pair near c=-2, including that point. For the source-selected local z=mathscrR(R^(-1)L_(N-h)) branch, let X,Y,H,L,U be the literal stationary functions of [the mixed local source lift](actual_pretzel_mixed_regular_character_lift.md), continued through the quarter point using the newly proved actual auxiliary-color packet. They satisfy U=(wY-1)/(w-Y), L=(H-X)/(1-HX), (1+YL)/(1+Y/L)=L^2/H. (2) The regular centralizer K_z of A constructed in the linked chart has determinant1, eigenratio U on the ordered A-eigenvalues (w,w^(-1)), and gives the rotated map (a,b) -> (K_z a K_z^(-1),K_z b K_z^(-1)). (3) Put P=aK_z a^(-1)K_z^(-1)=b^(-1)K_z bK_z^(-1). Then Tr P=-L-L^(-1). With Delta=(1+YL)(1+Y/L), J=(I-YP)/sqrt(Delta), C=(YI-P)/sqrt(Delta), JC=-P. (4) The branch of sqrt is its regular complete branch. The ACTUAL unrotated ports are incoming (K_z bK_z^(-1),b^(-1)) and outgoing (K_z a^(-1)K_z^(-1),a). Formula(4) gives exactly the threaded negative half-twist group relations. On the P-eigenflag with eigenvalue lambda=-L^(-1), C has the source-prescribed positive auxiliary meridian eigenvalue M=H^(-1/2). This is the local literal port/flag theorem, not a trace-only assertion. ## 2. The bare crossing in THIS bent frame It is essential not to apply the ordinary downward positive-Hurwitz rule to the bent (a,b) coordinates without transporting the ports. The FULL physical turn identity is mathscrR(R^(-1))=R, including kappa and every Casimir normal, by [the exact four-port turn calculation](actual_pair_casimir_commutant_and_rotated_trace.md#3-literal-turn-rotation-agrees-with-the-charge-block-formula). Here is its group-side port calculation. For a general turned box with input(a,b), output(a',b'), unrotation gives incoming (b',b^(-1)) and outgoing((a')^(-1),a). The unrotated bare R^(-1) uses the negative Hurwitz rule (u,v)->(v,vuv^(-1)). It follows immediately that a'=b, b'=bab^(-1). (5) Thus the actual source R in the bent frame is negative Hurwitz. No branch is selected by an eigenphase comparison. Define J_R=[A-(c-1)I]/sqrt(2-c), K_R=J_R^(-1). (6) Direct multiplication gives det J_R=1, J_R b=a J_R and J_R^2=-A^(-1). Consequently (5) is simultaneous conjugation by K_R. Its eigenratio on the ordered A-eigenvalues is -w; that of R^(-1) is -w^(-1). Both matrices are regular at c=-2. This agrees with the source's actual nodal Gaussian, but the group rule was proved FIRST from the literal turn. ## 3. The sharp box has its own actual positive-half meridian Write f^#(eta,chi)=conjugate(f(conjugate(eta),conjugate(chi))) for holomorphic Schwarz reflection. The source action of the literal sharp box obeys G_+=-G_-^#. Since the color logarithm z=Log H=2i chi has z^#=-z, while eta^#=eta, the chain rule gives partial_eta G_+=-(partial_eta G_-)^#, partial_z G_+=(partial_z G_-)^#. The effective stationary variables are therefore U_+=1/U_-^#, Y_+=1/Y_-^#, L_+=L_-^#, K_+=(K_z^#)^(-1). (7) The reciprocal of Y is essential: its stationary index is the Schwarz-reflected u, and Y=exp(2iu). At completeness both effective Y values are i. Merely conjugating K or declaring a different peripheral color would give the wrong source action. Form P_+=aK_+a^(-1)K_+^(-1), Delta_+ and J_+=(I-Y_+P_+)/sqrt(Delta_+) exactly as above. Trace invariance under K inversion, together with the old trace relation, gives Tr P_+=-L_+-L_+^(-1). For the literal POSITIVE unrotated half twist the actual meridian is C_+=J_+^(-1). (8) Indeed J_+ a_orig=a J_+ gives C_+^(-1)a_orig C_+=a, which is the second output of the positive-Hurwitz threaded box; the common product relation gives its first output. This checks the full port equations, not only their traces. On the P_+-eigenflag lambda_+=-L_+^(-1), eigen(C_+)^2=(1+Y_+L_+)/(1+Y_+/L_+)=H^(-1). (9) To verify the last equality, Schwarz-reflect(2): (1+Y_-^#L_+)/(1+Y_-^#/L_+)=L_+^2 H, then substitute Y_+=1/Y_-^#. Its regular square-root branch is precisely H^(-1/2). Thus the sharp box retains the SAME physical meridian color and has preferred lambda_+=-L_+^(-1), with all original ordinary-pivot spin signs. At completeness C_+ is J^(-1), while C_- is C; they are not assumed to be plain conjugate matrices. ## 4. Composition of every signed source piece The original stack pieces have full sources f_-=Rz and f_+=z^sharp R^(-1). Their literal mirror/reversed identification was proved in the stack cut certificate. The port maps above give simultaneous conjugation by K_(piece,-)=K_R K_z, K_(piece,+)=K_(box,+) K_R^(-1), (10) where K_(box,+) is the sharp BOX centralizer K_+ in(7). All matrices are specified functions of the SAME A, so they commute as actual centralizers; no arbitrary strand gauge is inserted between pieces. Their source-selected gains are gain(f_-)=(-w)U_-, gain(f_+)=U_+(-w)^(-1). After p plus,q minus pieces and an actual outer R^a, put n=p+q,m=q-p+a. The complete port map is conjugation by K_tot=K_R^m product_(plus)K_+ product_(minus)K_z, gain(K_tot)=(-w)^m product_i U_i. (11) These are full regular matrix identities through w=-1. To see their noncentral complete limit, let N_0=A+I, N_0^2=0. The actual selected local values are K_z=K_+=I-iN_0/2, K_R=I-N_0/2. Hence K_tot=I-(m+in)N_0/2. (12) In particular this complete outer meridian candidate never collapses to I when n>0. The matrix data retain the local regular octahedron flags, not only a cusp Hessian. ## 5. The literal outer-cut dictionary, with all coupons transported The actual outer dictionary is (a,b)=(beta_phys^(-1),alpha_phys^(-1)), C_0=K_tot, preferred P_0=beta_phys alpha_phys=A^(-1). (13) Here is its source/collar check. Keep the unrestricted ORIGINAL marked closure, pivot and single1/N on their original side. The physical cup and ordinary cap matrices are p_(a,b)=N x^(-b) delta_(a+b,d), ell_(a,b)=x^a/N delta_(a+b,d). Their literal snakes satisfy sum_b p_(a,b)ell_(b,c)=delta_(a,c), sum_b ell_(a,b)p_(b,c)=delta_(a,c). (13a) The one nonzero term has matching complement indices and all N/x factors cancel EXACTLY. Insert TWO noncrossing nested head snakes in the thin main-wire collar between the stack and outer loop; their arcs are disjoint from the auxiliary cut and closing pivot. For W=V tensor V the contravariant dual is ordered (second*,first*): the nested evaluation pairs first with fourth and second with third. Each actual cup takes its meridian path to the inverse. The explicit table on the outer side is therefore standard main port1 alpha_phys <-> bent port2 b^(-1), standard main port2 beta_phys <-> bent port1 a^(-1), auxiliary C_0 and its original closing pivot stay UNCHANGED. Every mixed crossing incident to these ports is transported through the SAME snakes by ORIGINAL Hopf duality. A dual matrix port is partially transposed and conjugated by p and ell: its coupon is NOT held fixed while its indices are renamed. Equivalently (S tensor id)(R_universal)=R_universal^(-1) and (id tensor S^(-1))(R_universal)=R_universal^(-1) move that strand through its evaluation. This includes the full q^(H tensor H/2), with S(H)=-H, and both finite nilpotent factors. Their literal endpoint zeros give no cyclic wrap term. The ordinary auxiliary object is not dualized or cut again. This is an all-port identity for an arbitrary exterior; the original co-source remains outside the move. For clarity, let U be the FULL unflipped universal-R matrix between the complete physical head and any ordinary color j. If the N-head is FIRST, the actual left/right bend identities are U=(p^T tensor I)(U^(-1))^(t_1)(ell^T tensor I), U^(-1)=(p tensor I)U^(t_1)(ell tensor I). If it is SECOND they are U=(I tensor p)(U^(-1))^(t_2)(I tensor ell), U^(-1)=(I tensor p^T)U^(t_2)(I tensor ell^T). The superscript t_i means the partial transpose on that physical head. Both original half-Cartan factors and finite nilpotent factors are in U. The indicated transpose of p is fixed by which actual side of the cup is bent; exchanging p with p^T arbitrarily is false. These identities transport both crossing signs in either tensor position. They are not a same-coupon index permutation. For an explicit tensor-index version, let P_ord denote reversal of ABSTRACT dual tensor ordering, not a physical braid. Then J_W=(p tensor p)P_ord, E_W=P_ord(ell tensor ell), J_W E_W=E_W J_W=I_(V tensor V). (13b) Indeed its full index sum is sum_(s,t)p_(a,t)p_(b,s)ell_(t,c)ell_(s,d)=delta_(a,c)delta_(b,d). No R, curl or framing shear implements P_ord. Transporting the coupons through these literal nested adapters is precisely the bent port convention used in sections1--3, including(5). The consequence is elementary and exact: conjugating the standard [2,1,1,2] loop map by this dictionary gives main map Ad(C_0^(-1)) and closing relation [C_0,A]=1. Its preferred disk word is A^(-1), with no additional C_0 power: substitute A_orig=b^(-1), B_orig=a^(-1) in the original disk word B_orig A_orig. Main inversion/reversal commutes with common conjugation, so the same Ad(C_0^(-1)) is obtained when returning to (a,b). No argument from equality of L_j polynomials is used to choose this orientation. Outer closure gives Ad(C_0^(-1)K_tot)(a,b)=(a,b). Since a,b remain irreducible, their common centralizer is scalar in SL and trivial in PSL. Hence C_0=K_tot in PSL, with its SL sign fixed by the trace+2 complete branch. Reversing BOTH peripheral generators and swapping their common eigenflag is a harmless alternative with the same positive (M,lambda) data; inverting only one is not. ## 6. Actual global peripheral and source differential Let z_i=Log H_i, eta=Log(-w), and let G_i be the source-normalized typed local actions. The actual outer Fourier phase has G_total(eta,z)=sum_i G_i(eta,z_i)+m eta^2/2+z_0 eta +known real constants. (14) The real constants retain the kappa/source-spin line and do not change the marked volume. Its eta stationarity is gain(K_tot)=exp(-z_0)=H_0^(-1). By(13), C_0=K_tot has the positive M_0=H_0^(-1/2) flag on the A-eigenvalue w branch; preferred P_0=A^(-1) has eigenvalue w^(-1)=-exp(-eta). Therefore ALL actual cusp coordinates satisfy u_i=-z_i/2, lambda_i=-exp(-partial_(z_i)G), v_i=pi i-partial_(z_i)G, d[G-pi i sum_i z_i]=2 sum_i v_i du_i. (15) For inner cusps this was proved locally above; for the outer cusp it uses the actual preferred word in(13). Hence the source action has the marked boundary differential, including the spin term. Its complete imaginary anchor is2n v8. The next section verifies the complete actual geometric anchor needed to calibrate its absolute regulator. As a consistency check, (12),(13) give the actual outer cusp ratio 2i/[n-im] and the two inner ratios sigma+i. These are TWICE the analytic curvature parameter phi''/(2pi i) when x=h/N; the geometric logs are u=-pi i x and v=-phi_x. The factor is fixed by(15), not by relabeling a source Hessian as a cusp modulus. ## 7. The full complete geometric anchor and every surviving main cusp The [regular cut-piece certificate](actual_belt_stack_regular_parabolic_port_chart.md#6-every-complete-white-and-inner-shaded-face-map) verifies EVERY white and both inner shaded face maps, not just six vertex flags. In its bounded frame the vertices are (0,infinity,1,-1,-i,i). Exact white reflection products give a,b,a',b',A, and the actual two J a',b'J^(-1) shaded maps send ALL three vertices of each original inner face correctly. They are therefore the complete face isometries of the actual cut two-octahedron quotient. The opposite half uses the same unmarked cut geometry with its actual meridian J^(-1), not a silent circle framing change. The [literal stack collar certificate](actual_balanced_octahedral_belt_stack_volume.md#3a-any-fixed-integer-outer-crossing-power) glues those pieces with their actual signs and the actual outer R^a. Section2 has calibrated that crossing in precisely the same transported bent frame. The local main-port matrices thus agree across every seam with the regular-cell developing holonomy. At the final outer loop, the original relation in section5 uniquely forces its meridian to be K_tot in PSL for BOTH the source lift and geometric developing map. Its trace+2 branch fixes the SL choice. Thus this last generator is matched too, not merely its trace or cusp derivative. The independent oriented pants-path calculation in the local note section7 gives(A^(-1))ba=I and checks the preferred outer boundary orientation directly. The ENTIRE complete representation is consequently the positively oriented geometric holonomy of the ACTUAL stack exterior, of volume 2n v8. This holds for every fixed sign word and integer a. The possible simultaneous reversal of a peripheral pair changes neither the primitive slope nor its selected eigenvalues. All generator matrices and selected flags vary continuously in bounded charts for the small complex source colors. The apparent w=-1 diagonal- frame singularity is absent in the regular matrices(1)--(4). Every surviving MAIN component has a noncentral parabolic meridian, being a conjugate of a or b. A peripheral longitude commuting with that meridian has squared multiplier1, so its small geometric similarity log is ZERO near the complete point. Hence BOTH logs at every UNFILLED main cusp stay zero. This includes odd a, where the two main components merge. No additional main cusp Hessian or independently imposed main longitude is needed for completion or for the regulator boundary term. ## 8. Absolute regulator and every independently long integral filling After eliminating eta by its actual source stationarity, write G_(z_i)=ell_i for ALL n+1 auxiliary cusps, including ell_0=eta. The marked norm from(15) is D_src=Im G-sum_i Re z_i Im ell_i. (16) Indeed retain Gbar=G-pi i sum_i z_i BEFORE forming the boundary norm: D_src=Im Gbar-2 sum_i Re u_i Im v_i. The central terms cancel only in this paired expression. They are not discarded from the action or physical ordinary-circle character. For the actual developed fundamental chain of this SAME marked exterior, the Bloch boundary is delta beta=-2 sum_i M_i wedge lambda_i. Its Bloch--Wigner differential is therefore dD(beta)=2 sum_i[Re v_i dIm u_i-Re u_i dIm v_i] =dD_src. The main cusp terms vanish by section7. Both functions have the same absolute complete anchor2n v8, so they agree on this connected source germ. This is the established [marked fundamental-chain comparison](actual_pretzel_marked_regulator_and_filling_action.md#3-the-geometric-regulator-has-the-same-derivative-and-absolute-anchor) applied to the explicit global lift. Neither a cusp-Hessian match nor an unproved equality of dilogarithm lists replaces it. The [actual outer squared-kernel theorem](actual_outer_color_squared_kernel.md) and the inner packet/gap theorem supply the WHOLE original mixed-color packet and its ENTIRE complementary physical-color cube estimate for these stacks. The [general original-source filling transfer](general_original_source_long_filling_transfer.md) then gives a NONZERO full asymptotic for independently sufficiently long FIXED signed integral fillings at ANY chosen subset I of the n+1 auxiliary circles. Keep every other auxiliary color literally h_j=0, hence its original L_N component; do NOT set p_j=0, which would meridionally fill and remove that circle. The exact packet, nonzero amplitude, negative real Hessian and entire physical-color complement gap restrict to the I coordinates. Apply only the original color-filling functionals indexed by I. The equations are z_i+2p_i ell_i=2pi i m_i, m_i=+1 or -1, i in I, z_j=0, j not in I. (17) Separate exact source evenness gives ell_j=0 at every unfilled auxiliary coordinate, even while filled coordinates vary. Its peripheral group remains noncentral parabolic near the complete point, with BOTH small logs zero. These unfilled auxiliary cusps join the main cusps in section7. No new estimate or geometric existence premise is required. The ACTUAL small geometric similarity logs are U_i=-z_i,V_i=-2ell_i. Thus (17) is precisely U_i+p_i V_i=-2pi i m_i. It is the primitive2pi branch, not merely an exponentiated PSL relation. The preferred SL longitude minus sign has already been retained in(15)--(16). These equations kill the literal disk slopes mu_i+p_i lambda_i. The original complete-color twist expansion inserts R^(-2p_i), including every confluent normal and dimension endpoint; hence the slope sign is the original disk sign. At the OUTER circle it can also be checked directly: K_R^2=-A, so R^(-2p) gives Ad(A^(-p)), exactly the loop action Ad(C_0^(-1)) when C_0 P_0^p=1 and P_0=A^(-1). For each inner circle the same sign was proved in the literal mixed-circle longitude certificate, and the actual quarter-turn transports its disk with the tangle. Every selected filled coordinate is nonzero. Separate source evenness makes ell_i divisible by z_i, even when all other colors vary, so z_i=0 would contradict(17). The small logs exclude an extra period. The matrices share their selected flags; their filling products are scalar in SL and identity in PSL. The [general marked completion theorem](general_source_regulator_hyperbolic_equality.md) therefore extends this nearby ACTUAL representation to a positive smooth complete hyperbolic metric on the indicated filled topology. It is the filled geometric holonomy. The two directions of the fundamental-class/Gromov-volume comparison identify the regulator with the actual filled hyperbolic volume, rather than only bounding it above. The source filling phase keeps the literal quadratic chirps on I. In the present eigenlog variables it is, up to the recorded real constants, G_fill=G+sum_(i in I) (z_i-2pi i m_i)^2/(4p_i). On(17) its added imaginary part is sum_i 2p_i Re ell_i Im ell_i=-sum_i Re z_i Im ell_i. Hence Im G_fill=D_src EXACTLY. This verifies the source-to-volume comparison after filling while retaining all spin and charge data. We obtain: for every fixed n>=1, every sign word of length n, every fixed integer outer crossing power a, and ANY subset I of its n+1 auxiliary circles, independently sufficiently long fixed signed integral fillings on I obey lim_N (2pi/N)log|K_N(filled stack)| =Vol(S^3 minus resulting partially filled link). (18) The empty subset is the already proved COMPLETE stack theorem, with no slope threshold or filling functional. For a nonempty subset its threshold may depend on I; for a fixed stack take the maximum over its finitely many subsets if desired. All N parities and composite levels are included. The original single-cut normalization is retained, with no separately modified dimension at every component. Full twists preserve the main permutation: when ALL auxiliary circles are filled, the result is a KNOT for odd a and has TWO components for even a. For a proper subset the unfilled auxiliary circles remain components: the total is n+2-|I| for odd a and n+3-|I| for even a. The threshold depends on this fixed marked source and its fixed analytic neighborhoods; no numerical threshold or slope comparability condition is asserted. This is a cyclic-belt family, not an arbitrary branched-source or arbitrary fixed-bridge volume theorem. Audit: [exact signed local matrices, literal nested source snakes and outer word algebra](../experiments/audit_actual_belt_stack_typed_character_composition.py). title: The complete beta source has an exponentially large first normal jet
text: # The complete beta source has an exponentially large first normal jet 28 October 2026. This is an obstruction to a uniform normal-neighborhood estimate AFTER integrating the original beta fiber. It is not an excess-volume contribution to a knot period, and it does not contradict a local exp(o(N)) bound in a shrinking collar where all the unintegrated full-Psi arguments approach one. ## 1. Exact source and exact first derivative Use precisely the original finite source in [the trivalent source theorem](actual_trivalent_quantum_beta_source.md#1-the-source-and-its-exact-finite-polynomial): Q=exp(2*pi*i/N), d=N-1, F_k=product_(j=1)^k(1-Q^j), B_N(u,v)=sum_(a=0)^d product_(j=0)^(a-1)(u-Q^j v). In the actual full-Psi fiber the arguments are u=Q^2 U, v=Q V, and its source normalization is Q^(-d)/N. These exact tags and that normalization are unchanged here. No residue-only beta replacement is made. Every nonempty Newton product contains u-v, so, identically in v, B_N(v,v)=1, partial_u B_N(v,v)=J_N(v):=sum_(k=0)^(N-2) F_k v^k, partial_v B_N(v,v)=-J_N(v). (1) The second equality follows by differentiating the first factor of each nonempty product; differentiating any other factor leaves u-v=0. Consequently this is a derivative of the COMPLETE original source, including the current responsible for B_N(v,v)=1. This is not the derivative of its homogeneous balanced-residue term alone. ## 2. A fixed regular point with an exponential derivative Set c_*=exp(-i*pi/3), I(s)=integral_0^s log(2 sin(pi*t)) dt, gamma=I(5/6)=-I(1/6)=v_3/(2*pi)>0. Here v_3 is the volume of the regular ideal tetrahedron; equivalently gamma=Im Li_2(exp(i*pi/3))/(2*pi)=0.161532973609725257.... For EVERY sequence of integer levels N tending to infinity, including both parities and every residue class modulo six, J_N(c_*)=i N exp[N gamma-25*pi*i*N/72] (1+o(1)). (2) More generally, uniformly for theta in a fixed bounded real interval, J_N(c_* exp(i*theta/N))/J_N(c_*) =exp(5*i*theta/6)+o(1). (3) Here and below c_* is a value of the actual tagged beta argument v. If one instead parametrizes its untagged argument V, choose V=Q^(-1)c_*. An O(1/N) root tag changes the nonzero prefactor through (3), not gamma. If a particular full-Psi chart also excludes c^N=1, use instead c_N=c_* exp(i*theta_0/N), for example theta_0=pi/7. Its N-th powers range over a fixed finite set bounded away from one, and (3) gives the same exponent with nonzero prefactor exp(5*i*theta_0/6). Thus the obstruction is not an artifact of the levels for which c_*^N=1. ### Proof For 0<=k<N there is an exact, continuously accumulated factorial phase: F_k=|F_k| exp[i*pi*k(k+1)/(2N)-i*pi*k/2]. (4) On every compact subinterval of 0<s=k/N<1, Stirling and elementary Euler--Maclaurin give the uniform estimate |F_k|=sqrt(2 N sin(pi*s)) exp[N I(s)](1+O(1/N)). (5) For clarity, subtract log(2*pi*t) from log(2 sin(pi*t)); the difference is smooth through t=0. Stirling for k! and the endpoint half-sum for that difference give exactly the prefactor sqrt(2 N sin(pi*s)). A global, endpoint-uniform version sufficient for discarding tails is log |F_k|=N I(k/N)+O(log N), 0<=k<=N-1. (6) One direct proof of (6) subtracts log t+log(1-t). The remaining function is smooth on [0,1], while the two singular sums are exactly log(k!)+log((N-1)!/(N-1-k)!)-2k log N. Uniform Stirling bounds, also at k=0 and k=N-1, give the stated error. The function I has its unique absolute maximum on [0,1] at s_*=5/6. Indeed I'=log(2 sin(pi*s)), its only interior zeros are 1/6 and 5/6, and I(0)=I(1)=0<I(5/6). Combining (4)--(5) gives the summand F_k c_*^k = sqrt(2 N sin(pi*s)) exp[N psi(s)] exp(i*pi*s/2)(1+O(1/N)), psi(s)=I(s)+i*(pi*s^2/2-5*pi*s/6). At s_* we have psi'(s_*)=0, psi(s_*)=gamma-25*pi*i/72, psi''(s_*)=-pi*(sqrt(3)-i). Equation (6) makes the sum outside any fixed neighborhood of s_* exponentially smaller. Within that neighborhood, I(s)<=gamma-c(s-s_*)^2. Set xi=(k-Ns_*)/sqrt N and use (5). The shifted lattice Gaussian Riemann sums converge by this bound, with arbitrary fractional part of Ns_*. Its integral is sqrt(2*pi/(-psi''(s_*)))=exp(i*pi/12). The remaining amplitude is sqrt N exp(5*pi*i/12); the lattice density is sqrt N. Their product with the Gaussian integral is iN, proving (2). Inserting exp(i*theta*k/N) proves (3) by exactly the same dominated Gaussian argument, uniformly on compact theta intervals. No external quantum-dilogarithm asymptotics or knot invariant identification enters. ## 3. Consequences for normal neighborhoods Already the order-one normal jet at the fixed regular point c_* has exponential rate gamma. Thus a claim that EVERY order r=o(N) normal jet costs exp(o(N)) relative to B_N(c,c)=1 is false, even for r=1. In fact the sharp uniform first-jet exponent on the entire unit circle is lim_(N->infinity) (1/N) log sup_(|c|=1)|J_N(c)|=gamma. (7) The upper bound follows from (6) and the sum of |F_k|; (2) gives the matching lower bound. Also, for ANY positive radius rho_N with log rho_N=o(N), Cauchy's derivative estimate gives sup_(|delta|<=rho_N)|B_N(c_*+delta,c_*)| >=rho_N |J_N(c_*)| =exp[N gamma+o(N)]. (8) This concerns a complex normal disk. It does not claim the same growth on every specified real contour or at every point of that disk. ## 4. The actual three-star block cannot uniformly hide this slope The exact actual figure-eight block in [the six-circuit computation](actual_six_circuit_beta_collision.md) has, after an invertible monomial coordinate change, the form W_N(U,V;a,b,c)=B_N(U,a) B_N(V,b) B_N(c,c U V). (9) The collision is U=V=1; c remains an independent nonzero parameter. All the other original atoms, cap factors, and remaining integrations are retained outside (9). Choose a,b with P_N=B_N(1,a)B_N(1,b)!=0. This excludes only the explicit finite local zero sets, and does not divide by an unknown knot period. Then W_N(1,1)=P_N, (partial_U W_N/P_N)(1,1) =A_N-c J_N(c), A_N=partial_u B_N(1,a)/B_N(1,a). (10) In particular no estimate on A_N is required for a UNIFORM obstruction. Take c_+=c_* and c_-=c_* exp(6*pi*i/(5N)). By (3), c_- J_N(c_-)=-c_+ J_N(c_+)(1+o(1)). The triangle inequality therefore implies max_(c=c_+,c_-)|A_N-c J_N(c)| >=N exp(N gamma)(1+o(1)). (11) Both marks may be multiplied by exp(i*pi/(7N)) if c^N=1 is excluded by an auxiliary chart. Their two N-th-power sets then stay uniformly away from one, while their asymptotic slope ratio is still -1. Thus the complete three-star block has an exponentially large relative first normal slope somewhere within O(1/N) of the SAME fixed regular c_*, regardless of the first star's derivative. For reference, an exact alternative uniform statement follows by Fourier orthogonality: (1/(2*pi)) integral_0^(2*pi)|A_N-e^(it)J_N(e^(it))|^2 dt =|A_N|^2+sum_(k=0)^(N-2)|F_k|^2. (12) The same real Laplace argument applied to (5), now without any complex phase, gives the positive energy asymptotic sum_(k=0)^(N-2)|F_k|^2 =3^(-1/4) N^(3/2) exp(2 N gamma)(1+o(1)). (13) Indeed 2I''(5/6)=-2*pi*sqrt(3), and the squared prefactor at the maximum is N. This is an exact Plancherel obstruction to a uniform tame normal-jet assertion, in addition to the explicit phase-coherent point (2). These are statements about an actual integrated subnetwork. They do not assert its exterior original-source pairing is nonzero. ## 5. What this does and does not rule out The exact collision identity B_N(c,c)=1 cannot be thickened to a uniform exp(o(N)) estimate for the COMPLETE fiber-integrated beta source on polynomial normal neighborhoods. A proof that removes a collision by first integrating that whole fiber and then using tame normal jets would lose a real exponential saddle. Conversely, a normal disk centered at this diagonal point on which the complete source is bounded by exp(o(N)) must have radius at most exp(-N gamma+o(N)), by the same Cauchy estimate. This does NOT obstruct the unintegrated, fixed finite shape-one collar patch. The derivative saddle above has Newton order k/N=5/6, away from the local all-six-shapes collar; global fiber integration can reach it. Local holomorphic regularization and preservation of its side currents remain valid. Nor is gamma an excess over the figure-eight volume rate: it is the single regular-tetrahedron rate. A sharp whole-knot bound still requires control after the exterior pairing, or a contour argument separating that saddle from the collision collar. No positive geometric intersection or knot-volume asymptotic is proved here. Reproducible finite/source and saddle checks: [audit script](../experiments/audit_actual_beta_collision_normal_jet.py).

title: The original beta current is a geometric extension, not a degenerate sector
text: # The original beta current is a geometric extension, not a degenerate sector 28 October 2026. The retained current has an exact triangular connection. Its power-series symbol is rational, but its logarithmic continuation can carry the SAME nondegenerate geometric full-Psi block as the residue. Thus a current in a full knot expansion cannot be declared geometrically degenerate from its local leading symbol alone. The complete original source is the invariant section of a rank-two extension. All identities below use the original polynomial B_N and the exact source cycle in [the beta-source theorem](actual_trivalent_quantum_beta_source.md), with the [proved normalizer](actual_trivalent_beta_normalizer.md). They do not introduce a different positive invariant or inserted coupon. The [audit](../experiments/audit_actual_beta_current_connection_and_monodromy.py) and [results](../experiments/actual_beta_current_connection_and_monodromy_results.json) check the commuting source-preserving matrices, seven normal-jet orders, nine actual full-Psi deck laws, eighteen Ward laws and six differential identities. The all-level proofs below do not infer their claims from those finite checks. ## 1. The exact extended state Put h=2*pi*i/N, Q=exp h, u=exp l, v=exp(l+c). Initially take -pi<Im l<0, 0<Im c<pi. The original state and source are B_N(u,v)=sum_(a=0)^(N-1) product_(j<a)(u-Q^jv), U=u^N, V=v^N, A=U-V, D=1-A, S_N(l,c)=(N/phi_N) exp(Nl-cl/h) Psi_+(c)Psi_+(h-l), B_N=S_N+D I_N. (1) I_N is the UPWARD Barnes line of the cited theorem, including its actual source residues. It is holomorphic and uniformly bounded on compact subsets of this initial positive boundary chamber, including the matched D=0 locus. Formula (1) defines its actual continuation elsewhere with the transported logarithmic marks. Apparent divisions by D below are always removable in this initial matched chamber; they must not be inverted separately on every continued branch. ## 2. Exact inhomogeneous Ward system The two original finite recurrences and exact Psi steps give S_N(l,c)=(u-v) S_N(l,c+h), I_N(l,c)=(u-v) I_N(l,c+h)+1, (2) v S_N(l+h,c)=(u-1) S_N(l,c), v I_N(l+h,c)=(u-1) I_N(l,c)+1. (3) The equations are literal on a common convergence chamber, and hold under continuation with its residue currents. They do not permit shifting a bare Barnes line across poles without those currents. Combining them, the u-only root shift is v S_N(Qu,v)=(u-1)(Qu-v)S_N(u,v), v I_N(Qu,v)=(u-1)(Qu-v)I_N(u,v)+Qu. (4) The +1 and +Qu are fixed original endpoint sources, not unspecified knot periods. The central D is invariant under each root shift. There is also an exact differential connection. Write p(Z)=d_Z Log Psi_+(Z), a meromorphic function explicitly given in the original full-Psi source note. Put q_c=-l/h+p(c), q_l=N-c/h-p(h-l). Then d_c S_N=q_c S_N, d_l S_N=q_l S_N. Differentiating the ORIGINAL invariant (1) gives the safe cross-multiplied form D d_c I_N+NV I_N=d_c B_N-q_c S_N, D d_l I_N-NA I_N=d_l B_N-q_l S_N. (5) No localization at a vanishing D is needed. Off that divisor, let J_N=B_N/D. The entire connection is equivalently d(I_N-J_N)=d Log(S_N/D) * (I_N-J_N). (6) Thus the inhomogeneous source is explicit and rational in the marked root coordinates u,v (not only their central powers U,V); its homogeneous line is precisely the original geometric full-Psi line. The connection is flat, since d_l q_c=d_c q_l=-1/h. This calculation does not classify its nonperturbative sectors from a formal asymptotic series. ## 3. Both boundary deck generators and their commutator Let T=2*pi*i. Under a v-only logarithmic deck turn c->c+T, the full-Psi monodromy and the Gaussian in (1) give exactly S_v=S/A, I_v=I-S/A. (7) For the simultaneous u,v deck turn l->l+T, c fixed, they give S_s=(U-1)S/V, I_s=I+S/V. (8) Therefore a u-only turn l->l+T,c->c-T gives S_u=A(U-1)S/V, I_u=I+U S/V. (9) These are meromorphic connection formulas with the full central factors retained. They are first established away from their displayed divisors, then interpreted by the matched total source. For example A=0 can make the individual continued terms singular although the polynomial B_N remains regular. For the column (S,I)^t, the v and simultaneous matrices are M_v=[[1/A,0],[-1/A,1]], M_s=[[(U-1)/V,0],[1/V,1]], M_u=[[A(U-1)/V,0],[U/V,1]]. (10) They obey M_v M_s=M_s M_v and M_u=M_s M_v^(-1). Thus both boundary deck generators commute, with their actual extension cocycle; there is no untracked central commutator. Direct multiplication shows [1,D]M_v=[1,D]M_s=[1,D]M_u=[1,D]. (11) The literal original source B_N=S+D I is their invariant section. On the balanced locus A=1, all three diagonals are one and their nonidentity parts square to zero. This is a genuine unipotent rank-two extension, not a claim of nilpotence of the full knot transport group. Generically the same extension also has nontrivial multiplicative norm characters; those characters cannot be discarded. More generally an arbitrary v deck of order m and simultaneous deck of order n have the exact solved transport mu=A^(-m)[(U-1)/V]^n, S' =mu S, I'=I+[(1-mu)/D]S. (12) Since mu=1 on D=0, the quotient is regular there and tends to -m+n/V. For the normal-jet ring modulo D^(p+1), write M=Id+L. Then L^k=(mu-1)^(k-1)L and therefore L^(p+2)=0. Every fixed normal jet has finite unipotent transport, with the full all-winding answer already given by (12). For an individual v deck the index p+2 is attained. This statement concerns the proved local deck connection, not every change of charts in a knot triangulation. Away from D=0 the gauge (S,I)->(S,B=S+D I) diagonalizes these matrices. Its determinant is D. Thus this splitting is invalid on the balanced source divisor itself; it cannot be used to discard the nontrivial unipotent extension or its normal derivatives. The geometric line span(S) is preserved, but the decomposition into an invariant original source and a current is not preserved as two independent scalar sectors. This is the precise failure of a proposed global proof that excludes every current term before its continuation. ## 4. A regular growing geometric sector inside a continued current Consider a compact original gap family with |u|<|v| and Lambda(u,v)>max(0,log|u|,log|v|), where Lambda is the exact residue rate in the normalizer theorem. Such genuine positive bipyramid families exist near |v|=1 and lower u with |u|<1. The principal current is O(1), whereas S grows with its specified full-Psi geometric phase. On this chamber 1/A=-v^(-N)[1+O((|u|/|v|)^N)]. Equation (7) therefore gives I_v=I+v^(-N)S[1+O((|u|/|v|)^N)]. (13) Since Lambda-log|v|>0, the continued current has a nonzero growing geometric sector. Its added phase differs from S only by the integer logarithmic mark -2*pi*i Log v. Their exponentiated canonical relations are the SAME and the geometric shapes remain regular. This conclusion uses an exact current connection and a checked rate gap; it is not inferred merely from a nonzero local density. An especially transparent fixed-center example is u=-i,v=1 along N=4m+1. Then A=-1-i stays nonzero and the principal I is bounded, while the current after the v deck has exponential rate lim_(m->infinity) (2*pi/N)log|I_v(-i,1)|=2D(i)>0. (14) The underlying positive bipyramid has p=q=2+i, H=1-2i and two outputs i,i. All five signed shapes are strictly nondegenerate. The source and all physical centers are unchanged by the logarithmic turn; B_N is exactly invariant by (11). This is a local original-source countercheck to automatic geometric degeneracy of retained currents. It is NOT a counterexample to a global knot volume statement, nor a claim that a particular full knot cycle must perform this deck turn. ## 5. Exponentially small geometry is also present in the current extension There is a second exact description in the open contraction chamber |u|+|v|<1. Its infinite Newton series H_N(u,v)=sum_(a>=0) product_(j<a)(u-Q^jv) converges absolutely and normally. The integer relation P_(a+N)=A P_a shows H_N=B_N/(1-A)=B_N/D, I_N=H_N-S_N/D. (15) No tail or boundary source has been omitted. The single-valued analytic series H_N stays fixed; the full-Psi block produces precisely the current deck jumps (7)--(9). For u=-4i/5,v=1/100 from the positive-bipyramid example in the beta-source theorem, the exact residue rate is strictly negative: Lambda=[ImLi_2(i/80)+ImLi_2(4i/5)]/(2*pi) +(1/4)log(1/125)<0. The imaginary dilogarithms are each less than their positive imaginary arguments; this bounds their sum by 65/80, while the logarithm is strictly negative by a fixed larger margin. Thus the full current contains the explicitly specified exponentially small term -S_N/D in (15). Its rational power-series symbol cannot determine this sector or its deck continuation. The source identity, rather than a chosen formal series, is needed for exterior composition. This is a specified exact source decomposition, not a claim that H_N itself has no further exponentially small components or that a unique transseries convention has been proved for it. ### The principal normalization symbol to every power On every compact subset of the initial positive boundary chamber, the actual current has an asymptotic expansion to every fixed order I_N(u,v)=sum_(k=0)^K h^k R_k(u,v)+O_K(h^(K+1)), R_0=1/(1-u+v), R_k=(u-v)/(1-u+v) sum_(j=1)^k (v*d_v)^j R_(k-j)/j!. (15a) All coefficients are rational, with poles ONLY on 1-u+v=0 and pole order at most 2k+1. The first correction is the one already independently derived in the beta theorem. Equation (15a) follows formally from the exact inhomogeneous Ward equation (2); the actual uniform remainder requires the contour estimate as well. Here are details supplying that estimate to every fixed order. The full-Psi logarithm has a complete fixed-order expansion on compact subsets of its selected strip. In a left-half-plane anchor this is proved directly: its noncentral logarithmic Fourier coefficient is -exp(nZ)/[n(1-Q^n)], N not dividing n. For n below a fixed small multiple of N, expand 1/(exp(hn)-1) to the required Bernoulli order. The remainder is bounded by a fixed power of |hn|, whose sum against exp(n Re Z) is convergent. The remaining modes and the explicit central logarithmic terms are exponentially small. To continue to an arbitrary compact selected-strip set, use the EXACT finite derivative formula sum_(ell=0)^(N-1)g_Z(ell/N) in equation (7b) of the full-Psi source note. Its g_Z is holomorphic on a common neighborhood of [0,1]. Euler--Maclaurin to any fixed order has a uniform remainder there; integrate it from the already normalized anchor. Cauchy estimates give the same derivative bounds. This proves the needed full-Psi expansion with its actual normalization, not a formal periodic replacement. In the Barnes integral, cut |Im a| at C log N, choosing C sufficiently large for the requested order. The already proved strict exponential tails make the omitted part smaller than that order. On the retained part the expansion of the ratio at c and c+ha has polynomial coefficients in a and a uniformly bounded remainder times a fixed power of 1+|a|. Taylor's formula and the exponential contour majorant then permit termwise integration with an O(h^(K+1)) remainder. Each coefficient is an ordinary Barnes moment of (u-v)^a, hence a rational derivative of 1/(1-u+v). Uniqueness of the recursion identifies it with (15a). Differentiation in u,v is uniform on smaller compact sets by holomorphy. There is a precise formal bubble geometry: on 1-u+v=0 the two shape arguments are x=v/u=1-y, y=1/u, and D(x)+D(y)=0. (15b) This justifies calling the FORMAL rational current a normalization or bubble channel in this chart. It does not classify the exact current: (7)--(15) display its additional geometric continuation and exponentially small sectors. In particular a formal pole calculation cannot replace the rank-two source connection. ## 6. What this settles for the next global step The normalization-current symbol and exact Ward equations are now available for whole-word composition. A global proof may use the invariant rank-two extension and its matched currents, or prove that its particular physical cycle avoids specified deck transfers. It cannot prove the needed gap by declaring every current sector a degenerate representation: (13)--(14) would contradict that assertion. The remaining geometric question is about the ACTUAL joint original cycle, its permitted branch transport, and the exterior stationary equations. None of the local identities above supplies a global geometric quotient or forces its coefficient to be nonzero. ## 7. Why killing the current is not a source-preserving deck quotient There is a concrete algebraic obstruction, stronger than observing a continued current with a large rate. Work over a ring R of single-valued meromorphic boundary functions on a regular marked chart, with A and D units. The logarithmic deck transformations fix R. Use the ACTUAL source presentation with generators S,I and its pointing B=S+D I. This is meromorphic deck descent data, not a claim that its variable coefficient matrices are constant monodromy matrices of a complex local system. Put J=D I. Equation (7) gives T_v(S)=S/A, T_v(J)=J-(D/A)S. (16) Let pi be an R-linear quotient whose kernel is stable under this actual deck transport. If pi kills the current J, it also kills T_v(J)-J. Since D/A is a unit, it follows that pi(S)=0, pi(B)=0. (17) Thus a nonzero invariant geometric quotient cannot be constructed by simply quotienting out this current. This uses the original polynomial pointing and its exact full-Psi deck law; no arbitrary replacement period or unknown knot scalar is introduced. Without inverting D, the same calculation forces D pi(S)=0. Hence a D-torsion-free quotient still kills S and B. A quotient supported on the balanced divisor, its derived normal source, or a comparison which is not deck-equivariant is a different object. The normal jets of Section 3 must not be discarded to identify those alternatives. The quotient here is taken over the REMAINING boundary variables before their period pushforward. A final exterior integral is not R-linear in a variable which it integrates. Hence (17) does not say that a particular integrated current can never vanish while a geometric integral survives. It excludes setting the current KERNEL to zero in a pointwise, deck-compatible comparison; nonlocal cycle cancellation after the exterior integration is a separate question. There is no assertion here that every local v turn is an allowed independent deck transformation after all boundary variables have been coupled. That is checked by the actual monomial boundary map. The following coupled version makes the required check explicit. ## 8. Disjoint original sink fibers and their coupled descent presentation In the ORIGINAL reduced atomic graph, an eligible beta sink has three incident atoms, all pointing into it before factorial reflection: one reciprocal factorial, one positive Euler transfer, and one positive factorial. Its finite coefficient contraction is exactly B_N from (1). Two such sinks cannot share an atom: an oriented incidence column has only one positive entry. Since neither sink is an original boundary cap vertex, no cup/cap factor has been removed by this observation. Consequently a family of s eligible sinks can be contracted simultaneously at the finite-coefficient level. The local result is the product of their B_N kernels with the SAME remaining original boundary functional. The sums are finite, so no contour interchange or independent-sector convergence is assumed for that identity. Its expansion into S_i+D_i I_i is pointwise exact on their common marked boundary chart. The exact u=Q^2U,v=QV tags and reflected NQ^d source factors are those of the beta-source theorem; each stays in its specified kernel or exterior density, according to that representation. None is reset. Eligibility matters: an original U/u/F sink is not the U/v/F beta kernel. BEFORE exact Gaussian absorption, the strict nine-atom crossing has the proved star {0,1,3} for either sign and additionally {2,4,6} for a negative crossing. The final raw star {5,7,8} contains a u transfer. For a positive crossing, however, the original finite Gaussian and its adjacent reciprocal diagonal combine EXACTLY by d_a/F_a=p_a*x^(-2a). Slot 5 is thereby a V diagonal, and {5,7,8} becomes a second genuine beta star, disjoint from {0,1,3}. This is an identity of the COMPLETE original finite Gaussian operator, not a pointwise removal at fixed continuous Gaussian variable. Thus each sign has two simultaneous eligible beta stars after this exact preprocessing, with the remaining adapters retained. Their literal whole-word monomials and Gaussian grouping belong to the original crossing assembly; they cannot be guessed from only the local shape relations. For each selected beta sink form its rank-two presented descent module M_i with the matrices of Section 3. Pull these modules back by the ACTUAL boundary monomials in the remaining head/Gaussian variables, and tensor them: M_presented=tensor_(i=1)^s M_i, b=tensor_(i=1)^s(S_i+D_i I_i). (18) This has a rank-2^s presentation. Its evaluation into actual functions may have further relations after boundary coupling; faithfulness is not inferred. Its pointing evaluates to the original product of finite B_N kernels. It has not been defined from the final knot value. The first guaranteed sink gives a literal check on this pullback. Label the single-crossing boundary/head coordinates as in the original nine-atom graph, with the sink z_2 and its neighbors z_0,z_1,z_4. Its reciprocal leg, positive Euler leg and positive factorial give the finite coefficient product (z_2/z_1)^i/F_i, p_j(x^(-1)z_2/z_0)^j, F_a(z_4/z_2)^a. The z_2 constant coefficient forces a=i+j and is exactly B_N(u_0,v_0), u_0=z_4/z_1, v_0=x^(-1)z_4/z_0. (18a) Thus a local z_0 logarithmic turn has a=0,b=-1 in the notation below, and its beta character is A_0=u_0^N-v_0^N, generically different from one. The nontrivial individual characters in (20) therefore occur in an ACTUAL crossing boundary map. In a whole word that head can also enter other sinks or source factors; all their pulled-back transformations must be composed. Equation (18a) does not assert that the local v turn is independent of those changes. For a particular head logarithmic turn, let the actual boundary map shift Log u_i by 2pi*i*a_i and Log v_i by 2pi*i*b_i. In (12) this means n=a_i and m=b_i-a_i. Thus each beta factor has its explicit character mu_i and current coefficient from that formula. Tensor the corresponding matrices. They preserve (18), and their geometric/current sectors mix by these specified coefficients. Untouched full-Psi factors, Gaussian and peripheral/source lines must carry their OWN descent factors as well; no conclusion about the full graph character follows from the beta factors alone. One useful falsification criterion applies directly to this coupled presentation. Localize where every D_i and mu_i is a unit, and put J_i=D_i I_i. Suppose a deck-stable quotient kills EVERY tensor sector containing at least one J_i. Under an allowed head turn, S_i -> mu_i S_i, J_i -> J_i+(1-mu_i)S_i. (19) Apply the turn to the sector with precisely its ith factor J_i and all other factors S_j. Modulo the killed sectors its image is (1-mu_i) product_(j!=i)mu_j * product_j S_j. (20) If any such 1-mu_i is a unit, the quotient kills the entire geometric product and therefore the original pointing b. It is not enough that the PRODUCT of the mu_i equals one: individual current sectors still mix into that product by (20). If all relevant characters are one, or one restricts to their fixed-character divisors, this obstruction alone decides nothing; the retained normal jets and exterior source still have to be computed. Equations (18)--(20) specify a source-preserving composition object and a check against an invalid quotient. They do not make the individual sector integrals single-valued on the original head torus. On overlapping logarithmic charts the FULL tensor descent data, and the matched source seams, are compulsory. Nor does the nonzero meromorphic product of local residues imply that its FINAL exterior period is nonzero. That remaining pairing is precisely what a global geometric coefficient theorem must control.

title: Polynomial-cost sublevel cycles for arbitrarily wide blockwise source cores
text: # Polynomial-cost sublevel cycles for arbitrarily wide blockwise source cores 28 October 2026. There is a constructive higher-anchor case of the missing mass theorem. Articulation points split the ORIGINAL coefficient, master, and torus by an explicit unimodular monomial change of variables. If every remaining biconnected block is either a two-anchor block or a balanced unit-factor block, the resulting product cycle has polynomial logarithmic mass. No semialgebraic triangulation or bound on an integer boundary-matrix inverse is assumed. The anchor count is arbitrary but fixed. This does not cover an unbalanced biconnected block with three or more anchors, does not sum the original clocks, and proves no new knot volume theorem. ## 1. Same original source and the exact articulation split Use the strict-Hall master and source of [the radial transport theorem](actual_anchor_sublevel_radial_transport.md): f=P/product_v X_v^(q_v), P=gamma product_e(alpha_e X_(u_e)-beta_e X_(v_e)), |alpha_e|=|beta_e|=1, sum_v q_v=M. Original extracted scalars remain in gamma. Parallel factors are retained with their multiplicities; their underlying simple graph determines the articulation points. Zero loops and forced cuts have already been treated by the exact source identities, not removed by an absolute estimate. Suppose v is an articulation point, and C_1,...,C_s are the components after deleting v. Put V_a=C_a union {v}, let P_a contain exactly the factors on V_a, and let M_a=degree P_a. Assign the component charges q_u^(a)=q_u, u in C_a, q_v^(a)=M_a-sum_(u in C_a)q_u. (1) Their sums are M_a, and sum_a q_v^(a)=q_v. These are FORCED charges: homogeneity makes every coefficient in the exterior C_a require exactly the displayed remaining power of X_v. Thus [product_v X_v^(q_v)]P =gamma product_a [product_(u in V_a)X_u^(q_u^(a))]P_a, (2) where gamma is allocated once, or equivalently kept outside every scalar-free factor on the right. There is no summation over articulation charges and no unknown source normalization. The same factorization holds before integration. Choose X_v=1 as the common gauge, and use Y_(a,u)=X_u/X_v for u in C_a. Then T=(C*)^V/C* ~= product_a ((C*)^(V_a)/C*), f=gamma product_a f_a. (3) This is a unimodular monomial isomorphism, so the logarithmic top form and the ORIGINAL torus generator are the product forms and generators, with the common orientation fixed accordingly. Iterating at further articulations gives the biconnected-block factorization. Each factor belongs to exactly one block. Strict Hall is preserved by (1). For a set I not containing v, its internal factors, crossing count and deficit are exactly the original ones. For a local set containing v use its nonempty complement J in C_a and the identity e_I=C_J-e_J. Hence every proper local cut remains strict. In particular q_v^(a)=C_(C_a)-e_(C_a) is a positive integer. ## 2. The regular critical values also split exactly In the independent coordinates (3), dlog f=direct_sum_a dlog f_a. A nonzero point is therefore critical exactly when EACH component is critical. Its value is gamma times the product of their values. Whenever the component regular critical sets are nonempty, Mcrit(f)=|gamma| product_a Mcrit(f_a). (4) All blocks used below have a nonempty regular critical set. This is immediate for balanced blocks by their positive unit-torus maximum. For a two-anchor strict-Hall block, its Laurent map has poles at both ends; its derivative numerator has degree m, and removing a root of multiplicity h from that numerator removes only h-1 copies. Thus at least one derivative zero remains off its zero divisor. The identity (4) does not declare these FIXED-clock critical points to be full knot/Hurwitz critical points. It only gives the exact critical modulus appearing in the present coefficient estimate. ## 3. Balanced blocks require no deformation or integer-chain estimate For a block B with incidence counts S_u and charges q_u, suppose S_u=2q_u for every vertex u of B. (5) On its unit torus every radial derivative of log|f_B| vanishes: this is the exact off-critical identity with equal endpoint radii and delta=0. The nonzero maximum on that compact torus also has all angular derivatives zero. It is consequently a regular complex critical point. Conversely the cut maximum principle forces every regular critical point of a connected balanced block to have equal radii. Therefore Mcrit(f_B)=max_(unit torus)|f_B|. (6) The original unit torus itself lies in the Mcrit sublevel and has normalized logarithmic top-form mass one. There is no positivity or noncancellation inference about its integral: it can vanish. ## 4. Two-anchor blocks have the already proved explicit cycle A two-anchor block with m factors and strict charge 1<=q<=m-1 becomes f_B(z)=gamma_B z^(-q) product_(j=1)^m(z-u_j), |u_j|=1. For every R_B>Mcrit(f_B), the boundary of the component of {|f_B|>R_B} containing the zero pole is a smooth oriented circle. It represents the original generator, lies on |f_B|=R_B, and its normalized logarithmic length tends, as R_B decreases to Mcrit, to at most A_B=4m^2 log(m+1). (7) This is the proved [two-anchor minimax estimate](actual_coefficient_minimax_upper.md). The circle is a selected component of a degree-2m real algebraic lemniscate. Its original pole component, not a favorable saddle, selects it. Repeated or arbitrarily clustered unit roots are permitted. ## 5. Actual polynomial-mass product cycle and its coefficient bound Assume EVERY biconnected block is either two-anchor or satisfies (5). For each balanced block retain its unit torus; for each two-anchor block use the circle above. Their product, followed by the inverse monomial isomorphism (3), is homologous to the ORIGINAL source torus. Its absolute logarithmic top-form mass is exactly the product of the block masses, because the monomial logarithmic determinant is +/-1. For any R>Mcrit(f), choose the finitely many R_B sufficiently close to their Mcrit values that the product supremum is less than R. The constructed product cycle then lies in {|f|<=R}. Its limiting normalized mass is at most the product of the A_B over two-anchor blocks. Hence |I| <=Mcrit(f) product_(two-anchor blocks B) 4m_B^2 log(m_B+1). (8) For fixed original diagram width and block count, m_B=O(N), so the cost is polynomial in N. This bound includes |gamma| through (4). It is not rescaled by the coefficient I or by a guessed regulator period. The cycles also have bounded-complexity algebraic supports. They are products of real algebraic lemniscates and unit tori; the monomial change has degree bounded by the fixed anchor count. Their support degree is polynomial in N. Their logarithmic radius range is O(log N), by the explicit modulus-nonincreasing radial clipping if necessary. On the product cycle the real logarithmic mass is the product of the block lengths/torus masses; the fixed monomial change and clipping multiply it by at most a constant depending on the anchor count. Thus the construction itself supplies the chain complexity which cannot be inferred from a triangulation of a general sublevel set. ## 6. Exact remaining scope This is an arbitrary-width source transport theorem, with a structural condition on its blocks. Exact articulation factorization reduces the general mass problem to UNBALANCED BICONNECTED unit-factor cores with at least three anchors. The statement does not prove that the full original clock source decomposes into the permitted block family. Actual macro-defect sectors can contain the excluded cores. In particular, taking absolute values over clocks after (8) is not a sharp knot upper bound. The critical actions in (4) are conditional, and all factorial weights, feedback phases and original normalization still enter the full source. The missing full-clock support/critical comparison remains in addition to the unbalanced-core mass problem. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_blockwise_sublevel_source_transport.py): exact articulation charge and coefficient factorization, strict-Hall preservation, actual source residual cores and wider mixed balanced/tree examples, plus critical splitting and the quantitative coefficient bound.

title: Actual braid transport has a flat Borel-relative algebra and a divided cap period
text: # Actual braid transport has a flat Borel-relative algebra and a divided cap period Research proof, 27 October 2026. The actual diagonal quantum Borel action has an explicit free fusion basis. Actual crossing words become matrices over a finite flat algebra, including at the original nilpotent source. The pivotal highest-input cap is an explicit Frobenius functional with its marked density. It is a divided central-F trace on a cyclic chart; bare semisimple reduction loses a nonzero actual period. This supplies an actual word AND source comparison, rather than only an auxiliary source-frame classification. Its target is not identified with a geometric gluing algebra or the A-polynomial. The central-F parameter below is not identified with the meridian or Q-normal. ## 1. The actual Borel algebra and its flat central extension Fix the actual root Q=exp(2 pi i/N), N at least two. On each regular holonomy splitting module retain K_i=x_i diag(Q^(-j)) and the actual F_i with F_i^N=phi_i. We can use the original balanced head frame: its nonwrapping arrow j to j+1 is 1-Q^(j+1), and its wrapping arrow is phi_i/N. This is exactly the factorial gauge of the regular module, not an altered representation. Put \[ H=(K_1\cdots K_b)/(x_1\cdots x_b),\qquad f=\Delta^{b-1}F=\sum_{i=1}^bK_1^{-1}\cdots K_{i-1}^{-1}F_i. \] Actual quantum-group multiplication and the root binomial identity give \[ H^N=1,\qquad Hf=Q^{-1}fH,\qquad f^N=\Phi:=\sum_{i=1}^b(x_1\cdots x_{i-1})^{-N}\phi_i. \tag{1} \] For example for two terms A=F_1,B=K_1 inverse F_2 one has BA=QAB, so all intermediate coefficients of (A+B)^N vanish. Iteration proves (1). Every complete center and meridian factor is retained in Phi. Define the algebra A_Phi by these three relations, with idempotents \[ e_j=\frac1N\sum_{a=0}^{N-1}Q^{ja}H^a,\quad z_{a,j}=f^a e_j,\quad 0\leq a,j<N. \] It has the EXPLICIT free basis z_(a,j). Multiplication is \[ z_{a,j}z_{c,k} =\begin{cases} \Phi^{\lfloor(a+c)/N\rfloor} z_{a+c\bmod N,k},& k=j-c\pmod N,\\ 0,&\text{otherwise}. \end{cases} \tag{2} \] This formula is associative (it records the shift of the idempotent and total integer f exponent) and realizes all defining relations, so it also proves the basis assertion without a dimension guess. Thus this is a flat rank-N-squared algebra over the WHOLE Phi base. At Phi=0 its ideal (f) is nonzero, nilpotent and two-sided, with quotient the N diagonal characters. It is the truncated quantum Borel algebra, also known as a Taft algebra. It is not Mat_N there. For Phi nonzero the cyclic module f e_j=e_(j+1) for j<N-1 and f e_(N-1)=Phi e_0, with H e_j=Q^(-j)e_j, gives Mat_N. The idempotents and nonzero cyclic arrows exhibit every matrix unit. After retaining a root rho^N=Phi, the normalized shift f/rho has Nth power one and gives a cyclic companion frame. This is a generic cyclic chart, not an extension of its bare matrix algebra through the nilpotent source. ## 2. Explicit free fusion for any number of actual strands For b=2 let u=e_0 tensor ones, and define \[ \mathcal F:A_\Phi\longrightarrow V_1\otimes V_2, \quad z_{a,j}\longmapsto f^a(e_0\otimes e_j). \tag{3} \] This is A_Phi-linear, because e_j u=e_0 tensor e_j. It is an isomorphism, including on Phi=0. Indeed the unique term with first output index a is F_1^a(e_0) tensor e_j, with coefficient (Q;Q)_a. Every other term has first index strictly smaller than a. No first-leg wrap occurs in fewer than N applications. In order of first index, (3) is block triangular with diagonal (Q;Q)_a times I_N. These are original nonzero factorial units. The determinant is their product, independent of phi_1,phi_2. For b greater than two, let t=(t_3,...,t_b) index the remaining physical heads and set u_t=e_0 tensor ones tensor e_t. Then \[ A_\Phi\otimes R^{N^{b-2}}\longrightarrow V_1\otimes\cdots\otimes V_b, \quad a\otimes t\longmapsto a u_t \tag{4} \] is again an isomorphism. The projector e_j selects the unique second index j-sum(t_i) modulo N; all-first-leg f terms give the same triangular diagonal (Q;Q)_a. Hence the actual tensor module is a FREE left A_Phi module of rank N^(b-2). This is a non-naive fusion basis built from the actual coproduct; no proposed product of two repaired head shifts has been substituted for it. The inverse is regular in all phi_i because that determinant is a fixed unit. Every actual matrix, source vector, cap and current has an exact conjugate under (4). There is no discarded endpoint, choice of replacement co-source or asymptotic remainder here. ## 3. Actual local R and arbitrary words act on this relative algebra The actual checked R intertwines the diagonal coproduct. On the same-color nilpotent section it commutes with H and f. Therefore (4) takes each actual local crossing and inverse into \[ \operatorname{End}_{A_\Phi}(A_\Phi^{N^{b-2}}) \cong \operatorname{Mat}_{N^{b-2}}(A_\Phi^{op}). \tag{5} \] For two strands it is right multiplication by a unique unit a_R, computed from R u using (3). It is NOT an unspecified scalar: the literal actual R matrix, including its half-Cartan and scalar line, fixes a_R. Composition and every signed braid relation follow by conjugating the actual word through the same basis change. The same construction applies to the full actual holonomy Hom line on its admissible splitting covers in [the regular holonomy theorem](regular_holonomy_braiding.md). The checked map preserves the diagonal coproduct, the product of the marked K roots and Phi in (1). Source and target versions of (4) give A_Phi-linear maps. Retain the actual Hom line and all closing root phases; no new global scalar frame is supplied here. The semicyclic case is the explicit polynomial intertwiner in [the carry-braiding theorem](semicyclic_carry_braiding.md), including its transported centers and corrected wrap factor. Thus (5) is actual root-parameter word transport across central Phi=0, not an assertion of topological invariance of a new period. The original selected word and its original source are transported together. On the nilpotent section their value is exactly the original invariant with every external normalization retained. ## 4. A regular Frobenius functional is a divided cyclic trace Define on the WHOLE flat algebra \[ \tau_{top}(z_{a,j})=\delta_{a,N-1}. \] Its left-dual basis is explicitly \[ d_{a,j}=f^{N-1-a}e_{j+a\bmod N},\qquad \tau_{top}(d_{a,j}z_{c,k})=\delta_{a,c}\delta_{j,k}. \tag{6} \] No Phi enters this Gram matrix: a matching product has exponent N-1 and never crosses a full f cycle. Thus this is a nondegenerate Frobenius functional on every fiber, including the nilpotent one. For any actual co-source Lambda on this relative algebra the marked density is the explicit finite element \[ C_\Lambda=\sum_{a,j}\Lambda(z_{a,j})d_{a,j},\qquad \Lambda(a)=\tau_{top}(C_\Lambda a). \tag{7} \] For several strands apply (7) to each relative matrix entry. Their coefficients are the literal pulled-back pivotal/cut rows from (4). This gives a concrete relative period for an arbitrary actual braid, not a replacement regular trace. For clarity the arbitrary-braid source formula is explicit. Let s,t index the tail labels of (4), and let a_(t,s) in A_Phi be the actual relative word matrix: its action is a tensor s to sum_t a a_(t,s) tensor t. For a closed input tuple (c,s), with c the second physical input, put k=c+sum_i s_i modulo N. Define the actual finite rows \[ L_{(c,s),t}(z) =(\mathrm{ones}^t\otimes e_c^t\otimes e_s^t) \mathcal F(z\otimes t), \] \[ \Lambda_{t,s}(z) =\sum_{c=0}^{N-1}\left(g_2(c)\prod_{i=3}^b g_i(s_i)\right) L_{(c,s),t}(e_k z). \] The g_i are the original pivotal entries with their actual colors. The original period, with its assigned external line gamma_beta, is EXACTLY \[ P_\beta=\gamma_\beta\sum_{t,s}\Lambda_{t,s}(a_{t,s}) =\gamma_\beta\sum_{t,s}\tau_{top}(C_{t,s}a_{t,s}), \tag{7a} \] where C_(t,s) is given by (7). This uses the original INPUT e_0 on the first strand, the SUM over its output, and every other original pivotal closure. Indeed e_k u_s is the literal input e_0 tensor e_c tensor e_s. Applying the A_Phi-linear word then gives this formula entry by entry. All closing identifications and the root of total K remain on their original cover. On the cyclic chart (7a) is the sum of Tr_N(f C_(t,s) a_(t,s))/Phi by (8), with its regular divided extension at Phi=0. No unspecified cap functional is introduced. In the N-dimensional cyclic splitting of Section 1, a stronger WHOLE polynomial identity is \[ \operatorname{Tr}_N(fa)=\Phi\,\tau_{top}(a). \tag{8} \] It suffices to check the basis: only a=f^(N-1)e_j contributes, when f a=Phi e_j. Consequently tau_top is exactly the retained DIVIDED central-F normal trace Tr(fa)/Phi, regular at Phi=0. Bare ordinary trace kills the nilpotent ideal and loses this value. The Frobenius functional is twisted rather than cyclic: its Nakayama transport is H to QH, f to f. It becomes conjugation by f only on Phi nonzero. No categorical modified-trace axioms are claimed solely from (6)-(8). ## 5. The actual two-leg cap density is explicit On the actual nilpotent same-color section put F_a=(Q;Q)_a, x=K on e_0 and g_j=(xQ^(-j))^(1-N). For a right multiplication operator R_a on A_0, the original highest-input pivotal cut is \[ \Lambda_{cap}(a)=\sum_{j=0}^{N-1}g_j L_j(e_j a),\quad L_j(z)=(\mathrm{ones}^t\otimes e_j^t)\mathcal F(z). \tag{9} \] All zero-framing, full d_N(M) and common crossing lines remain their original external factors. There is no extra 1/N here. For the basis z_(a,k), the finite binomial expansion of the ACTUAL coproduct gives \[ \Lambda_{cap}(f^a e_k)= \begin{cases} x^{1-N-a}Q^{-(k+a)}F_{k+a}/F_k,& k+a<N,\\ 0,&k+a\geq N. \end{cases} \tag{10} \] For the first case e_j f^a e_k requires j=k+a, and closing the second output at j forces all a lowering steps onto that leg. In the second case the required wrap is zero. This proves (10) with the original pivotal weights rather than an abstract trace. The density in (7) factors explicitly as C_cap=L R with \[ L=\sum_{j=0}^{N-1}\frac{x^j}{F_j}f^j e_{N-1},\qquad R=\sum_{k=0}^{N-1}x^{1-N-k}Q^{-k}F_k f^{N-1-k}e_k. \] The multiplication rule (2) gives \[ R L=\gamma e_{N-1},\quad C_{cap}^2=\gamma C_{cap},\qquad \gamma=N x^{2-2N}Q\ne0. \tag{11} \] Thus the cap is a marked primitive projective density, with its full source character gamma retained. Formula (11) is asserted on Phi=0 here: modulo the nilpotent ideal C_cap/gamma is the primitive idempotent e_(N-1), so it is primitive. A generic cyclic cap must keep its actual wrap coefficients. Neither cyclicity of tau_top nor erasure of gamma is used to convert it into a preferred modified trace. ## 6. An actual period detects the nilpotent relative source At N=2, q=i, eta=exp(pi i/4), x=i, direct use of the actual positive balanced R gives \[ a_R=\eta I+\frac{\eta^{-1}}2 f e_0. \] Here (f e_0)^2=0 and the second term lies in the nilpotent radical. The ORIGINAL cap (9)-(10) satisfies \[ \Lambda_{cap}(I)=0,\qquad \Lambda_{cap}(f e_0)=2. \tag{12} \] Thus Lambda_cap(a_R)=eta inverse, the actual nonzero one-crossing cut before its retained external lines. Its entire value comes from the radical term; semisimple reduction gives zero. More generally Lambda_cap(a_R^m)=m eta^(m-2) in this example. The full framing and modified-dimension lines multiply these exact values and have not been reset. This is an actual source obstruction to factoring the word period through the semisimple quotient, not the previously noted failure of a naive tensor product of repaired shift pairs. The regular module's ordinary trace also kills the radical, whereas the actual divided cap functional does not. ## 7. Quantum normal and geometric comparison remain distinct The flat A_Phi transport is at a fixed original root Q. It does not by itself extend through a moving Q^N normal. For example, at N=2 the original finite matrices have \[ f_{tot}^2=(1+Q)F_1K_1^{-1}F_2,\qquad \left[\frac{f_{tot}^2}{1-Q^2}\right]_{Q=-1} =\tfrac12F_1K_1^{-1}F_2\ne0. \tag{13} \] On the actual highest product source at x=i its all-ones output value is -2i. A claimed whole Q-normal Taft model setting f^N=0 would erase this real actual current. Its divided-power/endpoint extension must be kept. The central Phi normal, the meridian norm and the Q-normal are not equated by their notation. The construction provides an actual non-naive word/source transport and an explicit divided-trace period candidate before jets in the central parameters. It still does not identify that period with the marked geometric Bloch regulator, prove survival of its geometric block under the final finite source, or control its hyperbolic-volume norm. The smooth companion frame alone does not supply those additional identifications. There is a further essential distinction. Phi in this note is the Frobenius-center value of a coproduct power at a FIXED root Q_N. It is not a coordinate on the q-to-one geometric critical variety. At the actual M=1 augmentation all root central meridians are I. The direct Wirtinger induction in [the closed-braid center calculation](closed_braid_period_line.md), Section 4, proves that its completed knot-representation germ is entirely abelian. Consequently deforming this center/source family locally at that closed augmentation cannot produce the hyperbolic flat connection. The generic semicyclic comparison remains on its reducible character locus. The full holonomy line and this fusion basis can be considered at other admissible center points, but that does not continue the specified augmentation frame or identify its selected period on another component. Any regulator comparison must leave this local germ by an independently proved global center or q-to-one critical source transform. The exact socle/divided-trace formula by itself does neither. In particular its nonzero nilpotent source class must not be renamed the geometric period or its coefficient. [Exact actual fusion, R, cap and normal checks](../experiments/audit_actual_borel_regular_fusion.py) and [saved output](../experiments/actual_borel_regular_fusion_results.json).

title: A literal Borel Ward contraction for the actual finite cut
text: # A literal Borel Ward contraction for the actual finite cut Research construction, 27 October 2026. This derives an explicit split Ward complex and its cut functional from the actual root matrices. It identifies exactly what unknot normalization fixes. It does not yet map the partially summed geometric Gaussian block into that complex or prove a selected global geometric contribution. ## 1. The two actual matrices already determine the scalar Ward kernel Fix N>=2, Q primitive of order N, x=-M/q!=0. In the original balanced basis w_a=v_a/(Q;Q)_a, 0<=a<N, the actual generators are K_aa=k_a=x Q^(-a), F_(a+1,a)=f_a=1-Q^(a+1), 0<=a<N-1, with all other F entries zero. Distinct k_a and nonzero f_a are units at every M!=0, including the complete value M=1. No E coefficient is inverted, so no color-reducibility wall is removed. For C in End(V) put delta(C)=([K,C],[F,C]), p(C)=Tr(C)/N, i(c)=c I. (1.1) Define two explicit maps on a pair (X,Z) of matrices. Let H_K(X) have zero diagonal and off-diagonal entries H_K(X)_(a,b)=X_(a,b)/(k_a-k_b), a!=b. Put d_r=Z_(r+1,r)/f_r and define the diagonal matrix H_F(Z)_aa=(1/N)sum_(r=0)^(N-2)(N-1-r)d_r -sum_(r<a)d_r. (1.2) Then, for every matrix C, C=i p(C)+H_K([K,C])+H_F([F,C]). (1.3) For the off-diagonal entries this is immediate. On the diagonal, [F,C]_(r+1,r)/f_r=C_rr-C_(r+1,r+1); cumulative summation gives the diagonal minus its average, proving (1.3). In particular ker delta=k I. Define the actual Ward complex to be W^0=End(V) --delta--> W^1=im(delta). The map h(X,Z)=H_K(X)+H_F(Z) satisfies h delta=I-i p, delta h=I on W^1, p h=0, h delta i=0. (1.4) Thus it is an explicit strong contraction onto k I in degree zero. There is no claim that the unrestricted codomain End(V)^2 has vanishing higher cokernel; W^1 is the actual image subspace. These are matrix identities, independent of any irreducibility, semisimplicity, Haar integration, or modified-trace existence theorem. ## 2. The original marked cut is cohomologous to the normalized scalar row In this same balanced basis the prescribed source and co-source are psi=(1,...,1)^t and phi=(1/N)(1,...,1). Hence e=psi phi, e_(a,b)=1/N, Phi(C)=Tr(e C). The original pivot is g=K^(1-N), and its marked defect is D=g^(-1)e; thus the actual expression is Phi(C)=Tr(g D C). Neither the pivot nor the full external modified-dimension line d_N(M) is dropped. There is an explicit matrix B_cut, with zero diagonal, such that (B_cut)_(a,b)=1/[N(k_a-k_b)], a!=b, [K,B_cut]=e-I/N. (2.1) Consequently, for every C, Phi(C)-p(C)=-Tr(B_cut[K,C]). (2.2) Thus the degree-one row b(X,Z)=-Tr(B_cut X) is an exact cochain homotopy Phi-p=b delta on the Ward complex. In particular the original rank-one cut and the scalar normalized trace agree exactly on Ward-closed matrices. Their common value on I is one. This is the literal unknot normalization, rather than a comparison of two quantities that only have the same norm. The pivot's ordinary trace is still zero; (2.2) does not replace the marked defect D by an ordinary pivotal closure. At the root D^2=0, gD=e and DgD=D, as in [the actual relative source](relative_framing_source_transgression.md). The equality of cut rows is an equality on the Ward complex, with the defect retained. ## 3. The actual closed tangle is Ward closed The prescribed R matrices intertwine the actual coproduct, and the cups and pivotal caps are the explicit Hopf maps already checked in [the duality calculation](relative_pivotal_duality.md). Composing these identities around the closed strands shows that the original (1,1)-tangle endomorphism C commutes with K and F. It therefore lies in ker delta and equals p(C)I by (1.3). This proves the finite scalar/cut conclusion directly from the actual matrices. It also gives an exact target for any proposed framing reduction: a map of actual partial-source complexes into W, with the cut row (2.2) and its homotopy transported, would reduce that framing problem to its scalar Ward class. The global intertwining identity alone does not construct such a map for a partially summed array. A remaining external internal index is not an open-tangle matrix index.
