The resulting closed loop is a Hopf intertwiner: its cups/caps use the standard pivot and every mixed crossing is the actual intertwiner. No division by a quantum dimension enters this statement. On a target highest vector of H weight n, choose the block-braiding order in which the first nilpotent factor acts by target E. It annihilates that vector. In the return crossing any positive target F power cannot contribute to its highest coefficient. Thus only the two full Cartan factors contribute to that coefficient, giving Tr_(A_j)(K_j q^(n H_j)) =sum_(a=0)^(j-1) q^[(n+1)(j-1-2a)] =U_(j-1)((q^(n+1)+q^(-n-1))/2). (2) For a generic pair V_d tensor V_d the explicit highest vectors have weights n=2d,2d-2,...,0. Their descendants have total dimension N^2 and distinct Casimir values. Therefore (2) proves the FULL matrix identity U_(j-1)(Omega/2), not merely its eigenvalues at a root. All mixed R denominators are [h]!, h<=j-1<=N-1, and target factorial frame denominators have indices at most d. They are nonzero at q_N. The matrix identity consequently specializes regularly, including the actual nilpotent/Jordan coefficients at colliding Casimirs. At the root the ACTUAL auxiliary pivot satisfies K_j^(1-N)=(-1)^(j-1)K_j, since every H_j weight has parity j-1. This proves (1) with the literal original pivot and full Cartan normalization. This root specialization is not a claim about generic-q derivatives of the ADO pivotal source, for which K^(1-N) must remain literal. ## 2. The full pair relation and the complete-color circle On the two original complete targets, P_N(Omega)=0, P_N(z)=T_N(z)+2. (3) To check (3) without semisimplification, multiply the N quantum-shifted factors of FEcal=Omega-qK-q^-1K^-1. Their product is F^N Ecal^N=0. The elementary root product evaluates it as T_N(Omega)+K^N+K^-N. For two complete heads K12^N=1, giving (3). The degree-d physical block is the actual irreducible tridiagonal Jacobi matrix with nonzero adjacent entries. Its first coordinate is cyclic, so its minimal polynomial has degree N and is exactly P_N. Equation (1) at j=N is equivalently L_N=(-1)^d T_N'(Omega)/N. (4) It annihilates the highest pair vector |0,0>, and the ACTUAL cup p: L_N|0,0>=0, L_N p=0. (5) For the first identity use its Casimir c_0=q+q^-1 and U_d(c_0/2)=0. The same value holds on p. Alternatively its literal highest trace is q^(d^2)sum_(a=0)^d Q^a=0, retaining the Cartan and pivot. For even N, T_N+2=T_(N/2)^2. Hence (3)--(4) give L_N^2=0. (6) The operator is nonzero on the degree-d block: P_N there has actual double Jordan nodes and (4) has a nonzero first derivative at each. For odd N there is a single simple node -2; all other nodes are double. There is an exact projector P_St onto that simple total Steinberg channel, with L_N^2=N^2 P_St, L_N^3=N L_N^2. (7) The nilpotent part on the double channels is retained in (7). These are full matrix statements, not an odd-level semisimple replacement for the source. The original tame Hermite source plane makes the missing normal information especially concrete. In [its actual normalization](actual_tame_c0_hermite_source_frame.md), (Omega-c_0)t=theta p, theta=(-1)^N rho^2, mp=1, mt=0, ell p=0, ell t=1. At c_0 the derivative in (4) is (-1)^d N/[2sin^2(pi/N)]. Therefore L_N t=2N p. (8) Its coefficient is polynomial, but (8) is a nonzero NORMAL source. An ordinary positive scalar replacing L_N would lose this datum. In particular no all-input local operator S_p can satisfy R12^(2p)=S_p L_N, because the left side is invertible on |0,0> and the right side vanishes there. A scalar at fixed complete crossing-circle color therefore cannot be inverted into every original filling port. This does not say that a complete augmented-link scalar is zero, or that its geometric saddle cannot survive; the original modified source can detect nilpotent channels after the surrounding tangle. ## 3. The complete crossing-circle filling packet The N polynomials L_1,...,L_N have successive degrees0,...,d and nonzero leading coefficients. They are a basis of C[z]/(P_N). The original complete crossing has the already proved ALL-INPUT form R12=kappa r_N(Omega), r_N(c_k)=nu_k=(-1)^k q^[k(k+1)], c_k=q^(2k+1)+q^(-2k-1), r_N'(c_k)/nu_k=-(d-2k)/[2(q^(2k+1)-q^(-2k-1))] (9) at each double node. At the odd simple node only its value is required. The paired node k'=d-k has the same nu, so (9) is well-defined as a Hermite specification. All original first-normal coefficients are part of this formula. For every integer p the [explicit Fourier--Hermite filling kernel](actual_twist_circle_fourier_kernel.md) constructs coefficients a_(p,j) such that R12^(2p)=kappa^(2p) sum_(j=1)^N a_(p,j) L_j, (10) sum_j |a_(p,j)| <= 2N(1+|p|). (11) The kernel interpolates the full Hermite data of r_N^(2p) modulo P_N; it is not an interpolation of repeated eigenvalues without their derivatives. Equation (1) identifies every term of that polynomial kernel with a literal mixed-color crossing circle. Consequently (10) is an original tensor/source identity, not an assumed surgery formula or a semisimple Kirby-color substitution. ## 4. Arbitrary-width original-source filling identity Take any original marked braid/plat diagram with a fixed collection of disjoint, specified two-strand full-twist boxes. Write their powers as R_i^(2p_i), keeping all other signed crossings, turns, pivots and the ORIGINAL marked cut literally. An odd twist box may retain its one original half twist and apply (10) only to the even remainder. At a dual-oriented port transport the actual whole identity by its given rigid duality; no independent auxiliary cut is introduced. Remove the full twists and insert a crossing circle in each box. For colors j_i, let A_N(j_1,...,j_s) be that mixed-color diagram's literal contraction: physical heads still have complete color N, each new circle uses its ordinary auxiliary module and pivot from Section1, and the main modified/marked source is unchanged. Then K_N=chi_N product_i kappa^(2p_i) sum_(j_1,...,j_s) product_i a_(p_i,j_i) A_N(j_1,...,j_s). (12) The displayed chi_N is the ORIGINAL filled-diagram peripheral and framing line. It has not been replaced by a guessed normalization of the augmented diagram. If a separately normalized augmented-link invariant is used, its precise ratio to this literal A_N must first be calculated. No new 1/N or 1/j average is attached to the circles. Proof: tensor (10) with all spectators, substitute it at each box, expand finitely, and apply the unchanged original functional. Each auxiliary trace in (1) is exactly the local box operator. This proves (12) at arbitrary braid width, for either sign of p_i and at every N, with all Casimir normal coefficients retained. For fixed s the coefficient l1 norm is at most product_i 2N(1+|p_i|). (13) It is polynomial for fixed filling slopes, even if they are chosen large; more generally it is exp(o(N)) when sum_i log(1+|p_i|)=o(N). This is a quantified original-source filling map. Taking absolute values in (12) only gives an augmented-family envelope, not the smaller volume of the filled knot. The oscillatory kernel and selected filling saddle still matter. The auxiliary j<N terms in (12) are genuine ordinary modules with their literal traces. One must NOT identify them with closed N-dimensional ADO components at ordinary meridian points merely by the one-component quotient lemma: that lemma does not apply to separate closed crossing-circle components. The finite all-input identity (1) is the comparison used here. ## 5. Consequence for a fully augmented geometric-survival strategy The actual algebraic filling port and its normal data are now explicit. It is possible to pose the survival problem for a fully augmented diagram with arbitrarily many twist regions, using its full original mixed-color packet and (12). This is broader input than a single twist family and does not replace the knot invariant by an AK state. What is NOT proved is that this mixed-color base has a positive original relative cycle with nonzero geometric coefficient, uniformly in the cusp-color corridor required by long filling. The positive constrained-lens reference chart does not establish that source identification. Nor does a fixed-color augmented scalar plus (11) supply it, because (5)--(8) exhibit its lost normal information. Even given such a base, its geometric coefficient must be transported through the actual oscillatory filling kernel, including its boundary and confluent channels. No Stokes constancy or noncancellation theorem is inferred just from the polynomial coefficient cost (13). [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_crossing_circle_source_and_filling.py) constructs mixed universal R matrices with their full half-Cartan, the typed four-crossing loop, original pivotal traces, complete pair Casimirs and actual positive/negative twist matrices. It compares all input columns, nilpotent parities and original source normals.

title: Every actual root braid period has a source-equivalent Euler/Gaussian completion
text: # Every actual root braid period has a source-equivalent Euler/Gaussian completion 27 October 2026. The original checked crossing admits an explicit Euler/Gaussian completion whose error raises the TOTAL INTEGER head degree by N. On b strands all positive multiples-of-N errors form a source-null ideal with bth power zero. Consequently every SIGNED braid word in the completed generators and their literal inverses has exactly the ORIGINAL full one-cut pivotal matrix. This holds at every root and as the whole original meridian family. The bounded nilpotence concerns the error between two realizations, not the full braid action. The completed crossings need not obey the braid relation as matrices. They obey it modulo the proved source-null ideal, and their original closed scalar is exactly the original knot invariant. No quantum factorial model is substituted on asymptotic grounds and no numerical peripheral factor is chosen afterward. The construction uses the existing original root R-matrices and [actual Borel fusion](actual_borel_regular_fusion_and_divided_cap_period.md). It removes a specific finite-support wall for CLOSED braid periods. It does not yet prove their hyperbolic growth, nor preserve arbitrary inserted currents or moving-q normal jets. ## 1. The original positive crossing coefficient in the relative algebra Fix Q=q^2 of exact order N>=2 and write F_a=(Q;Q)_a. The nilpotent balanced heads have F e_a=(1-Q^(a+1))e_(a+1), K e_a=xQ^-a e_a. Let A_0=<H,f | H^N=1,Hf=Q^-1fH,f^N=0> with its usual right idempotents e_k. For two equal colors, the actual triangular fusion is C(f^a e_k)=f_total^a(e_0 tensor e_k). Its physical kernel is C_(u,v;a,k)=x^(u-a) F_a F_v/[F_(a-u)F_k] if 0<=u<=a, v=k+a-u<N; otherwise zero. (1) Retain the ORIGINAL common Cartan scalar kappa=R_(00,00). It can equally be recorded in its prescribed external Hom/normalization line; it is not reset in this calculation. The positive crossing R commutes with the actual diagonal Borel action, so C^-1 R C is RIGHT multiplication by a unique element a_R. That coefficient is exactly a_R=kappa sum_(a,k>=0,a+k<N) (-1)^k Q^(k(k-1)/2) x^(-a-2k) f^a e_k/F_a. (2) Here all a,k lie in 0,...,N-1. Formula (2) is an all-level coefficient identity for the actual R, not its semiclassical symbol. To prove it, apply the word to the algebra unit. Its physical seed is e_0 tensor ones, and the literal original crossing has R(e_0 tensor e_j)=kappa x^-j e_j tensor e_0. For total degree n<N, invert the upper-triangular block (1) on this vector. If its relative coefficients are h_a on f^a e_(n-a), put d_a=F_a h_a/[x^a F_(n-a)]. The equations are sum_(a=u)^n d_a/F_(a-u)=delta_(u,n) x^(-2n). Their reversed sequence is the inverse Euler series: d_a equals x^(-2n) times (-1)^(n-a)Q^((n-a)(n-a-1)/2)/F_(n-a). Undoing the change gives precisely (2), with k=n-a. There is no component of degree n>=N because the physical vector above has none and fusion preserves the total unwrapped degree a+k. ## 2. The completion is a genuine Euler times a marked Gaussian Define U_x(f)=sum_(a=0)^(N-1)x^-a f^a/F_a, D_x(H)=sum_(k=0)^(N-1) (-1)^k Q^(k(k-1)/2)x^(-2k)e_k, a_tilde=kappa U_x(f)D_x(H), R_tilde=C R_(a_tilde) C^-1. (3) The Euler factor has constant term one and nilpotent argument. Every Gaussian entry is nonzero. Thus (3) is an invertible actual finite matrix, with no support projector or division by an unknown period. Its negative crossing is its LITERAL inverse, R_tilde^-1=C R_(kappa^-1 D_x^-1 U_x^-1) C^-1. Right multiplication reverses composition, so the order of these factors is intentional. In (2), a_R is precisely the NONWRAPPED part of (3); the missing terms are f^a e_k with a+k>=N. This formula also has a local unequal-color version. For a checked crossing from colors (x_1,x_2) to (x_2,x_1), use input fusion C_in and output fusion C_out. Then its relative coefficient is a_R=kappa sum_(a+k<N) (-1)^k Q^(k(k-1)/2)x_1^-a(x_1x_2)^-k f^a e_k/F_a, and its completion is obtained by dropping a+k<N, namely kappa U_(x_1)(f)D_(x_1x_2)(H). The same triangular inversion applies, replacing its top right side by (x_1x_2)^-n. The equal-color case already covers every ordinary knot braid. At the complete color x=-q^-1, the right Euler argument in (3) is x^-1 f=Qz for z=xf. Thus this is exactly u_N(Qz), the Euler orientation appearing in the correctly transported primitive source sector of [the whole-word gauge theorem](whole_word_primitive_source_gauge.md). That observation identifies the actual local factor, without equating the full invariant with a single Fourier sector. The finite Gaussian is marked, not a periodically extended scalar Gaussian: its unwrapped entries obey d_(k+N)=-x^(-2N)d_k. For example its exact coefficient-algebra conjugation contains D_x f D_x^-1=-x^-2 fH^-1 +Q^-1 x^-2(1+x^(2N))f e_(N-1). (4) The second term is the original wrap correction. A numerical factor such as its complete value two has not been silently erased. Below we prove which closed-source operations kill its positive weight; outside that algebra (4) must retain the entire factor. ## 3. Every wrapped error raises physical integer degree by N Let D_b=sum_i J_i be the ordinary INTEGER head degree, J_i e_a=a e_a. Fusion preserves this degree: (1) has u+v=a+k as an equality of integers, not modulo N. Consider right multiplication by a wrapped path f^a e_k, a+k>=N. On a basis input f^c e_j it is nonzero only when j=k+a modulo N and c+a<N. Its output is f^(c+a)e_k. Therefore output degree-input degree =(c+a+k)-(c+j)=N. (5) No additional wrap can occur because 0<=a,k<N. Conjugating by C or by the two color versions of C preserves (5). In particular Delta=R_tilde-R raises total integer degree exactly N. The original R and R^-1 preserve integer degree exactly. Locally the two-head degree range is 0,...,2N-2, so Delta R^-1 Delta=0, R_tilde^-1=R^-1-R^-1 Delta R^-1. (6) Thus the negative completion also differs from the original inverse only by an operator of degree +N. The explicit inverse in (6) agrees with the inverse of the Euler/Gaussian factors in (3). ## 4. A level-uniform nilpotent error ideal for every braid index On b heads let F_b be the algebra of operators having only degree changes 0,N,2N,..., and let n_b be the subspace with only strictly positive such changes. It is a two-sided ideal of F_b. Since all physical degrees lie between zero and b(N-1), n_b^b=0. (7) More precisely its power floor(b(N-1)/N)+1 vanishes. The degree-zero projection pi_0 is an algebra homomorphism, with kernel n_b. It splits by embedding the degree-preserving operators themselves. On unit groups its kernel is 1+n_b; every fiber over a prescribed degree-zero unit is a torsor under that unipotent group. Inversion is the finite series in n_b, and [1+n_b^r,1+n_b^s] lies in 1+n_b^(r+s). Hence its nilpotence class is at most b-1, independently of N. This is a bounded error transport, not a nilpotence assertion for the whole actual braid group or its degree-zero semisimple sector. Embed (3) and (6) at every crossing of an arbitrary SIGNED braid word beta. Each completed factor belongs to F_b and has original degree-zero part. Consequently W_tilde(beta)-W(beta) belongs to n_b, (8) pi_0(W_tilde(beta))=W(beta). This includes arbitrarily long words; the nilpotence bound in (7) depends on braid index, not crossing number or level. The completed generators satisfy every actual braid relation MODULO n_b. They need not satisfy the braid relation as matrices: the exact audit finds nonzero positive-weight braid defects. No unrestricted new braided tensor functor is claimed. ## 5. The ORIGINAL full first-cut matrix kills the ideal Use the actual pivotal closure on all heads except the first, with the original diagonal pivots g_i=K_i^(1-N). In a matrix entry from first input a to first output c, every closed head returns to its original index. A term of degree change lN would therefore require c-a=lN. But -(N-1)<=c-a<=N-1. No strictly positive l is possible. Thus the entire original pivotal partial trace vanishes on n_b, entry by entry. Equation (8) proves the ALL-LEVEL, WHOLE-WORD identity ptr_g W_tilde(beta)=ptr_g W(beta). (9) Every original first-input row/column, highest-input source and averaged source is preserved. The full original Cartan lines, writhe/framing scalar and modified dimension d_N(M) multiply the same two matrices, so they remain IDENTICAL without a new normalization. In particular the reduced completed root period at M=1 is exactly the prescribed original Kashaev invariant. The formula holds over the original meridian coefficient field x=-M/q. In the usual rational ADO frame it is an identity of rational meridian families, not only their complete values. It therefore preserves their M-normal germs, all meridian derivatives, all defined orbit values M->q^j M, and the full peripheral rational map/source-lattice product. Any specified root-specialized annihilator of the ORIGINAL meridian period also annihilates the completed period. No assertion of a generic-q annihilator or a new ordering of the classical A-polynomial is needed for this consequence. There is also a matrix meridian-transport statement. If sigma(M)=qM, then wherever the actual braid matrix is invertible define K_j(M)=sigma^j(W(M)) W(M)^-1, K_tilde_j(M)=sigma^j(W_tilde(M)) W_tilde(M)^-1. The original K_j preserves integer degree; the completed one belongs to F_b. Because pi_0 is an algebra homomorphism, commutes with sigma and preserves inverses, pi_0(K_tilde_j)=K_j. (9a) The analogous identities hold for the local crossing transports and for logarithmic M-derivative connections. Thus root meridian matrix transports and their sourced word insertions are preserved in this filtered quotient even if they are not Borel-linear. Pivotal changes and the original scalar dimension/framing ratios are degree preserving and retain their assigned factors. This is not a claim that every chosen internal transfer-ratio coupon is unchanged as an uncontracted tensor; it is an exact two-fiber matrix/source statement about the actual root meridian family. Any additional degree-preserving coupons may be retained anywhere in (8)-(9). This covers unwrapped head clocks and diagonal weights. It does NOT cover arbitrary coupons, Fourier projectors on an opened second wire, or all E/F Ward insertions. There is a literal warning at N=2. With x=i, eta=exp(pi*i/4) and the original full positive crossing, Delta=eta^-1 E_(11,00), Ecal_(0,1)=-2, Lambda_phys[(I tensor Ecal)Delta]=2eta!=0. (10) The inserted lowering degree -1 lets total change N-1 appear in the all-ones first output. Thus (9) is a proved closed-word source equivalence, not an equivalence of every inserted current complex. It must not be promoted to that stronger statement. ## 6. What has moved on the critical path The ORIGINAL root state at arbitrary braid index now has an exact realization using explicit Euler and marked Gaussian factors with no local nonwrapped-path cutoff, modulo a SOURCE-NULL ideal of uniformly bounded nilpotence. This is a genuine extension beyond the fixed-polynomial observable window: it carries completed actual crossing words and their original meridian period exactly. The source no longer has to be guessed for this completion. It is compatible with the earlier [full Borel source-faithfulness theorem](actual_source_two_sided_quotients.md): that theorem permits arbitrary relative coupons, including negative N-degree maps. Here the algebra is restricted to nonnegative physical degree changes, which the completed words genuinely satisfy. What remains is to analyze the full Euler/Gaussian word with its original closure and prove that its selected period carries the marked geometric A-branch and the required regulator norm. No positivity, thimble intersection, geometric survival or global cancellation estimate is inferred from (7). The degree-zero part remains the entire actual braid operator. Bounded nilpotence of the completion error is not a bound for that operator's norm. The theorem is at the actual roots and the whole M family. It does NOT by itself identify moving-q normal jets: off root the actual truncated coproduct has divided-power defects, and the free nilpotent fusion algebra used here needs its own extension. Those quantum-normal terms cannot be discarded by a root identity. The original volume conjecture remains unproved. ## 7. A natural off-root continuation fails the actual quantum normal The restriction to actual root fibers is substantive. At N=2, remove only the common Cartan line from the actual matrices and keep Q,x as independent variables. The specified actual finite crossing and the natural finite-kernel continuation of (3) are R(Q,x)=[[1,0,0,0], [0,0,x^-1,0], [0,x^-1,1-x^-2,0], [0,0,0,Qx^-2]], R_tilde(Q,x)=[[1,0,0,0], [0,0,x^-1,0], [0,x^-1,1-x^-2,0], [-x^-3,0,0,-x^-2]]. (11) At Q=-1 their difference has only degree +2, as proved above. Off root it also has the degree-zero term -(Q+1)x^-2 E_(11,11). On the ORIGINAL three-strand figure-eight word (1,-2,1,-2), use the actual pivot diag(x^-1,Q/x), the literal negative inverses and the highest first-input cut. Exact symbolic multiplication gives C_00(W_tilde-W)=Q(Q+1)(x^2-1)/x^2. (12) Its root Q-normal derivative is [Q partial_Q C_00(W_tilde-W)]_(Q=-1) =(x^2-1)/x^2. (13) At completeness x^2=-1 this equals two. Differentiating along x=-M/q instead gives the same value: the x-derivative of (12) is multiplied by Q+1 and vanishes on the root. The word has writhe zero, so its common positive/negative Cartan lines cancel; the original nonzero peripheral factor multiplies this nonzero normal defect rather than removing it. Thus even an actual knot word distinguishes these two q-normal families. This is a VERIFIED failure of the natural continuation (11), not merely an absence of a proof. It does not preclude constructing a different completed quantum-normal family with its missing divided-power terms retained. It does preclude inferring that family from the root equality (9) alone. ## 8. Independent exact checks [The audit](../experiments/audit_actual_crossing_euler_completion.py) and [saved results](../experiments/actual_crossing_euler_completion_results.json) pass 26 root/meridian/braid-index cases and 88 complete signed words, including the original figure-eight word. They check: * the explicit actual relative R coefficient (2), independently against the original physical crossing; * the Euler/Gaussian factorization and literal negative inverse; * the physical +N weight of local and full-word errors; * equality of the ENTIRE original pivotal first-cut matrix; * original full dimension, Cartan and framing factors; * positive-weight braid defects and their zero source closure. Six additional unequal-color cases check the local Hom formula against the literal original balanced crossing coefficient. The audit separately checks four whole figure-eight two-fiber meridian matrix transports and their entire original first-cut matrices. It also verifies the negative-weight E coupon in (10) and the characteristic-zero q-normal counterexample (11)-(13). There are 74 nonzero full-word errors, so the source equality is not merely equality of the two tensor matrices. The proofs above are all-level. Another agent independently derived (2) and checked the grading, inverse, full-cut argument and the nonzero E coupon. Finite exact checks verify conventions and scope.

title: The actual crossing comparison retains a nontrivial normal insertion
text: # The actual crossing comparison retains a nontrivial normal insertion Research proof, 27 October 2026. The full actual balanced crossing can be compared coefficientwise between the q-normal integral color and the aligned fixed-root meridian color. Away from nonzero sine walls every aligned zero factor differs by an explicit bounded holomorphic unit. The resulting crossing ratio is nonetheless not a diagonal source/cut coboundary. It has a nonconstant finite normal insertion, and the periodic boundary zeros and Frobenius centers give further exact obstructions to a global fixed-fiber comparison. This follows the actual finite formulas in [the common-Verma construction](common_verma_two_wall_source.md), not a replacement quantum dilogarithm. The scalar Gamma comparison in [the whole frame profile](whole_gamma_frame_profile.md) remains valid; it does not by itself intertwine the complete crossing. ## 1. The two actual colors and their full scalar conventions Put c=2pi*i, n=N-1, and choose b in a fixed complex compact set. Set H_0=c/N, H=H_0/(1-b/N), q=exp(H/2), q_0=exp(H_0/2), M=exp(Hb/2)=-q^N, M_0=exp(H_0b/2), x=-M/q, x_0=-M_0/q_0. (1.1) The first head is the genuine integral-color quotient, with highest weight alpha=n. The second head is the actual fixed-root nilpotent color, with marked highest weight alpha_0=n+b. Both have the same shifted interior E zero j=b. Their other boundary conditions differ. The logarithms are fixed by Log x=c/2+H(b-1)/2=Hn/2, Log x_0=c/2+H_0(b-1)/2=H_0(n+b)/2. (1.2) Hence x/x_0=exp[(H-H_0)(b-1)/2], without an unrecorded phase. The common full positive Cartan factor and its negative inverse are C(H,alpha)=exp(H alpha^2/4). For the raw full positive crossing their ratio is exactly C(H,n)/C(H_0,n+b) =exp[(Hn^2-H_0(n+b)^2)/4] ->exp(-cb/4). (1.3) That finite factor is retained. The specified auxiliary twist is theta(H,alpha)=exp[H(alpha^2/4-n alpha/2)], because its stripped version is x^(-n). Thus the positive zero-framing-normalized crossing is x^n R_+^0; the negative one is x^(-n)R_-^0. The ratio of the full Cartan factors divided by their matching twist ratio is precisely (x/x_0)^n=1+O(1/N). No scalar in (1.3) is discarded; its cancellation uses that twist. If the first side is closed with the ordinary integral-color twist and pivot rather than the literal auxiliary ones, the exact route adapter in the divided-color/source notes must be retained as well. The two conventions are not identified by a basis change. ## 2. Literal positive and negative coefficients Write P_H(s)=1-exp(Hs), and let i,j be the incoming indices. For the positive checked crossing the output is (j+k,i-k), with 0<=k<=min(i,n-j). Its actual stripped coefficient is r_+^0(H,b;i,j,k) =(-1)^k x^(-i-j-k) exp{H[ij+(i-j)k-k(k+1)/2]} product_(r=1)^k P_H(j+r)/P_H(r) product_(r=0)^(k-1)P_H(b-i+r). (2.1) For the negative crossing the output is (j-k,i+k), with 0<=k<=min(j,n-i), and r_-^0(H,b;i,j,k) =x^(i+j-k)exp(-Hij) product_(r=1)^k P_H(i+r)/P_H(r) product_(r=0)^(k-1)P_H(b-j+r). (2.2) The Gaussian coefficients in the common-Verma formula are written as finite products here. Their apparent denominators are units at every displayed r<N, or cancel in the original polynomial Gaussian. Full crossings multiply (2.1) by C(H,n), and (2.2) by its inverse, with alpha_0 used on the root side. The original Cartan half-character remains marked. ## 3. An exact holomorphic unit through every aligned zero Let J(z)=2sinh(z/2)/z, J(0)=1, and DeltaH=H-H_0. The elementary ratio has its exact removable form U_N(s)=P_H(s)/P_(H_0)(s) =(H/H_0)exp(DeltaH*s/2)J(Hs)/J(H_0s), U_N(0)=H/H_0. (3.1) It is an explicitly defined unit through the common zero s=0; no division of two zero coefficients is needed. On any fixed strip |Re(s/N)|<=1-delta, with bounded Im s and bounded b, all J arguments avoid their nonzero zeros for sufficiently large N. Both U_N and its inverse are holomorphic and uniformly bounded. Define A_+=ij+(i-j)k-k(k+1)/2-(b-1)(i+j+k)/2, A_-=-ij+(b-1)(i+j-k)/2. The exact continued coefficient ratios are r_+^0(H)=Z_+ r_+^0(H_0), Z_+=exp(DeltaH*A_+) product_(r=1)^k U_N(j+r)/U_N(r) product_(r=0)^(k-1)U_N(b-i+r), r_-^0(H)=Z_- r_-^0(H_0), Z_-=exp(DeltaH*A_-) product_(r=1)^k U_N(i+r)/U_N(r) product_(r=0)^(k-1)U_N(b-j+r). (3.2) These are equalities of holomorphic coefficients even where the shared P_H(b-i+r) or P_H(b-j+r) factor is zero. Under the stated sine-safe strip condition, Z_+ and Z_- and their inverses are bounded uniformly in N. There are O(N) factors, but the logarithm of each U_N factor is O(1/N), not O(1). There is a finite one-index factorial form which makes the potential diagonal pieces visible. Put G_l=product_(r=1)^l U_N(r), L_l=product_(r=1)^l U_N(b-r). Then Z_+=exp(DeltaH*A_+) L_i/L_(i-k) *G_(j+k)/(G_j G_k), Z_-=exp(DeltaH*A_-) L_j/L_(j-k) *G_(i+k)/(G_i G_k). (3.3) The remaining transfer factorial G_k and Gaussian factor belong to the crossing. They are not removed merely by identifying a scalar half-adapter on one color. ## 4. The geometric bulk limit is a finite normal insertion Let u=i/N, v=j/N, t=k/N, and assume a compact sine-safe flow region. For example on the positive crossing take i/N<=1-delta and (j+k)/N<=1-delta; on the negative take j/N<=1-delta and (i+k)/N<=1-delta. Aligned zeros at the origin remain allowed by (3.1). Define the holomorphic removable function h(y)=cy exp(cy)/(exp(cy)-1), h(0)=1. (4.1) Uniformly on such regions and compact b-sets, Log Z_+=b I_+(u,v,t)+O(1/N), I_+=c[uv+(u-v)t-t^2/2] +integral_0^t[h(v+x)-h(x)+h(-u+x)]dx, Log Z_-=b I_-(u,v,t)+O(1/N), I_-=-cuv +integral_0^t[h(u+x)-h(x)+h(-v+x)]dx. (4.2) The logarithms are the ones furnished by (3.1)--(3.2), rather than arbitrary logarithms of the final coefficient. They remain defined through the aligned coefficient zeros. The auxiliary zero-framing scalar ratio is 1+O(1/N), so has the same bulk limit. The raw full Cartan factor adds the explicitly specified term -cb/4 positively, +cb/4 negatively. Proof: DeltaH=cb/N^2+O(N^-3). On the relevant strips, Taylor expansion of (3.1) gives Log U_N(Ny+O(1))=(b/N)h(y)+O(N^-2). (4.3) The expression is uniform at y=0 by the removable formula. Riemann summation in (3.2), followed by the elementary quadratic limits A_+/N^2 and A_-/N^2, proves (4.2). Thus the ratio is an O(1) normal transport insertion. It does not alter the common N-leading local action. There is an action interpretation with all branches retained. If the actual leading local coefficient is exp(S(x,y,z)/H), with x=Hi,y=Hj,z=Hk, differentiation at fixed integer indices gives precisely b I=(b/c)[-S+xS_x+yS_y+zS_z]. (4.4) Equivalently I=c partial_s[S(su,sv,st)/s]_(s=c). The constant/linear lift terms are the ones of the actual coefficient, not freely chosen phases. Passing from this local identity to a closed stationary network requires its original cut, pivots, twists and source: their Euler terms must be included. It does not by itself select a finite geometric cycle. ## 5. A diagonal Gamma or cut coboundary cannot remove the insertion There is an exact test independent of asymptotics. At k=0,i=j the positive checked crossing has the diagonal entry (i,i)->(i,i). Its continued auxiliary-normalized ratio is exp{DeltaH[i^2-(b-1)i+n(b-1)/2]}. (5.1) Every diagonal similarity leaves every such diagonal entry unchanged. Multiplying by an external scalar cannot fix the problem: for two different i values their ratio is exp{DeltaH(i_1-i_2)(i_1+i_2-b+1)}, (5.2) which is generically nontrivial. At distinct bulk values u_1,u_2, it tends exp[cb(u_1^2-u_2^2)]. This applies to arbitrary diagonal leg or pair gauges, including the retained Gamma/frame factors. Therefore a comparison of this same-fiber type is not a pure diagonal/cut coboundary. A non-diagonal or base/normal/Fock transport is not ruled out by this test; it must account for the actual surviving insertion. Separate spectral multiplicity tests can obstruct even a non-diagonal fixed-fiber similarity. ## 6. Periodic boundary zeros and the Frobenius center also differ The bounded-unit statement cannot be extended over nonzero sine walls. Take b=-1, H=c/(N+1), and the positive entry i=n,j=0,k=1. At the fixed root its Pochhammer factor is P_(H_0)(b-i)=P_(H_0)(-N)=0. On the integral-color side the corresponding factor is 1-exp[-cN/(N+1)]!=0; all its other factors are units. Hence the root coefficient vanishes while the moving-q coefficient does not. These are periodic root aliases, not the aligned s=0 zero treated by (3.1). On this same example Ecal has different ranks on the two heads, so no regular color-module intertwiner can identify them. This does not say that their selected knot scalars disagree; ordinary-color subquotients can kill the extra directions. There is also a generic root-central-power residual. Let gamma=(-1)^(N-1). On the moving-q head, (K_H^N)_i=gamma exp[Hb(n/2-i)], whereas on the fixed-root meridian head, K_0^N=gamma exp(cb/2) I. (6.1) Their eigenvalue ratio is exactly exp[Hb((b-1)/2-i)] -> exp(-cbu). (6.2) Thus the moving-q central power retains the bulk clock and is not a scalar Frobenius character on that normal family. An extension must transport this center/base or a genuine normal source sector; the scalar Gamma half-line is not the whole module. The moving-q power K_H^N is not asserted central away from the root; it is the continuation of the root-central generator whose non-scalar operator is being compared. ## 7. Meaning of the result Equations (2.1)--(3.3) are finite whole-source formulas with aligned zero divisors and full scalar conventions. Equation (4.2) gives their uniform bulk insertion. Equations (5.1)--(6.2) show concretely what remains after scalar/frame normalization. The result holds for every allowed crossing, independent of which knot braid later composes it. The whole-knot Euler cancellation and its geometric normal action are proved with the actual closure and source adapter in [the closed bulk-response theorem](quantum_normal_crossing_bulk_response.md). Its marked geometric transverse block has multiplier exp(-a S_geo/c), with the preferred regulator action and all original base factors retained. This is a formal calculation on the marked geometric branch, not a proof that the original finite cycle has that branch coefficient. The [full-head Gamma source transport](full_head_gamma_source_transport.md) also repairs the naive upper-half scalar source by its actual Weyl complement. It does not remove the crossing periodic-wall example or the Frobenius clock residual in Section 6. Thus the entry comparison still does not control those sectors or the selected trace norm. Those are precisely the sectors lost by treating an interior bounded unit as a global quantum-source isomorphism. The independent [whole checked-crossing spectrum calculation](crossing_normal_spectra_obstruction.md) strengthens the fixed-fiber obstruction: its generic channel multiplicities differ for every N, excluding even a nondiagonal similarity up to a scalar. This leaves relative source and base transport open rather than identifying the two full crossings. The [exact audit](../experiments/audit_actual_crossing_q_normal_meridian_ratio.py) checks both finite ratios, aligned zeros, full Cartan/twist cancellation, diagonal obstruction, periodic-wall rank example, central powers and the uniform bulk normal insertion.

title: The complete crossing Green source has explicit ground and carry endpoints
text: # The complete crossing Green source has explicit ground and carry endpoints 28 October 2026. The exact two-Newton/one-Rogers crossing layer gives a coupled source equation normal to its geometric holonomy. After the ORIGINAL physical finite boundary restrictions, its entire right side is explicit: a ground-output block, a ground-input block, and one rank-one carry on pair degree N. Its ORIGINAL cup/marked-cap value is the nonzero known number (Q(N-1)-1)/N, with the same external Cartan line retained. This is an inhomogeneous source theorem, not a claim that the currents vanish. It also computes the exact shared full-Psi face fusion and the remaining one-function Fourier kernel. The original relative Fourier cycle is not replaced by a standard real contour. Subsequent constructive resolution of the LOCAL comparison: [the balanced finite Fourier kernel](actual_balanced_fourier_crossing_kernel.md) uses an adaptive internal Fermat orbit and independent external finite frames. All three source norms then vanish on that actual sampling map, and an ORIGINAL E-current proves its four-full-Psi kernel is EXACTLY the original crossing operator. Its uniform local density is nonzero and polynomial. The global sewn source and geometric noncancellation remain separate. ## 1. The actual positive crossing and paired Ward source Use the [proved physical crossing layer](actual_trivalent_layer_crossing_source.md). Let z_0,z_1 be the original inputs, z_6,z_7 the outputs, and t its remaining internal variable. Put u=t/z_1, v=x^(-1)t/z_0, f=x^(-1)z_7/z_6, r=z_6/z_0, w=x^(-1)z_6/t, B_0(t)=B_N(u,v), F(w)=B_N(f,fw)R_N(r,w). Then the original normalized positive core is the physical finite block of CT_t B_0F, with its final original Hardy barrier. Its common kappa, writhe/peripheral line and original source are unchanged. All statements below are at the original fixed Q root for the whole nonzero color x family unless completeness is explicitly specified. Define the exact central sources D_0=1-u^N+v^N, D_B=1-f^N+f^Nw^N, D_R=1-r^N-w^N. The finite Newton and Rogers recurrences give the FULL paired Ward F(w)-fr F(Qw)=H_pair(w), H_pair=D_B R_N(r,w)+f D_R B_N(f,Qfw). (1) This is a polynomial identity, with every source endpoint retained. In particular D_B+f^N D_R=1-(fr)^N is a boundary norm identity, not a reason to discard both currents. ## 2. A source Green equation for the complete crossing Multiply (1) by v B_0(t), integrate the COMPLETE polynomial CT, and reindex t->Qt in its shifted term. The simultaneous-Q source recurrence is v B_0(Qt)=(u-1)B_0(t)+D_0. Because v(Qt)=Qv(t), the result is exactly CT_t[(v-Qfr(u-1))B_0F] =CT_t[v B_0 H_pair]+Qfr CT_t[D_0F]. (2) The original q factor in the reindexing is compulsory. Its left coefficient is the bounded-degree LINEAR polynomial v-Qfr(u-1)=x^(-1)/z_0 [t(1-Qz_7/z_1)+Qz_7]. (3) At Q=1 its zero is precisely the regular stationary gluing equation of the all-homogeneous Fourier kernel in Section 5. Thus (2) is an actual sourced quantum normal equation, without localizing a nilpotent face or dividing by an unknown period. Equation (2) holds before restricting any boundary coefficient. Apply the SAME original finite input/output boundary blocks to both sides. Below L denotes this physical block of its left side. This restriction is important for boundary monomials which can shift a physical output past its original top; it is not an additional reset inserted into one separated source sector. ## 3. Exact finite endpoint filtration Write d=N-1, F_a=(Q;Q)_a and p_j=(-1)^jQ^(j(j-1)/2)/F_j. On original input |a,b>, 0<=a,b<N, the physical form of (2) is L=G_out+G_top+G_in. (4) The ground-SECOND-INPUT term is particularly simple: G_in|a,b>=delta_(b,0) Q sum_(e=1)^a x^(-e)|a-e,e>. (5) It has rank N-1. To prove it, the two nonconstant terms of D_0 demand an incoming index at least N, and vanish on the ORIGINAL finite inputs. The constant term gives CT F=K_N(f)K_N(r). Multiplication by Qfr and the actual finite boundary block yields exactly (5). In particular the D_0F term is NOT zero. The ground-SECOND-OUTPUT block has rank at most N-1: G_out|a,b>=0 unless a>=1 and a+b<N, G_out|a,b>=x^(-b-2) F_(a+b)/F_b *sum_(j=0)^(a-1) p_j x^(-2j)/[F_(a-j-1)(1-Q^(b+j+1))] *|a+b,0>. (6) All denominators in (6) are ORIGINAL nonzero factorial units: b+j+1<=a+b<N. No singular determinant is inverted. The remaining term is one rank-one carry on pair degree N: G_top|a,b>=0 unless b=N-a, 1<=a<N, G_top|a,N-a>=-x^(-N-a) F_d/F_(N-a) p_(a-1) *sum_(e=1)^d x^(-e)|N-e,e>. (7) The rank is one because the output vector in (7) is fixed and nonzero. It is not a rank-one assertion about the whole Green operator or about an arbitrary crossing. Here is a direct proof of the filtration. In the first term vB_0 D_B R of the right side of (2), the -f^N summand has negative first output, and the (fw)^N summand has second output at least N. The original barriers remove both. Its constant summand has second output zero; coefficient expansion gives (6). In the second term vfB_0 D_R B(f,Qfw), the constant summand has negative first output, and -r^N demands first input at least N. The -w^N term survives only when the B_0 total order is EXACTLY d and the V-index of B(f,Qfw) is zero. The resulting inputs and outputs have total degree N; their coefficient is precisely (7). This also explains why multiplying a primitive ground-cell Ward by a monomial may expose an additional top carry. One must apply the physical barriers AFTER the specified weighting, not beforehand. ## 4. The ORIGINAL complete cap detects a known nonzero boundary At completeness x=-q^(-1), Qx^2=1. Keep exactly p=N sum_(a=0)^d x^(a-d)|a,d-a>, m|c,e>=x^e/N^2, mp=1. Then m G_in p=Qd/N, m G_top p=0, m G_out p=-1/N, m Lp=(Qd-1)/N!=0. (8) The first equality follows immediately from the one surviving input |d,0> in (5). The second follows because the original cup has total degree d, while (7) requires degree N. For the third, reorganize the finite coefficient sum in (6) by k=b+j+1. Its inner coefficient is sum_(b+j=k-1) p_j/F_b=delta_(k,1), the exact inverse Euler identity U(t)V(t)=1 modulo t^N. Thus for the same literal vectors at general x this pairing is -Q^(-1)x^(-2)/N; completeness makes it -1/N. This proves (8) by finite algebra at EVERY level. The original unstripped crossing carries its SAME external kappa multiplying this source value; it has not been reset. Equation (8) is a concrete boundary normalization of the actual Green source. It cannot be replaced by an assertion that every endpoint/current vanishes. It is also not a global knot lower bound. Transporting the nonintertwining ground/carry coupons through an arbitrary exterior needs their actual Ward/source equations; bare cut relocation or Schur scalarity does not justify that step. ## 5. Shared full-Psi face fusion, with its norm intact Use the exact, SOURCE-selected Newton and Rogers blocks: S_B(u,v)=(N/phi_N)u^N Psi_+(h-Logu)Psi_+(Log(v/u)) exp[-Log(v/u)Logu/h], T_R(r,w)=phi_N Psi_-(Logr-h)Psi_-(Logw-h) exp[-Logr Logw/h]. The latter is the proved [opposite-root Rogers source](actual_rogers_sink_opposite_beta_source.md). It is NOT obtained by substituting the balanced norm r^Nw^N off its balancing divisor. Its equivalent plus-oriented form contains (1-r^N)(1-w^N). Put A=Logz_0, B=Logz_1, C=Logz_6, D=Logz_7, X=Logx, tau=Logt, beta=B-A-X, f_log=D-C-X, rho=C-A, sigma=C-tau-X, l_u=tau-B. The shared face sewing is EXACTLY Psi_-(sigma-h)Psi_+(sigma)=1-exp(Nsigma), (9) not one. Therefore the complete all-homogeneous product is S_B(u,v)T_R(r,w)S_B(f,fw) =(N^2/phi_N)(uf)^N(1-r^N)(1-w^N) *Psi_+(h-l_u)Psi_+(beta)Psi_+(h-f_log)/Psi_+(rho) *exp[-(beta*l_u+sigma*(f_log+rho))/h]. (10) All four remaining full functions and both central norm factors are explicit. Since f_log+rho=D-A-X, its internal tau dependence separates as boundary_constant *(1-(x^(-1)z_6/t)^N) *Psi_+(h+B-tau) *exp[(D-B+2pi*i)tau/h]. (11) The boundary constant, including phase, is (N^2/phi_N)exp[N(f_log-B)](1-r^N) *Psi_+(beta)Psi_+(h-f_log)/Psi_+(rho) *exp{[beta*B-(C-X)(f_log+rho)]/h}. In particular the affine 2pi*i*tau term from u^N is retained. The remaining integral is a one-full-Phi Fourier FUNCTIONAL with a two-term central source; it is not a bare transform. The principal growth chambers of the two original local factors on this face have opposite signs. Their exact sewing (9) must be done before choosing their joint symbol or discarding a central factor. Separate local norm-gap theorems cannot be simultaneously asserted on this shared face. ## 6. A reference Fourier evaluation and the missing cycle equation For comparison only, the independently proved full-Phi Fourier formula gives the specified real/shifted Fourier functional F_ref(lambda)=1/(2pi*i)integral_GammaF Psi_+(z)exp(-lambda*z/h)dz =zeta_0/(i sqrt(N)) *exp[i sqrt(N)lambda c_b-iNlambda^2/(4pi)] *Psi_+(lambda+2pi*i+h), c_b=i(sqrt(N)+1/sqrt(N))/2, zeta_0=exp[pi*i(1-4c_b^2)/12]. (12) Initially take Im lambda<0 and the common convergent contour from the [independent Fourier proof](faddeev_pentagon_audit.md). Elsewhere (12) means its recorded meromorphic continuation. It retains the exact scalar and the full-function norm. Its dual step is F_ref(lambda-2pi*i) =(1-exp(-Nlambda))F_ref(lambda). (13) For the field (11), set z=h+B-tau, lambda=D-B+2pi*i and K=exp[N(C-X-B)]. Its source is the combination F(lambda)-K F(lambda-2pi*i), up to the explicit orientation and boundary exponential from that change of variable. On the REFERENCE Fourier chain this would give multiplier 1-K+K exp(-Nlambda) =1-(x^(-1)z_6/z_1)^N+(x^(-1)z_6/z_7)^N. (14) Neither this multiplier nor the one in (9) is silently set to one. Formula (14) is a genuine reference-chain evaluation, not an evaluation of the original Cauchy source. The remaining cycle distinction is exact. Under tau->tau+2pi*i, the field in (11) has multiplier (z_7/z_1)^N[1-(z_1/t)^N], (15) which depends on t. Its original lifted head-circle edge therefore does NOT close as an independent all-homogeneous period. The accompanying source currents restore the original single-valued finite crossing. Identifying this full relative functional with the reference chain in (12) requires precisely those current transports. Even its affine lambda mark often lies outside the initial Fourier convergence chamber; deleting the 2pi*i shift to reach that chamber would change the source. ## 7. What is now available for global composition The complete crossing has an actual sourced normal equation (2)--(3), with every physical endpoint and its nonzero original cap normalization known in (4)--(8). This is stronger than an unidentified right side of a transport equation. Its source terms are restricted ground cells and one degree-N carry. Their subsequent global transport may be studied with the original finite-head source and its Ward rules. One cannot simply remove these terms or declare them smaller: they have nonzero original source values, and current deck transport can contain the same geometric block. A proof of global endpoint induction, or an exact relative Fourier comparison retaining them, remains required. No global volume lower bound follows from the reference Fourier formula alone. The [audit](../experiments/audit_actual_crossing_shared_face_fourier_source.py) checks ten complete polynomial Ward/Green identities, fourteen physical color/level endpoint filtrations, the original complete cup/full marker, original full-pivot word insertions, three exact shared-face full-function fusions and the reference Fourier dual step. It keeps the physical barriers AFTER the weighted currents. ## 8. The top carry is a controlled idempotent and a normal Ward source At completeness the coefficient of (7) simplifies completely: F_d/F_(N-a) *p_(a-1)=Q^(1-a). This is ordinary root-factorial reflection. Put w=sum_(e=1)^d x^(-e)|N-e,e>. Since Qx^2=1, equation (7) becomes G_top=-Q w w^t=Q E, E=-w w^t, w^t w=-1, E^2=E. (16) The transpose here is BILINEAR, not a Hermitian adjoint. Indeed sum_(e=1)^d x^(-2e)=sum_(e=1)^d Q^e=-1. Thus the carry is not a nilpotent error. Its normalized rank-one projector has operator norm N-1 in the original Euclidean metric, since ||w||^2=N-1 and its row has the same norm. It is polynomially controlled without selecting an exponentially conditioned full flag basis. There is also an exact algebra for repeated carry contractions. Let P_* be the one-head projection onto indices 1,...,d, and let W be the coefficient matrix of w. Then W^2=x^(-N)P_*, x^(-2N)=1, E_12 E_23 E_12=E tensor P_*, E_23 E_12 E_23=P_* tensor E. (17) To verify the first identity, W has its sole entry in row a at column N-a, equal to x^(a-N); the two opposite entries multiply to x^(-N). Expanding three rank-one contractions uses W^2 twice and gives the other two identities. Disjoint E_i commute. Hence on all nonzero heads these are idempotent Temperley--Lieb relations. Globally the ground projections P_* in (17) must remain; no quotient of the original source or preservation by R is inferred. In particular this small endpoint algebra does not prove that an arbitrary interleaved braid word is polynomially bounded. The carry VECTOR also has an actual meridian-normal Ward description. Retain the original balanced coproduct F_tot=F_1+K_1^(-1)F_2, K_1=x Z_1^(-1), D_M=x partial_x at fixed physical Q. Direct application to the original complete p gives (D_M F_tot)p=N(1-Z_1)w. (18) Only the K_1^(-1)F_2 term differentiates. Its output |a,N-a>, 1<=a<N, has coefficient N x^(a-N)(1-Q^a), proving (18) entrywise. On this degree-N subspace every first index is nonzero, so 1-Z_1 IS a unit there. Thus w=N^(-1)(1-Z_1)^(-1)(D_M F_tot)p is a valid restricted identity. It does not invert the singular operator 1-Z_1 on the entire finite module. Nor does it replace a full normal co-source by this one operator-normal insertion. It identifies the carry line which the global endpoint/current transport must retain. These relations give an explicit finite endpoint calculus: ground heads, a rank-one degree-N projector and its actual normal Ward source. Sliding them through other crossings still requires the original coproduct/current equations; the relations alone supply no global geometric lower bound. ## 9. Exact flat-metric norm of the COMPLETE Green source At completeness, the ground-output coefficient (6) is just a unit phase: G_out|a,b>=x^(-b-2)|a+b,0>, a>=1, a+b<N. (19) This is a simplification of the FULL weighted endpoint, not of the unweighted ground cell of the primitive clock Ward. To prove it, use the partial-fraction identity 1/(z;Q)_a=sum_(j=0)^(a-1) (-1)^j Q^(j(j+1)/2) /[F_j F_(a-1-j)(1-zQ^j)]. (20) The residues at each of the a simple poles agree; both sides vanish at infinity, proving (20) without an asymptotic step. Set z=Q^(b+1). Since x^(-2)=Q, the sum in (6) is F_b/F_(a+b), which proves (19). No denominator vanishes: b+a<N. The support filtration in Section 3 is unchanged; there is no additional ground block. Use the original orthonormal finite-head basis and let d=N-1. Equations (5), (16), and (19) imply ||G_in||=||G_out||=sqrt(d), ||G_top||=d, ||L||=max[d,sqrt(d+sqrt(d))] =d for N>=3, and sqrt(2) for N=2. (21) Here the norm is the actual operator norm, not a norm after an exponentially conditioned gauge. To see sharpness, fix total degree t with 1<=t<N and write |b>=|t-b,b>. The complete lower-degree block is L_t=Q[|0>r_t^t+u_t<0|], (r_t)_b=x^(-b) for 0<=b<t, (r_t)_t=0, (u_t)_0=0, (u_t)_e=x^(-e) for 1<=e<=t. The two displayed output ranges are orthogonal. Therefore L_t^*L_t=conjugate(r_t) r_t^t+t|0><0|. Its possibly nonzero eigenvalues are t+sqrt(t), t-sqrt(t), since ||r_t||^2=t and |(r_t)_0|=1. The degree-N block is Q E; all other degree blocks vanish. This proves (21) including the small-level exception. The unstripped crossing retains the SAME external kappa, of modulus one at completeness. Thus the actual normal Green source of a crossing is only linearly large in N in the original metric, even though its individual unweighted clock ground kernel may be exponentially large. In a tensor word this gives an explicit local defect bound. Controlling its contraction through arbitrary exterior crossings still requires that exterior; (21) alone gives no global scalar lower bound or cancellation theorem. ## 10. The carry is fixed by its SAME original crossing Let B=R_+/kappa=C D U_+ C^(-1) at completeness. The vector w in Section 8 obeys the exact two-sided identities B w=w, w^t B=w^t, B E=E B=E. (22) Consequently the same holds for B^(-1). The original R_+ has eigenvalue kappa on this line, and R_- has kappa^(-1). These are identities in the ORIGINAL physical finite heads; no arbitrary cut relocation is asserted. Here is an all-level proof directly from the actual fusion. On total degree N its coefficient is C_(u,v;a,b)=x^(u-a) F_a F_v/[F_(a-u)F_b], u<=a, v=b+a-u. Hence, with b=N-a, the component of w^t C is x^(-b) F_a sum_(h=0)^(a-1) Q^h [b+h choose h]_Q =x^(-b)F_a [N choose a-1]_Q. It is zero unless a=1. The surviving row is x^(-d)F_1<1,d|. This row is fixed by D U_+: D_d=1 and only transfer order zero can reach its output from this finite total-degree sector. This proves the left equality. For the right equality, the original inverse-fusion Euler convolution gives z=C^(-1)w with z_(N-v,v)=-x^(-v)(-1)^v Q^(v(v-1)/2)/F_(N-v), 1<=v<N. Indeed its convolution is the full inverse-Euler coefficient zero minus its missing final term. Put m=N-v. Applying D U_+ to this vector multiplies its common output prefactor by D_v sum_(h=0)^(m-1) (-1)^h Q^(h(h-1)/2+(v+1)h)/[F_h F_(m-h)]. The sum extended through h=m is (Q^(v+1);Q)_m/F_m=0. Subtract its last term and use D_v=(-1)^v Q^(v(v+1)/2); the displayed factor is 1/F_m, because -(-1)^N Q^(N(N+1)/2)=1 for every N, including even N. Thus D U_+z=z. Together with the left identity and E=-ww^t, this proves (22). Equation (22) is compatible with (17), but it does not say that an adjacent crossing preserves the carry sector. Transport through neighboring heads remains a separate question with the ground projections retained. ## 11. An exact resonant Fourier source, including its closure current The remaining one-function field admits an exact finite-orbit comparison with (12), with no undetermined central scalar. Write h=2pi*i/N, retain the previously fixed phi_N, and put zeta=exp[-pi*i*(1+2c_b^2)/6], zeta_0=exp[pi*i*(1-4c_b^2)/12], A=exp(N lambda)(1-exp(Nz)), D=1-A. On the same logarithmic cover define the FINITE source T_N(z,lambda)=sum_(j=0)^d Psi_+(z-hj) exp(lambda*j). (23) Its exact original source decomposition is T_N=H_N(z,lambda) F_ref(lambda) +Psi_+(z) D I_-(exp lambda, exp(lambda+z-h)), H_N=i sqrt(N) phi_N zeta_0 *(exp(Nlambda)-1)(1-exp(Nz)) *exp[(N+z/h)lambda]. (24) Here I_- is precisely the conjugate opposite-root Newton Barnes current of the [Rogers source theorem](actual_rogers_sink_opposite_beta_source.md#3-carry-the-opposite-root-contour-and-the-full-norm), with its inherited DOWNWARD orientation and its continued logarithmic marks. Equation (24) is a meromorphic identity; at a collision it means the SAME continued combined source. Neither lambda nor z is reduced modulo 2pi*i. To prove (24), use the full-function shift exactly j times: Psi_+(z-hj)exp(lambda*j) =Psi_+(z) product_(k=0)^(j-1) [exp lambda-Q^(-k)exp(lambda+z-h)]. Thus (23) equals Psi_+(z) B_(Q^(-1))(exp lambda, exp(lambda+z-h)). (25) Apply the independently proved opposite-root Newton source, including its exact normalizer N/phi_-=phi_N. Its homogeneous term is phi_N exp(Nlambda)(1-exp(Nz)) *Psi_-(-h-lambda) exp[(z-h)lambda/h]. The compulsory sewing factor 1-exp(Nz) follows from Psi_+(z)Psi_-(z-h)=1-exp(Nz). Finally full inversion gives Psi_-(-h-lambda) =(1-exp(-Nlambda)) zeta^(-1) exp[-pi*i*(sqrt(N)lambda/(2pi)+c_b)^2] *Psi_+(lambda+2pi*i+h). Substitute (12) and zeta_0^2 zeta exp(pi*i*c_b^2)=1. This is exactly (24), including its affine exponential, phase, and two norm factors. In the actual field (11), take tau_j=tau_0+hj, z=h+B-tau_0, lambda=D-B+2pi*i. Its extra factor 1-exp[N(C-X-tau_j)] is constant on this finite orbit and is retained outside (23). The scalar A in (24) is EXACTLY the full-turn multiplier in (15). Consequently the remaining Barnes current is multiplied by the precise closure defect 1-A of the actual field. This is a computed source, not a normalization imposed on it. On the balanced divisor A=1, that current vanishes and T_N=H_N F_ref exactly. On its regular finite part H_N is nonzero: 1-exp(Nz)=exp(-Nlambda), and exp(Nlambda)-1 cannot vanish there. This proves a normalized, nonzero resonant reference coefficient on THAT divisor. The original whole source has NOT been shown to be supported on A=1. Off it the current remains compulsory and may contain the same continued homogeneous block. ### Why this finite orbit is compatible with the original source There is a separate exact finite-source fact, before any homogeneous/current split. The COMPLETE raw positive kernel K(t)=B_0(t)F(t) is a Laurent polynomial with exponents in [-2d,d]. For any fixed nonzero scalar t_0, (1/N)sum_(j=0)^d K(t_0 Q^j) =CT_t K+t_0^(-N)[t^(-N)]K. (26) There is only one alias, since 2d<2N and d<N. The sampling point may also depend on degree-zero auxiliary parameters, including the retained Gaussian variables. It must not carry nonzero total head degree; otherwise its power in (26) would change the grading argument below. For a monomial indexed by the actual nonnegative atom orders, minus its t exponent is the output total head degree minus the input total head degree. Thus the alias in (26), after the ORIGINAL finite head restrictions, raises integer degree by N. For the negative crossing the same statement follows from its exact two-Newton/Rogers layer, with its ONE shared continuous Gaussian retained; the Gaussian changes coefficients and not these degrees. Replace ANY collection of complete internal CTs in any original signed word by (26). Each resulting error raises total degree by a positive multiple of N; all original crossings preserve total degree. In the ORIGINAL one-cut pointed trace every traced head has identical input/output index. The remaining cut index would have to increase by at least N, impossible for indices 0,...,d. For the ORIGINAL k-pair pointed plat, the cups have total degree k d and its k-1 ordinary caps require (k-1)d. The marked pair would therefore have degree at least d+N=2N-1>2d, impossible for its two finite heads. This uses the actual marked row, not an assertion that this row is itself fixed-degree: it has coefficients x^e/N^2 on all |c,e>. Thus every nonempty alias selection vanishes. Hence this finite root-orbit replacement preserves the entire original whole source for arbitrary word length and bridge count. It also preserves its original scalar normalization. It is not asserted for arbitrary degree-lowering coupons. This is a source-level circle-to-finite-orbit map. One may apply (24) to its all-homogeneous summand, while retaining EVERY other B/R current sector with the SAME logarithmic marks. Neither (26)'s alias deletion nor its degree proof can be reapplied separately to a meromorphic S/I sector, whose Fourier support is different. Thus (24)--(26) do not yet identify the WHOLE original Fourier functional with the bare reference chain plus a polynomially bounded endpoint operator. The missing bound concerns the joint continued B/R currents, not the exact coefficient H_N. This last limitation concerns the INTERNAL-orbit map alone. The subsequent [balanced external Fourier theorem](actual_balanced_fourier_crossing_kernel.md) supplies an additional source-preserving polarization that makes all three original norms vanish together. Its exact current rigidity eliminates the remaining physical alias errors. That result resolves the local operator comparison, while retaining every finite adapter and the original global co-source.

title: A positive original cube packet with all four rung colors retained
text: # A positive original cube packet with all four rung colors retained 29 October 2026. Fix the EIGHT cycle channels of the original ordered cube to the odd Steinberg channel, while retaining EVERY physical complete-circle channel on its FOUR rungs. The original exposed marked source has an explicit positive Newton contraction. This includes all paired nilpotents, gives its exact global support, controls the entire four-color sum by the central term at polynomial cost, and proves a strict gap for macroscopic rung-color deficits. This is a specified sector of the original cube source, with its eight cycle projections still present. The remaining eight color sums and even levels are not evaluated. No conclusion about the full cube invariant or arbitrary cubic graphs is inferred. ## 1. The exact marked packet Keep N=2m+1>=3, d=2m, q=exp(pi i/N), the literal ordered cube and its EXPOSED marked white vertex from the [central cube theorem](actual_odd_central_cube_reflection_packet.md). Its two cycles have edge orders top (0,11,3,2), bottom (9,5,6,8), rungs (1,10,4,7). Every cycle edge has label m. The four rung labels j_0,...,j_3 vary independently over 0,...,m. For j<=m put k_j=2 if j<m, k_m=1, z_j(v)=s_(j+v)/[s_(j-v)s_v^2], 0<=v<=j, h_j=sum_(v=0)^j z_j(v) Bhat_v, P_(N,j)=sum_(v=0)^j z_j(v) beta(m,v)^2, S_N=P_(N,m), omega_j=kappa(-1)^j q^[j(j+1)], kappa=q^(d^2/2). Here the Newton basis and functional are the FULL root algebra, not the distinct-node quotient. In particular h_m is the genuine turned isolated projector from the central cube theorem. The actual complete circle sector L_j, paired or simple, obeys Rturn L_j=N k_j h_j. (1) Let Z_jvec denote the RAW original marked cube source with these twelve specified labels and no edge twists. Then Z_jvec=N^12 product_(r=0)^3[k_(j_r)P_(N,j_r)^2] phi(h_(j_0)h_(j_1)h_(j_2)h_(j_3)). (2) All factors and the functional in (2) are the actual ones. For any fixed signed edge exponents multiply (2) by exactly omega_m^(sum_cycle e_l) product_r omega_(j_r)^(e_(rung r)). (3) Thus a twisted individual label sector has a specified unit phase; a sum of differently phased rung sectors is not declared positive. The finite support of the untwisted source is particularly simple: Z_jvec>0 iff j_0+j_1+j_2+j_3>=d; Z_jvec=0 otherwise. (4) Every LOCAL vertex already has total label 2m+j>=d. The additional constraint (4) is a genuine global contraction constraint; it cannot be deduced by keeping only the local black scalar supports. ## 2. The full normal sector turns to a positive polynomial Let E_j be the FULL Hermite projector of the pair Casimir cluster c_j; L_j=L_N E_j. At a double node it retains the actual nilpotent circle normal. The complete Frobenius trace identity gives phi(L_j f)=N Tr(E_j m_f)=N k_j f(c_j). (5) It follows from the complete polynomial identity for L_N and the trace of multiplication; the trace in the j cluster has its actual algebraic multiplicity k_j. No spectral derivative has been removed from L_j before this identity is used. The Newton turn and pairing then give the v-th coefficient of Rturn L_j as phi(L_j Bhat_v)=N k_j Bhat_v(c_j). Direct paired-sine factorization gives Bhat_v(c_j)=z_j(v) for v<=j, and zero for v>j. This proves (1) as a FULL algebra identity. Its polynomial degree is j, and hence it also specifies its first normal at every other double node. The paired nilpotent has become an ordinary low-degree turned polynomial by the actual nonmultiplicative turn, not by treating it as a positive projector. ## 3. Use the actual physical source's cyclicity For the finite generic derivation retain the physical cup pV(u,d-u)=cV P_d(u), cV=N zeta^(-d^2), P_L(u)=(-1)^u zeta^[u(L-u-1)]F_uF_(L-u)/F_L. All factorials in this generic cup are retained. The root monomial formula is not substituted off the root. At the root gamma_j=q^(2-j^2)/N^2, h0_j=k_j N s_(2j)/s_j^2, pi_j=gamma_j^(-1)D_phys(W_j), L_j=h0_j W_j pi_j. Choose the regular generic W_j and pi_j lift of the original [first-normal theorem](actual_nc_morse_graph_first_normal_source_reduction.md). The latter identity is asserted at the root; its chosen lift is h0_j W_j(t)pi_j(t). Every denominator in W_j and pi_j is a unit at this odd root. Paired generic projectors are NOT used. There is an important simplification for unequal labels: rotate the actual black source U_abc, rather than assuming that every differently normalized canonical Theta has the same cyclic scalar. The physical nested-cup source has entries J_((a,b),(c,e),(f,g))=pV(a,g)pV(b,c)pV(e,f). The ratio to its pair-cyclic permutation is exactly K(a)K(b), because P_d(d-u)=K(u)^(-1)P_d(u), with d even. Covariance of each pi therefore proves the generic all-entry identity U_abc(alpha,beta,gamma) =K_a(alpha) U_bca(beta,gamma,alpha). (6) This is valid before specialization and therefore for its first normal as well. White source tensors have the corresponding genuinely dual identity. The scalar product of the three fixed gamma factors is symmetric and does not change (6). No plain leg permutation or same-order Hermitian dual is introduced. Use (6) to put each rung in the last black and first white slot, as in the explicit four-rung table of the central cube theorem. The two outer cycle objects are both Q_m=V_d, and the rung object is Q_j. Let W_j:Q_j->V_d tensor V_d be its ordinary Clebsch map and let D_can use the canonical cups on these two V_d objects. Set a_j=(-1)^(d-j) zeta^[-j(j+1)-d], Theta_mmj=(W_j tensor I)p_(2j)/a_j, s_j=the actual black corner s_(m,m,j), U_mmj=(s_j/a_j)(W_j tensor I)p_(2j). (7) To verify the anchor a_j, the proved lowest-column identity gives W_j[2j](d,j) =zeta^[j(d-2j)] h_(d-j), h_(d-j)=(-1)^(d-j)zeta^[-(d-j)(j+1)], P_(2j)(2j)=zeta^(-2j). Multiplication gives exactly (7), with no endpoint division by a zero factorial. Every a_j is a nonzero monomial. Contracting one rung is now the ALL-SIDE-LEGS-OPEN identity (s_j/a_j)^2 W_j D_can(W_j). (8) The two Q_j cup/cap matrices cancel in their actual order. Since the cycle object's physical cup is cV times its canonical cup, D_can(W_j)=cV^2 D_phys(W_j)=cV^2 gamma_j pi_j, W_j D_can(W_j) =cV^2 gamma_j L_j/h0_j at the root. (9) Equations (8),(9) retain the entire paired root operator. In fact for j<m this rung map is nonzero and nilpotent, with square zero. Splitting it into a vanishing generic norm times a singular generic projector would obscure this regular map; no such split is made. The four rung maps all act on V_d tensor V_d. Their genuine full-cup turn, cyclic four-box trace and mark are consequently exactly the entrywise identities (9a),(9b),(10) of the central cube theorem, now with four different self-dual regular maps. Projector idempotence was never needed in that index substitution. The exposed physical mark remains on a cycle V_d strand. It is not transported through any paired Q_j image. Generic ordinary closure is [N] times the root-open scalar; taking its first normal and dividing by nu_N is therefore the original marked value phi of the product of turns. ## 4. All source phases cancel, with paired factors retained Before simplifying, the preceding contraction gives at the root Z_jvec=(N gamma_m)^8 product_r[ h0_j gamma_j (s_j/a_j)^2] phi(product_r Rturn[W_j D_can(W_j)]). This follows from the original one-gamma-per-edge identity. Its eight cycle edge factors are N gamma_m; each of the four rung factors is h0_j gamma_j. The eight actual black/white source scalars are those in (8), not inferred from a closed theta norm. The mark's single quantum-dimension normal is treated only after this full contraction. Insert (9) and then (1). The remaining scalar is (N gamma_m cV)^8 N^4 product_r[k_j gamma_j^2 s_j^2/a_j^2]. (10) There is no missing h0_j: its occurrence in the edge factor cancels its explicit reciprocal in the regular map (9). The proved actual ordered scalar formula gives s_j=N^3 A_N(m,m,j), A_N(m,m,j)=(-1)^(j+1) q^[m^2-2m-j-3] P_(N,j). Its positive magnitude P_(N,j) is the finite one-leg source, and its displayed ordered phase is from the full source theorem, not a permutation guess. Squaring and using (7) yields exactly gamma_j^2 s_j^2/a_j^2 =N^2 q^[2m^2-2]P_(N,j)^2, (11) INDEPENDENT of j apart from P_(N,j). Also N gamma_m cV=q^[2-5m^2]. The complete phase in (10),(11) is q^[8-32m^2]=q^[8N(2-N)]=1. The powers of N are N^4 times N^8, and this proves (2). Full Cartan and all fixed signed crossing powers give precisely (3), as follows from the all-normal eigenvalue equality R^e L_j=omega_j^e L_j. ## 5. Exact global support and a whole four-color bound The positive Newton multiplication theorem applies to every h_j in (1). Its coefficients are strictly positive at all indices 0,...,j. If sum j_r<d, the product has degree below d, so phi=0. If sum j_r>=d, choose integers 0<=v_r<=j_r with sum v_r=d. Their product has positive coefficient at output d: at each multiplication choose its upper index, the current partial sum. These partial sums stay <=d<N, so none of the allowed products vanishes. All other coefficients are nonnegative. Thus phi(product h_j)>0, proving (4) without a norm or stationary-phase approximation. For v<=j<m the exact sine quotient is z_(j+1)(v)/z_j(v) =sin[pi(j+v+1)/N]/sin[pi(j-v+1)/N]>=1. The difference of these sines is 2cos[pi(j+1)/N]sin(pi v/N)>=0. The new coefficient at v=j+1 is positive. In the actual Newton cone this proves 0<=h_j<=h_m, 0<P_(N,j)<=S_N. (12) Multiplication and phi preserve the cone. Equations (2),(12), and k_j<=2 consequently give 0<=Z_jvec<=16 Z_(m,m,m,m). (13) Let Z_four-rung be the actual source obtained by replacing the four rung sectors by their FULL complete circles, while retaining the eight central cycle sectors and taking zero rung twists. Linearity of the original source makes it the sum of (2) over all four labels. It follows that Z_St<=Z_four-rung<=16(m+1)^4 Z_St. (14) The same statement holds after removing the common unit phase of arbitrary fixed cycle twists. It is not a triangle-inequality bound on an oscillating rung sum: the summed source itself is positive. There is also a strict full-source color gap. For every fixed delta>0, the proved one-leg factorial estimate supplies gamma_delta>0 with max_(m-j>=delta N) P_(N,j)/S_N <=poly_delta(N)exp(-gamma_delta N). Using (12) in (2) gives the entire four-color complement bound sum_(max_r(m-j_r)>=delta N) Z_jvec <=poly_delta(N)exp(-2gamma_delta N) Z_St. (15) All finite source values, not only a selected term or a value-only Casimir symbol, occur in (14),(15). The bounds are uniform over the whole four-rung physical color cube and include j=0 and paired axes. The empty range for an oversized delta is understood literally. The [proved positive central period rate](actual_positive_newton_cuboctahedral_period.md) and (14) therefore give lim_(N odd) (2pi/N)log Z_four-rung =16v8+2Vol(Q_cube)=Vol(actual augmented cube link). The eight fixed central cycle projections are still a substantive restriction; (14) does not allow their removal or control interference from the remaining cycle colors. This partial-source statement is not a full cube volume-conjecture theorem. Audit: [all-rung actual marked contractions and full local normals](../experiments/audit_actual_cube_four_rung_positive_source.py), with [recorded results](../experiments/actual_cube_four_rung_positive_source_results.json). It compares every rung tuple at N=3,5,7, further physical tuples at N=9,11, and a signed original edge word at each level. Every actual U cyclic identity is checked including its first normal; paired rung nilpotents and the full half-degree turn are checked as operators. The complex positivity and global support follow from the analytical proof above, not a sign or nonvanishing interpretation in a finite field. Independent internal review: the crossing-period agent read the full analytical proof and replayed all five levels, 369 untwisted original sources and five signed cases: PASS. The review checked the generic physical-U clocks, regular paired rung maps, canonical/physical cup normalizations, complete phase cancellation, support, monotonicity and whole four-color gap.
