title: An explicit root-channel adapter for the first-normal defect
status: Exact root-channel normal adapter and finite Plancherel bound
text: # An explicit root-channel adapter for the first-normal defect 30 October 2026. Independently reviewed. The genuine first quantum defect of the original off-node boundary functional is an explicit function of TWO root-channel insertions. The adapter has polynomial norm O(N^2) on the actual boundary scale. It retains the full open root channel, not just its scalar closure z. This is a finite-source identity at every N>=2 and arbitrary fixed Morse width. It gives neither a bound for the root-channel norm nor the coefficient of a geometric relative period. ## 1. The actual family and its divided descendants Fix N>=2, d=N-1, q=q0 exp(epsilon), q0=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2. The highest weight d and the physical indices remain FIXED. Use F e_a=(1-Q^(a+1))e_(a+1), 0<=a<d, F e_d=0, K e_a=q^d Q^(-a)e_a, ad_F X=FX-K^-1 X K F, ad_K X=KXK^-1. (1) Let C_e be a holomorphic family of linear maps on End(V_d), commuting with these ACTUAL generic adjoints, and suppose C_e(I)=z(e)I. (2) The original routed channel C_e(X)=P_V[A U^-1(X tensor I)U B] satisfies these hypotheses with the original generic pivot g=(-1)^d K, actual endpoints and all peripheral factors; the [braided source/current theorem](actual_braided_residual_framing_current.md) includes rectangular cuts and arbitrary fixed width. No bare root mark is made covariant, and no routed U band is omitted here. Only K and F covariance is needed in the proof below. For 0<=s<=d put h_s(q)=(-1)^s Q^[s(s+1)/2] {d choose s}_Q, {d choose s}_Q=product_(j=1)^s (1-Q^(N-j))/(1-Q^j). For -d<=n<=d let s0=max(-n,0), and define the n-th-band matrix V_n(q)_(s+n,s)=h_s(q)/h_s0(q) whenever 0<=s,s+n<=d; all other entries are zero. (3) All h_s(q0)=1, by 1-Q0^(N-j)=-Q0^(-j)(1-Q0^j). Thus (3) is holomorphic near the root and V_n(q0)=T_n, the literal unwrapped band sum sum_(r-s=n) E_rs. In particular V_-d=E_0d and V_0=diag(h_0,...,h_d). Here is the entire descendant calculation. The successive ratio is h_(s+1)/h_s=-Q^(s+1)(1-Q^(d-s))/(1-Q^(s+1)). On a band with entries h_s, the coefficient of ad_F is (1-Q^(s+n+1))h_s-Q^n(1-Q^(s+1))h_(s+1) =(1-Q^(N+n))h_s. (4) At either physical end the missing term is zero. Substitution of the same ratio verifies (4) at the newly appearing left endpoint; at the right endpoint h_(d+1)=0 is used only as that finite zero, not as a new cyclic arrow. After normalizing (3), for -d<=n<d, ad_F V_n=c_n(q)V_(n+1), c_n=1-Q^n if n<0, c_n=1-Q^(N+n) if n>=0. (5) In particular c_0=1-Q^N vanishes at the root. It is canceled GENERICALLY, before taking root values. Equivalently, with F_k=product_(j=1)^k(1-Q^j), (ad_F)^(d+n) E_0d =F_(d+n) sum_s (h_s/h_d) E_(s+n,s). (6) For d+n>=N, (6) cancels the common factor in F_(d+n); it never divides a specialized zero matrix by a root zero. This explains the positive-band descendants without replacing the physical endpoint. Generic ad_K has distinct eigenvalues on the different integer bands. Its extreme band is one dimensional, so C_e(E_0d)=lambda(e)E_0d, with lambda holomorphic. Covariance and the nonzero generic factors (5) imply C_e(V_n)=lambda(e)V_n, -d<=n<=d. (7) Analytic continuation gives (7) at the root too. Since V_0(q0)=I, lambda(0)=z(0). Thus this proof also gives C_0(T_n)=z_0 T_n directly from regular generic K/F covariance, without an off-root cyclic shift or an assumed interpolation. ## 2. Two literal root insertions give the first-normal defect Write C_1=partial_epsilon C_e|0, z_1=z'(0), and mathcal A=C_0-z_0 Id_End. Define the explicit root diagonal H_0=0, H_s=2N sum_(j=1)^s 1/(1-Q0^j), H=diag(H_0,...,H_d). (8) This is the genuine derivative h'_s(q0). Indeed differentiating the product for h_s gives s(s+1)+sum_j[2N/(1-Q0^j)-2j], leaving exactly (8). In particular it keeps the derivative of Q^N; the root simplification h_s(q0)=1 is not differentiated instead. The derivative J_n=V'_n has entries H_s-H_s0 on its band. Differentiating (7), and subtracting the derivative of (2) at n=0, gives the EXACT identities eta I=mathcal A(H), eta=lambda'(0)-z_1, (C_1-z_1 Id_End)T_n =eta T_n-mathcal A(J_n). (9) There is no unspecified scalar normal in eta: it equals any diagonal entry of mathcal A(H), or Tr(mathcal A(H))/N. For ANY unwrapped Toeplitz matrix X=sum_n x_n T_n, let J(X)=sum_n x_n J_n. Since J(X)=XH-sum_n x_n H_max(-n,0) T_n and mathcal A annihilates every T_n, (9) simplifies to (C_1-z_1 Id_End)X=eta X-mathcal A(XH). (10) In particular for X(p)_(r,s)=p^(r-s)/N, p!=0, the genuine defect Delta_e(p)=C_e(X(p))-z(e)X(p) has Delta'_0(p)=eta X(p)-mathcal A(X(p)H), eta I=C_0(H)-z_0 H. (11) Thus only the original ROOT insertions H and X(p)H are required, in the SAME routed channel with its original closure. If p depends on epsilon, the extra derivative is zero because the root defect vanishes identically in p. No derivative of a root-only simplification of an individual coupon has been used. For the original coherent row e_t of trace one and its exact b_N(t,p)=Tr[e_t X(p)], the retained scalar defect is therefore Tr[e_t Delta'_0(p)] =eta b_N(t,p)-Tr[e_t C_0(X(p)H)] +z_0 Tr[e_t X(p)H]. (12) If b_N!=0 this may be divided by that SAME b_N. Equation (12) does not evaluate either new root period from z. In particular it does not introduce a second trace-one localization or remove U. There is a useful exact check against the free pivotal channel B_e(X)=D_e X-tau_e(X)I, tau_e(X)=Tr(g_e X), D_e=tau_e(I). Swapping the sums in (8) gives sum_s Q0^(-s)H_s=-2N/(1-Q0^-1), tau_0(H)=-nu_N, nu_N=D'_0. Equations (11) then give eta=nu_N and Delta'_0(p)=nu_N[X(p)-I/N], retaining the physical trace-normal sign. The actual N=2 odd-braid family in the current theorem shows that these additional open data cannot generally be replaced by z. ## 3. The exact Plancherel bound Center H by its scalar mean: tildeH_s=H_s-N^-1 sum_r H_r. Both (9) and (10) are unchanged, since mathcal A(I)=mathcal A(X)=0. Set R_N^2=N^-1 sum_s |tildeH_s|^2. This variance has a finite exact Fourier formula. With hat f_k=sum_s f_s Q0^(-ks), define the cyclic difference b_s=H_s-H_(s-1 mod N). Then b_0=-N(N-1) and b_s=2N/(1-Q0^s) for s>0. Pairing s with N-s gives sum_(s>0)(1-Q0^s)^-1=(N-1)/2. The successive differences of sum_(s>0)Q0^(-ks)/(1-Q0^s) are -1 for 1<=k<N, hence hat b_k=-2Nk, hat H_k=-2Nk/(1-Q0^-k), 1<=k<N, R_N^2=4 sum_(k=1)^(N-1) k^2/|1-Q0^k|^2. (13) These are the unnormalized Fourier transform and its Parseval factor 1/N^2; no extra N is suppressed. Also sum_(k=1)^(N-1) csc^2(pi k/N)=(N^2-1)/3. For an elementary proof, logarithmically differentiate P(x)=(x^N-1)/(x-1)=product_(k>0)(x-Q0^k) twice at x=1, using P(1)=N, P'(1)=N(N-1)/2 and P''(1)=N(N-1)(N-2)/3. Subtract the two resulting sums to get sum |1-Q0^k|^-2=(N^2-1)/12. Therefore R_N^2<=N^2(N^2-1)/3, R_N<=N^2/sqrt(3). (14) Use Hilbert--Schmidt norm on matrices and its induced norm on channels. If |log|p||<=A/N, then ||X(p)||_HS<=exp(A), ||X(p)tildeH||_HS<=exp(A)R_N, |eta|<=R_N ||mathcal A||_(HS->HS). The second inequality follows entry by entry from |p^(r-s)|<=exp(A); the third follows from eta I=mathcal A(tildeH). Consequently ||Delta'_0(p)||_HS <=2exp(A)R_N ||mathcal A||_(HS->HS) <=4exp(A)N^2/sqrt(3) ||C_0||_(HS->HS). (15) For the last inequality, C_0(I)=z_0 I gives |z_0|<=||C_0||. The actual scale p_N=1-1/(N rho+c0), with rho in a fixed compact of C* and c0 bounded, satisfies this hypothesis uniformly for large N. Scalar pairing retains its actual factor ||e_t||_HS, and division by b_N retains |b_N|^-1; neither is silently declared polynomial. Most importantly, (15) is NOT a bound by |z_0|. The full channel norm can contain large independent open-source contributions. ## 4. A canonical square-zero part of the root channel Every such root channel preserves E_N=span{I,H}, and in the ordered basis I,H its matrix is [[z_0,eta],[0,z_0]]. (16) For composition of two admissible channel families, z(CD)=z(C)z(D), eta(CD)=z(C)eta(D)+eta(C)z(D). (17) Thus z+eta e, e^2=0, is an exact dual-number character of this channel algebra. Where z!=0, eta/z is additive under composition. This is literal finite linear algebra. Arbitrary braid coupons are not thereby factored into these End(V_d) channels, and (17) implies no global growth, transport or triangulation theorem. The first-normal defect is therefore explicitly determined by the FULL root channel, while (11)--(12) identify which additional root insertions must be retained. The original finite support cycles, their moving-period boundary terms and their relative geometric coefficient remain outside this adapter. The [focused audit](../experiments/audit_actual_explicit_root_channel_normal_adapter.py) and [saved results](../experiments/actual_explicit_root_channel_normal_adapter_results.json) pass 133 exact generic ladder entries and 54 raw divided-descendant identities. Nineteen original braid, complete-circle and rectangular sources give 2087 all-band first-normal defect comparisons, 2087 normalized-descendant jet entries, 801 off-node adapter entries, 57 coherent-period identities and 57 genuine moving-p checks. Twelve actual channel compositions check (17). Exact finite-field tests give 496 Fourier modes, 31 Parseval identities and 62 pivotal free-channel normal checks. Twenty boundary norm checks at 90 digits have maximum relative Parseval error below 4.2e-90. These tests retain the actual generic pivots; they do not infer the root-channel norm from z. Independent full analytical review: the primary and coherent-source readers checked the physical endpoints, generic descendant cancellation, two-root-insertion signs, genuine derivative convention, pivotal adapter, exact Fourier normalization, polynomial norm and composition scope. The coherent-source reader also independently checked 276 rational ladder entries and the root h_s/H_s/pivot formulas before reading the audit implementation. title: An exponentially tame completion of the original source
text: # An exponentially tame completion of the original source 28 October 2026. The known positive-integer-carry completion has a source-preserving deformation which makes its ENTIRE overflow part arbitrarily small exponentially, in the original balanced flat norm. This is a quantitative result for every fixed signed braid or marked plat, before taking absolute estimates. It removes one specified family of source-zero completion branches; nilpotence alone had not provided such an estimate. The genuine degree-zero original word is unchanged. Its geometric critical support, singular cycle boundaries and scalar exponential estimate remain to be controlled. This theorem does not make those remaining contributions small, and it is not a volume bound. ## 1. Keep the original crossing and its carry extension Put d=N-1, Q=exp(2 pi i/N), x=-exp(-pi i/N). Let R_plus and R_minus=R_plus^(-1) be the ORIGINAL complete balanced crossings, including their common Cartan scalar. The independently proved [Euler completion](actual_crossing_euler_completion_and_weight_source.md) has R_tilde_plus=R_plus+Delta_plus, R_tilde_minus=R_minus+Delta_minus, Delta_minus=-R_minus Delta_plus R_minus. (1) Each Delta has total INTEGER degree change exactly +N, whereas the original crossings preserve that degree. The literal completed crossings are mutual inverses. On b heads the positive-carry ideal has bth power zero. For an arbitrary scalar z define R_(sigma,z)=R_sigma+z Delta_sigma. (2) The two signs in (2) remain literal inverses: locally Delta_plus R_minus Delta_plus=0. For z=r^N, (2) is exactly R_(sigma,z)=r^D R_tilde_sigma r^(-D), (3) where D is local total integer head degree. This is an algebraic identity, not an estimate in an ill-conditioned changed metric. In particular the original degree-zero R_sigma in (2) is untouched. For ANY signed word beta on b heads, W_z(beta)=W(beta)+sum_(l=1)^(b-1) z^l W_l, W_l has degree +lN. (4) Thus the number of carry orders is bounded by braid width, not N or word length. Its entire original pivotal first-cut matrix equals that of W for EVERY z. Closing the other heads requires a first input/output difference strictly between -N and N, which excludes every positive carry. All original full dimension, peripheral, framing and Cartan factors multiply the same matrices and remain. The identity (4) also holds as the original root meridian family; the quantitative norms below are stated at complete color. The same exact source identity holds for the original marked plat. For 2k heads, the cups have total input degree kd. The k-1 ordinary caps fix degree (k-1)d and the FULL marked pair accepts degree from 0 to 2d. Hence the allowed total degree difference lies in [-d,d], again excluding +lN. No cap or marked row is replaced here. ## 2. The factorized quantum atom is retained In the relative algebra H^N=1, Hf=Q^(-1)fH, f^N=0, let e_j be its original right idempotents and write f_z=f[1-(1-z)e_d]. (5) Its right multiplication is the old nilpotent shift except that its wrapped step has weight z. The two-head fusion C preserves integer degree. The original right-coefficient calculation gives R_(+,z)=C right[kappa U_x(f_z) D_x(H)] C^(-1), U_x(t)=sum_(a=0)^d x^(-a)t^a/F_a, D_x(H)=sum_(k=0)^d (-1)^k Q^(k(k-1)/2)x^(-2k)e_k. (6) Indeed the coefficient of f^a e_k in U_x(f_z)D_x is its old completed coefficient multiplied by 1 if a+k<N and by z otherwise. There is at most one wrap. This proves (6), including the literal inverse with the original reversed factor order. No positive model or postulated tetrahedral weight is introduced. Since f_z^N=0, any anchored analytic cyclic-dilog completion with the same first N Euler coefficients acts identically on f_z. The literature norm-one functions and every norm factor can therefore be retained exactly as in the existing cyclic network theorem. The boundary idempotent in (5) is NOT discarded: damping is a controlled regularization of its carry, not a claim that the wall or its full inserted Ward complex has vanished. For 0<=z<=1, right multiplication by f_z is a weighted partial permutation of norm at most one in the original relative monomial basis. D_x and its inverse have norm one at complete color. ## 3. Uniform original-metric exponential bounds Here are bounds with an explicit constant and no unspecified factorial conditioning. For 0<=a<N, |F_a|<=2^N, 1/|F_a|<=(N/2)^a/a!, sum_(a=0)^d 1/|F_a|<=exp(N/2). (7) To prove the middle inequality, sort any a distinct nonzero root factors |1-Q^j|. The kth smallest is at least 2k/N: its distance from a multiple of N occurs at most twice, and 2sin(pi s)>=4s for 0<=s<=1/2. Their product is at least (2/N)^a a!. This applies to the actual initial root products. For completeness, fix a total degree T in the actual fusion (1) of the completion proof. Its block, with indices u<=a, factors as C_(u,a)=l_u M_(u,a) r_a, l_u=x^u F_(T-u), M_(u,a)=1/F_(a-u), r_a=x^(-a) F_a/F_(T-a). (8) All indices lie in [0,d]. The triangular Toeplitz M is a finite Euler function of a unit-norm shift. Its inverse has the same coefficient magnitudes, by the finite Euler convolution. Equation (7) therefore gives ||C||<=exp[(1+2log2)N], ||C^(-1)||<=exp[(3/2+log2)N]. (9) For example the three inverse factors in (8) have norms at most 2^N exp(N/2), exp(N/2), exp(N/2). These are bounds in the ORIGINAL balanced physical and relative monomial metrics. They do not claim that C is isometric. The Euler factor and its inverse in (6) each have norm at most exp(N/2). Put A=3+3log2. Equations (6)--(9) imply ||R_tilde_sigma||<=exp(AN), ||R_sigma||<=exp(AN), ||Delta_sigma||<=2exp(AN). (10) For the middle bound the original R is the block-diagonal degree-zero part of its completion, an orthogonal degree pinching of norm at most one. The same argument applies to the literal negative inverse. The original complete kappa has modulus one and is included throughout. ## 4. Entire overflow is arbitrarily small before an absolute bound Let the fixed signed word have m crossings, and choose z_N=exp(-tau N), tau>=0. Tensoring with untouched heads changes none of the local norms. The ordinary product telescoping identity and (10) give ||W_(z_N)-W|| <=2m 3^(m-1) exp[(mA-tau)N]. (11) For any prescribed L>0 choose tau>=mA+L. The entire carry error then has norm at most 2m3^(m-1)exp(-LN), while its original closed source is EXACTLY zero by (4). This holds for both signs in the same original flat metric, without changing that source to a conjugated or exponentially conditioned boundary vector. The trace norm of the original reduced first-cut functional is at most N^(b-1), since every closed pivot is unitary. Original finite cups/caps likewise have polynomial norms at complete color. Thus (11) also bounds their absolute carry contributions by a polynomial times exp(-LN), with the external source line chi_N retained explicitly. This does not require taking absolute values of the individually enormous unregularized carry paths. The finite factor-path absolute envelope can also be controlled, without relying on cancellation inside C or its inverse. For an N^2-by-N^2 matrix T, its entrywise absolute matrix obeys ||abs(T)||<=||T||_HS<=N||T||. Right Euler monomial shifts are partial permutations, so their entrywise absolute sum still has norm at most exp(N/2). The Gaussian absolute matrix is the identity. Consequently the nonnegative matrices summing all unwrapped or wrapped local C/Euler/Gaussian/C^(-1) paths each have norm at most L_N=N^2 exp(AN). Each wrapped path in (5)--(6) has exactly one factor z. In a word, the sum of absolute weights of paths with at least one wrap is therefore bounded in operator norm by m 2^(m-1) N^(2m) exp[(mA-tau)N]. (12) The positive-carry degree restriction actually forbids those paths from the plain original closed source term by term. Estimate (12) also applies before that contraction, or after polynomially bounded inserted coupons, when the simple closed-source degree exclusion is unavailable. Thus the quantitative claim is not an inference from source cancellation or an exchange of an infinite scalar expansion. It concerns the specified finite factor expansion; an arbitrary later scalar-contour rewriting must retain its own source identity. There is also a controlled extension to the earlier coupon caveat. Insert finitely many specified matrices whose original norms are polynomial in N, including fixed products of normalized E,F,K Ward coupons. Their completed-minus-original sourced products obey the same telescoping estimate with those polynomial factors. The equality is generally NOT exact for degree-lowering coupons; the known N=2 example becomes z_N times its original nonzero carry value. It is now smaller than any desired exponential rate by increasing tau. No moving-q normal identity is inferred. In particular let Q_in,Q_out be any of the specified physical Hopf/Ward matrices, of polynomial norm, satisfying the exact actual identity R_sigma Q_in=Q_out R_sigma. The deformed factor has ||R_(sigma,z_N) Q_in-Q_out R_(sigma,z_N)|| <=2 exp[(A-tau)N] (||Q_in||+||Q_out||). (13) Thus the damping can preserve the entire fixed finite collection of original Ward identities to an arbitrarily negative exponential order, even when their individual degree-lowering coupons detect the undamped carry. This is a norm statement on the original source complex. It does not identify stationary branches of an uncontrolled scalar factorization merely from those equations. ## 5. Exact scope for a global critical upper bound This is a source-preserving analytic completion with a verified absolute norm estimate for its entire source-zero overflow. Its matrix kernels are finite Laurent polynomials of degree O(N) on each local input/output pair, and (4) is polynomial in z of degree at most b-1. It can be inserted into the existing fixed-variable Euler/cyclic-dilog scalar networks; it introduces no hidden N-rank co-source or unknown scalar normalization. It does NOT prove that every stationary point of an arbitrary scalar factorization is physical, or that a raw scalar cycle can be replaced by its geometric contour. The idempotent (5), genuine degree-zero kernel, clock feedback and source/cycle boundaries remain. Excluding their nonphysical limiting stationary strata, or showing their aggregate cancellation, is the remaining task. In particular (11) is not an exponential estimate for W itself or for its original knot scalar. It removes the additional positive-N carry branches of this specified completion from that problem, with an arbitrarily strong bound rather than a formal source-null assertion alone. ## 6. Reproducible audit python3 experiments/audit_actual_exponentially_tame_carry_completion.py The audit verifies (5)--(6), degree-gauge covariance, literal signed inverses, and complete original one-cut/marked-plat sources for several nontrivial signed words. It independently tests the fusion factorization (8), the inverse Euler Toeplitz blocks, and the claimed original-metric inequalities on complex matrices. The all-level proof is (7)--(11), not a finite inference.

title: Complete-circle pruning through an exposed six-head source
text: # Complete-circle pruning through an exposed six-head source 29 October 2026. The actual saturated six-head source kills an unsaturated triple at an EXPOSED marked white vertex, before the unrestricted mark acts. The same argument kills unsaturated boundary triples in the typed three-port graph substitution. This is a whole source cancellation with all complete-circle normals retained. No bare mark is moved through a nested cap. ## 1. The actual support theorem being used Let O be the local ring of analytic functions at zeta=q=exp(pi i/N) and K its fraction field. For the generic balanced highest-weight-d physical module V_d(zeta), d=N-1, put Lambda_6=Inv_K(V_d(zeta)^tensor6) intersect V_d(O)^tensor6, S_N=Lambda_6/(zeta-q)Lambda_6. This is the ACTUAL saturated original-source specialization, not the span of one cup seed and not the whole enlarged root invariant space. The [proved six-port source support](actual_six_port_three_circle_support.md) states that on S_N the product of the three disjoint complete-circle sectors obeys (L_a tensor L_b tensor L_c) S_N=0 whenever a+b+c<d. (1) Each L_j is the full root sector of L_N, including its nilpotent first normal on a paired cluster. The source theorem proves (1) by clearing the absent generic joint corner. No root semisimplification or deletion of a derivative projector is involved. ## 2. A literal six-head ordinary removal Take the ordered NC/Morse graph and exposed white vertex v of the [corrected first-normal theorem](actual_nc_morse_graph_first_normal_source_reduction.md). Its three edge slots are in increasing order. Omit ALL THREE cap arcs of that white vertex. All other white cap arcs are ordinary. Because the outer arc of v is exposed, these remaining caps can be removed in their actual innermost Morse order without closing or passing over any of the six retained physical heads. The last six heads are exactly the three ordered consecutive pairs at v. Also temporarily omit the three pair coupons incident to v. Define Y(zeta) to be the remaining physical six-head column, with the original cup source and every other edge coupon present in its chosen regular generic Hopf lift. Every cup, cap removal and internal edge map is a regular generic Hopf map. Thus Y(zeta) in Lambda_6, Y(q) in S_N. (2) The generic lifts may be analytic full-cluster Casimir polynomials, or the explicitly regular h0 W(zeta)pi(zeta) lifts with the correct root value. They must not be singular individual generic projectors. Membership (2) uses only their regularity and covariance. Actual integer H=0 is preserved by the source, coupons and cap removals. The omitted three coupons touch NONE of the other removed cap heads. They can therefore be applied LAST to the retained six heads as an exact index contraction. This is a commutation of maps on disjoint indices, not a braid or a tensor flip. For their original exponents, the observed physical column is Y_obs=(R^(e1)L_a tensor R^(e2)L_b tensor R^(e3)L_c)Y(q). (3) The R powers preserve each paired source and are invertible, so (1) gives Y_obs=0 when a+b+c<d. Only AFTER this equality are the three remaining arcs closed by two ordinary caps and the original full m. Consequently their marked source is zero, without invoking any local invariant property of m or replacing it by an ordinary covector. The conclusion holds for every internal channel assignment, with all its phases and normals. It proves that an exposed marked-white unsaturated term in the first-normal formula cancels COHERENTLY: [product_(other vertices)s_v(0)] s_mark'(0) Xi_Gamma(0)=0. (4) If another source factor is zero the same conclusion already follows directly or by the multiple-zero rule. A local s_mark' can be nonzero; (4) is a whole-source compatibility relation, not its local deletion. Together with the existing black and ordinary-white zero statements, the complete exposed NC graph source can be summed using ONLY labels with J_v>=d at EVERY vertex, including the marked one. ## 3. The unsupported three-port seam is zero before its exterior For the typed graph substitution in [the three-port sewing theorem](actual_nc_three_port_source_sewing.md), B has an outer white block on slots (0,k,E_B-1). Omit its three caps and its three incident pair coupons. This is exactly the ordinary removal above, giving a physical Y_B(q) in S_N. In the new graph its three boundary coupons occur ONCE each on the merged edges; all other maps lie in B or in A's exterior. Their product annihilates Y_B(q) when the shared triple has sum <d. Hence the entire B source column is zero before pairing with ANY exterior supplied by A. Thus the unsupported triangular seam term is zero as an actual source, not a zero divided by a marked theta scalar. The exact whole raw gluing rule is Z_new=sum_(a+b+c>=d) Z_A(a,b,c) Z_B(a,b,c)/Z_theta(a,b,c). (5) The complete coherent interior sums are taken inside each Z_A,Z_B; the three shared boundary labels are summed once and stay correlated. Z_theta is the proved strictly positive all-channel marked expression. There is no omitted unsaturated correction in THIS typed complete- circle operation. An ordinary open coefficient may have nonzero higher normals there, but the original fixed first-normal source is zero by (1)--(3). ## 4. What is not annihilated An unsupported open S_N cell can carry a nonzero marked functional. Equation (1) kills its TOP COMPLETE-CIRCLE observation, not the cell or its lower moments. The correlated boundary torsor is unchanged. Nor does this argument apply to a bare mark at a nested cap: omitting that vertex can leave enclosing cap annuli across the retained heads, so the same untransported six-head array need not satisfy (2). The assumption of COMPLETE circle color is essential. Replacing L_N by a different ordinary auxiliary color gives different spectral values and normals; its product is not the top product in (1). No auxiliary-color corridor or filling-current pruning is asserted. The [focused sewing audit](../experiments/audit_actual_nc_three_port_source_sewing.py) constructs the actual physical Y before boundary circles, checks its ordinary six-head Ward equations and extracted divided-power kernel, then verifies its full observed zero on an unsaturated boundary. The all-N proof is the regular-source membership and the already proved all-N source support (1), not extrapolation from those levels. Independent internal review: root read the complete typed argument against the source-support theorem and confirmed the cap-removal order, exact saturated-lattice membership, regular lifts and disjoint coupon commutation. The focused audit passes nineteen sewings and five actual six-head ordinary/divided-current and pruning families; the nested-cap countercurrent is explicitly retained. This is a source theorem, not a norm estimate or a general graph-volume claim. The global audit agent subsequently read the full pruning and whole three-port sewing proofs and freshly replayed those physical tests, including the nonzero source before the unsupported circle product and the nested-cap countercurrent: PASS. No further correction was required after the exposed-pointing hypothesis was made explicit.

title: External circle reflection and its primitive cusp normalization
status: Exact reflection; mesoscopic Fourier and primitive cusp
text: # External circle reflection and its primitive cusp normalization 30 October 2026. Independently reviewed and frozen. The original color N-h circle splits exactly into a cosine-weighted COMPLETE circle and a literal small-color circle. This gives a precise interface to the positive face coefficient without discarding any root Casimir normal. The rectangle calculation independently identifies the primitive cusp shape associated with the folded Gaussian. Neither calculation proves the missing general complex external-color packet or its global gap. The exact cosine core was already identified in the [entire core-color compiler](actual_augmented_plat_entire_core_color_packet.md). The new interface here is its positive face-coefficient realization, its retained small-color and normal terms, and the independent primitive rectangle normalization. ## 1. The actual full-matrix polynomial identity Put N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N). To distinguish the two Chebyshev normalizations, write C_m(z)=2T_m(z/2), P_m(z)=U_m(z/2), C_0=2, C_1=z; P_0=1, P_1=z. Substitution of (1), with its signs, gives L_(N-h)=(-1)^h T_h(Omega/2)L_N+(-1)^N L_h. (2) The same equation holds at h=0 using T_0=1 and L_0=0. For the INTERNAL complete-circle label 0<=a<=floor(d/2), put s_a=d-2a, c_a=q^(2a+1)+q^(-2a-1), L_(N,a)=h0_a W_a pi_a. These are the actual complete sectors, including the nilpotent ones. At a double node L_N(c_a)=0, so multiplying by T_h retains exactly T_h(c_a/2)L_N'(c_a); its apparent T_h' term is multiplied by zero. At the odd simple node the ordinary value is retained. Therefore (-1)^h T_h(Omega/2)L_N =sum_a cos(pi h s_a/N) L_(N,a). (3) Here (-1)^h cos(pi h(2a+1)/N)=cos(pi h s_a/N) follows from 2a+1=N-s_a and the INTEGER external deficit h. An exact subset expansion of the original mixed source At R specified original circle ports substitute (2), tensor with all spectators, and keep each R_i^epsilon_i, physical cup/cap, unrestricted original mark and exterior framing line. Multilinearity gives a sum over subsets J of the ports. At i in J retain the literal small-color operator L_(h_i); at i outside J retain the weighted complete sum (3). (9) The derivative of T_h(Omega(epsilon)/2) is included. Every spectator, source cup, mark and exposed trace normalization still has its own derivative when the identity is contracted. No whole-source generic normal is replaced by a root value. Equations(2),(3) already retain the spectral normals f'(c); these are distinct from epsilon derivatives. ## 4. The actual tangent-circle rectangle fixes the factor two At one original crossing disk let x,y be the outer white-circle curvatures and b,c its two middle curvatures. In its positive orientation, tau_geom,0=2i W/H=2i A/(T_b+T_c)=2pi i/C. (12) The area of this primitive basis is2WH, the area of the two actual rectangles. (13) Source epsilon=-1 is the geometric '+' collar. This is the marked diagonal meridian in the half-twisted cusp lattice, not a claim that half of the longitude is an integral loop in the original lattice. ## 5. The exact empty-subset term has a mesoscopic complex Gaussian law Assume the fixed connected labeled right-angled certificate of the [signed complete-source theorem](general_signed_augmented_source_volume.md). Let A_N^epsilon=F_N(0) be the original complete signed source. Let l_N be its all-maximal positive coefficient radius, and retain Z_i,N=C_i(l_N)-pi i epsilon_i with Re Z_i,N>=c>0. For every fixed compact complex polydisc K, F_N(sqrt(N) z)/A_N^epsilon =exp[-pi^2 sum_i z_i^2/Z_i,N] [1+o(1)] (14) uniformly for z in K. All fixed z derivatives converge uniformly on smaller compact polydiscs to the derivatives of the displayed Gaussian. This is an absolute derivative statement, not a relative estimate at zeros of a differentiated Gaussian. Here is a direct proof retaining both finite lattices. Write a_i=M-t_i, M=floor(d/2), s0=d-2M in {0,1}. The signed theorem gives the actual relative sector weights uniformly for max t_i<=N^(1/2+delta), 0<delta<1/6, as exp[-sum_i Z_i,N t_i(t_i+s0)/N] [1+o(1)]. The extra factor is cos(pi z_i(2t_i+s0)/sqrt(N)). At odd levels k_M=1 and all other multiplicities are2; at even levels all are2. Thus u=t+s0/2 gives the full integer or half-integer Gaussian, with the retained factor exp(Z_i,N s0^2/(4N)). Uniform Riemann summation on either lattice gives sqrt(N) integral_R exp(-Z x^2)cos(2pi z x) dx =sqrt(pi N) Z^(-1/2) exp(-pi^2 z^2/Z). The square root has positive real part. The integral follows first for real positive Z and then by holomorphy on Re Z>0. Its convergence is uniform on the stated compact sets of Z and complex z. The original source tails remain controlled. The cosine product costs at most C exp(C sum_i t_i/sqrt(N)), so the central absolute majorant is exp(-c|t|^2/N+C|t|/sqrt(N)). The uniform relative sector error therefore contributes o(N^(R/2)). Beyond the mesoscopic window and below the fixed macroscopic cutoff, the proved common-radius bound is a fixed polynomial times that same Gaussian majorant, and its tail tends to zero. Beyond the macroscopic cutoff the original rate gap exp(-cN+o(N)) loses at most exp(C sqrt(N)), and remains a gap. Thus these sums concern the full finite F_N, not just a chosen window. Divide by the nonzero signed complete asymptotic. Its common exterior phase and omega_M factors cancel literally. The Gaussian is bounded away from zero on K. Finally Cauchy's formula on a slightly larger compact polydisc proves the derivative assertion. Equation (14) concerns the EXACT empty-subset term. It does not bound any nonempty-J small-color diagram, identify it with the whole mixed source, or give a fixed complex neighborhood of h/N. ## 6. The primitive Hessian matching and remaining external problem The [signed complete-source theorem](general_signed_augmented_source_volume.md) has folded weight exp[-Z t(t+s0)/N], where Z=C-pi i epsilon, s0=d-2floor(d/2), and s=s0+2t. The cosine in (3) is therefore in exactly the normalization whose Gaussian transform has the candidate quadratic external action phi(x_ext)=Phi-pi^2 x_ext^2/Z+O(x_ext^4). (15) Equation (14) proves this Gaussian normalization on its mesoscopic scale; it does NOT assert a general fixed-neighborhood external asymptotic or an analytic action phi. If the required packet is proved, its retained similarity coordinates U=-2pi i x_ext and V=-2phi' give V/U=tau_geom,epsilon to first order by (13). In particular phi''(0)=pi i tau_geom,epsilon. The transfer template which writes phi''=2pi i tau_packet uses tau_packet=tau_geom,epsilon/2=pi i/Z. (16) This agrees with the existing marked channel elimination and keeps the primitive cusp shape separate from the packet's Hessian convention. A real sqrt(N) folded-window estimate does not imply a relative packet on a fixed COMPLEX external neighborhood: the relevant complex internal displacement is then of order N. The general nonempty-J small-color contractions, the combined far-color and alias gap, and the actual nonlinear marked regulator comparison remain necessary inputs to [general long-filling transfer](general_original_source_long_filling_transfer.md), equations(2)--(5). None is claimed here. The external h_i and the internal s_i,a_i remain different variables throughout. ## 7. A strict bound for the all-small untwisted subset One subset admits an immediate literal bound. Assume EVERY circle is replaced by L_(h_i), h_i>=1, and every retained epsilon_i is zero. Write B_N^small(h) for this original marked contraction. In the original balanced complete physical basis, F|u>=(1-Q^(u+1))|u+1>, Ecal|u>=(Q^(-u)-1)|u-1>, K|u>=q^d Q^(-u)|u>. Thus ||F||,||Ecal||<=2 and ||K||=||K^-1||=1. The original coproducts F12=F tensor I+K^-1 tensor F and Ecal12=Ecal tensor K+I tensor Ecal have norms at most4. Hence ||Omega||<=18. Its exact Chebyshev recurrence gives by induction ||L_h||<=19^(h-1), retaining its actual full matrix. The k bottom cups have norms N^(3/2), the k-1 ordinary caps have norms N^(-1/2), and the unrestricted marked cap has norm N^-1: their respective supported entries have moduli N,1/N,1/N^2, with N,N,N^2 entries. The exterior framing factor is a unit. The literal matrix contraction therefore satisfies |B_N^small(h)|<=N^(k-1/2) 19^[sum_i(h_i-1)]. (17) If any h_i=0 this algebraic subset term is zero. Equation(17) is subexponential for h_i=O(sqrt(N)). For a fixed certified positive-volume exterior, it also gives a strict gap below F0=Vol(Y_D)/(2pi) throughout 1<=h_i<=delta N whenever delta R log19<F0. This covers only J=all ports and epsilon_i=0. A proper subset still contains its actual complete coupons; a signed port still contains R^epsilon. Neither may be deleted from the norm estimate. No general proper-subset gap, signed small-color bound, or mixed packet follows from (17), and no generic-q normal is inferred from this root estimate. ## 8. Verification and review The [focused audit](../experiments/audit_actual_external_circle_reflection_and_cusp.py), with [recorded results](../experiments/actual_external_circle_reflection_and_cusp_results.json), checks 78 formal polynomial identities, 54 full root matrix reflections, 204 actual complete-sector weights, 54 genuine polynomial first jets, and nine full Casimir-relation normal defects. title: The original factorial interpolant is exactly a full-Psi quotient
text: # The original factorial interpolant is exactly a full-Psi quotient 28 October 2026. The normalized factorial interpolation used for the original finite sums is the SAME full Faddeev function already used in the relative moment source. There is no residual period-one multiplier. This supplies a literal five-full-Psi formula for every original physical crossing coefficient, including its support zeros and complete scalar. This is a normalization comparison inside the existing double-sine/Barnes framework. It is not a new quantum invariant or a selected-cycle theorem. ## 1. Exact identity and elimination of the periodic ambiguity Let N>=2, h=2pi*i/N, d=N-1 and use the exactly normalized functions Fhat_N and G_N of [the factorial theorem](exact_factorial_interpolation_and_complex_contours.md). Let Psi be the ORIGINAL positive full function and phi_N=Psi(h)=sqrt(N)exp{i pi[1/4-(N+1/N)/12]}. Then as meromorphic functions of z, Fhat_N(z)=phi_N/Psi(h(z+1)). (1) Here is an independent proof fixing the possible period-one ambiguity. Both sides are nonzero and holomorphic on -1<Re z<N. For Fhat this was proved from its convergent Gamma product. For Psi use the proved identification Psi(Z)=Phi_(1/sqrt(N))(sqrt(N)Z/(2pi)-c_b). The zero-free strip |Im argument|<Im c_b becomes precisely 0<Im Z<2pi(1+1/N), or -1<Re z<N. These strip and conjugation facts are proved from the defining integral in [the full-Phi audit](faddeev_pentagon_audit.md), not assumed from a published pentagon. The two first-shift equations imply that H(z)=Fhat_N(z)Psi(h(z+1))/phi_N is one-periodic on their overlap. It extends to an entire, nowhere-zero one-periodic function by translations of this strip. Fix an entire logarithm L of H. On a central vertical strip of width one, both signs of log|H| have the bound |Re L(z)|<=C_N(1+|Im z|^2 log(2+|Im z|)). (2) For clarity this is a rough FIXED-N growth estimate, not a semiclassical estimate. The finite Barnes-G expression for Fhat proves it directly. All its Gamma/Barnes arguments have positive real parts in this strip. The convergent digamma series gives psi(w)=O(log(2+|w|)) there; integrating the proved derivative d_w log BarnesG(1+w) =w psi(1+w)-w-1/2+(log(2pi))/2 along a vertical line bounds its logarithm by O(t^2 log(2+|t|)). The same estimates bound both numerator and denominator in the finite Barnes product. The full-Phi left/right asymptotics on a fixed horizontal strip bound the Psi part, including its reciprocal, by a quadratic logarithm. This proves (2). Periodicity extends it to the whole plane. An entire harmonic function with growth O(R^2 log R) has zero derivatives of every order at least three: its circle Fourier coefficients of order ell are O(R^(2-ell)log R), tending to zero for ell>=3. Apply this to Re L, or the harmonic Cauchy formula. Thus L is a polynomial of degree at most two. Periodicity of H forces L(z+1)-L(z) to be a constant 2pi*i*m, m integer, so the quadratic coefficient is zero. Since H(0)=1, H(z)=exp(2pi*i*m z). (3) Finally take Re z=d/2. The real Gamma product and exact reflection G_N(z)G_N(d-z)=N give |G_N(z)|=sqrt(N). The modulus of the explicit Gaussian factor in Fhat is ONE on this line, hence |Fhat|=sqrt(N). The argument h(z+1) has Im equal to pi(1+1/N); its Faddeev argument is real. The proved conjugation identity therefore gives |Psi|=1. As |phi_N|=sqrt(N), we have |H|=1 on this entire vertical line. Equation (3) now forces m=0. This proves (1), including its phase. ## 2. Exact five-function ORIGINAL crossing coefficient For the positive physical crossing with input (a,b), total transfer k, and output (b+k,a-k), the original coefficient is r_plus(a,b,k)=kappa x^(-a-b+k)Q^(b(a-k)) F_(b+k)F_a/[F_k F_b F_(a-k)]. Apply (1) to the normalized interpolation in the transfer variable z. Its FULL function factor, with all fixed factors also expressed in Psi, is exactly Fhat(b+z)F_a/[Fhat(z)F_b Fhat(a-z)] =phi_N^(-1) Psi(h(b+1))Psi(h(z+1))Psi(h(a-z+1)) /[Psi(h(a+1))Psi(h(b+z+1))]. (4) The original Cartan monomial and kappa remain unchanged. Formula (4) is a literal equality, not an equality up to a central factor. Its negative version is the actual balanced antiunitary mirror, with the opposite full function and conjugate marked constants. At every physical integer z in [0,d], forbidden transfers z>a or b+z>=N are EXACT zeros of this expression. They are the actual pole/zero cancellations of the completed function. The half-integer rectangle of [the endpoint-packet theorem](actual_total_transfer_endpoint_packets.md) therefore represents the original finite transfer sum directly with these five functions, preserving all corners and source data. The five classical arguments are B, A/V, V, A and T/V, where A=Q^a, B=Q^b, V=Q^(a-z), T=AB. Their signed sum is exactly the original direct crossing symbol -[A]-[T/V]+[V]+[B]+[A/V]. Thus no extra auxiliary nine-to-five calibration is needed in THIS physical coefficient chart. This does not remove the true transfer boundary current (the low normal packet has the nonzero source in equation (12) of the endpoint theorem), provide an infinite-height quadrature estimate, or establish a global cycle with a sharp bound. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_total_transfer_endpoint_packets.py): independent Barnes-G versus completed full-Psi evaluations, original allowed/forbidden transfer values and exact normal/source identities.

title: Exact Gaussian stabilization preserves the unresolved geometric source
text: # Exact Gaussian stabilization preserves the unresolved geometric source 28 October 2026. The finite Fourier kernel in the actual clock-feedback theorem has a nonzero coefficient with normalization exactly one. Its Jacobian and transverse determinant can be computed without assumptions about a geometric saddle. But it is an exact stabilization of the SAME coupled action and the SAME original source. It does not supply the missing geometric intersection number. This answers a specific possible shortcut: Fourier-Gaussian ellipticity does not turn the already known geometric normal block into a selected global geometric contribution. No claim about the impossibility of a different global contour construction is made. ## 1. The finite feedback extension splits exactly Use the primitive variables and actual diagram matrix T of [the feedback theorem](actual_clock_feedback_normal_form.md), not independent physical spectator parameters. There are m crossings. On a coefficient R^nu Y^h the normalized finite Fourier realization is N^(-m) sum_(eta,lambda in (Z/N)^m) Q^[-lambda dot eta+lambda dot h+nu^T T eta]. (1) The clock h is the actual over-monotone clock; nu is the integer primitive Laurent exponent. Every original closure, pivot, dimension, framing and Cartan factor remains in its coefficient and its specified charged source. Equation (1) is only the exact feedback kernel. Make the finite change of variables eta=h+u, lambda=T^T nu+v, (2) with all entries interpreted modulo N in this finite sum. For EVERY integer nu,h and EVERY diagram T, this is a bijection, and its exponent is exactly -lambda eta+lambda h+nu^T T eta =nu^T T h-v dot u mod N. (3) Thus (1) is Q^(nu^T T h) * N^(-m) sum_(u,v)Q^(-v dot u) =Q^(nu^T T h). (4) For each fixed u the v sum is N^m if u=0 and zero otherwise. The extra Gaussian therefore has coefficient ONE, at every N, with no determinant character, unknown periodic unit or knot normalization. This statement survives the ORIGINAL source pairing, including the contracted closure jets. Indeed the change (2) does not change nu or h, and (4) holds coefficientwise before any anchor substitution, charged coefficient, clock sum or external scalar. Hence those operations commute with eliminating this normalized Gaussian. No source division is used. It is important that the shifts in (2) depend on the coefficient momenta nu,h. They describe a canonical Fourier stabilization, not a single substitution of the physical spectator coordinates. They cannot be used to replace the coupled action by the zero-feedback action. ## 2. Exact Jacobian and Hessian comparison The same fact has a precise local stationary interpretation. Let x be any regular local phase coordinates, with scaled momenta nu(x),h(x). Write alpha=2*pi*i and let S_0(x) be the independent coefficient action. The extended action is S_ext(x,eta,lambda)=S_0(x) +alpha[lambda(h(x)-eta)+nu(x)^T T eta]. (5) Use the local change eta=h(x)+u, lambda=T^T nu(x)+v. (6) Its full Jacobian, including x, is block triangular with identity on the diagonal, so its determinant is EXACTLY one. There is the exact identity of functions, not just of quadratic terms, S_ext=S_act(x)-alpha v dot u, S_act=S_0+alpha nu(x)^T T h(x). (7) Consequently the critical scheme is the product of that of S_act with u=v=0, including multiplicities and local Artin rings. At a critical point the Hessian is congruent to Hess(S_act) direct_sum [[0,-alpha I],[-alpha I,0]]. (8) Thus nullity Hess(S_ext)=nullity Hess(S_act), det Hess(S_ext)=(-1)^m alpha^(2m)det Hess(S_act) (9) when the determinants are defined in the full coordinates. The same formula applies to nondegenerate transverse slices in a Morse--Bott germ, with the original radical retained. The normalized Fourier half-density has the exact coefficient (4), so this auxiliary block changes no selected transverse amplitude or residual source density. Equations (5)-(9) are used only when a regular coefficient phase is available. They do not assert uniform asymptotics across a finite window, an endpoint, or a singular Fourier chart. Equation (4) itself has none of those restrictions. ## 3. The complete geometric fixed set is not isolated by this operation There is a concrete obstruction to applying an isolated-fixed-point Bethe/Lefschetz formula after merely adding this feedback kernel. For the actual marked knot critical scheme, simultaneous conjugation by B_1=Stab_(PGL_2)(1) preserves the chosen inverse cut flag and all closed braid equations. This group has dimension two. At the complete discrete-faithful representation its projective centralizer is trivial, so its orbit is a smooth two-dimensional family of distinct marked critical points. This is exactly the framing torsor in [the actual geometric normal theorem](actual_geometric_normal_period.md), whose Hessian has that two-dimensional radical. In particular, for the regular marked Hurwitz return map Phi, its infinitesimal conjugation vectors obey D Phi(v)=v. Therefore det(I-D Phi)=0 before a stated framing reduction. Adding (1) does not repair that determinant: (7) preserves the critical germ and (8) preserves its radical. One may choose a transverse framing section and obtain the already proved nonzero normal Gaussian block. Its two-form must still be paired with the specified ORIGINAL relative source. Taking an arbitrary section or assigning its relative period the value one would add a source selection, rather than derive it from (4). The new closure contractions in [general flow fusion](actual_general_flow_fusion.md) do retain the original source exactly. Their full length-d block is the reproducing kernel of the finite source algebra: contraction through an arbitrary exterior implements substitution modulo the original nilpotent walls. It is an identity on the transmitted finite state space, with pivots retained. It supplies no additional framing section or condition on the geometric relative period. At a regular phase realization it removes identity-wire coordinates, not the conjugation orbit above. ## 4. Exact consequence for the critical path There is no unknown Gaussian normalization left in this part of the comparison. If a source-preserving regular phase comparison with the geometric chart is constructed, its feedback stabilization contributes one and leaves its geometric coefficient unchanged. This is useful normalization control. But the full source coefficient which would have to be shown nonzero is still the original one. Neither invertibility of G_T, its unit coefficient norm, the perfect socle pairing, nor the nonzero transverse determinant computes that coefficient. The precise unproved step is the image of the ORIGINAL relative class in the action-normalized geometric summand after the remaining framing/charge contraction. The Gaussian (1) does not weaken that step, since (4) eliminates it without changing that class. This result therefore rules out the proposed inference from a nonzero Fourier-Gaussian fiber to whole-source geometric survival. It is not a volume-conjecture proof, a new sharp scalar bound, or an assertion that a global positive contour cannot exist. ## 5. Reproducible audit [audit_actual_feedback_geometric_selection.py](../experiments/audit_actual_feedback_geometric_selection.py) checks (3)-(4) with actual diagram T rows, both crossing signs and arbitrary primitive exponent signs; compares the stabilized complete source with original pivotal signed matrices; and verifies the full Jacobian, stationary Hessian congruence, determinant and lifted framing radical on an explicit nonlinear regular phase germ. The finite identities and general proofs above are not inferred from the tests.

title: Complete figure-eight clock sectors and diagonal Gram metrics
text: # Complete figure-eight clock sectors and diagonal Gram metrics 29 October 2026. The exact factorial length frame has a polynomial ORIGINAL clock co-source. Nevertheless one fully anchor-contracted clock sector of the original figure-eight knot has twice the desired volume rate. Consequently every positive DIAGONAL clock metric has an exponentially excessive Cauchy budget on this actual source. This concerns a COMPLETE clock sector, after its anchor sums and original closure contractions. It is not an expanded crossing state or an arbitrary inserted coupon. It does not disprove Cauchy--Schwarz, the volume conjecture, or a coherent non-diagonal special inner product. ## 1. The original source and its exact reduced table Use `q=exp(pi*i/N)`, `Q=q^2`, `d=N-1`, `x=-q^-1`, `F_a=(Q;Q)_a`, `s_a=|F_a|`. The actual word is `[1,-2,1,-2]`. Its clocks are the original overclocks `(h_0,h_1,h_2,h_3)`. The [whole charged source](actual_global_charged_bridge_flow.md) and [actual closure contractions](actual_general_flow_fusion.md) give K_N=sum_h K_(N;h), K_(N;h)=(chi_N/N) zeta_(N;h) C_(N;h), |zeta|=1. (1) `chi_N` is the unchanged original external dimension/framing line; at completeness its modulus and inverse have polynomial size. Every common Cartan, pivot and source factor stays in (1). `zeta` consists only of the explicitly retained powers of `x,Q`, the crossing Cartan phases and the closure-rescaling monomials. No unknown knot scalar has been divided out. The full source support gives `h_0=0`, before any separate-sector Schur argument. In the rescaled anchors of [the actual alternating-source table](actual_alternating_balanced_source.md#3-a-second-support-inequality-in-the-actual-reduced-polynomial), write `B_L(U,V;Q^p)=product_(r<L)(U-Q^(p+r)V)`. Then C_(N;h)=[A^d B^d C^d D^d] product of these EIGHT blocks: | tail -> head | length | p | | --- | --- | --- | | B -> C | d-h_0 | 0 | | C -> A | h_0 | 1 | | D -> A | d-h_1 | h_1+1 | | A -> B | h_1 | -h_1+h_2+1 | | C -> B | d-h_2 | h_0+h_2+2 | | B -> D | h_2 | -h_2-h_3-1 | | A -> D | d-h_3 | -h_1 | | D -> C | h_3 | 0 | This table includes the original pivotal closure substitutions. For auditability, `zeta` in (1) is obtained without any scalar choice by: the `charged_data` weight; the `normalized_graph` tail monomials; the `contract_edge` closure factors; and the substitutions of anchors `B,D` by `x^-1 B,x^-1 D`. Each factor is an original root of unity. Those exact operations are implemented in the audit linked below. The normalized blocks b_L=B_L/D_L, D_L=s_L^(1/2)/N^(1/4) have `D_(d-h_i)D_(h_i)=1` at each crossing. Thus the product of all EIGHT table normalizers is exactly one. The coefficient `C_(N;h)` is also the completely contracted normalized-b clock STATE in this closure-contracted presentation. The co-source remains polynomial, as in [the exact clock-source theorem](actual_length_gauge_clock_source.md). ## 2. A uniform family with no internal cancellation Let N=3k+1, d=3k, h=(0,2k,k,2k), k>=1, beta_(L,r)=|[L choose r]_Q|=s_L/(s_r s_(L-r)), S_k=sum_(r=0)^k beta_(2k,r) beta_(2k,k-r)>0. (2) Then the COMPLETE table coefficient is exactly C_(N;(0,2k,k,2k))=N q^(3k^2-2k) S_k/F_k. (3) In particular the ORIGINAL sector modulus is |K_(N;(0,2k,k,2k))|=|chi_N| S_k/s_k. (4) Here is a direct coefficient proof. The full `B_d(B,C;1)` contracts `B=Q^-1 C`. Its `C -> B` loop is `C^(2k)N/F_k`. Reversing the `D -> A` interval and concatenating it with the `A -> D` interval produces `B_(2k)(A,D;Q)` with reversal factor xi_1=(-Q^(2k+1))^k Q^[k(k-1)/2]. The replacement in `B -> D` contributes `Q^-k`. For the two remaining C/D intervals use B_k(C,D;Q^(-3k)) B_(2k)(D,C;1) =xi_J (C^N-D^N)/(C-Q^(-2k)D), xi_J=(-1)^(2k)Q^[(2k)(2k-1)/2]. (5) For `0<=r<=k` its coefficient of `C^(k-r)D^(2k+r)` is `xi_J Q^[-2k(2k+r)]`. The remaining A/D extraction is therefore the `D^k` coefficient of `B_(2k)(A,D;Q)^2`, times the displayed common root factors. Indeed the second interval has effective start `Q^(k-2k-2k)=Q^(-3k)=Q`. The coefficient of `A^(2k-r)D^r` in `B_(2k)(A,D;Q)` is (-q^(2k+1))^r beta_(2k,r). Consequently every summand of its `D^k` coefficient has the SAME phase. Combining this phase, (5), `xi_1` and `Q^-k` gives precisely `q^(3k^2-2k)`, proving (3). All finite sums, including the loop factor, have been evaluated; no uncontracted anchor is left. ## 3. Its exact exponential rate Put `Lambda(theta)=-integral_0^theta log(2sin u)du` and `v_3=3 Lambda(pi/3)`. The successive ratios of `beta_(2k,r)` are beta_(2k,r+1)/beta_(2k,r) =sin((2k-r)pi/N)/sin((r+1)pi/N), which decrease with `r` because `(2k+1)pi/N<pi`. Hence the symmetric summands in `S_k` are maximal at the integer(s) nearest `k/2`. The sum lies between that maximum and `(k+1)` times it. The uniform factorial estimate, including its endpoints, is log s_a=-(N/pi)Lambda(pi*a/N)+O(log N). It follows directly that lim_(k->infinity) (1/N)log(S_k/s_k) =[3Lambda(pi/3)+2Lambda(pi/6)]/pi =2v_3/pi=Vol(4_1)/pi. (6) The elementary Lobachevsky duplication identity gives `2Lambda(pi/6)=3Lambda(pi/3)=v_3`. The identification `Vol(4_1)=2v_3` uses its two regular ideal tetrahedra, rather than an asymptotic volume formula for the invariant. Thus the actual complete sector has lim (2pi/N)log|K_(N;h)|=2 Vol(4_1). (7) This is larger than the desired full-knot rate `Vol(4_1)`. The full original figure-eight scalar does have that latter rate by its separately proved positive finite sum. There must therefore be cancellation between COMPLETE clock sectors in this exact frame. ## 4. What this forces on a special inner product For the flat clock energy `G_N=sum_h |K_(N;h)|^2`, (7) gives liminf_(N=1 mod3) (pi/N)log G_N >=2 Vol(4_1). (8) The same exponent holds for the normalized-b state energy, because the original co-source coefficient in (1) has only polynomial norm. This rules out identifying that flat energy, up to subexponential factors, with a positive geometric angle partition of rate `Vol/pi`. More generally let `K=sum_h a_h f_h`. For EVERY positive diagonal metric `G=diag(g_h)` the exact Cauchy budget is B(G)=(sum_h g_h|f_h|^2)(sum_h |a_h|^2/g_h) >=(sum_h |a_h f_h|)^2. (9) The infimum over all positive `g_h` is the right side, obtained by `g_h` proportional to `|a_h|/|f_h|`; zero entries follow by limits. In particular (7) makes ALL diagonal-clock Cauchy budgets too large for the desired geometric upper exponent, even when the metric depends arbitrarily on `N` and on the entire diagram. For a general positive definite, possibly non-diagonal `G`, the Riesz vector of the linear co-source `sum_h a_h f_h` is `conj(a)`. Consequently its budget is B(G)=(f^*Gf)(a^T G^(-1)conj(a)) >=||f||^2 ||a||^2/kappa(G). (10) In the original singleton source `||a||` has polynomial upper and lower bounds, while this fixture gives `||f||^2>=exp[2N Vol(4_1)/pi-o(N)]`. Therefore a sharp budget `B(G)<=exp[N Vol(4_1)/pi+o(N)]` requires log kappa(G)>=N Vol(4_1)/pi-o(N) (11) along this subsequence. Exponential conditioning is allowed: the factorial metrics already exhibit it. Equation (11) is not a nonexistence theorem. It says that a successful coherent Gram has to retain genuine phase cancellation; a diagonal reweighting cannot replace it. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_figure_eight_clock_gram.py): the literal original reduced table and its exact root-field coefficient, the common-phase formula (3), positive-sum maximum bounds and the large-level rate. The proof above is uniform in all `k`.

title: The fixed complete Hermite energy overshoots the original figure-eight rate
text: # The fixed complete Hermite energy overshoots the original figure-eight rate 29 October 2026. The complete positive channel metric constructed in [the actual source multiplicity module](actual_complete_source_multiplicity_module.md) has polynomial BOTH original boundary norms. Its full coherent energy nevertheless exceeds the sharp knot-volume rate already for the literal original figure-eight word. This is proved by one EXACT complete channel, not by a dephased path, an unconstrained clock sector, or a numerical fit. For every odd N=2m+1>=3, the simple Casimir channel c=-2 has the exact amplitude z_simple=N Q^[m(m+1)] F_m B_m, B_m=sum_(r=0)^m |[m choose r]_Q|^2 >0. (1) All original Cartan phases and cap/cup normalizations are included. Consequently the normalized fixed-Gram energy satisfies E_N >=N^2 B_m^2, log(N^2 B_m^2)=N v_8/pi+O(log N), (2) where v_8=4 Catalan is the regular ideal octahedron volume. Since v_8>Vol(S^3 minus 4_1), this fixed Gram CANNOT supply a sharp figure-eight energy upper bound. It remains a valid Cauchy metric. The obstruction concerns this explicitly specified complete energy, not every coherent metric or a source-specific regrouping. ## 1. The complete metric and the ORIGINAL word Use N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2, x=-q^-1=q^d, F_a=(Q;Q)_a, and kappa=q^(d^2/2). On the complete N-dimensional three-head Hom space W use the physical basis |a,d-a>. Let R be the ORIGINAL positive pair crossing on degree d, including kappa, and let J be the exact symmetric anti-Pascal recoupling from [the complete module](actual_complete_source_multiplicity_module.md). The original pair source is p_a=Nx^(a-d), ell_a=x^a/N. The full signed generators are R_12=R and R_23=J^-1 R J. Let V be the COMPLETE degree-d canonical Hermite frame of the actual pair Casimir A, with f_0(c)=1, and define S=V^-1 J, G_N=S^*S/N. The metric is full rank and depends only on the original module and N. Its normalized ordinary-cap dual norm is <=1 and its initial cup energy is O(N^2), as proved in the complete source theorem. The TRUE figure-eight four-plat has chronological word [2,-1,2,2], W=R_23^2 R_12^-1 R_23. (3) It is NOT the original three-braid trace word with a newly attached cup. The [whole-source proof](figure_eight_whole_source_identity.md) identifies (3), its literal turns and its oriented framing. At completeness it gives EXACTLY ell Wp=K_N(4_1)=sum_(a=0)^d |F_a|^2. (4) In particular no unknown knot scalar is used to define G_N. The complete coherent output and normalized energy tested here are z=SWp, E_N=||z||_2^2/N. (5) The external line chi_N, if retained as a separate convention, is put inside the transported state and multiplies (5) by |chi_N|^2. In the reduced, zero-framing normalization (4) the scalar is the displayed positive original period. We never replace the full Cartan by its modulus inside the finite algebra below. ## 2. A positive full-channel covector, derived from the actual Casimir Assume N=2m+1. The pair Casimir has the SIMPLE channel c_m=q^(2m+1)+q^(-2m-1)=-2. It has no derivative column. Let f=f(-2) be its canonical eigenvector f_0=1. The exact identities from the source module are J=J^T, J A J^-1=B^T, B e_j=c_j e_j+b_j e_(j-1), c_j=q^(2j+1)+q^(-2j-1), b_j=Q^j+Q^-j-2. (6) For completeness symmetry of J follows directly from its formula: J_ij/J_ji reduces to1 using F_jF_(d-j)=N(-1)^j Q^[j(j+1)/2] and x^2Q=1. Set y=Jf. Since (B^T+2)y=0, its coordinates below m are zero. For j=m+r, r>=1, its recurrence has the real positive ratio y_(m+r)/y_(m+r-1)=b_(m+r)/b_r =|1-Q^(m+1-r)|^2/|1-Q^r|^2. The last row of J is e_0^T, so y_d=f_0=1. Thus EXACTLY y_i=0 for i<m, y_(m+r)=|[m choose r]_Q|^2, 0<=r<=m. (7) This is an eigenvector calculation on the COMPLETE original module. It retains the coherent q-Hahn sums within f and J. No path phases have been deleted. The root phases cancel only in the proved recurrence (7). ## 3. The original finite source reduces the selected channel to one sum The first actual crossing on the cup has the exact highest-chart coefficient (R_23 p)_a=kappa p_a F_(d-a). (8) Indeed the cup has third physical color0, and extracting output third color0 uses the literal ground-output coefficient R_(b,0;b,0)=kappa F_b. This does not change the rest of the source. Set v=R^-1(R_23 p). In RIGHT physical coordinates the remaining two R_23 factors are R^2. At the simple channel its CD inverse row is f^T/sigma, with sigma=x^d nu_m, nu_m=(-1)^m q^[m(m+1)], kappa^2=x^d. Consequently the full simple-channel coordinate is z_simple=(kappa^2 nu_m^2/sigma)y^T v=nu_m y^T v. (9) All kappa factors have been accounted for, rather than dropped. Here is a source-exact finite evaluation of y^T v. Substitution of the ORIGINAL negative crossing into (8), followed only by root complementation of factorials, gives for every 0<=i<=d v_i=x^(i-d)(-1)^i Q^[i(i+1)/2-d] F_(d-i)/F_i *sum_(b=i)^d Q^b F_b^3/F_(b-i). (10) This is the full negative matrix applied to (8), not one route. Put zeta_m=(-1)^m x^-m Q^[m(m+1)/2+1]. Using (7), each term in the selected contraction becomes exactly y_(m+r)v_(m+r) =zeta_m Q^(r^2)/F_r^2 *sum_(b=m+r)^(2m) Q^b F_b^3/F_(b-m-r). Swap b=m+t and r. The elementary finite Durfee-square identity sum_(r=0)^t Q^(r^2)/(F_r^2 F_(t-r))=1/F_t^2 (11) therefore gives y^T v=zeta_m Q^m F_m^3 U_m, U_m=sum_(t=0)^m Q^t (a;Q)_t^3/F_t^2, a=Q^-m=Q^(m+1). (12) One direct proof of (11) works first with a formal variable Q. The generating function for partitions with largest part at most t is1/F_t. Decomposing them by Durfee square r gives sum_r Q^(r^2)[t choose r]_Q/F_r: the right rectangle contributes the Gaussian polynomial and the lower partition contributes1/F_r. Substitution of the factorial expression gives (11). This rational identity extends to the present root because all its factorial indices are<N. No convergence argument at a unit root is used. ## 4. An elementary terminating transform makes the WHOLE projection positive The finite identity needed in (12) is U_m=(-1)^m Q^[-m(3m+1)/2] B_m, B_m=sum_(k=0)^m Q^[-k(m-k)] [m choose k]_Q^2. (13) The last summands are precisely the positive magnitudes in (1). Here is a derivation, independently reproduced in the [finite transform proof](actual_half_color_quadratic_source_transform.md). Expand the THIRD (a;Q)_t by the finite q-binomial theorem and put t=k+j,n=m-k. Its inner sum is the terminating Chu identity sum_(j=0)^n (Q^-n;Q)_j^2 Q^j/ [F_j(Q^(k+1);Q)_j] =Q^(-n^2)(a;Q)_n F_k/F_m. (14) For a direct finite proof, the general identity with one numerator replaced by b and the denominator by c is sum_(j=0)^n (Q^-n;Q)_j(b;Q)_j Q^j/[F_j(c;Q)_j] =b^n(c/b;Q)_n/(c;Q)_n. After multiplication by (c;Q)_n it is the Newton expansion of product_(i=0)^(n-1)(b-cQ^i) in the basis (b;Q)_j. The recursion b(b;Q)_j=Q^-j[(b;Q)_j-(b;Q)_(j+1)] and Gaussian Pascal give its coefficients by induction. Taking b=Q^-n,c=Q^(k+1), and Q^(m+1)=a proves (14). Inserting (14), use (a;Q)_k=(-1)^k Q^[-mk+k(k-1)/2] F_m/F_(m-k). The total sign is(-1)^m. Its exponent is -m(3m+1)/2-k(m-k). The remaining factorial ratio is [m choose k]_Q^2. This proves (13) with no uncomputed scalar. Combining (12),(13), its remaining phase is Q^[-2m^2+m+1]=Q^[(1-m)(2m+1)]=1. Hence y^T v=F_m^3 B_m. Finally F_m^2=N nu_m, and (9) yields z_simple=nu_m F_m^3 B_m=N nu_m^2 F_m B_m, which is exactly (1). This proves the witness for EVERY odd level, including composite levels, using only nonzero factorials of index<N. ## 5. Rigorous exponential excess of the normalized complete energy Let J(t)=integral_0^t log(2sin(pi*s))ds and Lambda(theta)=-integral_0^theta log(2sin u)du. The uniform root factorial estimate gives, simultaneously for every 0<=r<=m, log |[m choose r]_Q| =N[J(m/N)-J(r/N)-J((m-r)/N)]+O(log N). At m/N->1/2 the unique maximum is r/N->1/4. The derivative is log[sin(pi*(m/N-t))/sin(pi*t)], so its unique zero is t=m/(2N), with the expected sign on either side. Rounding to the nearest integer changes the objective by O(log N/N). There are only m+1 positive summands. Therefore log B_m=(4N/pi)Lambda(pi/4)+O(log N) =(2N/pi) Catalan+O(log N). (15) Here Catalan=2Lambda(pi/4); J(1/2)=0. Since |F_m|^2=N, the selected coordinate of (5) alone proves E_N>=|z_simple|^2/N=N^2 B_m^2, liminf_(N odd) log E_N/N>=8Lambda(pi/4)/pi=v_8/pi. (16) The original scalar (4) instead has squared rate Vol(S^3 minus 4_1)/pi=6Lambda(pi/3)/pi. Strict concavity of Lambda on(0,pi/3), with Lambda(0)=0, gives Lambda(pi/4)>(3/4)Lambda(pi/3). Thus v_8=8Lambda(pi/4)>6Lambda(pi/3)=Vol(S^3 minus 4_1). The excess is strict, without relying on numerical knot recognition or a fitted limit. In particular no polynomial factor can repair a sharp-volume upper bound for THIS E_N. We do not assert that the full energy limit equals v_8/pi. The proved lower witness is enough to decide the question. Other complete channels can only increase this positive energy. The ordinary-cap scalar still sums their VALUE coordinates COHERENTLY and gives (4). Thus the excess is not a counterexample to the invariant's volume limit or to Cauchy--Schwarz; it locates cancellation/energy discarded by this fixed metric. A non-diagonal source/word regrouping can change that energy and is not excluded. The same witness also applies to the complete diagonal CD-weighted channel metric with block weight |sigma_j|: its simple c=-2 weight is EXACTLY1. More generally any replacement channel metric bounded below by exp(-o(N)) times the identity retains the exponential excess. This does not exclude a coherent non-diagonal terminal/source Gram with a small eigenvalue on the offending full packet. Such a Gram requires an additional actual contraction or source argument; the polynomial boundary norms alone do not supply it. ### No positive metric separated by Casimir node has a sharp Cauchy budget There is a stronger conclusion that does not require a lower bound on the metric. Work in the full channel coordinates z=SWp and keep the actual cap row a=ell S^(-1). At the SIMPLE odd-level node c=-2, a_s=x^d/N, z_s=N Q^[m(m+1)]F_m B_m. Let D_N be ANY positive Hermitian metric block diagonal by distinct Casimir nodes. Its two-by-two Hermite blocks may be arbitrary positive matrices; their weights may depend exponentially on N or on the word. The isolated simple block is some number g_s>0. Positivity gives a D_N^(-1) a^*>=|a_s|^2/g_s, z^*D_N z>=g_s|z_s|^2. Consequently its ENTIRE Cauchy budget, not merely its state energy, satisfies (a D_N^(-1) a^*)(z^*D_N z) >=|a_s z_s|^2=N B_m^2. (17) By (15) this has exponential rate v_8/pi, strictly above the squared original invariant's rate. Thus arbitrary reweighting of separate Casimir nodes cannot fix the estimate by trading source cost against state energy. The sharp metric must mix distinct nodes, or use an actual coherent packet contraction that does so. The [terminal positive Gram](actual_terminal_packet_positive_gram.md) provides precisely such a contraction on the same full module for the benchmark, with all original source factors retained. ## 6. Stable whole-source audit [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_figure_eight_complete_channel_energy.py) retains the literal full original R and inverse, all half-Cartan kappas, the complete cup and cap, and the actual chronological word (3). Exact finite-field checks verify the selected FULL channel, not an isolated path. High-precision complex checks use the original q-binomial pair matrix, its exact antiunitary negative, and the closed CD inverse blocks. There is NO ill-conditioned dense numerical inverse. The exact scalar is compared to (4) at every tested level. The saved audit reports eight exact odd-root source witnesses, ten growing-level high-precision complete energies through N=129, and precision-refinement comparisons including the highest tested level. These are supplementary to Sections2--5, which prove the all-odd-level witness and strict exponential excess. The independent finite-transform artifact checks its elementary identities separately from the asymptotic.

title: Actual ordinary-color q-jets: one-volume growth and a macroscopic tame source
text: # Actual ordinary-color q-jets: one-volume growth and a macroscopic tame source 28 October 2026. The ordinary-color VALUES are polynomial at q_N, but their q-normal derivatives need not be. For the actual figure-eight state, the first derivative at color N-1 has the sharp volume exponent, with an explicit positive formula and leading constant. Nevertheless EVERY fixed-order q-jet, uniformly over all ordinary colors, has at most that ONE-volume exponent, not two volumes. A separate positive-plat argument gives a genuinely broad source filtration: every fixed q-jet is polynomial for colors k(j-1)+1<=N in a fixed k-bridge presentation. This includes the entire figure-eight half-orbit and its midpoint. It permits restarting the actual fixed-budget pointed recurrence at a macroscopic color, with polynomial data and no input from the complete value. ## 1. The actual whole-source cyclotomic polynomial Use the independently proved ordinary-color identity C_j(q)=sum_(k=0)^(j-1) T_(j,k)(q), T_(j,k)=product_(r=1)^k (q^(2j)+q^(-2j)-q^(2r)-q^(-2r)). (1) Its reduced unknot normalization, crossing Cartan phases and zero framing are the original ones. At roots (1) is the actual Newton state of the pointed Green theorem; for fixed j the generic Laurent identity follows from the independently identified ordinary quotient at infinitely many levels. Thus (1) is not fitted to K_N. Put q_N=exp(pi i/N), Q=q_N^2, F_k=(Q;Q)_k and J(s)=integral_0^s log(2sin(pi t))dt, gamma=max J=J(5/6), Delta=2gamma=Vol(4_1)/(2pi). All q-derivatives below keep the integer color j FIXED. They are not meridian derivatives or derivatives along a changing root level. ## 2. A sharp exact first jet at the top ordinary color Write D_q=q d/dq. For every N>=3, (D_q C_(N-1))(q_N) =-2N(Q-Q^-1) sum_(k=1)^(N-2) |F_(k-1) F_(k+1)|/|F_2|. (2) Every summand is POSITIVE real before the displayed common phase. Indeed all nonconstant T_(N-1,k) contain the root-zero factor r=1. Its derivative is -2N(Q-Q^-1). Every remaining factor is Q+Q^-1-Q^r-Q^-r =4sin(pi(r+1)/N)sin(pi(r-1)/N)>0, 2<=r<=N-2. Multiplication gives precisely the factorial quotient in (2), with the k=1 empty product equal to one. This is a derivative of the COMPLETE original ordinary state, rather than an individual large summand. Its value C_(N-1)(q_N)=1 does not control this jet. The exact leading asymptotic, through ALL integer levels, is (D_q C_(N-1))(q_N) =-i N^(7/2)/(pi 3^(1/4)) exp(N Delta)(1+o(1)). (3) Proof. Uniformly on compact 0<s<1 the elementary factorial estimate is |F_k|=sqrt(2Nsin(pi k/N)) exp(NJ(k/N))(1+O(1/N)), and its all-index version has logarithmic error O(log N). Also |F_2|=8pi^2/N^2 (1+O(N^-2)). Thus the summand in (2), at s=k/N, is [N^3 sin(pi s)/(4pi^2)] exp(2NJ(s))(1+O(1/N)). The exponent has its unique global maximum at s=5/6 and second derivative -2pi sqrt(3). Endpoint-uniform estimates discard its complement exponentially. Rescale k=5N/6+sqrt(N)xi. The lattice Gaussian sum has integral 3^-1/4, with arbitrary fractional part of 5N/6. Since sin(5pi/6)=1/2, its sum is N^(7/2)/(8pi^2 3^(1/4)) exp(NDelta)(1+o(1)). Finally -2N(Q-Q^-1)=-8pi i(1+O(N^-2)). This proves (3). At N=2 the only ordinary color is trivial and the first jet is zero. ## 3. Uniform ONE-volume upper bound for every fixed q-jet For every fixed nonnegative integer r there are constants A,C_r independent of N and j such that |[t^r] C_j(q_N(1+t))| <=C_r N^(A+4r) exp(NDelta), 1<=j<N. (4) The same assertion holds for logarithmic derivatives D_q^r, with a different fixed C_r. It controls the ENTIRE fixed-order ordinary jet vector, up to polynomial dimension factors. In particular fixed jets do not accumulate a two-volume rate in this example. Here is a direct all-color proof, including activated root zeros. For each factor in (1), at q_N, f_(j,r)=-4sin(pi(j+r)/N)sin(pi(j-r)/N). For r<j<N it is zero only when j+r=N, and there is at most ONE such factor in a product. Every nonzero factor has magnitude at least 16/N^2. Every fixed-order derivative of a factor is bounded by C_r N^r. Repeated Leibniz differentiation therefore costs at most C_r N^(4r) times the product of all NONZERO root factors: there are at most N^r choices of differentiated factors, at most r removed nonzero factors, and derivative powers cost N^r. An undifferentiated zero simply makes that term zero. It remains to bound these root products, not to assume them tame. If k<min(j,N-j), their exact magnitude is |T_(j,k)(q_N)| =|F_(j+k)|/[|1-Q^j| |F_(j-k-1)|]. (5) Its logarithm is at most N(max J-min J)+O(log N)=NDelta+O(log N). If j>N/2 and k>=m=N-j, the zero at r=m is removed; the remaining absolute product is EXACTLY |F_(k+m) F_(k-m)|/[|1-Q^m| |1-Q^(2m)|]. (6) All factorial indices are in 0,...,N-1 and 2m<N. Since each J is at most gamma and the two denominators are bounded below by 4/N, (6) has the same exponential upper bound. Equations (5)--(6), the all-index factorial estimate and the additional sum over k prove (4). This proof does not rely on cancellations or an ordinary-jet bound which is being inferred from the desired volume theorem. ## 4. A broad polynomial window, including the midpoint The independent positive-plat/source proof in [the macroscopic normal-jet window](ordinary_color_macroscopic_normal_jet_window.md) gives, for ANY fixed knot with a k-bridge plat and every fixed r, |[t^r]C_j(q_N(1+t))|<=C_(K,k,r) N^(c_(K,k,r)) whenever k(j-1)+1<=N. (7) The inclusive endpoint is important. Its elementary inputs are: * The actual endpoint-zero TL path space for the 2k(j-1)-strand cable has maximum height k(j-1). On the one-sided arc theta in [pi/(2N),pi/N), all required sine weights are positive. * Actual colored cups have squared norm [j]^k, and the reduced original closure divides by exactly [j], giving the generic-arc bound |C_j(exp(i theta))|<=[j]_theta^(k-1). * The actual zero-framed finite cut is Laurent in q^(1/2) of degree O_K(j^2). Clearing its denominator after a tangent-half-angle substitution makes an ordinary polynomial on an interval of length comparable to 1/N; the clearing factor varies by O_K(1). Elementary Chebyshev coefficient/derivative bounds give polynomial fixed derivatives, including at the one-sided endpoint. The proof takes the invariant polynomial to the endpoint, rather than differentiating a singular path basis or a zero quantum dimension. For k>=2 the relevant ordinary [j] is nonzero. For the figure-eight, k=2. Thus every fixed q-jet is polynomial uniformly through j=floor((N+1)/2). In particular the midpoint has NO positive exponential jet rate. No matching positive lower rate is claimed there: a particular derivative may vanish. On the other hand (3) proves sharp one-volume growth near the far endpoint. The polynomial source filtration therefore separates actual tame half-orbit data from exponentially large far normal response. ## 5. Restart the ACTUAL pointed system without using C_N Assume k>=2; the one-bridge unknot is already identically one. Let an actual all-level annihilator have order d and pole budget B as in the pointed Gram theorem. Define J_N=1+floor((N-1)/k), j0=J_N-d+1. For large N, j0 is beyond the fixed exceptional starting colors. Prescribe the actual B-jets of C_(j0),...,C_(j0+d-1), all inside the polynomial window (7), and impose the SAME all-level recurrence through color N. This produces an exact tail pointed system with polynomial source supported in its initial d blocks. The original valuation proof still makes its constant values unique: the sum of leading-coefficient zero orders over this TAIL is no larger than the original uniform budget B. Subtraction of any two solutions with zero prescribed initial jets therefore leaves every constant coefficient zero. Nothing in that induction requires a starting color fixed independently of N; the bounded source was the missing quantitative input, now supplied by (7). After the same jet scaling the tail bulk symbol and all normal resonance data are unchanged. Its starting coordinate tends to 1/k, rather than zero. This is an actual source-preserving improvement, not a definition using an unknown target value. A tail Green/transfer estimate still needs its singular-step and spectral control. In particular a general sharp Vol conclusion does not follow merely from this restart, nor from the figure-eight calculation (3)--(4). [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_figure_eight_ordinary_normal_jets.py): actual cyclotomic Taylor jets, all-color product identities, the positive endpoint formula and leading constant, and midpoint/tail growth diagnostics. Finite checks supplement the all-level proofs.

title: The actual regular figure-eight connection and regulator-fixed channels
text: # The actual regular figure-eight connection and regulator-fixed channels 28 October 2026. This tests the majorization criterion on the ACTUAL regular affine figure-eight quantum-A packet, rather than on the already excluded positive pivotal trace of the original crossing. The natural instantaneous modal connection is not a scalar multiple of a unitary. Its polar unitary is bistochastic but does not fix the geometric regulator observable.
