The source degree in (10) has a precise meaning. On a source space of dimension N+1 with the ordinary coherent degree N, B_N(J)=(1/N)sigma_(diag(J_0,...,J_N))(T=1/2). (14) This is an ordinary coherent source-current realization, not an assertion that the knot representation has changed color. In particular an N-dimensional head row alone cannot replace the j=N endpoint in (10). ## 4. The exact least-moment Green certificate maps to this relative complex The original arrays of [the full Green certificate](full_certificate_framing_boundary.md) already contain their prescribed 1/N. Write them as I_raw and J_(i,raw). Before using the matrix-normalized rows (7), define explicitly I_mat=N I_raw, J_(i,mat)=N J_(i,raw). (14a) The same pointwise Green identity holds for these rescaled arrays, since every external coefficient and shift commutes with N. Summing the noncut indices gives exactly the actual cut diagonal C_jj from I_mat, and J_cut below always means the corresponding J_mat sum. Thus the actual selected scalar is `(1/N)sum_j I_mat,j=sum_j I_raw,j`. This rescaling does not change the state; it aligns its original normalized array with its coherent matrix coefficient. Apply (11)--(13) coefficientwise to I_mat and J_mat. The weights depend only on the cut index. They commute with every other flow translation, with coupling derivatives in those other variables, and with its external meridian Ore operators. Cut-index moment factors remain inside J itself. Thus the cut divergence maps to the explicit wall row (10), while all other unsummed flow divergences remain literal currents. In particular first sum only the actual finite transverse indices, leaving the cut j and the other framing index k. Denote the resulting matrix-normalized arrays by calI and calJ_1,calJ_2. The exact least-moment certificate becomes the specified two-current identity (-1)^h A_alpha lambda_(N,rel)^+(calI) = B_N(calJ_1)+(S_k-1)lambda_(N,rel)^+(calJ_2), (-1)^h A_alpha lambda_(N,rel)^-(calI) =-B_N(calJ_1)+(S_k-1)lambda_(N,rel)^-(calJ_2). (14b) Thus one framing divergence has been converted into a concrete degree-elevated wall row with its endpoints retained. This is a finite source/current pushforward, not a replacement of the finite transverse sum by the internal formal Gaussian. The second divergence in (14b) has not been assigned an unjustified Weyl action. After summing the noncut finite indices, write J_cut for the resulting matrix-normalized cut current. Since the original unweighted closed cut is scalar, each hemisphere evaluates the original state to F_N/2. The actual scalar annihilator therefore implies B_N(J_cut)=0, (15) with its full shifted endpoint convention. This is an exact finite source constraint, not an inference from a locally nonzero or zero Gaussian coefficient. The two charts' signed wall sources cancel in (13) even before using (15). Equivalently one may keep raw arrays throughout and use the rows N lambda_N^+, N lambda_N^- and N B_N. In that convention the endpoint counterterms are exactly J_(cut,raw,0) and J_(cut,raw,N), since `J_mat/N=J_raw`. The coefficient N in this equivalence is essential and is not suppressed. For the second external framing index one still has a literal finite zero-extended sum and its endpoint currents. It is not an extra independent cut color. The actual Weyl identity (9) does not automatically act on that transfer index. An auxiliary second Bernstein source can encode its finite sum, but calling its reflection the actual quantum Weyl action would require a new network/current map. Neither (9) nor (15) supplies that identification after transverse Gaussian contraction. ## 5. The shared wall row has a macroscopic entropy phase Its coefficient at j/N=T in an interior real interval obeys (1/N)Log[binom(N,j)/2^N] =-Tlog T-(1-T)log(1-T)-log2+O(log N/N). (16) The elementary integral bounds for log(N!) give this uniformly on compact subintervals of (0,1). This real phase has a unique maximum at T=1/2 and second derivative -1/[T(1-T)]. Thus the row (10) is not an arbitrary order-one amplitude in a formal Gaussian comparison: it can localize and lift one framing direction. Its total positive weight is 1/N, but that alone does not bound a cancellation-prone Green current or an unknown selected knot sum. On the physical logarithmic section, T=1/2 has A_cut=-1, a regular complete framing. At the wall D_cut itself, however, A_cut=(1-eta v)^(-1) is infinite. The radial normal homotopy shares the base latitude T=1/2 while moving between those different normal points. The binomial row alone does not identify them without the relative normal-chain data. It does not prove that the remaining internal geometric critical point lies on the selected global source cycle, or that all other critical and escaping pieces are absent. ## 6. What is still unmatched The two source charts, their complete relative endpoint map, the degree-elevated wall row, and the nonzero Cech class (5) are now explicit for every actual finite source and Green current. They retain all marked Weyl/Gamma factors and can be computed before any partial trace or meridian specialization. The missing comparison is specific: the internal Gaussian pushforward of the actual currents must carry the rows `J_0/N`, `J_N/N`, and B_N(J), including their entropy phase, to the corresponding geometric endpoint and wall functionals. The second framing direction additionally needs an actual pre-collapse source map. Declaring those currents exact or identifying two abstract Borel actions does not compute it. In particular the known principal residue equality does not identify the lifted f_C nu_cut with every higher Gaussian current. The present construction does not claim that further map, nonzero selected geometric microstalk, a full scalar geometric-factor theorem, or a volume limit. ## 7. Exact audit [audit_actual_gauss_wall_cut_current.py](../experiments/audit_actual_gauss_wall_cut_current.py) and its [results](../experiments/actual_gauss_wall_cut_current_results.json) verify the incomplete-beta/binomial coefficients, Weyl complement and half normalizations, both head endpoint terms, and the complete zero-extended relative Green maps over Q for N=2 through 16. The current values are independent symbols, including both endpoint tails. All matrix-unit wall primitives and their Cech difference are checked at sizes 2 through 6. An additional entropy-phase grid checks the scale in (16). The proof is uniform in N and in the actual matrix coefficients; these checks are not knot examples and assume no selected asymptotic or quantum-to-Gaussian current identification.

title: General source-preserving fusion of the original charged network
text: # General source-preserving fusion of the original charged network 28 October 2026. Two exact operations apply to the WHOLE original charged source at arbitrary valency and arbitrary braid width: 1. A full length-N-1 block is the source reproducing kernel. It can be contracted through ANY polynomial exterior, not merely through one complementary Pochhammer. 2. A balanced trivalent charged star is exactly a triangle of three root intervals, with an explicit nonzero q-binomial scalar. The first operation contracts every original closure adapter of a nontrivial knot at the SOURCE level, retaining the actual pivots. The second is a genuine higher-valency fusion. Its proof is a root-orbit divisibility argument and degree rigidity, not a borrowed analytic pentagon or an assumed positive source. These operations do not yet reduce every original network or prove its selected geometric coefficient. A degree obstruction below explains why arbitrary charge stars cannot simply be declared balanced. ## 1. The source in which the operations are exact Use N>=2, d=N-1, Q=exp(2*pi*i/N), q=exp(pi*i/N). The [whole charged bridge theorem](actual_global_charged_bridge_flow.md) has already proved, with ALL original scalar lines retained, K_N=chi_N/N sum_h W_h lambda(P_h), lambda(P)=[X_1^d ... X_k^d]P, deg P_h=k d. (1) All h are the actual over-monotone clocks. The canonical [source theorem](actual_charged_socle_and_fermat_source.md) permits the SAME lambda to be evaluated in A_0=K[X_1,...,X_k]/(X_1^N,...,X_k^N). (2) This is an exact equality of the original selected period. It is not a rule setting every separate regular-grid factor to zero. The perfect multiplication pairing is lambda(X^a X^b)=delta_(a+b,d). In particular arbitrary polynomial exteriors are admissible in the algebraic identities below. No original coupon or scalar is removed. ## 2. Full blocks reproduce arbitrary exteriors Write B_L(X,Y;a)=product_(r=0)^(L-1)(X-Q^r aY). Root complementation gives B_d(X,Y;a)=sum_(j=0)^d X^(d-j)(aQ^(-1)Y)^j. (3) For ANY polynomial F(X,Y,U), with U denoting all other anchors, [X^d] B_d(X,Y;a)F(X,Y,U) =F(aQ^(-1)Y,Y,U) mod (Y^N,U_i^N). (4) There is no valency or individual-degree restriction on F. Indeed the left side is sum_(j<N)(aQ^(-1)Y)^j [X^j]F. Every missing term of the substitution has a factor Y^N and vanishes in (2). Pairing with the remaining original source proves (4) for the whole scalar. A tail coefficient alpha contributes its actual factor alpha^d. The reverse contraction, which may retain a preferred anchor, is [Y^d] B_d(X,Y;a)F(X,Y,U) =(aQ^(-1))^d F(X,(aQ^(-1))^(-1)X,U) mod (X^N,U_i^N). (5) All displayed monomial factors in (4)--(5) remain. If the two anchors already coincide, then B_d(X,X;a)=X^d G_N(aQ^(-1)), G_N(t)=sum_(j=0)^d t^j. Thus its source contraction is G_N(aQ^(-1)) times evaluation of the remaining polynomial at X=0, NOT a variable identification. For an actual root phase t=q^m, G_N(t)=N if m=0 mod 2N, 0 if m even, not0 mod2N, 2/(1-q^m) if m odd. (6) Every nonzero value has modulus between 1 and N. Its fixed-order logarithmic derivatives are bounded by N^(p+1), directly from the finite sum. This is a general tame fusion of a saturated source cycle, including its resonant value; no central norm is silently inverted at resonance. ### All original closure adapters can be contracted The closure numerator in the actual source is C(Z,Y)=sum_(j=0)^d Z^(d-j)(tY)^j=B_d(Z,Y;Qt), t=1 on the unpivoted cut, t=Q^(-1) on a pivotal head. Therefore its SOURCE relation is Z=tY, with the exact factors of (4) or (5). The original pivot scalar x^(1-N) also remains. This is the nilpotent-source contraction (4), not the forbidden pointwise matching of distinct regular Fermat grids or a bare Cauchy pole substitution. In the anchored graph the closure edges have in-degree and out-degree at most one. A closure-only cycle would follow a physical component through only UNDER encounters and closures, without any overbridge event. A one-component knot with at least one crossing has no such component: each of its self-crossings has an over encounter on the same component. Thus its closure edges form a forest. Contracting them by (4)--(5) removes ALL b boundary-adapter anchors, leaving exactly B anchors, one per open overbridge event (or their canonically identified representatives). This proves an exact globally sewn original source at the jet fiber. It retains chi_N/N and every pivot phase. It does not claim the raw four-Psi continuation has become periodic away from its sampling grid. For links with a closure-only component, the remaining cycle is instead evaluated by (6) and its accompanying zero-anchor substitution. ## 3. Balanced star--triangle identity Let k_1,k_2,k_3>=0, k_1+k_2+k_3=d, and L_i=d-k_i. For arbitrary nonzero a_i, the exact polynomial identity is [Z^d] product_(i=1)^3 B_(L_i)(X_i,Z;a_i) =C a_1^(k_2)a_2^(k_3)a_3^(k_1) *B_(k_3)(X_1,X_2;Q^(k_2+1)a_1/a_2) *B_(k_1)(X_2,X_3;Q^(k_3+1)a_2/a_3) *B_(k_2)(X_3,X_1;Q^(k_1+1)a_3/a_1), (7) C=(-1)^(k_1+k_3) Q^[k_1(k_1-1)/2+k_3(k_3-1)/2-k_2] *[d-k_2 choose k_3]_Q. (8) All lengths and factorials are at most d; the scalar is NONZERO. It must be retained. In particular its modulus need not be tame when all k_i are proportional to N. No half-volume or unknown period factor is absorbed into C. The balance condition is exactly L_1+L_2+L_3=2d. The three new lengths are k_i=d-L_i. The identity remains valid when some are zero, and after substituting coinciding outer variables. ### Proof by root covering and degree First set every a_i=1. The left side F has total outer degree d. For a cyclic pair (i,j) and the remaining index l, specialize X_i=Q^p X_j, p=k_j+1,...,k_j+k_l. The Z-root arcs of the two corresponding blocks are {Q^(p-r)X_j:0<=r<L_i}, {Q^(-s)X_j:0<=s<L_j}. Their union contains a FULL orbit of N roots. Equivalently their missing intervals, of lengths k_i+1 and k_j+1, are disjoint at precisely the displayed k_l positions. Hence the complete product of all three blocks is divisible, as a polynomial in Z, by X_j^N-Z^N. Its residual Z-degree is 2d-N=N-2=d-1. The coefficient of Z^d is therefore zero: the first term cannot reach degree d and the Z^N term already exceeds it. Thus F is divisible by all three displayed families of linear outer factors on the right of (7). Their total degree is k_1+k_2+k_3=d, exactly deg F, so their quotient is a scalar. The coefficient X_1^(L_1)X_2^(k_1) at X_3=0 fixes that scalar. It is (-1)^d Q^[k_3(k_3-1)/2+L_3(L_3-1)/2] [L_2 choose k_3]_Q on the left, and (-1)^(k_2) Q^[k_2(k_1+1)+k_2(k_2-1)/2] in the proposed product. Their ratio simplifies to (8). Finally rescale X_i by a_i and extract the factors a_i^(L_i). The remaining scalar powers are a_1^(k_2)a_2^(k_3)a_3^(k_1), which proves the full formula (7). Because (7) is an ordinary polynomial identity, it can be inserted inside ANY original exterior source pairing. The removed central anchor carries exactly its original charge d; every other anchor keeps its original charge. No scalar knot value is used to choose the normalization. Reversing any incident block is permitted with its exact monomial coefficient, so all strand orientations are covered. ### Connection and reverse move For a block of length L, its positive sine-binomial connection is w=-a q^(L-1). If the three star edges are oriented outer-to-center, then the new triangle edges obey exactly w_(i->j,new)=w_i/w_j. (9) Indeed the extra exponent is k_1+k_2+k_3+1=N and q^N=-1. Thus the new triangle is flat and has the same boundary path phases as the old star. Other nonflat cycles of the complete graph are not erased or declared positive. Conversely (7), divided by its explicit NONZERO scalar, inserts a charged anchor into a matching flat triangle. This is an exact source-preserving inverse move, including zero-length degeneracies. More explicitly, orient the triangle cyclically with lengths (k_3,k_1,k_2), sum d, and normalized root parameters (lambda_12,lambda_23,lambda_31). Its connection is flat precisely when lambda_12 lambda_23 lambda_31=Q^2. (10) Choose a_1=1, a_2=Q^(k_2+1)/lambda_12, and a_3=Q^(k_3+1)a_2/lambda_23. Equation (10) supplies the remaining edge. Thus the inverse has no unsolved normalizer or extension-field choice. A common nonzero rescaling of all a_i is simply the scale of the introduced anchor and is canceled by the retained scalar. This has a genuinely nonzero, nondegenerate typed application inside the ORIGINAL source, rather than only in an auxiliary graph. For the figure-eight word [1,-2,1,-2], its actual clocks h=(0,a,b,a+b), a>0, b>0, a+b<d, give the three bulk blocks of lengths (a,b,d-a-b) and holonomy one. The inverse move therefore has all three positive triangle lengths. At N=4, a=b=1, the complete original clock-sector coefficient is exactly 4(q^2-1), hence nonzero. The audit inserts the (2,2,2) star, retains its original exterior and inverse scalar, and checks the same coefficient. This example checks applicability of the general source identity; it is not a proof of nonvanishing for all clocks in the displayed family or a knot-volume asymptotic. ## 4. What simple source splitting can and cannot balance The full kernel (3) is also the canonical coproduct kernel of the source pairing. It permits splitting an anchor into two charged anchors joined by a full length-d edge, with an arbitrary partition of the old incident polynomial factors. This is exact by (4). Let the old incident lengths sum to S. Replace its neighborhood by r charged anchors and a TREE of r-1 such reproducing edges, without changing its external factors. The total incident length, counted at all new vertices, is S+2d(r-1). If every new vertex were a balanced star, that sum would be 2dr. Necessarily S=2d. Arc subdivision does not change S. Thus an unbalanced anchor cannot be converted to nothing but balanced stars merely by inserting source identity kernels and partitioning its old factors. A two-factor piece with lengths summing to d does give a balanced star after such a split, but its third edge is full length d and the triangle move has a zero-length edge. This alone is not a nondegenerate geometric triangulation. The local defect S-2d is additive under full-edge contraction and is unchanged at outer vertices by the balanced star--triangle move. Defects can be transported or combined; they cannot be silently discarded. Additional exact channel sums or a genuinely deficient-star identity would be needed for a universal reduction. ## 5. Scope of the general advance The full-kernel contraction performs the original boundary gluing at arbitrary valency. The balanced star--triangle move is an exact higher-valency rule inside the actual charge algebra, with its normalizer fixed and its root-orbit proof given above. Both commute with arbitrary exterior original source pairing and allow repeated application wherever their algebraic hypotheses hold. They do not prove that every charged knot graph admits an all-balanced trivalent resolution. Nor do they turn a general remaining cycle sum into positive weights or prove its geometric contribution survives. In particular no quantum determinant or general volume theorem is inferred from the existence of these local rules alone. For coverage only, root-of-unity Fermat and restricted star--triangle identities have substantial precedent, including [Faddeev--Kashaev, *Quantum Dilogarithm*](https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/9310070). No claim to the first such identity is intended. The independently proved implementation here is the ordinary polynomial identity with its exact scalar and the actual selected socle-source contraction; no proof or analytic contour from that literature is imported. ## 6. Reproducible audit python3 experiments/audit_actual_general_flow_fusion.py The audit checks the arbitrary-polynomial reproducing law, all balanced length triples and generic coefficients at several roots, connection transport, and contraction of every actual original closure adapter inside the whole charged source before comparison with the original signed physical word scalar.

title: A generic all-port single Racah kernel with actual Clebsch normalization
text: # A generic all-port single Racah kernel with actual Clebsch normalization 29 October 2026. This proves a SINGLE terminating balanced 4phi3 formula for every entry of the genuine inverse four-port recoupling matrix. All external nonnegative INTEGER highest weights are allowed, including half-integral spins and their actual cyclic-turn sign. The normalizer comes from a true boundary entry and a leading coefficient, not a quoted 6j evaluation or polynomial norm formula. The independent source is the actual two-sum/all-entry construction in [the ordinary four-port theorem](actual_ordinary_four_port_recoupling_kernel.md). All high channels and generic normal tails are retained. Root sign coherence, positive recoupling and sharp graph energy are not inferred. ## 1. Highest-weight notation and actual bases Use generic zeta, Q=zeta^2 and F_n=(Q;Q)_n. On the ordinary module V_A of INTEGER highest weight A>=0 use the original balanced generators and canonical cup: P_A(u)=(-1)^u zeta^[u(A-u-1)] F_u F_(A-u)/F_A, p_A(u,A-u)=P_A(u), ell_A=p_A^(-1), F|u>=(1-Q^(u+1))|u+1>, Ecal|u>=zeta^(-A-1)(1-Q^(A+1-u))|u-1>, K|u>=zeta^A Q^(-u). Take external highest weights A,B,C,D with even total. The allowed intermediate highest weights are E=max(|A-B|,|C-D|),...,min(A+B,C+D), step2, G=max(|B-C|,|D-A|),...,min(B+C,D+A), step2. (1) Assume these equal-cardinality ranges nonempty. Every W_AB^E has its first highest component one. Put m=(A+B-E)/2. Its actual highest coefficients are h_AB^E(s)=(-1)^s zeta^[s(A-2B+2m-s-1)] F_(B-m+s)F_(A-s)/(F_(B-m)F_A), (2) and W_AB^E[r]=Delta(F)^r h/F_r, with the canceled physical coproduct entries proved in the independent source theorem. Define FULL invariant columns in the SAME external A,B,C,D order: S_E=(W_AB^E tensor W_CD^E)p_E, T_G(u,v,w,z)=(-1)^A zeta^(A-2u) [(W_BC^G tensor W_DA^G)p_G](v,w,z,u). (3) The factor (-1)^A K_A is the ACTUAL last-to-first pivotal turn: ell_A^T p_A=(-1)^A K_A^(-1). It reduces to the older K_A for integer spins but its sign matters when A is odd. Scaled physical cups have reciprocal evaluations and retain this same snake. We prove S_E=sum_G L_(G,E)T_G on EVERY external color. These are inverse coefficients, not the specialized six-head source column. ## 2. Explicit product normalizers from actual boundary entries Set H=(A+B+C-D)/2, L=min(A,H), Gmax=min(A+D,B+C), n=(Gmax-G)/2, U=(C+E-D)/2, V=(D-C+E)/2, m=(A+B-E)/2, chi_E=(-1)^U zeta^[U(E-U-1)-CV] F_U F_D/(F_((C+D-E)/2) F_E). (4) The unique outer-color contribution in the true S column gives S_E(i,H-i,0,D)=chi_E W_AB^E[U](i,H-i). (5) Its LAST physical Clebsch entry X_E has a product evaluation: if L=H: X_E=F_H h_AB^E(m)/(F_m F_U); otherwise L=A, put k=E-U: X_E=(-1)^m zeta^[-AB+2Am-m^2-m+k(E-B)] F_(m+k)/(F_m F_k). (6) The first is the unique coproduct term with second color zero. For the second the proved lowest endpoint is W_AB^E[E](A,B-m)=(-1)^m zeta^[-AB+2Am-m^2-m]. Apply Ecal^(E-U). To finish with first color A every lowering must act on the second object. Its coefficient divided by the target coefficient zeta^[-(E-U)(E+1)]F_(E-U) gives (6). Thus no magnetic sum is hidden in X_E. For G put i0=(A+G-D)/2, m_bc=(B+C-G)/2, m_da=(D+A-G)/2. The first nonzero T-chart entry is b_G=(-1)^A zeta^(A-2i0) h_BC^G(m_bc) *(-1)^m_da zeta^[-AD+2D m_da-m_da(m_da+1)]. (7) Indeed T_G(i,H-i,0,D)=0 for i>i0, and its value at i0 is (7). It retains the canonical cup, the W_DA lowest endpoint and the odd-A cyclic sign. Every b_G is a nonzero generic product. Define also J_n=zeta^[-n(B+1)] F_L F_(B-H+L) /[F_(L-n)F_(B-H+L-n)], J_0=1. (8) This is the product of n lower off-diagonals of the ACTUAL first pair Casimir on physical prefix degree H: Omega_AB(i,i-1)=zeta^(-B-1) (1-Q^i)(1-Q^(B-H+i)). (9) All factorial indices in (4),(6),(7),(8) are nonnegative on their physical ranges. The formulas are source entries, not fitted gauges. ## 3. The single terminating balanced Racah formula If A+D<=B+C choose differences C-D,B-A; otherwise choose D-C,A-B. Their maximum is E_min=max(|A-B|,|C-D|). Call the larger s1=E_min and the other s2. Define alpha=zeta^(1+s1), beta=zeta^(1+s2), gamma=zeta^(-1-C-D), delta=zeta^(-1-A-B), P=alpha beta gamma delta=Q^(-Gmax), z_E=zeta^(E+1), K=zeta^(Gmax+1). (10) At equality this gives the same unordered parameter set. The first parameter alpha is fixed to specify the polynomial normalization. Put C_n=alpha^n(PQ^(n-1);Q)_n /(alpha beta,alpha gamma,alpha delta;Q)_n, G_n(E)=sum_(k=0)^n (Q^-n,PQ^(n-1),alpha z_E,alpha/z_E;Q)_k Q^k /(Q,alpha beta,alpha gamma,alpha delta;Q)_k. (11) Listed Pochhammers are multiplied. This is ONE finite sum, possibly terminated earlier by another numerator. All generic denominators are units in the physical length: alpha beta has positive exponent of Q, while alpha gamma and alpha delta first reach zero AFTER n. The leading coefficient C_n is nonzero generic. Then the exact all-entry source coefficient is L_(G,E)=chi_E X_E/(b_G J_n C_n) *G_n(E), S_E=sum_(G in (1)) L_(G,E)T_G. (12) No 6j formula, norm or orthogonality measure is an input. ## 4. The uniquely fixed actual Jacobi operator The actual fourth-leg bend identifies an invariant column with a highest-weight-D three-object column. Its third-color-zero chart w(i)=Psi(i,H-i,0,D), max(0,H-B)<=i<=L, is injective by the original highest equation and ordinary F descendants. The actual middle Casimir Bmid in that chart is the upper-bidiagonal matrix (Bmid)_ii=zeta^(D-A+1)Q^i+zeta^(-D+A-1)Q^(-i), (Bmid)_(i-1,i)=-zeta^(B+C-A-1)Q^(i-H) *(1-Q^(A+1-i))(1-Q^(H-i+1)). (13) This is the independently derived physical color0/color1 extraction. Let Amid=Omega_AB. The S_E and T_G have respective eigenvalues lambda_E=zeta^(E+1)+zeta^(-E-1), lambda_G. Put lambda(W)=zeta^(W+1)+zeta^(-W-1), Delta=zeta+zeta^(-1), rho=zeta-zeta^(-1), and central values a0=lambda(A)lambda(B)+lambda(C)lambda(D), b0=lambda(B)lambda(C)+lambda(A)lambda(D), c0=lambda(A)lambda(C)+lambda(B)lambda(D). The original generic cleared Fricke identities force Bmid to be three-diagonal in the S basis. Write its action as Bmid S_E=p_E S_(E+2)+d_E S_E+m_E S_(E-2). The first relation gives d_E=(Delta b0-c0 lambda_E)/(Delta^2-lambda_E^2). (14) The E=0 exception means A=B,C=D and is fixed by the ACTUAL cup projection rather than cancellation of 0/0. With S1=sum_(i=0)^A Q^-i and S2=sum_(i=0)^A Q^(-2i), (13) gives ell_A p_A=(-1)^A zeta^A S1, ell_A Bmid p_A=(-1)^A{ zeta^(C+1)(1+Q^(A+1))S1 +[zeta^(2A-C-1)-zeta^(C+1)Q^(A+1)]S2}. The finite ratio S2/S1=(1+Q^(-A-1))/(1+Q^-1) gives d_0=lambda(A)lambda(C)/Delta, the value of (14) after imposing A=B,C=D and canceling. A=0 is immediate in one dimension. The diagonal of the second Fricke relation fixes the products P_E=p_E m_(E+2), with P_(E_min-2)=0, by [2lambda_E-(Q+Q^-1)lambda_(E+2)]P_E +[2lambda_E-(Q+Q^-1)lambda_(E-2)]P_(E-2) =rho^2[Delta a0-c0 d_E-Delta^2 lambda_E +lambda_E d_E^2]. (15) The forward coefficient is nonzero generic. There is a known ACTUAL LEFT eigenrow fixing the remaining gauge. At G=Gmax one has i0=L, so this physical eigenrow is simply the last chart coordinate. Hence ell_0(E)=L_(Gmax,E)=chi_E X_E/b_(Gmax)!=0. (16) This is a genuine source row, not a prescribed spectral weight. Set u_E=p_E ell_0(E+2)/ell_0(E) and v_E=m_E ell_0(E-2)/ell_0(E). Their sum is lambda_Gmax-d_E, and their successive products are still P_E. Starting from v_Emin=0, the sum and (15) determine them uniquely whenever the proposed interior u is nonzero. The exact result is u_E=K U(z_E), v_E=K U(z_E^-1), U(z)=product_(t=alpha,beta,gamma,delta)(1-tz) /[(1-z^2)(1-Qz^2)], d_E=K+K^-1-K[U(z_E)+U(z_E^-1)]. (17) To prove this uniformly, use independent formal variables zeta,Q^a,Q^b,Q^c,Q^d,Q^e, with A=2a,...,E=2e. For the first branch K=zeta Q^(a+d), both (14),(17) and the product recurrence (15) have IDENTICALLY ZERO cleared rational numerators. The attached audit supplies these two exact six-variable symbolic certificates. The second branch follows by a<->b,c<->d, which preserves a0,b0,c0. Parameter permutation preserves U. After canceled endpoint factors are evaluated, U(z_E) is nonzero on every interior channel and vanishes at the upper endpoint; U(z_E^-1) vanishes at the lower endpoint. The uniqueness therefore proves (17) for the ACTUAL operator, with no unfixed sign. ## 5. Leading coefficients supply the true source normalization Let ell_G(i0)=1 be the physical LEFT eigenrow of (13), zero below i0 and satisfying the elementary one-step equation above i0. The independent two-sum source identity is L_(G,E)=ell_G(w_E)/b_G, w_E(i)=S_E(i,H-i,0,D). (18) Divide by (16). Equation (17) gives the actual finite problem U(z_E)[g(E+2)-g(E)]+U(z_E^-1)[g(E-2)-g(E)] =(Q^-n-1)(1-PQ^(n-1))g(E). (19) Indeed lambda_G=lambda_Gmax+K(Q^-n-1)(1-PQ^(n-1)). This is the exact affine eigenvalue conversion, not a replacement of the physical Casimir. Our OWN [finite symmetric polynomial calculation](finite_balanced_sears_operator_proof.md) proves that G_n solves (19), with leading coefficient C_n in lambda_E=z_E+z_E^-1. Its degree is n and its generic leading coefficient is nonzero. The finite grid has distinct Casimir nodes, and its forward coefficient is nonzero until the last slot, so the actual source row is proportional to G_n. Its multiplier still needs determining. For that multiplier, the physical Amid is irreducible tridiagonal. Starting from its last row yields w_E(i)/w_E(L)=a polynomial in lambda_E of degree L-i with leading coefficient 1/product_(t=i+1)^L Amid(t,t-1). (20) Formula (9) evaluates its denominator. In (18) only i>=i0=L-n occurs and ell_G(i0)=1. Thus L_(G,E)/ell_0(E) has degree n and leading coefficient b_(Gmax)/(b_G J_n). (21) Since n is less than the number of channel nodes, this polynomial leading coefficient fixes the proportionality even on the finite grid. Comparing (21) with C_n proves EXACTLY (12), on every color. ## 6. Exact conversion to the seven-factorial sum, including its phase Put [r]!=zeta^[-r(r-1)/2]F_r/(1-Q)^r and s=(A+B+C+D)/2. The tetrahedral incidence is the FOUR faces and THREE opposite sums t=( (A+B+E)/2, (C+D+E)/2, (B+C+G)/2, (D+A+G)/2 ), u=( s, (A+C+E+G)/2, (B+D+E+G)/2 ). Define the literal seven-factorial finite sum S=sum_(z=max t)^(min u) (-1)^z [z+1]! /(product_i[z-t_i]! product_j[u_j-z]!). (22) All its true factorial indices are nonnegative. Choose the effective quadruple (A',B',C',D')=(A,B,C,D) when A+D<=B+C, and (B,A,D,C) otherwise. This latter permutation leaves (22) exactly unchanged: it exchanges its last two faces and its last two opposite sums. Set t0=s-Gmax, R1=(C+D-E)/2, R2=(A+B-E)/2, R3=(A'-B'+E)/2, R4=(D'-C'+E)/2, S0=(-1)^s [s+1]!/([R1]![R2]![t0]![R3]![R4]!), Mstar=(Gmax+G)/2+1, V_n=zeta^n (Q^-Mstar;Q)_n /[F_n(Q^(t0+1);Q)_n(Q^(-s-1);Q)_n]. (23) Every factor in S0 and V_n is nonzero generic. The EXACT source normalization of the seven-factorial convention is S=S0 (V_n/C_n)G_n(E), L_(G,E)=chi_E X_E/(b_G J_n S0 V_n) *S. (24) This includes all signs and powers of zeta. In particular the coefficient is not merely equated to a positive square or to an unnormalized named 6j symbol. Here is an own finite proof of (24). Write a=A'/2,b=B'/2,c=C'/2, d=D'/2, e=E/2, f=G/2. Then fmax=a+d, n=fmax-f and t0=b+c-a-d. At f=fmax the z range in (22) is the SINGLE z=s, which is precisely S0. For general n write z=s-k. Dividing by S0 gives the finite falling-product identity S/S0=sum_(k=0)^n (-1)^k [R1]_k^down [R2]_k^down [R3]_(n-k)^down [R4]_(n-k)^down /([s+1]_k^down [t0+1]_(n-k)^up [k]![n-k]!). (25) The products have their evident consecutive quantum integers. If a formal term lies outside the true range of (22), one falling product contains [0], and that term is EXACTLY zero. No nonzero factorial is assigned to a negative index. For generic formal z_E, factor the k=0 term of (25). Its residual balanced series is 4phi3(Q^-n,Q^-R1,Q^-R2,Q^(-t0-n); Q^(-s-1),Q^(R3-n+1),Q^(R4-n+1);Q,Q). (26) Apply the OWN finite Sears identity, retaining Q^-R1 and taking d_S=Q^(-s-1), e_S=Q^(R3-n+1). The resulting series is exactly the same finite symmetric eigenpolynomial as (11), but with FIRST parameter gamma=zeta^(-1-C-D). In particular its numerator pair is Q^-R1 and Q^(-c-d-e-1), and its denominator parameters are Q^-D', Q^(-(s-B')), Q^(-s-1). After multiplying the k=0 term and canceling the two E-dependent Sears denominator products, its scalar is D_n=(-1)^n zeta^[n(B'-A'+n+1)] (Q^(s-B'-n+1),Q^-D';Q)_n /[F_n(Q^(t0+1);Q)_n]. (27) These cancellations are performed as rational identities in formal z_E BEFORE specializing a channel. Thus the identity still holds when a k=0 factorial representation would have a negative index: the falling-product polynomial (25) has no such division. The OWN symmetric-polynomial proof makes the normalized degree-n eigenpolynomial independent of its first parameter. Its leading coefficient when gamma is first is C_n^gamma=gamma^n(PQ^(n-1);Q)_n /(gamma alpha,gamma beta,gamma delta;Q)_n. Reverse the finite product (Q^(s-B'-n+1);Q)_n in (27). The factors Q^-D' and Q^(-(s-B')) cancel those of C_n^gamma. All signs cancel, the remaining zeta monomial is zeta^n, and D_n C_n^gamma=V_n. (28) Consequently D_n times the gamma-first polynomial equals (V_n/C_n)G_n(E), proving (24). This is a finite product/Sears proof; no generic factorial interpolation or quoted tetrahedral theorem is required. The rational identity for formal z_E specializes to every physical E using (25). ## 7. Exact source relation to a face-normalized scalar metric The actual prefactor in (24) SEPARATES the two intermediate labels: a_E^src=chi_E X_E/S0(E), b_G^src=1/(b_G J_n V_n), L_(G,E)=b_G^src a_E^src S. (29) Thus source columns rescaled as S_E/a_E^src and b_G^src T_G have coefficient EXACTLY the seven-factorial sum (22). No phase has been omitted in this row/column gauge. For an admissible highest-weight triple define its usual finite factorial expression, without assuming any 6j interpretation, D(U,V,W)=[(U+V-W)/2]![(U+W-V)/2]![(V+W-U)/2]! /[((U+V+W)/2)+1]!, D_E=D(A,B,E)D(C,D,E), D_G=D(B,C,G)D(D,A,G). The coefficient sqrt(D_E D_G)S is therefore an explicit diagonal gauge of the actual source: use sqrt(D_E)S_E/a_E^src and b_G^src T_G/sqrt(D_G) as its two generic bases. Square-root branches can be fixed positive at real 0<zeta<1, where every factorial is positive. The squared identity is branch-independent. For ANY separately fixed level N it says exactly [N]^2 D_E D_G L_(G,E)^2/(a_E^src b_G^src)^2 =[N]^2 D_E D_G S^2. (30) In particular (30) identifies the source with this convention of the normalized scalar metric BEFORE a root normal is taken. If the four face sums are in the saturated low-fold chamber, the familiar root-zero factors in (30) are the actual generic ones. High partners and [2N] tails remain in the same equality. Principal-root positivity of the scalar convention must keep its spin phase. For INTEGER spins (all six highest weights even), the supported theorem gives the positive once-power factorial square. For admissible half-integral spins the branch-free generic identity (30) still holds, but the positive sine-factorial square differs by the sign (-1)^(A+B+C+D+E+G). This is the parity of the four face zero-removal signs. No positive-square assertion for arbitrary half-spin data is silently included in (30). These are diagonal gauges of a SCALAR recoupling matrix. They may have zeros or poles at the root; paired confluence and original boundary costs still require their own estimates. They neither make the physical root operator positive nor identify this scalar metric with the full marked magnetic/tensor energy. Also a_E^src depends on its four external objects; it has not been asserted to be a single universal per-edge metric throughout a graph. ## 8. Generic normals and scope The theorem and (24) are rational BEFORE root specialization. High intermediate channels, high partners and every normal of the original maps remain present. Individual source factors may have zeros or poles at a root, and extra terminations can have derivative tails. The GENERIC finite sum and original source maps must be combined before taking a fixed marked normal. In particular second-orbit zeros such as [2N] in (22) are retained in (24); they cannot be deleted when comparing first normals. There is a useful explicit finite normal budget. If the EXTERNAL highest weights A,B,C,D are all <N, while intermediate E,G retain their ENTIRE ranges (1), then every denominator of G_n in (11) is a root unit. Indeed alpha beta=Q^(t0+1), and the last exponent t0+n is one of the ordinary physical coupling deficits, hence <N. The other two exponents start at -m_cd or -m_ab for the minimal E, with n<=m_cd,m_ab<N; their products end before exponent zero. The factor F_n is a unit too. The numerator of C_n has at most one simple root zero: its negative exponents have magnitude <2N and length <N. The actual chi_E has at most one pole, from F_E on a high channel E>=N, whereas X_E, b_G and J_n are physical products with indices <N. Consequently pole_order L_(G,E)<=2. (31) The full invariant T_G has at most one pole from its canonical p_G, so each term L_(G,E)T_G has pole order at most THREE. To check this complete physical identity through its first normal, retain Taylor orders zero through FOUR after multiplying by the cube of a local root parameter. This is a uniform finite normal budget, not a bound on coefficient magnitudes. For unfolded high EXTERNAL partners with highest weights >=N use the generic formula itself and retain its explicit zero factors; (31) is not asserted for that different range. The identity supplies finite actual all-port coefficients for graph contractions and meromorphic jets. It does not make a recoupling positive, unitary, polynomially conditioned or sharply controlled under cycle sewing. Audit: [uniform certificates and independent literal source tensors](../experiments/audit_actual_general_four_port_single_racah_kernel.py). Fresh replay passes two universal Fricke/AW identities, 381 generic all-port external families and 1125 single-sum source entries, including half-integral spins with the true (-1)^A cyclic sign. Eight root zero-order families check all 40,820 channel entries, including 14,332 retained high-channel entries, with the certified inverse pole bound two and full-term first-normal budget four. Finite tests supplement the displayed uniform proof; they are not a polynomial-fitting argument. Independent internal review: root completed a full analytical read and fresh primary replay of the actual source theorem, seven-factorial conversion and scalar metric gauge. The crossing/source agent also completed a full independent analytical read and fresh primary replay, then separately checked (25)--(28), the surviving zeta^n phase and the added finite pole/first-normal budget (31). All 1125 source entries were checked in both one-sum conventions. No energy or full-root positivity conclusion was included in either verdict.

text: # An exact generic boundary gauge for the original marked source 30 October 2026. Independently reviewed. A symmetric analytic basis change removes the nonmonomial part of every ordinary cup and preserves the entire original marked source, including its retained trace normal. Its transformed white coefficients are given below in terms of the ORIGINAL generic q-Hahn numerator. This is a finite tensor identity on the actual modules, including the paired nilpotent sectors. It is not a complex magnetic continuation theorem. ## 1. A root-normalized symmetric basis Fix N>=3, d=N-1, q0=exp(pi i/N), zeta=q0 exp(epsilon), Q=zeta^2, and F_n=(Q;Q)_n. For any actual module V_L with 0<=L<N set b_L(r;zeta)=zeta^[r(L-r)] F_r F_(L-r)/F_L, b_L^0(r)=b_L(r;q0)=s_r s_(L-r)/s_L, s_n=product_(k=1)^n 2sin(pi k/N), g_L(r;zeta)=[b_L(r;zeta)/b_L^0(r)]^(1/2), G_L=diag(g_L(0),...,g_L(L)). (1) The square root is the analytic one equal to 1 at epsilon=0. Every factorial index is below N, so all these functions are units on a neighborhood of the actual root. In particular G_L(q0)=I, g_L(r)=g_L(L-r), b_d^0(r)=1. (2) The last identity is s_r s_(d-r)=s_d=N. In the actual ordinary cup normalization, including its ordering, p_L(r,L-r)=(-1)^r zeta^(-r) b_L(r;zeta). The physical cup is pV=N zeta^(-d^2) p_d. Replace each module basis by its columns G_L and transform both covariant and contravariant tensor indices. Thus p'_L=G_L^(-1) p_L G_L^(-T), ell'_L=G_L^T ell_L G_L, ell_L=p_L^(-1). Then, EXACTLY before root specialization, p'_L(r,L-r)=(-1)^r zeta^(-r) b_L^0(r), pV'(r,d-r)=N zeta^(-d^2-r)(-1)^r. (3) The generic factorial factors have moved to the adjacent tensors; they have not been deleted from the source. The gauge has polynomial cost on physical indices. Indeed |1-q0^(2k)|>=c min(k,N-k)/N and direct logarithmic differentiation of (1) gives O(N^2 log N), uniformly in L,r. The same product estimate on a sufficiently small disk proves |g_L(r;zeta)|+|g_L(r;zeta)^(-1)|<=C for |epsilon|<=c/[N^2(1+log N)]. (4) Consequently every fixed epsilon derivative of g_L or its inverse is bounded by C_m[N^2(1+log N)]^m. These are estimates at the actual integer module indices only. ## 2. The actual white map, dual, and cyclic order Let W_a:V_(2a)->V_d tensor V_d be the original regular generic Clebsch map, 0<=a<=floor(d/2), with the normalization in [the full matching-graph source](general_matching_graph_full_normal_source.md). Keep its exact dual pi_a=gamma_a^(-1) p_(2a)^T W_a^T (ellV^T tensor ellV^T) P, gamma_a=q0^(2-a^2)/N^2. (5) Here gamma_a is the fixed root scalar in that regular lift; P reverses the two physical heads. Put G_pair=G_d tensor G_d and W'_a=G_pair^(-1) W_a G_(2a), pi'_a=G_(2a)^(-1) pi_a G_pair, K'_a=W'_a pi'_a=G_pair^(-1)(W_a pi_a)G_pair. (6) Substitution of (3) into (5), using P G_pair=G_pair P, proves the SAME categorical dual formula with every tensor primed. This verifies compatibility with the actual bent edges, rather than replacing the white vertex by a Hermitian adjoint. All generic intertwining identities remain true after conjugating the module matrices by G_L. No division by pi_a W_a occurs. In particular its root is still zero on a paired sector and the identity on the odd simple sector. The nilpotent source has not been replaced by a semisimple quotient. The exact generic reversal J_L|r>=zeta^[-(L+1)r]|L-r> commutes with G_L by (2). Therefore the original Chevalley/high- degree adapter also holds for the primed white maps. Likewise the actual four-physical-head cyclic turn, with its coefficient (-1)^d zeta^(d-2u), commutes with the product of four G_d factors: the diagonal coefficient commutes and the cyclic permutation permutes identical factors. No unproved cyclic-module adapter is being applied to the original nilpotent module. ## 3. The actual LARGE-channel numerator The generic source distinction is essential here. W_a takes values in the channel of highest weight 2a, so its generic Casimir eigenvalue is zeta^(2a+1)+zeta^(-2a-1). In the original compiler indexing its channel is m=d-a, not a. These two generic eigenvalues coincide at the root but have different derivatives. Use the actual generic polynomial from the [collision/source theorem](actual_q_hahn_partner_normal_collision.md): H_m^B(U,V)=sum_(k=0)^m (-1)^k B^k Q^[k(k+1)/2] [m choose k]_Q (BQ^(m-k+1);Q)_k/(BQ;Q)_k V^k product_(j<k)(U-Q^j) product_(j<m-k)(V-Q^j), B=Q^(-N). For 0<=r<=2a put m=d-a, sigma=m+r and i+j=sigma, with 0<=i,j<=d. Then the original white coefficient is EXACTLY W_a(i,sigma-i;r) =(-1)^m zeta^[-dr+di-m(m-1)] H_m^B(Q^i,Q^(sigma-i))/F_m, (7) and its transformed coefficient is W'_a(i,sigma-i;r) =g_(2a)(r)/[g_d(i)g_d(sigma-i)] * right_side_of_(7). (8) For the low half r<=a, the original endpoint and normalized LARGE column are W_a(0,sigma;r)=zeta^(-dr) F_sigma/(F_m F_r), C_m(zeta;sigma,i)=zeta^(di) H_m^B(U,V)/D_m(Q^sigma), D_m(T)=product_(k=0)^(m-1)(T-Q^k), D_m(Q^sigma)=(-1)^m zeta^[m(m-1)]F_sigma/F_r. The actual finite Clebsch sum divided by its endpoint is C_m; cancellation gives (7). For ALL r one can verify (7) term by term, without extending that nonexistent physical endpoint into high degrees. In the original Clebsch sum use highest index b and set k=j-m+b. Its denominator is F_b F_(m-b) F_k F_(r-k), with r-k=i-b. Its complete q exponent simplifies to -dr+di-2db+2bj+b(b-1), exactly the converted finite-H summand. The factorial numerator is F_(a+b)F_(d-b)/(F_a F_d) on both sides. Terms outside their finite support vanish by their Newton products, so the same identity holds in the high half r>a. All denominators in H_m and F_m are root units because m<N. Thus (7) is regular BEFORE taking its generic normal and specifies the full original white tensor, without a root-only high adapter. There is a decisive check already at a=0. The original coefficient is W_0(i,d-i;0)=(-1)^i zeta^(-i)b_d(i;zeta), W'_0(i,d-i;0)=(-1)^i zeta^(-i), whereas the SMALL normalized compiler column is C_0=zeta^(di). Their root values agree, but their generic derivatives do not. Thus substituting the small-channel generic R_a into W_a merely because the root columns collide would be incorrect. The precise possible bridge to the small numerator is the exact collision identity, with B temporarily independent of Q: H_m^B-H_a^B product_(k=a)^(m-1)(UV-Q^k) =(1-B^2 Q^N) T_(a,m)^B(U,V), m+a=d. (9a) It holds in the localized generic coefficient ring by the finite terminating identity proved in the collision note. Along the ACTUAL source B=Q^(-N), the derivative of 1-B^2 Q^N at q0 is 2N. Thus the transverse term in (9a) contributes to the original first normal. A bound or packet for the small R_a alone does not control that term. Equation (8), not a differentiated root simplification, is the transformed source requiring continuation. ## 4. Exact cancellation on the whole marked source Apply (1)--(6) at every physical and channel occurrence of the original typed matching graph. Every contracted wire has one G_L and one G_L^(-1); cups and caps transform as in (3). Consequently the ordinary closed scalar satisfies F'_Delta(epsilon)=F_Delta(epsilon) (9b) as an analytic identity, for any fixed original diagram and every fixed choice of its folded channel labels. This also holds after the finite label sum and retained signed half-twist factors. No coupon is commuted through another coupon. It is the exact coordinate invariance of this specified finite tensor contraction. Keep the SAME exposed original physical head. Its open endomorphism transforms by G_d^(-1) H G_d. For the original Hopf-covariant contraction H=z_Delta I, so its scalar is unchanged. The physical ordinary dimension remains D_N(epsilon)=(-1)^d[N]_(q0 exp(epsilon)), nu_N=D_N'(0)=2N(-1)^N/(q0-q0^(-1)). (10) This can also be checked directly from (3): the ratio of the two ordered complementary cup entries is still (-1)^d zeta^(d-2r). Since G_d(q0)=I, the original unrestricted marked row on that exposed arc is unchanged at the root, including its exact normalization m pV(q0)=1. Thus the source's genuine trace-normal extraction is preserved: Z_Delta=F_Delta'(0)/nu_N=F'_Delta{}'(0)/nu_N. (11) If one represents the mark off root as a row, it must transform covariantly too; retaining an untransformed generic row while changing its cup is not (9b). The proof of (11) uses the original ordinary closure and its first normal, so it requires no invented off-root mark and no movement of the bare root mark. For the complete-circle decomposition this applies to the regular Hopf lift in the full-source theorem. As there, that lift is not asserted to be the original complete circle's entire moving-q germ. The root scalar and its normalized ordinary trace derivative are independent of that choice. For an actual specified generic coupon (for example the original exceptional polynomial operator), basis covariance (9b) applies to that very coupon and all its generic jets. It does not replace its moving-q germ by the complete-circle lift. ## 5. What finite gauge cancellation does not prove The physical estimates (4) do NOT imply estimates at complex magnetic coordinates. There is an exact elementary obstruction to such an inference. Given any proposed holomorphic interpolation g(epsilon,u) of a physical gauge, replace it by g(epsilon,u) exp[epsilon exp(N^2) sin^2(pi u)]. (12) For every integer u this changes neither its value nor ANY of its epsilon derivatives. For integer L it preserves the symmetry u<->L-u. Yet its first generic derivative at a fixed noninteger u can be arbitrarily large. Even fixing all finite physical jets and the reversal symmetry does not determine the needed off-grid gauge. One may cancel specified factors algebraically in an exact whole- source continuation BEFORE estimating them. Alternatively one may prove bounds for an explicitly chosen continuation of the factors in (8). Neither operation follows from the physical cancellation (9b). In particular the existing joint deficient-degree theorem controls the actual R numerators, while the remaining boundary factors, the full generic operator lift in that chart, and the global degree period still require their own exact constructions. ## 6. What can nevertheless be bounded in the deficient corridor The exact numerator in (7) gives a useful positive statement without inventing a continuation of G_L. Define the unprimed white continuation by the RIGHT SIDE of (7), with m=d-a fixed, sigma=N Sigma complex, r=sigma-m, and a specified magnetic lift i of size O(N). It is a literal finite generic source expression, agreeing with every physical white entry as just proved. Denote it by mathscr W_a(zeta;sigma,i). It is not defined by interpolation of physical samples. Fix a compact K in the joint deficient corridor of the [actual joint numerator theorem](actual_q_hahn_joint_deficient_degree_packet.md), using z=q0^(sigma-2i) and its marked logarithmic lift. Put s=m-a=d-2a. There are eta,c,C>0, depending on K, such that for 1<=s<=eta N, every fixed k>=0, and all sufficiently large N, |partial_epsilon^k H_m^B(Q^i,Q^(sigma-i))|_0 <=C_k N^(10k) (C N^20)^s |H_a^1(U0,V0)|, (13) |partial_epsilon^k mathscr W_a|_0 <=C_k N^(10k) (C N^20)^s |mathscr W_a(q0)|. (14) The root quantities on the right are nonzero on K. The simple odd midpoint s=0 is covered directly by the small-numerator theorem. Thus the relative generic cost is subexponential in every window s log N=o(N), and polynomial for bounded s. This is an upper bound, not a nonzero leading normal amplitude. It concerns the specified unprimed white continuation; no bound for the unspecified complex gauge in (8) is asserted. Here is a proof retaining all large-channel factors. The exact generic normalization is H_n^B(Q^i,Q^(sigma-i))=zeta^(n sigma) K_n R_n(zeta;sigma,z). The joint deficient theorem supplies the actual small determinant M_a(epsilon), a bounded inverse, and a bounded determinant ratio on |epsilon|<=rho=c N^(-10). Its last diagonal cofactor is R_(a-1), so R_(a-1)/R_a is bounded on this disk too. The exact all-degree generic recurrence and its source justification are recorded in [the near-fold partner theorem](actual_q_hahn_near_fold_complex_partner_bound.md). On the circle |epsilon|=rho its only spectral denominators satisfy |Lambda_n-Lambda_(n-j)|>=c rho, j=1,2, n<=m, with the j=2 equation used only when defined. At the unique folded resonance the factor is 1-Q^(-N); its modulus is comparable to N rho, and the other factor is comparable to N^(-1). All other required gaps are at least cN^(-2). The finite rational coefficient formulas therefore give |alpha_n|<=C/rho, |beta_n|<=C/rho^2. Propagating the ACTUAL recurrence exactly s steps gives |R_m/R_a|<=(C N^20)^s. (15) The accompanying exact scalar quotient is K_m/K_a=product_(j=2a+1)^(2m)(1-B^2 Q^j) /[product_(j=a+1)^m(1-B^2 Q^j) product_(j=a+1)^m(1-BQ^j)]. (16) Its denominator indices stay uniformly near N/2, so their root values are units with a fixed lower bound; its 2s numerator factors are bounded above. Consequently |K_m/K_a|<=C^s. Also |zeta^(s sigma)|<=C_K^s, since the scaled marked parameters remain in a fixed compact. These estimates and the small-numerator bound prove (13) on the circle. The ORIGINAL finite H_m is holomorphic inside it: all denominator Pochhammer indices are below N. Thus Cauchy's estimate applies to H_m, not to its singular monic R_m. At the root the collision identity (9a) gives H_m^1=P_s(T0)H_a^1, P_s(T)=product_(j=a)^(m-1)(T-Q^j), c_K^s<=|P_s(T0)|<=C_K^s. (17) The last bounds hold because the deficient total Sigma is separated from the near-fold interval [a/N,m/N]. In particular no D_a(T0) is divided out, even when Sigma N is a deficient integer. Finally the monomial and F_m^(-1) in (7) have bounded relative variation on the same disk, by the fixed marked-lift bound and the root-unit factorial estimate in section 1. This proves (14). One can retain the actual transverse numerator as well. With the original compiler eigenvalues lambda_n=zeta^(2N-1-2n)+zeta^(-2N+1+2n), lambda_m-lambda_a=-(zeta^s-zeta^(-s)) (zeta^N-zeta^(-N)), the function mathscr T_a=[H_m^B-P_s(T)H_a^B]/(lambda_m-lambda_a) (18) is holomorphic through epsilon=0 by (9a). On the same circle the denominator has modulus at least c s rho. Applying the preceding estimates and then Cauchy's formula gives |partial_epsilon^k mathscr T_a|_0 <=(C_k/s) N^[10(k+1)](C N^20)^s |H_a^1|. (19) This is the original divided numerator with the actual gap sign. It does not divide by D_m(T), so it has none of the spurious deficient-degree column poles. It does not assert that the full exceptional operator's unspecialized boundary factors have already been continued or bounded. Nor can these nonreal local estimates turn an identically zero forbidden physical degree slice into a nonzero global period. Focused audit: [original cups, large white numerators, whole marked plats, and deficient generic circles](../experiments/audit_actual_generic_boundary_gauge_and_source.py), with [saved results](../experiments/actual_generic_boundary_gauge_and_source_results.json). title: A generic all-partner factorial formula for the actual six-head source
text: # A generic all-partner factorial formula for the actual six-head source 29 October 2026. This derives the local nested-cup coefficient and its ordinary closed trace at GENERIC zeta, for every physical pair channel 0<=j<=d=N-1, including the high partner d-j. The construction uses the actual Clebsch maps, genuine ordered ribbon duals, and physical cups. No root factorial reflection, conjugation, or quoted quantum 6j formula is used. Combining the factors gives a finite double-sum expression with an explicit root pole on each paired axis. Every actual marked joint-cluster moment is consequently an explicitly bounded-order Taylor coefficient, of order at most four. This supplies the previously missing generic input for the [actual boundary moments](actual_six_pants_boundary_torsor_and_sewing.md). The finite double source sum below is now reduced to an exactly normalized SINGLE generic Racah sum in [the actual source-column identity](actual_generic_trivalent_racah_source_identity.md), including all high partners and normal tails. It does not prove that their ratios, the boundary Gram, or recoupling maps have polynomial or subexponential conditioning. ## 1. Generic modules and literal duality Fix N>=2, d=N-1. In this note Q=zeta^2 is GENERIC, and F_k=(Q;Q)_k, F_0=1. The highest-weight L module, in its divided-F basis |u>, has F|u>=(1-Q^(u+1))|u+1>, Ecal|u>=zeta^(-L-1)(1-Q^(L+1-u))|u-1>, K|u>=zeta^L Q^(-u)|u>. Use Delta(F)=F tensor I+K^(-1) tensor F and Delta(Ecal)=Ecal tensor K+I tensor Ecal. The canonical cup is P_L(u)=(-1)^u zeta^[u(L-u-1)] F_u F_(L-u)/F_L, p_L(u,L-u)=P_L(u), ell_L=p_L^(-1). (1) Its first coefficient is one. The physical cup is pV=cV p_d, cV=N zeta^(-d^2), exactly the regular lift of the original cup. All generic formulas below are rational identities, so their stated continuations do not assume denominators remain nonzero at the root. For every j=0,...,d set l=d-j and define h_j(u)=(-1)^u zeta^(-du) Q^[u(l-1)-u(u-1)/2] F_(j+u)F_(d-u)/(F_j F_d), 0<=u<=l, W_j|r>=Delta(F)^r h_j/F_r, 0<=r<=2j. (2) The highest E equation gives (2) directly. The E,F commutator gives every interior covariance equation. The last F equation follows either from the endpoint below or from the full-column-rank physical E matrix above degree d. Thus W_j is the ACTUAL generic intertwiner from the ordinary highest-weight 2j module, without restricting j to the root low fold. Here is a useful formula with ONLY physical factorial denominators. For 0<=A,B<=d and A+B=l+r, W_j[r](A,B)=F_A F_B sum_u h_j(u) zeta^(-dt) Q^(ut) /[F_u F_(l-u) F_t F_(r-t)], t=B-l+u, max(0,l-B)<=u<=min(l,A), 0<=t<=r. (3) Outside these ranges the entry is zero. Indeed, write Delta(F)=A0+B0 with A0 B0=Q^(-1)B0 A0, expand with the finite Gaussian binomial, and cancel F_r. The two physical moves have lengths t and r-t; therefore ALL four denominator indices in (3) are <=d, even when r>=N. Formula (3) proves the entire W_j matrix is holomorphic at zeta=q=exp(pi i/N), including the high partner channels. Let P exchange the two physical legs. The actual right ribbon dual is DW_j=p_(2j)^T W_j^T(ellV^T tensor ellV^T)P, DW_j[r;u,v]=P_(2j)(2j-r) W_j[2j-r](d-v,d-u)/[pV(d-v)pV(d-u)]. (4) There is no Hermitian conjugation in (4). The swaps and inverse cup coefficients are fixed by the actual nested arcs. ## 2. Own endpoint and projector normalization The generic lowest endpoint is EXACTLY W_j[2j](j+u,d-u)=zeta^[j(d-2j)]h_j(u). (5) Proof. The lowest F equation and the highest E equation have the same coefficient ratio, so it suffices to take u=0 in (3). The remaining finite sum is sum_s (-1)^s Q^[s(s-1)/2] F_(d-s)/[F_s F_(l-s)F_(j-s)]=Q^(lj). For an own finite verification, rewrite it as F_d/(F_l F_j) times 2phi1(Q^-j,Q^-l;Q^-d;Q,1). The finite identity sum_(s=0)^n (Q^-n;Q)_s(b;Q)_s (cQ^n/b)^s/[F_s(c;Q)_s]=(c/b;Q)_n/(c;Q)_n follows from the already [finite-binomial proof](actual_half_color_quadratic_source_transform.md), section2, by replacing Q,b,c with Q^(-1),b^(-1),c^(-1) and clearing the displayed finite powers. Substitution n=j,b=Q^-l,c=Q^-d gives the endpoint constant in (5). This is a finite summation proof, not an assumed recoupling formula. The exact generic norm is DW_j W_j=n_j I, n_j=(-1)^(d+j)cV^(-2) zeta^[j(j+1)-d(2j+1)] F_(d+j+1)/[F_(d-j)F_(2j+1)]. (6) To prove its scalarity directly, DW_j W_j commutes with the generic ordinary K,F: its distinct K weights force diagonality, and nonzero interior F arrows force equal entries. Take its first entry, apply (5), and insert the cups (1). The only sum remaining is sum_(u=0)^l Q^[-(j+1)u] [j+u choose j]_Q[d-u choose j]_Q =Q^[-(j+1)l][d+j+1 choose l]_Q. After multiplication by Q^((j+1)l), this is the coefficient of z^l in 1/[(z;Q)_(j+1)(zQ^(j+1);Q)_(j+1)]. Expanding the reciprocal finite products by their inductive coefficient formula proves it. All remaining factors give (6). Consequently e_j=W_j DW_j/n_j, j=0,...,d (7) are the genuine generic pair projectors and sum to the physical identity. Indeed they are intertwiners with distinct ordinary highest weights; (6) gives their own nonzero retractions, and their dimensions sum_j(2j+1)=N^2. Their pair Casimir eigenvalues are c_j(zeta)=zeta^(2j+1)+zeta^(-2j-1). ## 3. Finite factorial source corner and full closed trace Take ANY ordinary triangle a,b,c in 0,...,d. Put J=a+b+c, r=b+c-a, r1=a+b-c, r2=a+c-b. The original six-head source is pV_16 pV_23 pV_45. Apply DW_a,DW_b, DW_c on consecutive physical pairs and extract ordinary output (2a,r,0). Define the following completely explicit analytic sum: B_abc=sum_(k=0)^(d-max(a,c)) h_a(d-a-k) h_c(d-c-k) *W_b[r1](d-c-k,a+k) /[P_d(d-a-k)P_d(k)P_d(d-c-k)]. (8) Each W entry in (8) is the physical finite sum (3). Hence (8) is a finite DOUBLE quantum-factorial sum, with at most N^2 terms; every denominator factorial index is <N. In particular B_abc is holomorphic on a fixed neighborhood of each chosen root, including when a,b,c are high partners. The literal source corner is sDW_abc=cV^(-3) zeta^[c(d-2c)-2c] P_(2b)(r1) B_abc. (9) To check (9), the three source cup constraints reduce the contributing physical indices to (u1,u2,u3,u4,u5,u6) =(d-k,a+k,d-a-k,c+k,d-c-k,k). In (4), the first W is its highest column, the third is its lowest column (5), and the middle is W_b[r1]. Three of the six physical inverse cups cancel the three actual source cups. The remaining three give precisely (8). This derivation retains every original port and source coefficient. Let Theta_abc be the genuine ordinary invariant with corner Theta_abc(2a,r,0)=1. The generic ordered pairing already derived by finite Vandermonde in the [marked two-vertex note](actual_trivalent_all_channel_marked_contraction.md), section2, is valid WITHOUT a low-fold restriction: Xi_abc=D(Theta_cba)Theta_abc =(-1)^r1 zeta^[2c-r1(r-1)] F_(2b)F_r2 F_(J+1) /[(1-Q)F_r F_(2a)F_r1 F_(2c)]. (10) The original ordinary closure with projectors e_a,e_b,e_c is therefore T_abc=sDW_abc sDW_cba Xi_abc/(n_a n_b n_c). The reversed labels in its second factor are necessary: white is the genuine ordered dual, not a same-order adjoint. Outside ordinary triangle support T_abc=0 identically. Combining ALL cups and norms yields the simpler exact formula T_abc=(-1)^d zeta^E/(1-Q) *F_r F_r1 F_r2 F_(J+1) *product_(j=a,b,c) [F_(d-j)(1-Q^(2j+1))/F_(N+j)] *B_abc B_cba, E=d(3a+2b+3c+3)-4a^2-4c^2+2ac-2J. (11) This is an actual generic source trace, not a tetrahedron assigned by name. For a direct normalization check, multiply the two ordinary cup factors in (9) by (10): their surviving factorials are F_r F_r1 F_r2 F_(J+1)/[(1-Q)F_(2a)F_(2b)F_(2c)]. Division by (6) replaces F_(2j+1)/F_(2j) by 1-Q^(2j+1). All physical scales cV cancel. The total sign is (-1)^d, since r1+J is even, and the remaining zeta exponent is E. Formula (11) keeps the ordinary quantum dimension and every high-partner term. ## 4. A nonsingular coefficient formula for every marked cluster moment Now specialize near the principal root q=exp(pi i/N), using the NORMAL COORDINATE Z=1-zeta^(2N), zeta=q(1-Z)^(1/(2N)), zeta(0)=q. (12) This specifies the analytic germ; it is not a free physical-color parameter. For each folded label l_i<=floor(d/2), take branches J_i={l_i,d-l_i} if 2l_i<d, J_i={l_i} if 2l_i=d. Let r0 be the number of paired axes. It is fixed for all <=8 branch triples. Each denominator F_(N+j) in (11) contains exactly one factor Z. On an odd simple axis, 1-Q^(2j+1)=Z cancels it. Therefore G_abc(Z):=Z^r0 T_abc(zeta(Z)) (13) is EXPLICITLY holomorphic, by replacing each F_(N+j) by F_(N+j)/Z and each odd simple numerator 1-Q^(2j+1) by 1. No cancellation of large singular matrices is needed to evaluate this formula. Use the literal root polynomial L_N(z)=(-1)^d U_d(z/2). A legitimate generic lift of the actual root eta on an axis is L_N(Omega(zeta)) times its analytic full cluster projector. At a paired branch j, L_N(c_j(zeta(Z)))=Z ell_j(Z), ell_j(Z)=(-1)^d zeta^[-d(2j+1)] *[sum_(v=0)^(2j) (1-Z)^v] /[1-zeta^(4j+2)]. (14) The denominator in (14) is a root unit on every paired axis. This is the finite character identity, not an omission of a Hermite jet. For I a subset of the paired axes, define H_I(Z)=sum_(a,b,c)in(J_1,J_2,J_3) G_abc(Z) product_(i in I) ell_(j_i)(Z), k_I=r0+1-|I|, 1<=k_I<=4. (15) Then the ACTUAL original marked boundary moment is EXACTLY m_I=(-1)^d(q-q^(-1)) [Z^k_I] H_I(Z). (16) In particular the top-circle moment needs one normal; the empty moment can require four. All lower moments, high fold partners and their cancellations are retained. This formula applies outside the regular saturation region too; no unsupported cell has been deleted. Proof of the coherent cancellations. At the root, distinct Casimir nodes coalesce only in the pairs j,d-j. The finite-dimensional Riesz projector for such a whole cluster is analytic and equals e_j+e_(d-j) generically; at a simple node it is e_j. This can equally be written by finite polynomial Chinese remainders. Thus the original closed physical lift with selected circles is the REGULAR function F_I(Z)=Z^(|I|-r0)H_I(Z). Keep the original globally exposed marked outer cap (16); the other caps are ordinary. Cutting it and bending with the SAME physical cup gives a generic Hopf endomorphism of V_N. Its distinct generic K weights and nonzero F arrows force a scalar z_I(zeta)I. The open maps are regular because the FULL cluster projectors and all actual physical maps are regular. Its ordinary trace is F_I(Z)=D_N(zeta) z_I(zeta), D_N=(-1)^d[N]_zeta =(-1)^(d+1) zeta^(-N) Z/(zeta-zeta^(-1)). Hence H_I is divisible by Z^k_I, exactly. The original unrestricted marked row applied to the original cup is one, so m_I=z_I(q). Taking the coefficient gives (16), since q^(-N)=-1. It agrees with the t-normal formula F_I'(0)/nu_N for zeta=q exp(t), but removes all apparent negative Laurent orders before computing that normal. This is a regular Hopf lift of the prescribed ROOT moment. It does not identify a formal continuation of a root scalar with the actual moving-q circle or colored-source family. Lift independence follows from the exposed physical scalar cut and its identical root maps. A bare marked row at an arbitrary nested white cap is not substituted for this cut; see the corrected hypothesis in the [first-normal source theorem](actual_nc_morse_graph_first_normal_source_reduction.md). ## 5. Bounded jets and the remaining analytic gate Equations (3),(8),(11)--(16) give a finite algorithm with no matrix minor inversion. There are <=8 branches, each B has <=N^2 terms, and every needed jet order is <=4, independently of N. The generic qdim has not been canceled before the actual marked quotient, nor have the first normals of paired circles been replaced by values. The formulas also admit explicit factorial ENVELOPES for their fixed jets. Divide every root-zero factor out first. On |Z|<=c/N^2, each remaining quantum factor with index<=3N changes by relative O(1/N), uniformly, because its nonzero root magnitude is >=2sin(pi/N), while the change of its exponent is O(|Z|). The product of O(N) factors is therefore bounded by a constant times its root product. Powers zeta^E, |E|=O(N^2), have the same property. Cauchy's coefficient bound multiplies this envelope by at most C_k N^(2k) at fixed order k. The finite character in (14) costs an additional polynomial factor. Applying this termwise to the explicit finite sums gives genuine bounded-normal factorial upper bounds, with only polynomial jet cost. This does NOT prove that m_I/m_top or the boundary square-root unit has polynomial growth. The absolute factorial envelope can exceed the coherent top moment, and (16) retains cancellations between different high/low branches and different summands. A quantitative comparison for that EXACT coefficient remains necessary for a tame source-aware Gram or general graph sewing theorem. Audit: [generic full physical and root-normal comparisons](../experiments/audit_actual_generic_six_head_tetrahedral_source.py). The audit checks 11 generic finite-field families, all j=0,...,d, 784 literal source corners, and 134 full physical ordinary closures. It also checks 14 actual root joint-cluster families through N=7, all marked moments on each cluster, including unsupported triples, and exact cancellation of every pole and ordinary trace constant. These finite checks supplement the derivations and do not establish conditioning or a new graph volume limit. Internal review: the primary agent and the independent conditioning agent read the full finite source and marked-normal derivation. The latter also replayed the audit and independently checked the complete phase in (11), all high-partner pole cancellations, the Z/nu_N sign, and the required orders in (16). Both reviews passed. This records internal proof review, not external peer review or a conditioning theorem.

title: The actual generic six-head source as a typed recoupling column
text: # The actual generic six-head source as a typed recoupling column 29 October 2026. This identifies the full generic source coefficient `B_abc` with a precisely normalized Clebsch recoupling coefficient. The proof uses the original nested physical cups and ordered ribbon duals, including the pivotal clock at the bend. It applies to every ordinary triangle `0<=a,b,c<=d=N-1`, including the high root partners. It is a rational generic identity; root zeros and poles are not discarded. The finite source sum is defined in [the generic six-head note](actual_generic_six_head_tetrahedral_source.md), §3. The unequal Clebsch conventions and complete four-port identities are those of [the four-port kernel](actual_ordinary_four_port_recoupling_kernel.md), §§1–4. No quantum 6j formula, orthogonality assertion, or asymptotic estimate is an input here. ## 1. The two genuinely typed Hom bases Put `Q=zeta^2`, `F_r=(Q;Q)_r`, and `V=V_d`. The ordinary object `Q_j` has highest weight `2j`. Every Clebsch map `W_AB^C` below has its first highest-vector component equal to one. Set cV=N zeta^(-d^2), pV=cV p_d, P_L(u)=(-1)^u zeta^[u(L-u-1)] F_u F_(L-u)/F_L, p_L(u,L-u)=P_L(u), ell_L=p_L^(-1). For fixed `a,b`, a basis of `Hom(Q_b,V tensor V tensor Q_a)` is L_c=(W_c tensor I_Qa) W_(Qc,Qa)^Qb, |a-b|<=c<=min(a+b,d). (1) Here `W_c:Q_c -> V tensor V` is the physical equal-pair map. A right basis instead first couples `V tensor Q_a` to an ordinary channel of highest weight `D`. We use its particular channel `D=d`: T=(I_V tensor W_(V,Qa)^V) W_b, T=sum_c H_c L_c. (2) All expressions have the displayed physical order `V,V,Q_a`. In particular `H_c` is a RIGHT-to-LEFT coefficient, rather than the inverse four-port coefficient. Generic highest-weight decomposition proves the bases complete; equivalently the explicit unequal Clebsch norms in the four-port note give their retractions before specialization. Write r=b+c-a, r1=a+b-c, r2=a+c-b. The exact source-to-recoupling identity is H_c=(-1)^(d+c) zeta^E F_r1 F_r2 F_(d-a) F_(d-c) F_(2c+1) /[F_a F_d F_(d+c+1)] * B_abc, E=-2a^2-5c^2+2ac+2bc+ad+3dc-c+d. (3) This is an equality of generic rational functions, not an equality deduced from root nodal values. The following index proof fixes every clock and scalar in (3). ## 2. Bend the original three-cup source Let J=pV_16 pV_23 pV_45, U=(DW_a tensor DW_b tensor DW_c)J. The actual generic source formula gives `U=sDW_abc Theta_abc`, where `Theta_abc(2a,r,0)=1` and sDW_abc=cV^-3 zeta^[c(d-2c)-2c] P_(2b)(r1) B_abc. (4) Move the first ordinary leg to the last by the ACTUAL inverse cyclic turn, and bend the now first `Q_b` leg into an input. The resulting map `M:Q_b -> Q_c tensor Q_a` has literal entries M_(gamma,alpha;t)=sum_beta ell_(2b)(t,beta) K_(2a)(alpha)^-1 U_(alpha,beta,gamma). (5) The `K_(2a)^-1` is essential: for an even highest weight `2a`, the inverse cyclic cup/cap turn is `K_(2a)^-1`, not a permutation. Taking the input highest color `t=0` and output `(gamma,alpha)=(0,r2)` gives M=sDW_abc kTheta W_(Qc,Qa)^Qb, kTheta=(-1)^r1 zeta^[2c+r1(2a+1-r1)] F_(2b)F_r2/(F_r F_(2a)). (6) Indeed `ell_(2b)(0,2b)=zeta^(2b)` and `K_(2a)(r2)^-1=zeta^(2c-2b)`. The remaining canonical invariant coefficient is the direct highest equation Theta_abc(r2,2b,0)=(-1)^r1 zeta^[r1(2a+1-r1)] F_(2b)F_r2/(F_r F_(2a)). There is no division by a root-zero invariant norm in this step. ## 3. The same bend, keeping all physical ports open Define an actual map from one physical object into `V tensor Q_a` by Wtilde_a(i6,alpha;i2) =(-1)^d K_d(i2) K_(2a)(alpha)^-1 sum_i1 DW_a(alpha;i1,i2) pV(i1,i6). (7) This is a rigid bend of `DW_a`, so it is a generic Hopf map. Directly from the highest entry `(i6,alpha;i2)=(0,a;0)` one obtains Wtilde_a=theta_a W_(V,Qa)^V, theta_a=cV^-1 zeta^[a(2a-d)] F_a F_d/(F_(2a)F_(d-a)). (8) For completeness the entry before the remaining physical cup cancels is DW_a(a;d,0)=cV^-2 zeta^[a(2a-d)] F_a F_d/(F_(2a)F_(d-a)). It follows by taking the unique term of the physical divided-coproduct formula for `W_a[a](d,0)`. In (7), the signs and the highest physical clock cancel against `pV(d,0)`, leaving exactly `cV` times that entry. Now substitute the THREE literal cups of `J` and the ordered formula for `DW_b` into (5). The cups `pV_23,pV_45` force `i3=d-i2`, `i5=d-i4`. Their only surviving ratio is pV(i4)/pV(d-i4)=(-1)^d K_d(i4). The ordinary input bend contributes `P_(2b)(t)/P_(2b)(2b-t)=K_(2b)(t)`. Physical weight conservation in `W_b[t](i5,i2)` gives K_(2b)(t)=K_d(i5)K_d(i2), K_d(i4)=K_d(i5)^-1. Thus the two physical clocks at `i4,i5` cancel, with precisely the remaining factors in (7). This proves the all-input map identity M=(DW_c tensor I_Qa)(I_V tensor Wtilde_a) W_b =theta_a (DW_c tensor I_Qa) T. (9) Equation(9) preserves arbitrary allowed exterior tensors and all input colors of `Q_b`. It is stronger than comparing a single source corner. Apply `DW_c` to (2). The generic equal-pair norm is DW_c W_c=n_c I, n_c=(-1)^(d+c)cV^-2 zeta^[c(c+1)-d(2c+1)] F_(d+c+1)/(F_(d-c)F_(2c+1)). (10) Different generic channels are killed. Comparing (6),(9) gives H_c=sDW_abc kTheta/(theta_a n_c). (11) Insert (4),(6),(8),(10) and use P_(2b)(r1) kTheta =zeta^[2c(r1+1)] F_r1 F_r2/F_(2a). The powers of `cV`, all three ordinary cups, and `F_(2a)` cancel. The remaining exponent and factorials are exactly (3). ## 4. Actual Casimir consequence and limits The RIGHT map `T` factors through the ordinary physical object `V_d` on positions 2,3. Hence Omega_23 T=(zeta^N+zeta^-N) T. (12) Consequently the vector of actual coefficients `H_c` from (3) solves the genuine left-channel Casimir eigenproblem, including its endpoint conditions. This supplies a literal source normalization for comparison with a finite Askey–Wilson/Sears polynomial. Identifying that polynomial requires matching the actual channel recurrence and gauge; its identity is not assumed in this note. All equations above are generic identities. They may be continued as meromorphic identities to the root, with paired columns and their normal derivatives retained together. Individual factors in (3) or (11) can vanish or have poles; the regular original physical source `B_abc` is still the finite analytic sum in the six-head note. Nothing here bounds recoupling conditioning, turns the ordered dual into a Hermitian adjoint, or proves a primitive-graph positive asymptotic. ## 5. Verification The matching audit constructs the physical `W_j,DW_j` independently, checks (7),(8) on every input color, and verifies (3) by projecting the full map (2) for every admissible triangle at generic finite-field levels. A separate literal six-head contraction verifies (5),(9), including the pivotal clock, before reducing to a scalar. These finite checks supplement the displayed generic index proof.

title: The actual generic trivalent source is the normalized single Racah sum
text: # The actual generic trivalent source is the normalized single Racah sum 29 October 2026. This proves the previously missing GENERIC finite identity, with the normalization determined by the original nested cups and genuine ordered duals. It includes both low channels and their high fold partners before root specialization. The proof uses an actual mixed-highest Casimir matrix, two universal rational certificates, the literal coefficient COLUMN obtained by bending, and our own finite polynomial/Sears calculation. No quoted quantum 6j evaluation is a premise. This is a finite identity and preserves the normal tails. A tame boundary-conditioning or general graph asymptotic estimate is not claimed solely from this formula. ## 1. Statement with the actual source normalization Let N>=2, d=N-1, zeta generic, Q=zeta^2, F_n=(Q;Q)_n, and [n]! = zeta^[-n(n-1)/2] F_n/(1-Q)^n. For every ordinary triangle 0<=a,b,c<=d put J=a+b+c and r=b+c-a, r1=a+b-c, r2=a+c-b. Let B_abc be the ACTUAL analytic factorial source sum defined in (8) of [the generic six-head theorem](actual_generic_six_head_tetrahedral_source.md). It is not defined through the formula to be proved here. Then B_abc=(-1)^J zeta^D [a]![b]![c]!/[J+1]! *S_abc, D=a^2-b^2+c^2-ab-ac+bc-cd, (1) where the SINGLE terminating sum is S_abc=sum_z (-1)^z [z+1]! /([z-J]! product_(j=a,b,c)[z-d-j]! [d+a+b-z]![d+a+c-z]![d+b+c-z]!), max(J,d+a,d+b,d+c)<=z <=min(d+a+b,d+a+c,d+b+c). (2) Every factorial index in its true range is nonnegative. Equations (1),(2) are generic rational identities, so all root-zero factors and all generic normals must be retained when specializing them. ## 2. An actual finite highest-source space First take a>=b, put h=a-b, and let C={h,h+1,...,min(a+b,d)}, D0=d+h, V=ker(Ecal_12^(2a+1)) in (V_d tensor V_d)_(degree D0). The generic physical Clebsch columns from the six-head theorem give a basis v_c=W_c[a+c-b], c in C. Indeed the generic physical pair decomposes into its distinct Casimir eigenspaces with highest weights 2c; in degree D0, precisely these descendants are killed by Ecal_12^(2a+1). Their highest lift to Hom(Q_b,V_d tensor V_d tensor Q_a) is H(w)=sum_(u=0)^(2a) alpha_u Ecal_12^u w tensor |u>, alpha_u=(-1)^u zeta^[u(4a+1)]Q^[-u(u-1)/2] F_(2a-u)/F_(2a). The direct E equation proves this formula, and extracting the third color zero is its inverse. Thus no full ambient space is silently identified with the actual highest source. Let A=Omega_12 and B be Omega_23 transported to this highest chart. In physical prefix coordinates |s,D0-s>, h<=s<=d, direct extraction of third colors zero and one gives B_ss=zeta^(-d+2b+1)Q^s+zeta^(d-2b-1)Q^(-s), B_(s-1,s)=-zeta^(2a-1)Q^(s-D0) (1-Q^(d+1-s))(1-Q^(D0-s+1)). (3) All other entries vanish. The diagonal FE contribution from third color zero cancels the corresponding term from third color one. This is the actual right-pair Casimir, whose physical V_d-channel eigenvalue is H0=zeta^N+zeta^(-N). The first physical component of each v_c has a closed finite Chu evaluation: phi_c=v_c(h,d) =zeta^[-dc+2(d-c)h] F_(d-h)/[F_(d-c)F_(c-h)]. (4) For clarity, (4) is obtained directly from the physical coproduct sum for W_c[c+h](h,d). After extracting zeta^(-dc)F_h/F_c, the remaining sum is sum_u(-1)^u Q^[u(u-1)/2] F_(d-u)/[F_u F_(d-c-u)F_(h-u)]. The finite second Chu identity, already proved by finite binomial expansion in the six-head note, evaluates it to Q^((d-c)h)F_c F_(d-h)/[F_(d-c)F_h F_(c-h)]. Thus (4) is not an assumed endpoint value. Put f_c=v_c/phi_c; every f_c has first physical component one. ## 3. A universal, uniquely determined three-diagonal matrix Write lambda_c=zeta^(2c+1)+zeta^(-2c-1), delta=zeta+zeta^(-1), rho=zeta-zeta^(-1), and alpha=H0^2+lambda_a lambda_b, beta=gamma=H0(lambda_a+lambda_b). The independently proved, generic [quantum Fricke identities](actual_adjacent_twist_character_and_source.md) apply to the actual adjacent Casimirs in this highest-source module. Eliminating their third generator gives A^2B-(Q+Q^-1)ABA+BA^2+rho^2 delta^2 B =rho^2(delta beta-gamma A), B^2A-(Q+Q^-1)BAB+AB^2+rho^2 delta^2 A =rho^2(delta alpha-gamma B). (5) These are universal cleared Hopf-algebra equalities, not a recurrence deduced from a guessed Racah sum. In the A-eigenbasis f_c, the first identity forces B to be tridiagonal: its off-diagonal coefficient can be nonzero only when the two indices differ by one. Its diagonal is b_c=H0(lambda_a+lambda_b)/(delta+lambda_c). (6) For c>0 this follows by canceling the nonzero generic factor delta-lambda_c. The channel c=0 occurs only when h=0 and a=b; there that factor is identically zero and requires a separate ACTUAL source calculation. Here f_0=p_d is the canonical physical cup. Its genuine retraction is the canonical cap ell_d, up to the same scalar on numerator and denominator, so b_0=(ell_d B p_d)/(ell_d p_d). Put S1=sum_(s=0)^d Q^(-s), S2=sum_(s=0)^d Q^(-2s). Using (3) and P_d(s)/P_d(d-s)=(-1)^d zeta^d Q^(-s), the diagonal and upper off-diagonal terms give EXACTLY ell_d p_d=(-1)^d zeta^d S1, ell_d B p_d=(-1)^d{ zeta^(2a+1)(1+Q^N)S1 +[zeta^(2d-2a-1)-zeta^(2a+1)Q^N]S2}. The finite geometric ratio S2/S1=(1+Q^(-N))/(1+Q^(-1)) reduces this to b_0=H0 lambda_a/delta=beta/(2delta), exactly (6). This supplies the exceptional endpoint without continuing in an integer channel. Write B f_c=p_c f_(c+1)+b_c f_c+m_c f_(c-1). Here m_h=0 and p_maxC=0. The two remaining coefficients are kappa0=zeta^N Q^b, p_c=-kappa0^-1 Q^(c-h) (1-Q^(c+h+1))(1-Q^(a+b-c))(1-Q^(d-c)) /[(1-Q^(2c+1))(1+Q^(c+1))], m_c=-kappa0^-1 Q^c (1-Q^(c-h))(1-Q^(N+c))(1-Q^(a+b+c+1)) /[(1+Q^c)(1-Q^(2c+1))]. (7) Here is a uniform proof of (7), rather than interpolation of matrix data. Since f_c has first physical component one, (3) and the first row of the physical A give a prescribed row-sum p_c+b_c+m_c=S_c. To state this and its certificate without long monomial powers, use INDEPENDENT formal variables q,t,H,V,Y and set Q=q^2, t=zeta^N, H=Q^h, V=Q^b, Y=Q^c, lambda(Y)=qY+q^(-1)Y^(-1), A00=q/t^2(1-H)(1-t^2/H) +qH/t^2(1-t^2/Q)(1-Q)+q/H+H/q, B00=QHV/t+t/(QHV), S(Y)=B00-(tV/q)(lambda(Y)-A00). (8) The coefficient of the first off-diagonal in B divided by that in A is exactly -tV/q; hence (8) is the first-row equation for EVERY c.
