title: The two geometric defects lie across the complete-channel support wall
text: # The two geometric defects lie across the complete-channel support wall 30 October 2026. Independently reviewed. For the prescribed-pair frame on any actual certified right-angled matching cut, the two failed ordinary factors at one matching edge have a precise common chart. Their normalized total degree has real part BELOW 1/2; their magnetic rows are strictly inside that degree. After the actual inverse turn, the target rows are physical and cross-central, but their separation has real part ABOVE 1/2. This identifies exactly which inequality in the controlled exceptional-kernel tube fails. The statement is geometric and algebraic. It neither continues an actual finite kernel across that wall nor supplies an asymptotic there. ## 1. A strict failed triangle has a deficient normalized degree Let (a0,a1,a2) be an original prefix triple in a generic regular frame. Assume zero is strictly inside its real convex hull, and Im(a0 conjugate(a2))!=0. Multiplying all entries by one nonzero scalar, put a0=1 and arg a2=theta in (-pi,pi), theta!=0. The strict positive relation among the three diagonals implies a1=-b0-b2 a2, b0,b2>0. Conversely such a relation makes zero an interior point of the triangle. Thus the argument beta of a1 lies strictly between pi and pi+theta, with these arguments lifted to the same interval of length less than pi. The actual wire exponentials and their canonical logarithms are X1=-a0/a1, X2=-a1/a2, xj=Log_(0,2pi)(Xj)/(2pi i), 0<Re xj<1. If theta<0, the two wire arguments are pi-beta and beta-theta-pi. They are positive and their sum is -theta. If theta>0, the arguments are 3pi-beta and pi+beta-theta, with sum 4pi-theta. Hence theta<0: 0<Re(x1+x2)=-theta/(2pi)<1/2, theta>0: 3/2<Re(x1+x2)=2-theta/(2pi)<2. (1) Use the ORIGINAL degree adapters even though the complete channel is no longer in their physical support. Define low: sigma=x1+x2, r=x1; high: sigma=2-x1-x2, r=1-x2. In both cases 0<Re sigma<1/2, 0<Re r<Re sigma. (2) No wire endpoint has been crossed. It is the complete-channel total degree bound, rather than a magnetic-row endpoint, that fails. ## 2. The two exceptional ends share this same complex degree The prescribed-pair theorem chooses the polarization line to leave the white-normal polyhedron through the interiors of the two shaded facets at one matching edge. For a generic transverse line, the induced affine map on each triangular facet is nonsingular. Its strict barycentric relation therefore gives the strict convex-hull hypothesis of section 1, not merely a boundary relation. The input and output triples at this edge have the SAME outer prefix diagonals a0,a2. They consequently have the same theta and the same adapter in (1). Their canonical wire sums have equal real parts, and their exponentials are both a0/a2. Their imaginary parts therefore agree as well. They share an EXACT complex normalized total sigma. Write their two normalized magnetic rows as r,s. Then 0<Re r,Re s<Re sigma<1/2. (3) The generic family can additionally avoid Re(r-s)=0. The relevant target-total ratio is the holomorphic ratio of the two middle prefix diagonals. It is nonconstant: otherwise the two transported first meridians would be proportional as linear trace functions on every rank-one projector, hence equal after using their common trace -2. The actual nontrivial complete collar does not fix that meridian. A nonconstant holomorphic ratio cannot take only positive-real values on the open prescribed-pair family. Its real seam is thus a proper excluded set, compatible with all the existing strict margins. ## 3. The actual target chart has exactly the opposite support defect First suppose the original adapter is low. Write O=exp(2pi i sigma), R=exp(2pi i r), S=exp(2pi i s). The original local prefix traces are (-1/R,-1/S,1/O). Undoing their actual inverse-turn relation gives target exponentials T_target=R/S, V_input=1/S, U_output=O/S. (4) Their canonical physical logarithms have total 1+r-s and rows 1-s, sigma-s. If Re r<Re s, this target is low. If Re r>Re s, apply its ORIGINAL high adapter: the normalized total is 1-r+s and the rows are 1-r, sigma-r. For an original high adapter, the exponentials are instead V_input=O/S,U_output=1/S; this only reverses the target input/output order in the same calculation. In a fixed component choose m,M from r,s by their smaller and larger real parts. This does not take a nonholomorphic minimum inside an action: the choice is fixed on that component. The normalized ordered target chart is delta=1-sigma, nu=sigma-M, lambda=m, tau=nu+lambda+delta=1+m-M, u=nu, v=nu+delta=1-M. (5) It follows immediately from (3) that 1/2<Re delta<1, Re nu>0, Re lambda>0, Re(nu+lambda+delta)<1, 1/2<Re tau<1, 0<Re u<Re tau/2<Re v<Re tau. (6) For the two midpoint inequalities, the positive differences are Re(tau/2-u)=[1+Re(r+s)-2Re sigma]/2>0, Re(v-tau/2)=[1-Re(r+s)]/2>0. Thus EVERY inequality of the proved exceptional-kernel tube is satisfied except its bandwidth condition Re delta<alpha<=1/2. This description is uniform in bridge width and uses the actual typed turn and degree adapters, not a freely selected target frame. ## 4. What continuation is actually required The controlled root kernel has delta=h/N, where h is the row separation, and requires 0<Re delta<a/N. At generic quantum parameter the original polynomial p_a(J_t) has bandwidth a. Consequently ALL real physical integer entries with h>a vanish identically, together with every retained generic-q jet. The geometric chamber (6) is beyond that support wall at the complete fold a/N->1/2. This does not make its complex geometric coordinates meaningless. It specifies what an analytic period or new transition kernel must justify; it cannot be supplied by a nonzero relative estimate merely extended from the present tube. In particular the normalized ordinary factors used inside that tube are outside their established complete-degree range after (2). Their apparent endpoint factors, zeros or poles must be retained in any proposed continuation rather than canceled after specialization. A block estimate or contraction tree that factors EVERY grouped patch back into ordinary packets on their old physical domains cannot remove this obstruction under the common K-frame hypothesis: it would make every original factor strictly physical and selected, contrary to the white-normal theorem. A genuinely coupled packet or source-exact frame transition remains a different possibility. This is a direct structural corollary of the audited prefix, adapter, prescribed-facet and inverse-turn identities. No new finite-kernel asymptotic, nonvanishing contribution or global equality is claimed. Primary-agent full analytical review: PASS. The reader checked both argument lifts, equality of the full complex degree, the original and target high adapters, the proper middle-ratio seam, and all target support and midpoint inequalities. Independent full analytical review: PASS. A second reader independently derived the deficient-degree chart, strict facet-interior consequence, both target input/output exponentials and actual logarithmic lifts. The multi-block limitation remains conditional on the common K frame; no finite continuation through the wall is inferred.

title: The actual geometric target channel and its finite Casimir polynomial
status: Exact actual target and generic Casimir polynomial
text: # The actual geometric target channel and its finite Casimir polynomial Follow-up: the [actual primitive-word theorem](actual_matching_circle_rectangle_bound.md) now proves c<=1 for EVERY circle in the certified complete class, including half twists. The c>1 algebraic case classified below is therefore formal and cannot be realized by that complete marked quotient. Equality c=1 remains a genuine parabolic target. 30 October 2026. The literal four-port bend fixes the recoupled channel; it is not a freely chosen geometric diagonal. In the certified right-angled geometry its complete trace is `2-4/c^2`, where `c` is the actual crossing-circle rectangle ratio. In particular, an entire already constructed class has a target outside the real physical channel range at EVERY matching edge. There is nevertheless an exact source polynomial that can be evaluated at that trace. The fully normalized original Racah scalar is a degree-a polynomial in the target Casimir, generically before specialization. Consequently the completed target operator is that polynomial of the ORIGINAL Casimir. This retains all its normal derivatives. Its scalar evaluation below trace -2 is positive and has a direct variational limit. This is not yet an asymptotic for that operator in the surrounding coherent contraction. In particular a polynomial of degree proportional to N cannot be replaced by its value at a classical symbol without an additional argument. No global volume equality follows here. ## 1. The typed bend fixes the geometric target Use the exact bend of the [marked four-port source](actual_matching_edge_marked_four_port_block.md): B(K)_(a,b,c,e)=sum_(u,v) K_(a,b;u,v) pV(u,e)pV(v,c). Its four external objects occur in the order `(a,b,c,e)`. The target tensor in that theorem couples the middle ports `(b,c)` and then applies the ACTUAL pivotal last-to-first turn to the other pair. It is not a different permutation of these objects. Here is the corresponding based-holonomy calculation. For an original physical head write Lminus(X,S)=[[1,0],[S(1-X)/X,-1/X]], G(X,S)=[[-1/X,(1-X)/(XS)],[-S(1-X)/X,-2+1/X]]. The original cup gives the inverse-head relation `(X,S) -> (X^-1,-S)`. Its two Lminus matrices multiply to the identity, and prefix transport makes its two based meridians inverses. Thus the nested cups in `B(I)` have ordered based meridians (A_in, B_in, B_in^-1, A_in^-1). (1) For example, the middle two local Lminus factors cancel; the remaining prefix at the fourth head is the first Lminus, which gives precisely the inverse of the first based meridian. This proves the nesting order, including its basing, directly from the original cups. The [actual critical character map](actual_augmented_plat_local_critical_character_map.md) preserves both total F and total K. Therefore it preserves the ENTIRE matrix `Lminus_2 Lminus_1`, not only the trace of the pair product. Applying the coupon to the first two heads of (1) consequently leaves the prefixes and based meridians at the last two heads unchanged. The bent tensor has the ordered tuple (A_out, B_out, B_in^-1, A_in^-1), A_in^-1 B_in^-1 B_out A_out=P_in^-1 P_out=I. (2) The original target middle Casimir is consequently lambda_target=Tr(B_in^-1 B_out). (3) The pivotal turn does not change (3): it is the actual cyclic basepath change for the OTHER pair, already retained in the finite tensor formula. It does not replace a meridian by its negative or insert a longitude. At completeness normalize the incoming pair by simultaneous conjugacy: A=-[[1,1],[0,1]], B=-[[1,0],[-4,1]], P=BA, H=P+I, H^2=0, C=I+bH, B_out=C B C^-1. Direct matrix multiplication gives Tr(B^-1 C B C^-1)=2+16b^2. (4) All these traces use the original trace-minus-two lifts. No common choice of framing flags changes (3) or (4). ## 2. Classification in the certified complete geometry The [general matching-graph geometry](general_augmented_plat_matching_geometry.md) puts the crossing-circle rectangle at `(1,E,-1,-E)`, with `E=exp(2pi i x)`, `0<x<1/2`, and `c=cot(pi x)>0`. The actual primitive collar, calibrated to the quantum half-twist sign in the [channel-Hessian theorem](actual_augmented_plat_channel_hessian.md), is tau_epsilon=2ic/(1-epsilon ic), b-epsilon/2=1/tau_epsilon, epsilon in {0,+1,-1}. Hence the apparent shear cancels in the physical pair transport: b=-i/(2c), lambda_target=2-4/c^2. (5) This is independent of the retained half-twist sign; its primitive auxiliary meridian still depends on that sign. The source target eigenvalue is `zeta^(2g+1)+zeta^(-2g-1)`, whose real scaled limit is `2cos(2pi xi_target)`. Thus (5) has the classification c>1: xi_target=asin(1/c)/pi in (0,1/2), up to partner; c=1: lambda_target=-2, the folded parabolic point; 0<c<1: xi_target=1/2 +/- i arcosh(1/c)/pi. (6) The last case is a fixed nonzero imaginary channel displacement. Neither the ordinary packet, which keeps the channel real and discrete, nor the shrinking REAL-fold norm theorem is a continuation to it. There is no general remedy by selecting another matching edge. The [strict-quarter theorem](actual_conway_strict_leaf_quarter_bound.md), together with the actual marked Conway geometry, proves `x_leaf>1/4` for EVERY leaf of EVERY retained robust cylindrical Conway factor. Those are its measured primitive rectangle parameters, as follows also from the proved cusp shape `2i cot(pi x_leaf)`. Thus every matching edge in that broad class has `c<1`. In `C(h^3)`, all three ratios are `c=1/2`, so all three target traces are -14. This is an obstruction to a proposed real-target-channel rescue, not to recoupling or to the conjecture. ## 3. The original scalar is a generic polynomial in the target Casimir Put `d=N-1`, use generic `zeta`, `Q=zeta^2`, and symmetric quantum integers `[n]=(zeta^n-zeta^-n)/(zeta-zeta^-1)`. Let `S_ag,G_ag,D_a` be the ACTUAL seven-factorial sum and face factors of the [positive matching-edge scalar](actual_matching_edge_racah_positive_scalar.md): G_ag=(-1)^d S_ag/[N], D_a=(-1)^a[N][a]!^2[d-a]!/[d+a+1]!, H_ag=D_a G_ag D_g. Define `lambda_r=zeta^(2r+1)+zeta^(-2r-1)` and p_a(z)=sum_(k=0)^a (-1)^k/[k]!^2 *product_(r=0)^(k-1) {[a-r][a+r+1]/([d-r][d+r+2]) *(z-lambda_r)/(zeta-zeta^-1)^2}. (7) For every generic label `0<=a,g<=d`, the exact identity is H_ag=p_a(lambda_g). (8) In particular this is a degree-a polynomial in the ACTUAL target Casimir, with `p_0=1` and `p_a(lambda_0)=1`. Its finite basic sum is 4phi3(Q^-a,Q^(a+1),Q^-g,Q^(g+1); Q,Q^-d,Q^(d+2);Q,Q). (9) There are no omitted powers of zeta in (7). Indeed each numerator pair in (9) contributes `-(zeta-zeta^-1)^2 zeta^(2r+1)[a-r][a+r+1]`, or its g version. The four denominator factors and the summand's `Q^k` leave exactly the sign `(-1)^k` in (7). Also `[g-r][g+r+1]=(lambda_g-lambda_r)/(zeta-zeta^-1)^2`. Here is an own finite proof from the source sum. By symmetry assume `a<=g`. Apply the already proved [finite Sears identity](finite_balanced_sears_operator_proof.md) to (9), with length a, retained parameter `Q^(g+1)`, and `d_S=Q^-d,e_S=Q`. Its new numerator and denominator EXPONENTS are (-a,g+1,g-d,-d-a-1); (-d,g-a+1,g-d-a), with prefactor F1=(Q^-g,Q^(g-d-a);Q)_a/(Q,Q^(-d-a-1);Q)_a. Apply the same finite identity again, retaining `Q^(g-d)` and taking `d_S=Q^(g-a+1), e_S=Q^(g-d-a)`. This gives 4phi3(Q^-a,Q^-a,Q^(g-d),Q^(d+g+2); Q,Q^(g-a+1),Q^(g-a+1);Q,Q), F2=(Q^-a,Q^(g-a+1);Q)_a/ (Q^(g-d-a),Q^(d-a+1);Q)_a. The intermediate denominator `Q^(g-d-a)` first vanishes AFTER length a, including g=d. Multiplying and reversing the negative products gives F1 F2=(-1)^a[N][d-a]![g]!^2/ ([d+a+1]![g-a]!^2). (10) The right side is precisely the original `z=d+g` Racah summand, multiplied by `(-1)^d D_a D_g/[N]`. Its successive summand ratio is -[d+g+k+2][d-g-k][a-k]^2 / ([g-a+k+1]^2[k+1]^2), which is also the final series ratio. It terminates at `min(a,d-g)`, exactly the original range. This proves (8) by finite products and the own finite transform, including all generic zeros. Both sides of (9) are symmetric in a,g, which covers a>g. ## 4. Exact completed-operator identity, with every normal retained Let Omega and Pi_g be the ORIGINAL generic two-head Casimir and its generic projectors in the [completed target theorem](actual_matching_edge_completed_projector_block.md). Its scalar is `F_ag=G_ag D_g`. Equation (8) gives the operator identity sum_(g=0)^d F_ag Pi_g = D_a^-1 p_a(Omega). (11) Indeed the projectors exhaust the actual generic tensor product and Omega has eigenvalue lambda_g on their images. This is a GENERIC identity, so it includes the true first normal and every fixed generic jet. At a colliding pair its root Hermite data are exactly F_ag(q)=D_a(q)^-1 p_a(lambda_g(q))=R_N(a,g), H_ag^div(q)=D_a(q)^-1 p_a'(lambda_g(q)). (12) The prime in (12) is the spectral-variable derivative; generic-q derivatives are still taken in (11). This distinction is essential. In particular the old nilpotent term has not been removed: (12) computes its actual coefficient rather than inferring that coefficient from equality of the two root scalar values. The full typed replacement is therefore exactly sum_g G_ag h_g T_(2g)=beta_N R B[D_a^-1 p_a(Omega)]. (13) Here `beta_N`, the physical bend B and the pivotal turn R are the unchanged maps of the completed target theorem. All original row weights, half-twist phases and the exposed whole-source normal remain outside (13) with their original conventions. For the original range `0<=a<=floor(d/2)`, every denominator in (7) and D_a is a root unit after its displayed common zero is canceled. Thus the right side of (11) is holomorphic directly, without forming individual singular projectors. Equation (11) is not an assertion that Omega is Hermitian or that p_a(Omega) has polynomial operator norm. ## 5. Positive evaluation at the actual nonphysical geometric trace At `q=exp(pi i/N)` put `theta=pi/N`, `x_r=2cos((2r+1)theta)`, `s_k=product_(v=1)^k 2sin(v theta)`. Converting the generic products in (7) at the root gives p_a(z)=sum_(k=0)^a s_k^-4 product_(r=0)^(k-1)(x_r-x_a)(x_r-z). (14) For the original folded row range, `x_r>x_a` whenever r<a. Hence EVERY term in (14) is positive at every real z<-2. This is a genuine finite source-polynomial evaluation, not interpolation in a fabricated complex integer color. At z=x_g it equals the previously proved positive squared-trinomial Racah sum, but (14) remains defined away from all those physical nodes. Fix compact subsets `xi in (0,1/2]`, `c in (0,1)`, and let `a/N->xi`, with actual geometric trace `z=2-4/c^2`. Write A=sin^2(pi xi), kappa=c^-2, f_(xi,c)(v)=integral_0^v log[(A-sin^2(pi s))(kappa-sin^2(pi s))/sin^4(pi s)] ds. (15) Then the actual finite polynomial satisfies N^-1 log p_a(2-4/c^2) -> max_(0<=v<=xi) f_(xi,c)(v). (16) If the parameters on the right are taken at their actual values `xi=a/N`, the logarithmic error is O(log N), uniformly on the stated compacts. This includes the folded limit. More explicitly, its k-th term has EXACT logarithm sum_(v=a-k+1)^(a+k) log sin(v theta) -4 sum_(v=1)^k log sin(v theta) +sum_(r=0)^(k-1) log[kappa-sin^2((r+1/2)theta)]. The first line follows from `x_r-x_a=4 sin((a-r)theta)sin((a+r+1)theta)`; all powers of two cancel. The last summand is smooth uniformly because kappa>1. The elementary endpoint harmonic bound for log sin gives an O(log N) error for its Riemann sums, even when a+k approaches N-1 or a-k=0. Finally `sin(pi(xi-s))sin(pi(xi+s))=A-sin^2(pi s)` identifies the integral with (15). Thus `log term_k=N f(k/N)+O(log N)`, including either endpoint. The polynomial has at most N positive terms; the upper bound is their maximum times N, and a nearest integer to its interior maximum gives the reverse bound with the same logarithmic loss. The maximizing point is unique. Set t=sin^2(pi v). The derivative exponential is `(A-t)(kappa-t)/t^2`, strictly decreasing from infinity to zero as t runs from 0 to A. Consequently sin^2(pi v_*)=A kappa/(A+kappa). (17) At the folded row `xi=1/2`, this becomes v_*=atan(1/c)/pi=x, (18) the ACTUAL measured crossing-circle rectangle parameter. Thus the positive finite polynomial selects the correct local rectangle in this precise scalar variational sense. For z in a fixed compact subset of (-infinity,-2), all fixed generic-q and spectral derivatives of the scalar in (14) cost only a polynomial relative to p_a(z). This follows from (7), not from differentiating a root-only formula: each root term is positive; the nonzero quantum integer factors have total logarithmic derivative `O(N^2(1+log N))`, and `z-x_r` is uniformly separated from zero. On a disk of that reciprocal radius every summand remains in a fixed narrow sector. Cauchy gives the fixed-jet bound. This controls scalar evaluation at that trace, not the norm of the operator in (11). ## 6. The remaining analytic question is narrower, but still real Equations (3)--(6) answer which target channel the actual geometry requires. Equations (7)--(14) provide its exact finite source polynomial without a complex-color interpolation. The full root Hermite data and generic normal are retained, and (16)--(18) give a positive scalar action whose critical parameter is the actual rectangle. The original contracted operator is nevertheless `p_a(Omega)` with `a` proportional to N. A sharp analysis must show how that polynomial acts on the actual surrounding selected boundary state, including the pivotal reshuffle and shared magnetic variables. Its scalar value at lambda_target is not already such an operator theorem, nor a noncancellation estimate for the full marked source. This is the remaining step exposed here; taking the independent full operator maximum would again pay the previously computed 10v3 boundary cost. Audit: [typed target, original polynomial, normal and scalar-rate checks](../experiments/audit_actual_matching_edge_geometric_target_polynomial.py). It passes exact symbolic nested-cup/prefix/primitive-collar identities, 4,485 generic ORIGINAL seven-factorial comparisons, eleven original Casimir polynomial matrices (6,453 entries), 529 four-jet comparisons before specialization and 251 actual divided-normal comparisons with the spectral derivative. Twelve positive scalar evaluations at 80 digits check the stated variational normalization and selected mode. These checks supplement the displayed finite and asymptotic proofs; none tests or asserts a surrounding coherent operator asymptotic. Independent geometry-agent proof review and fresh redirected audit: PASS. The review independently checked the nested-cup basepaths and full lower Borel preservation, the actual middle target and primitive half-twist cancellation, the generic finite polynomial, retained normal, positive scalar terms and endpoint-uniform logarithmic error. It also checked that the strict-quarter obstruction concerns the measured primitive rectangles. The fresh replay reproduced every recorded count. No scalar-to-operator asymptotic was included in that verdict. Root full analytical review: PASS. The review separately checked the typed nesting and collar trace, both finite Sears transformations and their original prefactor and termination, the generic operator identity and retained normal, the positive root products and uniform endpoint Riemann estimate, and the unique scalar saddle. Independent coherent-source review and fresh redirected audit: PASS. The full proof read checked the actual lower Borel basing and target, the half-twist cancellation, generic source normalization through both finite transforms, the completed spectral polynomial and true divided normal, and the scalar action and generic-jet scope. Its fresh replay reproduced all recorded counts. The note and focused audit are frozen.

title: The controlled exceptional kernel tube misses the selected global frame
status: Exact incompatibility of the controlled tube
text: # The controlled exceptional kernel tube misses the selected global frame 30 October 2026. Independently reviewed. This is an exact classical-coordinate consequence of the actual inverse turn. The [source-matching complex root kernel](actual_matching_edge_antidiagonal_operator_packet.md) is a valid nonzero packet on its stated tube. That tube does not contain the complete geometric point in a common frame having the global shaded-exterior flags and the selected physical complement used in our one-matching-edge localization. This strengthens the real-slice obstruction under an explicit global flag hypothesis. It includes the parabolic rectangle c=1, since the proof does not diagonalize the target or use a rectangle ratio. ## 1. The exact tube and the geometric assumptions Keep the actual certified right-angled matching cut, its literal prefixes, retained half twists and original mark. Fix a matching edge. Assume the common global frame has both shaded-exterior flags in K, and that every original ordinary factor outside this edge has strict physical support and its source-selected complete geometric sheet. These are the hypotheses supplied by the prescribed-pair localization. Use the actual root-kernel variables target output u=nu, target input v=nu+delta, target normalized total tau=nu+lambda+delta. At the complete input the packet's strict limiting tube is 0<Re delta<1/2, Re nu>0, Re lambda>0, Re(nu+lambda+delta)<1. (1) For a discrete input a/N<1/2 its proved tube is smaller, with Re delta<a/N. The geometric statement concerns the complete limiting channel; it does not continue that discrete index. Both finite degree offsets in the packet remain in that theorem. Here (1) describes its limiting classical coordinate domain, not a new finite-index identity. No common frame satisfying the preceding geometric hypotheses puts the actual inverse-turn target in (1), in either physical degree adapter or either input/output order. ## 2. Undo the actual inverse turn in multiplicative coordinates Let A,B be the original inputs and A_o,B_o their outputs, so P=BA=B_o A_o. The actual target inputs are A_o^-1,A, with outputs B_o,B^-1 and target product T_target=A A_o^-1. Use the original prefix-normalized projector Pi and target projector Pi_t=A_o Pi/Tr(A_o Pi). (2) As before, Pi comes from the ONE global frame by W Pi_global/Tr(W Pi_global), followed by the fixed local conjugacy. Its image and kernel are the actual prefix flags, not independently chosen local data. Write T=exp(2pi i tau), V=exp(2pi i v), U=exp(2pi i u). The LOW target adapter has prefix traces Tr(A_o^-1 Pi_t)=-1/V, Tr(B_o Pi_t)=-1/U, Tr(T_target Pi_t)=1/T. Applying (2), using T_target A_o=A and B_o A_o=P, gives (Tr(A Pi),Tr(A_o Pi),Tr(P Pi))=(-V/T,-V,V/U). (3) Thus the original physical exponentials are U_old,in=T/V, U_old,out=1/V, T_old=U/V. (4) For the HIGH target adapter the prefix traces are instead (-T/V,-T/U,T). Formula (2) gives (-V,-V/T,V/U), so the two original magnetic exponentials in (4) simply exchange. The total and the support conclusions remain unchanged. The canonical ORIGINAL low logarithms dictated by (1),(4) are tau_old=1-delta, nu_old,in=lambda, nu_old,out=1-nu-delta=tau_old-nu. (5) The integer one in tau_old and nu_old,out is essential. It is fixed by the actual canonical physical wires; it cannot be dropped by looking only at their exponentials. Equation (1) implies 1/2<Re tau_old<1, 0<Re lambda<Re tau_old, 0<Re(tau_old-nu)<Re tau_old. (6) Hence BOTH original factors lie in the full strict physical domain. If the target input/output order is reversed, the original physical total is 1+delta, with magnetic rows lambda+delta and 1-nu. The actual ORIGINAL high adapter subtracts delta from both rows and reverses the total, yielding exactly (5). This proves (6) for all the stated adapters and orders without a reality assumption. ## 3. The exact global contradiction Since the global flags lie in K, the literal white-reflection prefix dictionary supplies the oriented strip tests at EVERY disk, including the two factors on this edge. Equations (5),(6) put those two factors strictly inside the full ordinary physical domain. The proved selected-sheet continuation on that domain therefore makes their geometric sheets source-selected as well. Every factor would consequently have both strict physical support and the oriented strip condition. The purely geometric sections 4--5 of the [white-normal obstruction](actual_right_angled_selected_framing_obstruction.md) rule this out: the polarization kernel through the two K flags meets the white-normal polyhedron, and a boundary triangular facet gives a nonnegative relation among its three actual prefix diagonals. Their convex hull contains zero, violating strict physical support. This use of the old geometric proof does not extend an old central-only source theorem by assertion. The needed source-sheet continuation throughout the full physical domain is separately established in the [selected-factor theorem](actual_augmented_plat_selected_factor_localization.md). Neither the contradiction nor (2)--(6) uses c<1 or a diagonal target; the parabolic target is included. ## 4. What the result changes The complex root-kernel packet retains its exact finite grid values, holomorphic continuation and nonzero amplitude on (1). The obstruction concerns its compatibility with the currently selected geometric complement. Merely allowing complex coordinates inside that SAME physical tube does not resolve this interface. This one-block route needs continuation beyond the proved tube, or a different coupled grouping, complementary description or frame selection. No numerical rate gap, vanishing source contribution, absence of another contributing cycle, or failure of the volume conjecture is inferred. Boundary points and continuations across the stated support walls require their own analysis. This is an analytical corollary of the audited inverse-turn dictionary, physical adapters, full-domain sheet theorem and white-normal proof. It claims no new finite-kernel audit counts or asymptotic estimates. Primary-agent full analytical review: PASS. The reader checked the inverse-turn prefix ratios, the integer-one lifts, both adapters and the exact hypotheses of the reused white-normal argument. Two independent targeted analytical reviews: PASS. The source reader checked the stated tube against the actual root-kernel formula; the global-source reader independently derived both target adapters and the reversed-order high lift. All three readers retain the global K hypothesis and distinguish the coordinate obstruction from a failure of the finite packet theorem or the volume conjecture.

title: The actual magnetic-energy profile and the full Steinberg cost
status: Exact Plancherel; full folded norm rate
text: # The actual magnetic-energy profile and the full Steinberg cost 30 October 2026. An exact finite Fourier identity reduces the native magnetic energy to its actual center coefficient, within polynomial factors. The selected q-Hahn action therefore gives its rate without taking the absolute values of a coherent source sum. At the folded channel the degree profile is strictly increasing. The FULL odd Steinberg projector and the even maximal completed pair both have rate 5 v3/pi, larger than the highest-weight block example v8/(2pi). Here v3 is the volume of a regular ideal tetrahedron. The result is an operator boundary cost. It does not assert a volume identity for the original marked network or replace shared magnetic sums by independent local maxima. ## 1. Exact Fourier reduction, including the unused nodes Use q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, d=N-1 and an actual complete channel 0<=j<=floor(d/2), d-j<=t<=d. Let fhat(u) be the literal terminating continuation of the original normalized column C_j(t,u). The [magnetic polynomial theorem](actual_q_hahn_magnetic_complex_corridor.md) proves, with x=q^d, h=d-t and n=t+j-d, fhat(u)=x^u Q^(-ju) G_t(Q^u), G_t(q^t z)=c_t P_t(z), c_t=q^(jn)/(Q;Q)_j, P_t(z)=B_h(z) A_n(z)=sum_(k=0)^j p_k z^k. (1) Every p_k is strictly positive. This is the proved sine-coefficient recurrence for A_n and the positive sine-binomial coefficients of B_h, not positivity of the original oscillatory magnetic column. Also G_t(Q^u)=0 for every unused physical node t<u<=d. Since deg G_t=j<N, discrete Fourier orthogonality gives EXACTLY sum_(u=0)^t |C_j(t,u)|^2 =sum_(u=0)^d |G_t(Q^u)|^2 =N/s_j^2 sum_(k=0)^j p_k^2, (2) |fhat(t/2)|^2=(sum_k p_k)^2/s_j^2. All prefactors in the first line of (1) have modulus one at real u, including the possibly half-integral center. Thus no physical parity or source phase is changed in (2). The vanished nodes are essential: the whole Fourier sum is equal to the actual physical column norm, rather than a norm on a larger invented support. Cauchy's inequality and positivity now imply N/(j+1)|fhat(t/2)|^2 <= ||C_j(t,.)||_2^2 <=N|fhat(t/2)|^2. (3) This is both an upper and a lower estimate, uniform at ALL physical degrees in the complete range. It leaves the actual cancellation already present in the center coefficient untouched. ## 2. The explicit complete-channel energy profile Let J(y)=integral_0^y log(2sin(pi z))dz for 0<=y<=1, and let Phi_xi(tau,nu) be the ACTUAL selected action proved in the [full physical packet](actual_q_hahn_full_physical_complex_packet.md). For 0<xi<=1/2 and 1-xi<=tau<1 put e(tau,xi)=2 Re Phi_xi(tau,tau/2) -J(tau-xi)-J(tau+xi-1)+2J(tau). (4) This formula is uniform near xi=1/2. It applies to both double channels and the odd simple midpoint. More precisely, use the actual ratios xi_N=j/N and tau_N=(t+1)/N, so that the complete condition is exactly tau_N+xi_N>=1. On fixed real compacts with 1/2<tau_N<1 and xi_N bounded away from zero, log E_(t,j)=N e(tau_N,xi_N)+O(log N), (5) where E is the exact CD-normalized magnetic energy of the [native projector theorem](actual_matching_edge_native_projector_energy.md). The O(log N) is uniform, including the bottom complete degree. Indeed (3) changes the logarithm of the norm from that of its center by only O(log N). The original nonzero packet gives log|fhat(t/2)|=N Re Phi_(j/N)(t/N,t/(2N))+O(log N). Moving both scaled arguments by O(1/N) to the ratios in (5) costs O(1) on these compacts. The exact double CD measure is |sigma_(t,j)|=N s_(t-j)s_(t+j-d)/(s_t^2 a_j^2), a_j=|1-Q^(2j+1)|. Its log divided by N equals the three J terms subtracted in (4), to error O(log N/N). Nonzero a_j is at least a constant/N, so even the almost-folded double channels cost only O(log N). At the simple midpoint its exact measure N s_(t-j)^2/s_t^2 has the SAME limiting profile. Uniform factorial endpoint estimates include s_0=1. The shifted tau_N avoids assigning J a negative argument at t=d-j. The rate in (4) also has an elementary derivative. Set c=-cos(pi tau), C=cos(pi xi), s=sin(pi xi), k=sqrt(1+2c+C^2). In the strict complete interior c>C>=0, partial_tau e =2 log{ [s sqrt(1+c)+sqrt((1-c)(1+2c+C^2))] /sqrt(2(c^2-C^2)) }>0. (6) For a direct derivation, the actual selected magnetic multiplier at the real center is Y=(s+i k)^2/[2(1+c)]. It has modulus one and argument in (0,pi). The original second finite-shift equation gives exp(Phi_tau)=(exp(pi i tau)-Y^-1)/(1+exp(pi i tau)). Taking its modulus gives [s tan(pi tau/2)+k]/sqrt(2(1+c)). The real derivative along the center is Re Phi_tau because Re Phi_nu=0. Meanwhile the derivative of the CD action is log[(c^2-C^2)/(1-c^2)]. Combining these two identities proves (6). Its sign is exact: the square of the FIRST numerator term minus the denominator squared is (1-c)(1+2c+C^2)>0. It follows that the entire displayed numerator is strictly larger than its denominator. Thus the complete-channel rate is strictly increasing in physical degree. For a nonfolded PAIR, the unpaired degrees j<=t<d-j are not covered by this assertion; no full paired-operator maximum is deduced from (6) alone. ## 3. A finite folded determinant controls ALL physical degrees Now let N=2m+1 be odd and j=m. The full Steinberg projector is simple. By the exact high-degree adapter, it suffices to consider m<=t<=d=2m. Write c_t=-cos(pi(t+1)/N), R_m(z;c)=det(z I+c D_m+K_m), (7) where D_m is the already proved real positive matrix and K_m is real skew-symmetric. Here c_t ranges from sin(pi/(2N)) to 1. The exact source scalar and CD measure give |fhat(t/2)|^2/|sigma_(t,m)|=R_m(1;c_t)^2/N. Indeed beta(2m,m)=1, the sine denominator of the center column is s_t/s_(t-m), and |sigma|=N s_(t-m)^2/s_t^2. Therefore (3) becomes R_m(1;c_t)^2/(m+1) <= E_(t,m) <= R_m(1;c_t)^2. (8) The determinant is positive and strictly increasing for real c>=0. To verify this directly, conjugate I+cD_m+K_m by D_m^-1/2. Its symmetric part is D_m^-1+cI>0, so its inverse has positive definite symmetric part. Consequently partial_c log R_m(1;c) =tr[(I+cD_m+K_m)^-1 D_m]>0. (9) This proves finite bounds on the ENTIRE physical operator: R_m(1;1)^2/(m+1) <= ||Pi_St||op <= R_m(1;1)^2, ||Pi_St||op <= ||Pi_St||HS <= sqrt(N)||Pi_St||op. (10) Every physical degree is retained. These bounds do not claim that the exact finite maximum of E_(t,m) is always at t=d; they prove that its exponential rate is determined there. There is no unproved endpoint continuity hidden here. For c>=0 put S=I+cD_m. The symmetric part of (S+K_m)^-1 is bounded above by S^-1: conjugate by S^-1/2 and use Re(I+A)^-1=(I-A^2)^-1<=I for real skew A. Integrating the trace inequality yields 0<=log R_m(1;c)-log R_m(1;0) <=log det(I+cD_m). (11) Hadamard and the explicit diagonal (D_m)_(n,n)=1/[cos(n pi/N)cos((n+1)pi/N)] give log det(I+cD_m) <=sum_(r=1)^m log(1+C c N^2/r^2) <=C N sqrt(c). (12) The last step bounds the decreasing sum by its integral on (0,infinity). Thus the actual lowest c_t=O(1/N) and c=0 differ by o(N) in log determinant. Near c=1 the simpler bound partial_c log R_m<=m/c gives uniform continuity after division by N. Together with the interior packet, (8),(11),(12) extend the folded profile continuously to BOTH degree endpoints. At its lower endpoint the native highest-column calculation gives e(1/2,1/2)=v8/(2pi). ## 4. The endpoint is an actual cubic Fourier sum The upper endpoint can be evaluated without applying an interior amplitude theorem on the boundary. At t=d,u=j=m the ORIGINAL terminating sum is, up to its displayed unit phase, P_N(w_N)=sum_(a=0)^m beta(m,a)^3 w_N^a, w_N=q^m -> i, C_m(d,m)=exp(pi i m)q^[-(m+1)m] P_N(w_N). (13) The denominator beta(d,m) is exactly one. The [negative-root theorem](actual_q_hahn_negative_root_source_polynomial.md) applies to THIS physical polynomial and proves that every zero is negative real. Its positive-real asymptotic is therefore continued to i by the actual root-product normal-family argument. For completeness, uniform factorial estimates give the real Laplace phase E(alpha)=-3[J(alpha)+J(1/2-alpha)], 0<=alpha<=1/2. For every w>0, E(alpha)+alpha log w has one strict interior maximum: E'=3 log cot(pi alpha), E''<0. The selected saddle is explicitly alpha(w)=pi^-1 arctan(w^(1/3)). (14) Use the positive cube root at w>0 and its continuation on the slit plane C\(-infinity,0]. Its argument stays in (-pi/3,pi/3), so arctan and the J terms continue holomorphically without reaching their singularities. The root-product bound |Log((w+rho)/(1+rho))|<=C_K, rho>0, on each slit-plane compact and the positive-real Laplace limit identify the WHOLE actual normalized logarithm with this continued saddle action. This argument includes the moving arguments w_N and does not use a triangle bound for (13). At w=i, alpha=1/4+i log(3)/(4pi), z=exp(2pi i alpha)=i/sqrt(3). Let eta=Im alpha. The real source rate is S=Re[E(alpha)+alpha log i] =-6 Re J(alpha)-(pi/2)eta =3 Im Li2(z)/pi+log(3)/4 =3 D(z)/pi. (15) Here D(z)=Im Li2(z)+Arg(1-z)log|z| is the ideal tetrahedron volume. To check every constant, the analytic primitive on the sine strip is J(a)=i pi(a-a^2)/2+i[Li2(exp(2pi i a))-pi^2/6]/(2pi). At the displayed alpha it gives Re J(alpha)=-pi eta/4-Im Li2(z)/(2pi). Also Arg(1-z)=-pi/6 and log|z|=-log(3)/2. These prove (15). The ideal shape z has angles pi/2,pi/6,pi/3. Thus D(z)=Lambda(pi/6)+Lambda(pi/3), with Lambda(pi/2)=0. The elementary duplication identity for the integral Lambda gives Lambda(pi/6)=(3/2)Lambda(pi/3), and v3=3Lambda(pi/3). Consequently D(z)=5v3/6, so the EXACT endpoint energy rate is 2S=5v3/pi. (16) Since R_m(1;1)=sqrt(N)|C_m(d,m)|, equations (10),(13)--(16) prove lim_(odd N) N^-1 log ||Pi_St||op =lim_(odd N) N^-1 log ||Pi_St||HS=5v3/pi. (17) In the volume convention 2pi times a rate, this boundary cost is 10v3. It is strictly larger than the v8 cost in the highest-weight block, which has the LOWEST physical degree t=j. ## 5. What is retained for the general source The folded profile can be recorded without an implicit saddle: e(tau,1/2)=5v3/pi -integral_tau^1 2log{[sqrt(1+c) +sqrt((1-c)(1+2c))]/(sqrt(2)c)} ds, c=-cos(pi s). (18) It is continuous on [1/2,1], strictly increasing in its interior, and has the two endpoint values proved above. The fixed-jet native theorem adds only polynomial factors to these energies. Equations (2)--(5) retain an explicit magnetic degree and the exact CD measure. The full operator norm takes a maximum over that ONE degree. In an original diagram those degrees and magnetic variables are shared by adjacent coupons, and the phases in (1),(13) remain in their signed contractions. Nothing here authorizes multiplying independently maximized local boundary costs, discarding those phases, or identifying the energy optimum with a marked geometric critical point. Those are distinct global requirements. Audit: [actual Fourier energy and folded endpoint](../experiments/audit_actual_matching_edge_magnetic_energy_profile.py). ## 6. The even maximal pair has the same full rate Let N=2h>=4, j=h-1, l=h. Use the ACTUAL completed Q_j,M_j of the native-energy theorem, rather than treating the two root channels as separate simple projectors. The complete degrees are h<=t<=d. Their exact normalization is |fhat(t/2)|^2/|sigma_(t,j)| =(8/N) sin(pi(t-j)/N) R_j(1;c_t)^2. (19) For verification, a_j=2sin(pi/N), a_j s_(2j)=N and s_j^2=N/2. Substituting these identities into the center column and the DOUBLE CD measure leaves (19), because s_(t-j)/s_(t+j-d)=2sin(pi(t-j)/N). This retains the paired source normal and its measure. By (3),(9), 8 R_j(1;1)^2/(j+1) <= max_(h<=t<=d) E_(t,j) <=8 R_j(1;1)^2. (20) The lower bound uses t=d, where the sine in (19) is exactly one; the upper bound uses that sine<=1 and c_t<=1. There is just ONE incomplete low degree, t=j, with its reflected high copy. Its normalized highest column has |f_u|=beta(j,u) and |sigma|=1/sin(pi/N), so its energy has the smaller rate v8/(2pi). At t=d the center d/2 is half-integral. Use the original physical sample u=j, only half a step away. The endpoint polynomial is P_N(w_N)=sum_(a=0)^j beta(j,a)^2 beta(j+1,j-a) w_N^a, w_N=q^j -> i. (21) Again beta(d,j)=1 and the external source factor has modulus one. Its coefficients differ from the cubic coefficients by the EXACT positive ratio beta(j+1,j-a)/beta(j,a)=1/sin(pi(a+1)/N), which is between one and O(N). Thus its uniform real Laplace profile is the same E(alpha) as in section 4. Its actual negative roots then select the same complex action at i; this does not deduce the complex rate by comparing positive coefficients alone. The center/sample comparison is also exact up to a controlled unit. At t=d the positive polynomial P_t in (1) has all roots negative real. Each factor with root -rho satisfies cos(pi/(2N)) <= |exp(-pi i/N)+rho|/(1+rho) <=1. Multiplying its j factors, with the physical prefactors of (1), gives cos(pi/(2N))^j <= |C_j(d,j)|/|fhat(d/2)| <=1. (22) The center determinant scalar in (19) is polynomial in N, so (21),(22) prove N^-1 log R_j(1;1)^2 ->5v3/pi at even levels too. Finally, M_j has exact rank-one norm E_(t,j) on the complete blocks and is zero on the incomplete block. The native-energy theorem also places ||Q_j|| between constant times the complete energy and a polynomial times the full energy, retaining the incomplete block. Equations (20)--(22) therefore prove lim_(even N) N^-1 log ||M_j||op =lim_(even N) N^-1 log ||Q_j||op=5v3/pi, (23) with the same limits for Hilbert--Schmidt norms. Every fixed generic-q jet of these operators has upper exponential rate at most 5v3/pi by the already proved native bounds. No equality is asserted for a derivative that might vanish or cancel. This proves a common FULL folded boundary cost at both parities, using the simple odd projector and the actual even Hermite pair in their respective source roles. Primary-agent analytical review: PASS, including the exact physical Parseval reduction, source-shift/CD derivative and its strict sign, finite determinant bounds, skew-inverse comparison and endpoint control, actual cubic endpoint and its selected dilogarithm constant, and the even measure, half-step comparison and completed Q/M norms. The review retains the one-operator boundary-cost scope and does not infer a whole-network positive pairing, gluing identity or volume limit. Independent full analytical and targeted even-parity review: PASS. The reviewer independently derived the exact Fourier support and normalization, degree profile, determinant endpoint bounds, cubic source phase and selected 5v3/pi constant, even paired measure and half-step comparison, and full Q/M norm implications. A fresh 100-digit replay passed 1,848 original physical values, 336 unused nodes, 189 Parseval/center identities, 35 odd determinant brackets, seven odd cubic endpoints, 27 even center normalizations, six even endpoint/half-step comparisons and four source-gradient checks. The displayed sequences reach levels 256/257; the written proof, not those sequences, supplies the limits and uniform estimates.

text: # The original matching-edge block, its row measure, and its boundary cost 30 October 2026. This is an exact four-port rewrite of ONE matching edge of the original complete-circle source, at every level parity. It retains the physical cups, the categorical dual, the fixed gamma factor, every new recoupling channel, and the whole-network first normal. The original circle measure cancels the exponential row normalizer. The remaining estimate separates a positive scalar from an explicitly specified target tensor and complementary-network cost. This is not a positive norm formula for the completed block or a full-source volume bound. The retained half-twist phases, high-channel Laurent terms, and surrounding contraction are not discarded. ## 1. The actual typed block and its natural bend Use the conventions of the [full matching-graph source](general_matching_graph_full_normal_source.md). Put d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), zeta=q exp(t), and 0<=a<=floor(d/2). The matching object has highest weight E=2a. The two physical objects have highest weight d. Write W_a=W_dd^(2a), with its first highest entry one, and use the ACTUAL physical cup and inverse cap pV(u,d-u)=N zeta^(-d^2) (-1)^u zeta^[u(d-u-1)] F_u F_(d-u)/F_d, ellV=pV^-1, F_r=(zeta^2;zeta^2)_r. (1) The ordinary channel cup p_E has first coefficient one. Keep gamma_a=q^(2-a^2)/N^2 (2) as a FIXED root constant. The regular generic lift of the original root channel is exactly pi_a=gamma_a^-1 p_E^T W_a^T (ellV^T tensor ellV^T) P, K_a=W_a pi_a, (3) where P reverses the two physical heads. No inverse of pi_a W_a is used: that root composition is zero on every paired sector. This is the allowed regular Hopf lift of the root map, not an assertion that its entire moving-q germ equals the original circle's germ. For an operator K on V_d tensor V_d define the cup bend by B(K)=K(pV tensor pV)P, B(K)_(a,b,c,e)=sum_(u,v) K_(a,b;u,v) pV(u,e)pV(v,c), B^-1(Psi)=Psi P(ellV tensor ellV). (4) Thus the four outside ports are ordered a,b,c,e. This is the actual reversal already present in (3), not a permutation chosen to improve a recoupling coefficient. Every external object is V_d, independently of the ribbon order elsewhere in the matching graph. The exact generic identity is B(K_a)=gamma_a^-1 S_(2a), S_(2a)=W_a p_E W_a^T. (5) Here is the sign and scale check. Canonical cups satisfy ell_A^T p_A=(-1)^A K_A^-1, p_A^T=(-1)^A p_A K_A. Scaling p_A and inversely scaling ell_A leaves the first identity unchanged. The two physical (-1)^d signs therefore cancel in (4). Hopf covariance gives W_a K_E=(K_d tensor K_d)W_a, so the remaining factor is p_E^T K_E^-1=p_E because E=2a is even. This proves (5) with the physical scale in (1), before specialization. ## 2. The exact recoupling and the unchanged marked normal The [generic all-port theorem](actual_general_four_port_single_racah_kernel.md) now applies with A=B=C=D=d. Its actual target tensor includes the turn T_(2g)(u,v,w,z)=(-1)^d zeta^(d-2u) [(W_dd^(2g) tensor W_dd^(2g))p_(2g)](v,w,z,u). Consequently K_a=gamma_a^-1 sum_(g=0)^d L_(2g,2a) B^-1(T_(2g)). (6) All g=0,...,d are present. In particular the high targets 2g>=N are genuine meromorphic generic tensors. They are not removed using the root folded-channel range of the ORIGINAL matching edge. Fix all other original matching labels. After (6) is inserted into the actual network, denote its ordinary generic closure functional on the four-port operator by C(t). It includes the original outside ordering and bends. Keep the original exposed mark on a physical edge. The proved whole-network identity first replaces that marked scalar by the normal of its ORDINARY closure: Z_Delta(a,others)=nu_N^-1 [t^1] C(t)(K_a(t)), nu_N=2N(-1)^N/(q-q^-1). (7) The functional C is holomorphic because its remaining original coupons and physical cups/caps are regular. Equation (7) is not obtained by moving a bare marked row through a local cap. It follows from the ordinary whole-network trace D_N(t) times a regular open scalar, exactly as in the full matching-graph theorem. For the original complete circle the outside scalar remains h0_a=k_a N s_(2a)/s_a^2, k_a=2 if 2a<d, k_a=1 if 2a=d, omega_a=q^(d^2/2)(-1)^a q^[a(a+1)], s_r=product_(v=1)^r 2sin(pi v/N). (8) The coupon's signed half twist contributes omega_a^epsilon. Its unit absolute value does not authorize removing its phase from the sum over a. ## 3. The original measure cancels the row gauge Write the genuine seven-factorial Racah sum as S_ag and put G_ag=(-1)^d S_ag/[N]_zeta, R_N(a,g)=G_ag(q)>0. (9) The division is in each original summand. The [matching-edge scalar theorem](actual_matching_edge_racah_positive_scalar.md) proves analyticity, the positive formula R_N(a,g)=sum_(r=max(0,a-g))^(min(a,d-g)) [s_(g+r)/(s_(g+r-a)s_r s_(a-r))]^2, (10) and fixed generic jet bounds polynomial times R_N(a,g). Its full generic germ is tail-free: the original numerator never reaches [2N]. The actual source coefficient, with all boundary products as defined in the all-port theorem, is L_(2g,2a)=rho_a G_ag h_g, rho_a=(-1)^d [N]_zeta chi_(2a) X_(2a)/S0, h_g=1/(b_(2g) J_(d-g) V_(d-g)). (11) In particular h_g depends on g,N,t but NOT on a. Its b,J,V are the actual first-entry and Casimir products, not a chosen orthogonality measure. For completeness, with n=d-g and Q=zeta^2, S0=[2d+1]!/([d-a]!^2[a]!^2), V_n=zeta^n (Q^(-d-g-1);Q)_n / [(Q;Q)_n^2 (Q^(-2d-1);Q)_n], J_n=zeta^[-n(d+1)] F_d^2/F_g^2, b_(2g)=(-1)^d zeta^(d-2g) h_dd^(2g)(d-g) (-1)^(d-g) zeta^[-d^2+2d(d-g)-(d-g)(d-g+1)], h_dd^(2g)(r)=(-1)^r zeta^[r(d-2g-r-1)] F_(g+r)F_(d-r)/(F_g F_d). (12) The target product also has the exact symmetric-factorial form h_g=(-1)^d zeta^(g^2+d) [g]!^2[d-g]!^2[2g+1]![2d+1]! / ([d]!^2[d+g+1]!^2). (12a) One can check (12a) directly by writing each negative Pochhammer in (12) as a ratio of F-factorials; the residual zeta exponent is g^2+d. If a_src(g)=chi_(2g)X_(2g)/S0 denotes the generic row formula, continued through the entire target range, this gives a_src(g) h_g=[2g+1](Delta_g^2)^2, [N]^2 a_src(g) h_g=[2g+1]D_g^2. (12b) Here Delta_g and D_g are the actual face factors of the scalar theorem, with D_g(q)=1. Thus even the target normalization is a specified boundary product. Equation (12b) is a generic bilinear identity, not positivity of the completed root channel measure. There is an especially useful exact simplification of the row: chi_(2a) X_(2a)=(-1)^d zeta^[2a(a-d)-d] F_d^2/(F_(d-a)^2 F_(2a)), rho_a=zeta^(-a^2-d) [d]!^2[a]!^2 / ([2a]! ([2d+1]!/[N])). (13) To check the exponent independently, converting the displayed F ratio to symmetric factorials contributes 2da-3a^2; adding 2a(a-d)-d gives -a^2-d. The powers of 1-Q cancel. At the root, [2d+1]!/[N]=(-1)^d[d]!^2, rho_a(0)=(-1)^d q^(-a^2-d) s_a^2/s_(2a), h0_a gamma_a^-1 rho_a(0) =(-1)^d k_a N^3 q^(-d-2). (14) Thus the row's exponential factorial cost cancels against the ORIGINAL circle measure. This is not an adjusted normalization. Let u_a(t)=rho_a(t)/rho_a(0). All factors of (13), after its one [N] cancellation, are root units. The same elementary harmonic product bound used for (9) proves, for each fixed m, |[t^m]u_a(t)| <= C_m P_N^m, |[t^m]G_ag(t)| <= C_m P_N^m R_N(a,g), P_N=N^2(1+log N), (15) uniformly in every allowed a,g. This retains the actual generic derivatives; root equality of partner values is not differentiated. ## 4. The full first-normal formula and the precise bound it gives Set H_g(t)=t h_g(t) T_(2g)(t). (16) Every H_g is holomorphic. Indeed h_g has a simple pole exactly when 2g<d, while the target cup can have a simple pole only when 2g>=N. These ranges are disjoint. The Clebsch factors in T have the regular canceled physical coproduct expressions. This is the simple-pole result of the matching-edge scalar theorem, now with the actual typed source interface included. Combining (6)--(16) gives the exact original weighted sector h0_a omega_a^epsilon Z_Delta(a,others) =(-1)^d k_a N^3 q^(-d-2) omega_a^epsilon/nu_N *sum_(g=0)^d [t^2] {u_a(t) G_ag(t) C(t)(B^-1(t)H_g(t))}. (17) Only Taylor orders zero, one and two of each regular factor in (17) are needed. The regular full source requires a first normal; the second-order budget in (17) is exactly the cost of its singular recoupling coordinates. No termwise root evaluation replaces it. Here is one explicit bound, in the standard physical basis. Use the Hilbert--Schmidt norm for four-port matrices and its dual for C, and define the N-dependent quantities J_C=max_(0<=m<=2) ||[t^m]C(t)||, J_g=max_(0<=m<=2) ||[t^m]H_g(t)||_HS. (18) They are finite, fully specified ORIGINAL tensor and complement costs. They are not postulated to be subexponential. At the root each nonzero entry of pV has magnitude N, since s_u s_(d-u)=N. Therefore ||B^-1(0)||_(HS->HS)=N^-2, ||[t^m]B^-1(t)||_(HS->HS)<=C_m N^-2 P_N^m (0<=m<=2). (19) The second bound follows directly from the nonzero cup entries in (1) and their harmonic logarithmic derivative bounds. Thus the physical cup scale contributes no exponential cost. Expanding (17), using (15),(18),(19), and noting |nu_N|=N/sin(pi/N), gives |h0_a omega_a^epsilon Z_Delta(a,others)| <= C k_a sin(pi/N) P_N^2 J_C sum_(g=0)^d R_N(a,g) J_g. (20) The constant is universal for these fixed jet orders. Weighted Cauchy also gives sum_g R_N(a,g)J_g <= (sum_g R_N(a,g))^(1/2) (sum_g R_N(a,g)J_g^2)^(1/2). (21) Equations (20),(21) are source-exact upper estimates with every boundary cost displayed. They do not define a positive root inner product on the original paired-nilpotent channels. Summing them over a and the other original labels retains all their original scalar weights and yields an upper bound, not a lower bound or a nonvanishing statement. Retaining the phases in (17) is necessary for an equality. ## 5. What this resolves and the remaining costs The prescribed-pair geometric localization can put both exceptional facets at the ends of this ONE matching edge. Its four outside objects are then all V_d, so (5)--(20) apply at arbitrary plat width. A main-edge pair does not have this automatic all-physical port type. The exceptional scalar is positive, tail-free, and polynomially stable at all fixed generic jet orders. The original row measure and physical bend introduce no exponential loss. The remaining local cost J_g consists exactly of the target normalization h_g and the regularized target tensor, through order two. The complement cost J_C consists of its actual contraction and derivatives, also through order two. No theorem here controls those costs sharply by the geometric action. In particular the remaining vertices are not automatically in the central selected-kernel domain merely because their weaker support defects have been localized elsewhere. A full-source volume argument still requires such a coherent bound and a nonzero selected contribution with its physical cycle. The explicit row cancellation and finite Laurent budget remove two particular normalization obstacles; they do not supply that cycle. Audit: [actual typed bend, original measure, and full recoupling](../experiments/audit_actual_matching_edge_marked_four_port_block.py). The focused audit passed 30 generic physical matrix families and all 154 target coefficients, comparing 32,114 original operator entries; 19 actual root bend first-jet families, comparing 64,882 jet entries; 239 canceled row germs with 956 retained coefficients; and 54 target normalizers against their original boundary products. Odd pivotal-sign regressions and paired-nilpotent sectors are included. These finite checks supplement the generic tensor and harmonic-product proofs. Two independent analytical reviews passed the typed bend, original cup signs and gamma, both product normalizers, exact circle-measure cancellation, whole-network normal extraction and Taylor-two budget, and the norm factors in (19),(20). One reviewer also independently replayed the full focused audit and reproduced all reported counts. The reviews retain the stated complete-circle scope and the explicit, uncontrolled native target and complement costs. No positive completed Hermite metric or full-source asymptotic is inferred.

text: # Native magnetic energy controls every completed projector jet Follow-up: the [Plancherel and full folded profile](actual_matching_edge_magnetic_energy_profile.md) computes the full folded norm rate at both parities, and the [real shrinking-fold theorem](actual_matching_edge_shrinking_fold_native_energy.md) extends it to every j/N tending to 1/2. These are native real norm results; shared source contraction and global geometric selection remain open. 30 October 2026. The completed target operators in the [matching-edge block](actual_matching_edge_completed_projector_block.md) have no additional exponential cost in any fixed generic-q derivative. Their cost is the explicit, original-basis magnetic energy below. That energy itself can be exponentially large, already for an odd simple channel. Consequently this is a quantitative source interface, not a polynomial operator bound or a whole-network estimate. ## 1. The source and its exact generic high-degree adapter Put N>=3, d=N-1, q0=exp(pi i/N), q=q0 exp(epsilon), Q=q^2. The balanced ordinary highest-weight-d representation has the ACTUAL generators F|u>=(1-Q^(u+1))|u+1>, Ecal|u>=q^-N(1-Q^(N-u))|u-1>, K|u>=q^(d-2u)|u>. Use Omega=F_tot Ecal_tot+q K_tot+q^-1 K_tot^-1, with the original coproducts. Its degree-t matrix for 0<=t<=d is J_t(q) in the [physical generic-jet theorem](actual_q_hahn_physical_generic_jet_bound.md). Write its upper and lower entries a_r^+,a_r^- and its normalized column C_m(q;t,0)=1, with eigenvalue lambda_m(q)=q^(2N-2m-1)+q^(-2N+2m+1), 0<=m<=t. The high-degree adapter is exact BEFORE root specialization. Define W(q)|u>=q^(-Nu)|d-u>. Direct substitution gives WF=Ecal W, WEcal=FW and WK=K^-1W. The commutator Ecal F-F Ecal=(q-q^-1)(K-K^-1) then proves that P(W tensor W) commutes with Omega. On degree t its coefficient is the constant q^(-Nt). Hence, for 0<=k<=d, J_(2d-k)[d-k+r,d-k+s]=J_k[r,s] (1) as GENERIC matrices. The constant cancels in conjugation. The same identity follows by substituting u=d-k+r into the three explicit diagonals of the actual matrix. Thus every generic jet, including large-partner jets, obeys the translated low-degree identity. This statement strengthens the earlier root-only high-degree comparison; it does not differentiate that root-only formula. ## 2. The magnetic energy and the operator theorem Choose a completed pair 0<=j<l=d-j. This is the target pair g=j, g'=l, but the compiler's channel indices are reversed. Let Pi_m be the generic projector with eigenvalue lambda_m above, and define Q_j=Pi_j+Pi_l, M_j=(Omega-lambda_j I)Q_j. (2) Thus M_j is EXACTLY the target nilpotent operator in the preceding block theorem, with its target-index convention. It is not a spectral derivative substituted for a generic-q derivative. For each j<=t<=d put f=C_j(q0;t,.). If t<l, let sigma_(t,j)=f^T f. If t>=l, let sigma_(t,j)=f^T w, where w is the original divided pair, equivalently the spectral derivative of the root forward recurrence. Define E_(t,j)=||f||_2^2/|sigma_(t,j)|, E_j^full=[E_(d,j)^2+2 sum_(t=j)^(d-1) E_(t,j)^2]^(1/2). (3) These are explicit nonzero bilinear measures, not a chosen positive metric on the channels. With s_r=product_(k=1)^r 2sin(pi k/N) and a_j=|1-Q0^(2j+1)|, their magnitudes are |sigma_(t,j)|=s_(t-j)s_(t+j+1)/(s_t^2 a_j), t<l, |sigma_(t,j)|=N s_(t-j)s_(t+j-d)/(s_t^2 a_j^2), t>=l. (4) The root columns are the original finite q-Hahn sums. Thus (3),(4) contain no undetermined projector or inverse-frame norm. If their normalized logarithms have a uniform limiting profile, the square sum in (3) takes a maximum over the ONE physical degree of this operator. It is not a product of maxima over independent local degrees. In a network the magnetic indices and degrees remain shared along the actual wires; applying separate local maxima can lose precisely that incidence. The energy may have an explicit variational rate without being polynomial or subexponential. For every fixed r>=0 there is a constant C_r, uniform over N and all pairs, such that in the ORIGINAL physical Hilbert--Schmidt norm ||[epsilon^r]Q_j||_HS <= C_r N^(8(r+1)) E_j^full, ||[epsilon^r]M_j||_HS <= C_r N^(8r) E_j^full. (5) For the operator norm the same bounds hold with E_j^full replaced by max_(j<=t<=d) E_(t,j), since the physical degree blocks are an orthogonal direct sum. They retain all physical total degrees and both members of every pair. On a complete degree t>=l one has the stronger exact root identity M_j(q0)|_t=f f^T/sigma_(t,j), ||M_j(q0)|_t||_HS=||M_j(q0)|_t||op=E_(t,j). (6) On j<=t<l, Q_j is the ordinary simple projector, its two displayed norms equal E_(t,j), and M_j vanishes identically even generically. Below degree j both operators vanish. In particular E_j^full is bounded by C||Q_j(q0)||_HS: on complete blocks use M_j=(J_t-c_j)Q_j and the uniform bound for the entries and bandwidth of J_t(q0); on the other blocks use the exact rank-one norm. Thus (5) also bounds every generic jet by a polynomial times the actual root cluster norm. It does not bound that root norm itself by a polynomial. For odd N and the simple midpoint m=d/2, replace (3) by the same sum over t>=m, with |sigma_(t,m)|=N s_(t-m)^2/s_t^2. Then its isolated projector obeys ||[epsilon^r]Pi_m||_HS <= C_r N^(8r) E_m^full, ||Pi_m(q0)||_HS=E_m^full. (7) ## 3. Generic dual measures and the proof The actual generic matrix is not symmetric. Retain its symmetrizer G_0=1, G_u=product_(r=0)^(u-1) a_r^+/a_r^-, G=diag(G_u), GJ_t=J_t^T G. (8) At the root G=I. For a generic simple node its left row is C_m^T G. The continuant Christoffel--Darboux identity gives exactly C_m^T G C_m =C_m(q;t,t) product_(h!=m)(lambda_m-lambda_h) /product_(r=0)^(t-1) a_r^-. (9) One can derive (9) directly by subtracting the two tridiagonal recurrences, multiplying by the weights (8), and telescoping. In monic continuants it is P_t'(lambda_m)p_t(lambda_m)/product a_r^+a_r^-; since p_t=C_m(t) product a_r^+, this is (9). The endpoint is the original generic monomial C_m(q;t,t)=(-1)^m q^[dt-2Nm+m^2+m]. Suppose t>=l, and put delta=lambda_j-lambda_l. Define the units b_m=C_m(q;t,t) product_(h!=j,l)(lambda_m-lambda_h) /product a_r^-, m=j,l, R_m=C_m C_m^T G/b_m. (10) Equations (9),(10) yield the exact generic identities Pi_j=R_j/delta, Pi_l=-R_l/delta, Q_j=(R_j-R_l)/delta, M_j=R_l. (11) At the root both b_m equal sigma_(t,j). This follows either by the double-node specialization of (9), or from sigma=f^T w=C_j(t) product_(h!=j,l)(c_j-c_h)/product a_r^-. It proves (6), including its sign. The identities are consistent with the actual target gap being -delta. Here are uniform bounds on a genuine generic disk. Choose the constant c in rho=cN^-8 sufficiently small. The physical-jet theorem gives, for BOTH m=j,l, |C_m(q;t,u)| <= C |f_u|, |epsilon|<=rho. (12) The same theorem bounds every original offdiagonal ratio, while the endpoint monomial has exponent O(N^2). All other root node differences in (10) have magnitude at least 16/N^2 and generic derivative O(N). Their relative change is O(N^3 rho), and there are at most N factors. Therefore ||G||<=C, |b_m/sigma|+|sigma/b_m|<=C, ||R_m||_HS<=C E_(t,j) (13) throughout the disk. No separate exponential estimate of a factorial product has entered (13); it is a RELATIVE unit bound. The actual collision gap is delta=(q^s-q^-s)(q^N-q^-N), s=l-j. On |epsilon|=rho its magnitude is at least c rho: its linear coefficient has magnitude 4N sin(pi s/N)>=8, and the two explicit factors have uniformly controlled relative variation. The analytic completed projector therefore has norm at most C rho^-1 E_(t,j) on that circle by (11). Its holomorphy also follows directly from the coprime quadratic cluster factor of the full characteristic polynomial. Cauchy's formula proves its bound in (5). The regular identity M_j=R_l gives the better M exponent in (5). For t<l use (9) without deleting a partner: its norm is a unit relative to the nonzero simple sigma, so (12),(13) give the simple projector bound directly. The odd midpoint is identical. Finally (1) duplicates each low block except t=d. Orthogonality of the physical degree spaces in the original Euclidean basis gives exactly the square sum (3), proving (5),(7) for the whole pair. ## 4. The energy is genuinely exponential The distinction in (5) is necessary. Take odd N=2m+1 and the simple midpoint channel in degree t=m. Its normalized original highest column has |f_u|=s_m/(s_u s_(m-u)), 0<=u<=m, |sigma|=N/s_m^2=1. Consequently its projector norm is EXACTLY E_(m,m)=sum_(u=0)^m [s_m/(s_u s_(m-u))]^2. (14) This is a native physical operator norm, not a bound obtained by discarding phases in a contraction. Let J(x)=integral_0^x log(2sin(pi y))dy. Elementary endpoint-controlled Riemann sums give log s_floor(Nx)=N J(x)+O(log N), uniformly on [0,1/2]. Since J(1/2)=0, the largest summand in (14) occurs asymptotically at u/N=1/4: the derivative of -J(x)-J(1/2-x) is log cot(pi x). Bounding the sum between its largest term and (m+1) times that term proves lim_(odd N) N^-1 log E_(m,m) =-4 J(1/4)=2 Catalan/pi=v8/(2pi)>0. (15) The integral identity follows directly by integrating the Fourier series for log(2sin), or may be taken as the defining integral for the constant. Thus no uniform polynomial bound for the native projector norms in the preceding block theorem is possible. The scalar target normalization has been removed exactly, and generic derivatives now add only polynomial cost. The remaining magnetic energy must still be handled by coherent sewing, a sharp variational estimate, or a different justified inner product. Independent actual highest columns also check the native energy normalization in (14). The finite energy sequence through N=513 illustrates the proved limit (15); it is not the proof of that limit or of the uniform estimates.
