Reduce q to 375 in the prime field of order 1009; this has exact order six and every denominator is a unit. The actual physical contraction with bare m on the exposed white block (0,10,11) is 155. Putting the same bare m on the NESTED block (1,8,9), leaving all other coupons unchanged, gives 620. The ordinary trace and its first normal are unchanged, so these two bare insertions cannot both be its normalized pivotal cut. Their difference is an exact cyclotomic counterexample, not a floating-point discrepancy. The original proof's phrase allowing an arbitrary white vertex was therefore too broad. It has been corrected to the exposed hypothesis in section1, and the audit retains this negative test. Moving a genuine cut through an enclosing cap requires its actual pivotal transport. It cannot justify deleting the marked-white current in (15) while leaving that enclosing ordinary cap row unchanged. ## 5. Exact source support and the marked-white boundary term The following alternatives are valid for every graph above. * A nontriangle triple at ANY vertex makes Z_Gamma=0. If black, its generic invariant column is zero. If white, genuine ordered duality makes its generic ordinary row zero. In either case F_Gamma is identically zero. By generic scalarity and D_N(t)!=0 off its isolated root, the physical open scalar is identically zero and its marked specialization is zero as well. This includes a nontriangle MARKED white vertex; no local invariance of m is presumed. * A triangle with J<d at a black or an UNMARKED white vertex makes Z_Gamma=0 directly at the root: respectively the actual black column or the ordinary cap row is zero before estimating or summing. The marked white row is not included in this local deletion rule. * If every vertex has J>=d, all s_v(0) are nonzero, and (11),(12) force Xi_Gamma(0)=0. The complete formula is then Z_Gamma=C_Gamma [product_v s_v(0)] Xi_Gamma'(0)/nu_N. (14) * Suppose every black and unmarked white vertex has J>=d but the marked white triangle has J<d. There is exactly one zero source factor, s_v*(0)=0. Its full contribution is Z_Gamma=C_Gamma [product_(v!=v*) s_v(0)] s_v*'(0) Xi_Gamma(0)/nu_N. (15) Its ordinary root coefficient alone does not justify deleting this term. The derivative can be nonzero. A subsequent WHOLE-source result now proves its value zero for the closed complete-circle diagrams here: omit all three caps of the exposed marked vertex, obtain a regular six-head invariant, and apply its three complete circles last. Their unsupported product annihilates the saturated source before the mark acts. The full typed proof is in [the exposed six-port pruning theorem](actual_exposed_six_port_complete_circle_pruning.md). This does not set s_v*' to zero or delete an arbitrary open current. If at least two s_v(0) vanish, holomorphy of every factor in(11) gives a double zero and hence Z_Gamma=0. If there is a sole black or unmarked-white zero, (13) and the direct deletion above give the exact compatibility identity s_v'(0)Xi_Gamma(0)=0. This is a consequence of the whole original source, not a license to discard an arbitrary normal. ## 6. The retained normal is explicitly local and finite These formulas can be evaluated using first jets only. For example, put L_u=-sum_(k=1)^u 2k Q^k/(1-Q^k), L_0=0. The logarithmic derivative of the nonzero highest coefficient in(3) is h_u'/h_u=u(2l-d-u-1)+L_(j+u)-L_j+L_(d-u)-L_d. (16) All terms are physical units. With f_r=1-Q^r, its actual descendants and derivatives satisfy W_(r+1)=F_pair W_r/f_(r+1), W_(r+1)'=(F_pair' W_r+F_pair W_r')/f_(r+1) +2(r+1)Q^(r+1)W_(r+1)/f_(r+1). (17) For a canonical cup of highest weight L and scale p0(t), p_(u,L-u)'/p_(u,L-u) =p0'/p0+u(L-u-1)+L_u+L_(L-u)-L_L, ell'=-ell p' ell. (18) Here p0'/p0=-d^2 on V_N and zero on Q_j. Differentiating (4) gives pi_j'; differentiating the four factors in(8) gives s_abc' by a finite sum with one differentiated factor. Equations(6),(7),(18) similarly give Xi_Gamma' by a sum of ordinary magnetic contractions with ONE first-jet tensor or cup. This construction retains the full original source normal at any fixed width, without inverses of paired frames. The [exact first-jet audit](../experiments/audit_actual_nc_morse_graph_first_normal_source_reduction.py) checks these local jet identities and original marked graph contractions. Its sole-unsaturated-marked cube fixture has a nonzero LOCAL source normal but zero exterior spin value; it therefore asserts no nonzero boundary contribution merely from that local current. Both factors in(15) are retained. General norm/nonzero/volume control for the ordinary network normal in(14) remains open. Equation(15)'s local current is retained, while its closed complete-circle source value is now annihilated by the separate physical support theorem. No off-complete auxiliary-color or arbitrary open-current cancellation is inferred. Internal review history: the initial review and positive tests missed the exposed-versus-nested bare-mark distinction. The additional test in section4a found it. The pointing hypothesis and the dipole fixture have been corrected explicitly; all local source/jet formulas remain unchanged. The corrected audit passes five local jet families, sixteen exposed original source cases and the inner-mark rejection. These are internal checks, not an external peer review or a geometric identification of the network. The corrected exposed statements and the additional whole-source six-port pruning were subsequently checked independently by root and the global audit agent. The latter also freshly replayed the typed sewing/pruning regressions, including its negative nested-cut case. The original mark-scope correction is retained above rather than being hidden by that later review.

title: A graphic vanishing-order certificate for the actual spin-one packet
text: # A graphic vanishing-order certificate for the actual spin-one packet 29 October 2026. There is an exact generic algebraic model for the ordinary network in the [original first-normal graph reduction](actual_nc_morse_graph_first_normal_source_reduction.md). When EVERY ordinary edge is Q_1, the full network is an explicit flow polynomial, including its scalar normalization. This proves a simple root for every connected original NC cubic graph at N=3. It also gives an exact graph criterion at N=4 and a genuine unbounded class with arbitrary branching and no two-edge neck, where that root is simple as well. No first-nonzero-coefficient convention replaces the original FIXED first normal. Every original marked value below uses an EXPOSED top cap, as required by the corrected first-normal theorem. A bare mark at a nested cap needs additional pivotal transport and is not covered. The generic unmarked network identity(2) itself is independent of this pointing. These are fixed-level source/order theorems. They are not an all-N asymptotic, a volume estimate, or a graph extension of a knot-volume limit. At N>4 the all-j=1 source is unsaturated, so that same label choice does not supply an asymptotic family of surviving sources. ## 1. The exact generic packet is a flow polynomial Let Gamma be a connected graph in the literal NC/Morse class, with b black and b white vertices, E=3b ordered edges, and the original opposite ribbon orientations at black and white vertices. Put the canonical ordinary Q_1 tensor Theta_111 at every black vertex and its genuine pivotal dual at every white vertex. Their ordered contraction is Xi_Gamma(zeta), as defined in the first-normal theorem. Use a generic zeta near either exp(pi i/3) or exp(pi i/4), and put d0=zeta+zeta^(-1), delta=-d0, D=d0^2, g(zeta)=-zeta^7 d0. For a subset A of graph edges, let k(A) be the number of connected components of the spanning subgraph, including isolated vertices. Define the FINITE polynomial F_Gamma(D)=sum_(A subset edges) (-1)^(E-|A|) D^[|A|-2b+k(A)]. (1) Then the actual complete magnetic network obeys the generic identity Xi_Gamma(zeta)=g(zeta)^b F_Gamma(D). (2) All fields and normal derivatives are retained in (2). In particular its vanishing order is the order of the displayed polynomial at the appropriate D, since g and D' are nonzero at these two roots. ## 2. Own two-head cabling proof, with the actual pivotal tensors Use an AUXILIARY ordinary highest-weight-one object W of dimension two; this is a finite algebraic factorization of Q_1, not a replacement of the original physical V_N source. Its canonical cup and cap are p=[[0,1],[-zeta^(-1),0]], ell=p^(-1)=[[0,-zeta],[1,0]], sum_(a,b) ell_ab p_ab=delta. On W tensor W put e=|p><ell| and Pi=I-e/delta. The following literal matrices give Pi=i pi and pi i=I: i=(|00>, |10>+zeta^(-1)|01>, zeta^(-1)|11>), pi=[[1,0,0,0], [0,1/d0,zeta/d0,0], [0,0,0,zeta]]. (3) Direct substitution in the original balanced E,F,K matrices verifies that these are ordinary Q_1 intertwiners. The genuine Q_1 cup has highest coefficient one, as in the general source theorem. Its right dual gives the ALL-INPUT identity D(i)=zeta^(-1) pi. (4) The actual nested six-leg fundamental cup source, followed by pi on its three consecutive pairs, is u Theta_111, where u=-zeta^(-2)/d0. (5) Both sides are invariant in the same one-dimensional homogeneous space. To fix (5), take the canonical corner (2,1,0): its only physical contribution has three cup coefficients -zeta^(-1), one pi coefficient zeta, one 1/d0, and one 1. This gives (5). Equation (4) similarly follows from its four-by-three matrices, or from the row0/column00 coefficient and covariance. Let T_Gamma be the literal fundamental Morse contraction with Pi on each edge and the SAME nested vertex cups/caps. White duality, without a Hermitian conjugate, gives T_Gamma=(zeta^(-3)u^2)^b Xi_Gamma =(zeta^(-7)/d0^2)^b Xi_Gamma. (6) Now expand every Pi as I-e/delta. Let A be the edges on which I is chosen. The surviving curves are exactly the boundary components of the plane ribbon neighborhood of (vertices,A): the I edge joins its two vertex disks and the e term closes the two deleted ends. The literal NC vertex order, including the reversed white ribbon order, is essential here. Their number is boundary(A)=2k(A)-2b+|A|. Every resulting fundamental circle evaluates to delta, by the exact cup/cap above. The coefficient for the deleted edges is (-1/delta)^(E-|A|). Hence T_Gamma=delta^(2b-E) F_Gamma(delta^2) =delta^(-b)F_Gamma(D). Together with (6) this proves (2). The proof retains each state with its sign; no absolute-state estimate or graph projector has been used. ## 3. Exact simple zero for every connected NC graph at N=3 The plane dual H of Gamma has b+2 vertices. Its chromatic polynomial has the elementary subset expansion P_H(D)=sum_(B subset edges(H))(-1)^|B| D^k_H(B). For complementary primal and dual edge sets, the plane Euler formula gives k_H(B)=|A|-2b+k_Gamma(A)+1. Thus directly P_H(D)=D F_Gamma(D). (7) Every connected cubic BIPARTITE graph is bridgeless. A bridge cut would give 3(n_black-n_white)=+1 or -1 on one side, an impossibility. It also has no cut vertex: among three incident edges separated into at least two groups, some group has one edge, making a bridge. Thus every facial boundary is a simple cycle. A repeated vertex would, by a small arc in that face and the Jordan separation, be a cut vertex. The dual H is loopless and has no cut vertex. For the latter claim, remove one dual vertex f. Every remaining dual component meets f. Walk around its simple primal facial cycle. At a cubic boundary vertex the two other incident faces share the third edge. Thus two successive neighboring faces of f lie in the same component of H-f. All neighbors, hence all of H-f, are connected. Parallel dual edges can be discarded without changing P_H or this conclusion. Here is an elementary nonzero-derivative proof, not an appeal to a graph-polynomial name. For a connected loopless graph H with at least one edge put beta(H)=(-1)^|vertices(H)| P_H'(1). A cut-vertex factorization P_H=D^(1-r) product_(blocks)P_block makes beta zero if there are at least two nontrivial blocks. For K_2 it is one. If H is simple and 2-connected with at least three vertices, choose an edge e=uv. Both H-e and H/e are connected, and at least one is 2-connected after parallel edges are suppressed. Indeed only the contracted vertex can cut H/e. If it does, H-{u,v} has at least two components, each meeting both u and v by 2-connectivity. After any one other vertex is removed, another such component still joins u to v without e; this proves H-e remains 2-connected. Deletion/contraction P_H=P_(H-e)-P_(H/e) consequently gives beta(H)=beta(H-e)+beta(H/e)>0 by induction on edges/vertices, using the block factorization for non-2-connected children. This proves an INTEGER positive beta for our dual H. In particular F_Gamma(1)=0, F_Gamma'(1)=(-1)^b beta(H)!=0. (8) At q=exp(pi i/3), D=1 and D'=2(q-q^(-1))!=0, so Xi_Gamma has EXACT order one for every connected NC graph, including graphs with two-edge necks. This is an unbounded genuinely branched source result at this fixed level, not only a cube check. All j=1 triples are supported at N=3. Substituting the actual local constants h0=3, gamma=q/9, s=54q and the original trace derivative into the general source formula gives the particularly simple answer Z_(Gamma,N=3)=108^b beta(H)>0 (9) for untwisted edges. Arbitrary signed edge twists multiply this by the literal omega_1^(sum e), and cannot change its nonzero magnitude. ## 4. At N=4 the criterion is different and retains higher zeros Now q=exp(pi i/4), D=2, and D'!=0. A cubic graph admits no nowhere-zero 2-flow: the unique nonzero mod2 current cannot have zero boundary at a vertex of odd degree. This fact also follows from (1) by counting solutions of the incidence equations over F_2 with inclusion/exclusion. Hence F_Gamma(2)=0. Formula (2) gives the EXACT criterion ord_q Xi_Gamma=1 if and only if F_Gamma'(2)!=0. (10) The original all-j=1 sector is supported at N=4 as well. Its physical constants are h0=8sqrt(2), gamma=q/16 and s=64sqrt(2)q^(-1). Since D'/nu_4=-1/sqrt(2), its entire original magnetic contraction is Z_(Gamma,N=4)=(-1)^(b+1) 2^(12b-1/2) F_Gamma'(2). (11) At N=4 this is in fact the WHOLE full-circle marked source at that level. Here M=1. Any edge labeled zero belongs to a black vertex with sum of labels at most two, below d=3, so its actual black source is zero. Thus only the all-j=1 labeling survives. At N=3 there are also supported (0,1,1) vertices; equation(9) remains the specified all-j=1 sector there, without a claim about their additional sum. Connectivity alone does NOT prove a simple zero here. The literal four-vertex NC dipole has F_dipole(D)=(D-1)(D-2)^2, so Xi has exact order TWO and its original fixed first-normal source is zero. Selecting its next nonzero coefficient would compute a different invariant. This agrees with the full paired L_N^2 source obstruction, while (2) determines the whole order explicitly. ## 5. A literal branching insertion that preserves a simple zero Use the actual ordered cube from the vertex theorem: black: (0,1,2),(3,4,11),(5,9,10),(6,7,8), white: (0,10,11),(1,8,9),(2,3,7),(4,5,6). Let an existing black vertex occupy an interval (a,a+1,a+2). Remove it and insert the cube edge row at that interval. The cube's outer white vertex (0,10,11) is removed; its three ports are glued IN ORDER to the original three external edges. Map those original edge slots to a+(0,10,11), all later original edges by +9, and every cube edge k to a+k. Keep every other vertex and the original marked white arc. This is a literal NC/Morse operation. Existing white partitions are mapped monotonically. The new internal white triples are nested in the previously empty gap between the first two distinguished ports. New black triples occupy the interval replacing the removed black triple; all other black triples lie outside or surround it. Thus both partitions remain noncrossing, and their original cup/cap matchings give the required physical ribbon diagram without a bare permutation. It is a genuine planar vertex three-sum. It preserves three-edge connectivity: if a putative cut has at most two edges, restore each deleted degree-three vertex on the majority side of its three ports. In an internally split piece with internal cut count t and p of its three ports on one side, three-edge connectivity of the restored piece gives t+min(p,3-p)>=3, hence t>=2. Two split pieces force at least four cut edges. If only one splits and t=2, its port minority supplies at least one seam edge; if t>=3 the contradiction is already internal. If neither piece splits, their three seam edges are the cut. Each case contradicts the proposed two-edge bound. The dual operation is a clique sum along its common triangle. Colorings on that triangle are three distinct colors. Their number is D(D-1)(D-2), and all choices have the same extension count. Counting for all integer D>=3, then using polynomial identity, gives F_new=F_old F_cube/[(D-1)(D-2)], F_cube=(D-1)(D-2)(D^3-9D^2+29D-32). (12) The cube polynomial follows independently by inclusion/exclusion (1), or coloring its dual three-part complete graph with two vertices per part. Equation(12) is a GENERIC identity before root specialization; its vanishing denominator is canceled with the numerator zeros. It is not root multiplication of L_N coupons or a Frobenius vertex. Starting at the theta graph, k insertions therefore give b=1+3k and F_Gamma=(D-1)(D-2)(D^3-9D^2+29D-32)^k. (13) Every inserted cube creates two interval black vertices where a new copy can be inserted. Independent choices generate arbitrary finite ordered binary branching trees, not merely one cyclic chain. They all have a simple root at both D=1 and D=2, since the cubic factor is -11 and -2 there. The ORIGINAL fixed-channel marked values are Z_(N=3)=108^(1+3k) 11^k, Z_(N=4)=2^[12(1+3k)+k-1/2], (14) up to the retained signed edge-twist unit. These formulas determine their complete first-normal contractions at the indicated levels. ## 6. Scope of the order certificate The generic cabling, signed state expansion and graph insertion are source-exact; the [focused audit](../experiments/audit_actual_nc_spin_one_flow_order_certificate.py) checks literal fundamental Morse contractions as well as ordinary spin and original physical marked source contractions. The proof above is not inferred from isolated numerical graph values. What remains is an order/noncancellation estimate for actual supported labels growing with N. The Q_1 flow model does not provide it. A generic geometric principal symbol or an arbitrary first-nonzero Laurent convention cannot supply the missing fixed-normal theorem. Unsaturated marked-white terms in the general graph reduction remain retained; every vertex in the two fixed-level sectors above is supported. Independent internal review: root read the full graph proof and its fixed-level scope. The global audit agent independently checked the literal cabling constants, signed state expansion, beta positivity, both physical marked prefactors, NC cube insertion and canceled three-sum denominator, then freshly replayed the audit: PASS nine generic Morse/cabling graphs, six branching constructions and eleven original fixed-level source cases. No correction was required. These are internal checks, not external peer review or an all-N volume claim.

title: Exact three-port source sewing before and after the root normal
text: # Exact three-port source sewing before and after the root normal 29 October 2026. An actual NC/Morse vertex substitution has a generic three-port elimination, with an explicitly normalized theta denominator. At a supported boundary it preserves the original FIXED first normal: the new raw marked scalar is the product of the two old raw scalars divided by the positive actual marked theta scalar. This is not root multiplication of circle coupons. Unsupported boundaries retain their explicit open-column/source jets before an actual six-head support identity proves their complete-circle contribution zero. The theorem is channelwise at arbitrary N, with all three correlated boundary labels and original normal factors retained. It supplies a survival transfer when the two actual input sources are known. It does not prove a new all-N asymptotic for an unsolved primitive cube block, identify arbitrary six-pants boundary maps, or complete the graph-volume problem. ## 1. A literal NC vertex substitution, including the pointing Let A,B be ordered NC/Morse graphs of the [corrected exposed-source theorem](actual_nc_morse_graph_first_normal_source_reduction.md). A has an interval black vertex u on edge slots (a,a+1,a+2), and an EXPOSED white marked cap elsewhere. B has an outer white vertex w on edge slots (0,k,E_B-1), so every other white block is in one of its two gaps. Give B the exposed mark at w. Match the three boundary labels in their displayed order; call them (a0,b0,c0). Remove u and w and glue their three edge ends IN ORDER. Concretely replace A's three-slot interval by B's whole edge row, map the three old A contacts to a+(0,k,E_B-1), move subsequent A slots by E_B-3, and map every B slot e to a+e. Keep the other vertices. Black A blocks surround or avoid the replacement interval; the inserted black blocks are noncrossing within it. The old white blocks are mapped monotonically, and new white blocks lie strictly in the two previously empty contact gaps. Thus both new partitions remain noncrossing. The original p/ell matchings give a literal new Morse word. A's exposed marked cap remains exposed; no inserted white block can surround its contacts. All statements below use that point, not a bare mark moved to a nested cap. The two merged edge exponents ADD. The new edge has ONE coupon R^(e_A+e_B)L_j, not the product of the two old circle coupons. No L_j^2 has been substituted or inverted at the root. ## 2. A genuine invariant output column, not a guessed scalar exterior Fix generic zeta near q=exp(pi i/N), and the canonical ordinary Q_j tensors, duals and actual edge constants of the first-normal theorem. Assume first that every local ordinary triple is triangular. Remove ONLY B's outer white row D(Theta_c0,b0,a0). Contract every other ordinary vertex in B. The resulting column is Y_B(zeta) in Q_a0 tensor Q_b0 tensor Q_c0. (1) It is a genuine homogeneous invariant. For a direct proof, the noncrossing black source is built by inserting interval invariant triples, hence is globally invariant. Every white block other than w can then be removed in its innermost interval order, by a genuine ordinary invariant covector. All blocks are in w's two gaps. What remains are its three ordered output ports, with no intervening cap, braid, or free tensor permutation. The ordinary invariant space has dimension ONE at generic zeta, and its normalized Theta_a0,b0,c0 has corner (2a0,b0+c0-a0,0) equal to one. Every local coefficient is regular at the root. Consequently Y_B=alpha_B Theta_a0,b0,c0, alpha_B=(Y_B)_(2a0,b0+c0-a0,0), (2) with alpha_B a HOLomorphic finite function, computed by the open magnetic contraction. This is an all-entry identity of that source column and can be paired with an arbitrary exterior row. No invariant or regularity assumption about A's exterior row is needed. Let Xi_A,Xi_B,Xi_new be the complete ordinary networks. The fully normalized ordinary theta is Xi_theta=D(Theta_c0,b0,a0)Theta_a0,b0,c0. Then (2) gives exact generic identities Xi_B=alpha_B Xi_theta, Xi_new=alpha_B Xi_A, Xi_theta Xi_new=Xi_A Xi_B. (3) The scalar alpha_B is not defined by contracting the unknown final invariant: it is the explicit open corner in (2). In particular its regularity is proved BEFORE division by Xi_theta. If the boundary triple is nontriangular, the actual invariant column (1) is zero and the new source is identically zero. Nontriangular interior vertices are likewise zero; they are not omitted as a semisimple convention. ## 3. The denominator has an exact root order and source normalization Write a,b,c for the boundary labels in this section and set J=a+b+c, r=b+c-a, r1=a+b-c, r2=a+c-b, F_l=(zeta^2;zeta^2)_l. The independently proved finite Vandermonde evaluation is Xi_theta=(-1)^r1 zeta^[2c-r1(r-1)] F_(2b)F_r2 F_(J+1) /[(1-zeta^2)F_r F_(2a)F_r1 F_(2c)]. (4) All denominator factorials have index <N. Thus ord_q Xi_theta=1 if J>=d, and 0 if J<d, d=N-1. (5) The numerator contains at most one factor 1-zeta^(2N), since J+1<2N. Formula (4) applies to odd simple and even/odd paired axes without separating away their original source factors. Let F_A,F_B,F_new be the ordinary GENERIC physical closures in the chosen regular Hopf lift, and use C,S as in the first-normal theorem. The new constants are exactly C_new=C_A C_B/C_theta, C_theta=product_(boundary j)h0_j gamma_j, S_new=product_(vertices of A except u)s_v *product_(vertices of B except w)s_v. (6) Boundary edge twists are added, so their omega factors occur in C_new with the correct sum. Both removed source factors are the actual s_abc and s_cba. In particular the cross-multiplied identity is F_theta F_new=F_A F_B, F_theta=C_theta s_abc s_cba Xi_theta. (7) This keeps ALL phases, G factors, h0 first normals and fixed gamma units. Each remains present exactly once on a new edge. The source identity is generic and does not divide by nilpotent root operators. For J>=d the actual s_abc(0),s_cba(0) are nonzero, Xi_theta has a simple zero, and F_theta'(0)=nu_N Z_theta!=0, nu_N=2N(-1)^N/(q-q^(-1)), Z_theta=N^2 k_a k_b k_c s_r s_r1 s_r2/s_(J-d) *R_N(a,b,c)^2>0. (8) Here R_N is the already proved positive finite source partition, not an assumed quantum 6j. Equation (8) is a fully explicit boundary weight. It may be exponential and must not be called a polynomial normalization cost. ## 4. Exact fixed-normal gluing and order addition Each exposed physical closure is F_G=D_N z_G, where D_N=(-1)^d[N]_zeta has its simple zero at q and z_G is the actual regular open scalar. For a SUPPORTED boundary (J>=d), equation(7) therefore gives a holomorphic identity z_new=z_A z_B/z_theta, because z_theta(q)=Z_theta>0. In particular the original raw marked scalars, with no transported or repeated mark, obey Z_new=Z_A Z_B/Z_theta. (9) This formula holds even if one of the pieces has a zero raw scalar or a retained unsaturated marked-white current. Those pieces are the complete exposed original sources, not just a selected leading saddle. All such terms are included in their z_G. For nonzero generic ordinary spin networks, (3) gives v(Xi_new)=v(Xi_A)+v(Xi_B)-v(Xi_theta), (10) where v is the exact order at q. The regular alpha_B proves this without assigning a first-nonzero convention to the original source. For supported seams and nonzero physical closure germs one similarly has v(F_new)=v(F_A)+v(F_B)-1. Thus two genuine simple physical zeros give a simple zero after sewing. If a piece has higher order, its fixed first-normal value vanishes and (9) retains that zero. Any original external lines remain explicit. If K_G=chi_G Z_G, then the corresponding relation has the extra factor chi_new chi_theta/(chi_A chi_B); it cannot be suppressed without the actual framing/normalization certificate. ## 5. All boundary channels, including the unsaturated current The ordinary column (2) and identity (3) hold at EVERY triangular folded boundary label. For J<d, Xi_theta(q) is a unit. The two removed source factors s_abc(q),s_cba(q) are zero; it is not valid to divide root marked scalars by Z_theta=0. Instead the exact formula is Z_new=C_new/nu_N *d/dt|0 {S_new(t) Xi_A(t) alpha_B(t)}. (11) All local source factors in S_new are defined by actual finite Clebsch/cup contractions and their explicit first jets. Thus (11) retains the local unsaturated source normals, including a local marked-white current inherited from A. It does not infer them from the zero closed values of the removed boundary vertices. Using alpha_B=Xi_B/Xi_theta here is harmless because this particular ordinary denominator is a root unit. For full circles, the shared boundary triple must be summed ONCE, and its three labels remain correlated. If Z_A(a,b,c),Z_B(a,b,c) denote the complete coherent interior sums with those labels fixed, the whole new scalar is exactly sum_(a+b+c>=d) Z_A(a,b,c) Z_B(a,b,c)/Z_theta(a,b,c). (12) There is no omitted unsaturated correction in this COMPLETE-circle operation. The [exposed six-port pruning theorem](actual_exposed_six_port_complete_circle_pruning.md) proves it before the exterior or mark acts: remove B's three boundary coupons and every ordinary cap other than its omitted outer vertex. The remaining physical six-head column is a regular generic invariant, so its root lies in the actual saturated S_N. The three boundary coupons commute with those disjoint cap removals and can be applied last. Their full complete-circle product annihilates S_N when J<d. This proves that the exact expression(11) vanishes as a WHOLE source; it does not set its local source derivatives to zero. Nontriangles are zero as well. The positive denominator in (12) does not make its numerator a square: the two actual packets need not be conjugates. A physical mirror/reflection identity would still be needed before asserting a positive graph norm. ## 6. An explicit primitive cube corner, with three finite sum variables For the genuine ordered cube use black blocks (0,1,2),(3,4,11),(5,9,10),(6,7,8) and ordinary white blocks (1,8,9),(2,3,7),(4,5,6), leaving outer white (0,10,11) OPEN. Put j_0=a,j_10=b,j_11=c, fix boundary magnetic colors r_0=2a,r_10=b+c-a,r_11=0, and write J_v for the sum of edge labels at the indicated vertex. Define B0=j_1+j_2-a, B1=j_3+j_4+c, B2=j_5+j_9+a-c. For free magnetic integers u,v,w set r_1=u, r_2=B0-u, r_3=v, r_4=B1-v, r_5=w, r_9=B2-w, r_8=J_(1,8,9)-B2-u+w, r_7=J_(2,3,7)-B0+u-v, r_6=J_(4,5,6)-B1+v-w. (13) The remaining black magnetic equation holds identically by boundary weight conservation. Therefore alpha_cube is exactly the triple sum over (13) of the FOUR canonical black Theta entries and the THREE genuine white dual Theta entries. Require 0<=r_e<=2j_e on EVERY edge; otherwise the term is zero. Each individual entry is the explicit finite ordinary coefficient(6),(7) of the first-normal theorem, including its phase. There is no extra closed physical source or unknown inverse frame in this formula. This is a usable all-N primitive open-column scalar. The full column is alpha_cube Theta_boundary by (2), so the triple sum is not just one arbitrarily chosen bad entry. At spin one its exact evaluation is g^3(D^3-9D^2+29D-32), recovering the independently proved generic flow model. A positive high-fold evaluation or a large-N nonzero estimate for the general triple sum remains open; absolute values of its summands would discard precisely the coherence to be proved. ## 7. An exact order-two counterexample to a graph-only criterion At N=5, d=4 and M=2, take two actual ordered cubes. In A give its interval black edges (0,1,2) labels (1,1,1); every other edge has label2. In B give its outer white edges (0,10,11) labels (1,1,1); every other edge has label2. Perform the typed substitution. The new graph has fourteen vertices and twenty-one edges and is three-edge-connected by the vertex-sum proof. Its marked cap remains exposed. Every remaining vertex triple has sum FIVE or SIX, hence is fully supported and has the strictly positive local source scalar. The separating three-edge triple itself has sum3<d. The new ordinary network nevertheless has order EXACTLY TWO. Here is a compact exact certificate for the only additional zero needed. Evaluate B's triple sum(13) in Q(q), with Phi_10(q)=q^4-q^3+q^2-q+1=0. There are fifty nonzero terms. Group them by u=r_1=0,1,2,3. Their reduced coefficients in the basis (1,q,q^2,q^3) are u=0: ( 58, -58, 0, -92), u=1: (-386, 236, -92, 476), u=2: ( 476,-234, 150, -528), u=3: (-148, 56, -58, 144). Each column sums to zero. This is an exact reduction of the explicit finite canonical Clebsch sum, using only polynomial arithmetic and inversion of units modulo Phi_10. It proves alpha_B(q)=0 over the complex numbers, not just in one finite field. Its first derivative is nonzero. The exact rational first-jet formulas reduce modulo the prime 1021 at q->432, a primitive tenth root, to alpha_B'(q)->909, Xi_A'(q)->775. Every denominator is a unit in this reduction. A zero algebraic derivative would reduce to zero, so these nonzero images certify nonzero derivatives. Xi_A(q)=0 independently: A's exposed outer triple is (1,2,2), whose regular outer-column factor contains the simple Xi_theta zero. Thus v(Xi_A)=1 and v(alpha_B)=1. Equation(3) gives v(Xi_new)=2; its second Taylor coefficient has nonzero image 775*909=1006 modulo1021. All NEW vertex source factors are nonzero by their supported sums. Therefore the new physical ordinary closure also has order two, and the original fixed-first-normal marked sector is ZERO. Its higher normal is nonzero. This is not a zero of the full channel sum or a counterexample to a volume statement. It proves that connectivity, absence of a two-edge neck, and positive supported VERTEX scalars do not by themselves ensure simple source order. The separating source constraint matters. It agrees with the all-N six-port pruning theorem rather than deleting its higher jet. The [focused audit](../experiments/audit_actual_nc_three_port_source_sewing.py) checks open-column invariance and all entries, exact local theta normalization, NC/pivotal pointing, ordinary and full marked sewing, the cube triple-sum corner, the physical divided-current pruning, and the exact cyclotomic certificate above. No graph-volume or unconditional all-N cube survival claim is made. Independent internal reviews: root read the source sewing, exposed pointing and pruning arguments. The global audit agent independently read sections1--7 and the separate pruning proof, checked the C/S cancellations and fixed-normal quotient, and freshly replayed the audit: PASS nineteen sewings, five physical six-head Ward/divided- current pruning families, the nested-cut countercurrent and the exact QQ(q) order-two certificate. No correction was required to these corrected exposed statements. These are internal checks, not external peer review or an all-N primitive-core estimate.

title: The actual negative-band boundary moment is a Ward current
text: # The actual negative-band boundary moment is a Ward current Research proof, 27 October 2026. The boundary moment suggested by the pure-prefix framing chart has an exact whole finite-source model. It is the original cut paired with a particular K-Ward current, rather than the original identity source. Literal signed crossing tensors disprove a universal normalization identifying the two. Separately, the original Ward factorial has an exact inverse-norm boundary atom with a nonzero simple polar coefficient. These are explicit actual operations, but their occurrence in the selected full geometric contraction is not asserted. The physical edge clock B and the Fourier output-band variable eta_F remain INDEPENDENT. The geometric parameter eta_geo=p inverse is used only in the stated principal Fourier incidence and its algebraic boundary chart, not as an automatic image of the finite cap. ## 1. An exact all-level finite boundary functional Retain the literal tensor and all original pivots of [the two-cut construction](actual_two_cut_framing_port_reconstruction.md). Let C_X=P(A X B_word) be its original one-cut endomorphism after inserting the coupon X at the second cut. Here B_word is a word prefix; it differs from the physical clock B. In the balanced frame the original source is Phi(C)=(1/N)sum_(c,a) C_ca. Put \[ F(\eta_F)=\sum_{a,b,c,d}T_{c,d;a,b}\eta_F^{d-b}. \] The identity second-cut source is Phi(C_I)=F_0/N. In the pure-prefix geometric chart one instead encounters \[ J(\eta_{geo})=\frac{\eta_{geo}}{s(1-\eta_{geo})^2},\qquad [\eta^0]J(\eta)F(\eta) =\frac1s\sum_{m=1}^{N-1}mF_{-m}. \tag{1} \] The finite sum in (1) is exact on the Fourier side too, but this does not identify its source with the geometric one. Let U be the literal raising shift, U e_j=e_(j+1), U^N=0. Define \[ X_- =\sum_{m=1}^{N-1}mU^m=U(1-U)^{-2},\qquad \mathcal M_N(T)=\frac1N\sum_{m=1}^{N-1}mF_{-m}. \] Then for EVERY four-port tensor, including its arbitrary whole crossing couplings and actual sources, \[ \mathcal M_N(T)=\Phi(C_{X_-}). \tag{2} \] Indeed the coefficient of E_bd in X_- is b-d for b>d and zero otherwise, exactly the negative output-band weight. All finite bands, and the same single factor 1/N, are retained. This is a coupon/source formula, not a replacement of the original identity coupon by an asymptotically convenient function. ## 2. The coupon is an exact true K-Ward boundary In the actual head frame K=xQ^(-J_head). For m=1,...,N-1, \[ K U^m K^{-1}=Q^{-m}U^m. \] Consequently the WHOLE rational coupon \[ H_- =\sum_{m=1}^{N-1}\frac{m}{Q^{-m}-1}U^m \] is regular at a primitive N-th root and satisfies \[ X_-=(\operatorname{Ad}K-I)H_-. \tag{3} \] Every denominator in (3) is a unit there. The meridian scalar x cancels in Ad K; its other appearances in the original tensors and source are still retained. Actual A and B_word intertwine the true total K. The diagonal pivotal trace, for both the ordinary and frozen pivotal routes, commutes with this group-like action. Thus the exact source identity is \[ \boxed{\quad \mathcal M_N(T)=\Phi\bigl((\operatorname{Ad}K_{cut}-I)C_{H_-}\bigr) =\frac1N\sum_{c,a}(Q^{a-c}-1)(C_{H_-})_{ca}.\quad} \tag{4} \] This is a genuine Hopf Ward row. The last source row is generally NONZERO: the original balanced rank-one source is not invariant on every cut matrix. Its value on the scalar C_I does not imply its invariance on the charged C_(H_-). Additional weighted crossings, prefix coupons or nonintertwining coupons retain their actual K defects in the same ordered insertion formula; they may not be commuted away. At the physical unitary root, in the old flat head metric, the shift U has norm one. Using |1-Q^m|=2 sin(pi m/N) at least 4 min(m,N-m)/N gives \[ \|X_-\|\leq N(N-1)/2,\qquad \|H_-\|\leq\frac N4\sum_{m=1}^{N-1}\frac{m}{\min(m,N-m)} =O(N^2\log N). \tag{5} \] This is a polynomial root bound for this specific Ward primitive. It is not a whole-word R norm estimate or a tame comparison of different source metrics. Whole q-normal derivatives must still be taken from (3)-(4) with the actual moving tensors and source. ## 3. Actual signed tensor counterexamples to identity-source recovery For the literal flip tensor (the two-cut unknot), F_j=N-|j| and sum_(m>0)mF_-m=N(N^2-1)/6. Hence its proposed unknot-normalized boundary functional would be \[ \widehat{\mathcal M}_N(T) =\frac{6}{N(N^2-1)}\sum_{m>0}mF_{-m}. \tag{6} \] It cannot be identified with the original source for arbitrary actual words. Here is an exact characteristic-zero actual crossing calculation. At N=2 let q=i, eta_half=exp(pi i/4), and retain \[ R_+=\begin{pmatrix} \eta_{half}&0&0&0\\ 0&0&\eta_{half}^{-1}&0\\ 0&\eta_{half}^{-1}&2i\eta_{half}^{-1}&0\\ 0&0&0&\eta_{half} \end{pmatrix},\quad g=K^{-1}=\operatorname{diag}(-i,i),\quad R_-=R_+^{-1}. \] These are the literal actual balanced coefficients, not an unrelated matrix model. Keep the external line (i/2)eta_half^(-3 writhe) from the existing actual implementation. Cutting between a positive crossing and its inverse gives \[ T^{pair}_{c,d;a,b} =\frac i2\operatorname{ptr}_g [R_-(I\otimes E_{bd})R_+]_{ca},\qquad F_{pair}(\eta_F)=i(\eta_F^{-1}-\eta_F). \tag{7} \] Thus its original source is zero whereas its negative-band moment is nonzero. Cutting outside that cancelling pair instead gives a constant F equal to zero and moment zero. The complete original source is unchanged; (1) detects the actual inserted Ward current and its placement. No discarded pivotal or framing factor explains the discrepancy. The failure is not limited to a zero-source link. With the second cut immediately after the first positive crossing, the actual one-crossing and three-crossing words have, in the SAME retained normalization, \[ \begin{array}{c|c|c} \text{word}&\Phi(C_I)&F_{-1}\\\hline \sigma_1&-i/2&1/2\\ \sigma_1^3&3i/2&1/2. \end{array} \tag{8} \] Their closed braids are the unknot and trefoil. No common rescaling calibrated on the former makes the moment agree with the latter's original source. The common external conventions in (8) matter; they have not been separately normalized to preferred knot values. Equations (3)-(4), not equality to the identity source, explain the nonzero moment. ## 4. An actual Ward factorial has the required inverse-norm pole There is also a constructive local atom, retaining both the physical edge clock and its quantum normal. Use the actual unfolding F(Q,z) of the original factorial block. Ward iteration gives the EXACT whole negative N-step ratio \[ R_N^-(Q,B) =\frac{F(Q,BQ^{-N})}{F(Q,B)} =\frac1{(BQ^{-N};Q)_N} =\frac1{(1-B/Z)\,V_N(Q,B)},\quad Z=Q^N, \tag{9} \] where V_N=product_(r=1)^(N-1)(1-BQ^r/Z). Near the actual corner Q=Q_N,B=1 it is a unit with V_N(Q_N,1)=N. In particular the off-root divisor is B=Z, not B=1 obtained by first forgetting Q^N. Every scalar and this moving divisor are retained in (9). At the physical root, \[ R_N^-(Q_N,B)=\frac1{1-B^N}. \tag{10} \] The scaled physical boundary B=exp(w/N) makes (10) exactly 1/(1-exp w), for EVERY N. Its pole at w=0 has coefficient -1. This is a uniform root-slice boundary model. No uniform growing-N off-root estimate for V_N is inferred from its fixed-N unit property. The fixed-N exceptional normal ratio of the same actual atom, Q=Q_N exp(epsilon), U=exp(tN epsilon), is (1-B^N)^t. Formula (9) is its t=-1 case as an exact whole finite-product identity, with U=Q^(-N). Thus the pole is an original negative Ward circuit and its norm zero, not a pole supplied by a chosen unrelated amplitude. Its place in an actual factorial crossing coefficient can be specified without discarding the other factors. For any literal block C_k(z)=(z;Q)_k, the whole N-carry identity is \[ \frac{C_{k+N}(z)}{C_k(z)}=(zQ^k;Q)_N, \qquad \frac{C_k(z)}{C_{k+N}(z)}=(zQ^k;Q)_N^{-1}. \tag{10a} \] The actual balanced R coefficients in [the marked holonomy construction](marked_braid_holonomy.md), Section 3, are products and quotients of precisely these blocks and Cartan lines. For a denominator block, put B=zQ^(k+N) in (9); (10a)'s inverse is exactly the same atom. At the root its full norm is 1-(zQ^k)^N, rather than an unmarked numerical multiplier. This identifies a specific ORIGINAL denominator-block carry that supplies the pole. It does not treat that block in isolation as the full crossing coefficient: its numerator blocks, resonant factorials, Cartan line and actual source remain necessary and can cancel it. For the pure-prefix GEOMETRIC chart, take c=U_21 nonzero, s nonzero. Its principal relation is \[ k-1=-\frac{c\eta_{geo}}{s(1-\eta_{geo})^2},\quad B=k^{-1}, \quad \Omega_{cut}=\frac{d\log A\wedge d\eta_{geo}} {s(1-\eta_{geo})^2}. \tag{11} \] If the actual negative Ward circuit (9) is inserted and this principal geometric chart is used, its amplitude (10) has the nonzero polar coefficient \[ [\eta_{geo}^{-1}]R_N^-(Q_N,B(\eta_{geo}))=-\frac{s}{Nc}, \qquad \mathop{\rm Res}_{\eta_{geo}=0} (R_N^-\Omega_{cut})=-\frac1{Nc}d\log A. \tag{12} \] This follows from B-1=(c/s)eta_geo+O(eta_geo^2), so 1-B^N=-(Nc/s)eta_geo+O(eta_geo^2). Only that first polar coefficient enters (12). It is a nonzero actual-atom boundary coefficient. It is NOT a theorem that the original full knot co-source contains this negative circuit, or that its Fourier cap cycle maps to this geometric boundary. An actual crossing can carry several factorial, source and norm factors whose products change the pole order or cancel its coefficient. The exact coefficient (12) identifies what one original Ward factor can supply; (4) and (7)-(8) forbid recovering the selected source by a universal normalized negative-band moment. ## 5. Exact audit and remaining concrete target [The audit script](../experiments/audit_actual_negative_band_boundary_moment.py) checks actual signed tensor instances of (2)-(4), the complete characteristic-zero examples (7)-(8), the original inverse-norm factorization and the simple residue (12). Results are in [the reproducible output](../experiments/actual_negative_band_boundary_moment_results.json). The remaining target is an actual relative source transform carrying the independent physical B sum, Fourier eta_F cap, (3)-(4)'s Ward row and all normal/divisor factors into the geometric chart. The bare equality of a regular transverse Gaussian with the original identity source is not supplied by this local calculation.

title: Exact coherent turn reduction in the original Newton source
text: # Exact coherent turn reduction in the original Newton source 29 October 2026. The full original Newton alphabet obeys a projective modular relation, with its Cartan scalar retained. It removes arbitrary numbers of redundant twist/turn packets BEFORE a norm estimate. In one arbitrary-length class the complete reflected original source is exactly 1 or N and has zero exponential rate. A same-sign run of two-crossing packets reduces to one twist with explicit boundary adapters. These are source-exact coherent reductions, not a new hyperbolic-volume family. ## 1. All-input relation, including the original Cartan line Use the COMPLETE Newton packet of [the positive turn metric](actual_newton_turn_positive_gram.md). Let T=T_1, P=P_rev, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, kappa=q^(d^2/2), and nu_j=(-1)^j Q^(j(j+1)/2). Its actual entries are T_ij=kappa nu_j (-q)^(i-j) [i choose j]_Q, i>=j, T^(-1)=conjugate(T). All matrices below act on the FULL N-dimensional Newton packet, including every original confluent derivative. Put theta_N=kappa^3(-q)^d, |theta_N|=1. In fact theta_N=kappa, since kappa^2(-q)^d=1 at the specified root. Keeping the unsimplified form below displays the original phase sources. Then T P T=theta_N P T^(-1)P, (T P)^3=theta_N I. (1) Here P is the genuine unscaled physical turn in this packet. No eigenvalue-only quotient or assumed ordinary positive trace is used. For a finite own proof of (1), the Gaussian identity needed is sum_(k=0)^i (-1)^k Q^(k(k-1)/2-jk) [i choose k]_Q [j+k choose j]_Q =(-1)^i Q^(i(i-1)/2-ij) [j choose i]_Q. (2) To prove it, expand [j+k choose j]_Q=(Q^(k+1);Q)_j/F_j =F_j^(-1) sum_(l=0)^j (-1)^l Q^(l(l+1)/2)[j choose l]_Q Q^(kl). The finite binomial theorem performs the inner k sum as (Q^(l-j);Q)_i. If i>j every term is zero. If i<=j, only l<=j-i survive; insert (Q^(l-j);Q)_i =(-1)^i Q^[-i(j-l)+i(i-1)/2] F_(j-l)/F_(j-l-i). The remaining sum is sum_(l=0)^(j-i) (-1)^l Q^[l(l+1)/2+il] /(F_l F_(j-i-l)) =(Q^(i+1);Q)_(j-i)/F_(j-i)=[j choose i]_Q. This proves (2) by two finite binomial expansions. At the root every denominator used here has index<N. If j+k>=N the product expression for [j+k choose j] is zero and exactly supplies the original cutoff. Now use the exact root reflection [d-k choose j]_Q=nu_j^(-1) Q^(-jk)[j+k choose j]_Q. The (i,j) entry of TPT becomes kappa^2(-q)^(i+d-j) times the left side of (2). For i>j it is zero. For i<=j, the reflected inverse entry is (P T^(-1)P)_ij =kappa^(-1) nu_j^(-1)(-q)^(-(j-i)) nu_(j-i)[j choose i]_Q. Since nu_(j-i)/nu_j=(-1)^i Q^[i(i-1)/2-ij], (2) gives (1) entry by entry. Thus all repeated-root normal data are retained. These are the full CASIMIR Hermite normals at the fixed quantum root. No differentiation in q is being asserted: the actual generic-q turn need not be constant reversal in this root Newton frame. ## 2. An arbitrary-turn complete original source with an exact rate Let C=TP and let 1=e_0 be the original numerator-source vector. The first and last T columns give C e_0=kappa e_d, C^2 e_0=kappa^2 ((-q)^i)_(i=0)^d. Together with (1), for every integer h, C^(3h)e_0=theta_N^h e_0, C^(3h+1)e_0=theta_N^h kappa e_d, C^(3h+2)e_0=theta_N^h kappa^2 ((-q)^i)_i. (3) The exact positive Newton metric consequently gives, for EVERY N, ||C^m 1||^2 = 1, m=0 or1 mod3; N, m=2 mod3. (4) Its literal adjoint-word closure, with the original unrestricted marked cap and original cups, is exactly this norm by the positive metric theorem. Thus the ENTIRE original reflected circuit has zero exponential rate for arbitrarily many fixed turns. This does not say C is unitary: (4) itself distinguishes norms1 and N. It says that these particular large coherent turn networks are projectively periodic. This is a useful normalization class, not a new hyperbolic class. It shows why assigning an independent positive angle capacity to each expanded crossing cannot give the actual rate even in the positive reflected-source formulation. ## 3. Exact reduction of arbitrary same-sign two-crossing runs There is also a useful reduction of the newly solved T_2 kernel: T^2 P=theta_N C T^(-1)C^(-1), (T^2P)^m=theta_N^m C T^(-m)C^(-1). (5) These follow algebraically from (1), for all signed integers m. The original source endpoint satisfies C^(-1)e_0=kappa^(-2)(-q)^(-d) T e_0. Consequently the source-selected whole run is exactly (T^2P)^m e_0 =theta_N^m kappa^(-2)(-q)^(-d) T P T^(1-m)e_0. (6) Thus a run with unbounded turn count has ONE retained turn and one signed twist packet, with all original phase and endpoint adapters displayed. The adapters are actual Newton operators; no assertion of polynomial conditioning or unitarity is made for T. Equation (6) is an exact coherent source reduction, not a sharp estimate for its remaining mixed packet. The same relation can remove unit digits inside a general rational twist/turn word, with (1)'s scalar recorded. Reduced mixed-sign words still contain real oscillatory interactions. Neither (5) nor finite order of C diagonalizes those words or proves a geometric maximum. ## 4. Remaining analytic scope The source of a genuinely reduced word is not determined by the modular relation. In particular the norm of TPT_(-p)e_0 generally contains a nontrivial coherent finite sum; unit nodal twist phases do not make it a polynomially bounded operator. A new sharp variational estimate must control that remaining packet and its integer marks, then identify its full critical graph and regulator. This note proves the exact reduction and the nonzero rate statement (4), not those unproved assertions for arbitrary rational/arborescent sources. Audit: [full original physical alphabet, all-input modular identity and actual reflected closures](../experiments/audit_actual_newton_coherent_turn_reduction.py). Independent analytical review passed: the finite double-binomial cutoff/prefactors, theta_N including kappa, the three exact source vectors, and the same-sign-run conjugacy/source adapter were rederived. The finite audit separately passes49 generic identities, nine full original alphabets, and90 complete reflected original sources.

title: Actual ideal prism cells and geometric Newton associativity
text: # Actual ideal prism cells and geometric Newton associativity 29 October 2026. Every strictly positive Newton multiplication action is the volume of an explicit convex IDEAL TRIANGULAR PRISM. Its three ordered quadrilateral faces have cross ratios given by derivatives of the actual source action. Thus internal source stationarity is exactly the isometry condition for the prescribed quadrilateral face gluing. Two stationary multiplication cells form an ideal cube; its alternative diagonal cut gives the other parenthesization. The equality holds for the full conjugate-antisymmetric pre-Bloch class, not just its regulator. This supplies local geometric incidence and composition. It does not by itself identify every closed Conway expression with a complete hyperbolic link complement. Boundary degenerations, the global diagram identification and complete ends still require their own arguments. ## 1. The actual source action Use [the positive full-Newton multiplication](actual_positive_newton_multiplication.md), whose uniform action is m(x,y,z)=L(x+y)+L(z)-L(x)-L(y) -L(z-x)-L(z-y)-L(x+y-z), L(t)=integral_0^t log(2sin(pi u))du. Work first in its STRICT domain p=z-x>0, q=z-y>0, r=x+y-z>0, w=1-x-y>0, p+q+2r+w=1, x=q+r, y=p+r, 1-z=r+w. (1) For positive a+b+c=1 let V(a,b,c) be the actual volume of an ideal tetrahedron with angles pi(a,b,c). The proved source identity is pi m=V(y,x,w)+V(p,q,1-p-q)+V(p+q,r,r+w). (2) The source remains its original multiplication table, including its normal directions; no new state sum is being substituted here. ## 2. Explicit six vertices of a convex ideal prism In the upper half-space model, use the ideal point infinity and four points on the unit circle in the boundary plane: v0=1, v1=exp(2pi i p), v2=exp(2pi i(p+r)), v3=exp(2pi i(p+r+q)). (3) The consecutive half-arc lengths are p,r,q,r+w. They are all positive and sum to one. Let P be the intersection of the Euclidean lines (v0,v1) and (v2,v3). The inequalities in (1) imply that P lies beyond v1 on the ray from v0, and beyond v2 on the ray from v3. Indeed the exterior triangle (P,v1,v2) has angles angle(v1)=pi y, angle(v2)=pi x, angle(P)=pi w. Their sum is pi and all are positive. The elementary sine rule gives the explicit formula P=v1+kappa_x(v1-v0)=v2+kappa_y(v2-v3), kappa_x=sin(pi x)sin(pi r)/(sin(pi w)sin(pi p)), kappa_y=sin(pi y)sin(pi r)/(sin(pi w)sin(pi q)). (4) In particular |P|>1. Form the ideal quadrangular pyramid with apex infinity and base (v0,v1,v2,v3), and attach the ideal tetrahedron (infinity,P,v1,v2) along their common triangular face (infinity,v1,v2), on opposite sides of that face. The pyramid has dihedral angles p,r,q,r+w along its four base edges. Its dihedral angle at an apex edge is one minus the sum of the two adjacent half-arcs. Along the shared face the two apex-edge angles therefore add to pi after the attachment, while the base-edge angle adds to pi(r+w)<pi. The two coplanar face pairs merge. The resulting six-vertex polyhedron is the ideal triangular prism with faces triangles: (P,v1,v2), (infinity,v0,v3), quadrilaterals: Fx=(infinity,v0,v1,P), Fy=(infinity,v3,v2,P), Fz=(v0,v1,v2,v3). (5) Convexity is literal. The two merged vertical side planes are the planes over (v0,v1) and (v2,v3). The third vertical side plane is over (v3,v0). The remaining supporting hemispheres have boundary circles (v0,v1,v2,v3) and (P,v1,v2). P is outside the first circle, and v0,v3 are outside the second circle on the side opposite its arc through P. These five half-spaces contain both attached cells, and their intersection has exactly the vertices and faces (5). Thus the union is their convex intersection, not an immersed volume chain. Equivalently one may use the elementary convex-union argument: the two convex cells lie on opposite sides of the attaching support plane, and all its finite seam angles are at most pi. The union is locally convex. Between any two finite points, a length-minimizing path exists by compactness of a bounded hyperbolic ball containing a minimizing sequence; local convexity makes that path an ambient geodesic. Thus the union is convex, without an assertion at a missing ideal vertex. The complete edge-angle table is | Edges | Dihedral angle divided by pi | |---|---:| | P-v1 and infinity-v0 | x | | P-v2 and infinity-v3 | y | | v1-v2 and v0-v3 | 1-z | | P-infinity | w=1-x-y | | v0-v1 | p=z-x | | v2-v3 | q=z-y | Each ideal vertex has three incident angles summing to pi. The three longitudinal angles have sum pi(1-2r)<pi. This last strict inequality is visible directly in the construction; no polyhedron existence theorem is being invoked. Conversely any convex ideal triangular prism with these ordered ports has this explicit form after an isometry. Send its selected quadrilateral port circle to the unit circle, and one of its two remaining ideal vertices to infinity. The other two quadrilateral faces then lie in vertical planes through the remaining vertex P; their boundary lines are (v0,v1) and (v2,v3). Thus P is exactly their intersection, and its position on the exterior side of the base support hemisphere gives |P|>1. Orient the cyclic base order so that the finite triangular wall is (P,v1,v2). Its positive triangle angles make the four half-arcs (p,r,q,r+w) with w>0. The same sine rule recovers (4), and the edge-angle table recovers x=q+r, y=p+r, z=p+q+r. This verifies that the alternative prism pieces used in section 6 are actual cells of this family. Triangulating the quadrangular pyramid across (v0,v2) gives tetrahedral angle triples (p,r,1-p-r) and (p+r,q,r+w). Their volume sum is Lambda(pi p)+Lambda(pi q)+Lambda(pi r)+Lambda(pi(r+w)), because the complementary intermediate angles cancel. This is also the sum of the last two volumes in (2). The attached tetrahedron has volume V(y,x,w). Therefore this ACTUAL convex prism has volume pi m. ## 3. The ordered face metrics are the source derivatives For cyclically ordered ideal points (a,b,c,d) on a circle or line set kappa(a,b,c,d)=(a-b)(c-d)/((a-d)(b-c))>0, (6) using the limit when one point is infinity. This positive real number determines the ordered ideal quadrilateral up to hyperbolic isometry: send three vertices to (infinity,0,1) and the fourth is determined by (6). A one-step cyclic change of vertices, or reversal fixing the first vertex, replaces kappa by its reciprocal. For the orders in (5), direct substitution and the sine rule give kappa(Fx)=sin(pi x)sin(pi r)/(sin(pi w)sin(pi p)), kappa(Fy)=sin(pi y)sin(pi r)/(sin(pi w)sin(pi q)), kappa(Fz)=sin(pi p)sin(pi q)/(sin(pi z)sin(pi r)). (7) Differentiating the actual source action, with all other boundary variables fixed, proves the exact equations log kappa(Fx)=-partial_x m, log kappa(Fy)=-partial_y m, log kappa(Fz)=-partial_z m. (8) There is no normalization constant: all factors of 2 in L' cancel. The actual h-leaf action g(x)=-2L(x)-2L(1/2-x), 0<x<1/2, likewise has a literal ideal pyramid. Its apex is infinity and its base is the rectangle with vertices (1, exp(2pi i x), -1, -exp(2pi i x)). Its four base angles alternate x and 1/2-x, its four apex-edge angles are right angles, and its volume is pi g(x). Its ordered base metric is kappa_leaf=tan(pi x)^2=exp(-g'(x)). (9) ## 4. Source stationarity gives the actual corner-preserving gluing Mark any child output quadrilateral by C0,C1,C2,C3 in its source order. In a multiplication prism use the lower and upper input maps lower child: (C0,C1,C2,C3) -> (v0,v1,P,infinity), upper child: (C0,C1,C2,C3) -> (infinity,P,v2,v3). (10) These are the literal identity-stack corner identifications: the lower child's top left and right corners map to infinity and P, which are respectively the upper child's bottom left and right corners. Thus no unrecorded four-punctured-sphere mutation is inserted. Relative to (5), the first map is a cyclic shift and the second a reversal. Each replaces kappa by its reciprocal. At an internal wire u, source stationarity says that the child output derivative plus the parent input derivative is zero. Equations (8),(9) therefore give kappa_child kappa_parent=1. (11) By the complete metric invariant (6), (11) is EXACTLY the condition that (10) is an ideal-quadrilateral isometry. This proves metric matching of the whole face, rather than merely equality of a formal edge product. For the relevant angle bookkeeping, call output edges C0-C1 and C2-C3 FREE, and the other pair CAP. A leaf output has FREE angles x and CAP angles 1/2-x. A completed product output has FREE angles z and CAP angles 1-z. The input maps (10) send CAP edges to the prism's two edges with angle x or y, and FREE edges to its longitudinal edges. Thus a leaf-to-prism seam produces right angles on the CAP pair; a product-to-prism seam has angle pi on that pair and becomes flat. The edge common to both inputs has total angle pi(w+x+y)=pi, while the output's two longitudinal edges acquire angles pi(p+x)=pi z, pi(q+y)=pi z. (12) These identities explain the local right/flat boundary pattern. They do not alone prove the global closure or cusp completeness of an arbitrary expression. A genuine turn rotates a product output quadrilateral once, exchanges FREE and CAP, and replaces its label x by 1-x. It also inverts kappa, exactly as the derivative of the turned profile requires. ## 5. Equality of the full antisymmetric pre-Bloch class Write A(z)=[z]-[bar z] in the rational pre-Bloch group. For an ideal tetrahedron with positive angle triple (a,b,c), let its positive shape be z=exp(pi i a)sin(pi b)/sin(pi c), and put u_a=exp(2pi i a), and cyclically. Applying the defining five-term relation to (z,bar z) gives A(z)=-[u_a^-1]+[u_c]-[u_b^-1]. Subtract its complex conjugate. One obtains the uniform identity A(z)=1/2 (A(u_a)+A(u_b)+A(u_c)). (13) No integral inversion identity or unproved regulator injectivity is used. In particular A(exp(2pi i(1-a)))=-A(exp(2pi i a)) directly from its definition. Consequently the sum of A over a pyramid's two tetrahedra depends only on the sum of A(exp(2pi i theta)) over its four half-arcs; complementary diagonal terms cancel. The source ordering (p,q,r,r+w) and the actual prism ordering (p,r,q,r+w) give exactly the SAME class. Equation (13) therefore upgrades (2) to sum_(three source atoms) A(z_j) = sum_(an actual prism triangulation) A(z_j) (14) in the rational pre-Bloch group of any common field containing the displayed phases and shapes. For algebraic source stationary points this is a number field, as in the proved source-regulator theorem. No assertion of zero boundary for this open cell is made. More generally the antisymmetric class of a convex ideal polyhedron is independent of its ideal triangulation, directly from five-term relations. For equal boundary triangulations the difference of two tetrahedral chains is a 3-cycle in the full abstract simplex on their ideal vertices. Coning it to one vertex gives a 4-chain bounding it; the boundary of each 4-simplex is precisely a five-term relation. Different triangulations of a boundary polygon can first be corrected by tetrahedral chains whose four vertices lie on that face's circle. Their shapes are real, hence their A-symbols are zero. This proves the assertion without assuming a general Pachner-connectivity theorem. ## 6. Actual ideal-cube geometry proves stationary associativity Fix positive a,b,c,d with a+b<1, a+c<1, b+c<1, max(a,b,c)<d<min(1,a+b+c). (15) For the left parenthesization put F_L(t)=m(a,b,t)+m(t,c,d), max(a,b,d-c)<t<min(a+b,d,1-c). (16) This interval is nonempty precisely under (15). Its derivative is F_L'(t)=log[sin(pi(t+c)) sin(pi(a+b-t)) sin(pi(d-t)) /(sin(pi(t-a)) sin(pi(t-b)) sin(pi(t+c-d)))]. It tends to positive infinity at the lower endpoint and negative infinity at the upper endpoint. Strict concavity of the two actual source actions gives a UNIQUE interior maximizer t*. Therefore the two multiplication prisms glue by (10),(11). Their two wall-edge seams with angles (1-t*)+t* become flat. The four triangular walls merge into two quadrilateral walls. The union is an ACTUAL convex ideal cube with four input/output port faces. Its wall-edge angles, in order around either wall, are pi(a,b,c,1-d), and its four edges between consecutive port faces have angles pi(1-a-b), pi(1-b-c), pi(d-c), pi(d-a). (17) They are all positive and less than pi by (15). The seam's remaining edge angles are respectively (t*-a)+(d-t*)=d-a and (t*-b)+(1-t*-c)=1-b-c. Thus the two convex cells have no reentrant seam, and their union is the convex ideal hexahedron with these faces. There is an explicit common reflection, which supplies the other diagonal cut without invoking a rigidity theorem. For the single prism in section 2 define the reflection in the hemisphere centered at P with squared radius |P|^2-1: R(z)=P+(|P|^2-1)/(bar z-bar P). (18) It exchanges infinity with P. The elementary power-of-a-point identity for the unit circle shows that it exchanges v0 with v1 and v3 with v2. Its reflecting plane is perpendicular to all three quadrilateral port planes: it is perpendicular to the two vertical planes through P and orthogonal to the unit hemisphere. It exchanges the prism's two triangular walls. The corner maps (10) intertwine the corresponding vertex exchanges. Hence the two reflecting planes agree after gluing, and the ideal cube has a common reflection plane. Its section by that plane is a convex hyperbolic quadrilateral; its four vertices lie on the four edges between port faces. Each such edge is perpendicular to the reflection plane, and its two ideal endpoints are exchanged. The OTHER diagonal of this quadrilateral determines a hyperbolic plane perpendicular to the reflection plane. It contains both full perpendicular port edges at its endpoints. Consequently it cuts the cube in an IDEAL QUADRILATERAL with those four ideal endpoints. The two pieces are convex ideal triangular prisms. Their external ports are (b,c) and (a,d), exactly the right parenthesization. If u* denotes the new internal source label, the angle table in section 2 gives their actions m(b,c,u*) and m(a,u*,d). Their common face is already isometric, so (8) gives right-side stationarity. The same endpoint and strict-concavity argument makes u* its unique maximizer. Both parenthesizations thus decompose ONE actual ideal cube. They have equal volume and equal full antisymmetric pre-Bloch class by section 5. This is a source-local geometric associativity theorem; it is stronger than deducing equality of exponential rates from the finite algebra's associativity. There is also an exact algebraic check of the critical point. Put X=exp(2pi i a), Y=exp(2pi i b), Z=exp(2pi i c), W=exp(2pi i d), T=exp(2pi i t*). The sine equation in (16) is the polynomial identity (ZT-1)(XY-T)(W-T)=(T-X)(T-Y)(ZT-W). Its cubic and constant terms cancel, and its nonzero root is T=(XYZW-XYZ+XY-XW-YW+W) /(XYZ-XZ-YZ+ZW-W+1). (19) The denominator is nonzero under (15): otherwise the polynomial would have no nonzero root or would vanish identically, contradicting existence and strictness of the real stationary point. The root for u* follows by cyclically permuting (X,Y,Z). The selected angle interval, not the rational formula alone, fixes the geometric branch. The proof above concerns positive local cells and their stationary composition. Flat source faces, boundary maxima and full closed-link incidence must still be handled before turning these local results into a general hyperbolic-volume theorem. Audit: [explicit cells, symbolic classes and actual stationary cubes](../experiments/audit_actual_newton_ideal_prism_and_associativity.py) and [recorded results](../experiments/actual_newton_ideal_prism_and_associativity_results.json). It checks 163 prisms with exact rational circle coordinates and exact reflection maps, the symbolic five-term phase conversion and critical polynomial, and 20 actual stationary ideal cubes at high precision. The cube checks construct the face-gluing Mobius map, verify all six supporting face planes and convexity, check the common reflection, and test coplanarity of the four endpoints of the alternative cut. The uniform proof is the geometric and algebraic argument above; the finite checks do not infer arbitrary link geometry. Independent internal review: the primary agent read the full local geometry, ordered source maps, phase-symbol identity and reflected-cube alternative cut, and freshly replayed the audit: PASS. The coherent source agent independently checked the same analytical ingredients. The Conway geometry agent separately checked the cell and port data used by the global construction. The explicit converse normalization in section 2 identifies the alternative pieces with this source prism family; no general polyhedron rigidity theorem is assumed there.

title: A rank-three actual source: two endpoint envelopes give a sharp norm
text: # A rank-three actual source: two endpoint envelopes give a sharp norm 29 October 2026. The next repeated Newton twist/turn word has a genuine cubic spectral cover and an interior forward dominant-modulus switch. Nevertheless its ENTIRE positive original-source norm has a sharp limit. The proof keeps its exact source currents, uses a gapped backward branch only for the lower bound, and overlaps two full spectral-radius envelopes for the upper bound. The required profile comparisons have finite outward-rounded interval/Rouche certificates. No hyperbolic volume or link identity is inferred from the resulting constant. ## 1. The actual source and both of its boundary vectors Use T=T_1,P=P_rev and the unchanged original Newton metric. By the [universal endpoint identity](actual_newton_run_endpoint_vectors.md), (T^2P)^4 1 has, up to a unit scalar, coefficients v_i=kappa^(-2)(-q)^(i-d)K_i, K_i=sum_(j=0)^i nu_j [i choose j]_Q conjugate(P_(d-j)). (1) Here P_i is the original Green sequence, not the turn matrix. Its rank-three forced Ward, with G_i=K_i/F_i and M_i=F_i^3G_i, is proved in [the endpoint theorem, section5](actual_twist_endpoint_gaussian_certificate.md). Write its coefficients as B_i,C_i,D_i there. The exact monic equation is M_i+B_i M_(i-1)+C_i(1-Q^(i-1))^3 M_(i-2) -Q^3(1-Q^(i-1))^3(1-Q^(i-2))^4 M_(i-3) =Q^2 delta_(i,1). (2) Negative-index terms are absent. Its literal data are M_0=conjugate(P_d), M_1=(1-3Q+Q^2)conjugate(P_d)+Q^2; D_2=0 fixes the next datum. In particular the source forcing has not been deleted. There is a regular exact backward equation. Put g_k=conjugate(F_k)^4 M_(d-k), Z_k=Q^(-k). For every3<=k<=d, g_k=a_k g_(k-1)+b_k g_(k-2)+c_k g_(k-3), (3) a_k=1+Q^(-1)+Q^(-2)-(4+Q^(-1))Z_k, b_k=[-Q^(-3)-Q^(-2)-Q^(-1) +(3+4Q^(-1))Z_k-3Q Z_k^2](1-Q Z_k), c_k=Q^(-3)(1-Q Z_k)(1-Q^2 Z_k)^4. All original currents are encoded in its INITIAL VECTOR. Let S_0=sum_(j=0)^d conjugate(P_j). Exactly, for N>=3, g_0=N^2 S_0, g_1=N^2 Q^(-1)[(Q-3)S_0+2N], g_2=N^2 Q^(-4)[(Q^4-3Q^3-3Q^2+6Q+3)S_0 +2(Q^3+Q^2-3Q-1)N]. (4) For a direct proof of(4), root reflection gives K_(d-h)=nu_h sum_(j=h)^d [j choose h]_Q conjugate(P_j). Writing S_m=sum_j Q^(mj)conjugate(P_j), the original finite Green equation yields (1-Q^m)S_m+2Q^(m-1)S_(m-1)-Q^(m-2)S_(m-2) =N delta_(m,1 modN). The actual inverse-crossing last row also gives S_(-1)=NQ: equivalently sum_j Q^jP_j=NQ^(-1). These evaluate S_1,S_2 from S_0,N and give(4). Reversing(2) and multiplying by the displayed fourth factorial proves(3). The independently evaluated original endpoints give |M_0|~N^(3/2), S_0=N^(3/2)exp[-i pi(3-N)/4]+O(N). Consequently (g_2,g_1,g_0)/g_0=(4,-2,1)+O(N^(-1/2)). This is the nonzero dominant eigenvector at the backward endpoint. The N terms in(4) are retained source currents, not arbitrary choices. ## 2. Spectral envelopes, and a source-selected backward lower bound Put Y=e^(2iu),Z=e^(-2iu). The forward and backward principal cubics are f_u(lambda)=lambda^3+(-3+7Y-3Y^2)lambda^2 +(3-5Y)(1-Y)^3lambda-(1-Y)^7, b_u(lambda)=lambda^3+(5Z-3)lambda^2 +(3-7Z+3Z^2)(1-Z)lambda-(1-Z)^5. (5) Let rho_f,rho_b be their largest root moduli. They are continuous and bounded below by1/3,2/3 respectively, by their traces. Set I_e(u)=pi^(-1)integral_0^u log rho_e(t)dt, e=f,b. Uniformly for all indices in any indicated compact u interval, the actual matrix product has the spectral-radius upper bound log|M_i|<=N I_f(pi i/N)+o(N), log|g_k|<=N I_b(pi k/N)+o(N). (6) This remains valid at modulus switches and the initial double fast zero. Here is an elementary proof avoiding an ill-conditioned full eigenframe. A bounded3x3 matrix of spectral radius at most1 has ||A^l||<=C(l+1)^2, uniformly in repeated roots: Newton interpolation of z^l bounds its order0,1,2 confluent differences by the corresponding complete homogeneous polynomials, of size at most (l+1)^2. The matrix factors in that interpolation are uniformly bounded. Freeze the exact smooth companion over blocks of length L=floor(N^(1/8)). Its step error is O(L/N). Expanding the product in those errors bounds one block by rho^L C L^2 exp(C L^4/N). Multiplying the blocks costs O(N log L/L+L^3)=o(N) in its logarithm. Uniform continuity of log rho gives the Riemann integral, uniformly also for partial final blocks. Polynomial initial data add only O(log N). This proves(6). The upper-bound mechanism is valid for ANY FIXED companion rank r, not only this cubic. A uniformly bounded rank-r matrix with spectral radius at most one has powers bounded by C(l+1)^(r-1), by the same order-(r-1) confluent divided-difference formula. Freezing L steps therefore costs at most rho^L C L^(r-1) exp(C L^(r+1)/N). Over O(N/L) blocks the extra logarithm is O(N log L/L+L^r). Taking L=floor(N^(1/(2r))) makes this o(N). This requires a fixed-rank uniformly smooth actual recurrence, a positive lower spectral-radius bound, and subexponential initial data; it permits eigenvalue collisions and modulus switches. It is a FULL spectral-radius upper envelope, not a lower bound or a license to replace the radius by an arbitrarily selected single branch. For every strict backward prefix0<=u<=u_0<pi/2 there is also a lower: log|g_k|=N I_b(pi k/N)+O_(u0)(log N). (7) The [independent exact dominant-root certificate](actual_backward_cubic_dominant_source_certificate.md) proves a unique simple dominant branch of b_u beginning at-2 on the ENTIRE strict half-circle. Its two fast roots may coalesce at0. Its regular dominant projection and a uniformly stable complement power-Gram give source transport without diagonalizing those fast roots. Equation(4) supplies the required actual nonzero projection with relative O(N^(-1/2)) error. The exact backward equation is homogeneous for k>=3, so no interior forcing is omitted in applying that certificate. Summed dominant logarithms prove(7). This argument does not transport a branch through the forward modulus switch. ## 3. One algebraic profile maximum and two finite comparisons Let Lambda be Lobachevsky and define J_e(u)=I_e(u)+2Lambda(u)/pi, e=f,b. Since M_i=F_i^2K_i and s_i s_(d-i)=N, (6) gives the two original coefficient envelopes J_f(pi i/N) and J_b(pi(d-i)/N). The lower(7) gives J_b at every fixed strict backward prefix. The backward profile has exactly one first-half maximum u_*. Put p_6(z)=z^6-9z^5+29z^4-38z^3+10z^2+2z+1. Its unique root z_* in[1,4] lies in(19/5,77/20), and u_*=arcsin(sqrt(z_*)/2), so 2pi/5<u_*<pi/2. Indeed J_b'(u)=pi^(-1)log[rho_b(u)/(2sin u)^2]. Imposing |lambda|=z=4sin^2u in b_u and its conjugate and eliminating lambda,Z gives z^24 p_6(z)^2=0. Exact Sturm counts give just two positive roots of p_6 in[0,4]: one in(2/3,7/10) and z_* above. The smaller cannot give rho_b=z because the product of the three root moduli gives rho_b>=z^(5/6)>z when0<z<1. At u=pi/2 all roots of lambda^3-8lambda^2+26lambda-32 have modulus<4: its unique real root lies in(2,3), and the conjugate pair has modulus sqrt(32/r)<4. Continuity now proves the claimed maximum. These eliminations use full polynomials, not a sampled eigenvalue branch. The forward profile is increasing: its root trace has modulus1+3z, so rho_f>=z+1/3>z. Two further finite inequalities suffice for a global overlap: integral_0^(2pi/5)log(rho_f/rho_b)du<0, integral_(2pi/5)^(pi/2)log[rho_b/(2sin u)^2]du<0. (8) The audit supplies rigorous interval bounds on WHOLE parameter cells. For each cubic it chooses rational complex root centers and verifies three disjoint disks by |p'(c)|_lower r > |p(c)|_upper+|p''(c)|_upper r^2/2+r^3. Rouche therefore encloses all roots for EVERY parameter in that cell. Their moduli bound rho and its logarithm. The small initial interval uses a monic Cauchy bound and rho_b>=2/3. At4096 outward-rounded cells the two certified upper bounds in(8) are respectively less than -.0327 and-.0114. This is a finite proof of the comparisons, not extrapolation from samples. The first inequality makes J_f(2pi/5)<J_b(2pi/5). The second makes J_b(pi/2)<J_b(2pi/5). Root-conjugation symmetry gives J_b(pi-u)=2J_b(pi/2)-J_b(u), so J_b(3pi/5)<J_b(pi/2). The only profile criticals before3pi/5 are u_* and its reflected minimum. Therefore the maximum of J_b on[0,3pi/5] is J_b(u_*). Use the forward envelope for i/N<=2/5 and the backward envelope for i/N>=2/5. They cover EVERY physical index and neither exceeds this backward maximum. ## 4. Whole original-source conclusion and scope The polynomial number of positive norm terms gives the upper rate; a rounded backward index near u_* and(7) give the matching lower. For the literal original halfword A=(T_2P_rev)^4, lim_N N^(-1)log||A1||_Newt^2=2J_b(u_*). (9) Its original adjoint-word marked closure equals this positive norm exactly. All Cartan lines and all fixed-root Casimir normals remain. No value-only trace or arbitrary diagonal Newton coupon was substituted. The assertion concerns fixed word depth before N tends to infinity. This extends the source-aware folded Ward method to a genuine cubic with an interior modulus switch. Its inputs are explicit resets, the full opposite source vector, finite algebraic dominant-mode tests, and finite certified envelope comparisons. It is not a general theorem that an arbitrary scalar A-polynomial selects its largest root, and it is not a new broad bridge-family or hyperbolic-volume claim. Audit: [original source, exact folded current, algebraic criticals and interval spectral profiles](../experiments/audit_actual_newton_rank_three_folded_packet.py). Two independent complete proof reviews passed. Fresh replays confirm eleven full original source/current families, the exact modulus resultant and Sturm counts, and8192 outward-rounded whole-cell spectral disks. The root proposals are never used without the stated Rouche validation. Both reviewers rederived the freeze-block bound, the actual source projection and the reflected profile overlap; no topological or volume identification was inferred.

title: Finite Gaussian boundary data for arbitrary repeated twist/turn runs
text: # Finite Gaussian boundary data for arbitrary repeated twist/turn runs 29 October 2026. For every fixed integer m, the actual source of (T_2 P_rev)^m has explicit first AND last fixed-rank endpoint vectors. They reduce to original signed-twist sources with fixed Newton insertions. Each such source has a finite algebraic Gaussian leading coefficient, so testing a candidate recurrence's boundary projection does not require an unknown knot invariant or an unspecified solution. No interior branch-survival theorem for all m is asserted. ## 1. Universal exact source endpoint identities Use the full original Newton algebra/metric, Bhat_h=B_h/s_h^2, T=T_1,P=P_rev,R=kappa r. The actual Cartan identities give kappa^2(-q)^d=1, theta=kappa^3(-q)^d=kappa. Thus the [coherent modular reduction](actual_newton_coherent_turn_reduction.md) simplifies, for every integer m, to v_m:=(T^2P)^m1=kappa^m T P T^(1-m)1. (1) For a polynomial f, its Newton endpoint coefficient satisfies alpha_(d-j)(f)=phi(f Bhat_j). Lower triangularity of T therefore gives (v_m)_h=kappa^m sum_(j=0)^h T_(h,j) phi(R^(1-m) Bhat_j). (2) There is an equally explicit right endpoint formula. Define E_h=sum_(r=0)^h nu_h^(-1)nu_(h-r)(-q)^(-(h-r)) [h choose r]_Q Bhat_r. Then, on the FULL algebra and with every confluent normal retained, mathscrR(R Bhat_h)=R^(-1)E_h, (v_m)_(d-h)=kappa^m phi(R^(-m)E_h). (3) Proof. TPT=kappa PT^(-1)P implies PT=kappa T^(-1)PT^(-1)P. Apply this to e_h. The middle vector PT^(-1)e_(d-h) is supported on indices0,...,h. The actual reflected inverse kernel gives kappa (T^(-1))_(d-r,d-h) =nu_h^(-1)nu_(h-r)(-q)^(-(h-r))[h choose r]_Q. This proves (3)'s first equality. The Frobenius identity phi(mathscrR(f)g)=phi(f mathscrR(g)) then proves its second. It is a full operator/source calculation, not a claim about eigenlines. In particular (v_m)_0=kappa^(m+1)phi(R^(1-m)), (v_m)_d=kappa^m phi(R^(-m)). (4) For fixed endpoint rank h, all sums in(2)--(3) have at most h+1 terms, with explicit coefficients. There is no inverse Clebsch minor. ## 2.
