Therefore ALL main cusps remain parabolic, including when the changed pairing joins many old main components into one knot component. ## 5. Exact primitive auxiliary meridians and longitude Define rho=Z/(1+E-Z), Q=(E-Z)/(Z-1). (14) The common longitude is the actual disk path W2^-1 W0. In the selected flag-at-infinity coordinate its multiplier is Q^2. The pure meridian is S^-1, with multiplier rho. At the two half-twist markings the primitive collar paths are mu_geometric,+ = A^-1 W0, mu_geometric,- = W0^-1 B. Direct differentiation at the finite flag Z, taking the reciprocal to get the flag-at-infinity multiplier, gives respectively exp(U_plus)=rho Q, exp(U_minus)=rho/Q, exp(V)=Q^2. (15) These paths reduce at completeness to the primitive translations -2 and 2E, while the disk longitude translates by -2(E+1). Their primitivity and sign were independently checked on the two-rectangle cusp lattice. Thus (15) retains the original integral collar paths; it is not an arbitrary choice of eigenvalue square root. The physical coupon R^-1 uses the geometric positive-diagonal meridian, and R uses the negative-diagonal meridian. This local sign can be checked against the literal threading and Hurwitz convention, without identifying a meridian from a Hessian. Write P for its actual disk-product SL(2) matrix. At the complete negative coupon, the source-selected regular local calculation gives C=I-(P+I)/(1+E), Tr P=-2. (16) Here C is the actual auxiliary meridian from the typed loop [2,1,1,2] followed by R^-1; the preferred PSL longitude is -P. Consequently its complete translation ratio is lambda/mu=1+E, exactly the positive-diagonal primitive path above. Formula (16) and its actual word meaning are proved by the explicit local threading calculation in [the regular character lift](actual_pretzel_mixed_regular_character_lift.md), sections 4--5. They concern one coupon and do not use a cyclic global pretzel gluing. Reversing the retained half twist changes the meridian by one disk longitude, giving the other path. There is also a direct algebraic check against the finite source: eliminating Z from (9) and rho Q=H^-1 gives exactly (6), with its selected complete branch. Thus the actual primitive meridian and the selected physical-color variable agree, beyond the complete translation calibration. Using (10),(14), rho=exp(-2pi i t), Q=exp(-v). Hence for the physical epsilon convention, with all small logs continued from zero, U= -2pi i t-epsilon*V/2 =-2pi i[t-epsilon*v/(2pi i)]=-2pi i chi, V=-2v=-2 partial_chi f_epsilon. (17) Equations (15)--(17) are exact on the connected local branch. In particular the framing correction is a HALF-longitude shear between different cusp lattices, not an assertion that lambda/2 itself is a primitive loop in either lattice. The actual integral paths were fixed before writing their logarithms. ## 6. The full source primitive, regulator and filling equation The envelope rule in the stationary wires now gives (1) for every auxiliary component of the whole source. Unfilled auxiliary colors have chi_i=0. Separate evenness then gives V_i=0 as well, so they remain parabolic. All main components were treated in section 4. Put G=2pi i phi, retaining the known real Cartan/framing constant. Then dG=(1/2)sum_i V_i dU_i. (18) Locally the change in the leaf primitive is explicitly G_epsilon=G_pure-epsilon*V^2/8. (19) Its derivative is exactly the shear U_new=U_pure-epsilon V/2. Thus the quadratic framing term required by the odd cusp is PRESENT in the selected action, rather than appended after a volume comparison. The original SL(2) pivot spin is retained when taking eigenlogs; (1),(17) use centered PSL(2) similarity multipliers, the squares of those eigenvalues, as in the general transfer theorem. At the complete point Im G(0)=2pi phi(0) is the ACTUAL half-twist partner volume by the complete geometry theorem. The same oriented fundamental-chain boundary calculation therefore gives the absolute regulator identity Vol(rho_chi)=Im G-(1/2)sum_i Re U_i Im V_i. (20) This uses the actual nearby representation just constructed, its primitive markings, and its complete geometric anchor. It does not compare unrelated Bloch cycles by equal regulators. For independently sufficiently long fixed signed integral full twists on any chosen auxiliary subset, the original transfer saddle phi_i(chi)+(pi i/p_i)(chi_i-1)=0 is precisely U_i+p_i V_i=-2pi i. The unfilled peripheral groups remain parabolic. The general geometric completion theorem therefore makes this actual nearby representation the smooth complete hyperbolic holonomy of the correctly marked filled topology. At its saddle, (20) equals 2pi Re[phi(chi)+(pi i/2)sum_i(chi_i-1)^2/p_i]. (21) This completion uses the ACTUAL ODD-LINK primitive basis. In the hidden pure variables its equation reads U_pure+(p_i-epsilon_i/2)V=-2pi i. Multiplying it by two would give the pure-link primitive pair (2,2p_i-epsilon_i) with right-hand side -4pi i, not the smooth primitive 2pi equation. Consequently the half-integer shear must not be replaced by an assertion about ordinary rational Dehn filling of the pure partner. It relates local marked representation branches of different face-paired topologies. Whenever the separately proved odd-source whole-color gap and exact complex packet supply the analytic transfer hypotheses, (21) is therefore the FULL ORIGINAL invariant's actual filled hyperbolic volume limit. For retained C(FG) these are the current source inputs; the stronger all-color theorem does not include the small C(h^3) exception merely because the geometric construction also works there. Finally choose one of the constructive one-main-component patterns from the complete half-partner theorem and fill all auxiliary circles. The resulting topology is a KNOT for every integral full-twist tuple. Thus, with the stated original-source inputs, this geometry applies to arbitrarily branching long-filled knot families, rather than only links or a fixed-width twist/pretzel subclass. Audit: [generic odd transport, actual peripheral flags and selected-source shear](../experiments/audit_actual_odd_conway_marked_peripheral_deformation.py) and [results](../experiments/actual_odd_conway_marked_peripheral_deformation_results.json). PASS for the three odd edge words over Q(E,R), both peripheral commutators, all apex and primitive multiplier formulas, the actual meridian/source resultants at both signs, and the exact implicit generating-function derivatives. No complete-R specialization or numerical phase samples are used. Independent internal reviews: the root agent read the full argument and replayed the exact audit with PASS, including the selected-source phase, bounded frames and actual collar sign. The coherent-source agent separately reviewed the full topology/peripheral construction, primitive threading calibration, implicit shear, absolute anchor and smooth-completion scope, and independently replayed the audit with PASS. Neither review substitutes a pure-link rational filling for the actual odd-link primitive equation. The local-cell/source agent independently checked the entire marked argument and replayed its audit with PASS, including Y=E in the original typed R^-1 sign calibration and the endpoint constant in the selected-source action comparison.

title: Odd half twists in the full Conway Newton source
text: # Odd half twists in the full Conway Newton source 29 October 2026. A literal half twist has an explicit triangular transport matrix in the FULL Newton algebra. It yields a new uniform Newton-coordinate bound for every auxiliary-color alias. At complete colors, the already selected local coherent coefficient and a concave global envelope prove the original-source asymptotic for arbitrary fixed half-twist patterns in every retained robust Conway factor. This note concerns exact transport and complete colors. The later [supporting-plane theorem](actual_odd_conway_uniform_mixed_source_gap.md) supplies the whole mixed-color gap for C(FG), with both children robust; it excludes C(A). Neither result by itself supplies a long-filling theorem. The changed source is not obtained by dropping phases from the positive source. ## 1. Exact full-algebra half-twist transport Use the original pair algebra H_N, actual turn T, crossing R, and Newton basis Bhat_v of the [pure auxiliary-color theorem](actual_pure_conway_auxiliary_color_leaf.md). Put D=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), x=q^D=-q^-1, kappa=q^(D^2/2), with its original unreset half-Cartan mark. For epsilon=+1 or -1 define T_epsilon(f)=T(R^epsilon T(f)). Then, for EVERY 0<=v<=D, exactly in the full repeated-root algebra, T_epsilon(Bhat_v) =kappa^epsilon (-1)^v sum_(r=0)^v q^[epsilon v(r+1)] [v choose r]_q Bhat_r, [v choose r]_q=s_v/[s_r s_(v-r)]>0. (1) In particular the actual odd leaf is h_j^epsilon=T(R^epsilon L_j)=T_epsilon(h_j). (2) Proof. The literal continuant source identity gives T_-(Bhat_v)=kappa^-1 f_v. One can also obtain it by comparing the FULL two-band formula for every actual L_j with the pure-color formula: the L_j form a basis, so this comparison proves the linear identity on the entire algebra, not only its values at the nodes. The independently proved finite continuant expansion is f_v=x^v sum_(r=0)^v (Q^-v;Q)_r Q^r P_r/F_r^3, P_r=q^(r^2) B_r, F_r=(Q;Q)_r, Q=q^2. Insert s_r^2=(-1)^r q^[-r(r+1)]F_r^2 and (Q^-v;Q)_r=(-1)^r Q^[-vr+r(r-1)/2]F_v/F_(v-r). The coefficient of Bhat_r becomes x^v q^[r^2-2vr] {v choose r}_Q =(-1)^v q^[-v(r+1)] [v choose r]_q. This proves (1) for epsilon=-1, including v>D/2 and every normal coordinate. The actual inverse crossings are coefficient-conjugate polynomials in the real Newton basis: their nodal values are reciprocal unit phases and their first logarithmic derivatives are purely imaginary. Uniqueness of Hermite interpolation proves the full polynomial identity. The turn reverses this real basis, so it commutes with coefficient conjugation. Conjugating the preceding formula proves (1) for epsilon=+1. No Hermitian positivity is being asserted. ## 2. A uniform full-Newton bound for the actual color alias Write the exact pure split h_j=C_j+A_j. Every A_j has support v>=ceil(N/2), and each of its coefficients has modulus at most N/2. More precisely its support is v>=N-h for a low complementary color 1<=h<=floor(N/2). The actual half-twist alias is T_epsilon(A_j). Equation (1) gives the exact coefficientwise upper bound |[Bhat_r]T_epsilon(A_j)| <=(N/2) sum_(v=max(r,N-h))^D s_v/[s_r s_(v-r)]. (3) Let J(t)=integral_0^t log(2sin(pi u))du. The endpoint-uniform factorial estimate then gives, uniformly over ALL physical colors and all Newton indices, |[Bhat_r]T_epsilon(A_j)| <=poly(N) exp[N k(r/N)], k(u)=-2J(u/2), 0<=u<=1. (4) Here and below a zero coefficient causes no difficulty. Indeed the largest possible exponent in (3), after relaxing its lower bound to v/N>=max(u,1/2), is max_(w>=max(u,1/2)) [J(w)-J(u)-J(w-u)]. Its derivative in w is log[sin(pi w)/sin(pi(w-u))]. The maximum is at w=(1+u)/2. Reflection J(1-a)=-J(a), followed by duplication J(2a)=2J(a)-2J(1/2-a), reduces its value to -2J(u/2). The argument includes u=0,1 by continuity; the exact factorial errors are O(log N) uniformly there. The maximum of k is at u=1/3 and equals v_3/pi, where v_3 is the regular ideal tetrahedron volume. On u>=1/2 it is strictly decreasing, since k'(u)=-log(2sin(pi u/2))<0. In particular k(1/2)=-2J(1/4). This is a coordinate bound for the original normal source, so it may be propagated through the positive Newton product and the actual index-reversing turn. It is not a bound in a nodal quotient or an unspecified operator norm. There is a useful exact small-color estimate as well. Set v=N-t. Root factorial reflection gives [N-t choose r]_q=[t+r-1 choose t-1]_q <=binomial(t+r-1,t-1) <=binomial(N-1,t-1). (5) The middle inequality follows from the nonnegative coefficients of the ordinary Gaussian polynomial at a unit root. Thus for 1<=h<=floor(N/2), every alias coefficient is at most (Nh/2) binomial(N-1,h-1). (6) In a corridor h<=delta N, delta<1/2, this costs at most poly(N) exp[N H(delta)], where H(delta)=-delta log delta-(1-delta)log(1-delta)->0. For h=1 each transport coefficient actually has modulus one: [D choose r]_q=1. Thus an alias can occupy ALL Newton coordinates, including their normals; it is no longer square-zero under products. A sharper color-dependent envelope is obtained by keeping chi=h/N in (3): it is k_chi(u)=J(u+chi)-J(u)-J(chi), u<=1-2chi, k_chi(u)=-2J(u/2), u>=1-2chi. (7) These expressions agree at the joining point. This is an upper envelope, not an assertion that the signed alias attains it. ## 3. Complete odd coefficients: the exact selected source At j=N there is no alias. The old finite original-source transform gives, with M=floor(D/2), h_N^-=exp(-i pi D/4) sum_(r=0)^M a_(N,r) W_(N,r) Bhat_r, a_(N,r)=N^2 s_(2r)/s_r^4. (8) For reference W is fixed by the literal finite sums, not chosen as a formal recurrence solution: A_r=sum_(v=r)^M Q^(-vr) F_(2v)/(F_v^3 F_(v-r)), D_r=Q^(-r^2)F_(2r)/F_r^3, W_(N,r)=kappa^-1 exp(i pi D/4) (A_r/D_r)/[(-1)^r q^(r(r+1))]. The [selected high-index theorem](actual_pretzel_coherent_inner_gauss_elimination.md) proves, uniformly on compact subintervals 1/4<u<1/2, W_(N,r)=sqrt(sin(pi u))exp(i pi u/2)[1+O(N^-1)], u=r/N. (9) The [actual quarter-transition theorem](actual_complete_circle_boundary_packet.md) extends this same nonzero selected expression to a fixed neighborhood of u=1/4. Its exponentially accurate source transport includes the initial second channel and all coupling errors. Distinct recurrence roots alone would not justify this extension. At ALL indices the [two-branch source bound](actual_pretzel_all_index_backward_envelope.md) gives |W_(N,r)|<=poly(N)exp[N E(pi r/N)], where E(pi u)=g(1/4)-g(u), 0<=u<=1/4; E(pi u)=0, 1/4<=u<=1/2; g(u)=J(2u)-4J(u). (10) The first identity is exact because g'(u)=2log cot(pi u). Consequently the full coefficient envelope for a complete odd leaf is the CONCAVE function g_tilde(u)=g(max(u,1/4)), 0<=u<=1/2. (11) It is constant below 1/4 and agrees with g above it; its derivatives join at zero. The positive-half-twist formulas are the coefficient conjugates of (8)--(9), with the same envelope. This is a coherent coefficient theorem; termwise absolute values in its original inner factorial sum would give a different bound. ## 4. Arbitrary fixed half-twist patterns at complete colors Fix any retained cylindrical robust factor and independently choose epsilon_l in {0,+1,-1} at each of its individual leaves. Replace its actual h_N leaf by T(R^epsilon_l L_N), leaving every product, turn, mark and external normalization unchanged. Let Z_N^epsilon be this literal raw closed source and Z_N^0 its pure counterpart. Let x_(l,*) be the unique complete positive maximizing leaf labels. The [strict-quarter theorem](actual_conway_strict_leaf_quarter_bound.md) gives x_(l,*)>1/4 for every leaf of every such factor. Then Z_N^epsilon =exp[(i pi D/4)sum_l epsilon_l] a_E(0) N^(3/2) exp[N phi_E(0)] product_(epsilon_l!=0) [sqrt(sin(pi x_(l,*))) exp(-i epsilon_l pi x_(l,*)/2)] *[1+O(N^-1)]. (12) Here a_E(0)>0 and phi_E(0) are the ORIGINAL pure-source normalization and action from the finite Conway packet. The displayed leading coefficient is nonzero. Both parities, every normal direction and every fixed mixture of half-twist signs are included. Proof of the global source claim. Replace g by g_tilde only at the odd-marked leaves in the complete variational action. Each retained product action m is concave, and the support polytope is convex. The resulting majorant action is therefore concave. By the strict quarter theorem it agrees with the pure action on a neighborhood of its strict complete maximizer. That point is still stationary with negative definite Hessian in the free wire coordinates, hence is its unique GLOBAL maximizer. A second maximum would give a constant segment through that strictly concave neighborhood. The complement of any fixed small central window therefore has a strict exponential gap for the majorant. Equations (8),(10), the uniform factorial estimates and the polynomial state count bound the whole original complex sum there, before any cancellation. On the central window every odd coefficient has (9), with its original common phase in (8). The resulting smooth nonzero multiplier of the positive summand is exactly the product in (12), evaluated at the critical point. The already proved lattice Laplace argument, or its real-parameter version with this smooth complex amplitude, proves (12). There is no assumption of positivity of the odd source. Thus its exponential rate is the same complete geometric action 2pi phi_E(0) as the pure factor. Identifying this with the half-twist partner's actual volume also uses its literal shaded-face gluing; volume invariance is not a substitute for the quantum proof above. ## 5. What is still needed for odd-coupon long fillings The mixed half-twist CORE has its [proved uniform envelope g_tilde](actual_pretzel_global_core_spectral_gap.md), including colors outside a fixed corridor, by the actual selected mixed-source recurrence. Its high-index physical-color packet is also known. Equations (3)--(7) bound the changed alias in the correct FULL Newton coordinates. The subsequent [supporting-plane theorem](actual_odd_conway_uniform_mixed_source_gap.md) proves its exponential gap after arbitrary C(FG) composition, with both children robust. The minimal C(A) remains outside that estimate. In particular the alias is not confined to output indices above one half and products containing two aliases no longer vanish. The pure source's square-zero seed argument cannot be reused. The separately proved [complex packet](actual_odd_conway_complex_color_packet.md) and [actual marked deformation](actual_odd_conway_marked_peripheral_deformation.md) now complete the required interfaces for the [long-filled knot and link theorem](actual_odd_conway_long_filling_volume.md). Audit: [full physical transport, alias bounds and complete-source calibration](../experiments/audit_actual_odd_conway_newton_transport.py). Independent internal analytical review by the coherent-current agent checked both full normal transport matrices and their Cartan phases, the global and retained-color alias envelopes, the concave plateau argument, and the nonzero complete-source leading multiplier. A fresh replay passed 108 physical transport columns, 243 marked mixed-sign sources, 27,900 alias checks and 30 finite complete-source diagnostics. The diagnostics are not used to infer any asymptotic theorem. Primary-agent analytical review and fresh audit replay also passed. The full-algebra transport, signed phase, uniform alias envelope and nonzero complete multiplier were checked independently of the finite rate diagnostics.

title: A whole mixed-color gap for arbitrary robust odd-coupon Conway factors
text: # A whole mixed-color gap for arbitrary robust odd-coupon Conway factors 29 October 2026. For every retained C(FG), with F and G robust, arbitrary fixed pure or signed odd-half-twist coupons have a uniform gap for ALL actual alias sectors and for the entire physical color complement. The estimate permits arbitrarily many aliases and arbitrary fixed turns and branching. It uses supporting planes of the actual concave source action, with the full Newton alias profile. The minimal retained factor C(A), A=h^3, is EXCLUDED from this theorem. Its complete odd-coupon asymptotic is already proved, but the stronger leaf bound used here does not hold for it. No claim for its whole mixed-color source follows by ignoring that exception. ## 1. Exact changed source and statement Fix a literal C(FG) and a choice epsilon_l in {0,+1,-1} at each individual leaf. The actual mixed leaf is h_j^epsilon=T(R^epsilon L_j), 1<=j<=N. All turns, products, pivots and the original marked cylindrical closure are unchanged. Write its exact full-algebra decomposition as C_j^epsilon+A_j^epsilon, obtained by applying the half-twist transport to the pure core and alias separately. At epsilon=0 this is the pure split. Let Z_N(j) be the original closed source and Z_N^core(j) the circuit using only the C_j^epsilon. Let F0 be the complete PURE maximizing action. The [complete odd-source theorem](actual_odd_conway_newton_transport.md) already proves the nonzero complete asymptotic with this same F0. There is gamma>0 such that, uniformly over the ENTIRE physical color cube, for all sufficiently large N, |Z_N(j)-Z_N^core(j)| <= exp[N(F0-gamma)]. (1) For every fixed sufficiently small delta>0 there is gamma_delta>0 such that max_(some N-j_l>=delta N) |Z_N(j)| <=exp[N(F0-gamma_delta)]. (2) Both parities and composite levels are included. The expression, coupon signs and delta are fixed before N tends to infinity. These are whole original-source bounds, including all normal coordinates; no semisimple quotient or positive-matrix replacement is used. ## 2. A stricter leaf interval for every C(FG) Use the port variables of the [strict-quarter theorem](actual_conway_strict_leaf_quarter_bound.md). At every proper robust macro-port of this CLOSED factor, they obey 0<X<1, 0<Y<1. At a proper seed A=h^3 its three leaf cotangents all equal X, and its port invariant is Y=1/(4X^2-1). Therefore Y<1 gives 1/sqrt(2)<X<1, 1/4<a_l< a0:=atan(sqrt(2))/pi <1/3 (3) for EVERY complete maximizing leaf label a_l. This is why both root children must be robust: C(A) instead has X=1/2 and its leaves lie at atan(2)/pi, outside (3). ## 3. One supporting plane dominates an alias at every output Put g(a)=J(2a)-4J(a), k(u)=-2J(u/2), 0<=u<=1, J(u)=integral_0^u log(2sin(pi t))dt. The new full-Newton transport theorem gives the global alias rate k. For every a in [1/4,a0] its tangent to g satisfies the UNIFORM strict inequality k(u) <= g(a)+g'(a)(u-a)-c0 for all 0<=u<=1, (4) c0=g(1/4)-(3/4)log2=2Catalan/pi-(3/4)log2>0. Here is a direct proof, including both ends of the output interval. Write s=g'(a)=2log cot(pi a), so -log2<=s<=0. The function k is strictly concave in the interior, with k'(u)=-log(2sin(pi u/2)). Its slope decreases from +infinity to -log2. The maximizer u(a) of k(u)-su lies in [1/3,1], and is characterized by k'(u)=s, with u=1 at s=-log2. The minimum tangent gap is I(a)=g(a)+s(u(a)-a)-k(u(a)). On the interior, I'(a)=g''(a)(u(a)-a)<0, since u(a)>=1/3>a. Continuity extends this monotonicity to the endpoints. Thus I(a)>=I(a0)=g(a0)-(1-a0)log2. Since g' decreases from zero to -log2 on [1/4,a0], integration gives g(a0)>=g(1/4)-(a0-1/4)log2. This proves (4). For an explicit elementary positive certificate, the alternating Catalan series gives Catalan>1-1/9=8/9. Using pi<22/7 and log2<7/10, c0>56/99-21/40=161/3960>0. (5) No numerical optimizer or special-function decimal is needed to establish the margin. ## 4. Sum the source supporting planes before estimating states For an odd coupon its all-color core has the uniform upper rate g_tilde(u)=g(max(u,1/4)), 0<=u<=1/2, (6) by the [actual mixed-source recurrence](actual_pretzel_global_core_spectral_gap.md). In that recurrence's normalization, the modulus of the actual Newton core coefficient is exactly N^2 s_(2r)/s_r^4 * |V_(h,r)|. Its complete factorial rate is g, so the recurrence bound adds E and g+E is precisely g_tilde. No coefficientwise domination is inferred by applying an oscillatory transform to the pure core inequality. The error beyond this rate is uniformly o(N), including all colors and both index endpoints. A pure core has rate at most g(u), hence also at most g_tilde(u). At a complete maximizing leaf a_l in (3), concavity gives g_tilde(u)<=g(a_l)+g'(a_l)(u-a_l). (7) For every alias, the [full Newton transport bound](actual_odd_conway_newton_transport.md) gives rate at most k(u) on its ENTIRE range 0<=u<=1, so (4) applies. A pure alias has polynomial coefficients and rate zero; it obeys the same upper bound because k(u)>=0 on [0,1]. Every actual positive Newton multiplication has action m on max(x,y)<=z<=x+y<=1. This domain is convex, m is concave, and at its complete strict state w_* its tangent gives m(w)<=m(w_*)+grad m(w_*) dot(w-w_*). (8) Expand the exact original source according to its alias subset S. Its state support may allow alias leaf outputs above one half, but every product still lies in the SAME domain in (8). The actual turn equations and final closing input relation are the same affine relations as before. Thus one may add (4),(7),(8) for any one of these expanded states, even when it lies outside the pure-leaf polytope. All linear terms cancel by stationarity of the ORIGINAL pure action in its free wire coordinates. The resulting upper rate is F0-|S|c0. (9) This is the essential reason the argument handles multiple aliases. No assertion that their products vanish is made; indeed those products generally do not vanish after an odd half twist. At finite N use the actual scaled wire labels r/N, which remain in the domains of all the supporting inequalities. Their turn and closing equations have right-hand side 1-1/N. Thus the cancellation of the fixed tangent linear terms has only O(1/N) error; multiplying by N costs O(1). The endpoint-uniform factorial errors cost O(log N). The fixed tree has only polynomially many Newton states and finitely many alias subsets. Their uniformly subexponential coefficient factors can therefore be absorbed into half the fixed margin in (9). Summing all nonempty S proves (1). ## 5. The complete physical color complement Replace g by g_tilde at all leaves to get a convenient common majorant for the all-core circuit. It is concave and agrees with the pure action near its strict complete optimizer, by (3). Consequently that optimizer is its unique global maximum with value F0. Outside a small fixed neighborhood W of that state the majorant has a strict compactness gap, uniformly over all colors. The finite physical supports have the same inequalities and affine relations with O(1/N) shifts. Every convergent sequence of finite states therefore limits to the stated compact support. The same outside-W gap, slightly reduced, holds for all sufficiently large N. Choose beta<1/2 larger than every leaf coordinate throughout W. For an odd coupon, the actual mixed-source theorem gives, uniformly for delta N<=h<=floor((N-1)/2) and r<=beta N, log|core_coefficient_(N,h,r)| <=N[g_tilde(r/N)-gamma(delta,beta)+o(1)], (10) where gamma(delta,beta)>0. It retains the actual terminal source, both recurrence branches, and repeated-root endpoint colors. For a pure coupon the exact factorial formula gives the analogous strict loss from g_chi(u)=g(u)-[J(u-chi)+J(u+chi)-2J(u)], chi=h/N>=delta, uniformly near its interior complete coordinate; if h>r its coefficient is zero. A physical color j<=floor(N/2) has zero core and needs no further core estimate. If some deficit is at least delta N, every all-core state either lies outside W and loses the majorant gap, or lies inside W and loses the positive amount in (10) at that leaf. Uniformity and the polynomial state count prove a strict whole-core complement gap. Combine it with (1) to obtain (2). ## 6. Scope of the advance This proves the full physical color-gap hypothesis needed for long-filling transfer for arbitrary fixed coupon patterns on C(FG). The complete signed source is already nonzero by its separately proved local coherent amplitude and global plateau bound. The [exact finite analytic packet](actual_odd_conway_complex_color_packet.md) for these CHANGED mixed coupons and the [marked odd deformation](actual_odd_conway_marked_peripheral_deformation.md) are proved separately. Literal connectivity is supplied by the [half-partner theorem](actual_conway_half_twist_partner_geometry.md). Together they give the [long-filled knot and link equality](actual_odd_conway_long_filling_volume.md). None of these interfaces is obtained by substituting the unchanged pure colored packet for the actual odd source. Audit: [exact port, tangent and transport certificates](../experiments/audit_actual_odd_conway_uniform_mixed_source_gap.py). The all-expression proof is the supporting-plane argument above, not an extrapolation from finitely sampled source values. Independent analytical review checked the actual all-color Ward recurrence and terminal value, the spectral ellipse including Jordan collisions, the fixed-block product estimate, the stricter proper-seed interval, and the supporting-plane argument on expanded alias support. Fresh replays of the gap certificate, old mixed-core audit and full Newton transport audit passed. The primary-agent review also checked the tangent-gap derivative, its exact positive lower bound, and the finite affine shifts. This review does not supply the separately required changed complex packet or marked geometric deformation.

title: The marked logarithmic class of the source-preserving odd form
status: Marked logarithmic periods and the finite-q integer noncancellation criterion
text: # The marked logarithmic class of the source-preserving odd form 30 October 2026. Independently reviewed and frozen. The underlying odd framing form is the pullback of an explicit integral logarithmic class. Keeping q0 gives a stronger two-integer noncancellation criterion. Neither calculation assigns those integers to the original quantum cycle or removes its coherent base weight. ## 1. The actual marked functions Use the fixed original cut and the ACTUAL routed first head of [the source-preserving odd-period theorem](actual_source_preserving_odd_framing_period.md). The recorded route and its inverse remain in the source. In its complete parabolic frame write F(r,s)=[[r,1-r],[s,-s]], A=(1+s)^-1, mu_e=I+c[[b,-b^2],[1,-b]], c!=0, R=r-sb, p_e=(R-1)/R, k-1=(c/s)R(1-R), q0=exp(pi i/N), N>=2. (1) Here mu_e is the actual Hurwitz-transformed meridian, not the unrouted edge meridian. The constant c is nonzero exactly when this routed first-head position detects the residual framing. The underlying original marked density is Omega_src=(c_D/s)dr wedge dLog A, c_D!=0, independent of r,s. (2) Work on its regular framed locus where s!=0,-1 and R!=0,1, with any additional source divisors also removed. Define the units f=1-A=s/(1+s), g_0=R, g_1=R-1, Psi=(f,k-1): framed locus -> (C*)^2. (3) These are algebraic functions of the ACTUAL marked physical clocks and relative wave momentum. For example R=1/(1-p_e). They do not depend on logarithm branches or on reparametrizing the same framed point. They do depend on the chosen cut, route and orientations; changing those data is an actual source adapter, not an invariance assertion about (3). The principal odd form computed from the literal two bands is (p_e^-1-p_e)Omega_src =c_D ds wedge d(k-1)/[(1+s)s(k-1)] =c_D dlog f wedge dlog(k-1). (4) Thus (4) is precisely the pullback of dlog z1 wedge dlog z2 through Psi, with its original nonzero scalar and orientation. This is a logarithmic class on the FRAMING orbit. It is not a Bloch regulator, and it must not be substituted for the separately proved Bloch-regulator value of the actual three-manifold. ## 2. Closed-cycle pairing, proved directly Let Gamma be a compact closed oriented two-cycle in the displayed regular locus, or a finite sum of smooth such cycles. For two nonvanishing functions u,v there, write dlog u=dlog|u|+i alpha_u, where alpha_u is the globally defined closed argument one-form. Every term of dlog u wedge dlog v containing a modulus derivative is exact: log|u| and log|v| are single-valued real functions, and the argument one-forms are closed. Its closed-cycle integral is therefore -integral_Gamma alpha_u wedge alpha_v. The map (u/|u|,v/|v|):Gamma->S1 x S1 has an integer degree n. One elementary description is the signed number of inverse images of a regular point after subdividing the cycle. Local change of variables and cancellation along paired subdivision edges give integral_Gamma alpha_u wedge alpha_v=(2pi)^2 n. Consequently integral_Gamma dlog u wedge dlog v=(2pi i)^2 n. (5) The same argument extends additively to integral cycles. In particular the period of (4) is (2pi i)^2 c_D deg(arg Psi). This proves the normalization without selecting a geometric cycle or citing a cohomological comparison theorem. For an unramified finite cover of degree d over such a cycle, its FULL transferred cycle pairs with the pulled-back form as d times the original period. This follows by summing the local sheets in the integral. A zero pairing therefore stays zero under transfer. One selected lift instead requires its actual descent and multiplicity; the covering map alone does not select an original nonzero period. This statement concerns the specified transported source cycle, not an assertion about character polynomials of arbitrary manifold covers. ## 3. The retained q0 detects two integer classes Keep the actual finite quantum coefficient in the UNDERLYING rational symbol form, and put Omega_q=(p_e^-1-q0 p_e)Omega_src, lambda=(r/s)dlog A. Since d lambda=Omega_src/c_D and dR=dr-b ds, direct substitution of p_e gives the exact identity Omega_q=(1-q0)c_D d lambda +c_D dlog f wedge [dlog g_1+q0 dlog g_0]. (6) No primitive is dropped on a relative chain. On a CLOSED Gamma, however, the first term integrates to zero. Define the two integers n_j=(2pi i)^-2 integral_Gamma dlog f wedge dlog g_j. Then integral_Gamma Omega_q=(2pi i)^2 c_D(n_1+q0 n_0). (7) The argument of q0 lies strictly between zero and pi. Thus (7) vanishes if and only if n_0=n_1=0. More quantitatively, for a nonzero integer pair, |n_1+q0 n_0|>=sin(pi/N)>=2/N. (8) If n_0!=0 use its imaginary part; otherwise |n_1|>=1. The last bound follows from concavity of sine on [0,pi/2]. This covers both parities and all N>=2. No restriction on the relative sizes or signs of the two integers is needed. At q0=1 the two classes combine: because k-1=-c g_0 g_1/s and dlog f wedge dlog s=0, deg(arg Psi)=n_0+n_1. The finite-q criterion is strictly sharper: opposite nonzero integers may have zero classical total degree, while (7) is still nonzero with only polynomial loss. This remains a criterion for the stated rational SYMBOL form, not an assertion that a finite quantum packet has already been replaced by it. ## 4. The original source still requires relative transport The odd-period theorem proves the unchanged scalar exactly as Tr(e_t C0(T1-q0T_-1))/kappa_N(t). The original scalar density (2) contains a marked row 1/N; this new source has the additional base weight N beta_a(t)/kappa_N(t), with its original finite head sum. It cannot be absorbed into c_D as A varies. A legitimate first-cut Gaussian retains its own nonzero factor; an arbitrary replacement by a closed two-cycle with constant weight is not licensed by (5). Likewise the explicit nonzero finite sample of the fiber residue in that theorem is only a sample of the underlying form. It does not show that the actual quantum period has degree (n_0,n_1). There is a useful CONDITIONAL sampling corollary. Suppose a specified closed cycle on EVERY canonical first-head fiber has the SAME integer winding pair (m_0,m_1) about R=0,1. Its underlying fiber period is 2pi i c_D(m_1+q0 m_0)/s_a, where A_a=q0 Q0^a and s_a=A_a^-1-1. Keeping the original coherent sample and its normalization gives exactly 2pi i c_D(m_1+q0 m_0) G_N(t)/kappa_N(t), G_N(t)=sum_a beta_a(t)/s_a. (8a) For real t, Re G_N=-1/2; on any fixed interior real t compact, |kappa_N|<=C/N. Thus a nonzero common pair gives a lower bound c|c_D| in (8a), even if m_1=-m_0!=0. This is algebra of the SPECIFIED underlying cycles; their realization by the quantum source is not proved. A restricted window is not covered without an explicit bound for its weighted remainder: a small binomial tail alone does not bound unspecified winding integers on the discarded fibers. Uniform matching is also separate: at r=N rho, the actual q-retained symbol has size N^-1, and separate O(N^-1) errors in the two quantum bands do not determine their normalized difference. For a relative chain, (6) retains the boundary term (1-q0)c_D integral_(boundary Gamma) lambda. Its argument integrals need not be integers. Every source-divisor tube, the primitive cotangent measure, the finite-head carries and the retained Poisson characters must be transported with that chain. The [H-period theorem](actual_root_channel_H_period_transport.md) gives explicit corrections for the two normal insertions; it does not provide the missing geometric pushforward or its ends. There is no known identification of those integers with the original physical head cycle. If Psi and g_0,g_1 extend as nonvanishing functions over a particular small head polydisk, its local torus has zero degree by contraction within that disk. This observation has that EXPLICIT regular-extension hypothesis; it says nothing about integer nodes where source or geometric divisors degenerate. An N-head carry fixes the physical clocks, so it does not by itself assign degree one. Nonzero winding can only be asserted after the actual pushforward and its relative end/divisor terms have been computed. Thus the new checkable criterion is precise: for an explicitly constructed CLOSED underlying framed cycle, a nonzero pair (n_0,n_1) prevents cancellation in (7). For the original invariant one must additionally justify its weighted quantum realization. ## 5. Class-wide geometric and long-twist quantifiers Fix k>=2 and a finite ordered 2k-plat skeleton D, with every crossing in a designated two-strand box, actual cups/caps, cut, primitive crossing-disk markings, and fixed half twists epsilon_i in {0,+1,-1}. Combine adjacent powers of the same generator before treating their full twists as independent. The outside terminal matching together with the parity restoration must be one cycle. This finite test ensures that all exponents epsilon_i-2p_i give knots; full twists do not change connectivity. Here k is a presentation width, not a claim of minimal bridge number. For geometry alone, the least restrictive proved sufficient input is an [actual positive marked gluing certificate](general_marked_positive_gluing_certificate.md): the correct labeled manifold quotient, torus links, positive shapes, complex edge equations and complete primitive peripheral equations. It proves the complete metric and volume of the actual marked exterior. The current common boundary-chart route uses the STRONGER labeled right-angled certificate of the [matching-graph theorem](general_augmented_plat_matching_geometry.md). Its ideal vertices and supporting Lorentz normals have the original medial incidence, strict nonincident inequalities, and orthogonal adjacent face normals. The actual white-reflection prefixes and signed shaded pairings are retained. These are finite algebraic equalities/strict inequalities on supplied exact data. The certificate constructs a positive marked triangulation; the reverse implication has not been proved. There is no restriction to a Conway tree or to one fixed width, but existence of such data for EVERY essential hyperbolic augmented plat is not asserted. No EXTRA noncommuting-route hypothesis is needed in that class. At an actual complete box Tr A=Tr B=Tr BA=-2, so its punctures cannot all preserve the reference cusp flag. The literal Hurwitz routes and induction in the odd-period theorem therefore supply a fixed routed first head with c!=0. Its exact source-preserving odd observable, nonzero kappa_N, and the nontrivial forms (4),(6) are now proved at arbitrary fixed width. This removes the old need to POSTULATE an orientation-sensitive observable representing the same scalar. It removes none of the original global-cycle or mixed-color asymptotic hypotheses. The [geometric filling corollary](general_augmented_plat_long_filling_quantifiers.md) already supplies T_geom(D) for all independently long signed fillings, and all partial subsets, under the positive marked certificate. The full conjecture remains: for every fixed essential hyperbolic augmented D as above, there exists T(D) such that for EVERY FIXED integer vector p with all |p_i|>T(D), lim_(N->infinity) (2pi/N)log|K_N(K_D(p))| =Vol(S3 minus K_D(p)). (9) The broad conjecture assumes hyperbolicity of the actual augmented exterior; it is not restricted to diagrams already carrying our right-angled certificate. The present boundary construction applies to the certified subclass and does not prove that certificate exists for every diagram in the conjecture. Both level parities and composite levels are included. Signs and relative slope magnitudes are unrestricted. The slopes are fixed BEFORE N tends to infinity; thresholds may depend on the entire D, not just k. No uniform statement for p=p(N) follows. The existing [source-to-filling theorem](general_original_source_long_filling_transfer.md) proves (9) CONDITIONALLY on the original uniform complex external-color packet, its nonzero contracted amplitude, full alias/normal/color gap, and actual marked geometric action selection. A unit amplitude, or a controlled coordinate monomial times a unit, gives every long tuple. A merely nonzero germ permits an exceptional analytic divisor, as the [source-divisor theorem](general_long_filling_source_divisor.md) states. The internal Casimir deficits N-1-2a_i controlled by the boundary envelope are not the external filling-color defects N-j_i. The new logarithmic integer criterion isolates a concrete part of the needed cycle calculation; it is not a replacement for that packet or its global complementary-color estimate. This elementary note has no separate numerical audit. Its identities follow by the displayed changes of variables, Stokes argument and integer-degree calculation; the finite source and routed geometry are audited in the cited odd-period theorem. Independent source-agent full analytical review: PASS. The reader checked the marked map, exact primitive and wedge signs, closed-cycle degree normalization, both finite-q integer classes and their bound, cover transfer multiplicity, retained relative term and coherent base weight, common-pair sampling with its window limitation, and the class-wide geometric/quantum quantifiers. No original geometric winding or mixed-color packet is supplied by this review. Primary-agent full analytical review: PASS. The reader independently checked the exact-term sign, integral-degree normalization, finite-q lower bound, common-pair normalized sample, cover transfer and all fixed-diagram/fixed-slope quantifiers. The logarithmic criterion remains separate from the actual weighted quantum cycle and the three-manifold regulator. No additional numerical audit is required for this elementary derivation from the already audited source and geometry identities.

title: The original odd pretzel and its complete mixed-circle transfer source
text: # The original odd pretzel and its complete mixed-circle transfer source 29 October 2026. The literal original turns and disjoint twist boxes give an exact cyclic transfer formula for EVERY odd number of odd pretzel boxes. It keeps one unwrapped integer charge, the entire marked row and all original crossing-circle normal channels. It is not a replacement by a Jones polynomial, a TV state, or an AK integral. The formula is a concrete source for the arbitrary-region augmented pretzel survival question. Its complete-color base does not become entrywise positive by a diagonal phase gauge, even after retaining the half twists. A positive reflected network or an original relative-cycle calculation still needs proof. ## 1. Diagram, signs and literal original source Use \(N\geq2,d=N-1,q=e^{\pi i/N},Q=q^2,x=q^d\). Label \(2s\) vertical heads from left to right. Box \(i\) acts on heads \((2i-1,2i)\). At BOTH ends the planar matching is \[ (1,2s),(2,3),(4,5),\ldots,(2s-2,2s-1). \tag{1} \] The outer bottom turn is the original \(p_{a_1,b_s}\); the other bottom turns are \(p_{b_i,a_{i+1}}\). At the top the inner turns are \(\ell_{d_i,c_{i+1}}\), and the outer turn is the sole original marked row \(m_{c_1,d_s}\). All port orders here are part of the definition, including that of the nested outer turn. The original formulas are \[ p_{uv}=N x^{-v}\mathbf1_{u+v=d},\quad \ell_{uv}=x^u/N\,\mathbf1_{u+v=d},\quad m_{uv}=x^v/N^2. \tag{2} \] In particular \(m\) has NO degree indicator before the contraction. For degree-preserving physical boxes \(B_i\), define the RAW marked source \(\mathcal A_{s,N}(B_1,\ldots,B_s)\) by this tensor diagram. Its original peripheral/framing line \(\chi_N\) remains outside it. For odd box integers \(n_i\), the usual odd pretzel diagram is (1) with \(B_i=R^{-n_i}\), with this explicit crossing convention. Choosing \(R^{n_i}\) instead gives the global mirror. This fixes the sign by the one-crossing boxes: rotating their original cup/cap diagrams and applying the two snake identities concatenates them into the literal central \(s\)-crossing four-plat, with no curl. Thus the all-\(n_i=1\) raw source agrees with the original four-plat \(\sigma_2^s\). This is an equality of the specified tangle sources, not an identification inferred from a colored polynomial. There is one component when \(s\) is odd. Indeed each odd box has the swap permutation of its two endpoints. Following the two planar matchings advances the box index by two modulo \(s\). For odd \(s\) this visits every box; for even \(s\) there are two components. This proof is independent of the odd twist magnitudes and signs. We use only odd \(s\geq3\), so the sole marked source is an admissible original one-component cut. Reduction, hyperbolicity and long filling are further topological hypotheses, not consequences of this source formula. ## 2. Exact unwrapped-charge transfer theorem For \(-d\leq h\leq d\) put \[ I_h=\{\max(0,h),\ldots,\min(d,d+h)\},\quad D_h=\operatorname{diag}_{a\in I_h}x^{2a}, \] \[ M_i^{(h)}[a,a'] =x^{-2a+h} (B_i)_{(a-h,\,d-a'+h);\,(a,\,d-a')}, \qquad a,a'\in I_h. \tag{3} \] These are finite physical matrix entries; no cyclic index is allowed. Then \[ \boxed{\displaystyle \mathcal A_{s,N}(B_1,\ldots,B_s) =\frac{x^{(s-1)d}}N \sum_{h=-d}^d\operatorname{Tr} \bigl(D_hM_1^{(h)}\cdots M_s^{(h)}\bigr).} \tag{4} \] The statement holds for arbitrary degree-preserving boxes on their specified physical pairs, not merely for one eigenchannel or for root-sampled continuations. In particular it includes every actual signed power of \(R\), every literal mixed-color circle, and their products. Proof. Write the inputs of box \(i\) as \((a_i,b_i)\), its outputs as \((c_i,d_i)\). The bottom source forces \(b_i=d-a_{i+1}\), cyclically, where the exceptional outer source has the ordered coefficient \(p_{a_1,b_s}\). The inner caps force \(d_i=d-c_{i+1}\), \(i<s\). The total input degree is \(sd\); each \(B_i\) preserves its actual integer degree. Therefore the remaining outer pair has \(c_1+d_s=d\), including when evaluated against the FULL marked row (2). Only now may that forced equality be used to write \(d_s=d-c_1\). Each box conservation equation is now \[ a_i-a_{i+1}=c_i-c_{i+1}. \] Thus \(h=a_i-c_i\) is a common UNWRAPPED integer, and each \(a_i\) lies exactly in \(I_h\). No mod-\(N\) aliases have been introduced or discarded. The total turn coefficient before using this conservation law is \[ \frac1N x^{(s-1)d+2a_1-\sum_i a_i-\sum_i c_i} =\frac{x^{(s-1)d}}N x^{2a_1} \prod_i x^{-2a_i+h}. \tag{5} \] The \(N^{-1}\) in (5) is exactly \(N^s/N^{s+1}\) from the cups, ordinary caps and single marked cap. Summing the resulting cyclic product gives (4). This proves the literal source normalization; there is no new trace average of size \(N^{s}\) or \(2N\). ## 3. Simultaneous original full-twist filling For \(n_i=2p_i+1\), keep the half twist \(R^{-1}\) and use the already proved ALL-INPUT circle kernel on \(R^{-2p_i}\): \[ R^{-n_i}=\kappa^{-2p_i}\sum_{j=1}^N \beta_{N,-2p_i,j}\,R^{-1}L_j, \qquad\sum_j|\beta_{N,-2p_i,j}|\leq2N(1+|p_i|). \tag{6} \] Every \(L_j\) is the ordinary \(j\)-dimensional mixed auxiliary circle with its original pivot, not an extra complete component identified by a quotient lemma. Define \[ \mathcal A_{s,N}(j_1,\ldots,j_s) =\mathcal A_{s,N}(R^{-1}L_{j_1},\ldots,R^{-1}L_{j_s}). \] Equations (4) and (6) give the exact original pretzel scalar \[ K_N=\chi_N\prod_i\kappa^{-2p_i} \sum_{j_1,\ldots,j_s}\left(\prod_i\beta_{N,-2p_i,j_i}\right) \mathcal A_{s,N}(j_1,\ldots,j_s). \tag{7} \] The \(\chi_N\) here is the ORIGINAL filled pretzel's line. It is not replaced by a guessed normalization or framing of the augmented diagram. For each fixed \(s\) the coefficient mass is at most \(\prod_i2N(1+|p_i|)\). The formula treats arbitrary odd \(s\), so it is not restricted to bounded braid width or one variable slope. Its large-\(N\) constants may depend on the fixed diagram \(s\). ## 4. Exact complete-base channel formula and a positivity test At complete circle colors every box is the SAME \(B_*=R^{-1}L_N\). Hence (4) becomes a sum of weighted powers \(\operatorname{Tr}(D_h(M_*^{(h)})^s)\). The [positive reflected-circle theorem](actual_complete_circle_reflection_positive.md) gives a complete all-degree expansion of \(B_*P\). In a low total degree block \(T\), its coefficients are \[ B_*P=\sum_jh_{T,j}(\kappa\nu_j)^{-1}v_{T,j}v_{T,j}^*, \quad h_{T,j}>0, \tag{8} \] including the odd simple node and every even-level normal channel. Thus the transfer (3) retains the HALF-TWIST phase \((\kappa\nu_j)^{-1}\); it is not the plain PSD matrix \(L_NP\). Its two physical ports can belong to different total degrees \(T=d+a-a'\). A partial transpose or reshuffling of the PSD matrix is not assumed positive. For an exact illustration, at \(N=3,h=0\) the literal transfer is \[ M_*^{(0)}= \begin{pmatrix} \tfrac92+\tfrac{3\sqrt3}2i&-\tfrac32-\tfrac{3\sqrt3}2i&0\\ 3&\tfrac{21}2+\tfrac{9\sqrt3}2i&-\tfrac32+\tfrac{3\sqrt3}2i\\ 0&-\tfrac32-\tfrac{3\sqrt3}2i&9 \end{pmatrix}. \tag{9} \] Its diagonal entries do not have a common phase. No scalar and diagonal similarity can therefore make this matrix entrywise nonnegative or Hermitian positive. This is a failure of that specific Perron/diagonal-gauge shortcut, not an obstruction to a coherent reflected-source formula or geometric survival. The complete raw base scalar at \(N=3,s=3\), including ALL charges in (4), is exactly \[ \mathcal A_{3,3}(3,3,3)=-189+81\sqrt3\,i. \tag{10} \] Its nonzero value is an exact source check. It is not an all-level nonvanishing theorem, an asymptotic volume calculation, or a proof that its geometric coefficient is nonzero. Establishing an original positive reflected base or a selected relative cycle in an open cusp-color corridor remains the geometric step. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_odd_pretzel_augmented_transfer_source.py) compares (4) with direct physical tensor contraction, all single crossing pretzels with the original central four-plat, mixed-circle ports and the simultaneous filling, and reconstructs (9)--(10) over the exact quadratic field.

title: The actual Fourier source reduces exactly to one exterior index
text: # The actual Fourier source reduces exactly to one exterior index Research theorem, 27 October 2026. For the original root family the fully reclosed one-cut operator is scalar. Hence ANY fixed first input column, paired with the original output row, gives the original period. Applied to the actual second-wire Fourier polarization, this removes the first exterior average exactly and leaves one finite Fourier-label sum. A whole actual Ward homotopy records every normal defect of this source reduction; off-root scalarity is not assumed. ## 1. The scalar root closure and its precise source Use the actual nilpotent color at q_N=exp(pi*i/N), Q_N=q_N^2, with M left as its original meridian parameter. In the balanced head frame K=x diag(Q_N^(-j)), x=-M/q_N, F_(j+1,j)=1-Q_N^(j+1), 0<=j<N-1. The original signed local crossings intertwine the true coproduct. Closing every other strand with its ORIGINAL root pivotal cap therefore makes the one-cut matrix C_N(M) a module endomorphism. The literal closure proof, including the root cap and all full peripheral factors, is given in [the closed-braid period construction](closed_braid_period_line.md), Sections 2--3. No extra pivot is attached at the opened identity wire. One can prove scalarity directly with just the actual K and F rows. Distinct K eigenvalues make C_N diagonal. The F commutator then gives (1-Q_N^k)(C_(k-1,k-1)-C_(k,k))=0, 1<=k<N. Every prefactor is nonzero, so all entries agree. This proves C_N(M)=P_N(M) I. (1.1) If C_N includes the original external d_N, then P_N=d_N F_N; if that line is recorded externally, P_N=F_N. Use the SAME choice on every side. The equality first holds on the admissible generic M chart and continues as its actual rational-map/source-lattice identity. It includes every regular complete value M=1. It does not invert a peripheral norm-zero factor or assert off-root q scalarity of the compressed auxiliary family. Let 1 denote the all-ones column, and retain the actual source Phi(C)=(1/N)1^t C 1, lambda_a(C)=1^t C e_a=sum_c C_(c,a). (1.2) Equation (1.1) proves, for EVERY a in the physical head, lambda_a(C_N)=Phi(C_N)=P_N. (1.3) This fixes only the INPUT column. The output row still sums all c. It is not the diagonal source E_aa when applied to current tensors. ## 2. One remaining Fourier-label sum, with its original normalization For the literal two-cut tensor let T^V=(I tensor V)T(I tensor V^-1), V_(j,b)=Q^(jb), Jtilde_(a,j)=sum_c T^V_(c,j;a,j). Use the WHOLE actual inverse from [the Vandermonde source theorem](actual_two_cut_fourier_polarization_and_cap.md). Its exact partial-trace identity gives, even before specializing Q, sum_j Jtilde_(a,j)=lambda_a(C). (2.1) At the actual root the scalar closure therefore proves P_N(M)=sum_(j=0)^(N-1) Jtilde_(a,j)(M) (2.2) for ANY chosen first input a. There is no remaining first average and no extra 1/N outside this last sum. The inverse Fourier matrix still supplies its own 1/N INSIDE each raw Jtilde. For charge-zero T, Jtilde_(a,j)=(1/N)sum_(b,q) Q_N^(jq)T_(a-q,b+q;a,b). (2.3) Thus fixing a does not force q=0 and does not remove the second momentum coordinate. The original first output row is essential. The specified proper-root partial lift with Q^(jq)/N has the same values in (2.2) at every original root. Off root its inverse need not equal V(Q)^-1. Equation (2.1) with the whole inverse and (2.2) with the root/proper-root inverse have these stated different scopes. Their q-normal source jets are not silently identified. ## 3. A whole balanced Ward contraction for the source change This section is an exact finite-matrix identity, before jets. It uses the actual balanced finite K,F matrices at whole Q,M. Put D_K(C)=K C K^-1-C, D_F(C)=F C-K^-1 C K F, delta C=(D_K(C),D_F(C)), p(C)=Tr C/N. (3.1) At a genuine Hopf fiber these are the actual Hopf-adjoint rows. Elsewhere (3.1) remains its specified compressed finite-matrix formula; its whole network defects must be retained. Work only over the localization where Q^l-1 is a unit for 0<|l|<N. These units do not invert 1-Q^N. For X=(X_K,X_F), set O(X)_(i,j)=(X_K)_(i,j)/(Q^(j-i)-1), i!=j, O(X)_(i,i)=0, d_k(X)=(X_F)_(k,k-1)/(1-Q^k), 1<=k<N. Let Q_k be the centered diagonal step (Q_k)_(i,i)=(N-k)/N-1_(i>=k), h(X)=O(X)+sum_(k=1)^(N-1) d_k(X) Q_k. (3.2) Off-diagonal recovery is immediate from D_K. The selected F entry has NO off-diagonal pollution, since both left F and right F have only one arrow in that direction: (D_F C)_(k,k-1) =(1-Q^k)(C_(k-1,k-1)-C_(k,k)). (3.3) Telescoping the centered steps proves the WHOLE identity h delta C=C-p(C)I, p h=0, delta I=0. (3.4) In particular the actual image complex End -> im delta contracts onto the scalar line. No cokernel assertion is made for the entire unrestricted two-row space. No integral-factorial basis change has been introduced; this is the original balanced head. Write Q_a=e_a 1^t, e=(1/N)1 1^t, gamma_a(C)=lambda_a(C)-Phi(C)=Tr[(Q_a-e)C], b_a(X)=gamma_a(h(X)). Since gamma_a(I)=0, applying gamma_a to (3.4) gives lambda_a-Phi=b_a delta (3.5) as an exact WHOLE source/current identity. For the actual reclosed matrix this says sum_j Jtilde_(a,j)-Phi(C)=b_a(delta C). (3.6) At its root Hopf fiber delta C_N=0, so (3.6) becomes (2.2). For whole q/M auxiliary arrays, or inserted Green/current coupons, the right side records the actual remaining closure/current row; it is not discarded by an off-root Schur argument. Normal derivatives follow by differentiating (3.5). In Taylor coefficients at any specified actual normal path, gamma_a(C_n)=sum_(i+j+k=n) (b_a)_i delta_j(C_k). (3.7) This includes the derivatives of the whole operators, source and unit denominators. For an uninserted scalar C_0 at first order, delta_1(C_0)=0 because delta_t(I)=0 for all t, and delta_0 C_0=0. Hence gamma_a(C_1)=(b_a)_0 delta_0(C_1). A current insertion with nonscalar C_0 retains the other terms in (3.7). On a full diagram use the original ordered Hopf/coprod and pivotal row, including prefixes, to evaluate delta C. The whole frozen pivotal cap is chi^-1 ptr_K M_(Z^J), not ptr_K by itself, with Z=Q^N. Its exact moment-clock and divided rows are retained in [the actual cap theorem](actual_divided_ward_closure_and_green_caps.md). This source homotopy does not set those cap/Green endpoints to zero. ## 4. A polynomial root bound in the original balanced metric Give the balanced head its flat positive metric and End its Hilbert--Schmidt norm, with the orthogonal product norm on the two current rows. The K-row inverse gap at Q_N is bounded by 1/[2 sin(pi/N)] <= N/4. (4.1) For the diagonal part integrate edge gradients from the middle vertex m=floor(N/2), then subtract the mean. This is the SAME centered step operator in (3.2); only its norm estimate changes. For left edges k<=m, 1/|1-Q_N^k| <= N/(4k). The relevant tail-sum matrix is A_(i,k)=1/k for 1<=i<=k<=m. With weights w_i=i^(-1/2), elementary sums give sum_(k>=i) A_(i,k)w_k <=3w_i, sum_(i<=k) A_(i,k)w_i <=2w_k. The weighted Cauchy--Schwarz inequality then gives ||A||<=sqrt(6)<3. The right half has the same estimate with k replaced by N-k. The two edge sets and anchored outputs are disjoint; subtracting the mean is orthogonal projection. Thus ||h_diag|| <=3N/4, ||h||<=3N/4. (4.2) For completeness the matrix bound follows by writing |sum_k A_ik x_k|^2 <= (sum_k A_ik w_k) sum_k A_ik |x_k|^2/w_k and then summing i. This proves the estimate without importing a Hardy inequality. Complex reciprocal phases are bounded by the same positive kernel. No q-factorial condition number has been omitted. The original row difference has exactly ||Q_a-e||_HS=sqrt(N-1). Consequently its actual source primitive satisfies ||b_a|| <=(3N/4)sqrt(N-1). (4.3) These are root metric bounds for this specified Ward/source map, not bounds on the whole word or the geometric quantum period. They make no uniform-neighborhood estimate for its normal units. ## 5. Choosing a good first-position anchor at every large level Assume the established geometric framing model has a nonempty regular algebraic chart for (A,p_e), with nondegenerate Fourier normal block as in [the actual Fourier construction](actual_fourier_polarized_geometric_normal_block.md). This is its stated complete positive geometric/marked branch input, not a new conclusion from (1.1). Over the fixed marked representation/half-density cover, remove every denominator and critical discriminant used for that chart. These are finitely many nonzero algebraic functions on its selected connected component. For a finite algebraic marking cover, take their nonzero field norms first, then clear denominators on the rational (A,p_e) chart. Since A=1/(1+s) is a nonconstant framing coordinate, only FINITELY many A-values have their entire fiber excluded. Explicitly, clear denominators of each defining function as a polynomial in the other coordinate; a fiber is identically zero only when all its coefficient polynomials in A vanish. They have finitely many common roots. Choose a root of unity A_*=exp(2pi*i p/d) outside that finite set, with 0<p<d, gcd(p,d)=1. Its finite marked-cover lifts are retained. There is no assertion that the particular choice A_*=-1 is good for every knot. Set a_N=floor(pN/d), r_N=pN-d a_N in {0,...,d-1}. Then a_N is an original physical head index, and A_N=Q_N^(a_N)=A_* exp[-(r_N/d)H_N], H_N=2pi*i/N. (5.1) Along each residue class of N modulo d, r_N is constant. The classes may be refined by every previously retained parity/phase modulus; no existing root sign or source branch is reset. The selected good geometric point deforms on its fixed marked cover to A_N for all sufficiently large N; the remaining framing/ Fourier coordinate is still free on a nonempty open. Formula (2.2) therefore computes the SAME original root period using a good fixed first-position sequence and just one exterior j sum. Existence of this formal geometric branch does not prove its survival in that last selected finite sum. The WHOLE clock before normal differentiation is A=Z^(p/d) Q^(-r_N/d), Z=Q^N, (5.2) on its MARKED power cover: the root value of Z^(p/d) is A_*. One may realize it with v^d=Q, W^d=Z, W=v^N and A=W^p v^(-r_N). This equals Q^(a_N) exactly on the actual power graph. Keeping Z and its phase branch is essential. Replacing its marked value by the constant A_* FIRST would lose D_Q log A=a_N, and would give only -r_N/d instead. Thus residue-class root selection does not identify off-root q-normal germs. Equation (3.7) and the whole inverse must be used for those germs. ## 6. Scalarity is necessary, and the source is not a diagonal probe There is an actual WHOLE auxiliary counterexample even for the one-positive-crossing unknot. At N=2 use x=-M/q, Q=q^2 and remove only the common Cartan scalar as in the actual residual matrices. In the ordinary F-shift frame its checked crossing is Rplus=[[1,0,0,0], [0,0,x^-1,0], [0,x^-1,1-x^-2,0], [0,0,0,Q*x^-2]]. The frozen cap is g=x^-1 diag(1,Q); the original zero-framing multiplier is theta^-1=x. Taking the literal partial trace gives C(Q,M)=d_2(M)diag(1,1+Q(Q^2-1)/M^2), d_2(M)=i M/(1+M^2). (6.1) The balanced diagonal frame does not change this diagonal cut. At Q=-1 it equals d_2(M)I, including the original complete value. Nevertheless the whole source difference and its first normal are gamma_0 C=-d_2(M) Q(Q^2-1)/(2M^2), D_Q(gamma_0 C)|_(Q=-1)=d_2(M)/M^2 !=0. (6.2) Here M is held fixed and the original phase i is fixed. At M=1 this normal value is i/2. Equation (3.5) reproduces (6.2) exactly from (D_F C)_(1,0)/(2(1-Q)). Thus the whole Ward row genuinely survives differentiation; scalar root closure cannot erase it. Using the ordinary generic ribbon cap instead of the specified frozen auxiliary cap would be a different off-root source. For the literal two-cut unknot T is the flip. Inserting the actual matrix-unit coupon X=E_00 at the second identity wire gives the one-cut matrix C=X. Its selected average is Phi(C)=1/N, whereas lambda_0(C)=1, lambda_a(C)=0 for a!=0. The fixed-input reduction therefore fails without scalarity. Its exact discrepancy is (3.5), with the nonzero F/K current of that specified coupon. Similarly a charged C=E_(c,a), c!=a, has lambda_a(C)=1 while its diagonal probe at a is zero. Removing the output sum would change the current/source problem even when the eventual uninserted knot matrix is scalar. [The exact audit](../experiments/audit_actual_one_index_fourier_source.py) and [saved results](../experiments/actual_one_index_fourier_source_results.json) check the whole two-row contraction and sources, actual signed root braid/Fourier tensors at complete and generic meridians, off-root current defects, metric bounds and marked clock exponents. No hyperbolic-volume or global selected-cycle conclusion is claimed.

title: Actual open meridian transport has a source-preserving horizontal polarization
text: # Actual open meridian transport has a source-preserving horizontal polarization Research theorem, 27 October 2026. The actual open R-word has an explicit endpoint half-character under M->qM. An M-dependent SECOND- wire gauge removes that half-step and preserves the whole source on arbitrary current tensors. A first-wire alternative has its separate explicit Cartan Ward correction. This constructs a real word-induced meridian/current connection, retaining the original finite source, power characters, cyclic wrap and peripheral factor. It does not yet turn the selected word class into the marked geometric period. The remaining insertion/current equation is stated explicitly in Section 7; no principal rational-density filter is substituted for the actual period. ## 1. The exact endpoint character of an arbitrary open braid word Use the original zero-framed knot braid on b strands, with writhe w. The first cut is at strand zero. The second is an INTERNAL IDENTITY wire at a specified braid level and strand slot ell, counted from zero. Use the literal tensor convention T_(c,d;a,b0)=ptr_other[A E_(b0,d)^(ell) B]. Thus d is the position immediately BEFORE the removed identity and b0 immediately AFTER it. Every ORIGINAL pivotal matrix remains in ptr_other; opening this wire neither removes its old cap nor adds a new pivot. Put nu=d-b0. Conservation gives c=a-nu for the uninserted tensor. All four physical head bounds and internal finite supports remain the original ones. For one actual crossing with first input i and first output c_1, the already proved finite coefficient identity is r_sign(qM)=x^(-sign) q^(c_1-i) r_sign(M)/tau_sign, x=-M/q, Y=M^2, tau_+=BC/x *(1-Y/A)/(1-YC/A), tau_-=x/A *(1-Y/B)/(1-YC/B). (1) The ratios in (1) mean their CANCELLED WHOLE finite products, as in the actual longitude-insertion theorem. No zero Pochhammer or peripheral denominator is divided separately. To telescope the half-character use the INTEGER position potential J(a_vec)=-sum_i i a_i. At every checked crossing, J_out-J_in=c_1-i. The final/initial closed strands have identical positions and the first position has coefficient zero in J. The matrix-unit insertion at the second cut changes J by -ell(b0-d)=ell nu. Therefore exactly sum_crossings(c_1-i)=-ell nu. (2) No root square root or cyclic interpretation is used in this equality. Write n=N-1, kappa_D=w-b+1, and retain the whole scalar gamma_N=q^(n kappa_D), L=gamma_N x^(-w) product_crossings tau_sign^-1. (3) The original closed pivotal/framing lines give gamma_N, just as in the closed calculation: each old closed pivot contributes q^(1-N), and the residual zero-framing line contributes q^(w(N-1)). The opening has not changed them. All common full Cartan scalars are kept with their original twist cancellation. At a knot root only, kappa_D is even and gamma_N=q^(-kappa_D). Off root keep gamma_N=q^(-kappa_D)(q^N)^(kappa_D), with its mark. For every raw finite open weight I the result is I(qM)=q^(-ell nu) L I(M). (4) Let T^[L] mean the SAME finite tensor with that cancelled whole insertion on every actual path. Put rho=q^(-ell) and D_rho=diag(rho^j) on the SECOND cut. Then (4) is the literal matrix identity T(qM)=(I tensor D_rho)T^[L](M)(I tensor D_rho^-1). (5) For the full ADO period multiply L by the ACTUAL whole ratio g_N=d_N(qM)/d_N(M) =q^(N-1)(q^2M^2-1)/(M^2-1) *(M^(2N)-1)/(q^(2N)M^(2N)-1). (6) Its original phase cancels only by using the SAME phase lift on both sides. The root reduction of (6), its complete norm-zero lattice and all q-normal source terms are not suppressed. ## 2. The raw Fourier source and independent alias powers Keep the full band kernel F(M,eta)=sum_nu f_nu(M)eta^nu, with the first input fixed and original output row still summed. Equation (4) reads F(qM,eta)=F^[L](M,rho eta). (7) The actual co-source is its constant coefficient, so CT_eta is unchanged by rho dilation, for WHOLE functions and every finite tail. No physical-position sum is replaced by a Fourier evaluation. For one uninserted first-input head a, the band interval [a-(N-1),a] has length N; root averaging computes CT exactly. For unwrapped currents keep an independent V_eta=eta^N: Av_(N,V_eta)F=sum_k f_(kN)V_eta^k, V_eta ->rho^N V_eta=(q^N)^(-ell)V_eta. (8) Thus an odd ell changes the physical root grid V_eta=1 to the antiperiodic grid -1. The original head CT agrees on these grids, but alias powers of a current do not. They retain the sign and the whole (q^N)^(-ell) character before normal differentiation. On the complete root head-band window, dilation by rho is a genuine finite matrix on the Fourier-label array: conjugate diag(rho^nu) by its finite Fourier evaluation matrix, using the ACTUAL unwrapped representatives in that interval. It fixes the constant-mode source, commutes with cyclic Fourier-label shifts, and is unitary when |rho|=1. It is not obtained by silently identifying every tail with its residue modulo N. In a whole generic-Q Vandermonde frame, use the original full tensor and its last-row carry, not a root permutation extended without corrections. ## 3. The second-wire horizontal gauge preserves the entire source functor On the SECOND identity wire put D_2(M)=diag(M^(-ell b)), T_h=(I tensor D_2^-1)T(I tensor D_2). Its coefficient factor is M^(ell(d-b))=M^(ell nu) for EVERY tensor entry, including charged current tensors. It therefore cancels (4) for the uninserted open word: I_h(qM)=L I_h(M), F_h(M,xi)=F(M,M^ell xi). (9a) The second partial trace is invariant under this conjugation on ALL matrices, not only diagonal or scalar reclosures: ptr_second T_h=ptr_second T. (9b) The first source, original caps, peripheral line and every source current are unchanged. On other internal pieces transform their ordered operators by the same basis map. This is a strict whole source/current functor before normal jets. No Schur argument or source replacement is used in (9b). There is an equally explicit GLOBAL braid-frame construction. On a level of b strands use G(M)=tensor_j M^(-j J_j), with first strand j=0. For one crossing its coefficient in G^-1 R G is M^(-(c_1-i))r. Thus (1) immediately loses its q^(c_1-i) factor under M->qM. All adjacent level gauges cancel in a word; the original closed diagonal pivots commute with them, and the first source is untouched. Cutting this global gauge at the second wire gives exactly D_2 above. In the actual generic-Q Fourier frame this is a SCALED Vandermonde isomorphism, not a root-only kernel substitution: W(M,Q)=V(Q)D_2(M)^-1, W_(j,b)=(M^ell Q^j)^b, W^-1=D_2 V^-1. The node gaps are only M^ell(Q^i-Q^j), so no additional source norm-zero divisor has been inverted. Equations (5) and (9a) give the exact whole matrix meridian identity (I tensor W(qM))T(qM)(I tensor W(qM)^-1) =(I tensor W(M))T^[L](M)(I tensor W(M)^-1). (9c) Indeed W(qM)D_rho=W(M). The raw first-output sum of the diagonal j entries therefore has fixed exterior xi=Q^j under the meridian step. Its remaining action is the ACTUAL insertion L, not a scalar chosen from the geometric branch. The forced normal connection on this whole frame is A_M=(D_M W)W^-1=ell V J V^-1, A_Q=(D_Q W)W^-1=(D_Q V)V^-1 (M fixed). Thus D_M T^W=W(D_M T)W^-1+[A_M,T^W] on that wire; the commutator has zero second partial trace entrywise. At a complex root, ||A_M||<=ell(N-1) and the old bound for A_Q is unchanged. On |M|=1, W/sqrt(N) is unitary. These are source-frame bounds, not full crossing-word bounds. Along M(q), retain the chain-rule connection and the marked M^N and q^N powers. There is a precise ROOT-only cyclic current corollary. For a charge-zero fixed-input packet put F_a[j,c]=Q_N^(j(a-c)), 0<=c,j<N, H_a(M)=F_a diag(M^(ell(a-c)))F_a^-1. Then J_h=H_a J, Sigma H_a=Sigma, H_a 1=1. Every factor is diagonal in the same finite Fourier basis, so H_a commutes with the cyclic shift, its normalized difference and its centered primitive. Its M-connection is A_a=ell F_a diag(a-c)F_a^-1, Sigma A_a=0, A_a1=0, ||A_a||<=ell(N-1). For |M|=1 this is an ISOMETRY of the actual cyclic source/current complex. In particular its distance to the zero-source current space is unchanged. This finite-packet statement is not extended to charged/unwrapped tails by forgetting their alias powers; those use the strict whole tensor map and (8). The packet connection A_a is NOT the full matrix A_M and is not independent of the unwrapped input window. For 0<=a<N-1, let Pi_(a+1) be the root Fourier projector on residue a+1. Then A_(a+1)-A_a=ell N Pi_(a+1), H_(a+1)H_a^-1=I+(M^(ell N)-1)Pi_(a+1). This is the exact branch carry as that head window moves by one. It is trivial in value at M=1 but not in its normal jet. The full tensor functor retains it, rather than treating A_a as a window-independent current connection. ## 4. Optional first-wire gauge and its exact Ward correction On the FIRST wire define D(M)=diag(M^(ell a)), T_hor=(D(M)^-1 tensor I)T(D(M) tensor I). (9) For a charge-zero path its coefficient is M^(ell(a-c))=M^(ell nu). Substituting (4) at qM cancels the factor q^(-ell nu). Hence I_hor(qM)=L I_hor(M), F_hor(M,xi)=F(M,M^ell xi), F_hor(qM,xi)=F_hor^[L](M,xi). (10) This is an alternative meridian-horizontal polarization, with no guessed quiver transport. Its endpoint half-character has been absorbed by a specified whole diagonal gauge, while L itself remains the actual word insertion rather than its critical value. The first-wire reclosure C=ptr_second T is diagonal for every whole uninserted auxiliary word by total position conservation. Therefore ptr_second T_hor=D^-1 C D=C (11) even OFF root. The selected uninserted state and full d_N line are exactly unchanged. For a current tensor of total charge d, c+nu=a+d; its factor is M^(ell nu)M^(-ell d). This extra source character is retained, rather than extending (11) to nonscalar charged matrices without their row correction. There are two equivalent complete current presentations. Transport all source data by the actual gauge: psi_hor=D^-1 psi and ell_hor=ell D, with the corresponding transformed coupon. Then the pairing is identical on EVERY matrix. If one keeps the convenient original fixed-input/all-ones row instead, its exact whole defect is the Cartan Ward row lambda_a(D^-1 C D)-lambda_a(C) =sum_(c!=a) [M^(ell(a-c))-1]/[Q^(a-c)-1] (D_K C)_(c,a), D_K C=K C K^-1-C. (12) Only genuine head units are inverted. No color edge or 1-Q^N is removed. Equation (12) handles all ordered/Green current tensors. On homogeneous charge d its selected line factor is M^(-ell d). The forced M-connection in the horizontal matrix frame is (D_M+ad_(ell J_head)) C_hor =D^-1(D_M C)D, D_M=M partial_M. (13) Its sign follows by differentiating D^-1 C D. The q-normal connection is zero with M held independent; on an actual path M(q) retain its chain-rule multiple of ell J_head. This does not freeze the fixed-level power graph or any normal source character. On the physical unit-meridian arc D(M) is unitary. The row in (12), in the original balanced flat metric, satisfies ||beta_(a,ell)(M)||^2 <=(N^2-1)/3, |M|=1, beta_(a,ell)(1)=0, ||D_M^k beta_(a,ell)(1)|| <=ell^k N^(k+1)/sqrt(12), k>=1. (14) Proof: numerator modulus is at most two and the denominator runs once through all nontrivial N-th root gaps; their inverse-square sum is (N^2-1)/12. For k derivatives use |a-c|<N. These are polynomial bounds for the SOURCE GAUGE and its fixed normal jets, not for the whole R-word, the external d_N pole or a complex neighborhood of the physical arc. ## 5. The pointed cyclic polynomial and wrap cannot be dropped The MAIN second-wire construction leaves the original first source and its supplied chi polynomial untouched. On any wire carrying a pointed cyclic source, an actual basis change transports its source vector, co-source and spectral polynomial simultaneously. For the optional first-wire gauge, the original first source is highest input and the orbit output row; in a cyclic frame its repair P=U+W has P^N=I. Equation (9) gives EXACTLY P_hor=D^-1 P D =M^(-ell)[P+(M^(ell N)-1)W], P_hor^N=I, ell_hor P_hor=ell_hor. (15) The marked source vector and row transform as just specified. Thus its characteristic polynomial and FORCED pointed factor are retained: chi(z)=(z-1)chi_red(z). In the actual cyclic repair chi=z^N-1. For an unfolded sourced companion the full conjugation also preserves its supplied chi and transports its chi_red row. Replacing (15) by bare M^(-ell)P would instead change the characteristic polynomial and its source eigenvalue. Its wrap character M^(ell N) is essential, including at a normal root. None of this identifies chi_red with the knot A-polynomial. ## 6. Compatibility with the geometric pole, with the exact scope The horizontal open phase adds ell Log M times the boundary displacement t=Hnu. Its principal incidence is therefore xi=M^(-ell)p_e^-1, p_hor=M^ell p_e. (16) The critical displacement is still zero, so its marked geometric action is unchanged. The nondegenerate Fourier block persists on the same regular meridian germ. At COMPLETENESS the proved Möbius framing coordinate and its pole lambda_e apply. Away from it, only a supplied marked polar branch, if it persists, can be said to rescale to lambda_hor=M^ell lambda_e(M). No global generic-M Möbius or single-pole theorem is assumed. For the rational principal coefficient T(p)=G p/(p-lambda)^2, sampling p^N=S gives EXACTLY Av_(N,S)T=G N S lambda^(N-1)/(S-lambda^N)^2. (17) Thus the antiperiodic source grid changes 1-lambda^N to 1+lambda^N with the corresponding numerator sign. In horizontal coordinates the retained candidate norm is 1-M^(ell N)lambda_e(M)^N. (18) The differential Jacobian is essential: at fixed M, dr expressed in p_hor=M^ell p gives G_hor=M^ell G as well as the rescaled pole. Where both expressions are regular, the RATIO of the two principal filters under this coordinate rescaling alone is M^(ell N)[(1-lambda_e^N)/ (1-M^(ell N)lambda_e^N)]^2. (19) At M=1 its extra logarithmic derivative is ell N(1+lambda_e^N)/(1-lambda_e^N), retaining the pole. Equation (19) is a geometric filter comparison, NOT a proved adapter of the actual selected quantum period. The exact main tensor gauge (9a)--(9c) preserves that period while its raw principal filter may be singular. Its missing whole word numerator/current correction must cancel or account for such poles; (17) alone cannot do it. ## 7. The remaining source-current equation is now explicit On any regular proper-array chart let R_i=S_i I_hor/I_hor be the actual internal ratios. Since the main identity (9a)--(9c) is exact, sigma_M(R_i)/R_i=S_i(L)/L. (20) For the finite Green insertion operator d_R,i=R_i S_i-I, this gives the coefficientwise chain identity L d_(sigma R),i(f)=d_R,i(Lf). (21) The global meaning is the zero-extended array identity, retaining all original endpoints and cancellation lattices. Together with the semilinear shift of f, it is the actual word-induced meridian connection on the insertion/current complex. After finite source pushforward it is the exact period equation T_M P_N=source(L I_hor), (22) with (6) in full normalization. Finite coefficient elimination already supplies a nonzero actual scalar meridian operator. What (20)--(22) do NOT prove is a geometric quotient of this SELECTED class. On ordinary finite-array currents multiplication by L leaves the exact residual sum_s L(s)(S_i-I)H(s) =sum_s [L(s-e_i)-L(s)]H(s). (23) Discarding it, or replacing L by its critical longitude inside the sum, would change the current/source comparison. A solution of gate C must transport (21), its MAIN whole source functor (9b)--(9c), its supplied pointed spectral/co-source data and the norm-pole corrections (18), then prove that the resulting original class is nonzero on the marked geometric period. This note removes a concrete endpoint twist and supplies tame actual source transport, but does not assert that last global map. The first-wire rows (12),(15) describe only the optional alternative. [Exact local/path/source/normal audit](../experiments/audit_open_meridian_horizontal_transport.py) and [saved results](../experiments/open_meridian_horizontal_transport_results.json).
