For the ACTUAL source polytope dP, each cell is consequently u=d v_0+B n, n in d*Delta, B in GL_(m+1)(Z), where Delta is the standard simplex and B is independent of N. The cell d*Delta itself has N-dependent size; it is not asserted to have lattice volume one. Its change of source coordinates has counting Jacobian one. Shared cell faces must be assigned once by a fixed half-open convention if their finite lattice sums are split. This finite real simplex atlas supplies controlled integral charts. It does not identify or glue their COMPLEX cotangent residue cycles. ## 3. The radial logarithmic coefficient never vanishes Let F be a nonempty proper face of P. Let H(F) list its active head occurrences h_i=0 or1, and J(F) its active transfers k_j=0 or1. The row vector governing the radial logarithmic term is q_F=sum_(i in H(F)) c_i grad h_i -sum_(j in J(F)) grad k_j. (5) The SAME sign applies at the lower and upper endpoint. Indeed, for I(s)=integral_0^s log|2sin(pi u)| du, either real endpoint a=0,1 satisfies I(a+delta v)-I(a)=delta v log delta+O_v(delta) (6) on a continuously marked side. At the upper endpoint this also follows from I(1-s)=-I(s). Full-function branch changes add recorded integer linear terms; along a real normal displacement they do not change the real logarithmic coefficient. If J(F) is nonempty, choose j in it. Every head contribution to the k_j coefficient of (5) is even, while its own transfer contributes -1 and other transfers contribute zero. That coefficient is ODD. Hence q_F!=0, regardless of simultaneous head collisions. If J(F) is empty, all transfers are positive and below one on the relative interior of F. A head h_i=0 must be a strict local minimum along the component: its preceding increment is negative and its following increment is positive. Otherwise a neighboring head would be negative. Thus c_i=-2. Similarly a head h_i=1 is a strict local maximum, so c_i=+2. Writing a_f for the active INWARD inequalities h_i>=0 or 1-h_i>=0, we obtain q_F=-2 sum_f grad a_f. (7) This cannot vanish. At a real relative-interior point x of F, all a_f(x)=0; at a strict interior point x_* all a_f(x_*)>0. If their gradient sum vanished, their sum would be constant and these two values would coincide, a contradiction. This completes the proof for EVERY proper face. ## 4. An outward direction with strict action decrease For every F there is a fixed integer vector v_F and an active inward inequality a_g such that a_g'(v_F)<0, q_F(v_F)>0, a_f'(v_F)!=0 for every active a_f. (8) For a facet the verification is explicit. A transfer k_j=0 facet has q_F=-grad k_j. A k_j=1 constraint cannot be a facet: its crossing forces physical head endpoints as independent equalities. A head endpoint facet has q_F a negative positive-integer multiple of its inward normal, by the local-minimum/maximum argument above. Choose v outward, then perturb within its open halfspace if needed. For codimension at least two, active inward normals span a space of dimension at least two. Since q_F!=0, at least one normal a_g' is not a positive multiple of q_F. There is then a real vector v with a_g'(v)<0 and q_F(v)>0: these two strict halfspaces are incompatible only for positive proportional normals. Avoid the finitely many other normal hyperplanes, choose v rational, and clear denominators. This gives (8) with integer v_F. All its constants depend only on the fixed word and face, not on N or the tangential source values. The direction need not make EVERY active inequality negative. It remains outside the physical polytope because a_g<0. This is why it also handles the all-zero corner, where shifting every transfer outward negatively was uphill. At that corner one can instead increase all transfers and decrease t sufficiently: all heads move outside while q_F(v_F)>0. The COMPLETE product descends. ## 5. Uniform local phase estimate Write the original scalar density as exp(N S) times its retained amplitude, with the gathered factorials (4), and include any fixed integer character sector from the actual cardinal/norm packets. Let y_F be a point of the COMPLEXIFIED affine face: its active indices equal 0 or1 exactly. Assume its inactive factors are regular on the chosen marked tube. If G is the nonsingular part, suppose |grad G|<=C_0+C_1 epsilon log N. (9) The original shrinking-strip hypotheses supply (9); it is not a bound on an unknown knot scalar. Choose delta=N^(-alpha), with alpha>C_1 epsilon/q_F(v_F), allowing fixed norm-comparison constants. The finitely many endpoint expansions (6) give Re S(y_F+delta v_F)-Re S_face(y_F) =delta log delta q_F(v_F) +O_word(delta(1+epsilon log N)) <=-c_F delta log N (10) for all sufficiently large N. Choose alpha<1 and epsilon small. The estimate is uniform on the regular tangential tube. Any fixed integer mark has exactly constant modulus under this real displacement. The active full-function resets change only those marks, so (10) holds for all retained outgoing marked sectors. A pole in a separated cardinal coefficient is not crossed independently of its full packet. Small complex offsets of size delta'=N^(-beta), beta>alpha, change the active-factor height by O(delta'|log delta'|), and the regular height by O(delta'(1+epsilon log N)). They therefore do not remove the far-edge decrease in (10). The shift of the quantum upper endpoint d/N from1 costs O(log N/N), also smaller than the stated drop. This is a local inner-to-outer normal estimate, not a monotone flow assertion at every intermediate point of every small corner. There are finitely many physical faces for a fixed word. Thus the vectors, charts and admissible exponents can be chosen uniformly over this entire finite list. At every vertex Re S_face=0: all factorial arguments are 0 or1 and all retained polynomial phases are pure imaginary on the real vertex. This agrees with the independent subexponential all-transfer-endpoint operator bound. ## 6. Exact source scope and what remains The cardinal-completed scalar is holomorphic in any prescribed fixed O(N) box and has the exact original values at every valid integer state, zero at every invalid one. Therefore its COMPLETE finite residue sum can be represented in any affine unimodular chart from Section 2. This is equality of residue functionals on holomorphic scalars, with orientation retained. It is not a pointwise identity between the different products of cotangents. Consequently (8)--(10) identify a descending normal for every physical face without assuming independent output positions or individual-atom zero sides. They do not by themselves glue those charts into one global deformed cycle. Partial chart changes retain diagonal cotangent walls and side currents; a sweep through valid physical integers retains their original residues. Nonphysical integer poles of separated window modes must still cancel in their complete packet. The remaining global claim must control this entire assembled source, the cumulative transport mass and any escaping tangential charts. Neither geometric survival nor a sharp whole-source volume upper bound follows merely from nonvanishing q_F or from the existence of the local vectors (8). These are constructive boundary action estimates for the proposed boundary-to-interior transport, with the exact source gluing still required. ## 7. A uniform quantum bound for the complete active cluster The preceding real radial estimate has an exact finite-N counterpart. It concerns the WHOLE cardinal-completed active factorial packet, not separate polar Gamma or cardinal modes. All constants below may depend on the fixed face, word, chosen integer direction and bounded normal-height set, but not on N or the bulk amplitude. ### 7.1 A primitive outward direction with a literal source coordinate One can strengthen (8) to choose grad a_g(v_F)=-1, q=q_F(v_F)>0, grad a_f(v_F)!=0 for every active a_f. (11) Every physical row a_g is primitive. If q_F is a negative multiple of grad a_g, any integer solution of grad a_g(v)=-1 has positive q_F(v); perturb it within the integer kernel to avoid the finitely many other normal hyperplanes. Otherwise q_F is nonzero on its integer kernel. Start with one integer solution v_0 and add Lw, where w lies in that kernel, q_F(w)>0, and avoids all active normal kernels except those forced by proportionality to a_g. Such w exists by an open rational halfspace argument; choose L sufficiently large and avoid the finitely many exceptional values. This proves (11). The vector v_F is automatically primitive, since its pairing with an integer row is -1. Use a_g as the FIRST affine integer source coordinate and complete the others by an integer basis dual to v_F and ker a_g. The resulting chart has determinant +/-1. With its tangent coordinates fixed, the outward normal path is u=u_F+z v_F, a_g(u)=-z EXACTLY. (12) This selected zero offset is important. Other active factorial arguments may have bounded complex offsets nu_f in a small face tube, but the selected a_g has zero offset for every value of those tangent coordinates. Every positive integer z in (12) is therefore an INVALID physical state through this selected head or transfer. The complete cardinal factor for that physical form vanishes there, even when the remaining tangent coordinates are complex. This is stronger than an assertion just on integer tangent slices. Re-present the COMPLETE residue source in this affine integer chart before taking the normal homotopy. Its first factor is pi*cot(pi*a_g) da_g=pi*cot(pi*z) dz with induced orientation. Moving the original outward edge from Re z=1/2 to Re z=M+1/2 crosses only these zero-residue nonphysical integers. Both finite-height horizontal connectors remain. This source statement uses the full holomorphic completion, not a pointwise substitution of one cotangent product for another. No valid-state cotangent residue is swept away. ### 7.2 All upper normalizers and window reflections are exact Write an active argument at its lower endpoint as s, and one at its upper endpoint as d+s. Its exponent c is one of the actual head exponents -2,0,2 or a transfer exponent -1. The exact identities are Fhat(d+s)/N=exp[i*pi*s*(s+d)/N]/Fhat(-s), w_N^+(d+s)=w_N^-(-s), w_N^-(d+s)=w_N^+(-s). (13) The first identity retains the complete reflected chirp and the factor N=F_d. The other two follow from S_N(d-s)=-S_N(s) in the literal cardinal sum. Thus the complete active packet, including its windows, becomes N^(C_upper) exp(P_upper(z)) product_i [Fhat(s_i)^(r_i) w_N^+(s_i)^(p_i^+) w_N^-(s_i)^(p_i^-)], s_i=nu_i+beta_i z, beta_i integer nonzero, C_upper=sum_(active upper occurrences) c, sum_i r_i beta_i=q_F(v_F)=q>0. (14) Here lower occurrences have r_i=c and their original slope; upper occurrences have r_i=-c and the reflected slope. P_upper is the explicit sum of the chirps in (13). The powers are those of the original scalar cardinal completion, with orientations exchanged under (13). They are never reset to one. Total window powers are strictly larger than every positive Gamma pole order; in particular p_i^++p_i^->max(r_i,0). An active physical window with r_i=0 is kept as well. It may be precisely the selected window in (12). The integer power N^(C_upper) is the ACTUAL upper-endpoint factor, not a tame normalization chosen by the proof. It may be negative. It will remain explicit in the bound below. On bounded normal imaginary height the chirp exp(P_upper) has at most exp(O(M+1)) modulus for Re z of size M. ### 7.3 Uniform regularized Gamma estimate through all collisions Put h=2*pi*i/N and use the fixed branch Log(-h)=log(2*pi/N)-pi*i/2. The actual Barnes product gives EXACTLY Fhat(s)=(-h)^s Gamma(s+1) A_N(s), A_N(s)=exp[i*pi*s*(s+1)/(2N)] product_(k>=1) Gamma(Nk+s+1) /[Gamma(Nk-s)(Nk)^(2s+1)]. (15) For |s|<=delta_0*N with any fixed sufficiently small delta_0, A_N is holomorphic and zero-free, including at the negative integers. The common Gamma divisor in (15) has been canceled BEFORE evaluating there. Uniformly in this disk, |A_N(s)|+|A_N(s)^(-1)| <=2 exp[C(|s|+1)^2/N]. (16) For completeness, apply the elementary uniform Stirling expansion to t+s+1 and t-s, t=Nk. Its 1/t term cancels exactly: LogGamma(t+s+1)-LogGamma(t-s)-(2s+1)log t =O((|s|+1)^3/t^2). Both arguments have positive real part, uniformly away from zero. The error sums absolutely over k. Its total is O((|s|+1)^3/N^2), bounded by C(|s|+1)^2/N on the disk. The explicit quadratic chirp in (15) has the same latter bound. This proves (16) without a periodic ambiguity or a choice of a replacement factorial. Let Re z=M+theta with theta in a fixed bounded interval, |Im z|<=T, and let all nu_i range over a fixed bounded complex set. For M sufficiently large the sign of Re s_i is the sign of beta_i. For negative Re s_i use the exact reflection Gamma(s_i+1)=-pi/[sin(pi*s_i) Gamma(-s_i)]. The COMPLETE window is w_N^+/- (s)=exp(+/-pi*i*s) sin(pi*s) S_N(s)/pi. On Re s<=-1/2, |S_N(s)|<=C log(N+1). The retained window powers cancel every negative-integer Gamma pole in the same product, and leave only nonnegative powers of sin(pi*s). These are uniformly bounded on the stated fixed-height strip. For positive Re s_i, the original Gamma is regular and the whole-plane cardinal bound is polynomial in N on that strip. Stirling for the remaining Gamma or reciprocal Gamma factors now gives, for the complete product, log |active packet/N^(C_upper)| <=-q M log[N/(M+1)] +C M+C M^2/N+C log N. (17) Offsets nu_i contribute only O(log N), since they are bounded; all constants beta_i are fixed. For bounded M the same assertion, with enlarged C, follows from (15) after the already-canceled Gamma poles. Thus (17) is uniform through dependent and coincident active collisions. No estimate is made on individual polar modes. ### 7.4 Coupling to the actual bulk and the quantitative collar Let G_N(u_F) contain all INACTIVE factorials and the full original Cartan, conversion, pivot, kappa and external chi_N/N factors. Do not divide by a completed face amplitude, which may vanish. The explicitly retained N^(C_upper) stays outside G_N. Assume the inactive marked tube gives the normal allowance |G_N(u_F+zv_F)| <=exp(CM) N^(C_1*epsilon*M+C_2) |G_N(u_F)|. (18) This is the quantitative form of (9). On a regular marked bulk branch with uniform factorial-symbol control, inactive clocks and their complements bounded above and below by N^(+/-epsilon), and a displacement smaller than their singularity distance give the stated O(1+epsilon log N) leading logarithmic derivative. In a continued chart the EXACT allowance (18) additionally retains and controls its central norm factors and full symbol; it does not follow merely from bounds on B and 1-B if an outside-band integer factorial divisor is approached. Finite bulk-window modes keep their actual integer-marked exponential in G_N; the HEAD/active windows remain whole as in (14). Their bounded-height polynomial factors are already included in (17). Combining the exact active bound and (18) gives the following bound for each retained bulk-window mode, with the active packet WHOLE: |Atilde_N(u_F+zv_F)| <=|N^(C_upper) G_N(u_F)| N^C exp[CM+CM^2/N] N^(C_1*epsilon*M) [(M+1)/N]^(qM). (19) For a general nonreal tangent chamber the COMPLETE scalar is the fixed finite sum of these modes. Its bound uses the SUM of the absolute reference amplitudes on the right of (19), not the absolute value of their potentially canceling sum. On a fixed-height joint contour the inactive windows themselves cost only a polynomial; there the unwindowed original bulk G_N suffices directly. Choose M=floor(N^(1-alpha)), with max(epsilon,C_1*epsilon/q)<alpha<1. Then the far normal edge has the strict bound |Atilde_N|<=|N^(C_upper)G_N(u_F)| exp[-(q*alpha-C_1*epsilon+o(1))M log N]. (20) Throughout that collar the additional normal cost is exp(o(N)); finite-height connector lengths and cotangent bounds add only polynomial factors. Estimate (20) compares to the retained bulk source itself, not to an assumed volume bound for it. Arbitrarily fixed bounded normal jets obey the same kind of bound on slightly smaller contours by Cauchy's formula after pole cancellation. One may allow offset size L=o(M), at the additional cost exp[O((L+1)log N)]: the same regularized Gamma calculation and bounded-height estimate use |Im s|=O(L+1). In particular the small thickenings in Section 5 with beta>alpha do not remove (20). This extension concerns a single common radial normal and its specified small offsets, not arbitrary nested scales. The actual conclusion is a uniform active-cluster OUTWARD quantum collar for every physical face, whenever the inactive bulk allowance is available. The original residues and all upper normalizers are retained, and the selected outside cotangent integers have exactly zero residue. It does not glue different face collars, prove a global mass bound, or classify every nested tangential escape. Independent source-agent proof review: Sections 1--6 verified, including endpoint-independent q_F, transfer parity, the direct TU minor argument and the exact residue-functional qualification. Section 7 supplies the finite-N whole-packet estimate; no scalar noncancellation or full volume theorem is inferred. [Independent face audit](../experiments/audit_actual_physical_face_outward_action.py): 790 proper physical faces of seven original signed words, 4877 exact maximal minors, primitive outward vectors and 28 radial phase checks. The all-word conclusions use the proofs above, not this finite census. The supplementary complex checks in [the two-neighbor audit](../experiments/audit_actual_regular_head_face_cot_filling.py) also pass nine normalized Gamma-factor checks, eighteen exact upper window reflections, and three mixed-direction pole cancellations. The latter use a cluster with q=2*(-1)+(-1)*(-3)=1, so an individual factor goes toward a pole while the COMPLETE product has the stated descending logarithmic coefficient. These are checks of exact local identities, not substitutes for the uniform proof or global source gluing.

title: Independent audit of the physical-face outward action theorem
text: # Independent audit of the physical-face outward action theorem 28 October 2026. Independent proof read of [the physical-face theorem](actual_physical_face_outward_action.md), including the complete quantum Gamma packet in Section 7: **PASS** within its stated local hypotheses. This is not an audit claiming the remaining global cycle/gluing or knot-volume estimate is proved. The theorem concerns a NONEMPTY one-component braid word. The empty one-head unknot has a constant factorial density and zero radial q; it is an irrelevant but literal exception to an unrestricted phrase "every braid word." ## Algebra and face geometry I independently re-derived the signed head gathering from the actual negative-root chirp. The head exponents are even, and each independent total transfer has exponent minus one. The transfer coordinates are integrally free for a one-component closure, with one additional base color; this also follows from the separate source lattice proof in [the transfer-face note](actual_transfer_only_face_downhill_patch.md). The interval-column proof of total unimodularity is valid. After restricting to selected arc rows, successive row differences produce at most one positive and one negative entry per column. Expansion or zero column sums give determinants in {0,+1,-1}. Unit transfer rows and upper inequality signs preserve the assertion. Consequently the physical vertices are binary and independent active rows give honest affine unimodular source coordinates. The parity argument proves q_F!=0 whenever a transfer endpoint is active. With no active transfer, physical support forces a zero head to be an over-to-under minimum and a unit head to be an under-to-over maximum; hence q_F=-2 times the sum of active inward normals, which cannot vanish by strict interior feasibility. The k=1 constraints cannot be facets because they force independent head endpoint equalities. The remaining facet cases and the codimension-at-least-two halfspace construction are correct. A primitive normal direction with selected inward slope -1 exists, so its positive integer source normal is invalid for all tangent values, including complex ones. ## Action, marks and the exact quantum packet Both endpoints of I(s)=integral_0^s log|2sin(pi t)|dt have the SAME coefficient delta*v*log(delta). No upper-end sign is missing. Integer cardinal and full-Psi norm characters have exactly constant modulus along the prescribed real displacements. Thus their leading marks do not reverse the strict far-normal height drop. The statement is correctly a face-to-far-edge estimate; it does not assert monotonicity at every point of a general interpolating sweep. I checked the whole factorial factorization Fhat(s)=(-h)^s Gamma(s+1) A_N(s). Its branch is the original Gaussian branch. The 1/t coefficient in LogGamma(t+s+1)-LogGamma(t-s)-(2s+1)log t cancels exactly, leaving a summable O((|s|+1)^3/t^2) error. This proves the stated zero-free A_N and inverse bound on a fixed sufficiently small O(N) disk. The exact upper reflection retains both N=F_d and its chirp; the cardinal orientations exchange correctly under reflection. For negative normal arguments, Gamma reflection and the COMPLETE window leave nonnegative powers of sin(pi*s). This cancels the negative-integer Gamma poles before estimating. Positive arguments use ordinary Stirling. Summing the signed slopes r_i beta_i gives exactly q_F(v_F), and hence the displayed leading term -q M log(N/(M+1)). Bounded offsets cost O(log N); smaller growing offsets cost the stated O((L+1)log N). Upper endpoint powers N^c are retained explicitly. No estimate of separated polar cardinal modes has been substituted for the complete packet. ## Scope required for a global use The exact inactive-bulk allowance (18) is a substantive hypothesis. It is not supplied merely by bounds on B and 1-B in a continued chart near an outside-band integer divisor. The note states this correctly. Retained inactive mode exponentials belong in that bulk reference; their wrong-side growth cannot be omitted. The zero-residue normal extension is exact after re-presenting the COMPLETE finite residue source in the chosen unimodular chart. It is not a pointwise replacement of the old cotangent product. Partial chart transitions, valid physical residues swept in a larger move, side curtains, repeated visits and escaping tangential regions still need the separate global control identified in the original note. Fresh independent replay of [the exact audit](../experiments/audit_actual_physical_face_outward_action.py) passed 7 signed original braid words, 790 proper physical faces, 4,877 exact maximal-minor checks and 28 logarithmic phase diagnostics. I also read the witness construction and face enumeration; their finite checks agree with, but do not replace, the uniform proof.

title: An ordinary pivotal cap coherently collapses reassociation to one angle weight
text: # An ordinary pivotal cap coherently collapses reassociation to one angle weight 29 October 2026. Contracting the ORIGINAL ordinary pivotal cap with the actual three-head reassociation packet annihilates every middle input except the top index d=N-1. The surviving map is a phase times weighted truncated addition. In the source-fixing quarter-factorial metric its squared coefficient is exactly ONE positive affine-angle weight. All intermediate terms have been summed coherently first. The inverse-packet/cup move has an equally explicit bottom-index selection and the same one-weight energy. These are exact local operator/source identities for arbitrary exteriors, not merely scalar normalizations. The marked cap is different: its complete retained packet is given below and is not replaced by the ordinary cap. ## 1. Actual packet, source and metric conventions Put q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2, d=N-1, x=-q^-1=q^d, N>=2, F_a=(Q;Q)_a and s_a=|F_a|. Keep the original finite transfers C'_12|a,b>=sum_r x^-r [b+r choose r]_Q |a-r,b+r>, (C'_12)^-1|a,b> =sum_r (-1)^r Q^[r(r-1)/2]x^-r [b+r choose r]_Q |a-r,b+r>, (1) 0<=r<=min(a,d-b). These are the original nilpotent Euler matrices and their full inverse, including strict head endpoints. The actual packet is A=(C'_23)^-1 C'_12. (2) Its full entry, derived by its UNIQUE intermediate state, is |a,b,c> -> |a-r,b+r-s,c+s>, A=(-1)^s Q^[s(s-1)/2]x^[-(r+s)] [b+r choose r]_Q[c+s choose s]_Q, (3) r<=min(a,d-b), s<=min(b+r,d-c), r,s>=0. The normalized original ordinary cap and cup are ellhat= sqrt(N) ell, ellhat|u,v>=(xQ)^-u/sqrt(N) delta_(u+v,d), phat=p/N^(3/2), phat=sum_(u=0)^d x^(u-d)/sqrt(N) |u,d-u>. (4) Indeed the literal original turns are ell|u,v>=x^v g_u/N delta_(u+v,d), p_(u,v)=N x^-v delta, g_u=x^-d Q^-u. Thus(4) retains the original pivot, not a cap with a favorable substituted phase. The normalized cap and cup both have norm1. Literal ell and p are restored by their stated N powers; all external Cartan/framing/peripheral lines are unchanged. Use the PHYSICAL gauge and squared metric B_a=L_a^-1/4, h_a=B_a^2=sqrt(N)/s_a, L_a=s_a^2/N. (5) Root reflection gives B_a B_(d-a)=1. These original turns are fixed by B on paired legs. Hats on maps below mean conjugation by B on their physical input/output legs. This is not the length normalization b_l=B_l/D_l and is not the different tame-current metric L^(1/2). ## 2. Exact cap selection, including the coherent root sum Define K=(ellhat_12 tensor I_3) A. For every physical input, K|a,b,c>=0 unless b=d and a+c<=d. (6) In the surviving case n=a+c, K|a,d,c>=N^-1/2 (-1)^a Q^[a(a-1)/2-a]x^(-2a) [n choose a]_Q |n>. (7) Proof. The cap condition in(3) fixes s=a+b-d. If this is negative, or s>d-c, the contraction is zero. Otherwise its allowed r range is exactly0,...,d-b. The ordinary pivotal cap phase supplies Q^r, and all the remaining factors are independent of r. Its complete coherent sum is sum_(r=0)^(d-b) Q^r[b+r choose r]_Q =[N choose b+1]_Q. (8) For completeness, q-Pascal gives [j+1 choose b+1]-[j choose b+1]=Q^(j-b)[j choose b]. Sum from j=b to d. At the primitive root the resulting Gaussian polynomial is zero for b<d and one for b=d. Its intermediate factorials have no zero denominator; [N choose N]=1 is its literal polynomial value. This works at every even and composite level as well. Thus b=d, r=0, s=a, n=c+a, with the strict condition n<=d. Substitution of the ORIGINAL cap coefficient gives precisely(7). This is cancellation of the full finite packet, not one selected term or an assumed homogeneous-source quotient. ## 3. The doubled packet has exactly one positive angle weight Define w_d(i,j,k)=1/(s_i s_j s_k), i+j+k=d. Applying(5) to(7) gives the exact entry Khat_(n;(a,b,c)) =delta_(b,d)delta_(n,a+c<=d) q^[a(n-N-1)] sqrt(w_d(a,c,d-n)). (9) Indeed the squared gauge ratio is h_n/(h_a h_d h_c)=s_a s_c/s_n. Consequently |Khat_(n;(a,d,c))|^2 =(1/N)|[a+c choose a]_Q|=w_d(a,c,d-a-c). (10) For the LITERAL original cap ell the right side is w_d/N, because ell=ellhat/sqrt(N). No original scalar line was discarded. The complete doubled input Gram retains the mixed copies: (Khat^*Khat)_(a,d,c ; a',d,c') =delta_(a+c,a'+c') q^[a'(a'+c'-N-1)-a(a+c-N-1)] sqrt(w_d(a,c,d-a-c)w_d(a',c',d-a'-c')). (11) All other middle-input rows/columns are zero. The positive trace on the one remaining output has supplied the UNWRAPPED constraint n=n'. It admits either exact N or2N Fourier character expression, since n,n' lie in0,...,d. This does not identify n=n' with a global triangulation edge sum2d. The non-diagonal terms of(11) have not been dephased. Rows of Khat have disjoint total-input-degree support, so Khat Khat^*=diag(R_n), R_n=sum_(a=0)^n w_d(a,n-a,d-n), ||Khat||_op^2=max_n R_n, ||Khat||_HS^2=sum_n R_n=Z_(3,N). (12) Here Z_(3,N) is the positive affine angle-simplex partition, with total d and zero angles retained. Thus the EXACT map has the one-tetrahedron energy exponent log||Khat||_op^2=log||Khat||_HS^2+O(logN) =N v_3/pi+O(logN). (13) The uniform factorial estimate and the unique simplex maximum at thirds prove(13); no isolated numerical saddle is a premise. Equation(12), not a separate entrywise Cauchy estimate, gives its quantitative all-exterior boundary norm. ## 4. The inverse-packet cup move Let J=A^-1(phat_12 tensor I_3). Its exact output selection is J|n> supported on |a,0,c>, a+c=n+d, n<=a<=d, J_(a,0,c ; n)=N^-1/2 x^[2(a-d)] [c choose d-a]_Q. (14) Proof. Write the cup index as p and apply C'_23 followed by (C'_12)^-1. The desired output fixes s=d-a-b and p=a+r. The remaining finite r sum is sum_(r=0)^b (-1)^r Q^[r(r-1)/2][b choose r]_Q =(1;Q)_b. It is zero unless b=0; for b=0 one has r=0,p=a,s=d-a and c=n+s. Substitution gives(14), with every inverse phase retained. Thus this is an exact cup/current cancellation, not an adjoint claimed from a nonunitary packet. In the SAME physical metric(5), |Jhat_(a,0,n+d-a ; n)|^2 =w_d(n,d-a,a-n). (15) To check it directly, the squared gauge ratio is h_a h_0 h_c/h_n=N s_n/(s_a s_c). Multiplying the squared coefficient in(14) and using s_a s_(d-a)=N gives(15). It follows that Jhat^*Jhat=diag(R_(d-n)), so its operator/HS norms have the same exact one-weight partition as(12). The literal original cup p restores the factor N^(3/2) in amplitude, or N^3 in energy. These polynomial factors remain explicit. ## 5. What is retained at the marked cap The actual full marked row is m_(u,v)=x^v/N^2, WITHOUT a degree delta. It cannot use(8). Its complete packet on arbitrary input has output n=c+s, 0<=s<=d-c, and the exact coefficient (m_12 A)_(n;(a,b,c)) =N^-2 (-1)^s Q^[s(s-1)/2]x^[b-2s] [c+s choose s]_Q *sum_(r=max(0,s-b))^(min(a,d-b)) [b+r choose r]_Q. (16) An empty interval means zero. This follows directly from(3) and the unrestricted original row; no source component is omitted. It is the remaining finite current packet when a marked boundary is present. Only if the FULL exterior has already forced pair degree d can the corresponding restricted marked row be used. Even then its r sum lacks Q^r and equals (Q^(-(d-b));Q)_(d-b), not the delta in(8). It is generally nonzero away from b=d. Thus the ordinary cap elimination is source-exact and useful, but does not delete the last marked source or its normal currents. If a beta or divided-Ward factorization is used to express(2), all its terms must add back to(6)--(16). Keeping only a bare balanced residue would not establish these identities. ## 6. Positive multiplication form and iteration scope Write sigma_a=q^[a(a-N-1)] and g_j=q^[j(j-1)/2]. Since q^(ac)=g_(a+c)/(g_a g_c), the unitary port phases in(9) can be displayed explicitly. After transporting those phases, the positive two-input part is T^+_(n;a,c)=N^-1/2 delta_(n=a+c<=d) sqrt(s_n/(s_a s_c)). (17) For W_j=1/sqrt(s_j) it is exactly T^+=N^-1/2 W^-1 M(W tensor W), where M is multiplication in C[z]/(z^N), in its canonical monomial basis. Consequently these positive kernels associate exactly, and their internal factorials telescope on a rooted tree. Actual port phases and the removed middle |d> registers must still be retained in the original diagram. They are not declared globally canceled by(17). The [complete cap-tree calculation](actual_cap_tree_angle_energy.md) gives the arbitrary-width boundary-tree energy with these original node types. This does not assert that every signed braid reduces to such a tree: overlapping recoupling cycles, Gaussian feedback and especially the full marked packet(16) remain. No broad knot survival or sharp whole-source volume estimate follows merely from this local contraction. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_pivotal_cap_reassociation_angle_packet.py): full original finite packet matrices, ordinary cap and cup source, complete phases and forced indices, exact mixed-copy Gram, one-weight norms, and the unrestricted marked packet. Fresh replay: PASS seven levels N=2,...,8 and all 1,295 three-head input columns, checking the full original cap and inverse-cup matrices, the retained marked packet, phases, mixed-copy Gram and one-weight norms. The algebraic proofs above establish the all-level statements; these finite checks are supplementary.

title: The literal planar three-port double and its original Morse source
text: # The literal planar three-port double and its original Morse source 30 October 2026. This certifies the topology and pointing of the planar three-port double used in the whole-source reflection calculation. It constructs an original augmented-link Morse diagram; it does not assume the doubled graph admits the older two-row noncrossing ordering. It does not prove the proposed theta-normalized quantum contraction. ## 1. Delete, reflect and sew the embedded vertex Start with the ACTUAL plane cubic source graph Gamma and an exposed trivalent vertex w. Retain its cyclic order and the three labeled incident edge ribbons a,b,c. Choose a small vertex disk meeting exactly these ribbons once and containing no circle coupon. Deleting its interior leaves a three-leg ribbon graph in the complementary disk. For a connected double assume this remaining graph is connected; otherwise the same construction records all its components rather than discarding one. Reflect this entire remaining ribbon disk, reversing its planar cyclic orders and interchanging black/white source orientations. Glue its three boundary ends to their corresponding original ends by the orientation-reversing boundary identification. This is the embedded three-edge vertex sum Gamma_double=(Gamma minus w) union (mirror Gamma minus mirror w). At the physical six-strand boundary, use the cyclic terminal list (a-,a+,b-,b+,c-,c+). The reflected disk reads this list in reverse order. Glue each actual labeled terminal to its reflected copy; in clockwise position indices this is j -> 5-j. Thus the full head reversal is prescribed geometrically. A free permutation of ports, or a same-order adjoint of a trivalent tensor, is not this gluing. ## 2. One original circle per merged edge Construct the augmented diagram from the SEWN ribbon graph. Replace each surviving trivalent vertex by its original three planar main strand arcs. In its cyclic labels the pairs are (a+,b-), (b+,c-), (c+,a-). The two main strands follow each edge ribbon. Put exactly ONE actual crossing circle on every resulting edge, with its twice-punctured spanning disk and any recorded signed twist. In particular each of the THREE seam edges receives one circle. An equivalent cut description amputates the three boundary circle coupons before reflecting, then inserts one coupon on each sewn edge. Reflecting two already decorated edge stubs and retaining both circles would give a different diagram. At even levels it could also replace one required nilpotent coupon by its vanishing square. No such step is allowed by this certificate. This expansion gives precisely the Fisher matching graph of the sewn Gamma. It retains every vertex arc, disk label and component. The existence of the actual planar diagram follows from the ribbon disk gluing, not from a graph incidence count. ## 3. An actual Morse word and a legitimate exposed mark Make the planar main arcs piecewise smooth and choose a generic height. After small disjoint isotopies their critical heights and the circle boxes are distinct. Reading height gives an explicit finite sequence of the original cups, caps, identity strips and circle coupons. Local orientations of a two-strand box are changed only by its actual cup/cap bends, hence by the genuine turned coupon and its recorded clocks. No crossing of two planar main arcs is introduced. This is an original Morse source even if it has many alternating cup/cap levels. It need not have all black vertices in one row or all white vertices in another. Arbitrary structural relabelings of heads are not substituted for these actual identity strips. Because w was exposed, choose the seam sector corresponding to its original outside-face corner. A main arc bordering that sector gives a distinguished ONE-HEAD cut. Choose the planar point at infinity in that white region and place this cut at the exposed closing cap from the start. The remaining whole tangle is a generic Hopf endomorphism of the physical V_d and therefore scalar. Its actual ordinary trace has the single factor (-1)^d[N]. The original physical marked row extracts that scalar because m pV=1. This justifies the exposed physical pointing of the NEW diagram. It does not move a bare mark through an enclosing cap of an already fixed diagram. If a proposed source formula starts at another cut, its whole pivotal transport must still be supplied. ## 4. The geometric volume subtraction, when cores are certified Suppose Gamma has the positive labeled ideal rectified core Q of [the proved NC core theorem](actual_nc_graph_rectified_core_geometry.md), and w corresponds to its actual triangular face T_w. Reflect a copy of Q and glue the two copies along those triangles with the prescribed three-port correspondence. The adjacent right angles sum to pi, so the seam's white faces merge. The convex-face union proof in that same theorem gives the positive core of Gamma_double; its volume is 2Vol(Q). Its remaining face labels are exactly those of the ribbon vertex sum above. If Gamma has b black and b white vertices, Gamma_double has 2b-1 of each type. Its actual augmented link therefore has volume 4(2b-1)v8+4Vol(Q) =2[4b v8+2Vol(Q)]-4v8. (1) The subtracted 4v8 is the complete marked theta-link volume. Thus a source double formula with a theta denominator has the expected GEOMETRIC normalization. Equation (1) does not prove that source formula, its positivity, or its asymptotic rate. It is conditional on the actual positive core and the correctly sewn original diagram.

title: An exact positive full-source formula for planar three-port doubles
text: # An exact positive full-source formula for planar three-port doubles 30 October 2026. A literal planar three-port double has an exact nonnegative complete-circle source at EVERY quantum level. All interior and seam colors are summed; there are no fixed Steinberg cycle projections. The formula is a sum of squared COHERENT boundary packets, with the positive original marked theta scalar as its prescribed weight. It retains the single physical mark and every paired circle normal. The primitive half can have arbitrary fixed size and branching. Its boundary packet is still a genuine coherent contraction, not a product of local black scalar magnitudes. Thus this theorem removes cancellation between the double's boundary sectors; it does not yet compute their exponential size or prove the volume limit for arbitrary plats. ## 1. A reflection operation on the whole original Morse word Let J_n reverse ALL n physical V_N tensor factors. For a matrix F:V_N^tensor a -> V_N^tensor b put F^sharp = J_a F^dagger J_b. (1) This reverses composition and tensor order. It is a whole-word operation, not a partial transpose of one leg. Set d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), x=q^d. For the ORIGINAL physical cup and cap, p_(u,v)=N x^-v delta_(u+v,d), ell_(u,v)=x^u delta_(u+v,d)/N, one has exactly p^sharp=N^2 ell, ell^sharp=N^-2 p. (2) Indeed p^dagger P=N^2 ell, with P=J_2. The original unrestricted marked row is m_(u,v)=x^v/N^2; it is NOT replaced by its local adjoint in this argument. Let L_j be a FULL complete-circle Hermite sector. Its actual all-degree factorization, including a paired root normal, is L_j=F_j F_j^dagger P. Consequently L_j^sharp=L_j, (R^e L_j)^sharp=R^-e L_j. (3) For the second identity use the proved all-input equality R^e L_j=omega_j^e L_j with |omega_j|=1. If a structural crossing is present elsewhere in the original word, it obeys the independently proved identity P R^dagger P=R^-1 as well. These are actual matrix identities, including both parities; a paired nilpotent is not being replaced by a projector. In a Morse word from a physical one-head cut back to that head, the numbers of cups and caps are equal. Therefore every scale N^2 in (2) cancels globally. The word obtained by reversing its composition and tensor order, exchanging its cups/caps, and reversing its signed crossings is exactly T^sharp=T^dagger. It is the literal reflected Morse diagram. Boundary labels are transported by that same geometric reflection, including its reversal of the cyclic three-port order. The cut word T is a Hopf endomorphism of the original V_N. This module is irreducible: its interior E and F coefficients are all nonzero and its K weights are distinct. Hence T=z I. The original marked closure extracts precisely z, since m p=1. Its reflected one-head cut is z-bar I, so Z_reflected(reflected boundary labels) =conjugate(Z_original(boundary labels)). (4) This proves the marked identity without reflecting a bare local m, without moving a bare mark through a nested cap, and without first specializing an ordinary quantum trace to zero. A correct generic first-normal trace quotient gives the same scalar, but is not needed to establish (4). Any original exterior framing line is reflected and conjugated separately. Legitimate one-head cuts on another physical main arc give the same raw scalar when needed in the seam construction. To verify this, choose the regular generic lift of the WHOLE labeled diagram. Its closed scalar F(zeta) equals D_N(zeta) times the open scalar at either cut, where D_N is the same physical V_N quantum dimension. Away from its isolated zeros those open scalars agree; they are regular and therefore agree at the root. This transports the complete cut tangle, not a bare local marked row. The chosen lift is used only to establish this equality of the actual root coupons. ## 2. The double is a specified physical source Start with an actual planar complete-circle graph source Gamma and a specified three-port vertex disk for which its punctured source has an actual Morse realization. For example take the exposed outer white vertex of an original NC/Morse graph. Remove that vertex disk, reflect its remaining planar piece as in section1, and glue the two disk boundaries in their reversed cyclic order. The seam has three edges, not six consecutive edge coupons. Install ONE original complete-circle coupon on each merged edge. Equivalently remove the old boundary circle coupons before joining the two pieces and reinstall one on each seam. Signed seam exponents add; reflected partners cancel there. Reflect every remaining signed crossing in the second half as required by (3). Expand the surviving vertices to their actual nested main-strand arcs. A generic planar height produces the corresponding cups, caps and turned-circle Morse word. Choose its single physical one-head mark on an outer-face seam main arc FROM THE START. This construction is the planar vertex sum Gamma #_3 reflected(Gamma), with its actual source orientations. It does not assert that the result has the previous one-row NC edge order, nor insert unrecorded edge permutations or structural crossings to force such an order. The [geometric source certificate](actual_planar_three_port_double_topology.md) records this disk construction, including its six-terminal reversal. The algebra below uses only its specified physical port joining and one-circle-per-seam convention. Applying two old root circle coupons in succession instead would give a different source and is NOT the double studied here. ## 3. Exact theta division before taking the fixed root normal Let D_N be the supported folded triples 0<=a,b,c<=floor((N-1)/2), a+b+c>=N-1. Write theta_N(a,b,c)>0 for the RAW ORIGINAL marked theta source with these three full-circle sectors and no twists. Its positivity and normalization are proved in the all-channel marked-theta theorem. Let Z_Gamma(a,b,c) be the original coherent source with these three boundary sectors fixed and EVERY other complete-circle color summed. The mark is a legitimate physical cut of the original closed source. The [three-port source sewing theorem](actual_nc_three_port_source_sewing.md) has an all-entry local proof. Removing the ordinary boundary invariant row from the regular generic lift leaves a genuine invariant column Y_Gamma(zeta)=alpha_Gamma(zeta) Theta_abc(zeta). The canonical Theta corner is one, so alpha is the finite open-corner contraction and is regular BEFORE dividing by a closed theta. The same argument applies to the literal disk joining in section2: the punctured source is an actual composition of Hopf morphisms, not a bare permutation of a six-head array. For a supported triple the ordinary theta has exactly one root zero. Its local source scalar is nonzero. The generic cross-multiplied sewing identity can therefore be divided by its single common quantum dimension factor BEFORE specializing. The one-circle-per-seam edge constants and the two removed source scalars give exactly Z_sewn(a,b,c)=Z_A(a,b,c) Z_B(a,b,c)/theta_N(a,b,c). (5) No paired projector norm or root L_j inverse is used. The retained first normal is the originally specified one; higher nonzero coefficients are not selected if it vanishes. Nontriangles vanish. For unsupported triples the actual product of three complete circles kills the regular saturated six-head boundary source before the exterior or the mark acts, by the exposed six-port pruning theorem. Thus there is no missing marked-white boundary current in the COMPLETE-circle sum. This is a whole-source statement; it is not an assertion that an arbitrary open local current vanishes. At the reflected boundary identify its labels by the actual reversed cyclic port map. Equation (4) makes its coherent packet the conjugate of Z_Gamma, while theta is symmetric and positive. Therefore the RAW original source of the double is exactly Z_double = sum_(a,b,c in D_N) |Z_Gamma(a,b,c)|^2/theta_N(a,b,c) >= 0. (6) All interior color sums in each factor of (6) are performed coherently. The sum includes every physical seam triple. Both parity cases and all paired first normals occur. If D_N is empty the sum and source are zero. If D_N is nonempty, strict positivity holds exactly when at least one coherent boundary packet is nonzero. No universal nonvanishing premise for an unknown primitive piece is added. ## 4. What the positive formula controls quantitatively Define the actual weighted boundary maximum B_N=max_(j in D_N) |Z_Gamma(j)|/sqrt(theta_N(j)). When the supported set is nonempty, B_N^2 <= Z_double <= |D_N| B_N^2, |D_N| <= N^3. (7) Hence whenever the source is nonzero its complete exponential rate is controlled, with an O(log N/N) error, by the largest COHERENT weighted boundary packet. This is a full-source estimate, not a norm of one fixed central channel or an absolute magnetic-state envelope. Equation (6) does not make the inside of each Z_Gamma a positive factorial sum. Estimating that coherent packet is still required to identify (7) with the actual doubled hyperbolic volume. In particular known projected cube or ladder packets cannot be substituted for the full Z_Gamma in (6). The double class has arbitrary fixed primitive size; it is a specified subclass of physical planar sources, not a proof for every fixed k-bridge skeleton. ## 5. A literal full-color NC cube double There is an especially direct certificate using the original ordered cube, with interval black vertex (0,1,2) and outer white vertex (0,10,11). Its ribbon reflection swaps the color classes and has edge permutation (1 10)(2 11)(4 7)(5 8), with 0,3,6,9 fixed. (8) It maps the interval black boundary to the outer white boundary IN THE DISPLAYED ORDER. The induced rotations at the other vertices are the genuine pivotal cyclic moves, not plain magnetic-leg swaps. Insert the reflected cube at that interval by the existing literal NC graft. The result has fourteen trivalent vertices and twenty-one complete circles. Its original mark stays exposed in that construction. Reflecting the signed interior edge exponents by (8) gives exactly (6). The focused audit computes this TWENTY-ONE-CIRCLE source directly by full physical magnetic tensors, with all colors already assembled in each complete L_N coupon. It independently compares the result to the supported three-color sum in (6), and checks each reflected boundary packet against the conjugate-root calculation. In particular none of its cycle colors is frozen to the central channel. Audit: [whole-word reflection and full physical doubles](../experiments/audit_actual_planar_three_port_reflection_double.py). Independent geometric/source review: full analytical read and fresh audit PASS at six levels and twelve full twenty-one-circle sources. The reviewer checked the whole-word cup scales, full-normal circle reflection, common generic trace factor for legitimate cuts, regular three-port column in the actual sewn Morse disk, saturated-source pruning, and the one-circle seam normalization. This is an internal proof audit, not a claimed full-source volume estimate. Independent coherent-partner review: full analytical read and fresh six-level/twelve-source replay PASS. The reviewer separately checked the whole-word reflection and cut scalar, full Hermite sector identity, single generic theta normal, saturated boundary pruning, and inclusion of every interior and seam color at both parities. No correction was required; the remaining coherent half-packet size estimate is explicit.

title: The original plat source has explicit cup/cap Gram supports
text: # The original plat source has explicit cup/cap Gram supports 28 October 2026. For EVERY fixed actual 2k-head plat word, the original scalar has an exact matrix-element presentation between two specified positive pure states, with a unitary pivot and explicit polynomial normalization. No period is divided out and neither state is chosen to favor a geometric saddle. The transported cup state satisfies the actual incoming inverse-meridian constraints exactly. The cap state has the outgoing inverse-meridian constraints in mean square with O(N^-2) error. Hence their positive moment limits have the two honest compact braid/cap supports. Their intersection satisfies precisely the plat representation relations within this bounded star-character space. It is not asserted to exhaust the unrestricted representation variety. The overlap need not have nonzero limiting mass. No exponential overlap estimate, joint atomic-shape comparison or volume bound is inferred. ## 1. Exact ORIGINAL source, after its permitted whole-degree restriction Use N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2 and x=-q^(-1), with the original balanced basis and actual pivot g_i=x^(1-N)Q^(-i). On a standard neighboring primal/dual pair the original left cup p and ordinary right cap l are p_(i,j)=N x^(-j) delta_(i+j,d), l_(i,j)=x^j g_i/N delta_(i+j,d). Since |x|=1, l=N^(-2) p^* G, G=diag(g on the primal leg). (1) Both the N and 1/N are the literal actual turn normalizations. The full original marked cap is m_(i,j)=x^j/N^2, with NO degree delta. It is not changed termwise in an arbitrary decomposed tensor. Put u=p^(tensor k). It has total INTEGER degree kd. Every ORIGINAL crossing preserves that degree, so the fully assembled W u still has degree kd. The k-1 ordinary top caps force degree d on each of their pairs. Consequently the last MARKED pair also has degree d in the whole scalar pairing. On that specific degree-d subspace, m=N^(-3)p^*. (2) Thus with any chosen marked pair r_*, the exact originally pointed plat scalar is P_N=chi_N N^(-2k-1) <u,G_top W u>, G_top=product_(r!=r_*) diag(g on primal leg of pair r). (3) Here chi_N is the unchanged original external line, including whatever framing/full peripheral convention has been specified. No component of g or chi_N is reset. Formula (3) uses integer-degree conservation BEFORE the marked-cap restriction. The replacement (2) is not asserted for arbitrary degree-changing coupon insertions or for separated nonconserving current sectors. In the actual flat metric ||p||^2=N^3, so ||u||^2=N^(3k). Define uhat=u/N^(3k/2), phihat=G_top^* uhat. The pivot is unitary, and g=x^(-N)K on each primal head. Hence G_top is a fixed-degree bounded polynomial in the original Cartans, with its exact parity phase retained. Equation (3) becomes P_N=chi_N N^(k-1) <phihat,W uhat>. (4) This is an exact same-source scalar identity, not positivity of a pivotal trace. The states here are fixed by the actual turns. ## 2. The actual inverse-meridian equations of every cup Let the bounded physical based quantum meridians H_j and their exact transport be those of [the all-word theorem](actual_bounded_quantum_meridian_transport.md). Define, as a two-by-two matrix of physical operators, A_r=H_(2r)H_(2r-1)-I, 1<=r<=k. (5) EVERY entry of A_r annihilates u exactly. Here is a direct proof. On the local pair the actual cup obeys E_tot p=0, F_tot p=0, K_tot p=p. The two product matrices L_(-,2)L_(-,1) and L_(+,2)L_(+,1) therefore act as the identity on each auxiliary component of p. Their ratio is precisely the local H_2 H_1, so its difference from I kills p. For a later pair the global based product is P^(-1)(H_2 H_1)P, where P consists only of earlier heads. Its matrix entries commute with the local pair's entries. Thus each term of the difference still annihilates that cup, irrespective of the state on the earlier heads. This proves (5) for the full tensor u, with the original ordering. The total product T=H_(2k)...H_1 also acts as I on u and is preserved by W. Its preservation follows from the original total E,F,K Hopf intertwining, equivalently the preserved products of L_+ and L_-. Let psi_N=W uhat/||W uhat||. It exists for EVERY N because W is invertible and uhat is nonzero; no assumption on the scalar pairing (4) is required. Define A_(r,W)=W A_r W^(-1). All of these are the N-uniformly bounded Nielsen polynomials already proved in the physical-meridian theorem, and A_(r,W) psi_N=0, (T-I)psi_N=0. (6) Thus for the POSITIVE pure Gram state of psi_N, <psi_N,A_(r,W)^* A_(r,W)psi_N>=0 (7) entrywise, exactly at each level. These are the actual transported bottom cup constraints, not a newly imposed classical graph. ## 3. The actual top cap has controlled mean-square support The cap state in (4) is phihat=G_top^* uhat. Since A_r uhat=0, A_r phihat=[A_r,G_top^*] uhat. (8) All entries of A_r and G_top are fixed-degree polynomials in the actual bounded scaled head observables. Their star commutators have the proved norm bound C_k/N. Therefore ||(A_r)_(ab) phihat||<=C_k/N, <phihat,(A_r)_(ab)^*(A_r)_(ab)phihat><=C_k^2/N^2. (9) This includes the marked pair: it has no pivot of its own in G_top, but pivots on earlier heads can enter its based prefix. Equation (8) handles them rather than treating the based constraint as a local unbased one. The estimate is independent of W and does not replace the original marked source before its permitted whole-degree use. The stronger exact cap-row equations for ordinary top caps are also consistent with (9); they are not needed to infer support here. ## 4. Positive limits and the honest plat intersection The all-word bound supplies a common finite bounded star family for H_j, all W H_j W^(-1), their entries and adjoints. Their commutators are O(1/N). Consequently subsequential moment limits of the two positive pure states have compact commutative realizations as in the physical-meridian theorem. At every character write h_j for the SL2 matrices determined by H_j; the physical meridians are -h_j and have trace two. The limiting cup measure is supported by phi_W(h_(2r))phi_W(h_(2r-1))=I for all r, h_(2k)...h_1=I, (10) where phi_W is the EXACT Nielsen word read contravariantly from the actual W. This follows from the zero mean squares (7). The cap measure is supported by h_(2r)h_(2r-1)=I for all r, (11) by (9). No positivity of the original pivotal closing is assumed. The intersection of (10) and (11) is the subset of the bounded character space satisfying the honest plat representation relations, including degenerate/central meridians. To verify the group statement, take free meridian generators at the braid's top. Each top cap identifies its two oriented meridians as inverses, giving (11). Pull the bottom meridians through the literal braid Hurwitz words; its bottom caps then give precisely (10). These are exactly the Wirtinger/van-Kampen identifications of the plat diagram. The total product relation is redundant once all adjacent cap products are I, but it is genuinely retained by the quantum source as well. For a one-component knot any noncentral trace-two meridian has parabolic centralizer, so its commuting peripheral image is boundary-parabolic. If it is central in PSL2, normal generation makes the representation trivial. Hence the sharp representation volume bound applies to every representation in this intersection. This is not yet a claim that its joint atomic shapes have the saturated critical regulator values. ## 5. A bounded overlap limit also has this intersection support There is a further statement which does not assume a nonzero overlap. For any fixed polynomial observable F in that bounded star family set omega_N(F)=<phihat,F psi_N>. (12) Its norm is at most the operator norm of F. Polarization expresses it as a linear combination of four positive vector Gram functionals of phihat+i^j psi_N, whose norms are at most four. Their subsequential compact commutative realizations from Section 4 therefore give a bounded complex measure for (12), possibly the ZERO measure. From (6) we have omega_N(F A_(r,W))=0. From (9), <phihat,A_r^* F psi_N>=O(1/N); commuting fixed-degree observables changes this by O(1/N). Consequently the limit annihilates every polynomial multiple of A_(r,W) and A_r^*. Including all adjoints and using continuous approximation shows that it is supported on the intersection (10)-(11). There is no division by omega_N(1) or P_N. These moments belong to the exact scalar representation (4). They are not asserted equal to old marked-cap moments after arbitrary degree-changing coupon insertions, for which (2) need not hold. The distinction from an exponential theorem is essential. From (4), |P_N|=|chi_N| N^(k-1)||W uhat|| |omega_N(1)|. (13) The overlap can be exponentially small, and every fixed-degree moment in (12) can then tend to zero. The separate positive cup and cap measures do not create a normalized overlap measure or a nonzero intersection coefficient. Dividing by that small overlap would destroy the uniform moment bound just proved. No claim is made that the discrete-faithful point lies in this real compact intersection. Complex stationary deformation and its original source still matter. The new unconditional result is the SAME original scalar's explicit cup/cap support and bounded overlap-support statements, for all widths and words. A sharp upper bound still needs exponential control of that overlap and of the associated atomic regulator at singular shape charts. A volume lower bound also needs nonzero geometric selection. Neither conclusion is inferred here. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_plat_gram_support.py): exact full marked-source reduction, all cup and transported constraints, retained total product and pivots, plus direct flat-complex mean-square cap bounds. Both crossing signs and marked-pair locations are retained.

title: A source-exact bulk Agmon energy for the actual pointed quantum-A system
text: # A source-exact bulk Agmon energy for the actual pointed quantum-A system 28 October 2026. The actual bounded-jet pointed system admits a positive weighted energy with its ORIGINAL boundary source. On any compact arc whose weighted classical symbol has a fixed gap from zero, a direct localized Plancherel argument bounds the interior energy by that source and explicit boundary packets. No eigenvector diagonalization, global inverse bound or cancellation of source terms is assumed. This is a quantitative general theorem for the actual fixed-band system of EVERY knot. It is local in the color coordinate: turning-point, resonance and end packets remain. It does not yet give their sharp geometric connection estimate or a new volume-conjecture class. ## 1. Actual system and exact positive weighted energy Use the uniformly scaled bounded-jet matrix and source of [the pointed Gram theorem](pointed_a_gram_period.md), M_N y=b_N, R_N y=(C_(j_*),...,C_N)^t. (1) Its block size and bandwidth are fixed independently of N, all entries are uniformly bounded, and b_N is supported on the prescribed fixed number of INITIAL IDENTITY rows. Those initial jet values are fixed small-color Laurent polynomials and their bounded-order jets; their scaled norms are uniformly bounded. Every solution has the same constant-color vector, even when its higher jets are not unique. Interior recurrence rows, indexed by their initial color j, have form (M_N y)_j=sum_(i=0)^d A_(i,N)(j) y_(j+i). Uniformly on compact color intervals, their fixed-size matrix coefficients satisfy A_(i,N)(j)=A_i(j/N)+O(1/N), A_i are continuously differentiable. (2) These are not assumptions about an unknown asymptotic solution. For the actual system they follow directly from its finite monomial and binomial formula (2.1) and the N^-r jet scaling. Its symbol is exactly the proved block polynomial A_B(x,L) of equation (5.2) there. Possible root-level nullspaces and the entire jet budget remain in (1). Let phi be a fixed real C2 function of x=j/N. Give each COLUMN color block weight exp(N phi(j/N)), calling the resulting diagonal matrix W_c. Give a recurrence ROW the same weight at its row label j; each initial identity row receives the weight of its prescribed color. Call this W_r. Define u=W_c y, L_(phi,N)=W_r M_N W_c^-1, P_(phi,N)=L_(phi,N)^dagger L_(phi,N). (3) Then, EXACTLY, L_(phi,N)u=W_r b_N, <u,P_(phi,N)u>=||W_r b_N||^2. (4) This is the full sourced Hermitian energy. No affine term or normal component has been discarded. Choose phi(0)=0. Since the source colors are fixed, their N phi(j/N) are bounded; the right side of (4) is uniformly bounded. The original complete color is still the selected constant jet in (1), not an arbitrary solution of the principal symbol. Despite the potentially exponential values of W_c and W_r themselves, the nonzero entries of L_(phi,N) involve only bounded local ratios. In an interior row their leading coefficients are A_i(x) exp(-i phi'(x)), (5) where i in (5) is the INTEGER shift index, not sqrt(-1). The uniform error is O(1/N). Thus L_phi and P_phi still have bounded entries and fixed bandwidth. The Hermitian bulk symbol is the POSITIVE matrix A_B(x,exp(-phi'(x)) L)^dagger A_B(x,exp(-phi'(x)) L), |L|=1. (6) It is not obtained by silently treating a moving eigenframe as unitary. ## 2. A proved local coercivity theorem Let I be a compact color interval contained in (0,1). Suppose the explicit weighted block symbol satisfies sigma_min A_B(x,exp(-phi'(x)) exp(i theta))>=eta>0 for x in I, theta real. (7) This is independently checkable from the specified finite operator. For the actual lower-triangular jet symbol, invertibility is equivalent to the scalar A_cl not vanishing on that circle. On a compact arc fixed dimension and continuity then give the positive eta; no semisimplicity or separation of different eigenvalues is needed. For vectors u supported in I and a fixed small interior margin, ||L_(phi,N)u|| >=(eta-C N^-1/2)||u||. (8) Here the operator includes EVERY row meeting that support. There is no artificial Dirichlet deletion of its boundary output rows. Proof. On the color lattice choose a bounded-overlap partition sum_l chi_l^2=1 with windows of length ell=floor(sqrt(N)) and |chi_l(j+i)-chi_l(j)|<=C/ell for bounded i. Freeze (5) at each window center. The full-line constant-coefficient operator has Fourier multiplier A_B(x_l,exp(-phi'(x_l))exp(i theta)); ordinary Plancherel and (7) give norm at least eta on every localized vector. The difference from the actual operator is at most C ell/N on each window by (2) and phi in C2. Bounded overlap gives the same bound after summing the squared localized norms. Its commutator with chi_l has summed norm at most C/ell times ||u||, by fixed bandwidth and the displayed difference bound. Since sum_l ||chi_l L_phi u||^2 =||L_phi u||^2, the direct-sum triangle inequality yields eta||u|| <=||L_phi u||+C(ell/N+1/ell)||u||. This is (8). The proof handles block coefficients, repeated roots away from the weighted circle, and nonnormal actual transfers. ## 3. Apply it to the ORIGINAL response, keeping boundary currents Let chi be a smooth cutoff supported in I and equal to one on a smaller interval I'. Let B_chi contain all its transition colors and their fixed bandwidth neighbors. Applying (8) to chi u and using the EXACT equation (4) gives, for large N, ||chi u|| <=(2/eta)[ ||chi W_r b_N|| +(C/N)||u restricted to B_chi|| ]. (9) The cutoff on recurrence rows uses their original label j. On initial identity rows it uses their prescribed color, so the source convention is unchanged. Formula (9) follows from L_phi(chi u)=chi W_r b_N+[L_phi,chi]u. The commutator is EXPLICITLY supported in B_chi and has norm at most C/N for a fixed scaled cutoff. A cutoff over ell lattice steps instead has C/ell and its corresponding retained boundary packet. These are the original normal/endpoint flux terms of the estimate; they are not asserted small without their actual source connection. Since R_N selects the constant jet and commutes with the color weight, (9) also bounds the weighted interior ordinary-color energy. It holds for every actual truncated-jet solution; higher-jet nonuniqueness is not removed by choosing a favorable solution. A global kernel can still be supported by the boundary packets, and nothing here divides by an unproved finite Evans or resonance determinant. ## 4. A regulator barrier is a possible weight, not a free boundary estimate On a genuinely identified peripheral branch set phi(x)=-R(x)/(2pi). In the recorded color convention dR/dx=2pi log|L_branch|, so exp(-phi')=|L_branch|. Exactly at that eikonal radius the symbol gap (7) is zero. On a compact regular arc with distinct root moduli one may tilt phi' by a fixed small amount so its circle lies strictly between adjacent root moduli. Then (7)--(9) hold. The tilt can tend to zero AFTER the large-N bound, while every boundary packet remains. This gives genuine controlled propagation THROUGH a forbidden bulk arc, rather than assuming contraction of instantaneous eigenvectors. It works at eigenvalue collisions away from the chosen weighted circle as well. At a root on that circle the estimate stops; the corresponding turning or interface packet must be connected by an additional source estimate. The original fixed initial packet and complete-color resonance also remain. The geometric bound |R|<=Vol(X) bounds this ABSOLUTE weight whenever the spectral component has actually been identified as a peripheral representation branch. It does not bound its omitted boundary packets, choose among several branches, or prove such an identification for an arbitrary annihilator. A general sharp upper theorem still needs a source-compatible connection estimate across the finite set of turning/interface/end packets. Equations (4) and (9) show precisely where their cumulative amplification enters; it cannot be replaced by uniqueness or by a largest-root integral. The SOURCE ANCHOR must also remain. For the polynomial initial-source bound following (4), normalize instead phi(x)=-[R(x)-R(0)]/(2pi). Recovering an unweighted value then costs the regulator DIFFERENCE R(x)-R(0), whose geometric bound is in general 2Vol(X), not Vol(X). Keeping phi=-R/(2pi) simply puts the compensating exponential into the weighted initial source. Fixed small-color pointing does not by itself prove that every spectral branch has regulator zero there. A sharp bound needs its actual branch/source normalization as well as the boundary connections. No constant action shift has been used to conceal that factor. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_pointed_a_bulk_agmon.py): the actual figure-eight affine coefficients with fixed original source, weighted positive-energy identities, compact off-root-circle bulk coercivity, and the retained cutoff commutator equation. Numerical checks supplement the all-fixed-band proof (2)--(9), not a new knot-class assertion.

title: Quantitative inward propagation for the actual pointed-A boundary response
text: # Quantitative inward propagation for the actual pointed-A boundary response 28 October 2026. A uniformly off-characteristic color interval has a controlled whole-line Green extension and an explicit finite-interval observability estimate. Weighted energy entering from its retained boundary packets decays exponentially inward. The constants remain polynomial when the spectral gap shrinks slower than N^-1/2. This upgrades [bulk Agmon coercivity](actual_pointed_a_bulk_agmon_energy.md) to a resolvent and a maximum estimate for the actual fixed-band source system. It accounts for nonnormality without diagonalizing transfers. Both boundary packets remain in the general case. It is not a claim that an arbitrary square finite compression has a tame inverse, or that the required right-hand source packet is already bounded by volume. ## 1. Broad operator class and actual inputs Let the block size r and shift radius d>=1 be fixed. On a lattice interval J=[a,b] of length O(N), consider the ACTUAL weighted recurrence (L_N u)_j=sum_(i=-d)^d C_(i,N)(j) u_(j+i). (1) The forward-only case has zero coefficients for negative i. Assume uniform boundedness of the coefficients, and that they are within C/N of matrices A_(i,N)(j/N) having a uniform Lipschitz bound on J/N. The functions A may depend on N. Suppose sigma_min(sum_i A_(i,N)(x) exp(i i theta))>=eta_N>0 for x in J/N, theta real. (2) In exp(i i theta), the first i is sqrt(-1), the second the integer shift index. The notation is solely the Fourier symbol of (1). Require eta_N>=4C_0 N^-1/2, where C_0 depends on those uniform bounds and on fixed r,d. Eventually strict inequality suffices. These are independently checkable coefficient hypotheses. For the actual pointed jet matrix, after its proved jet scaling and color weight exp(N phi_N(x)), its symbol is A_B(x,exp(-phi_N'(x))exp(i theta)). The hypotheses above follow from the actual finite monomial formula whenever phi_N' and phi_N'' are uniformly bounded and this radius has gap eta_N. No unknown period is used. All original jet components and source rows remain. A shrinking radius tilt with a fixed smooth profile is allowed; an unbounded derivative of that profile is not. ## 2. A controlled whole-line extension and inverse Extend each coefficient sequence constantly beyond the two ends of J. Equivalently clamp the symbol path at its endpoint values; the actual coefficients keep their O(1/N) error there. This defines an auxiliary operator L_ext on ell2(Z,C^r), agreeing with the actual recurrence on J. The extension is part of the PROOF; it replaces neither the original outside word nor its source. The sqrt(N)-window Plancherel argument gives ||L_ext v|| >=(eta_N-C_0 N^-1/2)||v|| >=eta_N||v||/2. (3) The same proof applies to L_ext^dagger. Its coefficients are shifted adjoints of those in (1), hence have the same slow variation, and its frozen symbol is the adjoint of (2), with the same singular-value gap. Thus its kernel is zero too. The range of L_ext is closed by (3) and dense by the zero adjoint kernel. Therefore it is onto and G_N=L_ext^-1 exists, ||G_N||<=2/eta_N. (4) This is a two-sided, source-independent resolvent theorem, with no assumption of normal matrices or distinct eigenvalues. The constants do not grow with interval length. The proof uses full output rows; it does not discard the leakage rows at an interval endpoint. ## 3. Exponential Green decay, proved by bounded conjugations Put K_1=sum_i |i|sup_j||C_(i,N)(j)|| and K_1^+=max(1,K_1). Choose mu_N=min(1/d, eta_N/(8K_1^+)). (5) For a fixed source color k, multiply by the BOUNDED weights W_R(j)=exp(mu_N min(|j-k|,R)). Their neighboring ratios differ from one by at most exp(mu_N|i|)-1<=2mu_N|i|. Consequently ||W_R L_ext W_R^-1-L_ext||<=2mu_N K_1<=eta_N/4. Neumann inversion using (4) bounds the conjugated inverse by 4/eta_N, uniformly in R. Applying it to a block point source at k and then letting R increase proves the explicit kernel bound ||(G_N)_(j,k)||<= (4/eta_N)exp(-mu_N|j-k|). (6) No unbounded conjugation or imported decay theorem is used. Block sources and multiplicities are included in the operator norm. ## 4. Exact finite-interval boundary observability Suppose u is the ORIGINAL response on J and satisfies (1)=f on all rows whose stencil is inside J. Let J_in=[a+d,b-d]; retaining this slightly smaller row set works for both shift orientations. Zero extend u from J and call it u_J. Then exactly L_ext u_J=1_(J_in)f+B_left u_left+B_right u_right. (7) The two u-side packets contain the first and last 2d physical color blocks of J. The two B operators are simply the corresponding boundary rows of L_ext; they are explicit, have fixed support and uniformly bounded norm. Their row supports lie within distance d of the respective endpoint. If J is shorter than 4d the analogous finite-dimensional estimate uses all its blocks as boundary data. Uniqueness of (4) gives an EXACT representation by applying G_N to (7). In particular ||u_J||_2 <=C eta_N^-1 (||f_(J_in)||_2+||u_left||_2+||u_right||_2). (8) More precisely, for any j in J, (6) gives ||u_j|| <=C eta_N^-1 [ sum_(k in J_in) exp(-mu_N|j-k|)||f_k|| +exp(-mu_N dist(j,left))||u_left||_2 +exp(-mu_N dist(j,right))||u_right||_2 ]. (9) The fixed-width ambiguity in dist is absorbed into C. Summing the geometric series proves the uniform maximum/observability estimate sup_J||u_j|| <=C eta_N^-1(1+mu_N^-1) (sup_(J_in)||f_j||+||u_left||+||u_right||). (10) Thus a regular homogeneous bulk transmits only the retained boundary packets, with exponential distance suppression. On a compact bulk interval of the actual pointed jet system, its initial identity rows lie outside J, so f is zero in (9); this is NOT a replacement by an arbitrary homogeneous solution. Those initial rows remain original boundary data. More general actual affine sources may lie inside a regular interval; their full row and column weighting remains in f. An initial identity row is not silently assigned the bulk symbol (2). For eta_N=N^-gamma with 0<=gamma<1/2, the inverse and maximum constants are polynomial and the decay length is O(N^gamma). Thus the loss is exp(o(N)), even for a shrinking off-characteristic tilt. This also applies to the full normal-jet blocks, not only their constant-color projection. The latter can be selected afterwards. ## 5. Which boundary data are genuinely necessary The general estimate needs BOTH sides. Spectral gap alone does not make a recurrence stable in the forward direction. The elementary scalar recurrence u_(j+1)=2u_j has a fixed unit-circle gap, yet left data u_0=1 grow to 2^j. Its reciprocal recurrence demonstrates the opposite direction. These examples concern the broad operator class, not a proposed replacement knot state. Nor does (4) prove a tame inverse for any chosen square compression. For example I-2T has min_(|L|=1)|1-2L|=1, but the n-by-n upper bidiagonal compression has inverse sum_(k=0)^(n-1)2^k T^k, of norm at least 2^(n-1). It has dropped an output leakage row and imposed the wrong boundary condition. The full-output estimate and (7) retain precisely the boundary data which prevent that inference. There is a genuine one-sided improvement under an EXTRA checkable stability condition. Suppose the monic actual companion equals T(j/N) up to O(1/N), with T uniformly bounded and Lipschitz, and has uniformly rho(T(x))<=1-delta on the interval. Then its positive Lyapunov metric sum_(k>=0)(T^dagger)^k T^k/(1-delta/2)^(2k) is uniformly bounded and Lipschitz. Its neighboring metric changes are 1+O(1/N), so for large N the actual transfer contracts by 1-c_delta. Variation of constants gives a uniform one-sided bound from the full LEFT initial packet and its actual sources. If the inverse companions have that property, the analogous theorem uses the RIGHT packet. Mixed stable/unstable spectra do not satisfy either premise. For an actual geometric radius between spectral branches, mixed spectra are the usual case. The missing incoming packet is then genuine source data, not an error that the local gap controls. The pointed initial rows, cyclic root matching and normal resonance must determine it with a quantified bound. This is exactly the boundary-response problem retained by the positive Schur reduction. For the ACTUAL bounded-jet problem the initial fixed-color packet is known polynomially, including all its retained jets. The far packet is different: the ordinary-color theorem bounds only CONSTANT values C_j(q_N), j<N, not their q-normal jets. Those jets, and the complete coordinate itself, may carry exponential size. Replacing the full right-hand packet in (8)--(10) by the ordinary-color bound would therefore drop source data. Bounding it by an unknown multiple of the target period would not close the estimate either. An actual cyclic/Weyl or source-Schur certificate is needed there. ## 6. Consequence for a sharp volume estimate The theorem gives controlled inward propagation on every certified regular interval. It accounts for repeated roots away from the chosen circle, nonnormal jet blocks and shrinking gaps. A regulator primitive is a legitimate weight there only on a genuinely identified peripheral branch. It must also retain its SOURCE anchor: normalizing the small-color source changes the recovery factor to R(x)-R(0), which may be as large as twice the knot volume. It follows that a sharp Vol upper bound needs a quantified connection of the actual endpoint/turning packets, with that source anchoring. Equations (7)--(10) remove uncontrolled regular-interval amplification from this question; they do not supply those remaining boundary values or assume them equal to the desired invariant. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_pointed_a_interval_observability.py): actual full-source figure-eight intervals with full leakage rows, explicit nonnormal Green kernels and the finite-compression caution. The all-operator proof is (2)--(10); the finite checks do not assert a new sharp knot class.

title: The actual pointed commutant is scalar on its selected Mellin state
text:
# The actual pointed commutant is scalar on its selected Mellin state Research obstruction and constructive formal adapter, 27 October 2026. The canonical actual Mellin companion cannot directly provide a nontrivial irreducible critical-field observable through an endomorphism which commutes with whole quantum transport and preserves its source lattice. Such endomorphisms have a scalar character on the selected state. A concrete critical observable instead exists on the actual partial Gaussian insertion module; it has a covariant, rather than horizontal, transport rule. No geometric candidate for the final selected cyclotomic residue is constructed here. The distinction identifies a necessary change of object before applying the critical trace nonvanishing theorem. ## 1. The entire admissible horizontal lattice is one-dimensional Use the original [actual Mellin source](fourier_mellin_actual_source.md), with F=k(Q,X), R=k(Q)[[X]], sigma(X)=QX, and Q an indeterminate: \[ AZ=B
e0,\qquad Z\in X^{n_0}R,\qquad \widehat A=(S-\sigma(B)/B)A. \] All fixed left-shift conventions, source coefficients and finite color pointing are those of that construction. Its exact affine equation has exactly one solution in this lattice. Let d be the order of \(\widehat A\), C its forward companion, \(T=C^{-1}\sigma\), \(v=J_dZ\), and \(\ell J_df=Af/B\). If \(w\in k(Q)((X))^d\) satisfies \(Tw=w\), the companion's first rows force \(w=J_dW\) for its first component W.
