title: Actual middle-Pachner saturation with its compulsory source current
text: # Actual middle-Pachner saturation with its compulsory source current 28 October 2026. The literal middle five-point crossing identity has an exact ordered version of the polynomial which removes the spurious cleared Pachner component. It holds on the ORIGINAL finite heads with their missing arrow retained. The ordinary commutative polynomial is not zero as an actual sourced operator: its error is an explicitly retained commutator current. A two-component source presentation keeps this current by polynomial, invertible row and column operations. This is a local exact source relation, applicable inside any original word and to all formal normal coefficients. It is not an estimate on all analytic endpoints of the scalar period, nor a proof of its nonzero geometric coefficient. In particular, no exponential estimate on the inverse of a face frame is asserted. ## 1. The actual middle faces Use the complete original heads and conventions of the [literal middle identity](literal_middle_full_phi_certificate.md): Q=exp(2pi*i/N), d=N-1, x_c=-q^(-1), S_1^N=mu, S_2^N=x_c^N mu, X=x_c S_2 S_1^(-1), Z=Z_1, XZ=QZX, X^N=Z^N=1. The cyclic heads have the required opposite wrap when N is even. Let E_0 be the ORIGINAL first-clock projector onto index zero. Thus E_0(1-Z)=0. The actual nilpotent crossing argument and its fifth clock are n=(Q-Z^(-1))X, P=P(n), H=P^(-1)ZP=Z(1-n)=Z+(1-QZ)X, H^N=1, where P is the finite Euler polynomial of the original crossing. Only H is inverted below. It is an actual clock unit; neither 1-Z nor E_0 nor another nilpotent face wall is inverted. For the present Pachner coordinates put x=1-X, y=1-Z, w=xy, H=1-w, K=X(1-E_0), u=1-KH^(-1), v=1-ZH^(-1). (1) The equality H=1-(1-X)(1-Z) follows from XZ=QZX. These are the specified actual middle faces after the required quad changes, not independently chosen shapes. Indeed the developed cut argument in the literal middle identity is QK, and its ratio is r=QKH^(-1). Consequently u=1-Q^(-1)r, v=-Q^(-1)n(1-Q^(-1)n)^(-1). (2) The latter follows by conjugating n with Z. Thus the Q-shift and the nilpotent quad inverse are explicit. At a commutative regular symbol, (1) gives exactly w=xy, u=x(1-y)/(1-w), v=y(1-x)/(1-w), (3) the rational Pachner map in the [saturated critical compactification](saturated_critical_regulator_compactification.md). ## 2. The finite wall and an ordered saturation theorem The right-cleared graph equations of (1) are EXACTLY uH-x+w=XE_0=:E, vH-y+w=0, E y=XE_0(1-Z)=0. (4) The first wall E is retained. It is not zero, and it cannot be deleted inside an arbitrary original word. It is the same missing arrow seen in the literal middle certificate, in its present orientation. Define the bounded-degree ordered polynomial g_q=uv-u w v+u w+w v-w. (5) Then g_q=0 (6) as an actual finite operator, for every N and every nonzero typed wrap mu. The proof only uses (4) and that H=1-w is a unit: g_q H=(w+uH)(w+vH)-w =(x+E)y-xy =E y=0. (7) In the first equality H commutes with w; no other factors are commuted. Cancelling H is valid since H^(-1)=H^(N-1) here. Equation (7) is a source-level replacement for dividing the commutative cleared equations by a vanishing determinant. Its wall is killed by its actual adjacent face y, rather than discarded. There is also a representation-independent version. In any unital algebra, choose X,Z,E_0 satisfying E_0(1-Z)=0 and assume H=1-(1-X)(1-Z) is a unit. Definitions (1) then satisfy (4)--(7), without a q-commutation or a cyclic-power hypothesis. The root representation establishes the required unit for the actual crossing, while this universal form proves the normal-jet result below. ## 3. Why the classical polynomial alone changes the source Choose the ordering of the ordinary saturated polynomial to be g_bare=uv-w(1-u)(1-v), C=[u,w]. Expansion without any commutations gives g_q=g_bare+C(1-v), g_bare=-C(1-v). (8) Thus for ANY input psi, output functional Lambda and original exterior operators A,B, including all other heads, Lambda(A g_bare B psi) =-Lambda(A C(1-v) B psi). (9) This uses exactly the same exterior/source on both sides. No Hopf-invariance of the inserted coupon is assumed and no cut is relocated. Tensoring by identities and applying any original closure, framing, peripheral scalar or divided co-source preserves the equality. The current is compulsory even for the smallest actual cup. At N=2, Q=-1, x_c=i, with the original balanced ordered basis, take S_1=[[0,1],[1,0]], S_2=[[0,-1],[1,0]], X=i S_1 tensor S_2, Z=diag(1,-1) tensor I, p=(0,-2i,2,0)^t, m=(1,i,1,i)/4. These are the original cup and full marker, with mp=1. Direct exact calculation gives m g_bare p=1, m C(1-v)p=-1. (10) The audit also inserts both sides of (9) at an interior position of the original figure-eight braid, retaining both original pivotal closures and the original averaged first cut. They cancel there exactly. The test does not replace that cut by a highest entry after the inserted nonintertwining coupon. In particular, (6) does not authorize imposing g_bare=0 in the actual coupon algebra. That would contradict (10) and the already proved [faithful-source obstruction](actual_source_quotient_and_critical_relation.md). A commutator current may cost powers of the semiclassical parameter while retaining the full exponential rate. No smaller exponential rate is claimed for the right side of (9). There is a stronger, fixed-degree description of this current on the actual q-torus. The cut K satisfies KZ=QZK, H=Z+K-KZ. The second identity uses XE_0(1-Z)=0, so it retains precisely the same physical missing arrow. Expanding the commutator gives [K,H]=(Q-1)(1-K)ZK, C=[u,w]=[K,H]H^(-1) =(Q-1)(1-K)Z(1-u). Substitute K=(1-u)H and Z=(1-v)H. The result is the exact bounded-degree polynomial identity C=(Q-1) Pi, Pi=[1-(1-u)H](1-v)H(1-u), g_bare=-(Q-1) Pi(1-v), H=1-w. (10a) In particular the right side contains no clock projector, no inverse of H, and no polynomial degree growing with N. This is stronger than relying on an unspecified principal-symbol rule for commutators. It gives an explicit integral quantum correction to the classical saturated equation. Formally setting H=0 in this polynomial face relation gives u+v=1, even before setting Q=1; thus the spurious cleared point w=1,u=v=i fails the retained quantum boundary relation too. The fixed-factor assertion in (10a) requires KZ=QZK. It is not asserted for arbitrary off-torus normal perturbations from Section 5. The more general ordered relation (6), current equation (8), and source extension below hold for those perturbations as stated. When a formal q-torus family does retain KZ=QZK, (10a) also holds over that parameter ring. No claim of a small operator norm follows from a fixed-degree expression in possibly large face operators. ## 4. An exact polynomial source-current presentation The relation can be retained as an explicit finite extension. Put K_sat=[[g_bare, C], [-(1-v), I]], U=[[I,-C],[0,I]], V=[[I,0],[1-v,I]]. Then the exact ordered matrix identity is U K_sat V=diag(0,I). (11) Both U and V have polynomial unipotent inverses. There is no face localization or division by a quantum scalar in (11); on the actual q-torus its upper-right entry is explicitly (Q-1)Pi from (10a). Its solutions are precisely psi_ext=(psi,eta), eta=(1-v)psi, K_sat psi_ext=0. (12) The original source is embedded by (12), and the original co-source is Lambda_ext=(Lambda,0), so that Lambda_ext psi_ext=Lambda psi. (13) The second copy is a retained current variable, not a new summation weight chosen to change the invariant. Eliminating that copy by the unit block gives the exact quantum relation (6), not the false classical relation g_bare=0. Conversely, deleting the current copy without this elimination loses (10). This construction works on each specified local state in a whole word. For a sequence of L local uses, retain the actual time states and append eta_j=(1-v_j)psi_j at the j-th position. There is one current copy per use. The block eliminations (11) act in their own constraint rows and remove these copies successively; the physical state transitions and their original endpoint functional are unchanged. This is a linear-size constraint/source extension for arbitrary bridge count. It is not a quotient or a semisimplification of the original full coupon algebra. ## 5. All normal coefficients and the limited leading consequence Let R be any formal parameter ring, for example the joint formal meridian and quantum-normal ring. Suppose X_R,Z_R and E_(0,R) deform the actual matrices with E_(0,R)(1-Z_R)=0. Since the constant term of H_R=1-(1-X_R)(1-Z_R) is invertible, H_R has a unique formal inverse by the finite-coefficient Neumann construction. Apply the universal algebra proof after (7). Thus (6), (8), and (11)--(13) hold over R, to ALL normal orders. Every original exterior/source and any defined residue or divided coefficient functional may be applied coefficientwise to (9). This does not assume that an auxiliary off-root Euler completion is the original crossing; those two objects have a known quantum normal discrepancy. Nor does it identify the quantum-normal filtration with the meridian-normal filtration. The claim is the stated universal zero insertion for the actual deformed coordinates where defined; the geometric face interpretation in Sections 1--2 was established on the physical root family. In a commutative leading-symbol chart compatible with multiplication for these actual face operators, with Q tending to one, the fixed polynomial correction in (10a) has zero leading symbol. Equation (6) then imposes uv-w(1-u)(1-v)=0. (14) It imposes this bounded-degree relation without having to invert the leading value of H. For example the false cleared point x=y=w=1,u=v=i has (14) equal to -1+2i and cannot be such a commutative leading face character. This is a formal support statement, conditional only on having that multiplicative symbol chart. It does not construct a uniform symbol chart at every singular scalar endpoint. The missing analytic step is specific. One still has to prove that all exponentially relevant pieces of the ORIGINAL relative cycle admit such a compatible source/current reduction, or bound the remaining pieces directly. The exact current in (9) can have the same exponential rate as the underlying period; neither local unimodular equivalence nor the classical saturation certificate proves it negligible. Likewise this one literal middle-port calculation does not supply all first/third-port identifications with a global positive triangulation. No volume lower bound or global geometric intersection is inferred. ## 6. Reproducible audit Run python3 experiments/audit_actual_quantum_pachner_saturation.py The [audit](../experiments/audit_actual_quantum_pachner_saturation.py) checks 24 actual level/wrap families (N=2 through 9), the retained wall (4), ordered relation (6), nonzero bare relation, the polynomial source extension, fixed-degree divisibility (10a), five normal coefficients under off-torus perturbations, and four original whole figure-eight closures. It also checks (10) exactly over Q(i), independently of finite fields. The adjacent JSON records the outputs. These computations audit the universal proofs; finite coverage is not used as their proof.

title: The original source is a tame nilpotent extension, not a positive trace
text: # The original source is a tame nilpotent extension, not a positive trace 28 October 2026. There is a universal, source-specific obstruction to obtaining geometric nonvanishing from an ordinary faithful positive trace on the actual root quantum-group category. Its tensor-closing map sends the identity to zero but a canonical nilpotent cup/cap to the identity. This holds at every level and can be inserted into ANY original knot cut without changing its value. The source extension is polynomially tame in the actual flat metric. Consequently this is not an obstruction to a later geometric norm comparison or emergent positive integral. It rules out deriving that comparison just from positivity/unitarity of the original categorical trace, or from a positive semisimplification which discards its jets. ## 1. Keep the actual turns and boundary projector Put N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2 and x=-q^(-1). Use the ORIGINAL balanced factorial basis w_a. The actual pivot is g_a=x^(1-N)Q^(-a), sum_a g_a=0, |g_a|=1. (1) At this color the dual color x^(-1)Q^(-1) equals x. The exact actual turns in [the bridge-source proof](quantum_bridge_cap_source.md) give the cup column p and right-cap row l on V_N tensor V_N: p_(i,j)=N x^(-j) delta_(i+j,d), l_(i,j)=x^j g_i/N delta_(i+j,d). (2) These retain the actual N, 1/N and pivot, rather than rescaling the turns to obtain a desired state. Define Pi_N=p l. Then l p=sum_i g_i=0, Pi_N^2=0, rank Pi_N=1. (3) The ORIGINAL pivotal partial closing is Phi_N(T)=Tr_2[T(I tensor g)]. (4) By direct evaluation of (2), Phi_N(I_(N^2))=0, Phi_N(Pi_N)=I_N. (5) For the second identity the only retained diagonal term has j=d-i; its coefficient is g_i g_(d-i)=1, using x^2=Q^(-1). The actual snake normalization is therefore fixed. No zero quantum dimension is divided out and no full peripheral multiplier is replaced by its root value. On the open cut retain its original e=psi phi, psi_i=1, phi_i=1/N. Thus e is an orthogonal rank-one projector in this flat metric. Define the actual two-head scalar functional Lambda_N(T)=Tr[e Phi_N(T)]. It has the exact values Lambda_N(I)=0, Lambda_N(Pi_N)=1. (6) The positive open-cut functional Tr(e C) has not been replaced. The failure of positivity is at the compulsory pivotal tensor-closing map Phi_N, before that boundary functional is applied. ## 2. No positive realization of that closing map or full source Suppose Phi_N were positive as a linear map between operator algebras with ANY positive definite Hermitian metrics. Every positive A obeys 0<=A<=r I for some r. Positivity and Phi_N(I)=0 then force 0<=Phi_N(A)<=0. Positive matrices linearly span the whole algebra, so Phi_N would be zero, contradicting Phi_N(Pi_N)=I. This proves that no change of positive head metric makes the SAME original pivotal closing a positive map. The argument does not assume the flat metric, a particular knot or an asymptotic expansion. Similarly no positive functional on a unital star algebra can have both values in (6). Cauchy--Schwarz gives |tau(a)|^2<=tau(I) tau(a^*a)=0 if tau(I)=0. It would vanish on every a. Therefore the restriction of Lambda_N to the unital actual intertwiner algebra cannot be a positive state or trace for any involution respecting that algebra. A global nonzero scalar phase does not repair a zero value on I. One cannot evade this by first taking a positive spectral corner while keeping its actual nilpotent source. The earlier direct Casimir proof gives, on the actual tensor module, Pi_N=(-1)^N (q-q^(-1))^(-2)(Omega-c_0)e_0, c_0=q+q^(-1), (7) where e_0 is the actual double-node projector. This makes Pi_N a CENTRAL nilpotent in the quantum-group intertwiner algebra. Every positive star realization of a finite-dimensional algebra kills a central nilpotent: its image commutes with its adjoint, hence is a normal nilpotent and is zero. Equivalently Cauchy--Schwarz iterated on the nilpotent selfadjoint Pi_N^* Pi_N proves its positive functional vanishes. This applies even if the corner's identity has nonzero trace. Equation (7) is the retained actual confluence, proved in [the meridian Casimir-source theorem](meridian_casimir_source.md), not an assumed property of an abstract quantum topology construction. Thus a positive reduced spectral quotient cannot preserve (6). It must retain a source/normal extension outside that ordinary quotient. ## 3. This obstruction is functorial for EVERY original knot For ANY finite cut matrix C, not only a scalar intertwiner, linearity of the partial closing and (5) give Phi_N[(C tensor I)Pi_N]=C, Lambda_N[(C tensor I)Pi_N]=Tr(e C). (8) In particular let C_K be the actual cut operator of a knot with its specified crossings, pivots and framing convention. Its original external line chi_N is retained, so its scalar is P_(K,N)=chi_N Tr(e C_K) =chi_N Lambda_N[(C_K tensor I)Pi_N]. (9) This is a canonical cup/cap realization of the SAME period for all knots and levels, not an arbitrary inserted coupon chosen to defeat a positivity claim. The actual complete cut is scalar by the already proved original quantum-group intertwining and irreducibility. If C_K=f_(K,N)I, the state in (9) is f_(K,N)Pi_N, a nilpotent multiple. Dropping the nilpotent source would erase its whole original value, not just a dispensable local correction. This explains why ordinary-color positive traces do not extend by formal faithfulness to the Kashaev color. The exact ordinary-color positive realization has zero quantum dimension at this endpoint; its positive semisimplification kills precisely the object/source which (5)-(9) retain. The separate regular-period theorem correctly uses that positivity only below color N, not for the volume target. ## 4. Original braiding is also not positively unitarizable The all-N actual Casimir interpolation retains the nonzero derivative at c_0. If B=R_checked/kappa removes only the recorded common Cartan scalar, its double-node block obeys e_0(B^2-I)=(-1)^(N+1)(N-1)(q-q^(-1))Pi_N !=0, (10) and the right side has square zero. Therefore B^2, hence B, has a nontrivial Jordan block. A unitary matrix in a positive definite metric is diagonalizable. No positive metric and no common phase normalization makes the original checked crossing unitary. This is an exact all-N consequence of the original R coefficient and the actual cap jet. The derivative interpolation and its direct matrix derivation are already in [the Casimir braiding proof](casimir_braiding_and_recoupling_lattice.md) and [the meridian source proof](meridian_casimir_source.md). We use them with their scalar and parity, rather than assuming a literature unitarity theorem. ## 5. The necessary extension is tame, but does not give a lower bound In the actual flat complex root metric, (2) gives exactly ||p||_2=N^(3/2), ||l||_2=N^(-1/2), ||Pi_N||_op=N. Also ||Phi_N||_(op->op)=N and ||Lambda_N||=N. The upper bounds follow from summing N unitary-pivot diagonal blocks. Equality for Phi uses T=I tensor g^(-1); equality for Lambda uses T=e tensor g^(-1). Thus the universal source extension costs only polynomial factors, not an unknown exponential normalization. For the assembled scalar cut there is the exact positive norm identity |P_(K,N)|=|chi_N| ||(C_K tensor I)Pi_N||_op/N. (11) Equation (11) is useful normalization information but NOT a new noncancellation mechanism: C_K already contains the original internal pivotal sums. The right side is the same unknown scalar in a canonical nilpotent line. A local geometric amplitude or ambient operator norm does not supply a lower bound for it. No source-specific broad positivity/nonvanishing theorem has been obtained here. What is decided is that the actual cyclic/Hopf source does not force it through ordinary positive trace, unitarity or a positive reduced torsor. A successful positive geometric comparison must explicitly transport the retained nilpotent/relative source and prove its nonzero geometric image. Emergent positivity of a suitably reduced global integral is not excluded by this result. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_quantum_source_positivity.py): direct actual cups/caps, pivot, Hopf invariance, original full-twist nilpotent, and functorial reconstruction of actual whole-knot cut operators.

That sign is unchanged by every partner reflection, since its exponent changes by 2D-4j, an even integer. Thus both the signed generic metric value and the positive sine-factorial convention satisfy (4). No positive-square convention is silently extended to half spins. ## 2. The full actual source fixes a reciprocal trace normalization Let A=2a,B=2b,C=2c,D0=2d,E=2e,G=2f be INTEGER highest weights. Use the ACTUAL invariant columns S_E,T_G and inverse source matrix L_(G,E) from [the generic all-port source theorem](actual_general_four_port_single_racah_kernel.md). Write its explicitly proved seven-factorial prefactor as p: L_(G,E)^ABCD=p_abcd(e,f) S. This p includes every actual cup, cyclic sign, monomial and factorial. The reciprocal coefficient is not obtained by squaring p and guessing an ordered norm ratio. Indeed let C_A move the last V_A to the front by its actual snakes, so it multiplies by (-1)^A K_A. It gives C_A S_G^BCDA=T_G^ABCD, C_A T_E^BCDA=S_E^ABCD. (5) For the second equality, the two cyclic moves interchange the two coupled pairs in S_E. This proves (5) on ALL external colors, not just on a highest corner. It follows that the actual reciprocal matrix is R_(E,G)^ABCD=L_(E,G)^BCDA. (6) The exact source prefactors consequently satisfy p_abcd(e,f) p_bcda(f,e) =[2e+1][2f+1] product_faces Delta_F^2. (7) Here is a uniform own algebraic certificate for (7). In the all-port theorem, put s=(A+B+C+D0)/2, Gmax=min(A+D0,B+C), n=(Gmax-G)/2, t0=s-Gmax and M=(Gmax+G)/2+1. Its finite product V_n can be written V_n=zeta^[n+2n(t0+n)] F_M F_(s+1-n)F_t0 / [F_(G+1)F_(s+1)F_n F_(t0+n)]. (8) Replace every symmetric factorial by zeta^[-r(r-1)/2]F_r/(1-Q)^r in the explicit source prefactor p=chi_E X_E/(b_G J_n S0 V_n). There are FOUR algebraic cases: the two choices of Gmax and the two choices of the cyclic Emax. For all four, literal cancellation gives the following ratio to the right side of (7): nonzero F_r exponents: none, residual zeta exponent:0, residual (1-Q) exponent:0, residual sign exponent: E+G-3A-2B-C-2D0. (9) This last integer is even because E=A+B mod2 and G=B+C mod2. Let M_abcd=Inv_K(V_A tensor V_B tensor V_C tensor V_D0), over generic meromorphic germs K. On this ACTUAL space let Pi_e^S and Pi_f^T be the generic rank-one channel projectors for the two pairings. Every partner has exactly the needed physical channel collision For one folded face (x,y,z) with x,y,z<=D/2 and x+y+z>=D, any subset of partner flips gives D<=x'+y'+z'<=2D, 0<=y'+z'-x'<=D, and its two cyclic versions. Applying its deficit bound to BOTH values gives max I_S <= D+min(e,e*) < N+min(e,e*). (13) All indices in I_S are nonnegative. The root Casimir eigenvalues are lambda_j(q)=q^(2j+1)+q^(-2j-1). Saturation makes the residue comparison legitimate Let O be the analytic-germ ring at zeta=q, K its fraction field, and V_A(O),... the ordinary highest-weight modules with the original balanced matrices. The tail z>2D contains the additional factor [2N] and vanishes ONLY at the value. Thus (3) has strictly positive terms. This is compatible with, and does not replace, the source/projector proof of its symmetry. ## 6. The full generic normal is retained and is not symmetric There is an EXACT generic relation in place of an incorrect jet symmetry. For a paired e write d_j=[2j+1] and let E_e=Pi_e+Pi_e* be its analytic cluster on the SAME actual source space. Equation (10) gives, before specialization, d_e* mathcal W(e*,f)^2+d_e mathcal W(e,f)^2 =[N]^2/d_f tr(E_e Pi_f). (17a) The right side is O(t), with t=log(zeta/q), whether f is paired or simple. If f is also paired, its complete double sum obeys sum_(i,j=0,1) d_(e_i)d_(f_j) mathcal W(e_i,f_j)^2 =[N]^2 tr(E_e E_f)=O(t^2). (17b) Here e_0=e,e_1=e*,f_0=f,f_1=f*. The four terms retain their full generic gauges and normal currents. Analyticity of the clusters proves the stated orders. In particular the weighted sum in (17b) has zero first normal, although its individual summands need not. These are source/projector conservation identities, not bounds on the individual cluster trace or an instruction to dephase copies. Set G(zeta)=(-1)^D S(zeta)/[N]. Termwise removal of the actual zeros gives the exact local analytic decomposition G=C+[2N]T. (18) Here C contains z<=2D and T contains z>2D, with BOTH [N] and [2N] removed in its numerator. All true denominator indices are <N, and z+1<3N on these partner branches, so C,T are analytic. For the latter bound, every folded opposite sum is >=D; replacing its four labels gives at most 4D minus that sum, hence <=3D. This accounts for every numerator zero and loses no tail. For the logarithmic generic derivative, dot G(q)=dot C(q)+4N/(q-q^-1) T(q). (19) There are actual partner branches where this additional normal is nonzero. title: The actual cyclic head has a rank-one moment relation and an orbit co-source
text: # The actual cyclic head has a rank-one moment relation and an orbit co-source Research proof, 27 October 2026. The proposed multiplicative relation is exact for the actual repaired head. Its natural moment covector differs from the original Whittaker row. Retaining their finite orbit path gives the original source and an explicit whole Ward homotopy. Actual R coefficients transport the moment framing, but do not make the orbit row an eigenrow. Thus the relation yields an exact source sum rule rather than survival of the geometric line in the last sum. This is a direct finite-matrix calculation. No classification or published multiplicative-moment proof is used. ## 1. Exact framed multiplicative relation before root specialization Use the actual matrices from [the highest/Whittaker boundary construction](actual_highest_whittaker_boundary_and_moving_walls.md): \[ B=\operatorname{diag}(1,Q,\ldots,Q^{N-1}),\quad P=\sum_{j=0}^{N-2}E_{j+1,j}+E_{0,N-1},\quad P^N=I. \] Write Z=Q^N, delta=1-Z, v=e_0, w=e_0^t, e=vw=E_00, so wv=1. Since W=eP=E_(0,N-1), the exact relation BP-QPB=delta W gives \[ \boxed{\quad BPB^{-1}P^{-1}=Q[I+(Z^{-1}-1)vw].\quad} \tag{1} \] For example W B inverse P inverse=Q^(-(N-1))e, proving every coefficient and the sign in (1). With the actual framing vector v and scaled covector what=(Z inverse minus one)w, it is the framed equation Q inverse BPB inverse P inverse=I+v what. Its determinant forces and satisfies 1+what v=Z inverse. The inverse equation is equally exact: \[ PB P^{-1}B^{-1}=Q^{-1}[I+(Z-1)e]. \tag{2} \] It is the rank of the Q-NORMALIZED commutator minus I that is at most one. The factor Q cannot be dropped: at a primitive N-th root Q is not one. Generically Z not one makes that rank exactly one. At Z=1 it drops to zero, but the divided normal retains \[ \left[\frac{Q^{-1}BPB^{-1}P^{-1}-I}{1-Q^N}\right]_{Q_N}=e. \tag{3} \] The actual whole lift specifies w through what=(Z inverse minus one)w. A bare root moment relation with what=0 does not reconstruct that divided covector or the selected source. ## 2. Both actual endpoint walls use this same marked projector Let kappa=M-M inverse, e_top=P inverse eP. The cyclic expressions and actual finite generators factor WHOLE as \[ F_{cyc}=P(I-QB),\quad \mathcal E_{cyc}=P^{-1}(MB^{-1}-M^{-1}I), \] \[ \boxed{\quad F=F_{cyc}(I-e_{top})=F_{cyc}-\delta eP,\qquad \mathcal E=\mathcal E_{cyc}(I-e) =\mathcal E_{cyc}-\kappa P^{-1}e. \quad} \tag{4} \] The first equation deletes the last raising arrow and the second deletes the first lowering arrow. Thus both actual walls have the same rank-one framing transported to the appropriate end. The multiplicative commutator itself only sees the Q-wall delta; the independent meridian character kappa must also be retained. In particular F^N=0 while F_cyc^N=delta(Q;Q)_(N-1)I, and the original pair detects the divided wrap value N. At a primitive root E_cyc^N=(-1)^(N-1)(M^N-M inverse N)I. These are the actual central norms and endpoint factors, including the ones entering the full modified-dimension ratio. Neither (1) nor its root rank drop replaces these norms by numerical units or equates their different normal directions. ## 3. The actual co-source is a required finite orbit path The natural moment covector is w. The ORIGINAL output row is ell=ones transpose. It is recovered exactly by the finite path \[ S_P=\sum_{r=0}^{N-1}P^r,\qquad \ell=w S_P,\qquad Q_0=v\ell=e S_P. \tag{5} \] Thus the exact highest-input period is ell C v=w S_P C v, not just w C v on arbitrary current matrices. Both anchors equal one on I, but their rows are not proportional for N greater than one. Any simultaneous change of basis carries w,ell and S_P together; it cannot erase their relative orbit path. There is a source-preserving framed period identity, not just the unpointed matrix relation. Write Delta_mom=BPB inverse P inverse minus QI and lambda(C)=ell C v. Combining (1) and (5) gives \[ \Delta_{mom}S_P=Q(Z^{-1}-1)Q_0, \] \[ \boxed{\quad \lambda(C_1\Delta_{mom}S_P C_2) =Q(Z^{-1}-1)\lambda(C_1)\lambda(C_2). \quad} \tag{5a} \] This holds for arbitrary actual whole matrices C_1,C_2 with their coefficient lines consistently retained. It is the literal rank-one cut/source factorization: Q_0=v ell. Dividing the already specified whole equation by delta and evaluating at the root gives coefficient Q_N on the right. Equivalently the selected divided moment insertion is Q_N Q_0. Without S_P the right factor would have the different moment row w. Thus (5a) is an actual whole loop/source identity with its required orbit path, not permission to discard that path or to assign a new value to the uninserted period. The norm of S_P in the original flat unitary head metric is N, and the norm of ell is sqrt N. No exponential source scale is introduced by (5). Conversely these elementary source bounds are not a bound on the actual R word or its period. There is an exact WHOLE source-current comparison. Put D_K C=K C K inverse minus C with K=xB inverse, and define \[ \beta_K(X)=\sum_{c=1}^{N-1}\frac{X_{c,0}}{Q^{-c}-1}. \] Every displayed denominator is a unit at a primitive N-th root. Entrywise multiplication gives \[ \boxed{\quad \ell C v-wCv=\beta_K(D_K C).\quad} \tag{6} \] This is the K-only specialization of the established actual Ward source homotopies. It holds before jets on arbitrary C, so all derivatives of beta_K, K, C and the original peripheral line are retained. At the physical root its exact flat-metric row norm is \[ \|\beta_K\|^2 =\sum_{c=1}^{N-1}\frac1{4\sin^2(\pi c/N)} =\frac{N^2-1}{12}. \tag{7} \] For a direct proof of the last identity, apply two logarithmic derivatives at one to (t^N-1)/(t-1), whose roots are the nontrivial N-th roots. This gives sum Q^c/(1-Q^c)^2=-(N^2-1)/12; each negative summand is the corresponding reciprocal squared sine. ## 4. Exact consequence for the actual one-index Fourier source Use the whole Vandermonde change on the SECOND wire and put A_j[c,a]=T^V_(c,j;a,j). Define \[ J^{Whit}_j=\ell A_j v,\qquad J^{mom}_j=w A_j v. \] Equation (6) gives the WHOLE coefficientwise relation \[ J^{Whit}_j-J^{mom}_j=\beta_K(D_K A_j). \tag{8} \] At the original root, charge conservation and the ordinary scalar closure prove \[ J^{mom}_j=P_N/N,\qquad J^{Whit}_j=P_N/N+\beta_K(D_K A_j),\qquad \sum_j\beta_K(D_K A_j)=0. \tag{9} \] Indeed setting c=a=0 forces the old second offset to zero; Fourier transformation then contributes precisely 1/N and no j dependence. The first formula is not an off-root scalarity claim. The whole sum of (8) is beta_K(D_K C); it vanishes at the root for the uninserted fully reclosed scalar C, while inserted currents and normal derivatives retain their actual defects. Equation (9) is a genuine constraint on the final finite j source. It also explains a limitation: replacing the Whittaker orbit by the natural moment row loses ALL nonconstant Fourier geometry. The geometric formal block may occur in this Ward sector, whose sum is controlled only after closure. A nonzero local block or a rank-one moment relation does not prove its selected survival. ## 5. Actual R transports the framing but not the orbit row trivially For any actual invertible crossing R, conjugating ALL B_i,P_i,e_i and their vector/covector maps preserves (1)-(4) algebraically. This is a strict identity of the actual finite matrix algebra; it is not a claim that individual generators remain fixed. For two highest inputs the literal actual coefficients give \[ R(v\otimes v)=r_{00}(v\otimes v),\qquad (w\otimes w)R=r_{00}(w\otimes w). \] The full scalar r_00, including its half-Cartan mark, is retained. Thus the highest moment framing is compatible up to this actual scalar. For two copies of the original boundary object, its tensor orbit row has the exact residual \[ (\ell\otimes\ell)R-r_{00}(\ell\otimes\ell) =(w\otimes w)[S_P\otimes S_P,R]. \tag{10} \] It is generally nonzero. At N=2, q=i, eta_half=exp(pi i/4), the literal positive crossing matrix displayed in [the actual boundary-moment audit](actual_negative_band_boundary_moment_and_ward_atom.md) has r_00=eta_half. The input (0,1) component of (10) is eta_half inverse minus eta_half=-sqrt(2)i, not zero. Multiplying the crossing by its retained scalar normalization multiplies both sides; it does not remove this defect. Actual word, cap and prefix transport must carry the orbit path and this residual. This is a local boundary-object covariance test. A full original braid still has its pivotal caps on the other strands; their source is not replaced by ell tensor ell. The actual fully sourced one-index identity is (8)-(9), with those original caps retained. Even the naive tensor product of the moment pairs is not another rank-one pair: for B_tot=B_1B_2,P_tot=P_1P_2 its normalized commutator is (I+a e_1)(I+a e_2), a=Z inverse minus one. For generic Z not plus or minus one its defect has rank 2N-1, preserved by every simultaneous crossing conjugation. The true Hopf/coprod and source fusion therefore cannot be replaced by that naive product if a rank-one target is desired. ## 6. Exact audit and scope [The independent script](../experiments/audit_rank_one_moment_orbit_source.py) and [its output](../experiments/rank_one_moment_orbit_source_results.json) check the whole framed relation, endpoint projectors, root divided class, orbit path, current homotopy, actual Fourier sum rule and literal R residual, including a characteristic-zero example. The usable whole object is the framed pair B,P,v,w WITH its original orbit co-source S_P, both actual endpoint deletions and the meridian characters. This is more precise than a bare root commutator relation. It supplies exact source-current identities; it does not identify a global geometric cycle, make the final source horizontal by itself, or prove a volume limit. ## 7. Existing terminology and the root specialization The defining rank-one multiplicative-commutator relation occurs in [Chalykh--Fairon, Section 3, page 10](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1704.05814). Their invertible-coordinate presentation has rank(XZX inverse Z inverse minus q_0 I)=1. Our actual generic pair has X=B, Z=P and q_0=Q. At Q^N=1 its rank drops to zero, so the root belongs to the rank-at-most-one closure, with the divided marking (3) retained. Their Proposition 3.3 assumes q_0 is not a root of unity. Their subsequent regular coordinate chart also excludes x_i=q_0 x_j, which the actual clock spectrum violates. No smoothness or coordinate theorem there is applied to this resonant root/source section; only the defining coverage is used. The additional [aligned source-frame theorem](flat_cyclic_source_frame_and_scalar_period.md) proves the whole matrix-algebra classification directly, including its necessary alignment and flat-saturation hypotheses. The [actual Fourier cancellation theorem](actual_fourier_source_cancellation.md) then constructs a nonzero geometric Ward block whose selected cyclic sum vanishes. These distinguish frame rigidity from the remaining selected-period problem.

title: The full actual reassociation is an angle half-density
text: # The full actual reassociation is an angle half-density 29 October 2026. Every entry of the actual adjacent-pair fusion reassociation has a unique two-transfer path. In the source-fixing physical quarter-factorial gauge, its squared entry is exactly a product of FOUR positive affine-angle weights, one per cell. The full root phase and all strict finite-head inequalities are explicit. This is an all-entry, all-exterior tensor identity. It supplies actual shared-charge incidence, rather than assigning independent angle variables after taking absolute values. It does not yet identify this cell complex with a geometric ideal triangulation or bound its global partition by knot volume. ## 1. The actual divided-power fusion is one finite Euler operator Put `q=exp(pi*i/N)`, `Q=q^2`, `d=N-1`, `F_a=(Q;Q)_a`, `s_a=|F_a|`, and use the original balanced head basis. Let S^-|a>=|a-1> for a>0, S^-|0>=0, mathsfF|a>=(1-Q^(a+1))|a+1>, mathsfF|d>=0. For a nonzero original meridian root x, divide the ACTUAL Borel fusion column indexed `(a,b)` by its explicit `F_a`, and denote the resulting map by C'_x. Its exact kernel is (C'_x)_(a-r,b+r;a,b)=x^(-r) [b+r choose r]_Q, 0<=r<=min(a,d-b). (1) All other entries vanish. This follows either from the original coproduct powers or from the physical kernel of [actual fusion](actual_borel_regular_fusion_and_divided_cap_period.md). No relative index is identified with a physical one without this map. Set `T_x=x^(-1) S^- tensor mathsfF`. Then `T_x^N=0` and C'_x=p_N(T_x), p_N(t)=sum_(r=0)^d t^r/F_r, (C'_x)^(-1)=sum_(r=0)^d (-1)^r Q^(r(r-1)/2)t^r/F_r evaluated at t=T_x. (2) Indeed the r-th power has coefficient `x^-r F_(b+r)/F_b`. The finite Euler inverse follows by q-binomial convolution. Its inverse entry is (1) times `(-1)^r Q^(r(r-1)/2)`, with exactly the SAME strict support. Every endpoint and zero transfer is retained. For reference the head relation is EXACT at both finite endpoints: S^- mathsfF=(1-Q)I+Q mathsfF S^-. On three heads it gives `T_23 T_12=Q T_12 T_23+(1-Q)T_13`, where `T_13=(xy)^(-1)S_1^- mathsfF_3` if the two fusion parameters are x,y. Thus the overlap is an actual finite q-oscillator algebra, with no silently omitted rank-one endpoint correction. ## 2. Every reassociation entry, including its phase Let A_xy=(I tensor C'_y)^(-1)(C'_x tensor I). For input `(a,b,c)` the only possible outputs are (u,v,w)=(a-r,b+r-s,c+s), 0<=r<=min(a,d-b), 0<=s<=min(b+r,d-c). (3) For each input/output there is at most one path, since `r=a-u`, `s=w-c`. The COMPLETE entry is A_(u,v,w;a,b,c) =(-1)^s Q^(s(s-1)/2)x^(-r)y^(-s) [b+r choose r]_Q [c+s choose s]_Q. (4) In particular the intermediate head bound `b+r<=d` is essential; checking only the final output would add spurious entries. Formula (4) follows by multiplying the two literal kernels (1)--(2). It is an operator identity on the complete finite three-head space, so it preserves ANY adjoining tensor, source or current when all their interfaces are transported. No knot scalar occurs in it. Assume now `|x|=|y|=1`, including the original complete source. Write `beta_(L,r)=s_L/(s_r s_(L-r))`. The principal half-root identity `[L choose r]_Q=q^(r(L-r)) beta_(L,r)` gives the exact unit phase omega=(-1)^s x^(-r)y^(-s) q^[rb+sc+s(s-1)]. (5) All signs and the half-period q are kept, at odd and even N. There is also an exact Fourier polarization of this phase: omega=zeta_out(u,w) zeta_in(a,b,c) q^(-ub-wc), zeta_out=(-1)^w x^u y^(-w)q^(w^2-w), zeta_in=(-1)^c x^(-a)y^c q^(ab+c). (5a) Substituting `u=a-r,w=c+s` proves (5a). Its bilinear part is a TWO-variable 2N-half-clock Fourier phase. The physical indices still lie in the original N-windows with the strict constraints (3); an unwindowed Fourier/Plancherel replacement is not authorized by this phase identity alone. ## 3. Source-fixing quarter gauge and four positive cells Use the PHYSICAL gauge g_a=L_a^(-1/4)=N^(1/4)/sqrt(s_a), L_a=s_a^2/N, h_a=g_a^2=sqrt(N)/s_a. It is source-fixing because `g_a g_(d-a)=1`. The original cup and ordinary cap are fixed on their complementary physical indices; the full marked row has this property on its degree-d restriction. The original integer-degree argument forces that restriction only after the other ordinary caps have been assembled. We use exactly that whole-source scope, as in [the physical weighted-source theorem](actual_weighted_fourier_plat_energy.md). Original pivots commute with this gauge. No marked corner is inserted in an arbitrary exterior. Let `Ahat=g^(tensor 3) A (g^(-1))^(tensor 3)`. For every entry (3), |Ahat_entry|^2 = beta_(a,r) beta_(b+r,r) beta_(b+r,s) beta_(c+s,s) = N^4 product_(j=1)^4 w_N(alpha_j), (6) where `w_N(i,j,k)=1/(s_i s_j s_k)` and alpha_1=(r,a-r,d-a), alpha_2=(r,b,d-b-r), alpha_3=(s,b+r-s,d-b-r), alpha_4=(s,c,d-c-s). (7) Every alpha has nonnegative integer entries summing EXACTLY to d. The full complex half-density is therefore Ahat_entry=N^2 omega sqrt(product_j w_N(alpha_j)). (8) Proof. The squared gauge ratio is `s_a s_b s_c/[s_(a-r)s_(b+r-s)s_(c+s)]`. Multiply this by the squared magnitudes of the two binomials in (4). Inserting the intermediate `s_(b+r)` expresses the result as the four beta factors in (6). Finally each beta is exactly `N w_N(r,L-r,d-L)` by root complementation. This proves (6)--(8) without changing or suppressing any original source factor. For a single C'_x or its inverse, the corresponding two-cell formula is |Chat'_entry|^2 =N^2 w_N(r,a-r,d-a)w_N(r,b,d-b-r). (9) The inverse has the additional unit phase from (2), so its positive cell kernel is identical, while its coherent composition differs. ### Exact incidence, rather than independent angles The four cells in (7) satisfy alpha_1,1=alpha_2,1=r, alpha_3,1=alpha_4,1=s, alpha_2,3=alpha_3,3=d-(b+r). (10) The external ports are recovered by a=alpha_1,1+alpha_1,2, b=alpha_2,2, c=alpha_4,2, u=alpha_1,2, v=alpha_3,2, w=alpha_4,1+alpha_4,2. (11) Conversely four nonnegative sum-d triples satisfying (10), with these boundary values, recover exactly one admissible entry (3). Thus (7),(10),(11) are a bijective actual local charge model; their five free integer parameters are `(a,b,c,r,s)`. In particular the intermediate upper wall is the shared NONNEGATIVE charge `alpha_2,3=alpha_3,3`. Integer total degree is conserved. These are proven shared-spin constraints. They are not by themselves the geometric equation that sums dihedral angles to 2pi around each edge of an ideal triangulation. That further global identification, including peripherals, must be established rather than inferred from the presence of positive sum-d cells. ## 4. Exact factorization through the normalized b coefficients This kernel is compatible with the proposed LENGTH normalization, not an unrelated square-root replacement. Put B_L(X,Y)=product_(j=0)^(L-1)(X-Q^jY), D_L=s_L^(1/2)/N^(1/4), b_L=B_L/D_L, m_j=s_j/sqrt(N), tau_(L,r)=sqrt(m_r m_(L-r)) [X^(L-r)Y^r]b_L. The [normalized coefficient Gram identity](actual_length_normalized_star_gram.md) is exactly |tau_(L,r)|^2=sqrt(N)w_N(r,L-r,d-L), arg(tau_(L,r))=arg[(-1)^r q^(r(L-1))]. (12) For one positive or inverse fusion cell let `m=b+r`. Then Chat'_entry=sqrt(N) eta_+ tau_(a,r)tau_(m,r), (Chat'^(-1))_entry=sqrt(N) eta_- tau_(a,r)tau_(m,r), eta_+=x^(-r)q^[r(2-a-r)], eta_-=(-1)^r x^(-r)q^[r(1-a)]. (13) For the full reassociation the exact complex coefficient is Ahat_entry=N eta tau_(a,r)tau_(b+r,r) tau_(b+r,s)tau_(c+s,s), eta=(-1)^s x^(-r)y^(-s) q^[r(2-a-r)+s(1-b-r)]. (14) Multiplying the four phases in (12) proves (14), including (5). In particular ZERO lengths are retained: `b_0=N^(1/4)` and `tau_(0,0)=N^(-1/4)`. At the all-zero input the factor `N tau_(0,0)^4` is one, as the original operator requires. The b-length tensor and physical quarter gauge have therefore been matched with their actual normalizers and source types. ## 5. Positive energies and the full coherent Gram For a fixed input i, the exact column energy is the positive sum ||Ahat e_i||^2=N^4 sum_(r,s satisfying (3)) product_j w_N(alpha_j). (15) The Hilbert--Schmidt energy is its sum over all physical inputs. Thus each local positive cell contributes ONE w, not its square. This is a genuine identity for the entire column, not a saddle approximation or a single selected large entry. The FULL Gram, however, is (Ahat^*Ahat)_(i,j) =N^4 sum_(common output o) conj(omega_(o,i))omega_(o,j) sqrt(W_(o,i)W_(o,j)), W_(o,i)=product_four_cells w_N. (16) Off-diagonal replicas remain. They cannot be deleted as an exact source operation. Any all-exterior upper comparison obtained by Cauchy must bound or retain these mixed terms; (16) states their phase and incidence explicitly. The original marked source has not been assumed positive or diagonal. ## 6. The complete original crossing uses the same physical cells There is no remaining standalone factorial diagonal between these physical Euler maps. Let `C'_(21)=Flip C'_(12) Flip`, and retain the original Gaussian D_2|a,b>=(-1)^b Q^(b(b-1)/2)x^(-2b)|a,b>. For the original same-color braid at every meridian root x, R_+=kappa C'_(12) D_2 C'_(21) (C'_(12))^(-1), R_-=kappa^(-1) C'_(12) (C'_(21))^(-1) D_2^(-1)(C'_(12))^(-1). (17) Here kappa is the original full common Cartan scalar, not a new normalization. To verify (17), start with the exact all-integer-degree factorization in [the Pascal theorem](actual_pascal_coherent_gram.md#61-an-exact-pascalgaussian-alphabet-for-original-braid-crossings). There `C=C' diag(F_a)`. Conjugating its relative Euler factor U by this diagonal gives coefficient `x^-r F_(a+r)/(F_a F_r)=x^-r[a+r choose r]`, exactly the physical C'_(21), with its strict bounds. The diagonal commutes with D_2. This proves (17) in EVERY total degree and hence as a full operator. The negative formula is its literal inverse. At completeness D_2, kappa and all original pivots/framing phases have modulus one. In the SAME source-fixing quarter gauge, each of the three C' factors in a crossing has the two-cell kernel (9). Their inverse phases, upper/lower walls and original finite source remain present. This is an exact coherent physical alphabet at arbitrary braid width, not a source-null completion or a deletion of the inhomogeneous current. It provides six positive cell weights per crossing before any shared-head contractions. To turn the resulting positive comparison into a sharp volume theorem one still needs its global geometric edge/peripheral constraints or a further coherent contraction. Neither is asserted merely from (17). In particular a generic positive path partition is not automatically the partition on an ideal geometric triangulation. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_reassociation_angle_kernel.py): original coproduct-derived fusion, finite Euler inverses, all strict reassociation entries, half-root phases, b_0 and normalized coefficient factorization, exact local charge incidence and both ORIGINAL signed crossing operators with retained common Cartan.

title: The literal reflected two-circle source and its two-octahedron geometry
text: # The literal reflected two-circle source and its two-octahedron geometry 29 October 2026. The positive original circuit \[ E_N=\phi\!\left(\mathscr R(RL_N)\,R^{-1}L_N\right) =\|\,\mathscr R(R^{-1}L_N)\,\|_{\rm Newt}^{\,2} \tag{1} \] has a genuine four-component hyperbolic interpretation. The labeled cut-and-reglue certificate below gives two regular ideal octahedra, volume \(2v_8\). This is a complete-base calibration, not yet a new broad family of filled knots. The literal cut/face matching and the exact metric certificate have now passed independent analytical review and a fresh audit replay; software recognition is not their proof. ## 1. Exact source diagram and cut-open port table Let \(C\) be the actual auxiliary three-braid \([2,1,1,2]\), with its THIRD top and bottom endpoints joined outside on the right. Its first two top/bottom endpoints stay open. The original pivotal color-\(N\) evaluation of this circle is precisely \(L_N\), with no extra trace normalization. Use the literal single crossings \(X_\pm\). The diagram is the denominator closure of \[ \mathscr R(X_+C)\,(X_-C). \tag{2} \] Thus it is fixed before evaluating any invariant. Its two auxiliary circles are distinct. Deleting them leaves the genuine diagram \(\mathscr R(X_+)X_-=X_-^2\), whose braid closure has two components. There are therefore FOUR components in (2). In the audit's crossing convention its unmodified planar code is [(1,10,2,11),(2,19,3,16),(15,19,10,18),(17,15,18,14), (16,3,17,4),(11,4,12,5),(5,8,0,9),(12,7,13,8), (6,13,7,14),(9,0,6,1)]. The retained half crossings are 0 and 5; the auxiliary loops run through crossings 1--4 and 6--9. A simultaneous mirror convention does not change the absolute invariant or volume conclusion. Cut along the projection sphere and the two twice-punctured crossing disks. Keep each half twist as its actual regluing. This produces two balls \(P_+,P_-\). A crossing-disk cut replaces its local circle gadget by two shaded triangles with a common circle vertex. This is reversed by restoring the disk collar and the third-strand closure defining \(C\). Label the four main arc segments between the disks cyclically by \(p_0=Y_+,p_1=Z_+,p_2=Y_-,p_3=Z_-\). The unturned disk sides see \((p_0,p_1)\), \((p_2,p_3)\). The GENUINE quarter-turn shifts the second disk's cyclic port order by one, giving \((p_3,p_0)\), \((p_1,p_2)\). With circle vertices \(X_0,X_1\), the shaded triangles in either cut ball are consequently | Face | Vertices | | --- | --- | | \(A\) | \(X_0,Y_+,Z_+\) | | \(B\) | \(X_0,Y_-,Z_-\) | | \(C\) | \(X_1,Y_+,Z_-\) | | \(D\) | \(X_1,Y_-,Z_+\) | Their edges form the octahedral graph, with opposite pairs \(\{X_0,X_1\},\{Y_+,Y_-\},\{Z_+,Z_-\}\). The four white complementary regions are \[ W_0=(X_0,Y_+,Z_-),\ W_1=(X_0,Y_-,Z_+),\ W_2=(X_1,Y_+,Z_+),\ W_3=(X_1,Y_-,Z_-). \] Without the port shift the disk-side pairs would repeat; it would be incorrect to replace this actual turn by scalar multiplication. White gluing is \(W_j^+\to W_j^-\), with identity vertex map. The odd half twists exchange the upper/lower disk sides, giving | Source | Target | Vertex map | | --- | --- | --- | | \(A^+\) | \(B^-\) | \(X_0\to X_0,\ Y_+\to Y_-,\ Z_+\to Z_-\) | | \(A^-\) | \(B^+\) | same rule | | \(C^+\) | \(D^-\) | \(X_1\to X_1,\ Y_+\to Y_-,\ Z_-\to Z_+\) | | \(C^-\) | \(D^+\) | same rule | This follows by tracing the two punctures through the single crossing, not by matching a computed volume. Restoring the white sphere and these disk collars reverses the cut and gives (2). The sign of the half twist retains its source disk-framing convention. Adding a full disk twist changes its preferred filling meridian but not this unmarked exterior quotient. No new filling-peripheral identification is inferred from this complete-base certificate. ## 2. Exact positive metric, edge cycles, and four complete cusp tori Realize each cell as a regular ideal octahedron, for example \[ X_0=0,\quad X_1=\infty,\quad Y_\pm=\pm1,\quad Z_\pm=\pm i . \] Use opposite labeled orientations on the two copies. Every displayed triangle map is realized by an octahedral symmetry followed by the appropriate face reflection. In the hyperboloid model take center \(O=(1,0,0,0)\) and normalized ideal lifts \((1,\pm e_1),(1,\pm e_2),(1,\pm e_3)\). An octahedral symmetry fixes \(O\) and maps these lifts EXACTLY; reflection in a target face fixes its three lifts. Thus all face maps preserve the canonical horospheres, not just ideal endpoints. The finite combinatorial checks from this table are: * The 24 octahedral boundary-edge occurrences form six cycles of length four. Their dihedral angles sum to \(4(\pi/2)=2\pi\). Matched endpoint horospheres exclude a dilation along an edge. * The ideal vertex classes are \(X_0^\pm\), \(X_1^\pm\), all \(Y_\pm^\pm\), and all \(Z_\pm^\pm\). They give the four actual components. * Their links have respectively \(2,2,4,4\) Euclidean squares. Every link edge is paired twice and every link vertex has four right-angle sectors. Each link is connected and orientable, with Euler characteristic zero, hence a nonsingular torus. Shrinking compatible horospheres first gives disjoint actual corner sections and full horoball ends. The remaining core is compact. The resulting positive curvature-minus-one metric is complete and finite-volume on the actual complement of (2). An explicit eight-tetrahedron version makes the check reproducible. Put \(v=(Y_+,Z_+,Y_-,Z_-)\). The tetrahedra in \(P_+\) are \((X_1,X_0,v_j,v_{j+1})\), \(j\bmod4\); reverse the last two labels in \(P_-\). Their shapes are \(i\) in the respective reflected frames. Internal and external face maps have local permutation \(0132\). The audit builds these maps from the table, checks all face pairs and exact rational edge-angle sums, and checks the links. Thus the volume is \(8D(i)=2v_8\). This link is genuinely hyperbolic, not merely a JSJ/composite explanation of the observed exponent. ## 3. The original quantum limit and what generalizes Section 6 of [the Newton-turn theorem](actual_newton_turn_positive_gram.md) proves the whole-source identity (1) and \(\lim N^{-1}\log E_N=v_8/\pi\), using the actual finite coefficients, all-index endpoint bound, and a nonzero high-index lower term. Both level parities and all composite levels are included. The original single-cut reduced normalization changes (1) only by its recorded unit phase; the optional one-cut modified convention adds \(1/N\), not one factor per component. Therefore \[ \lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N} \log|\langle L_{\rm ref}\rangle_N| =2v_8=\operatorname{Vol}(S^3\setminus L_{\rm ref}). \tag{3} \] Here \(L_{\rm ref}\) is the explicit diagram (2), not a census name. There is an exact reusable non-scalar tangle gluing: \[ \phi(f^\sharp\mathscr Rg) =\sum_{r=0}^d\overline{\alpha_r(f)}\alpha_r(g). \tag{4} \] It preserves all physical source ports and gives positive entire reflected circuits. But its quantum separating cut is not automatically the projection/disk cut of the geometric octahedra. A general tangle double need not have a verified geodesic separating surface, and its \(N\)-channel overlap is not a scalar product of independent local invariants. Two known packet norms alone do not control the sharp coherent overlap or its geometric critical point. There is now a separate verified extension at THIS actual outer crossing-disk seam. The [bandlimited nodal theorem](actual_complete_circle_nodal_energy_and_belt_sewing.md) controls the full complete-circle channel sum, and the [balanced belt-stack certificate](actual_balanced_octahedral_belt_stack_volume.md) glues the cut two-octahedron pieces along their literal geodesic pants. The subsequent coherent boundary-source theorem extends this to every fixed sign word of \(n\geq1\) pieces and every fixed integer outer collar: the original complete-link limit is \(2n v_8\). There are \(n+3\) components for an even outer power and \(n+2\) for an odd one; the balanced positive case was the first subclass. It is a cyclic one-belt operation, not a claim about arbitrary graph vertices or the new bases' fixed Dehn fillings. In a genuinely branched construction with three paired boundary slots, the original vertex is a SIX-port tensor. Its saturated source has dimension \((N^3+N)/2\) and the explicit divided-power kernel of [the six-port source theorem](actual_six_port_divided_power_source_kernel.md). It cannot be replaced by independent two-port scalar Frobenius multiplication vertices. The bounded confluent construction controls its finite normal order, but not its coherent geometric energy. Thus the present exact base and gluing metric are useful analytic inputs; they do not prove closure under arbitrary octahedral graphs or an arbitrary-bridge volume conjecture. Audit: [actual tangle and exact octahedral face/edge/cusp certificate](../experiments/audit_actual_reflected_two_circle_octahedral_base.py). Software census names and numerical volumes, when requested in the audit, are diagnostics only; the written proof is the reversible disk/projection cut and the exact metric checks above. Independent analytical review rechecked the actual auxiliary disk, the quarter-turned four-port partitions, all shaded/white face maps, the inverse collar reconstruction, exact horosphere preservation, and the complete cusp links. The focused exact audit was separately replayed with its optional literal-diagram cross-check. Both passed; no general graph/filling scope is inferred from this base certificate.

title: Reflection-compatible original cap metrics, and the remaining leg-order test
text: # Reflection-compatible original cap metrics, and the remaining leg-order test 29 October 2026. The positive complete-circle form controls the ORIGINAL ordinary and marked boundaries, but with DIFFERENT literal leg flips. This gives an all-width positive boundary estimate with polynomial dual cost. It does not yet identify an arbitrary untwisted fully augmented planar diagram with a Hilbert norm square. A concrete single-leg bend below shows why that last wiring check cannot be omitted. ## 1. Actual pair sources and the two positive forms Put N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2, x=q^d. On two original physical heads retain \[ p_{a,b}=Nx^{-b}\delta_{a+b,d},\quad \ell_{a,b}=x^{-a}Q^{-a}\delta_{a+b,d}/N, \quad m_{a,b}=x^b/N^2. \] Let P|a,b>=|b,a> be the literal tensor flip, NOT a crossing. Write m_d=m times the INTEGER pair-degree-d projector. Since x^2=Q^(-1), the exact row identities are \[ \ell=N^{-2}p^\dagger P,\qquad m_d=N^{-3}p^\dagger=N^{-1}\ell P. \tag{1} \] The original complete crossing circle satisfies the independently proved [full physical positivity theorem](actual_complete_circle_reflection_positive.md): \[ C=PL_N\succeq0,\qquad H=L_NP=PCP\succeq0. \] The original Hermite source normal t has ell t=1, m_d t=0, L_Nt=2Np. Consequently the already derived ordinary-cap identity is C t=2N^3 ell^dagger and ell C^+ ell^dagger=1/(2N^3). Conjugating by the TRUE flip P gives the new marked identity \[ H(Pt)=2Np,\qquad \boxed{\displaystyle m_d H^+m_d^\dagger=\frac1{2N^5},\qquad m_d^\dagger m_d\preceq\frac H{2N^5}.} \tag{2} \] Indeed H^+=PC^+P and m_d=ell P/N. Equivalently Pt/(2N^4) is an explicit inverse solution for m_d^dagger, and its pairing with m_d is 1/(2N^5). No inverse of L_N or deletion of its radical is made. Ordinary ell uses C; marked m_d uses H. Both distinctions matter. Since Cp=0 and m_d p=1, the marked row is not bounded by C. The UNRESTRICTED m is not bounded by H either: H|0,0>=0 while m|0,0>=1/N^2. It is the whole-source degree argument below, not a local marked-row substitution, that permits (2). ## 2. All-width original marked boundary estimate Consider the original k-cup plat source p^(tensor k) and a full original signed word W preserving total INTEGER degree. Each cup has degree d. After the k-1 ordinary output caps have fixed their pair degrees d, the remaining marked pair is forced to degree d. Therefore, on the ACTUAL incoming total degree kd, \[ (\ell^{\otimes(k-1)}\otimes m)W p^{\otimes k} =(\ell^{\otimes(k-1)}\otimes m_d)W p^{\otimes k}. \tag{3} \] Put Lambda=ell^(tensor(k-1)) tensor m_d and \[ Q_{\rm top}=C^{\otimes(k-1)}\otimes H,\qquad c_k=2^{-k}N^{-(3k+2)}. \] Tensor the actual pair dual norms. This gives EXACTLY \[ \boxed{\displaystyle \Lambda Q_{\rm top}^+\Lambda^\dagger=c_k,\qquad \Lambda^\dagger\Lambda\preceq c_k Q_{\rm top}.} \tag{4} \] For the original scalar, with its existing framing/peripheral line chi_N unchanged, one consequently has \[ |K_N|^2\leq|\chi_N|^2c_k \langle Wp^{\otimes k},Q_{\rm top}Wp^{\otimes k}\rangle. \tag{5} \] The estimate extends to arbitrary coefficient Hilbert spaces and keeps every actual pivot already present in ell. It neither assumes W is unitary nor pays a condition number for its unknown state. It is a boundary Cauchy theorem, NOT yet a geometric bound for the positive energy on the right. On ordinary pairs the original signed same-pair twists are exact C-isometries. On the marked H pair, their REFLECTED conjugates P R^a P are H-isometries. Replacing one by the other without the literal leg interface would not be a source identity. ## 3. Reflection of original crossings and a genuine bend caveat The full original equal-color balanced crossing is complex symmetric. In its strict coefficient, reversing input(a,b) and output(b+k,a-k) leaves the full factorial ratio, x power, and Q exponent unchanged. The independently checked actual inverse is Rminus=P conjugate(R)P. Thus \[ P R_{\rm minus}P=R^\dagger. \tag{6} \] This is the correct reflected-adjoint statement; P remains a leg exchange, not a physical extra braid. Similarly, a reflected ordinary cap is p^dagger P/N^2, whereas the legitimately restricted marked one is p^dagger/N^3. These are different boundary orientations. There is a local obstruction to treating PSD as invariant under ARBITRARY planar bending. Regard the actual cup as the matrix N U: \[ U_{a,b}=x^{-b}\delta_{a+b,d},\qquad U^\dagger U=I,\qquad \ell_{a,b}=(U^{-1})_{a,b}/N. \] Using these very turns to dualize one physical leg of a four-port form B gives \[ (\mathcal D_2B)_{ab;cd} =\sum_{u,v}U_{bu}B_{av;cu}(U^{-1})_{vd},\qquad \mathcal D_2B=(I\otimes U)B^{\mathsf T_2}(I\otimes U^{-1}). \tag{7} \] The factors N from cup and cap cancel. At N=2 the ACTUAL positive H=L_2P has its sole nonzero block on |01>,|10> equal to \[ \begin{pmatrix}4&-4i\\4i&4\end{pmatrix}. \] Its one-leg transpose, and hence the actually turned form (7), has eigenvalues 4,4,4,-4. Thus a single-leg source duality is NOT in general a positive Hilbert congruence. A bare ordinary bubble gives the related warning ell p=0, whereas replacing ell by p^dagger/N^2 would incorrectly give N. This is a statement about a DIFFERENT bipartition of an already formed four-port Gram tensor. It is NOT the genuine antiparallel crossing circle, whose reflection must be transported together with its dual object. The next section verifies the distinction explicitly. ## 4. Genuine dual objects introduce no local positivity failure Use standard dual bases for V*. With the original antipode conventions, the self-duality isometry from V* to V is \[ T=U^{\mathsf T},\qquad T S(h)^{\mathsf T}T^{-1}=h, \quad h\in\{H,K,\mathcal E,F\}. \tag{8} \] For example S(E)=-EK^(-1), S(F)=-KF. Checking the single nonzero entry in each raising/lowering column proves (8), including the endpoints; S(H)=-H and S(K)=K^(-1). The standard coevaluation becomes the original p/N after I tensor T, and standard evaluation becomes N ell after T^(-1) tensor I. Thus this is the actual duality, rather than a guessed rotation of the positive form. For any choices of the two object orientations, put D=T^(epsilon) tensor T^(eta), epsilon,eta in {0,1}, and transport BOTH the circle and its reflection: \[ L_{\epsilon\eta}=D L_ND^{-1},\qquad P_{\epsilon\eta}=D P D^{-1},\qquad L_{\epsilon\eta}P_{\epsilon\eta}=DHD^\dagger\succeq0. \tag{9} \] All D are unitary. In particular no negative eigenvalue in (7) disproves the antiparallel instance of (9). This transport can be chosen consistently along EVERY oriented diagram wire: assign the appropriate object isometry to that wire, and transform a coupon B by D_out B D_in^(-1). Each contracted internal port cancels a D with its inverse. This elementary tensor identity holds for arbitrary exteriors and all leg orderings. It does not require an extra sign or an arbitrary new crossing. If left and right self-duality conventions are instead identified, their exact discrepancy is the ORIGINAL pivot. Namely, with g_a=x^(-d)Q^(-a), \[ U^{-1}U^{\mathsf T}=g,\qquad U^{\mathsf T}U^{-1}=g^{-1},\qquad UgU^{-1}=g^{-1}. \tag{10} \] These identities are direct antidiagonal multiplication. They show which unitary clocks must remain when a turn changes sides. Their existence permits a consistent genuine-dual description; it does NOT license deleting a pivotal holonomy on a closed component. The unresolved global check is therefore more specific than an orientation-sign problem. One must exhibit the projection-plane cut of the ACTUAL fully augmented tensor graph, with its remaining wire contractions and original turns, as a common ket/bra pairing of the transported positive forms (9), or another positive boundary pairing of polynomial cost. A positive coupon on each face is not itself that graph identity. The original ordinary bubble, for example, is ell p=0, whereas replacing its pivotal contraction by p^dagger p/N^2 would give N. No proof that a correctly cut reduced fully augmented diagram must use the bad bipartition (7) is asserted. Conversely no arbitrary global norm-square theorem follows here merely from (9). Until the complete wiring identity is proved, (5) and (9) are the supported all-width source and oriented-local results; the global geometric energy estimate remains open. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_reflection_marked_boundary_metric.py) checks eight exact original-module source levels, five tensor-source widths, seven genuine-dual circle families, and the exact N=2 different-bipartition diagnostic. It also checks the literal full crossings, all source inverse solutions, original degree restriction, and both left/right pivotal discrepancies.

title: Exponential ordinary-color control and elimination of fast modes on a regular arc
text: # Exponential ordinary-color control and elimination of fast modes on a regular arc 28 October 2026. Two statements below are proved directly for the original source. First, every fixed knot diagram has an exp(CN) bound for ALL ordinary colors j<=cN on a fixed O(1/N) complex annulus around q_N. Second, on a compact arc where the highest surviving classical coefficient is nonzero, the higher quantum-order terms can be eliminated using a slow-forward / fast-backward comparison. No eigenframe, lower bound for the actual leading coefficient, or bound on an inverse braid is used. This weakens the order-survival hypothesis of the [macroscopic spectral bound](actual_macroscopic_a_spectral_upper_bound.md) on a regular arc. It does NOT yet remove it globally across zeros of the highest surviving classical coefficient. That additional gluing problem, including a zero at the selected endpoint, is stated explicitly below. ## 1. Actual ordinary colors are exponentially bounded on the full annulus Fix an original zero-framed b-strand braid closure representing a knot, and let C_j(q) be its ordinary reduced color-j scalar, with the original half-Cartan, pivot K(q), and framing twist. For fixed c,S>0 there are constants A,B, depending on the word,c,S, such that |C_j(exp((pi*i+s)/N))| <= j^B exp(Aj), 1<=j<=cN, |s|<=S. (1) In particular the right side is exp(CN). This includes j>=N and both parities. It is a statement about the GENERIC ordinary Laurent polynomial family, not a quotient-color assertion for a high ADO color. There is no division by a vanishing quantum dimension in the proof. Proof. Use the ordinary highest-weight basis with E v_a=[a]_q[j-a]_q v_(a-1), F v_a=v_(a+1), H v_a=(j-1-2a)v_a, 0<=a<j. In the original positive R, the h-transfer coefficient before its Cartan factor is q^(h(h-1)/2) rho^h/[h]! * [a]!/[a-h]! * product_(r=0)^(h-1)[j-a+r], rho=q-q^-1. Equivalently it is q^(h(h-1)/2-h(a-h)) [a choose h]_(q²) * product_(r=0)^(h-1)(q^(j-a+r)-q^(-j+a-r)). (2) This is an exact polynomial cancellation, valid also where a divided factorial in the first expression vanishes. The inverse has the same form, with the corresponding input/color and an altered q-monomial. All those monomial exponents, including the Cartan weight product/2, have absolute value at most Cj². Keep the marked half-root q^(1/2)=exp((pi*i+s)/(2N)); no parity simplification is made. In fact, in the Laurent coefficient norm in the marked half-root, each entry in (2) has norm at most 4^j: the Gaussian coefficient has coefficient sum binom(a,h)<=2^j, and each of the h binomial factors has coefficient norm two. Monomials do not change this norm. The same argument applies to the inverse crossing. If the fixed braid has ell crossings, summing its at most j choices per crossing and its j^(b-1) environmental trace indices gives the explicit coarse bound ||C_j||_(Laurent coefficient l1) <=j^(ell+b-1) 4^(ell*j). (2a) Pivots, the full common Cartan line, and the zero-framing correction are monomials and have coefficient norm one. This is a bound for the original reduced cut, so no dimension denominator has been inserted. Together with the directly proved degree O_word(j²), (2a) is an alternative proof of (1). Gaussian Pascal gives nonnegative integer coefficients, total coefficient sum binom(a,h)<=2^a, and degree h(a-h)<=j²/4. Therefore |[a choose h]_(q²)| <= 2^j exp(S j²/(2N)). (3) Each factor in the product in (2) is at most 2exp(2Sj/N), while any remaining q-monomial costs exp(CSj²/N). Since j<=cN, both crossing signs consequently have every entry bounded by exp(A0 j). A checked two-head matrix has at most j nonzero entries in any row or column, so its original flat operator norm is at most j exp(A0 j). A fixed braid word has norm at most j^B0 exp(A1 j). The ordinary pivot has norm at most exp(Sj/N), and the zero-framing scalar has modulus at most exp(C_word Sj²/N). The literal reduced cut is C_j(q)=theta_j^(-w) [Tr_env(W_j(q)(I tensor K(q)^(tensor(b-1))))]_(0,0). Bounding that trace by j^(b-1) times the matrix norm proves (1). This is the original cut definition. At exceptional q it follows by the displayed integral matrix expressions/continuity, with no replacement of the pivot or source. ## 2. The exact slow-forward / fast-backward system Suppose the actual generic color family has a specified recurrence sum_(i=0)^d a_i(q,-q^j) C_(j+i)(q)=0, (4) with Laurent polynomial coefficients. Remove a common q-1 power. Let m be the HIGHEST index for which a_m(1,M) is not identically zero; assume 1<=m<d and put r=d-m. On a compact x interval I suppose |a_m(1,-exp(pi*i*x))| >= c0 >0. (5) All estimates below are uniform for q=q_N exp(s/N), |s|<=epsilon_N, epsilon_N->0. In particular they apply at s=0. On I and fixed finitely many neighboring mesh points, division by a_m is harmless. Put g_i(j)=a_i(q,-q^j)/a_m(q,-q^j), 0<=i<m, Y_j=(C_j,...,C_(j+m-1))^t, z_j=C_(j+m)+sum_(i<m)g_i(j)C_(j+i). (6) These are the original scalar values, not new independent solutions. With A_j the m by m companion having last row -g_i(j), Y_(j+1)=A_j Y_j+e_m z_j. (7) For i=m+t, iterating (7) a fixed t+1 steps expresses C_(j+i) as a bounded row times Y_j plus a bounded linear combination of z_j,...,z_(j+t). All those rows are uniformly bounded because d is fixed and the g_i are bounded. For i>m, a_i(q,M)=(q-1)b_i(q,M), (8) since its specialization at q=1 is identically zero. Thus its ratio to a_m is O(1/N), uniformly on (5). Substituting these fixed forward expansions into (4), and absorbing the resulting O(1/N) coefficient of z_j, gives the EXACT relation z_j=c_j Y_j+sum_(l=1)^r b_(j,l) z_(j+l), ||c_j||+sum_l|b_(j,l)| <= C/N. (9) No approximation or factorization of a characteristic polynomial is used to obtain (9). In particular, no division by a_d occurs. Equation (9) is a backward-contracting fast system even if the original d by d forward companion is unbounded or undefined at a particular q. ## 3. A two-boundary comparison with a macroscopic right buffer Let A(x) be the classical m by m companion formed from a_0(1,M),...,a_m(1,M), and rho(x) its spectral radius. Fix epsilon>0. The positive Lyapunov metric from the spectral-bound note gives, uniformly on I and for large N, a norm in which one step in (7) has cost at most R_j=rho(j/N)+2epsilon. (10) The metric and its inverse are bounded. Its variation on adjacent mesh points is absorbed in the fixed epsilon. In particular R_j is bounded above and below by positive constants, including when rho=0. Let w_a=1 and w_(j+1)=R_j w_j. After dividing by w_j and using the metric, (7),(9) imply scalar inequalities with one fixed constant C: U_(j+1)<=U_j+C Z_j, Z_j<=h C U_j+h C sum_(l=1)^r Z_(j+l), h=1/N, (11) where U_j=||Y_j||/w_j and Z_j=|z_j|/w_j. Bounded ratios w_(j+l)/w_j for l<=r have been included in C. Take the equations for a<=j<B, specifying only U_a and the r terminal values Z_B,...,Z_(B+r-1). Suppose the latter are at most exp(C1N). This is available for the original source by (1); the weight w_j and the bounded rows in (6) change that bound only by another exp(C2N). Here is an elementary positive supersolution for this mixed boundary problem. Choose kappa=2C and lambda=4C², increasing them slightly if needed for strict inequalities. For sufficiently large N let eta=N^(-1/(2r)), U_j^slow=A exp(lambda h(j-a)), Z_j^slow=kappa h U_j^slow, Z_j^fast=B0 eta^(B-j), U_j^fast=4C eta Z_j^fast. (12) Take A>=max(1,U_a) and B0>=max terminal Z_j. The sum of the slow and fast packets is a strict supersolution of (11). For its fast Z-row, the future contribution is at most h C r eta^-r=Cr/sqrt(N)->0. For its slow Z-row the future contribution is O(h²) relative to U_j^slow. The U-rows follow respectively from exp(lambda h)-1> C kappa h and 4C>C+4C eta. These verify every inequality for large N. For completeness, comparison needs no invertibility theorem. If an actual component exceeded its supersolution, take the largest ratio over the finite U,Z array. It cannot be on the specified boundaries. At an interior component, (11) and the strict supersolution make the ratio a strict subaverage of ratios no greater than that maximum, a contradiction. Thus (12) bounds the original solution. For a target T with B-T>=delta N, delta>0 fixed, the terminal term is <=exp(C2N) N^(-(B-T)/(2r))=exp(-Omega(N log N)). (13) The slow term costs exp(O(1)) beyond w_T and A. Therefore, if U_a is polynomial, the ORIGINAL selected solution satisfies limsup (1/N)log||Y_T|| <= integral_(lim a/N)^(lim T/N) log(rho(x)) dx, (14) interpreting the right side by epsilon-downward limiting if needed. For the usual nonzero lower classical coefficient its logarithm is integrable. All terminal fast data were retained and bounded; they were not set to zero. ## 4. A genuine partial extension of the actual whole-source theorem Suppose (4) is an actual all-level ordinary color recurrence, its highest surviving classical index m>=1, and (5) holds on I=[1/k,1+delta] for some fixed delta>0. Start with the m colors ending at the actual positive macroscopic window J_N=1+floor((N-1)/k). These initial values are polynomially bounded. Take T=N and B=floor((1+delta/2)N). The ordinary-color exponential bound (1) supplies every terminal value needed in (12), even though those colors are larger than N. Consequently (14) gives limsup (1/N)log|K_N| <= integral_(1/k)^1 log rho_m(x) dx. (15) This uses the finite roots of the HIGHEST SURVIVING CLASSICAL order, even when d>m. It proves actual scalar control, not merely a formal slow characteristic. At s=0 the exact color recurrence and (5) suffice; there is no moving-q denominator to regularize and no inverse of the actual leading coefficient. The complex-annulus version of the same argument is also valid when the initial packet has its independently proved polynomial complex bound. ## 5. The precise remaining exceptional-set problem The condition (5) is essential in this proof. Near a zero of a_m(1,M), the coefficients g_i and the small coefficients in (9) need not remain bounded. The old d-order forward companion can still be polynomially bounded on a suitable tiny q-circle, but multiplying that bound over a fixed macroscopic buffer costs exp(O(N log N)), not exp(o(N)). Conversely a shrinking buffer need not suppress the a priori exp(CN) terminal data by (13). Thus those two estimates cannot simply be combined to assert global elimination through a turning core. This note proves neither that such exceptional cores necessarily add growth for a knot, nor that they can be omitted. A compatible global slow/fast transport or an additional source constraint at every core is still needed to remove the classical-order-survival assumption for an arbitrary annihilator. It also proves no geometric inequality for the finite-root integral and no selected lower bound. Reproduce the finite coefficient cancellations and exact defect-system identity with ```sh python3 experiments/audit_actual_regular_fast_color_elimination.py ``` The audit supplements the proofs above; it does not replace the uniform barrier argument or claim an exceptional-core theorem.

title: Exact two-neighbor filling of regular physical head faces
text: # Exact two-neighbor filling of regular physical head faces 28 October 2026. Grouping the TWO actual crossings neighboring a physical head before estimating its normal contour gives a source-faithful outward filling at every regular physical head endpoint. This uses the complete original scalar state, not a discarded tail of a low-band Hardy kernel, a new boundary state, or an independent output projection. The theorem is uniform for every fixed signed braid and bridge count. Its scope is a head face whose other head colors AND all transfers remain in a fixed bulk chamber. Simultaneous head/transfer endpoint clusters are excluded. The estimate does not by itself give the sharp whole-knot volume bound or geometric noncancellation. ## 1. Exact signed scalar and the head-factor composition identity Retain N>=2, d=N-1, Q=exp(2*pi*i/N), x=-exp(-pi*i/N), the original kappa, all pivots and the original external chi_N. Let Fhat_+ be the actual factorial interpolant and Fhat_- its conjugate-root partner. Their exact relation is Fhat_-(s)=g_N(s) Fhat_+(s), g_N(s)=exp[i*pi*s-i*pi*s*(s+1)/N]. (1) Indeed both factorials have the SAME real meromorphic sine-factorial part in their independent Barnes definition; only their displayed quadratic chirps differ. This proves (1) as a whole meromorphic identity, including every normal coefficient. It is not just equality at integer states. In particular g_N(n)=(-1)^n Q^(-n(n+1)/2). For positive transfer k, the actual signed checked coefficients are r_+(a,b;k)=kappa x^(-a-b+k) Q^(b*(a-k)) Fhat_+(b+k)Fhat_+(a) /[Fhat_+(k)Fhat_+(b)Fhat_+(a-k)], r_-(a,b;k)=kappa^(-1) x^(a+b-k) Q^(-a*(b-k)) Fhat_-(a+k)Fhat_-(b) /[Fhat_-(k)Fhat_-(a)Fhat_-(b-k)]. (2) Their unwrapped outputs are respectively (b+k,a-k) and (b-k,a+k). The physical OVER strand always loses k, and the physical UNDER strand always gains k; the sign determines which tensor slot has that role. Replace each Fhat_- in (2) using (1), retaining its entire factor g_N. At EITHER crossing sign the head incidences are now exactly OVER input: +1, OVER output: -1, UNDER input: -1, UNDER output: +1, (3) and its transfer has exponent -1. Thus, on any closed physical knot, the complete ordered scalar product has the exact meromorphic form A_N(u)=E_N(u) product_(physical arcs e) Fhat_+(h_e(u))^(c_e) product_j Fhat_+(k_j)^(-1), (4) where c_e=+2 for UNDER output -> OVER input, c_e=-2 for OVER output -> UNDER input, c_e= 0 for a continued OVER or UNDER role. (5) All original kappa, half-Cartan, g_N conversion chirps and closure pivots are retained in the specified nonzero entire exponential E_N; the original external chi_N/N stays outside unchanged. The logarithm of E_N is an explicit quadratic polynomial with quadratic coefficients O_word(1/N) and linear coefficients O_word(1); its external state-independent factor is not normalized away. Formula (4) is an EXACT two-neighbor composition identity. If different physical arcs have the same state linear form, their factors are multiplied, not declared independent. ## 2. Which endpoint can occur with nonzero adjacent transfers? Consider a physical arc of color h. At h=0 with both adjacent transfers strictly positive, its previous crossing cannot have UNDER output: the UNDER input h-k would be negative. Its next crossing cannot have OVER input: the OVER output h-k would be negative. Therefore this is necessarily an OVER-output -> UNDER-input local MINIMUM and c_e=-2. At h=d with both adjacent transfers strictly positive, its previous crossing cannot have OVER output (its input would be d+k), and its next crossing cannot have UNDER input (its output would be d+k). It is a local MAXIMUM, UNDER output -> OVER input, and c_e=+2. These statements use the actual nonnegative transfer convention at both crossing signs. They are physical state inequalities, not a positivity claim about crossing coefficients.
