Put t=exp(2pi*i*a), lambda(t)=u^N-v^Nt and t_*=(u^N-1)/v^N, exp(2pi*i*alpha)=t_*, w=v exp(h alpha). Assume first D_N!=0 and u^N!=1. The marked meromorphic form omega=2pi*i D_N * t g(a) da/[(t-1)(1-lambda(t))] (10) has residues P_k at integers k, EXACTLY the original source. Its other poles alpha+k have residue -g(alpha+k). Their monodromy is exactly one, and u^N-w^N=1. Thus their full N-orbit residue is -R_N(u,v), R_N=g(alpha)B_N(u,w). (11) This residue is nonzero. The marked full function in (8) is regular and nonzero at c. Its denominator at alpha cannot be a zero or pole: exp[N(c+h alpha)]=1-u^(-N) differs from both zero and one at a regular parameter. Changing alpha by an integer changes g(alpha) and the balanced B by inverse factors in (5), so their product R_N is unchanged. A finite rectangle of width N enclosing k=0,...,d and the corresponding alpha-orbit gives, with all FOUR edges retained, B_N=R_N+(1/(2pi*i))integral_boundary omega. (12) The extra numerator t in (10) is important at the horizontal ends. Choose the left vertical edge Re a=-epsilon, with 0<epsilon<N gamma/(2pi). The inverse full function has no poles in this rectangle: Im(c+ha)>0. Its possible upper Phi poles give zeros, not poles, of g. The full-function asymptotics or its defining integral show both horizontal ends of (10) vanish as their heights tend to infinity. On paired vertical edges omega(a+N)=lambda(t)omega(a). Their difference therefore gives EXACTLY B_N(u,v)=R_N(u,v)+D_N I_N(u,v), I_N=integral_(Re a=-epsilon,up) g(a)/(exp(-2pi*i*a)-1) da. (13) All constants are fixed by residues; no knot period occurs in a denominator. At D_N=0 the identity extends by the matched limit: alpha may be chosen to tend to zero, w tends to v, g(alpha) tends to one, and the finite source tends to its nonzero balanced value. No central-norm denominator is inverted there separately. This is the same local Frobenius gluing as the original field. Writing U_0=U^N=u^N,V_0=V^N=v^N, its multiplier-one internal radius is r_crit^N=1/(1-t_*)=V_0/(1+V_0-U_0). (14) Thus the balanced source in (11) lies on the ACTUAL central gluing divisor; a free central normalization was not substituted. On every compact subset of the above positive boundary chamber, |I_N(u,v)|<=C. (15) Here is the quantitative reason. Put a=-epsilon+iNy. The full-Psi strip estimate, including its nonzero amplitude, gives a leading logarithmic modulus profile with derivative R'(y)=-phi-Arg(1-(v/u)exp(-2pi*y)). Uniformly, delta<=R'(y)<=2pi-delta. The denominator in (13) is bounded below on this vertical line and supplies exp(-2pi Ny) at the upper end. Thus the lower profile has a uniform positive slope and the upper weighted profile a uniform negative slope. Its amplitude grows at most exp(C|y|), and g(-epsilon)=O(1). The measure is Ndy, so integration against exp(-delta N|y|) is O(1). The finitely many small N are bounded by continuity and the same absolutely convergent tails. This proves (15), with every boundary current retained. The companion beta theorem supplies the fuller contour and continuation details; the finite-height audit checks (12). ## 4. Uniform balanced growth on a genuine geometric lift chamber Now suppose additionally 0<rho=|u|<1. Take a compact subset of this chamber, bounded away from rho=0,1 and its angular ends. Choose alpha in any fixed width-one real interval. Then uniformly w=v exp(h alpha)=exp(i Arg v)(1+O(1/N)), |w|=1+O(rho^N/N). Let I_rho(theta)=Im Li_2(rho exp(i theta)) and theta_rho=acos(rho/2). Elementary uniform product Riemann sums give, for x=a/N or k/N, log|p_a|=N P(x)+O(1), P(x)=integral_0^x log|u-exp(i Arg v+2pi*i*t)|dt, log|r_k|=N Qprof(x)+O(1), Qprof(x)=integral_0^x log|u-exp(-2pi*i*t)|dt. Every factor is bounded away from zero since rho<1. The O(1) is uniform in ALL indices; there is no fixed-small-log assumption or omitted rotated endpoint. Positive Laplace bounds and (7) consequently give log|B_N(u,w)|=N(max P-max Qprof)+O(log N). (16) Both maxima can be computed directly. The common periodic derivative is log|1-rho exp(i theta)|, of zero mean, with zeros at theta=+/-theta_rho. The maximizers are its positive-to-negative transitions. Their antiderivative is -I_rho(theta). Hence max P=[I_rho(gamma)+I_rho(theta_rho)]/(2pi), max Qprof=[I_rho(phi)+I_rho(theta_rho)]/(2pi), max P-max Qprof=[I_rho(gamma)-I_rho(phi)]/(2pi)>0. (17) The second maximizer may lie near either end of the period; both positions give the SAME formula. Omitting one of these periodic possibilities would give an incorrect exponent. The full-Psi estimate in (8), with its actual logarithms, also gives log|g(alpha)|=N G(u,v)+O(1), G=[-phi log|v|+ImLi_2(v/u) -ImLi_2(exp(i gamma)/rho)]/(2pi). Inversion in the upper half-plane gives ImLi_2(exp(i gamma)/rho) =I_rho(gamma)+log(rho)(gamma-pi). Combining with (16)--(17) proves the explicit rate theorem log|R_N(u,v)|=N Lambda(u,v)+O(log N), Lambda=[ImLi_2(v/u)-ImLi_2(u) +(pi-gamma)log|u|-phi log|v|]/(2pi). (18) The integer/affine mark in (18) is essential. For example it is the imaginary part, divided by 2pi, of W=Li_2(v/u)-Li_2(u)+1/2 Log(u)^2 -Log(u)Log(v)+pi*i Log(u). (19) It cannot be discarded as a central factor with limit one. ## 5. An open local class where the ORIGINAL sink grows geometrically Let delta_norm=max(0,log|v|). Equation (4) gives |D_N|<=C exp(N delta_norm) on the present rho<1 chamber. Suppose a compact family has the explicit strict gap Lambda(u,v)>=delta_norm+eta, eta>0. (20) Equations (13), (15), and (18) then prove B_N(u,v)=R_N(u,v)[1+O(N^C exp(-N eta))], log|B_N(u,v)|=N Lambda(u,v)+O(log N). (21) This is noncancellation of the ORIGINAL local source. Its balanced contribution has coefficient exactly one, and its remaining original current is exponentially smaller under the stated checked inequality. No complex phase of the oscillatory sum was assumed to be nonzero. The exact source normalizer now proves the same Lambda formula for all |u|, including |u|=1. In that extension replace delta_norm by max(0,log|u|,log|v|); the compact gap and relative error statement are otherwise unchanged. Its proof is the explicit two-full-Psi source formula, not extrapolation of the nonsingular product sums of Section 4. All bounds are uniform for N-dependent parameters staying in the indicated compact chamber. In particular the ACTUAL tags u_N=Q^2U,v_N=QV from (2) are allowed whenever U,V belong to a compact gap family: for large N they stay in a slightly larger such family. Smoothness gives Lambda(u_N,v_N)=Lambda(U,V)+O(1/N). The factors NQ^d in (2) remain in the exact source; their magnitude adds log N to a logarithmic rate rather than being reset. The class is nonempty and open. If |v|=1, then G=0 and Lambda=[I_rho(gamma)-I_rho(phi)]/(2pi)>0, because gamma is upper and phi lower. Every compact family therefore has a positive gap, which persists in a full open neighborhood by continuity. For example u=0.7-0.4i and v=0.9+0.2i have Lambda approximately 0.191315 and norm-rate zero. A certified neighborhood follows from continuity; the theorem itself uses the explicit inequality (20), not that numerical example. There is also a literal unique regular critical action. The finite product's analytic action is W_source(s)=Li_2(v/u)-Li_2((v/u)exp s)+s Log u. Its stationary equation is u-v exp s=1. The marked solution is s_*=Log(1-u)+pi*i-Log v, with 0<Im s_*<2pi. Its second derivative is 1-u!=0. The elementary Euler and quad dilogarithm identities give W_source(s_*)=W+pi^2/6. Thus (18) is precisely this marked geometric critical rate, not an unrelated estimate on a maximum. The real constant has been recorded; no arbitrary complex period normalization is chosen to achieve the identity. ## 6. Scope and audit Equation (1) is a polynomial kernel identity, valid with every original exterior functional. Equations (13)--(21) give a local analytic growing-source theorem on a specified open chamber. To use it for an entire knot, one must prove that its actual positive-chart transport places the needed internal fibers in this chamber, control their joint exterior cycle, and retain all other source currents. Those global hypotheses have not been established for a broad knot class. No whole-knot volume conjecture follows from the present note. The [audit](../experiments/audit_actual_sink_source_convolution.py) checks the original coefficient/tag identity, central current, balanced nonvanishing, full-Psi VARIABLE monodromy, all four finite contour edges, exact Parseval ratio and representative growing-source comparisons. The uniform proofs above do not infer their all-level statements from finite checks.

title: An actual six-circuit collision and its exact three-beta source
text: # An actual six-circuit collision and its exact three-beta source 28 October 2026. A common zero-side direction exists for the nine atoms of either single crossing when its external ports may move. Such directions do NOT glue through arbitrary braid words. The actual figure-eight word [1,-2,1,-2] already contains a compatible minimal six-circuit in its first three crossings, with no port frozen and no Gaussian variable involved. Its exact quantum tag is Q^5. The useful replacement is constructive: complete the six factors by three actual atoms and contract three disjoint Newton stars. The entire block becomes B_N(U,a) B_N(V,b) B_N(c,cUV). (1) At the collision U=V=1 it is exactly N^2 v_N(a)v_N(b). All three beta currents are retained. In particular the last complete beta is 1 while its full-Psi residue is zero. The value identity alone does not bound normal derivatives or the surrounding original period. ## 1. Actual signed normals Use the slots, variables and exact shifts of [the original trivalent layer](actual_trivalent_layer_crossing_source.md). Let e_j denote d Log z_j and let e_G=d Log g be the one Gaussian coordinate (a fixed nonsingular linear coordinate in its complexified Gaussian line). With the original scalar Psi half-steps retained, the arguments and signs are: | slot | epsilon | positive argument | negative argument | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 0 | - | Q^-1 z2/z1 | same | | 1 | + | x^-1 z2/z0 | same | | 2 | - | Q^-1 z3/z0 | same | | 3 | + | Q z2/z4 | same | | 4 | - / + | Q^-1 x^-1 z3/z4 | g x^-1 z3/z4 | | 5 | - | Q^-1 g z5/z4 | same | | 6 | + | Q z3/z6 | same | | 7 | - | Q^-1 x^-1 z5/z6 | same | | 8 | + | Q z5/z7 | same | The signed normals w_j=epsilon_j d Log A_j are w0=e1-e2, w1=e2-e0, w2=e0-e3, w3=e2-e4, w6=e3-e6, w7=e6-e5, w8=e5-e7, w4+=e4-e3, w4-=e3-e4+eG, w5=e4-e5-eG. (2) In a single crossing there is no positive dependence among these normals. For the positive crossing a strict witness w_j(eta)<0 is eta=( -4,-6,-5,-3,-4,-1,-2,0 ), eta_G=0. For the negative crossing replace eta4 by -2. Every displayed pairing is at most -1. Thus ANY subset of single-crossing collisions has a common zero-side translation when all these coordinates may move. Freezing all four external ports creates artificial restrictions on this question. For reference, allowing the Gaussian line to move but freezing z0,z1,z6,z7 leaves minimal positive circuits {0,1}, {2,6}, {7,8}, {0,3,4,6} (positive), {0,1}, {2,6}, {7,8}, {2,4,5,8} (negative). These lists are exact nullspace calculations. They are not used to deduce the global obstruction below, which leaves EVERY external coordinate free. ## 2. The globally compatible six-circuit Take the first three crossings [1,-2,1] of the actual figure-eight word. Write C,D for the two outputs of crossing 1, and F for the first output of crossing 2. These are the two inputs C,F of crossing 3. Let L be crossing 1's z5, M crossing 2's z3, and T crossing 3's z2. The six DIRECT full functions in the circuit are exactly Psi_-(Log(L/(xC))-h) Psi_+(Log(L/D)+h) Psi_-(Log(M/D)-h) Psi_+(Log(M/F)+h) Psi_-(Log(T/F)-h) Psi_+(Log(T/(xC))), (3) where h=2pi i/N. All other atoms, original monomial prefactors, Gaussian weights and source coupons remain present. The signed-normal sums of the three pairs are respectively e_C-e_D, e_D-e_F, e_F-e_C. Their sum is zero. The six columns form a simple directed cycle, hence a minimal positive dependence with every coefficient 1. This uses slots (7,8) of crossing 1, (2,6) of crossing 2 and (0,1) of crossing 3. None contains the Gaussian coordinate or the sign-changing central slot, so the same dependence holds for any signs on the three positions [1,2,1]. It is not an adjacent same-pair C^-1 C cancellation. Collision feasibility must include the constants. The CLASSICAL six arguments in (3) all equal 1 at D=F=L=M=T=xC, C!=0. (4) The product of the EXACT arguments to their signs is Q^5, not -1. Consequently the exact six arguments can all equal 1 when N=5: L=QxC, D=Q^2xC, M=Q^3xC, F=Q^4xC, T=xC. For every large N the classical locus (4) puts all exact arguments within O(1/N) of 1. Thus this is a genuine simultaneous shrinking collision, even when no exact six-fold intersection exists at that N. The classical fixed constants are compatible, rather than a spurious signed-normal dependence with product constant -1. Original cap/trace factors do not impose coordinate identifications on C,D,F. In the full source they are retained holomorphic polynomial or interval factors. This circuit also does not force a source zero: the initial and final endpoints of the four-crossing word remain independent. They can be chosen with every source ratio of modulus different from 1, so all finite K_N source factors are nonzero on (4). This observation concerns the scalar integrand; it does not assert nonvanishing after the remaining integrations. ## 3. Exact grouping, with every omitted atom restored The circuit factors alone must not be integrated while omitting their third incident atoms. The full original layer supplies precisely these three disjoint Newton stars: * crossing 1, positive final star {5,7,8}, after its COMPLETE Gaussian absorption d_j/F_j=p_j x^-2j; * crossing 2, negative middle star {2,4,6}, with its ONE shared negative Gaussian retained; * crossing 3, first star {0,1,3}. Put t1,t2,t3 for their original residual source vertices z4 and set U=D/(xC), a=x^-2 D/t1, V=F/D, b=g_- x^-1 F/t2, c=t3/F. Their entire exact contraction is (1). The third beta's second argument is x^-1 t3/C=cUV. This is an invertible monomial coordinate change in the nonzero variables (C,D,F,t1,t2,t3,g_-); no independent phase, clock or source factor has been dropped. The contraction is first proved on the original finite coefficient kernels. Each of L,M,T occurs only in its three incident atoms, and the three sets of atoms are disjoint. Their finite coefficient sums therefore commute with each other and with the remaining original source contraction. The already proved full-Psi relative source may then be reinserted for each COMPLETE B. This proves a source-preserving operation, rather than a pointwise replacement of separated residues. The same argument contracts the prescribed two disjoint Newton stars at every crossing of an arbitrary signed word; this is the whole-word identity of the linked trivalent-layer note. It does not remove the remaining Rogers factors or justify deleting any beta currents. ## 4. Exact collision fibre and its actual source sectors With F_j=(Q;Q)_j and p_j=(-1)^j Q^(j(j-1)/2)/F_j, use B_N(u,v)=sum_(i+j<N) F_(i+j)/F_i p_j u^i v^j, v_N(v)=sum_(j=0)^(N-1) p_j v^j. Then, identically in v and u, B_N(1,v)=N v_N(v), B_N(u,u)=1. (5) For the first identity, fix j. The quotient F_(i+j)/F_i is (Q^(i+1);Q)_j. Extend its i-sum to a full N-orbit: every added term contains 1-Q^N and is zero. Since j<N, root orthogonality leaves only its constant term, giving sum_i (Q^(i+1);Q)_j=N. For the second, the total-degree-n coefficient is the finite binomial sum sum_j (-1)^j Q^(j(j-1)/2) [n choose j]_Q=(1;Q)_n. It is 1 at n=0 and zero for 1<=n<N. These are elementary finite polynomial proofs. Thus U=V=1 gives B_N(U,a)B_N(V,b)B_N(c,cUV) =N^2 v_N(a)v_N(b). (6) This all-N fusion incorporates the fixed half-step mismatch; it is not obtained by setting Q=1 in (3). For the ORIGINAL relative beta source write B=S+D I, where D=1-u^N+v^N, S=(N/phi_N)u^N Psi_+(h-Logu)Psi_+(Log(v/u)) exp[-Log(v/u)Logu/h]. On (4), the three normalizers are a^N, b^N and 1. They do NOT vanish. The exact anchors Psi_+(h)=phi_N and Psi_+(0)=0 give, at regular c, S_N(1,a)=N Psi_+(Loga), a^N I_N(1,a)=N[v_N(a)-Psi_+(Loga)], S_N(c,c)=0, I_N(c,c)=1. (7) The same holds for b. Hence the all-residue three-star term is zero on this fibre; a nonzero complete factor is carried by the third CURRENT. This is an explicit actual boundary contribution, not a justification for declaring every current geometrically degenerate. There is also an exact raw-product simplification on the port locus D=F=xC, before integrating L,M,T. Put l=L/(xC), m=M/(xC), t=T/(xC). The six factors (3) are then exactly K_N(l) K_N(m) (1-t^N), K_N(s)=sum_(j=0)^d s^j. (8a) In |Log l|,|Log m|,|Log t|<=delta their modulus is at most 2N^2 exp(3Ndelta). Thus the fixed Q^5 mismatch has an explicit retained polynomial source, rather than being a unit or an uncontrolled scalar. This estimate is on the port-coincidence locus. It does not bound derivatives transverse to D=F=xC after the complete sink integrations. The product identity Psi_+(z)Psi_-(z)=(1-e^z)(1-e^(Nz)), Psi_+(z)Psi_-(z-h)=1-e^(Nz) (8) follows directly by pairing the finite factors in their defining formula on Re z<0, then continuing the same functions. For example, when the corresponding external ports coincide, a U/F pair in (3) can become K_N(t)=(1-t^N)/(1-t), while a U/V pair becomes 1-t^N. These CENTRAL factors are part of the original source and cannot be replaced by a unit. Away from port coincidence each pair retains its nontrivial deck character, for example P(L+full turn)/P(L) =[1-(L/(xC))^N]/[1-(L/D)^N] for the first pair in (3). Thus no pointwise deletion into a single- valued rational norm factor follows on a neighborhood of (4). ## 5. What is and is not controlled near the collision Equation (1) is a polynomial in U,V,a,b,c, so the COMPLETE contracted source has no analytic pole near U=V=1. Arbitrary finite local contour homotopies are therefore legal after this coherent contraction, with their original side currents retained. This is stronger than trying to choose an impossible common zero-side direction for (3). Its exponential bound is a different question. Equations (5)--(7) specify values on a codimension-two fibre, not bounds for their normal jets. In particular S(c,c)=0 and I(c,c)=1 do not show that I is tame on an N-dependent neighborhood. All exterior source couplings remain, and the remaining two Euler factors in (6) can have nontrivial action. No implication that every tangential stationary boundary point is an honest original representation is proved here. Such a statement needs the actual normal equations or a source-preserving alternative chart, not signed-normal compatibility alone. The [audit](../experiments/audit_actual_six_circuit_beta_collision.py) checks the minimal circuits, the two single-crossing witnesses, the exact Q^5 mismatch and N=5 intersection, both full-function identities, and the finite beta collision identities at multiple levels. ## 6. A non-strict simultaneous patch, even for dependent normals Positive circuits obstruct a COMMON zero-side direction. They do not obstruct a finite local regularization of subexponential absolute cost. This distinction gives a second constructive treatment of the raw six-circuit without assuming port coincidence. Suppose in a fixed finite local tube the ACTUAL differential form is product_(j=1)^s Psi_(epsilon_j)(u_j(Z)) exp(G(Z)/h) a_N(Z) dZ, u_j=v_j.Z+c_j, (9) where the nonzero real integral v_j may be dependent. Every u_j uses the DIRECT collision lift near zero; a finite full-function half-step may be included in c_j. The complete form, its original co-source and a_N are holomorphic in this tube. All other factors are retained in G,a_N and remain in their legal regular windows. Assume |a_N|<=exp(oN) and |partial G|<=C(1+log N) there. The qualification about the direct lift is substantive: an additional full turn carries its rational norm denominator, which cannot be declared holomorphic separately. Choose a fixed real vector eta outside the finitely many hyperplanes v_j.eta=0, and rescale it so min_j |v_j.eta|>=1. Such eta exists for ANY arrangement, whether it has positive circuits or not. For initial |u_j|<=delta, with delta=N^-alpha and 0<alpha<1, translate H_t(Z)=Z+2i delta t eta, 0<=t<=1. (10) The whole sweep has |u_j|<=C_eta delta. At its outgoing end each epsilon_j Im u'_j is either at least delta or at most -delta. The sign is fixed by epsilon_j v_j.eta, independently of the initial point. Each direct factor is holomorphic and bounded by |Psi_(epsilon_j)(u_j)| <=exp[C Ndelta(1+|log delta|)+O(log N)] (11) throughout this entire tube, including its accumulating zeros. To prove this, shift it by a FIXED integer O(Ndelta) of its signed quantum steps until the entire tube lies in the selected strip at distance comparable to delta. The exact shift writes the original function as that regular shifted function TIMES O(Ndelta) factors 1-exp(u+jh). Each latter factor has modulus <=Cdelta. The shrinking-strip symbol bound and Li_2(exp w)=pi^2/6+O(w(1+|Log w|)) prove (11). There are no inverse finite products in this argument. It is the same scalar collar proof as [the isolated patch](actual_isolated_shape_one_downhill_patch.md). For every outgoing factor on its negative signed side use the EXACT identity Psi_epsilon(u')=(1-exp(Nu')) Psi_epsilon(u'+epsilon 2pi i). (12) The other outgoing factors already lie in their selected strips. Thus the outgoing form is exactly a sum of at most 2^s regular full-Psi sectors. Each central exponential in (12) adds its original 2pi i u' to the action; none is discarded. Dependence among the u_j merely allows two such marks to coincide and does not invalidate the finite expansion or its inherited source. The translation has Jacobian one, its sweep has bounded mass cost in fixed dimension, and G changes by O(delta log N). Relative to the SAME tangential background phase, the complete tube and each regular outgoing sector have upper cost exp(O(Ndelta log N)+oN)=exp(oN). This is an ABSOLUTE local estimate, not a lower bound or a ratio to an incoming integrand which may vanish. Stokes gives exactly incoming =sum of outgoing sectors minus the original side sweep, as in the isolated patch. Every side current and every logarithmic mark remains. For the six-circuit, (10) applies directly with coordinates (Log C,Log D,Log F,Log L,Log M,Log T) and, for example, eta=(0,1,2,4,8,16). Its three negative-root factors go to their zero side and its three positive-root factors to their selected regular side. The outgoing source has eight sectors with all central norms. This patch need not be DOWNHILL: positive circuits prevent extending the isolated signed downhill argument to all its factors at once. Neither the number of visits to such patches nor the exponential action of their tangential side currents is controlled here. In particular, the patch does not show that a restricted tangential stationary point lies on the saturated original critical graph.

title: The actual six-pants boundary: topology, a pointed finite frame and sewing
text: # The actual six-pants boundary: topology, a pointed finite frame and sewing 29 October 2026. The four-octahedron geometric block has six pants boundaries, but its actual quantum boundary cannot be replaced by six independent complete-color trivalent states or by the positive closed theta scalar. This note gives three concrete results toward the open kernel: the boundary incidence and genus of every connected NC Morse graph; an explicit nondegenerate marked Frobenius frame on every surviving joint source cell, with at most eight coordinates; and an exact original-source counterexample to independent three-axis marked pairings. The remaining geometric-cut identification and conditioning questions are stated separately. ## 1. The boundary slopes and actual incidence At a retained crossing disk, its three-punctured-sphere boundary has the slopes (belt longitude, first main meridian, second main meridian). (1) The first boundary circle follows the crossing disk boundary, while the two others are the small circles cut from that disk around its intersections with the physical main strands. Thus (1) is a literal topological path statement. These are not three meridian-polarized color-N punctures. The original mixed circle realizes precisely the longitude-polarized operator L_l(Omega), as proved with all physical ports retained in the [circle source theorem](actual_crossing_circle_source_and_filling.md). There is a sharp parity check on the distinction. At even N the unrolled H weights of V_N^tensor3 are odd, so its integer-H invariant space is zero. Nevertheless the actual even marked theta source is nonzero for N>=4. Assigning Inv(V_N^tensor3) independently to each geometric pants would therefore lose the original source. This does not disprove a boundary theory in the correct polarization. Let Gamma be a CONNECTED graph in the actual ordered NC Morse class: 2b trivalent vertices, b black and b white, and E=3b edge slots. Use its literal noncrossing cup and cap matchings, with a retained circle on every edge slot. Cut the projection sphere and all crossing disks, and then glue ONLY the white projection faces. Before the final shaded pairings there are 2E boundary pants, naturally indexed by the halfedges (v,e) of Gamma. The exact adjacency of their rank-one cusp annuli is as follows. * Each graph edge e joins the two pants (v,e),(w,e) by the annulus at its retained crossing-circle cusp. * At a graph vertex v, the three original cup or cap arcs join its three incident pants pairwise, giving a triangle of three main-arc cusp annuli. Hence this adjacency graph is the Fisher expansion T(Gamma): replace each trivalent vertex by a triangle and retain the original matching edges between those triangles. It is connected, cubic, with number of pants=2E, number of annuli=3E, genus of the connected truncated boundary=E+1=3b+1. (2) For a direct proof of the genus, the pants contribute Euler characteristic -2E, and the annuli zero. Their specified connected gluing is an oriented closed boundary surface, so 2-2g=-2E. The same count follows from the projection cut: its connected bowtie skeleton has 3E ideal vertices, 6E edges and 2E shaded faces, hence E+2 white faces. Gluing the two projection balls along those white disks is a handlebody with E+1 handles. This is also a direct topological construction of the boundary surface in (2). Reducible diagram faces can be read as boundary walks after taking a regular neighborhood; no convex geometric realization is asserted for an arbitrary such graph. For the theta graph, T(Gamma) is the triangular prism and g=4. This is precisely the six-pants geometric block in [the actual theta angle certificate](actual_marked_theta_link_and_angle_geometry.md). For b>1 the true open white-glued object has one connected boundary of genus 3b+1. It is not b independent copies of that genus-four block. To obtain T(Gamma), the cusp annuli between vertex triples must be rewired according to the original Gamma. Gluing geodesic pants in an arbitrary collection of blocks is a valid geometric operation, but it does not by itself implement this original annulus and white-face wiring. That topological identification requires its own explicit cut certificate. ## 2. A canonical finite actual marked frame on every regular cell Use the saturated six-head source S_N, its three disjoint pair Casimirs A_1,A_2,A_3, and the actual nested cup v=p_16 p_23 p_45. For a folded triple j=(a,b,c) let E_j be the FULL regular joint cluster projector, not a value-only projector. Restrict now to a+b+c>=d=N-1. The [proved regular-cube theorem](actual_trivalent_all_channel_positive_scalar_and_regular_cubes.md) gives the actual source cell S_j=R_r v_j, v_j=E_j v, R_r=C[eta_1,...,eta_r]/(eta_1^2,...,eta_r^2), dim S_j=2^r<=8. (3) There is one eta_i for each PAIRED axis, and it is chosen as the ACTUAL complete-circle sector on that axis. On an odd simple axis the corresponding circle is the scalar N. Thus eta_i is the full first-normal nilpotent, with its original coefficient, rather than an arbitrarily normalized formal coordinate. Let lambda be the original unrestricted physical marked co-source, including the two other ordinary caps. Define actual boundary moments by m_I=lambda(eta_I v_j), eta_I=product_(i in I)eta_i, tau_j=m_all=Z_N(a,b,c)/N^(3-r)>0. (4) The last equality is the [all-channel marked source evaluation](actual_trivalent_all_channel_marked_contraction.md). All moments in (4), including the lower ones, are finite original physical contractions with full cluster projectors and the same marked row. None is declared small or omitted. The pointed boundary multiplication pairing is B_j(fv_j,gv_j)=lambda(fg v_j), F_(I,J)=0 if I intersects J, F_(I,J)=m_(I union J) otherwise. (5) It is NONDEGENERATE. More precisely let C_(I,J)=1 if I=J^c and zero otherwise. Multiplication by the following explicitly known unit q_j of R_r gives q_j(eta)=sum_I (m_(I^c)/tau_j)eta_I, q_j(0)=1, lambda(fv_j)=tau_j[eta_all](q_j f), F=tau_j C M_(q_j), det F=det(C) tau_j^(2^r)!=0. (6) Indeed the coefficient identity is checked on each monomial, and M_(q_j) is unitriangular in increasing degree. Equivalently every nonzero ideal of the regular cube contains its top monomial, whose actual marked value is (4). There is no arbitrary maximal-minor denominator or implicit choice of Smith frame in (6). This gives an exact algebraic sewing kernel on the WHOLE source cell: in the monomial frame v_I=eta_I v_j it is I_j=sum_(I,J)(F^(-1))_(I,J) v_I tensor v_J. (7) For example inserting (7) into two boundary linear functionals reproduces their contraction through the pairing (5). Because B_j is nondegenerate, all linear exteriors on S_j can be represented this way. This is an all-exterior statement on this ACTUAL finite source cell. It does not assert that the geometric mapping class of a pants seam acts by the pairing (5) without further typing. ## 3. Explicit positive Gram and its unproved cost The same moments give a positive Gram without frame inversion. Put n_j=q_j-1 and use the FINITE binomial polynomial q_j^(-1/2)=sum_(k=0)^r binom(-1/2,k)n_j^k, w_I=q_j^(-1/2)eta_I v_j. (8) Nilpotence makes this exact; there is no analytic square-root branch. Then B_j(w_I,w_J)=tau_j delta_(I,J^c), I_j=(1/tau_j)sum_I w_I tensor w_(I^c). (9) Define the conjugate-linear reflection J_j by J_j(w_I)=w_(I^c), and conjugate its coefficients. The explicit Hermitian form H_j(u,v)=B_j(J_j u,v)/tau_j (10) makes the w_I an orthonormal basis. Thus it is positive definite on the actual complete source cell. J_j is a constructed boundary reflection; it has not been identified with a physical mirror or with the original ribbon duality. Its actual source and dual costs are also explicit. Write q_j^(1/2)=sum_I a_I eta_I and K_j=sum_I|a_I|^2. Then ||v_j||_(H_j)^2=K_j, ||lambda|S_j||_(H_j^(-1))^2=tau_j^2 K_j. (11) The first equality uses v_j=q_j^(-1/2)q_j^(1/2)v_j. For the second, lambda(w_I)=tau_j a_(I^c). These identities display exactly what a Cauchy estimate would cost. Bounded coordinate count does NOT prove K_j is polynomial or subexponential. The lower moments m_I/tau_j can carry amplification, and transitions between different pairings can mix cells. A quantitative bound for those actual moments and for genuine recoupling matrices remains required. The source cells outside a+b+c>=d are NOT discarded. Their full marked source need not be killed by the three-circle observed quotient, as shown by the [marked radical obstruction](actual_three_belt_saturated_source_and_marked_metric.md). They remain additional packets in any full open boundary construction. Equations (3)--(11) concern precisely the regular surviving cells. ## 4. A rigorous original-source obstruction to independent axes The actual marked pairing (5) need not be a product of three two-dimensional axis pairings. There is already an exact counterexample at N=4 and a=b=c=1. Reduce its ORIGINAL physical matrices in the cyclotomic field Q(q), q^4=-1, by the homomorphism q -> 762 modulo the prime 1009. This image has exact order eight. All physical and projector denominators are nonzero in this reduction. In mask order empty,1,2,12,3,13,23,123 the actual normalized marked moments are (m_I/tau) mod1009=(571,201,201,0,201,0,0,1). (12) These are RESIDUES, not complex values or floating-point fits. The flattening of this three-axis moment tensor has the minor det [[m_empty/tau,m_23/tau], [m_1/tau,m_123/tau]]=571!=0 mod1009. (13) Thus the original moment tensor is not decomposable over C: an identically zero cyclotomic minor would reduce to zero. Rank-one flattening is invariant under independent invertible changes on each axis, so such changes cannot make it a tensor product either. Equivalently the unit in (6) has q_1=q_2=0 but q_12=201 in this reduction, violating q_12=q_1q_2. This is a finite exact nonfactorization proof for the prescribed original marked data. It does not rule out a correlated Gram like (10), a larger faithful angle embedding, or a different physical cut. It rules out replacing this actual three-axis marked boundary pairing by three independent scalar pants norms. ## 5. Original sewing uses one synchronized normal The [exact NC Morse source reduction](actual_nc_morse_graph_first_normal_source_reduction.md) gives the appropriate all-width algebraic boundary packet in a chosen regular generic lift. For fixed labels it retains the entire ordinary magnetic tensor network Xi_Gamma(t), all source coefficients s_v(t), the root h0_j,gamma_j,omega_j, and the SAME parameter t at every boundary. If epsilon^2=0, it is equivalently a tensor network over C[epsilon]/epsilon^2 with one common epsilon: B_v(epsilon)=B_v(0)+epsilon B_v'(0), Z_Gamma=(1/nu_N)[epsilon] {C_Gamma product_v s_v(epsilon) Xi_Gamma(epsilon)}, nu_N=2N(-1)^N/(q-q^(-1)). (14) Here the original marked cap must be GLOBALLY exposed/top-level in the Morse diagram, or its pointed tensor must be genuinely transported to that cut. A bare local marked row at an arbitrarily nested white cap is not covered by (14). The original theta mark on16 is exposed, so none of the local marked moments in sections2--4 is affected. Every matrix entry and derivative here is explicit in the original regular W,pi and cups. Only ONE first-normal insertion occurs in each term of (14), summed over its possible positions. Assigning independent epsilon_v and extracting one normal from each local block gives a different source. For example two disjoint theta sources with just one marked arc have an extra ordinary zero dimension and vanish, whereas the product of their two independently marked positive values is nonzero. The missing normalization is not repaired by a scalar factor on each block. For a sole unsaturated marked-white vertex the retained term is s_v'(0)Xi_Gamma(0); at all saturated vertices the term is product_v s_v(0) Xi_Gamma'(0). These alternatives are genuine full source identities, not a selection of a preferred geometric saddle. The source theorem also proves nontriangle deletion at the marked vertex through the entire generic physical cut, rather than by assuming the unrestricted mark is an ordinary invariant. The nondegenerate kernel (7), the topology (2), the longitude polarization (1), and the synchronized normal (14) give concrete necessary data for a proposed geometric six-pants sewing map. What is NOT yet proved is that arbitrary pants identifications are represented by the canonical algebraic sewing (7), with the actual annulus/meridian markings and controlled positive energy. A valid identification must retain the unsupported packets, realize the Fisher cusp incidence, transport the original single mark, and control the correlated boundary Gram and recouplings. No closed theta scalar can replace these checks. The [focused exact audit](../experiments/audit_actual_six_pants_boundary_torsor_and_sewing.py) uses full physical cluster projectors, nilpotent circle matrices, nested cups and unrestricted marked row at six levels N=3,...,8. It checks all four regular-block sizes, the actual Frobenius determinant, finite square-root congruence, and the exact residue certificate (12),(13). It separately checks the connected Fisher boundaries of the genuine theta, dipole and corrected cube source diagrams. The finite algebraic proofs above establish the general regular-cell claims; no polynomial conditioning or general graph volume is inferred. The root independently read the topology, actual Frobenius determinant, finite square-root construction, exact source/dual costs, cyclotomic nonfactorization inference and synchronized-normal scope and reported analytical PASS. The exact residue arithmetic was separately replayed by the focused physical audit. These are internal checks, not external peer review.

title: Source-exact analytic sewing: the physical interface and the remaining six-port estimate
text: # Source-exact analytic sewing: the physical interface and the remaining six-port estimate 29 October 2026. This separates an exact original-source fact from an analytic criterion. Uncrossed sewing of literal physical ports has only polynomial norm cost. A coherent scalar packet can then be sewn on any fixed graph, including graphs with cycles, if its JOINT marked phase has a controlled nondegenerate saddle and a global gap. Local packet gaps alone do not establish those hypotheses. The genuine six-port source is known exactly, but its required physical coefficient estimate is still missing; no broader knot equality is claimed here. The distinction matters because the [generic six-port channel frame](actual_six_port_deformable_source_and_recoupling.md) is source exact only after saturation, and is not known to be tame. The theorem below does not assume a tame 6j/Smith frame. ## 1. The literal physical interface is polynomially conditioned Retain N,d=N-1,q,Q,x and the ORIGINAL turns, with |x|=1: p_ab=N x^(-b) delta_(a+b,d), ell_ab=x^a delta_(a+b,d)/N, m_ab=x^b/N^2. Let U_ab=x^(-b)delta_(a+b,d). Then U is unitary, the cup matrix is NU, and the ordinary cap matrix is U^(-1)/N. Consequently a single-leg bend has matrix norm N or N^(-1), with no factorial conditioning. As flattened tensors their exact Euclidean norms are ||p||=N^(3/2), ||ell||=N^(-1/2), ||m||=N^(-1). (1) The last equality uses the FULL unrestricted marked row. Its eventual integer-degree restriction may be made only after the assembled source forces it. Pivots, literal leg permutations, and genuine dual-object isometries have norm one. Closing a fixed number of bare wires costs at most a fixed power of N by finite-dimensional Cauchy. Thus for any fixed planar port graph G whose crossings and nontrivial coupons are kept INSIDE its specified blocks, its remaining original sewing functional satisfies |Gamma_N(A_1,...,A_v)| <= N^(C_G) product_i ||A_i||_2. (2) This follows by composing the displayed turns and partial contractions; C_G is independent of N. Formula (2) retains the actual marked row, all unit characters, and every original scalar normalization. It does NOT make R or a changed recoupling frame polynomially bounded. A braid at an interface must be included in a block, or estimated separately. In particular the exact six-head source can be sewn in its FULL physical tensor basis without an inverse generic Clebsch minor. Its known orthogonal projection onto the saturated generic source has norm one. But neither the reduced invariant lift Phi nor the unspecified generic channel inverse is thereby proved tame; those are different maps. Nor does a flat orthogonal projection prove preservation of an exponentially weighted geometric corridor. ## 2. A quantitative error budget that survives the actual contraction Suppose an exact physical block is A_i=A_i^0+E_i, where, for fixed G, ||A_i^0|| <= N^C exp(N a_i), ||E_i|| <= N^C exp[N(a_i-gamma_i)], gamma_i>0. (3) Expansion of the multilinear contraction and (2) give the PROVED bound |Gamma_N(A)-Gamma_N(A^0)| <= N^(C') exp[N(sum_i a_i-min_i gamma_i)]. (4) If the proposed coherent main signal has rate F, preservation of its nonzero leading coefficient is therefore guaranteed by min_i gamma_i > sum_i a_i-F. (5) One can improve (4) using boundary-dependent profiles and joint maxima, but one cannot omit the loss sum a_i-F. Relative O(1/N) block errors do not in general preserve an exponentially smaller closed signal. For an elementary sharp warning, contract vectors A=(exp(Na),exp(Na),1), B=(exp(Nb),-exp(Nb),1). Their exact pairing is 1. Perturbing the second coordinate of A by exp[N(a-gamma)] changes the pairing by exp[N(a+b-gamma)]. The contraction itself has norm one. Thus exponential amplification here comes from coherent cancellation, not an ill-conditioned measure. The actual source has its own stronger warning: at even N the full circle satisfies L_N^2=0 although L_N is nonzero. Hence multiplying nonzero local circle images cannot supply a nonzero sewn density by itself. This is precisely why the genuine six-port junction cannot be replaced by Frobenius multiplication or by dephased positive routes. ## 3. A nonzero marked lattice-saddle theorem Here is a sufficient analytic statement with an explicit noncancellation proof. After solving the EXACT wire/complement constraints, suppose a piece of the original scalar is S_N=c_N sum_(k in NP intersect (Z^r+sigma_N)) a_N(k/N) exp[N Phi(k/N)], (6) where P is a fixed compact convex polytope, r is fixed, and c_N is its original nonzero unit-character/power-of-N line. Affine O(1/N) shifts from d=N-1 must be retained in a_N or Phi_N, not silently replaced by their limit. For simplicity (6) displays one exact lattice coset. For example Phi_N=Phi+Psi/N+O(N^(-2)) changes the leading density to a_0 exp(Psi); that nonzero normalization factor is part of the answer. Assume the following on a fixed neighborhood of an interior x_*: * Phi is C^3 there, a_0 is C^1, and a_N=a_0+O(1/N) uniformly, with a_0(x_*)!=0. * For a RETAINED integer Poisson mark m, grad Phi(x_*)=2pi i m. * H=-Phi''(x_*) is complex symmetric with Re H positive definite. * Re Phi has its unique maximum F=Re Phi(x_*) on P; it has a fixed gap outside every fixed neighborhood of x_*. The local drop is quadratic. Globally |a_N| is polynomially bounded. Then the whole sum (6), not just its absolute envelope, has S_N=c_N exp(2pi i m.sigma_N) exp[N Phi_m(x_*)] N^(r/2) (2pi)^(r/2) a_0(x_*)/sqrt(det H) (1+O(N^(-1/2))), (7) where Phi_m=Phi-2pi i m.x. The square root is the continuous Gaussian branch on Re H>0. In particular its leading coefficient is nonzero. Proof. On the exact coset the removed mark is the constant phase in (7). All terms outside a small fixed ball have a uniform exponential gap. Inside, put t=sqrt(N)(x-x_*). Taylor expansion gives the Gaussian exp(-t^T H t/2), with an integrable quadratic envelope. Restrict first to |t|<=N^epsilon, epsilon<1/6; the Taylor error is controlled by the Gaussian moments and is O(N^(-1/2)) after summation. The complementary local tail is exponentially small in N^(2epsilon). Gaussian Riemann sums with mesh N^(-1/2) converge uniformly in their bounded coset shift to the Gaussian integral, with O(N^(-1/2)) error by integrating the summable first derivatives over grid cells. That integral equals (2pi)^(r/2)/sqrt(det H): prove it first for real positive H and continue holomorphically on the convex domain Re H>0, using the same integrable bound. This proves (7) without deleting any endpoint residue. For finitely many lattice cosets or marked sectors, their ACTUAL leading coefficients must be summed. Individual nonzero coefficients need not have nonzero sum. The single-coset theorem does not supply that extra arithmetic/source pairing. The original pretzel proof checks its paired charges explicitly; the six-port problem must do the corresponding work. If the saddle is off the original real grid, (7) cannot be applied by declaring a new contour. One must first prove an EXACT source contour identity with all side currents retained. On a specified middle- dimensional contour having a real parametrization, the analogous continuous Gaussian proof applies to its pulled-back phase and density. Its Jacobian, boundary gaps and residual source currents are hypotheses, not consequences of a formal complex Hessian. ### Fixed original normal jets: a uniform packet is the needed input The [bounded-confluence theorem](actual_six_port_bounded_confluent_blocks.md) now bounds the actual six-port source clusters by eight and their required normal coefficient order by a fixed constant (ten coefficients suffice). This removes an unbounded-order jet problem, but not a conditioning or nonvanishing problem. Here is the exact analytic consequence. Let t=zeta-q be the ACTUAL normal parameter. If a coherent error E_N(t) is holomorphic on |t|<=r_N, r_N>=N^(-B), and sup_|t|<=r_N ||E_N(t)|| <= N^C exp[N(F-gamma)], then for every fixed j<=J, ||[t^j] E_N|| <= N^(C+Bj) exp[N(F-gamma)]. (7a) This is Cauchy's coefficient formula in any fixed physical tensor norm; finite dimension does not add an exponential loss. A fixed-pole Smith regularization uses only finitely many such coefficients, so (7a) preserves its exponential gap IF its explicit multiplying matrices have polynomial bounds, or their exponential rates are included in the budget (5). The bound on cluster size alone supplies neither fact. The selected leading normal density must also be nonzero. For a scalar packet exp[N Phi(t)]a(t), any fixed derivative is exp[N Phi(0)] times an explicit finite Bell polynomial in N and the derivatives of Phi,a. The original source's specified linear combination of those polynomials must be shown to have at least a polynomial lower bound. A fixed derivative order does not prevent that combination from vanishing. If only a finite inverse-N approximation to a(t) is used, it must be taken to sufficient order to survive the N^(BJ) Cauchy cost; a pointwise O(1/N) approximation is not automatically differentiable at that cost. The [bounded factorial envelope](bounded_normal_quantum_factorial_envelope.md) controls explicit termwise normal coefficients. It does not imply the UNIFORM COHERENT disk estimate in (7a). The physical original finite tangles have their own regular normal family, which must remain the one used in (7a); a root-only identity or another interpolating germ is not interchangeable with it. This is a precise analytic target for the new bounded six-port source, rather than a claim of automatic survival. ## 4. Closure on a fixed graph and the geometric test Suppose every specified scalar block packet is expressed in its actual physical boundary labels. After literal sewing, these labels are affine functions L_i x+b_i of the independent wire coordinates. The total phase and density are the SUM of block phases and the PRODUCT of their densities, with the original wire characters included. The integration domain is the intersection of their actual support domains. In the real-concave case below this sewn domain is required to be compact and convex. If its actual support is not convex, a global uniqueness and gap statement must instead be proved on all its components. For real concave phases, uniform strict concavity on all free directions follows from the checkable matrix inequality sum_i L_i^T[-Phi_i''] L_i >= h I, h>0. (8) This allows local gauge zero modes if their joint kernel has been removed by the exact lattice constraints. An interior solution of the FULL sewn equations has a unique maximum and the required boundary gap; the finite lattice theorem proves its nonzero coefficient. Nothing in this argument restricts the fixed graph to a tree. For complex phases the corresponding LOCAL statement is also stable under elimination. If Re H>0 and internal coordinates are eliminated at their genuine stationary point, the effective Hessian is H_eff=H_ee-H_ei H_ii^(-1)H_ie, Re H_eff>0. (9) Indeed for w=(-H_ii^(-1)H_ie v,v), H w=(0,H_eff v), so Re(v^*H_eff v)=w^*(Re H)w>0. The effective density is multiplied by the NONZERO Gaussian determinant of H_ii. A global gap and the source contour family still need a separate proof; (9) alone is local. If, in addition, the actual block canonical graphs identify the sewn stationarity equations with full shape matching, true INTEGER edge angles and the marked peripheral periods, the [full-slice criterion](source_angle_stationarity_critical_audit.md) identifies the positive critical point with the Casson--Rivin maximum. Absolute regulator calibration and primitive smooth end completion then identify its value with hyperbolic volume. These geometric tests cannot be inferred from (8), ordinary channel triangle inequalities, or the fact that a physical source polytope is combinatorially an octahedron. ## 5. Actual applicability and the next local estimate The measure hypothesis is ALREADY true for literal original physical sewing by Section 1. Exact cap-tree kernels also give a real, all-width test case for positive squared kernels: their complete contraction has once-power positive simplex energy and strict concavity, with all internal factorials and phases accounted for in the [cap-tree theorem](actual_cap_tree_angle_energy.md). That test case does not give a complete interior six-port block. For the genuine six-port source, the [divided-power theorem](actual_six_port_divided_power_source_kernel.md) provides the exact saturated source kernel, all original marked normalizations, and a finite formula for every physical coefficient. It does NOT yet provide: * a coherent physical coefficient packet with the nonzero density and uniform complex/corridor bounds needed in (6), or an exact permitted contour putting its saddle on that real parameter domain; * an error exponent satisfying the JOINT budget (5), and a global complementary-source gap; * the actual six-port canonical/angle incidence required after (9). Thus a generic 6j formula followed by an unspecified inverse minor is not the missing estimate. A sufficient concrete target is a uniform packet for the literal six-head tensor of a SPECIFIED prime tangle in its physical ports, retaining its divided Ward relation. Such a result can be sewn without first proving a tame generic channel frame. This changes where the conditioning problem must be solved, but does not pretend the currently known six-port kernel already meets the analytic hypotheses or establish a new general volume-equality family.

title: Complete six-port confluence in blocks of at most eight channels
text: # Complete six-port confluence in blocks of at most eight channels 29 October 2026. The saturated ORIGINAL six-port source decomposes by regular joint idempotents of the three disjoint pair Casimirs. Each block has rank at most eight. Relative to primitive generic eigenline columns, its Smith exponents are between0 and3. Thus only three normal saturation steps are needed. An explicit physical-projector construction of those columns requires Taylor order at most TEN, independently of N. This avoids arbitrary maximal-minor denominators. It is a valuation and finite-jet theorem, NOT an estimate on a frame's Hermitian condition number. All actual Casimir derivatives, original turns and marked rows are retained. Disjoint pairs alone do not give bounded-size blocks at eight or more heads; section7 states the precise limitation. ## 1. The actual lattice and the three commuting pair operators Fix N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), and t=zeta-q. Work over O=C{t}, K=Frac O, M=V_d(zeta)^tensor6, Lambda=Inv_K(M tensor K) intersect M. (1) All modules and matrices use the regular balanced generic original color. The [deformable source theorem](actual_six_port_deformable_source_and_recoupling.md) proves saturation, injective root specialization and rank Lambda=(N^3+N)/2. The [normal Ward theorem](actual_six_port_divided_power_source_kernel.md) also identifies its root image with the explicit divided-current kernel. Neither statement semisimplifies the original root color. Let A_1,A_2,A_3 be the actual pair Casimirs on physical pairs12,34,56. They commute and have the generic polynomial P(z;zeta)=product_(a=0)^d(z-c_a(zeta)), c_a(zeta)=zeta^(2a+1)+zeta^(-2a-1). (2) The original generic highest-vector calculation proves P(A_i)=0; at the root it is the complete polynomial T_N(z)+2, including its double nodes. Their coefficients and all A_i are regular over O. ## 2. Regular cluster idempotents split the SATURATED source Partition indices a by their root value c_a(q). Each cluster is C={a,d-a}, with a singleton when N is odd and a=d/2. Put g_C(z)=product_(a in C)(z-c_a(zeta)). Distinct g_C have resultant a UNIT of O: their roots have distinct values at t=0. The elementary Chinese-remainder/Bezout construction therefore gives polynomials e_C(z) with coefficients in O such that, modulo P, e_C=1 mod g_C, e_C=0 mod g_D (D!=C), sum_C e_C=1, e_C e_D=delta_(CD)e_C. (3) One may construct e_C=H_C B_C, where H_C=P/g_C and B_C is its inverse modulo g_C. Only a scalar/unit resultant is inverted; no vanishing eigenvalue gap within C is divided at this step. Each e_C(A_i) preserves M and the generic invariant space, hence Lambda. The triple products E_C=e_(C1)(A_1)e_(C2)(A_2)e_(C3)(A_3) (4) are regular orthogonal ALGEBRAIC idempotents summing to identity. Thus Lambda=direct_sum_C Lambda_C, Lambda_C=E_C Lambda. (5) This is an actual decomposition of the free saturated lattice and therefore also of its root source. It is not just a list of generic eigenvalues that might miss the normal directions at specialization. Over K the ordinary triangular channels are triples(a,b,c) satisfying |a-b|<=c<=a+b. Each contributes ONE invariant line. Consequently rank Lambda_C=#admissible triples in C1 x C2 x C3<=8. (6) The bound applies on the invariant lattice. The corresponding physical joint pair eigenspace before imposing invariance is much larger. Admissible subsets of a cube need not be the whole cube, and Lambda_C need not be a free rank-one module over three dual-number variables. ## 3. Three is a uniform saturation bound For a double cluster C={a,a*}, a*=d-a, the individual generic branch projector is p_a(A)=e_C(A)(A-c_(a*))/[c_a-c_(a*)]. (7) For a singleton it is e_C(A). The denominator in(7) has a SIMPLE zero: D_log(zeta)(c_a-c_(a*))(q) =2N[q^(2a+1)-q^(-2a-1)] !=0. (8) The excluded zero in(8) is precisely the singleton case. Thus p_a has pole order at most one. A triple branch projector p_alpha=p_a(A_1)p_b(A_2)p_c(A_3) (9) has pole order at most THREE as an endomorphism of the physical lattice. It preserves the generic invariant space; on Lambda tensor K an admissible branch has rank one, and an inadmissible branch is zero. Let L_alpha=Lambda intersect that generic invariant line, and choose a primitive column v_alpha generating this rank-one lattice. In a cluster put L0=direct_sum_alpha L_alpha. For v in Lambda_C, t^3 p_alpha v belongs to L_alpha, v=sum_alpha p_alpha v. Therefore the EXACT lattice inclusions are t^3 Lambda_C subset L0 subset Lambda_C. (10) All elementary divisors of L0 in Lambda_C are consequently t^s with 0<=s<=3. This bound is independent of the size of the ambient physical tensor and does not follow merely from a determinant valuation. There is a constructive saturation algorithm. For any current basis matrix B(t), use only a constant invertible column change to separate independent residue columns from combinations that vanish modulo t. Divide the latter columns by t. This replaces its lattice L by t^(-1)L intersect M. Indeed the residue relation kernel forces exactly those coefficients to cancel at order zero. After at most THREE repetitions it equals Lambda_C by(10). No block contains more than eight columns. Their root values require only Taylor coefficients through order3 of the chosen primitive v_alpha. In particular all confluence is retained when only some of the eight generic branches are admissible. ## 4. An explicit primitive column construction: no unspecified minor The preceding statement used primitive generic invariant columns. They can be constructed directly from known physical projectors with a uniform derivative bound, without choosing an arbitrary nonzero minor of a large Clebsch matrix. Let Omega_tot be the actual SIX-head total Casimir. Generically its irreducible highest weights are 2a, 0<=a<=3d, with eigenvalues c_a(zeta). The polynomial I_inv=product_(a=1)^(3d) (Omega_tot-c_a)/(c_0-c_a) (11) is precisely the projector onto the spin-zero isotypic component, namely the generic invariant space. Nonzero generic eigenvalues are distinct Laurent functions, even when they collide at the selected root. There is no extra highest-weight component in its generic IMAGE; every positive highest-weight component is killed. Its pole order is at most FOUR. To see the exact count, use c_0-c_a=-zeta Q^(-a-1)(1-Q^a)(1-Q^(a+1)). (12) Apart from a unit monomial, its denominator is F_(3d) F_(3d+1)/(1-Q), F_m=(Q;Q)_m. (13) For N>=3 the four root-zero factors are a=N-1,N,2N-1,2N. For N=2 there are three. Each is simple. For the denominator gap c_0-c_a, its logarithmic derivative at a=kN is -2kN(q-q^-1); at a=kN-1 it is +2kN(q-q^-1). Thus (11) is not being assigned a four-pole bound merely from a root count with unverified multiplicities. Formula(13) is an explicit fixed-factorial normalizer, not an unknown condition number. For each admissible alpha form T_alpha=I_inv p_alpha. (14) All factors commute: a pair Casimir is a Hopf intertwiner and commutes with the total generators. Generically T_alpha is an idempotent of rank ONE onto the actual invariant line. Its pole order is at most 4+3=7, so Q_alpha=t^7 T_alpha is regular. Since Tr Q_alpha=t^7, the smallest entry valuation nu_alpha is between0 and7. Choose a physical column u_j in which that smallest valuation occurs and set v_alpha=t^(-nu_alpha) Q_alpha u_j. (15) This is a regular primitive invariant column. A component is a unit, so every regular vector in its generic line is an O multiple of it. It therefore generates the FULL L_alpha used in(10), not a sublattice with an unmeasured extra zero. To know its Taylor coefficients through order3, it suffices to know Q_alpha through order nu_alpha+3<=TEN. Together with the three-step algorithm this constructs complete saturated root frames with a uniform derivative order, even when a naive generic Clebsch column vanishes or diverges at the root. Replacing t by the source coordinate zeta=q exp(h/N) changes it by a unit with leading factor q/N; it does not change these derivative-order bounds. Its explicit fixed powers of N are polynomial. The seed construction may be computationally large. It is an exact all-N construction and pole bound, not a claim of a fast algorithm. Its norm may still be exponential. This distinction is essential. ## 5. Recoupling on the root by only fixed-size inverses Repeat the construction for the other pairing/tree. Let B_beta be its root frame in the beta-cluster, with at most eight independent columns, and E_beta its regular joint cluster projector. On the actual source, the coefficients of an input frame column v in that output cluster are (B_beta^dagger B_beta)^(-1) B_beta^dagger E_beta v. (16) The Gram in(16) is positive definite because those columns are independent. One can use the literal physical tensor metric, or first apply the fixed original W_2 extraction and use its specified physical metric. All original source/cap normalizations are then transported literally. Formula(16) is exact coordinate extraction; no orthogonality of distinct algebraic cluster projectors is assumed. The only inverses in(16) have order at most8. This replaces a large arbitrary maximal-minor inverse with regular spectral separation, bounded normal saturation, and explicit small-block Gram inverses. There is NO uniform lower bound for those Gram eigenvalues asserted. Thus (16) does not turn bounded jet order into polynomial recoupling norm or into a sharp geometric energy estimate. For an original regular physical tangle operator G, use E_beta G v in(16). Its actual root matrix already contains the complete Casimir Hermite derivatives. Constructing both complete root frames by(15) and the three-step saturation does not require discarding a derivative row or a marked source term. ## 6. What this settles for the six-port analytic problem The following pieces are now PROVED: regular joint decomposition of the saturated source, rank<=8 per collision block, Smith exponents<=3, an explicit derivative-order<=10 seed construction, and source-exact recoupling with only fixed-size block inverses. No arbitrary generic Clebsch maximal-minor denominator remains as an unmeasured q-pole. To estimate an actual fixed-factor factorial/Clebsch sum, bounded normal jets can be compared with its original factorial envelope. The independently checked [uniform normal-factorial bound](bounded_normal_quantum_factorial_envelope.md) proves this when each entry is an explicit fixed-factor factorial sum, including indices exceeding N with their root zeros removed. It does not apply automatically to an unestimated small-block Gram inverse. But the norm of a saturated frame, the inverse Gram in(16), and the coherent source/cap contraction still require their own quantitative estimate. The present theorem supplies neither a positive geometric measure nor the missing non-tree source packet by itself. The germ variable here is the normal q deformation. It is not an automatic holomorphic continuation of the physical auxiliary colors on a fixed complex corridor, which remains a separate analytic input. ## 7. The precise fixed-width limitation The rank<=8 statement uses the fact that THREE ordinary pair channels have invariant multiplicity at most one. It is FALSE for disjoint pairs alone at eight or more physical heads. For example, fix all four pair spins to a=d in eight heads. The invariant space of W_d^tensor4 has generic dimension2d+1, since the intermediate W_j occurs once for every j=0,...,2d. A single joint four-pair collision block therefore already contains at least2N-1 independent generic invariants. At a larger fixed width one must refine the commuting family by a COMPLETE laminar fusion tree, not just disjoint pair Casimirs. Its generic branches again have multiplicity one. Each internal highest weight is at most a fixed multiple of N; its root collision class has bounded size depending only on that width. A gap between two different branches has order at most2: order1 except at a root Casimir value+/-2, where the distinct positive exponents have different squares and split at order2. Products of the finitely many branch projectors therefore have a pole bound depending only on the fixed tree. The argument(10)--(15) then gives a fixed-width finite-jet bound too, with larger constants. It does NOT give bounded-size blocks for an incompletely resolving family. The six-port bounds3,7,10 above are explicit and require no such additional tree. No high-width norm or volume bound follows from this fixed-jet observation. ## 8. Exact checks and analytical review [The focused exact audit](../experiments/audit_actual_six_port_bounded_confluent_blocks.py) passes nineteen physical spectral-gap families N=2,...,20 using cyclotomic polynomial divisibility, not numerical root proximity. It checks the actual total-projector zero indices and every simple pair gap. It also tests all nine admissibility patterns appearing there in the tensor-Jordan lattice model; their Smith exponents are<=3. The full eight-branch example has exponents0,1,1,1,2,2,2,3, so the algebraic pole argument cannot in general promise fewer than three saturation steps. These lattice stress tests are explicitly NOT a bound or an identification of an unknown physical Gram matrix. The full proof has passed an independent analytical read. That review corrected the signs in the derivative of c_0-c_a in section4; the nonzero multiplicities and all bounds were unaffected. The uniform normal-factorial estimate has separately passed independent review.

title: The actual six-port source has a smaller regular generic-q module
text: # The actual six-port source has a smaller regular generic-q module 29 October 2026. The complete root invariant space is larger than the source space reachable by an ORIGINAL complete-color plat. There is a canonical, proper, braid- and circle-stable module obtained by regular generic-q specialization. This is an actual source restriction, not a semisimple deletion of the original Casimir normal coefficients. For six heads its rank is (N^3+N)/2, whereas the full root invariant space has dimension (2N^3+N)/3. The difference (N^3-N)/6 consists of extra root invariants which cannot be reached from the original cup by any regular original tangle. The original marked co-source remains literal, and compression to this module has NO additional boundary norm cost. This gives the appropriate source-exact generic 6j input for a genuine six-ended block. A sharp coherent packet estimate for such blocks is not supplied by the rank theorem alone. ## 1. The whole root space and its exact octahedral lattice Use q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, d=N-1 and the ORIGINAL balanced V_N. The [complete source theorem](actual_complete_source_multiplicity_module.md), section5, identifies Inv_root(V_N^tensor6) = W_2=(V_N^tensor4)_(degree2d). Its inverse is the specified coefficient of the last two physical colors(0,d), multiplied by x^d/N, x=q^d. Thus there is no arbitrary source projection or unidentified scalar in this identification. Write the four physical labels as (a,b,c,e), with e=2d-a-b-c. Then the remaining labels obey 0<=a,b,c<=d, d<=a+b+c<=2d. (1) The continuous polytope is an octahedron. The integer coordinates u=d-b-c, v=d-a-c, w=d-a-b identify its actual lattice with |u|+|v|+|w|<=d, u+v+w == d (mod2). (2) The inverse is a=(d+u-v-w)/2 and its cyclic variants. Conditions(1) and(2) are equivalent by checking the eight octahedral facets. Their lattice count is dim W_2=[z^(2d)](1+z+...+z^d)^4=(2N^3+N)/3. (3) This is a PHYSICAL source-support polytope. Its name does not identify it with an ideal octahedron in a link complement or supply geometric edge equations. A generic Borel tensor of dimension N^3 cannot simply be substituted for this complete physical module. ## 2. The regular generic-q source lattice Fix N while varying zeta near q. Let O be the convergent-power-series DVR at zeta=q, t=zeta-q, and let K be its fraction field. Use the ordinary highest-weight-d module in the analytic balanced basis F|a>=(1-zeta^(2a+2))|a+1>, Ecal|a>=zeta^(-N)(1-zeta^(2(N-a)))|a-1>, K|a>=zeta^d zeta^(-2a)|a>. (4) The endpoint arrows are zero. At zeta=q these are exactly the original root generators. The basis change from the ordinary highest weight basis uses only factorials of indices<N, hence is regular and invertible at q. The actual finite universal R and its inverse are also regular: their summation orders are<N and their divided-factorial denominators do not vanish. This retains the full Cartan phase. Put M_O=V_d(zeta)^tensor6 over O and define Lambda=(Inv_K(M_O tensor K)) intersect M_O. (5) It is saturated: if t v belongs to Lambda for v in M_O, the generic invariance equations imply that v belongs too. Hence M_O/Lambda is torsion free, Lambda is free, and its specialization embeds into the physical root tensor without a Tor kernel. Denote its image by S_N=Lambda/t Lambda subset Inv_root(V_N^tensor6). (6) This is a definition from the actual generic generators, independent of the numerical knot invariant. Every actual generic braid, its inverse, and every interval Casimir preserve the generic invariant space and M_O, hence preserve Lambda and S_N. The same holds for any polynomial circle coupon in an actual pair Casimir. No individual Casimir value or generalized direction has been discarded. ## 3. Every original cup source lies in this module The invariant generic cup can be normalized by its a=0 coefficient p0=N x^(-d), x=zeta^d. On a+b=d its coefficients are p_a=p0 (-x)^a Q^[-a(a+1)/2] F_a F_(d-a)/F_d, Q=zeta^2, F_r=(Q;Q)_r. (7) All denominators are units at q. Its successive ratio is p_(a+1)/p_a =-x Q^(-a-1)(1-Q^(a+1))/(1-Q^(d-a)). (8) Equation(8) is exactly the two-head coproduct-F invariant equation; the E equation follows by the same substitution. At the root, F_a F_(d-a)=N(-1)^a Q^[a(a+1)/2] and F_d=N, so (7) becomes p_a=N x^(a-d), the literal original cup. Therefore p(zeta)^tensor3 belongs to Lambda, and EVERY original braid/circle word applied to that cup specializes into S_N. Arbitrary external rows may be contracted afterward. In particular the original ordinary caps and full marked cap are kept. This restriction concerns original deformable source inputs. It is not an all-input identification of the larger root invariant space with a generic-q invariant space. A root-only Hopf coupon with no regular generic lift need not preserve S_N; no such coupon is inserted into the original argument here. ## 4. Exact rank: ordinary triangular channels, not a root semisimplification Over K the tensor of two highest-weight-d modules is the direct sum of the highest-weight-2a modules W_a, a=0,...,d, each once. This follows directly from their distinct generic pair Casimirs, their explicitly constructed highest vectors and the dimension identity sum_a(2a+1)=N^2, as in the actual Casimir proof. Three such channels have a one-dimensional invariant precisely when 0<=a,b,c<=d, |a-b|<=c<=a+b. (9) Indeed the same two-factor highest-vector calculation decomposes W_a tensor W_b into the weights 2a+2b-2r, r=0,...,2min(a,b). It contains W_c exactly under(9), once; the unique pairing with W_c then gives the invariant. This uses generic distinctness, not a root semisimplicity assertion. Count the triples: of the N^3 triples, those with a>b+c number sum_(a=1)^d a(a+1)/2=d(d+1)(d+2)/6. The analogous three violations are disjoint. Consequently rank Lambda=dim S_N=(N^3+N)/2, dim Inv_root-dim S_N=(N^3-N)/6. (10) The latter is a PROPER subspace already at N=2. Thus it would be wrong either to identify the whole root Inv space with a generic 6j channel space, or to infer that generic source specialization loses the actual original word. The saturated lattice distinguishes these two statements. ## 5. A fully specified finite recoupling kernel before specialization No published TV/shadow state sum is needed to construct the generic six-port kernel. Here is a direct finite tensor construction with all coordinates specified. For the complete pair and its channel W_a put k=d-a. Its highest vector h_a=sum_(r=0)^k b_r |r,k-r> has b0=1 and b_(r+1)/b_r =-x^(-1)Q^(k-1-r) (1-Q^(a+1+r))/(1-Q^(d-r)). (11) These are units near q; their derivation is the actual coproduct-E equation in(4). Let iota_a:W_a->V_d tensor V_d send its divided-F basis vector of index r to F_pair^r h_a/(Q;Q)_r. For arbitrary ordinary channels W_a,W_b, their highest vector for the W_c component has index k=a+b-c and coefficients beta_r, beta0=1. In its own balanced bases define e_a(j)=zeta^(-2a-1)(1-Q^(2a+1-j)), K_a(j)=zeta^(2a)Q^(-j). Then beta_(r+1)/beta_r =-e_b(k-r)/[e_a(r+1)K_b(k-1-r)]. (12) Divided-F descendants define iota_(a,b)^c. Compose it with the nonzero ordinary cup of W_c, then with iota_a tensor iota_b tensor iota_c. This gives one explicitly normalized rational six-head invariant B_abc for every triple(9). Formula(7), with the appropriate highest weight and a fixed p0=1, specifies the internal cup too. Thus all B_abc are finite products/sums of actual Gaussian factorial coefficients and fixed Cartan phases. Let B_T be the resulting column matrix for a chosen paired tree T. It has full generic column rank(10). Choose any nonzero maximal minor to form an explicit rational left inverse L_T. A specified genuine SIX-ENDED tangle, after bending its incoming legs by the original duality, gives a physical invariant tensor Psi_G. Its exact channel coordinates are L_T Psi_G, and Psi_G=B_T(L_T Psi_G). The physical contraction defining Psi_G, including any internal crossings/circles, is retained; this does not assert that a generic trivalent B_abc is already a particular geometric shadow block. For an actual BRAID ENDOmorphism R_G on six physical heads, its complete channel transport matrix is exactly K_(T',T)(G)=L_(T') R_G B_T. (13) Changing trees or multiplying tangles gives the same actual physical map, because all columns represent the SAME invariant vectors. This is the source-relevant finite 6j construction. No equality of an unpointed cyclic Borel 6j with the original marked source is assumed. At the root, denominators with index>=N can vanish. One MUST compute (13) on the saturated lattice(5), equivalently take its complete Smith regularization before specialization. Taking values of the generic channel matrix alone would omit precisely the confluent information at risk. The original R's first Casimir derivatives, and any additional source-frame normal coefficients required by that lattice, remain. No uniform bound on the norm or necessary jet order of this generic frame is asserted here; an unspecified minor inverse is not a tame metric. The physical saturated source space itself is nevertheless completely defined and source exact by(5)--(10). ## 6. Polynomial-cost compression and a concrete further Ward constraint Transport S_N to W_2 by the original coefficient isomorphism. Let P_S be its orthogonal projector in the specified physical orthonormal W_2 basis. The complete original source theorem has w0=p tensor p, lambda=ell tensor ell, original scalar=chi_N lambda B_word w0, ||w0||=N^3, ||lambda||=N^(-1). (14) Here the FULL marked cap was reduced only after the whole invariant tensor identity. Since w0 and every original state lie in S_N, insert P_S on both sides of every reduced generator without changing(14). Its norm is one, and the restricted boundary row has no larger norm. Thus the original boundary norm product is at most N^2, with no new exponential cost. This is an actual source-specific compression before choosing a geometric metric. It does not yet bound the word's energy. There is also a concrete normal Ward operator. In the generic physical tensor define the ordinary divided power E^[N]=E_tot^N/[N]_zeta!, with the fixed nonzero conversion between E and Ecal retained. This has a regular matrix on tensors of highest-weight-d modules: in the divided coproduct formula all individual indices are<N, and terms with a local index>=N vanish identically. Every generic invariant is killed by it. Hence S_N is killed by its specialized normal operator. Under the W_2 extraction, this implies specifically E_(first4)^[N] w=0, w in S_N. (15) To check(15), project the global divided-power equation to last colors (0,d). Last color d forces zero lowering there. In H_2(w), fifth input c>0 contributes E_4^c w and requires c lowering in that head; the remaining ordinary E_4^(N-c) then yields E_4^N=0 at the root. All such denominators are units. Only c=0 leaves E_4^[N]w, multiplied by the known nonzero extraction factor. Its target degree is N-2, of dimension [z^(N-2)](1+z+...+z^d)^4=binom(N+1,3), exactly the dimension difference in(10). The separate [divided-current kernel theorem](actual_six_port_divided_power_source_kernel.md) now proves this surjectivity, rather than inferring it from the count: in its literal first-normal normalization J_E J_F=-2N^2 I on that target. Consequently the saturated source is EXACTLY ker J_E, and its algebraic projection is I+J_F J_E/(2N^2). The proof retains both E/F constraints and all original Cartan signs. The projection is oblique; no polynomial operator-norm estimate follows from its displayed denominator. The [all-width normal-current calculation](actual_all_width_divided_source_projection.md) extends the same kernel identification to every even plat width. The normal Ward is a genuine all-source constraint at level N, not an ordinary fixed-degree observable or an independently imposed angle edge charge. It is compatible with retaining the original normal source instead of quotienting it to zero. Derivatives of the WHOLE source in q still satisfy differentiated inhomogeneous Ward equations; this root-value restriction does not make those equations homogeneous. ## 7. The precise analytic six-port task still needed The reduction above exposes a concrete local problem. For a SPECIFIED prime six-ended block with its literal physical tensor Psi_G, the coordinates L_T Psi_G and transport(13) must be specialized on the lattice(5). To use that block in the general long-filling theorem one needs a uniform complex saddle/packet estimate for this COHERENT finite Clebsch contraction, on a bounded geometric color corridor, and a bound on its complementary root channels. No particular prime block is identified solely from the coordinate count. The ordinary triangle domain(9), physical support(2), and divided-power constraint(15) must all be retained; they are not three independently summable scalar circle registers. The naive alternative of replacing such a vertex by commutative Frobenius multiplication is specifically invalid: the exact circle algebra has L_N^2=0 at even levels, so a tree built only from that connector and scalar multiplication already collapses. The [circle-source extension](general_augmented_graph_source_extension.md) retains that warning. Conversely the generic-q 6j frame alone has no proved sharp large-N norm and its polar factors cannot be declared subexponential. A uniform coherent estimate of(13), together with its normal Ward source, is the next analytic input; a TV state sum is not substituted for the original scalar. This is a structural extension beyond the two-port turn algebra: it supplies a proper, exactly source-stable six-port module, an explicit finite actual Clebsch construction and a new normal Ward constraint. It does not declare a new broad geometric source packet proved, and does not change the active general equality objective into a formal recoupling identity. ## 8. Focused verification [The new audit](../experiments/audit_actual_six_port_deformable_source.py) passes three COMPLETE generic six-port Clebsch frames at N=2,3,4, including every triangular channel, literal E/F/H invariance and full column rank. Four original root families at N=2,...,5 check the exact octahedral parity lattice, the regular generic cup's literal root specialization, all five induced physical braid generators, and a mixed signed word against the full six-head marked scalar. Their source cyclic ranks are respectively5,15,34,65, agreeing with(10). The rank theorem for S_N is the analytical saturation/count argument; no uniform claim that the cup is cyclic in S_N is inferred from these finite checks. title: The actual six-port source is an explicit divided-power kernel
text: # The actual six-port source is an explicit divided-power kernel 29 October 2026. The saturated specialization of GENERIC invariant tensors inside the full root-level six-head invariant space has an explicit single divided-power equation. The equation is surjective onto a specified physical degree space. Its right inverse and an algebraic source projection are given below at every \(N\), including even and composite levels. This does not assume a semisimple root tensor category or a tame recoupling frame. ## 1. Regular actual divided operators on any fixed number of heads Put \(d=N-1,\ q=e^{\pi i/N},\ Q=q^2,\ \rho=q-q^{-1}\).
