Audit and current limitation [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_terminal_shrinking_arc_jet_diagnostic.py) uses ORIGINAL E/F/R matrices and physical terminal projectors for nine exact finite-root source checks. It verifies (1),(3),(5),(6), all normalizers, the full first-jet coefficients, and the all-input normal-current row (13). Ten high-precision profiles through N=256 then use only the finite R matrices and the coherent first-order Green recurrence; there is no numerical inversion. The Krawtchouk recurrence computes ALL coefficients in (9), followed by the complete monomial Gram (10). At N=128, increasing working precision from228 to360 decimal digits changes the centered first jet by less than2.2e-198 relatively and the complete energies at h=N^-1,N^-2 by less than1.7e-198. These checks make the finite diagnostic reproducible; they do not replace an analytic exponent theorem. The closed source bound is proved, while positive exponential growth of D_N and failure of all polynomial shrinking arcs for this source remain explicitly UNPROVED.

title: An original cup slide exposes an amplified normalization packet
text: # An original cup slide exposes an amplified normalization packet 29 October 2026. The problematic vector in the terminal-Gram transport test is reached by a FIXED original braid prefix applied to the original cup. The complete recorded packet after one further crossing has positive exponential energy, although its original closed scalar is a unit phase. There is also an explicit coherent factorial divergence which removes this amplification at the normalization closure. This is a finite Ward packet with its endpoint retained, rather than a deletion of individual channels or a new positive trace. The result concerns the present full-circle/recorded-color metric. It does not rule out a nondiagonal coherent metric, a shrinking arc, or a sharp estimate on a source after coherent normalization pruning. The [backward Ward disk estimate](actual_normalization_clock_disk_bound.md) now proves subexponential shrinking-arc energy for this SAME original normalization packet, including its whole germ and specified sublinear clock-frequency exteriors. ## 1. A literal source identity on every input color Use the original complete multiplicity conventions: N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, x=q^d=-q^-1, F_j=(Q;Q)_j, kappa=q^(d^2/2), kappa^2=x^d, W=(V tensor V)_(integer degree d), e_j=|j,d-j>, p_j=N x^(j-d), ell_j=x^j/N. Let R=R_12 be the FULL original positive pair crossing on W and R_23 its adjacent complete multiplicity operator. The original highest chart, applied to the literal physical crossing, gives (R_23 p)_j=kappa N x^(j-d) F_(d-j), (R^(-1)e_0)_j=kappa^(-1)x^j F_(d-j). Consequently the exact source-orbit identities are R_23 p=N R^(-1)e_0, R R_23 p=N e_0. (1) There is no arbitrary inserted state in (1). The Cartan identity kappa^2=x^d fixes the coefficient N at every even or composite level. The negative coefficient is the literal original inverse crossing, not a unitary adjoint. For completeness the second identity has a direct finite-binomial proof. Multiplying the original positive coefficients yields (R R_23 p)_i =N x^(-i) Q^[i(d-i)] F_i sum_(k=0)^i (Q^(-i);Q)_k Q^(ik)/F_k =N x^(-i) Q^[i(d-i)] F_i (1;Q)_i =N delta_(i,0). (2) Every factorial denominator in this calculation has index below N. The equality is the highest column of the all-input physical cup slide (R_12 R_23)(p_12 tensor I_V)=I_V tensor p_23. (3) Indeed both sides intertwine the ACTUAL coproduct. Applying its F^a/F_a to the verified highest column proves (3) on every original |a>, 0<=a<N. Thus (3) is an operator identity and can be tensored with arbitrary spectator ports. No scalar-knot Schur argument or replacement of the marked row is used. ## 2. Complete terminal packets and their original closed scalars Keep the [full terminal operator](actual_terminal_packet_closed_kernel.md) T=N^(-1) X R P_rev R, X=diag(x^j), P_0=1, P_j=(1-Q^j)^2 P_(j-1)+Q^j, P_rev=diag(P_(d-j)), P_d=sum_(j=0)^d F_j. (4) Its physical-projector rows sum to the original ordinary/marked whole co-source after the two terminal crossings. This is the SAME complete source as in the [positive terminal Gram](actual_terminal_packet_positive_gram.md). Retain the original external factor chi_N on every side below. The two actual prefixes [2] and [2,1] give the exact vector formulas T R_23 p=kappa P_d e_d, b:=T R R_23 p =x^(-d) (Q^(-j) conjugate(F_j))_(j=0)^d. (5) To check the first formula, write T R^(-1)=N^(-1)X R P_rev, use (1) and R e_0=kappa x^(-d)e_d. For the second use (R e_d)_j=kappa N x^(j-d)/F_(d-j), F_(d-j) conjugate(F_j)=N, x^2=Q^(-1), kappa^2=x^d. These retain all coherent Green summation; P_j is never replaced by its absolute envelope. In particular ||T R_23p||^2=|P_d|^2<=9N^4, ||T R R_23p||^2=Z_N:=sum_(j=0)^d |F_j|^2. (6) The first bound is the original endpoint theorem in the [Green-capacity proof](actual_terminal_green_capacity_bound.md). It is not a bound on the sum of absolute factorials. Both original closed scalars remain explicit: 1^T T R_23p=kappa P_d, 1^T b=x^(-d) Q. (7) For the last equality, Q^(j+1)F_j=F_j-F_(j+1), with F_N=0, implies sum_j Q^(-j)conjugate(F_j)=Q. Thus the second full word [2,1,2,2] is a normalization source with raw scalar of modulus one. No phase is fitted from its scalar value. The original chi_N multiplies both this scalar and the corresponding packet; any specified framing normalization remains literal. The usual uniform factorial estimate, with J(t)=integral_0^t log(2sin(pi s))ds, gives log Z_N=N v_3/pi+O(log N), (8) where v_3 is the volume of the regular ideal tetrahedron. Its proof is elementary: log|F_j|=N J(j/N)+O(log N) uniformly to both endpoints, and J has maximum v_3/(2pi) at5/6. A nearest lattice point supplies the lower bound; N terms supply the upper bound. Thus a fixed original source trajectory, rather than only an arbitrary all-port vector, realizes the exponential metric-motion obstruction in [the terminal-Gram test](actual_terminal_gram_lyapunov_obstruction.md). With epsilon=exp(-N^2), the same exact regularized quotient there is obtained after multiplying both test vectors by N. A source-dependent changing metric or a further coherent packet is not excluded. ## 3. Exact coherent pruning and the retained exterior current The amplified vector (5) is a particularly simple finite divergence. Put G_j=conjugate(F_j) for0<=j<N and G_N=0. Then b_j=x^(-d) Q(G_j-G_(j+1)). (9) For ANY row f_j of scalar, vector or operator-valued spectator coefficients, distributivity alone proves sum_j f_j b_j =x^(-d)Q [f_0+sum_(j=1)^d(f_j-f_(j-1))G_j]. (10) No commutativity of the f_j is needed. The factorial factors G_j are fixed scalars. The original constant closing row kills the interior differences and retains the unit endpoint f_0. A general exterior instead keeps the explicit finite-difference current in (10). The difference matrix in (9) has operator norm at most2, and its finite cumulative inverse has norm at most N. These are coefficient bounds; G itself has exponential norm. Accordingly (10) supplies a source-preserving coherent normalization pruning operation. It does NOT give a bound for a general exterior by dropping its difference. This is the exact point at which an iterated bridge estimate needs the neighboring original Ward equations or another coherent identity. ## 4. Arbitrary diagonal recorded-color metrics cannot repair this source For any positive diagonal packet metric D=diag(w_j), including weights with arbitrary N dependence, the complete Cauchy budget is (1^T D^(-1)1)(b^*Db) =(sum_j w_j^(-1))(sum_j w_j |F_j|^2) >=(sum_j |F_j|)^2. (11) The minimum is exactly the right side: choose w_j=1/|F_j|, since every F_j with j<N is nonzero. Uniform factorial asymptotics show its logarithmic rate is again N v_3/pi+O(log N), while the squared raw scalar in (7) is one. This is a complete coherent packet counterexample to a diagonal recorded-color metric, not a sum of isolated shear paths. A genuinely nondiagonal metric can retain the telescoping in (9). Neither (11) nor the full-circle energy proves failure of the [shrinking-arc metric](actual_shrinking_arc_cauchy_metric.md). Indeed the first jet of this particular packet is still polynomial: summation by parts gives sum_j j b_j=x^(-d)Q conjugate(P_d-1). In fact the [whole normalization germ](actual_normalization_clock_disk_bound.md) is polynomial on disks of radius C/N, and subexponential on EVERY shrinking disk. Its shrinking-arc energy therefore has rate zero. This uses the complete backward Ward recurrence, beyond the first-jet identity above. The distinct source in [the jet diagnostic](actual_terminal_shrinking_arc_jet_diagnostic.md) still has no proved positive all-N jet exponent. ## 5. Audit and scope [The audit](../experiments/audit_actual_terminal_source_normalization_packet.py) checks (3) on EVERY physical input color directly from the original signed matrices, not from a chosen reduced R_23. It also extracts the complete highest chart, verifies (1),(5)--(7) on every retained packet, and checks (10) with noncommuting spectator matrices. Complex tests verify the complete energies and the optimized diagonal budget. The algebraic and asymptotic proofs above are all-level. The resulting normalization move is source-exact and usable with arbitrary spectators; the remaining finite-difference exterior in (10) is retained. No broad knot-volume upper bound or selected geometric noncancellation follows. Fresh replay: PASS nine original all-input cup-slide/source-packet levels N=2,...,10, including54 physical input columns; nine complex complete energy/optimized-metric levels through N=96; all operator-valued exterior currents. Compilation passes. The tests supplement the finite proofs.

title: Three complete belts: the saturated source and the marked-pair obstruction
text: # Three complete belts: the saturated source and the marked-pair obstruction 29 October 2026. On the genuine six-head saturated source, three disjoint positive complete-circle forms define an explicit positive Gram. They do NOT have a finite dual norm for the original marked co-source. There is an all-level source vector whose three-belt energy is zero and whose original marked evaluation is exactly ONE. The correctly typed original cap inequality uses C tensor C tensor H, not C tensor C tensor C. It detects the same vector with a polynomial lower bound. Thus a simple tensor-cube DCT or a scalar Frobenius branch cannot be used to claim a marked trivalent source theorem. This result retains the full divided-current kernel and root normals. ## 1. The actual six-port space and the three circle operators Use d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, x=q^d, N>=2. The balanced physical generators are Ecal=-F^dagger, K^dagger=K^-1. Let L=(-1)^d U_d(Omega/2), C=P L>=0, H=L P=P C P>=0, where P exchanges the two physical legs, not a braid crossing. All the literal ordinary-circle pivots and Cartan phases are retained. Their positivity and kernels are the [complete-circle theorem](actual_complete_circle_reflection_positive.md). Let S be the SATURATED generic-q specialization inside the full six-head H=0 invariants. The [divided-power source theorem](actual_six_port_divided_power_source_kernel.md) identifies it, with every original cup/braid word included, as S = Inv_root,H=0 intersect ker J_E,6, ext(S)=ker(J_E,4:W->Llow), W=(V_N^tensor4)_(degree2d), dim S=(N^3+N)/2. (1) The maps Phi:W->Inv and ext are the specified actual source maps, with ext extracting final physical colors(0,d) times x^d/N. No semisimple projection is substituted for (1). On W the three disjoint physical pair Casimirs become A1=Omega12, A2=Omega34, A3=F4 Ecal4+(q+q^-1)I. (2) For completeness A3 is EXACTLY ext Omega56 Phi. Split the six heads into A=1234 and B=56. On an invariant vector, E_B=-K_B E_A, F_B=-K_A F_A, K_B=K_A^-1. Using F_B K_B=Q K_B F_B and E_A K_A=Q^-1 K_A E_A gives F_B E_B=E_A F_A on that vector. The actual commutator [Ecal_A,F_A]=(q-q^-1)(K_A-K_A^-1) therefore turns Omega_B into Omega_A. On W, K_A=1, proving (2). In particular the reduced operators in (2) are not guessed trace variables. They commute on the actual invariant space and preserve S. The positive unmarked-belt form is G_C(v,v)=v^dagger(C12 tensor C34 tensor C56)v. (3) Its kernel equals that of L12 L34 L56, since the product of the three physical P maps is invertible. This kernel assertion does not identify (3) with an original marked link closure. ## 2. Full cluster projectors, including their first normals Let c0=q+q^-1. Its actual root cluster is {0,d}: c0=cd, and it is DOUBLE for every N>=2. The distinct other nodes are c_j=q^(2j+1)+q^(-2j-1), 1<=j<=floor(d/2). Let e0(z) be the FULL Hermite cluster polynomial: value one and derivative zero at c0, and value/derivative zero at the other double nodes (value zero at the possible odd simple node). It may be given by l0(z)=product_(c!=c0)(z-c)/(c0-c), e0(z)=l0(z)^2[1-2l0'(c0)(z-c0)] mod P_N(z). (4) All denominators are nonzero at the fixed level. Thus e0(Ai) is an actual root cluster projector, not an eigenvalue-only substitution. Write E000=e0(A1)e0(A2)e0(A3). It preserves S and every root normal within the chosen joint cluster. Its rank on S is five, as also follows from the five admissible generic branches of {0,d}^3. The regular generic pair projectors give an elementary annihilation identity. The branch (d,0,0) has no generic invariant: a positive spin d cannot couple two spin-zero channels to an invariant. Its joint projector is therefore zero on the saturated generic source lattice. Multiply this projector by the THREE within-cluster gap denominators before specializing q. This gives on E000 S (A1-c0)(A2-c0)(A3-c0)=0. (5) There is no division by a root-zero gap in (5); it is the root value of an exact cleared generic identity on the actual lattice. The complete circle on this cluster is L_N(Ai)E000=L_N'(c0)(Ai-c0)E000, (4-c0^2)L_N'(c0)=(-1)^d 2N !=0. Consequently, with ALL first normal data retained, L_N(A1)L_N(A2)L_N(A3)E000 S=0. (6) This argument does not assume that a rank-eight generic cube would specialize to a regular three-variable dual-number module. ## 3. An original planar source whose marked value survives Take the actual nested planar cups joining physical ends (1,6),(2,3),(4,5). The original cup is p_(a,b)=N x^(-b) delta_(a+b,d). Let v_triangle be their tensor insertion in the physical order. It has the regular generic cup lift, so belongs to S. Its exact W coordinate w_triangle=ext(v_triangle) is w_triangle_(0,b,d-b,d)=N^2 x^(-(d-b)), 0<=b<=d, all other coefficients zero. (7) The ORIGINAL whole marked co-source on W is lambda=ell12 tensor ell34, ell_(a,b)=x^a/N delta_(a+b,d). (8) This is the result of the full six-head invariant identity, not a local replacement of an unrestricted marked row. The only surviving term in lambda w_triangle is b=d, and hence lambda w_triangle=1. (9) On the whole invariant source lambda is a left c0 eigenvector of ALL three Ai. For A1,A2 this is the original ordinary-cap intertwining equation. After those two caps the remaining pair is an actual invariant cup, with Casimir c0; applying the full marked row afterward proves the A3 assertion too. Thus lambda E000=lambda on S. Set u=Phi E000 w_triangle. It is an explicit nonzero original saturated-source vector, with regular cluster coupons and no unknown knot invariant in its definition. Equations (6),(9) prove G_C(u,u)=0, original_marked_row(u)=1. (10) Therefore there is NO finite constant B_N, even one allowed to grow exponentially, such that the original marked functional satisfies |original_marked_row(v)|^2 <= B_N G_C(v,v) for all v in S. This is an actual source Riesz obstruction, not a generic indefinite-metric example or an absolute-value estimate. It does not assert a counterexample to a closed link's volume limit: u uses known Casimir cluster coupons, and the failed statement is the proposed all-exterior marked positive sewing theorem. ## 4. The genuine marked metric evades the obstruction The correctly typed original three-pair form is G_m(v,v)=v^dagger(C12 tensor C34 tensor H56)v. (11) The [original cap/source inequality](actual_complete_circle_positive_quotient.md#5-the-complete-original-boundary-has-a-positive-cauchy-form) gives, after the WHOLE degree restriction of the marked pair, |original_marked_row(v)|^2 <= G_m(v,v)/(8N^11) for every six-head invariant v. (12) In particular the same explicit source vector (10) satisfies G_m(u,u)>=8N^11, while G_C(u,u)=0. (13) The distinction is the physical last-pair reversal, not a harmless choice of positive inner-product coordinates. Writing H=P C P moves that P onto the source vector; a single-pair flip does NOT preserve the original ordered six-head Hopf invariant space. Thus the joint simplex support of the three unreflected pair-Casimir product cannot simply be transferred to (11) by keeping S unchanged. Exact full-source diagnostics give ranks of the two forms on S: | N | dim S | rank G_C | rank G_m | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 2 | 5 | 0 | 1 | | 3 | 15 | 4 | 6 | | 4 | 34 | 1 | 6 | | 5 | 65 | 10 | 19 | These finite ranks illustrate the already proved all-N distinction (10)--(13); no rank trend is used as proof of a limiting theorem. ## 5. What remains possible at a genuine trivalent junction For the three-C observation, joint positivity gives a sum of positive channel weights, but its original source dual already fails (10). The joint branch geometry also removes a full tensor-cube DCT: missing admissible joint nodes cannot reconstruct arbitrary products of three independent half-bandwidth polynomials. A correct simplex interpolation/angle weight would describe that observed quotient, not restore the missing marked functional. One may instead keep (11), change the entire reflected source by the actual duality/permutation braid, or point an auxiliary belt using its FULL open-loop normal source. Each is a concrete different physical problem. The present result neither deletes that current nor identifies a physical leg flip with an added crossing. A geometric trivalent-source survival theorem would need such a source-compatible kernel before its angle or DCT estimate. There is an explicit correctly marked all-input kernel, useful for stating that next problem without an unknown recoupling frame. Use the orthonormal single-pair quotient rows of the [positive circle quotient](actual_complete_circle_positive_quotient.md), pi_(j,r) = w_(j,r)^dagger C / sqrt(g_j beta(2j,r)), w_(j,r)=F_pair^r E_j(Omega)|0,d-j>/F_r, 0<=j<=floor(d/2), 0<=r<=2j. Here E_j is the stated value Lagrange polynomial; use of values is valid only AFTER its actual complete-circle map, and its g_j, factorials and angle normalizations are exactly those proved there. Define on every W input by the FULL original Phi K_(j1,r1;j2,r2;j3,r3)(w) =(pi_(j1,r1) tensor pi_(j2,r2) tensor pi_(j3,r3) P56)Phi_w. (14) Then G_m(Phi_w,Phi_w) is EXACTLY the sum of |K|^2 over all these indices. Integer degree imposes r1+r2+r3=j1+j2+j3, including every endpoint. The original scalar, not an auxiliary unknown invariant, is precisely lambda w = K_(0,0;0,0;0,0)(w)/(sqrt(8) N^(11/2)). (15) This explains the polynomial dual constant in (12). It also locates the missing moment-map constraint. With Pi=pi tensor pi tensor pi, the vector K=Pi P56 v for v in S satisfies E_Q,total K=Pi [Ecal_6,P56]v, F_Q,total K=Pi [F_6,P56]v, (16) not the zero-current trivalent invariant equations. The actual ordered coproducts give the LOCAL currents [Ecal_6,P56] =[E5(K6-1)-E6(K5-1)]P56, [F_6,P56] =K1234^-1 [F5(1-K6^-1)-F6(1-K5^-1)]P56. (17) These follow by exchanging physical legs5,6 in the displayed coproduct, and are exact finite operators. Thus the marked kernel already has genuine normal/momentum data beyond three independent node values. Setting (17) to zero would change the original source. Bounding the coherent kernel (14), or constructing a differently pointed reflected closure with its full source, remains the next analytic step; the tensor-cube sampling proof does not supply it. Audit: [literal six-head source, full Hermite projector and marked/unmarked forms](../experiments/audit_actual_three_belt_saturated_source_and_marked_metric.py). Independent full analytical review and fresh replay passed: seven divided-source/full-Hermite levels, four literal all-input six-head marked comparisons and three independent complex positive forms. The exact local E/F moment-current identities were checked too. The source-compatible multivariate positive correction is now [the marked middle-degree Chebyshev packet](actual_marked_multiport_chebyshev_source_packet.md), with an explicit original corner and tensor Parseval. Its geometric energy estimate remains separate.

title: Exact three-port Cauchy transport and a nontrivial projected cube kernel
text: # Exact three-port Cauchy transport and a nontrivial projected cube kernel 29 October 2026. The whole-support correlated Gram bound removes a local marked normalization cost. It does not by itself prove sharp transport through a graph. Complete-circle three-port sewing observes only the socle of each regular cube and hence reduces to a scalar weighted Cauchy pairing. This note makes that limitation precise, then gives an ACTUAL nontrivial positive cross-color transfer for the cube packet already proved, with its sharp norm and iterated source rate. The eight cycle projections remain in one cube; there is no full-color cube or arbitrary-graph volume-conjecture assertion. ## 1. What the correlated Gram does under complete-circle observation On a supported source cell use the exact boundary frame R_r=C[eta_1,...,eta_r]/eta_i^2, lambda(fv)=tau[eta_all](q f), q(0)=1, w_I=q^(-1/2)eta_Iv, <w_I,w_J>=delta_IJ. The [whole-support theorem](actual_whole_support_boundary_gram_envelope.md) proves polynomial source cost K and exact dual cost tau^2 K in this frame. But the complete paired-circle product itself is simply eta_all w_empty=w_all, eta_all w_I=0 for I!=empty. (1) Thus it has operator norm EXACTLY ONE and rank one. The simple axes contribute their actual scalar N, so the full three-circle product has norm N^(3-r). On its image the original row is lambda(w_all)=tau, lambda(eta_all f v)=tau f(0). (2) Equations (1),(2) keep the original marked row; they do not replace it by an ordinary cap. They also show that the complete observation does not measure the lower nilpotent coordinates of f. After this observation, a Cauchy estimate on one cell is an estimate of its one surviving scalar. Polynomial K supplies no independent geometric upper bound for that scalar's exterior-dependent energy. ## 2. The exact weighted packet and its available transport Let D_N be the supported folded triples and put theta_l=Z_theta(l)>0, a_G(l)=Z_G(l)/theta_l, F_G(l)=sqrt(theta_l)a_G(l)=Z_G(l)/sqrt(theta_l). Here Z_G(l) is the COMPLETE coherent interior source with the three boundary labels fixed, not an individual black vertex. For the exact typed vertex substitution, including the exposed mark and one circle per merged edge, the [source sewing theorem](actual_nc_three_port_source_sewing.md) gives Z_new=sum_(l in D_N) theta_l a_A(l)a_B(l) =sum_l F_A(l)F_B(l), |Z_new|^2<=E_A E_B, E_G=sum_l |Z_G(l)|^2/theta_l. (3) The bilinear sewing map has norm one in this explicitly prescribed Hilbert space. Its Cauchy proof conjugates the first numerical vector; it does NOT assume that one physical graph is the mirror of the other. No extra K or generic inverse-frame factor occurs in (3). The theta weight can be exponential and must not be called a polynomial cost. Grafting a fixed piece B onto an unsummed boundary is multiplication by a_B. Its norm is EXACTLY max_l |a_B(l)|. Thus sharp control of (3) requires the actual boundary packet or this multiplier, not just an estimate of the closed scalar sum_l Z_B(l). For example, for two supported labels l_1,l_2 the numerical packet a(l_1)=T/theta_(l_1), a(l_2)=-T/theta_(l_2) has closure zero and unbounded energy as T grows. This is a finite-space obstruction to deducing energy from one closure; it is not asserted to be a realizable knot counterexample. The proved signed-theta boundary has a_theta,e(l)=product_i omega_(l_i)^e_i. It is consequently an exact unitary multiplier in (3). These are actual source-preserving twist operations; theta substitution itself leaves the graph skeleton unchanged. The one-variable complete-pretzel circle metric is a different actual cut and polarization. A bound on its one closed functional does not identify a three-variable F_G or bound E_G without an explicit port-opening identity. No such general identity is inferred here. ## 3. An actual two-boundary cube transfer beyond a scalar closure Now take N=2m+1 and the original ordered cube of the [four-rung packet](actual_cube_four_rung_positive_source.md). Fix its eight cycle edges to m. Keep the outer-white rung (edge 10) at j, the interval-black rung (edge 1) at l, and sum the other two rung labels (edges 4,7). Use zero rung twists. Set p_j=P_(N,j)>0, k_j=2 except k_m=1, h_j=Rturn L_j/(N k_j), f=sum_(l=0)^m k_l p_l^2 h_l, theta_j=Z_theta(m,j,m)=N^3 k_j p_j^2. (4) The last normalization is exact: in the actual theta formula s_j s_(d-j)=N and the one-leg source has R_N(m,j,m)=p_j. All paired rung nilpotents and the original unrestricted mark remain. By the proved four-rung SOURCE formula and linearity, the actual two-boundary cube contribution is B_(j,l)=N^12 k_j k_l p_j^2 p_l^2 phi(h_j h_l f^2). (5) This is a full coherent magnetic contraction, not a product of unsewn black coefficients. The exposed white boundary is (m,j,m) and the interval black boundary is (m,l,m), with their original orders. Both are supported at every j,l. For a typed graft, the three shared contacts are summed once using the exact denominator theta_l, so its relative-packet transport is a_new(j)=sum_l B_(j,l)/theta_j *a_old(l). Equivalently in F=sqrt(theta)a coordinates its matrix is A_(j,l)=B_(j,l)/sqrt(theta_j theta_l) =N^9 sqrt(k_j k_l)p_j p_l phi(h_j h_l f^2). (6) This is an actual cross-color kernel, not the product of two known closed scalar values. It is real symmetric and ENTRYWISE strictly positive. Indeed all h_j have positive Newton coefficients through their degree j, while f^2 has strictly positive coefficients at every degree 0,...,d. The constant coefficient of h_jh_l is positive, so the actual phi in (6) is strictly positive. The Newton theorem retains the full root algebra and its first normals in this argument. Entry positivity does not make A a positive semidefinite Gram. At N=3, h_0=1,h_1=1+Bhat_1, p_0=1,p_1=2 and f=6+4Bhat_1. The exact matrix of the phi factors in (6) is [phi(h_j h_l f^2)]_(j,l=0,1) = [[16,80],[80,244]], determinant=-2496. (7) Thus A itself has determinant -19968*3^18. This is a genuine correlated transfer with both eigenvalue signs; no Hilbert norm square or physical reflection identity is being smuggled into it. ## 4. Its operator norm has the sharp primitive-core increment Put h=h_m, S=p_m, W=phi(h^4)>0. Coefficientwise Newton monotonicity and the positive multiplication law give h_j<=h, p_j<=S, S^2 h<=f<=2(m+1)S^2 h. Consequently, with R_N=N^9 S^6 W, R_N<=A_(m,m)<=[2(m+1)]^2 R_N, 0<A_(j,l)<=2A_(m,m), A_(m,m)<=||A||_2<=2(m+1)A_(m,m). (8) The last lower bound is a diagonal Rayleigh quotient. The upper bound is the maximum row sum for the absolute-entry matrix, or sqrt(||A||_1||A||_infty); symmetry makes those norms equal. It does not require A to be positive semidefinite. Thus (8) is a direct source-preserving weighted Cauchy transport estimate whose exponent is computed independently from positive factorial periods. The proved actual central scalar and [cuboctahedral period theorem](actual_positive_newton_cuboctahedral_period.md) give, on all odd levels, lim (1/N)log||A||_2=6v8/pi+Vol(Q_cube)/pi. In hyperbolic-volume units this is lim (2pi/N)log||A||_2 =12v8+2Vol(Q_cube) =Vol(augmented cube)-Vol(augmented theta). (9) The equality with these ACTUAL complements is the independently proved labeled rectified-core geometry, not a volume-constant fit. It is the precise primitive-core increment in this projected packet. ## 5. Iteration is a genuine but still projected graph-source family Start with theta, keeping its two cycle contacts at m and its third label j summed. Repeatedly insert the ordered cube at the interval black vertex (0,1,2), with outer white boundary (0,10,11). Preserve the original exposed mark. At each stage the two cycle contacts remain m and the middle contact is summed as an actual full circle. The exact NC substitution supplies the new Morse word and one circle per merged edge. Equations (3),(5),(6) give, for fixed k>=0, Z_k^proj=u^T A^k u, u_j=sqrt(theta_j). (10) This is the raw original partial source of the resulting graph. It retains ALL 1+3k rung labels and fixes the 2+6k cycle labels to m. The graph has b=1+3k vertices of each color. The one exposed physical mark is never replicated; the formula comes from the already normalized fixed-first-normal quotient at each graft. Every matrix entry in (10) is positive. Choosing only the central index at each step supplies the lower bound, while (8) and u_j<=sqrt(2)u_m supply the upper bound N^(3+9k) S^(2+6k) W^k <= Z_k^proj <=[2(m+1)]^(3k+1) N^(3+9k) S^(2+6k) W^k. (11) For k=1 this is the exact four-rung packet bound; k=0 is the one-rung theta face. Therefore for every fixed k, lim_(N odd) (2pi/N)log Z_k^proj =(4+12k)v8+2k Vol(Q_cube). (12) The actual graph geometry is the same sequence of triangular core grafts: its core is k cuboctahedra glued along triangles, with additive volume k Vol(Q_cube). The [rectified-core theorem](actual_nc_graph_rectified_core_geometry.md) therefore identifies (12) with its ACTUAL augmented complement volume. All cycle twists can be kept as one common unit character; different rung-twist phases do not preserve this positivity argument. The proved one-leg boundary gap also transfers, without a new stationary-phase assertion. For fixed delta>0, p_j/S<=poly(N)exp(-gamma_delta N) whenever m-j>=delta N. Resolve each f in (5) into its actual complete-circle color sum and iterate the source quotient. Every one of the 1+3k rung labels occurs with its factor k_jp_j^2 ONCE, while every surviving phi factor is bounded above by W using h_j<=h. Therefore sum_(some rung m-j>=delta N) Z_(k,labels)^proj <=poly_(k,delta)(N)exp(-2gamma_delta N) N^(3+9k)S^(2+6k)W^k. (13) These are the whole-label one-leg estimates of the actual theta source transported through a specified branching kernel. They now control EVERY unfrozen rung channel in the projected chain, rather than just its scalar endpoints. The labels remain INTERNAL pair- Casimir channels. No auxiliary meridian interpretation, complex peripheral-color packet or Dehn-filling estimate follows from (13). This is an unbounded sequence of actual graph diagrams and correlated source transports. It remains a PARTIAL original source with many cycle projections and odd levels. Removing those projections and controlling even levels remain necessary before asserting a full graph invariant equality. The result does not rename the general scalar Cauchy inequality as a sharp energy theorem: its new energy bound is the independently positive two-boundary kernel (5)--(8). Audit: [literal boundary kernels and projected graph sources](../experiments/audit_actual_three_port_cauchy_transport_and_cube_kernel.py), with [recorded results](../experiments/actual_three_port_cauchy_transport_and_cube_kernel_results.json). The focused replay passes the exact N=3 non-PSD certificate, all three full boundary matrices at N=3,5,7 using 353 original marked rung contractions, and seven complete projected-chain sources, including the fourteen-vertex two-cube source with all seven rung labels summed. The source checks use the actual unrestricted mark and local regular generic first-normal identities. They supplement the all-N source/graft and positive-cone proofs, not an inference from measured matrix spectra or a whole-graph invariant claim. Independent internal review: the Euler-atom agent re-derived the socle norm, theta and cube normalizations, the non-PSD determinant, weighted transport, cone norm bounds, every fixed-k source count and the inherited rung gap, and completed a fresh focused replay: PASS. The distinction between the exact scalar quotient pairing and the independently bounded projected cross-color kernel is retained. This is an internal research review, not external peer review or a full graph invariant equality.

title: Coherent original-transfer endpoint packets and exact Markov corners
text: # Coherent original-transfer endpoint packets and exact Markov corners 28 October 2026. Collapsing the two Euler factors BEFORE separating transfer endpoints gives a quantitative, source-preserving boundary filtration of every original signed braid word. Both sublinear total-transfer endpoint collars have subexponential operator norm. Consequently the entire all-endpoint corner of the full original source is subexponential, without an assumption about its stationary positions. This does not bound a mixed corner containing macroscopic transfers by the knot volume. It also does not identify a bridge overclock endpoint with a total physical transfer endpoint. An exact Markov calculation below shows why an isolated endpoint attached to a nontrivial exterior can still carry that exterior's full rate and must be grouped as a normalization cell. ## 1. Use the original coherently summed crossing Put d=N-1, Q=exp(2pi*i/N), x=-exp(-pi*i/N), F_r=(Q;Q)_r. The ORIGINAL positive crossing, with its common unit scalar kappa retained, sends input (a,b) to (b+k,a-k), where 0<=k<=min(a,d-b), with exact coefficient kappa x^(-a-b+k)Q^(b(a-k)) F_(b+k)F_a/[F_k F_b F_(a-k)]. (1) This is the independently checked physical coefficient of [the weighted-crossing theorem](weighted_crossing_source_gap.md), with j=a-k. Both Euler factors have already been summed coherently; one of their separate orders is not called k here. The negative crossing is the exact balanced antiunitary mirror P conjugate(R_plus)P. It has the same k-indexed magnitude and bounds. For an integer 0<=R<=d/2 let E_low be the sum of the original matrix entries with k<=R, and E_top those with d-k<=R. These are specified entry submatrices, with every original phase and zero retained. They are not substituted invariants or new quantum atoms. ## 2. Uniform quantitative normal-scale bounds In the variables j=a-k,b, the magnitude of (1) is A(k,b,j)=|F_(k+b)F_(k+j)|/[|F_k F_b F_j|]. (2) For k<=R each numerator ratio adds k factors of magnitude at most two, while |F_k|>=(4/N)^k k! for k<=N/2. Hence A(k,b,j)<=N^k/k!. (3) For k=d-r, support forces 0<=b,j<=r. Exact reflection |F_(d-s)|=N/|F_s| gives instead A(d-r,b,j)=N/|F_r| *|[r choose b]_Q|*|[r choose j]_Q| <=N^(r+1)/r!. (4) Indeed the sine formula and decrease of sin(t)/t on (0,pi) give |[r choose s]_Q|<=binom(r,s); their product is at most 4^r, which cancels the factor 4^r in the lower bound for |F_r|. The polynomial matrix dimension and disjoint k-support now imply the conservative explicit bounds, for BOTH signs, ||E_low||,||E_top|| <=H_N(R), H_N(R)=N^3 (e N/max(1,R))^R. (5) The exponent at R=0 is interpreted as zero. For every R_N=o(N), log H_N(R_N)=o(N). This includes all bounded normal quantum jets, but also collars growing arbitrarily sublinearly. For R=floor(epsilon N), the rate is at most epsilon log(e/epsilon)+o(1), tending to zero with epsilon. The physical endpoint normal scale has therefore been bounded, rather than evaluated using an invalid bulk Stirling expansion. The top collar forces both physical inputs and outputs into endpoint collars: a=d-r+j, b<=r, output(d-r+b,j). This is stronger support than a single separate Euler endpoint. The low collar includes its noncentral zero-transfer Cartan branch, so centrality must not be inferred for that branch. ## 3. A full-source all-corner estimate at arbitrary braid width Use the original scalar source, already justified before decomposition, K_N=chi_N/N Tr[(I tensor g tensor ... tensor g) W_N], g_a=x^(1-N)Q^(-a). Fix the original word and replace EACH of its m crossings by either E_low or E_top, keeping all signs, order, pivots and chi_N. The entire sum of these 2^m corner words has magnitude at most |chi_N| N^(b-1) 2^m H_N(R)^m. (6) This follows from the operator trace inequality on the actual N^b-head space; each pivot is unitary. In particular the WHOLE all-endpoint corner is exp(o(N)) times its retained external source for R_N=o(N). No position compactness, separate-sector positivity or removal of clock feedback is a hypothesis of (6). For a mixed corner one must retain and estimate every remaining bulk operator. Its endpoint factors still cost (5), but this alone gives only the norm bound for the remaining coherent blocks. Neither (6) nor the zero local endpoint rate assigns a volume bound to that mixed source. In particular one may not fix bridge clocks and ignore W_h. ### Exact thin-source reduction and the regular top-collar criterion The top packet has an additional ORIGINAL-source description: E_top,+(R)=sum_(a-j>=d-R) (I tensor E_j)R_plus(E_a tensor I). (6a) There are (R+1)(R+2)/2 terms: a=d-s, s,j>=0, s+j<=R. Each term keeps the COMPLETE original R between two PHYSICAL head projectors. Put k=a-j=d-(s+j). Its sole remaining input index b lies in [0,s+j]. The term is exactly J_out diag_b(r_plus(a,b,k)) J_in^dagger, J_in|b>=|a,b>, J_out|b>=|b+k,j>. (6b) Both J maps are isometries from a space of dimension at most R+1; the diagonal has the subexponential bound (4). Thus this is a literal lower-dimensional boundary source, with the exterior word and its actual coupons unchanged. The negative version is the exact mirror. It is not a replacement by an ordinary low-color representation. This grouping also supplies a quantitative version of the REGULAR physical-projector value theorem in [the actual cap note, Section 9](actual_coupled_caps_interval_source.md#9-finite-physical-projector-stationary-strata-have-action-zero). Suppose the remaining full phase is stationary in every direction except the fixed projector-clock normals; every crossing belongs to its genuine regular actual canonical graph, or a controlled joint limit of that graph. Bound all physical positions, their inverses and the finitely many based conjugating frames by H>=1. Then for a fixed diagram there is a fixed exponent C such that the top-collar clocks give, throughout their stationary support, delta_N=H^C(R+1)/N, |Im W|<=C delta_N(1+|log delta_N|) if delta_N is small. (6c) Here W is the complete calibrated leading phase with its original unit-clock and integer marks, not a phase obtained by dropping a factorial face. To verify the estimate, the projector clocks satisfy |B-1|<=2pi(R+1)/N. In the actual finite position chart, e and f vanish to first order at B=1, K=-B^(-1), so ||G+I||<=C H^C(R+1)/N. The actual Hurwitz and inverse-turn relations propagate this estimate through the one-component knot. This does not assume that a projector preserves the meridian. Cut the oriented knot at EVERY projector. Each resulting interval has projector endpoints, and each side of each such endpoint is independently near -I: its clock is near one while either position is bounded by H. Follow an interval from its endpoint. Each actual crossing retains its physical strand meridian or conjugates it by a matrix whose norm and inverse are bounded by a fixed power of H. Each turn inverts the same nearcentral matrix. There are only a fixed number of these operations, so its distance from -I grows by at most a fixed power of H along the entire interval. At the next projector restart with its independently small endpoint value; no equality across its allowed position jump is assumed. All physical arcs, and hence their clocks, are within C delta_N of the central value. This also covers multiple retained top packets, since their number is bounded by the fixed original word. The projector constraints are pure-imaginary logarithmic constraints. At restricted stationarity their missing normal gradients consequently have zero contraction with Re Z, exactly as in that cap theorem. The phase-defect identity leaves the original direct five-symbol sum. Its arguments are products and ratios of these near-unit physical clocks, and D(z)=O(|z-1|(1+|log|z-1||)) near z=1. This proves (6c). In particular H<=N^epsilon and R<=N^alpha give a vanishing regular action whenever alpha+C epsilon<1. The estimate does not concern arbitrary auxiliary cleared branches, uncontrolled chart denominators, or a restriction to a REAL cutoff face without stationarity in its normal. At |z|=N^epsilon the missing conormal can contract nontrivially with Re Log z. Thus (6c) alone does not bound gradient-flow exit currents, their mass, or escaping mixed endpoint periods. The low-transfer Cartan branch is not covered by its central-meridian argument. Formula (8) below demonstrates that a top endpoint can still carry an exterior's full rate through exact normalization; it is not legitimate to discard it from (6c). ## 4. The maximal-transfer Markov corner is exactly normalization Let theta=x^(1-N), the ORIGINAL complete twist line. At k=d, (1) has only a=d,b=0, and its coefficient is kappa N. Therefore E_top,+ at R=0 =kappa N |d,0><d,0|, E_top,- at R=0 =kappa^(-1) N |0,d><0,d|. (7) Open an arbitrary original knot at the strand where a Markov cell is to be attached, BEFORE decomposing that cell. Its complete cut is C=K I. Keep the SAME original averaged cut on that strand and close the new head with its original g. Direct evaluation gives (1/N)Tr[(C tensor I)(I tensor g)E_top,+] =kappa theta K, (1/N)Tr[(C tensor I)(I tensor g)E_top,-] =kappa^(-1)theta^(-1)K. (8) Here g_0=theta and g_d=theta^(-1). These are exactly the full original positive/negative Markov-cell values, before the known framing line cancels their twist. Thus ALL other transfer slices of that attached cell sum to zero with this prescribed exterior and source. This is a source-level normalization reduction, not an operator equality or a permission to relocate a cut after insertion. For comparison, its k=0 corner alone has value kappa theta K/N *sum_(a=0)^d Q^(a^2) (9) in the positive case. This can have the full exterior rate, despite its own unit operator norm. Such endpoint pieces are paired in the exact normalization (8), rather than assigned a strict gap one by one. This is consistent with regular finite-position endpoint action zero: that action statement does not control an escaping source or its complete exterior normalization. The SAME phenomenon holds for an actually summed low endpoint packet, not only a single k=0 term. For every fixed R and odd N>2R+1 its normalized multiplier relative to kappa theta K is exactly L_(N,R)=1/N sum_(k=0)^R F_k^(-1) sum_(b=0)^d Q^(b^2)(Q^(b+1);Q)_k^2. (9a) Indeed tracing (1) forces a=b+k. The factors x^(-2b), Q^(b^2) and g_b leave theta Q^(b^2). Terms b>d-k can be included because their displayed Pochhammer is exactly zero. No endpoint source has been changed in (9a). Let G_N=sum_b Q^(b^2). At every odd N, |G_N|=sqrt(N): in its squared modulus the invertible change (a,b)->(a-b,a+b) gives sum_(u,v)Q^(uv)=N. For P_k(t)=(Qt;Q)_k^2=sum_s c_s(Q)t^s, completion of the same finite square gives exactly sum_b Q^(b^2)P_k(Q^b)/G_N =sum_(s=0)^(2k)c_s(Q)Q^(-s^2/4), (9b) where division by four is modulo N. Along N=1 mod4, Q^(-1/4) tends to i; along N=3 mod4 it tends to -i. Since c_s(Q) tends to (-1)^s binom(2k,s), the right side for k>=1 tends respectively to 2^(2k-1)(1-i) or 2^(2k-1)(1+i). It is a fixed finite expression, so its error is O_R(1/N). Finally F_k=(-2pi*i/N)^k k!(1+O_R(1/N)). Thus the largest k=R term dominates the ACTUAL sum in (9a), and for every fixed R>=1, |L_(N,R)|= [2^(2R-1)sqrt(2)/((2pi)^R R!)] N^(R-1/2)(1+O_R(1/N)). (9c) For R=0 its magnitude is exactly N^(-1/2). These are polynomial, nonzero multipliers of the unchanged exterior knot period. A single Markov cell has no adjacent inverse pair to contract first. Hence a mixed low endpoint packet does NOT in general restore the missing normal gluing equation by itself. Exact complete-cell normalization is necessary even for this simplest source test. This does not assign the same behavior to an endpoint after that whole cell has been pruned. ## 5. A closed half-integer contour retaining physical support zeros There is an actual finite-height quadrature starting from (1), without moving upper transfer limits or a free separate Euler endpoint. Use the normalized factorial Fhat of [the exact interpolation](exact_factorial_interpolation_and_complex_contours.md) and replace the factorial ratio in (1) by Fhat(b+z)F_a/[Fhat(z)F_b Fhat(a-z)]. (10) It is holomorphic on a neighborhood of -1/2<=Re z<=d+1/2. To check this, Fhat is nonzero on -1<Re z<N. Its shift equation extends Fhat holomorphically to Re z>-1, with zeros at all integers N,N+1,...; the reciprocal extends holomorphically to Re z<N, with zeros at -1,-2,.... These continuations follow by shifting to the original nonzero strip and multiplying finite factors. At every integer z in [0,d], (10) is the actual coefficient and is zero if z>a or b+z>=N. Thus the forbidden physical tails vanish EXACTLY; they are not restored by declaring a new state support. After multiplying by the specified port monomials and choosing their logarithms, the finite sum is its integral against pi cot(pi z)/(2pi*i) around a positively oriented rectangle with vertical edges -1/2,d+1/2 and finite nonzero heights. This contour contains precisely the original integer transfer poles 0,...,d. It preserves their endpoints and all corners, for any fixed bridge width and every fixed choice of the other original source variables. Fubini on these compact contours gives the simultaneous word identity. No infinite-height type estimate or sharp full-source bound is inferred from this representation. Rounding an artificial meeting of contour pieces does not remove their enclosed integer poles. The quantitative normal packets which can presently be grouped without such a claim are (3)--(8); mixed intermediate/endpoint strata remain additional work. The [projected cotangent completion](actual_projected_transfer_cot_completion.md) now provides a further OPERATOR-level normal extension: retaining the original physical output Fourier projections makes every added negative integer pole removable, even at simultaneous scalar factorial collisions. Its normal collar cost is exp[O(s log N)], uniformly over all physical inputs, hence subexponential for s<=N^alpha, alpha<1. It keeps the original nonnegative residues and supplies no sharp estimate for a bulk exterior. ### The low normal packet has an explicit nonzero source current The normal-scale equation can be calculated before a contour or saddle argument. Fix the literal a,b and write r_k for (1), with zero forbidden coefficients. Its exact successive ratio gives, at every index, (1-Q^(k+1))r_(k+1) =c(1-Q^(b+k+1))(1-Q^(a-k))r_k, c=xQ^(-b). (11) For F_R(t)=sum_(k=0)^R r_k t^k and sigma F(t)=F(Qt), define L=(1-sigma)-ct(1-Q^(b+1)sigma)(1-Q^a sigma^(-1)). Then the ENTIRE finite low packet has the exact sourced equation L F_R=-c t^(R+1)(1-Q^(b+R+1))(1-Q^(a-R))r_R. (12) The full physical sum F_d has zero right side: either its last coefficient is already zero, or the actual support endpoint kills one displayed factor. Thus adjacent complementary transfer packets cancel exactly the SAME boundary current, with no arbitrary source normalization. Formula (12) holds inside the original full word with all other head variables and source coupons retained. This current cannot be dropped on the bounded or sublinear normal scale. Suppose a/N,b/N stay in compact subsets of (0,1), R=o(N), and t stays in a compact nonzero annulus. For every k<=R, (11) gives |r_(k-1)/(t r_k)|<=C R/N. The two shifted denominator factors stay bounded away from zero; the numerator is at most 2pi k/N. Summing the resulting geometric tail proves uniformly for R>=1, F_R(t)=r_R t^R(1+O(R/N)). (13) For R=0 this equality is exact. Dividing the SOURCE in (12) by (13) therefore has nonzero limiting symbol -ct(1-B)(1-A), A=lim Q^a, B=lim Q^b. (14) In particular it does not tend to zero. Omitting this source would incorrectly force the extra normal equation (1-A)(1-B)=0 and a central meridian. Closed half-integer contours do retain its original integer residues; rounding a contour corner alone does not authorize that omission. The operator size of the source in (12) is subexponential by (3), multiplied by a polynomial dimensional factor and the bounded displayed unit-clock factors. Its contraction with a bulk exterior can nevertheless have that exterior's full rate, as the exact packet calculation (9a)--(9c) demonstrates. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_total_transfer_endpoint_packets.py): independent original coefficients at both endpoint collars and signs, their normal-scale inequalities, whole-source Markov normalization corners, summed low packets, their sourced normal equation, and exact holomorphic support zeros in (10).

title: Simultaneous lower-transfer faces with interior physical heads go downhill
text: # Simultaneous lower-transfer faces with interior physical heads go downhill 28 October 2026. This gives a source-preserving boundary operation for an arbitrary fixed one-component braid word. Several actual total transfers may approach zero simultaneously. If every physical head factorial stays in a regular interior strip, all those transfer normals have compatible zero sides. The original scalar cardinal source can be continued from its existing lower cotangent sides through their joint NEGATIVE collar, with its exact currents retained. Every outgoing selected-strip norm/cardinal phase is downhill at the stated nested scale. Head endpoints are excluded. This is a genuine class of removable exits, not a sharp bound for the remaining whole knot period, nor a claim about the number of repeated boundary visits during a global descent. ## 1. The original source has independent integer transfer coordinates Use the original complete balanced crossing, with d=N-1. Its two signed routings are (a,b) -> (b+sigma*k, a-sigma*k), sigma=+1 or -1. (1) All original kappa, Cartan, pivotal, framing and external factors are retained. Before splitting states, use the justified whole original averaged trace K_N=chi_N/N Tr[(I tensor g tensor ... tensor g) W_N]. (2) For a one-component closure its integer closed paths have coordinates (t,k_1,...,k_m) in Z^(m+1), (3) with counting Jacobian ONE. Here t is one arc's color. Follow the oriented physical knot: each crossing's two visits change that color by opposite multiples of k_j. Every intermediate arc label is therefore an integer linear form ell_r=t+sum_j e_(rj) k_j, e_(rj) in {0,1,-1}. (4) Each k_j cancels after its second visit, so the path closes for EVERY integer transfer vector, and conversely every closed path recovers its unique t and transfers. An equivalent direct proof propagates symbolic initial heads through (1). At the end their owners are permuted by a single cycle P and acquire integral offsets d_r(k). Closure asks A_r-A_(Pr)=d_r(k). Degree conservation gives sum_r d_r=0 identically, so these equations solve integrally around that cycle, with one free common color and no divisibility constraint. The physical state polytope is exactly 0<=k_j<=d, 0<=ell_r(t,k)<=d. (5) For the average (2) it has strict real interior: take t=d/2 and every k_j=eta d with eta<1/(4(m+1)). This is a domain assertion, not a positivity or noncancellation assertion. A highest-cut t=0 presentation can have forced faces. Its forced equalities must be removed before using a free-coordinate interior statement; (2) is justified for the whole original word, not separately after inserting a current. This is the explicit knot lattice of [the scalar cardinal completion](actual_scalar_cardinal_source_completion.md#explicit-knot-coordinates-dimension-and-forced-cut-faces). It explains why the lower-transfer normals in the following theorem are independent even after the ORIGINAL closure is imposed. ## 2. Exact singular factor and the regular-head hypotheses For a positive crossing the original coefficient is r_+(a,b;k)=kappa x^(-a-b+k) Q^(b(a-k)) Fhat(b+k)Fhat(a)/[Fhat(k)Fhat(b)Fhat(a-k)], Q=exp(2pi*i/N), x=-exp(-pi*i/N). (6) The negative one is precisely its balanced conjugate mirror, not a replacement positive coefficient. Its denominator also contains the negative-root Fhat_-(k). The exact full-function identity is 1/Fhat_epsilon(k)=Psi_epsilon(epsilon*h*(k+1))/phi_epsilon, h=2pi*i/N, phi_-=conjugate(phi_+). (7) Thus the classical lower-transfer normal has the EXACT tag xi_j=(k_j+1)/N, u_j=epsilon_j*2pi*i*xi_j. (8) It is not legitimate to omit the +1 when locating finite zeros. Fix a subset J of crossings. Put delta=N^(-alpha), 0<alpha<1, and assume |xi_j|<=delta for j in J. Every physical head label appearing in any crossing is assumed to stay in the interior strip eta <= Re(ell_r/N) <= 1-eta, eta=N^(-epsilon), |Im(ell_r/N)| <= C epsilon log N+C/N. (9) Other transfer factorial arguments are regular in their own marked strips. In particular none of their full-function arguments approaches one during this operation. More generally it is enough to assume the regular part G of the original logarithmic action satisfies |partial_(xi_j) G| <= C_0+C_word epsilon log N (10) on the entire normal tube. Condition (9), the actual five-function formula (6), and the fixed integer coefficients (4) imply (10). Indeed every relevant derivative is a fixed combination of Log(1-Q^ell) and Log(Q^ell), plus fixed lift constants. Interior angular margin eta bounds the first by O(1+epsilon log N); (9) bounds the second. The original Cartan Gaussian has the same bound. Constants depend only on the fixed word and the prescribed tube constants. If alpha>C_word' epsilon for a sufficiently large fixed word constant, all heads stay in (9), with slightly weaker constants, when ANY subset of the k_j is displaced by real distance at most 2N delta. This uses the finite integer routing coefficients in (4). Thus this hypothesis can be checked before the move; it is not an assumed unknown period comparison. In what follows choose alpha so that alpha > (C_word+2) epsilon, (11) enlarging C_word to cover those margin changes. Such alpha exists for all sufficiently small fixed epsilon. ## 3. All retained marks have zero real variation in these normals The [scalar cardinal source](actual_scalar_cardinal_source_completion.md) uses fixed powers of w^+(s)=A_N(s)+B_N(s) exp(2pi*i*s), w^-(s)=B_N(s)+A_N(s) exp(-2pi*i*s). (12) Every mode of every window is an INTEGER character of the actual linear labels (4). Along a real transfer displacement its modulus is EXACTLY constant, even when the other variables are complex. Hence these leading integer marks cannot change the downhill sign below. Their coefficients have only polynomial normal bounds on the fractional fixed-height edges used here: heads stay in (9), and a transfer window's digamma poles are a fixed distance from those edges. No assertion that the modes are harmless on arbitrary macroscopic complex deformations is made. Likewise the ORIGINAL full-Psi reset Psi_epsilon(u)=(1-exp(Nu)) Psi_epsilon(u+epsilon*2pi*i) (13) retains TWO outgoing sectors. Their relative character exp(Nu), with u from (8), also has exactly constant modulus along a real k_j shift. All original norm factors 1-exp(Nu) remain; none is replaced by one. Integer step shifts leave these characters themselves unchanged. At outside physical integers the A_N,B_N packets have compensating poles. Consequently (12) must remain a JOINT packet during the filling. It is split only on regular outgoing edges. The ensuing statement about each outgoing sector does not authorize independent pole crossings for its separated terms. ## 4. Uniform simultaneous downhill at the nested scale Write the original density's leading exponential as exp(N S), so its height is Re S. On a continuous marked branch its singular transfer part has the exact leading form S_sing=sum_(j in J) Li_2(exp(epsilon_j*2pi*i*xi_j)) /(epsilon_j*2pi*i). (14) All other leading terms are G in (10). Along xi_j -> xi_j-s_j with s_j real and 0<=s_j<=2delta, partial_(s_j) Re S =log|1-exp(epsilon_j*2pi*i*(xi_j-s_j))| -Re partial_(xi_j)G <= -(alpha-C_word epsilon) log N+C. (15) This follows directly by differentiating Li_2. Its real logarithm is single valued on the punctured normal disk. The exact holomorphic completion below retains the zero if the path meets it. Under (11), (15) is <=-c_word log N for all sufficiently large N. The normals are independent coordinates, so they can be shifted in any order; no positive circuit arises among them. After shifting each one by 2delta, its signed full-Psi imaginary coordinate satisfies epsilon_j Im u_j' in [-6pi delta,-2pi delta]. (16) Apply (13) at every outgoing factor and retain the complete 2^|J| norm packet, together with every cardinal mode. The two-sector selected-strip calculation in [the shape-one patch](actual_isolated_shape_one_downhill_patch.md) shows that the maximum outgoing sector height is at most the continuously marked height followed in (15). Equivalently, the branch on either side of the normal cut is the larger of the two reset sectors; the other one has smaller height. Integer cardinal characters do not change (15). Therefore EVERY outgoing sector obeys Re S_out <= Re S_in -2 c_word |J| delta log N. (17) The assertion is local in the stated regular-head tube. It makes no claim about every sector of the entire original period away from it. The full quantum factor, including its zeros, has the uniform normal bound exp[O(N delta(1+|log delta|))+O(log N)]. The regular background varies by O(N delta(1+epsilon log N)). Cardinal coefficients contribute only a fixed polynomial factor on the stated edges. Thus the complete fixed finite patch has additional mass exp(o(N)). These estimates use alpha<1 and (11); they do not divide by the value of the knot period. ## 5. Exact cotangent filling and source sides The finite-level reason this is an original-source operation is also explicit. At a newly crossed integer k_j=-s, 1<=s<N, ord[1/Fhat_epsilon(k_j)]=1. Every head factorial in (6) is nonzero and holomorphic on the interior strip (9). The remaining transfer factors are regular, so the complete summand has a zero at k_j=-s. Its full cardinal completion is holomorphic there too, and has at least that zero. The cotangent pole is therefore removable. At joint negative integers these statements hold separately in every free k_j variable; the completed scalar summand is holomorphic before taking any multivariate residue. Consequently the old lower side Re k_j=-1/2 can be moved to Re k_j=-R-1/2, with R=O(N delta)<N, at fixed positive upper/lower heights, retaining both horizontal connecting pieces. No original physical integer residue is removed and no new one is added. This can be performed simultaneously in all j in J, because (3) is an integer coordinate system. The iterated product-prism Stokes identity retains every side and corner current with its induced orientation. The statement is applied to a joint-chain piece on whose ENTIRE sweep the head margin (9) holds. If the full source is first split into this regular-head piece and head-endpoint pieces, the new transverse cutting curtains are part of those side currents. They are not dropped or declared lower-rate by the present theorem. For a single translated patch, with sweep S and partial S=Gamma_out-Gamma_in-S_side, the exact identity is integral_(Gamma_in) omega =sum_outgoing_sectors integral_(Gamma_out) omega_sector -integral_(S_side) omega. (18) At outside integer poles the packet is kept combined, as required in Section 3. Formula (18) does not drop the horizontal connectors or the side currents of the other original logarithmic/radial factors. Its residue-free form assumes the sweep stays in Re k_j<0, starting at the original lower sides as just specified. A patch starting at POSITIVE transfer coordinates can cross the original poles k_j=0,1,...,O(N delta). Their original residue currents must then be added with their orientations. They are not canceled by the windows, which equal one on physical integers. The existing low-transfer packet bound controls their operator cost but does not bound an unrestricted exterior by the knot volume. No generic positive-side residue deletion is part of this theorem. A direct finite-step estimate provides an independent check on the zero side. For k=nu-s on a fractional fixed-height edge, 1/Fhat(k)=product_(r=0)^(s-1)(1-Q^(nu-r))/Fhat(nu). For s=O(N delta), its modulus is at most N^C [C(s+1)/N]^s. (19) The regular head and Cartan ratios cost at most N^(C_word epsilon*s+C). All integer characters are invariant under those step shifts. Thus the far negative edge has the suppressing factor exp[-(alpha-C_word epsilon)s log N+O(s+log N)], in agreement with (15). Near the start and on the retained horizontal connectors one uses the complete bounded normal patch rather than asserts a uniform strict gap from a face of zero displacement. ## 6. Boundary of the theorem This supplies a simultaneous downward filling for lower-TRANSFER-only outer cotangent faces with regular interior heads, in the ORIGINAL complete closed source at arbitrary braid width. A failure of its regular-head hypotheses routes the analysis to a physical head endpoint, another transfer endpoint, or an escaping/nonregular head chart. It cannot be blamed on an arbitrary circuit of nine auxiliary atomic variables in this chart. An interior normal cut may instead retain the original low-transfer residue packet described above; that current is also not removed. It does NOT assert that all physical face directions are downhill. For example at the all-zero head AND transfer vertex, reverse any strict interior flow. Since the factorial-degree imbalance at either signed crossing is +k, its logarithmic modulus along that outward ray has the leading positive increment -k t log t+O(t). Fixed cardinal characters have unit modulus there. Thus Slater feasibility alone does not give a downhill direction when head endpoints collide. That increment is still o(1) at t=N^(-alpha); it is not an excess-volume counterexample and does not affect (15), where heads are regular. Global sharp upper bounds still require handling those other faces, controlling repeated patch/flow visits and their aggregate source, and retaining the original phase through any chart change. Neither geometric survival nor the original volume limit is inferred here. Reproducible free-coordinate, signed phase and exact-window checks: [audit](../experiments/audit_actual_transfer_only_face_downhill.py).

title: The original marked two-vertex contraction in every channel
text: # The original marked two-vertex contraction in every channel 29 October 2026. The complete magnetic contraction of one actual black vertex with its ordinary white vertex and the ORIGINAL physical marked arc has a positive formula at every supported folded triple. This is a coherent contraction, not a replacement of white by a Hermitian adjoint. The paired circle is retained as a nilpotent coupon. Its first normal and the normal required by the physical mark are included separately. Write N>=2, d=N-1, M=floor(d/2), q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, F_u=(Q;Q)_u, s_u=|F_u| and x=q^d. For 0<=a,b,c<=M put J=a+b+c, delta=J-d, r=b+c-a, r1=a+b-c, r2=a+c-b. Let L_j be the FULL c_j sector of the actual complete circle L_N, where c_j=q^(2j+1)+q^(-2j-1). On the original nested six-head source p_16 p_23 p_45, insert L_a,L_b,L_c on the three consecutive physical pairs. Close with the two original ordinary caps and the original unrestricted marked row specified in the [actual vertex definition](actual_trivalent_complete_circle_vertex_kernel.md). Denote this raw scalar by Z_N(a,b,c). No extra component normalization is inserted. Put k_j=2 for a paired node 2j<d and k_j=1 for the odd simple node 2j=d. Then Z_N(a,b,c)=0 for J<d. For J>=d it is EXACTLY Z_N(a,b,c) =N s_delta s_r s_r1 s_r2 *product_j h0_j/(s_(2a)s_(2b)s_(2c)) *|A_N(a,b,c)|^2 =N^2 k_a k_b k_c s_r s_r1 s_r2/s_delta *R_N(a,b,c)^2 >0. (1) Here A_N and R_N are the proved actual scalar and positive factorial partition in the [all-channel source theorem](actual_trivalent_all_channel_positive_scalar_and_regular_cubes.md), and h0_j=k_j N s_(2j)/s_j^2. (2) All factorial indices in (1) lie in 0,...,d. At N=2 there are no supported triples. Formula (1) is a local two-vertex source evaluation; it is not an arbitrary-graph norm or a hyperbolic-volume identification. ## 1. Genuine duality, including the reversed label order Use the original ordinary image Q_j, its full Clebsch columns W_j and its positive single-object metric from the [all-degree CD normalization](actual_trivalent_full_cd_normalization_and_magnetic_growth.md): G_(j,u)=s_(2j)/(s_u s_(2j-u)), pi_j=G_j^(-1) W_j^dagger P, L_j=h0_j W_j pi_j. (3) On a paired axis pi_j W_j=0. On the odd simple axis it is I. Nothing below uses a paired retraction or substitutes a value-only projector for L_j. For Q_j choose the canonical ordinary cup with first entry one: p^(j)_(u,2j-u)=(-1)^u q^[u(2j-u-1)] F_u F_(2j-u)/F_(2j), ell^(j)=(p^(j))^(-1). (4) Its defining E,F equations follow directly from the displayed ratio. The physical maps remain p_(u,v)=N x^(-v)delta_(u+v,d) and ell_(u,v)=x^u/N delta_(u+v,d). The right dual of W_j is D(W_j)=(p^(j))^T W_j^T(ell^T tensor ell^T)P, D(W_j)=gamma_j pi_j, gamma_j=q^[2d^2-2dj-j^2-2j]/N^2 =q^(2-j^2)/N^2. (5) These are bilinear pivotal duals. To fix the scalar, take row0 and physical input (d-j,0). The original lowest endpoint is W_(j,2j)(d,j)=q^[d^2-dj-j^2], and p^(j)_(2j,0)=q^(-2j), giving the first exponent in (5). Its difference from 2-j^2 is a multiple of 2N. Both maps are actual integer-H intertwiners. Their homogeneous Hom space is one-dimensional: after duality its highest vector lies in the degree d-j E-kernel, whose first-order recurrence has all interior arrows nonzero. This proves the all-input equality. Also D^2(W_j)=(K_V^(-1) tensor K_V^(-1))W_j K_j=W_j, directly by the cup matrices and K covariance. Thus D(pi_j)=gamma_j^(-1)W_j, even when pi_j W_j=0. Define the ordered black column and ordinary white row by U_abc=(pi_a tensor pi_b tensor pi_c)J_source, Lambda_abc=ell^S(W_a tensor W_b tensor W_c). Right duality REVERSES the three object labels. The actual nested matching is invariant under the six-head reversal, so Lambda_abc=gamma_a gamma_b gamma_c D(U_cba). (6) In particular a same-order adjoint cannot be inferred when labels are unequal. Let Theta_abc be the genuine ordinary invariant normalized by Theta_abc(2a,r,0)=1. The complete source theorem gives U_abc=s_abc Theta_abc, s_abc=N^3 A_N(a,b,c)/G_(b,r), s_cba=N^3 A_N(c,b,a)/G_(b,r1), G_(b,r1)=G_(b,r). (7) All source phases in (7) are kept. ## 2. An own finite ordered theta evaluation Temporarily use a generic parameter zeta, Q=zeta^2. Let the same ordinary modules have highest weights 2a,2b,2c, and use the cups (4) with q replaced by zeta. The canonical invariants are regular finite Clebsch recursions, with denominators of index at most 2a,2b,2c. The third-color-zero slice of Theta_abc is, for 0<=k<=r1, A_k=Theta_abc(2a-k,r+k,0) =(-1)^k zeta^[k(2a+1-k)] F_(r+k)F_(2a-k)/(F_r F_(2a)). (8) This follows by solving its first-order lowest F equation backward from its stated corner. For the reversed tensor, the first color 2c is held fixed. Its E equation has just two terms, giving B_k=Theta_cba(2c,r1-k,k) =zeta^[2k(a-b)] A_k. (9) There is no boundary term: the first E input would be color 2c+1. Let T be the partial magnetic pairing of Theta_abc and D(Theta_cba) over the first two objects. The invariant E equations imply K_c T is scalar, as cleared equalities between adjacent diagonal entries. At third color zero its scalar is zeta^(2c)T_00. Substituting (8),(9) and the exact cups yields zeta^(2c)T_00 =(-1)^r1 zeta^[4c-r1(r-1)] F_(2b)F_r2/(F_r F_(2a)) *[J+1 choose r1]_Q. (10) For completeness, the sole finite summation in (10) is sum_(k=0)^r1 Q^[k(r2+1)] [r+k choose k]_Q[2a-k choose r2]_Q =[J+1 choose r1]_Q. (11) It is the coefficient of u^r1 in 1/[(uQ^(r2+1);Q)_(r+1)(u;Q)_(r2+1)] =1/(u;Q)_(2c+2). The reciprocal finite-product coefficient formula follows by induction on its length; no theta or 6j evaluation is a premise. Taking the pivotal trace of (10), and canceling its factor 1-Q^(2c+1) BEFORE specializing, proves the finite identity Xi_abc:=D(Theta_cba)Theta_abc =(-1)^r1 zeta^[2c-r1(r-1)] F_(2b)F_r2 F_(J+1) /[(1-Q)F_r F_(2a)F_r1 F_(2c)]. (12) This keeps both the ordered normalization and its root zero. ## 3. Retain the physical marked normal by a regular trace quotient A regular generic lift of the physical W_j is explicit. Put t=d-j. Its highest coefficients and actual divided descendants are h_u(zeta)=(-1)^u zeta^(-du) Q^[u(t-1)-u(u-1)/2](Q^(j+1);Q)_u F_(d-u)/F_d, W_(j,v)(zeta)=F_pair^v h(zeta)/F_v, 0<=v<=2j. (13) Its highest recurrence and the directly inductive E,F commutator give its E,F,K covariance at every interior descendant. The final vector F_pair^(2j+1)h is killed by E_pair by the same commutator. Its degree is d+j+1>d, where E_pair is a rectangular bidiagonal matrix of full column rank: starting at its boundary row eliminates each input in turn, using only nonzero physical interior E arrows. Hence that final vector is zero. This proves the last F endpoint as well, without a generic decomposition theorem. All denominators in (13) have index <=d<N and are units near the chosen root. At that root factorial reflection gives exactly the original W_j. For the physical cup choose its generic canonical formula with highest weight d and scale N zeta^(-d^2); its root values are exactly the original p and ell. Keep the ROOT gamma_j and h0_j fixed, and define pi_j(zeta)=gamma_j^(-1)D(W_j(zeta)). Thus h0_j W_j(zeta)pi_j(zeta) is a regular Hopf coupon specializing to the full actual circle sector (3), including its nilpotent value. This is a regular lift for a FIXED-ROOT identity. It does not identify the original moving-q germ with a projector or a new scalar germ. By the original dual index contraction (6), the ordinary closed generic physical source without the h0 factors is F(zeta)=gamma_a gamma_b gamma_c s_abc(zeta)s_cba(zeta) Xi_abc(zeta). (14) The source coefficients s(zeta) are holomorphic and their root values are (7). Cut the ORIGINAL physical marked arc. The resulting map is a regular scalar t(zeta)I on the generic physical highest-weight-d module. Indeed its K eigenvalues are distinct and its interior F arrows are nonzero, so commuting with K,F forces a scalar. Direct cup/cap multiplication gives ell p^T=(-1)^d K_V, F(zeta)=(-1)^d[N]_zeta t(zeta). (15) At the root this is exactly the original pivot K^(1-N), since K^N=(-1)^d I. The original unrestricted marked row has m p=1, hence the marked closure is t(q). The mark has stayed on the physical V_N component; no paired-image projection is used to move it. For J>=d, J+1=N+delta<2N. The numerator F_(J+1) in (12) has EXACTLY one root zero, and all displayed denominator factorials are units. Since F_(J+1)/(1-Q^N) -> N F_delta, equations (12),(15) give the finite, nonzero normal quotient eta_abc=lim_(zeta->q) Xi_abc/[(-1)^d[N]_zeta] =(-1)^(r1-d)q^[2c+d-r1(r-1)] N F_delta F_(2b)F_r2/[F_r F_(2a)F_r1 F_(2c)]. (16) This quotient retains the physical marked normal. Because Xi has a simple zero, derivatives of the holomorphic source coefficients in (14) make no contribution to the limit. The full paired-circle CD normal was already included in h0 and is not substituted for this different normal operation. ## 4. Full phases and the positive answer Combining (7),(14)--(16), the marked scalar including all three circle sectors is Z_N=product_j h0_j *q^[6-a^2-b^2-c^2] A_N(a,b,c)A_N(c,b,a) *eta_abc/G_(b,r)^2. (17) The two actual corner magnitudes are equal. Their ordered source phases satisfy phase(A_abc A_cba) =q^[2a^2+2c^2-2ac-2J-6]. Substitute F_u=(-i)^u q^[u(u+1)/2]s_u in (16). The net F-index difference is -d. Combining it with (17) leaves the phase (-1)^(r1-d) i^d q^[N(N-2J-1)/2]=q^(-2Nc)=1. Its remaining magnitude is N s_delta s_(2b)s_r2/[s_r s_(2a)s_r1 s_(2c)]. Use G_(b,r)=s_(2b)/(s_r s_r1). This proves the first equality in (1). The independently proved scalar formula |A_N|=s_a s_b s_c R_N/(N s_delta) and (2) give its second equality. No phase, paired multiplicity or factor of N has been dropped. As normalization checks, the odd simple triple a=b=c=(N-1)/2 gives Z=N^3|A|^2. For even N=2m>=4 and a=b=c=m-1, it gives Z=8N^3|A|^2/cos(pi/N), exactly the separately proved [even central normal contraction](actual_even_central_black_white_marked_contraction.md). There is also an explicit marked co-source identity. With the original unscaled W-coordinate packet Vm and the independently normalized Theta_abc used above, contracting all magnetic indices gives sum_magnetic Theta_abc overline(Vm_abc) =N^5 s_delta s_r2/[s_(2a)s_(2c)] overline(A_N(a,b,c)). (18) Indeed the literal vertex normalization is Z=(product h0_j/N^7)sum U_raw overline(Vm)/product G, while U_bal=N^3 A Theta/G_(b,r). Substitution of (1) proves (18). This is a specified linear functional of the entire magnetic tensor, not equality of the marked co-source and an adjoint on other inputs. For literal signed edge twists R^(e_i)L_(j_i), multiply (1) by product_i omega_(j_i)^(e_i), where omega_j=kappa(-1)^j q^[j(j+1)], kappa=q^(d^2/2). This follows on the full root block since its nilpotent circle kills the additional normal term of R. It is not a stripped-Cartan phase. The coherent sum over different triples can then have cancellations. For three UNTWiSTED full complete circles the source is the sum of the positive terms (1); that statement concerns this specified two-vertex wiring only. Any external original line factor stays outside the raw scalar. ## 5. What this theorem does and does not estimate The extra growth of the black magnetic tensor is contracted BEFORE an estimate. Its compensation here is supplied by the genuine white duality and the physical marked normal, not by bounding white in a Euclidean norm. Formula (1) supplies an exact positive partition for this local marked two-vertex source. It does not make the marked white tensor an adjoint on arbitrary exteriors, prove a tensor-product metric compatible with general recoupling, or identify its factorial action with the volume of a graph complement. The [focused exact audit](../experiments/audit_actual_trivalent_all_channel_marked_contraction.py) checks all folded triples at ten physical levels N=2,...,11, every original Clebsch dual, reversed-label ordinary white and unrestricted marked contraction. A separate generic audit checks (10),(12) on all 65 admissible spin triples <=4 and all covariances of eleven regular physical lifts. Direct ungrouped original physical sources include both parities, unequal labels, genuine full-normal circle summands and signed Cartan crossings, in eighteen closures. These tests supplement the finite Vandermonde, duality and regular-trace proof above. An independent analytical reader rederived the ordered magnetic recursions, Vandermonde, generic endpoint, all-label normal quotient and exact remaining phase, and reported PASS. A separate fresh replay of the audit also passed. These are internal proof reviews, not external peer review.

title: All-channel positive black scalar and regularity of every surviving source cube
text: # All-channel positive black scalar and regularity of every surviving source cube 29 October 2026. This is an ALL-LEVEL result for the original trivalent source, at both parities and composite levels. Every allowed three-circle block has a nonzero scalar with an explicit positive factorial evaluation. Consequently the actual saturated source on each surviving block is the regular cube module, cyclically generated by the original nested cups. The previously conditional three-circle rank bound is now an equality. This is a local source theorem. It does not identify a sewn graph with a hyperbolic manifold, bound the full black magnetic tensor by its scalar, or replace the sole marked white co-source by an ordinary cap. ## 1. Exact source scalar at every retained triple Put N>=2, d=N-1, M=floor(d/2), q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, s_u=product_(v=1)^u 2sin(pi v/N), s_0=1. The retained pair labels are 0<=a,b,c<=M. Use the ORIGINAL coproduct columns H^(j)_k=q^(k^2)[d-j choose k]_Q, W^(j)_r=F_pair^r H^(j)/(Q;Q)_r. At a triangle triple, the black coefficient extracted by the rows W^dagger P with magnetic indices (2a,b+c-a,0) is N^3 A_N(a,b,c). Its physical pair degrees are (d+a,d-a+c,d-c). These are the exact columns and cup ordering of the [general source-corner formula](actual_trivalent_general_scalar_candidate.md). Write J=a+b+c, delta=J-d and e=2a^2-ab-ac+bc-J-3. The actual scalar vanishes for J<d. For J>=d, the triangle inequalities are automatic because a,b,c<=M, and A_N(a,b,c)=(-1)^(N+J)q^e C_N(a,b,c) R_N(a,b,c), C_N=s_a s_b s_c/(N s_delta), (1) where R_N=N sum_(max(a,b,c)<=t<=min(a+b,a+c,b+c)) s_t/[s_(t-a)s_(t-b)s_(t-c)s_(d+t-J) s_(a+b-t)s_(a+c-t)s_(b+c-t)]. (2) All summands and C_N are STRICTLY POSITIVE. Every factorial index lies in 0,...,d, and the summation interval is nonempty. In particular A_N(a,b,c)!=0 if and only if J>=d (3) within the triangle range; the full black tensor also vanishes outside the triangle range. The phase in (1) belongs to the stated ordered corner; the modulus is symmetric in a,b,c. There are two own finite proofs of (1). Both begin with the exact [root-Fourier source coefficient](actual_trivalent_root_fourier_source_certificate.md), including the low-mode cancellation that proves its zero branch. The [short square-linearization proof](actual_trivalent_square_linearization_bridge.md) uses finite product induction and (U;Q)_N=1-U^N. The independent [Jackson/Newton proof](finite_trivalent_euler_racah_transform.md) uses finite Leibniz, Newton interpolation and Vandermonde. Each reaches the same symmetric terminating series through an [independently proved finite Sears transformation](finite_balanced_sears_operator_proof.md). Its terms have one exact phase, which cancels to positive sines. The proofs retain all normalizing factors; (1) is not inferred from finite tests or from a published 6j formula. ## 2. General regular-cube theorem for the actual saturated source Let S_N be the ACTUAL six-head saturated invariant source and let A_1,A_2,A_3 be its three disjoint pair Casimirs. For a folded joint cluster j=(a,b,c), write E_j for the regular cluster idempotent and S_j=E_j S_N. Let r be the number of DOUBLE axes; an odd central Steinberg axis is simple. On a double axis put epsilon_i=A_i-c_(j_i). The previously proved [saturated support theorem](actual_six_port_three_circle_support.md) gives epsilon_i^2=0, R_r=C[epsilon_1,...,epsilon_r]/(epsilon_1^2,...,epsilon_r^2), dim S_j=2^r when a+b+c>=d. (4) The complete ordinary circle acts by a nonzero multiple of epsilon_i on a double axis, and by N on a simple axis. Outside a+b+c>=d, the product of the three complete circles is zero by the cleared missing-corner identity on the ACTUAL torsion-free source lattice. For EVERY surviving cluster, put v_j=E_j(p_16 p_23 p_45). Then the map R_r -> S_j, f -> f v_j (5) is an isomorphism. Thus the original nested cup is a cyclic generator of every surviving regular cube; no choice of a semisimple root frame or a guessed generic lattice is involved. Proof.
