By [multi-cusp marked rigidity](general_marked_multicusp_gluing_rigidity.md), with main meridian logs fixed to zero, the auxiliary PROJECTIVE meridian logs U=(U_1,...,U_r) are holomorphic coordinates on the decorated geometric germ. The actual preferred longitude logs obey V_i(U)=U_i t_i(U), t_i(0)=tau_i, Im tau_i>0. (1) This divisibility follows from the exact commuting-similarity identity, not a guessed source potential. Choose a sufficiently small geometric neighborhood where all t_i are nonzero and where the framed representations lie in the fixed neighborhood required by the existing [geometric completion theorem](general_source_regulator_hyperbolic_equality.md). Normalize a developed triple to obtain a bounded holomorphic representative of the framed family there. Introduce complex parameters e_i and solve V_i(U)+e_i U_i=-2pi i e_i, i=1,...,r. (2) At (U,e)=(0,0) the U-Jacobian is diag(tau_i), hence invertible. The holomorphic implicit-function theorem gives one solution U(e) in a fixed polydisk around zero. Shrink that polydisk so the framed family stays in the above completion neighborhood and |t_i(U(e))+e_i|>=c_D>0. Using (1), equation (2) becomes the exact coordinatewise identity U_i(e)=-2pi i e_i/[t_i(U(e))+e_i]. (3) In particular |U_i(e)|<=2pi|e_i|/c_D, even when the e_i have arbitrarily unequal magnitudes. If e_i=0, then U_i=V_i=0 EXACTLY. That cusp is unfilled and parabolic; it has not been assigned a filling coefficient p_i=0. Now put e_i=1/p_i for i in I and e_i=0 otherwise. For sufficiently large independently signed |p_i| this is in the same polydisk and (2) gives the ACTUAL small-log equations U_i+p_i V_i=-2pi i, i in I. (4) The curve mu_i+p_i lambda_i is primitive because its meridian coefficient is one. Equation (4) has unit charge, with its original orientation. All unfilled groups are parabolic and nontrivial nearby. These are precisely the inherited hypotheses of the geometric completion theorem: actual nearby framed representation, correct primitive marking, parabolic unfilled ends, and unit-charge filling logarithms. That theorem constructs the complete smooth metric on the correctly marked filled topology. This proves the corollary. The argument makes no rational-surgery quantum claim. Retained half twists belong to Y_D and its own primitive collar. A hidden half-integer slope on a different pure link is not substituted for (4). ## 3. The strongest honest general volume statement is still conditional For this SAME D, suppose the original mixed-color marked source satisfies all hypotheses of [the general original-source long-filling transfer](general_original_source_long_filling_transfer.md): an exact analytic color packet, uniform complex asymptotic with nonzero leading density, the full complementary-color/alias/normal-current gap, and selection of the actual marked geometric action and its complete regulator anchor. Then that transfer theorem gives a threshold T_vol(D)>=T_geom(D) such that, for every FIXED signed vector p with all |p_i|>T_vol(D), lim_(N -> infinity) (2pi/N) log |K_N(K_D(p))| =Vol(S^3 minus K_D(p)). (5) Here the parity test in section 1 is assumed, and all auxiliary circles are filled. Every quantum level is included, both parities and composite levels. The order of quantifiers is for each fixed k and admissible fixed D, there exists T_vol(D), for every fixed signed long vector p, take the full sequence N -> infinity. The general quantum hypotheses have NOT yet been proved for every D. Thus T_geom(D) is established under the positive marked certificate, whereas existence of T_vol(D) for arbitrary certified D remains the active volume-conjecture target. The exact compiler, classical geometric critical scheme and local column amplitudes do not by themselves supply that missing full-source estimate or period coefficient. If only a nonzero analytic density germ is proved, rather than a unit or a controlled peripheral monomial times a unit, the [source-divisor extension](general_long_filling_source_divisor.md) allows an exceptional analytic divisor of slopes. Its density-one conclusion must not be restated as the all-long-slopes assertion (5). There is no assertion of uniformity when p depends on N. The transfer errors and their constants are proved with p fixed. Likewise no threshold depending ONLY on k follows from these arguments: bridge width bounds the number of simultaneous heads, while the number/order of boxes and all geometric and source constants remain part of D. This is a limitation of the proved quantifiers, not a proof that a universal k-only threshold cannot exist within a more restrictive certified class. ## 4. What long twisting does and does not provide Given the positive marked base certificate, long integral twists provide the hyperbolic filled geometry by section 2. They preserve the already fixed knot/link connectivity. They do not imply the base certificate: Y_D is independent of p, as are its cusp labels, essential crossing disks and actual cut topology. Nor does hyperbolicity of a filled knot imply that every chosen augmented presentation has a hyperbolic base. There is an elementary obstruction to using raw crossing counts in place of essential marked disks. Two adjacent same-pair blocks can satisfy R^(2p) R^(-2p+2c)=R^(2c) with fixed c while both apparent twist counts grow. This identity holds in the ORIGINAL source, with its Cartan factor and marked closure. It motivates merging redundant regions and certifying the drilled topology; it does not disprove a uniform threshold inside the certified essential class. The present target is therefore broad but precise: every fixed certified essential augmented 2k-plat skeleton, for every k>=2, with the required parity and independently long signed full twists. It is not a claim that every k-bridge knot already lies in that long-twist class, nor that the full volume conjecture for that class has now been proved. Root analytical review: checked the holomorphic cusp divisibility, invertible Jacobian, one fixed parameter polydisk, coordinatewise bounds, exact partial-filling locus and every inherited hypothesis of the cited geometric completion theorem. The geometric threshold is proved under the marked positive certificate. The quantum threshold remains conditional. No additional finite audit is needed for this direct assembly corollary.

title: The general long-twist target at arbitrary bridge number
text: # The general long-twist target at arbitrary bridge number 30 October 2026 update. The target remains arbitrary fixed k>=2 and independently sufficiently long FIXED signed twists, with the knots and slopes fixed before the quantum level tends to infinity. It remains a CONJECTURE for a general essential hyperbolic augmented skeleton. There is now a whole-source intermediate theorem: the [original signed augmented source](general_signed_augmented_source_volume.md) has limit equal to the actual complete volume for every fixed connected plat with the stated labeled right-angled certificate and any retained half-twist pattern. Both parities and composite levels are included. This is an augmented-LINK theorem, including patterns whose main strands form one component; it is not yet the general long-filled knot theorem. The proof uses the [exact positive face coefficient](actual_original_marked_face_coefficient.md), its [global torus saddle](actual_positive_face_coefficient_saddle.md), the [uniform all-channel bound](actual_positive_face_channel_rate.md), and the [absolute facet-coning volume](actual_original_boundary_stationary_character.md). The signed extension derives a uniform relative folded Gaussian from the original continuants and sums the actual phases to a nonzero leading coefficient. All original factors and the primitive grid measure remain. The [fixed complex complete-core theorem](actual_complete_core_complex_packet.md) now supplies a nonzero asymptotic on a fixed neighborhood in EXTERNAL crossing-circle colors, for the exact complete-image term of reflection. The [marked geometric assembly](actual_complete_core_geometric_deformation.md) now identifies its limiting action, including at the zero faces, with the actual geometric regulator and its complex boundary correction. The [whole-source untwisted corridor](general_untwisted_mixed_source_volume_corridor.md) now transfers this volume identity to the original mixed source when any chosen set of untwisted ports varies near completeness. A [signed one-port criterion](actual_signed_small_circle_face_kernel.md) is also proved under its explicit local curvature inequality. General long fillings still require bounds for interacting signed reflected terms and the combined far-color source. The current dependency map is in the [frontier chapter](../book/chapters/frontier.md). The older source, operator, Fourier and torsor tools are preserved below with their own scopes. They are not an assertion that the general filling inputs have now been proved. ## 1. Quantifiers and the actual diagram Fix k>=2 and an ordered 2k-strand plat diagram with r designated two-strand twist boxes. Every crossing belongs to one of the boxes; all other wires, cups and caps are those of this fixed diagram. For example its braid word can be written beta(p)=sigma_(i_1)^(epsilon_1-2p_1) ... sigma_(i_r)^(epsilon_r-2p_r), epsilon_s in {0,+1,-1}, p_s in Z. The index word, box ordering, endpoint marking and epsilon are fixed. Adjacent powers of the same generator are combined before treating their twist parameters as independent. The fixed upper and lower pairings together with the permutation of the epsilon word must give one component. This is a finite permutation/matching test: adding a full twist does not change it. Thus every p gives a knot with a k-bridge presentation; k need not be its minimal bridge number. Drill one actual crossing circle around each box, remove the full twists, and retain its specified half twist. Denote the resulting marked augmented exterior by Y_D. Require Y_D to be hyperbolic, with the actual primitive crossing-disk markings retained. This is a geometric hypothesis on the supplied diagram, not an assertion that every presentation of a hyperbolic knot has hyperbolic augmentation. **General long-twist conjecture.** For every such fixed diagram D there is T(D)<infinity such that, for every fixed integer vector p with all |p_s|>T(D), lim_(N->infinity) (2pi/N) log|K_N(K_D(p))| =Vol(S^3 minus K_D(p)). (1) Here N is the quantum level. Twist numbers are fixed BEFORE this limit. The conjecture includes both level parities and composite levels, arbitrary signed twist vectors, and no comparability condition on their magnitudes. It asks for the volume of the FILLED knot, not the complete drilled volume or a limit in which p grows with N. For a partial filling the analogous statement is about the remaining link exterior with its original single marked normalization. The quantifier is every fixed k and every admissible fixed skeleton; there is no proposed universal threshold depending on k alone. Under an actual positive marked gluing certificate, the [geometric long-filling corollary](general_augmented_plat_long_filling_quantifiers.md) now proves a threshold T_geom(D) for complete hyperbolic geometry of every independently long signed filling. Existence of the quantum threshold T(D) in (1) is the remaining conjectural assertion for a general skeleton. These two thresholds must not be conflated. ## 2. Why twist length needs a diagram hypothesis Raw box counts do not measure geometric twisting. For the actual crossing operator, including its Cartan factor, R^(2p) R^(-2p+2c)=R^(2c). (2) Both displayed blocks can have arbitrarily many crossings while the diagram remains the fixed bounded-twist diagram on the right. The identity holds inside ANY 2k-strand source and before its marked cap. It is an exact algebraic cancellation, not an asymptotic example. Likewise a nugatory twist can change a presentation without adding an essential drilled cusp. Thus independent long parameters must refer to actual essential crossing disks. Certifying Y_D directly is a uniform way to impose this requirement without restricting k or assuming that a visually complicated plat is geometrically essential. ## 3. The exact reduction already works for every fixed k The all-input circle identity gives the original full-twist expansion on each pair of strands. Let A_(D,N)(h_1,...,h_r) be the actual augmented source with circle color j_s=N-h_s, including all its specified half twists, cups, caps, pivots and the exposed first cut. Then the [general source transfer](general_original_source_long_filling_transfer.md) has the exact identity K_N(K_D(p))=chi_N kappa^(-2 sum_s p_s) sum_(j_1,...,j_r=1)^N product_s beta_(j_s-1)^(-p_s) A_(D,N)(N-j). (3) The source A is defined before the displayed recorded outer factor chi_N; it is not normalized using the unknown answer. All repeated Casimir-root normals are part of beta. Multilinearity applies each substitution in its ORIGINAL operator order. Physical crossings at different boxes need not commute. Only the independent color-register functionals commute. Consequently the long-twist problem does not require a new surgery formula for each bridge number. The same exact filling map is already available. What is missing generally is control of its input A_D. ## 4. Inputs still needed for general signed long fillings **Full mixed-color quantum source.** Establish an exact holomorphic color packet for A_D near the complete colors, with a uniform complex asymptotic, and an exponential gap on the ENTIRE physical color complement. The estimate must include all aliases and normal currents. A bound for one positive sector or for independently maximized vertices does not give this input. The marked multiport Chebyshev/Parseval packet is exact at every fixed k, but its physical source-to-coefficient energy is still the quantity to estimate. **Actual geometry.** Supply the marked complete augmented exterior and its absolute volume anchor. A positive ideal gluing certificate on a triangulation of the actual exterior is one sufficient route. Another starts from its actual disk/projection cut: the cubic graph of shaded triangles and its distinguished crossing-circle matching describe the whole polyhedron, and a positive right-angled realization supplies the complete metric. A triangulation of an unrelated manifold or a numerically matching volume does not identify this labeled topology. The [general marked gluing certificate](general_marked_positive_gluing_certificate.md) proves the geometric implication directly. It also proves the Casson--Rivin equivalence with an interior critical point of the actual angle-volume function, whose unique maximum is Vol(Y_D). Positive phases and positive multiplier variables give a finite algebraic certificate; the selected optimum has algebraic shapes. None of these geometric facts implies the quantum packet estimate. **Same selected action.** Prove that the critical source action is the calibrated primitive on the ACTUAL peripheral branch, retaining the selected square roots and logarithms. The required equations are G=2pi i phi, U_s=-2pi i x_s, V_s=-2 partial_s phi, Im G(0)=Vol(Y_D). (4) The filled source saddle then gives the primitive equation U_s+p_s V_s=-2pi i. The existing geometric completion theorem constructs the actual smooth filled metric and identifies its volume with the boundary-corrected source action. It is this last equality, not an unnamed source volume, that yields the right side of (1). The already proved long-filling transfer is independent of k once these inputs are available. It must not be cited as having supplied them for an arbitrary plat. The new [critical-scheme equivalence](actual_augmented_plat_critical_scheme.md) and [marked multi-cusp rigidity](general_marked_multicusp_gluing_rigidity.md) now supply a nearby geometric stationary branch under an actual positive gluing certificate. The only magnetic Hessian null directions are the two framing directions; a transverse slice removes them. The branch has the actual peripheral differential and absolute volume anchor. The quantum statement still requires that the original finite source select and contribute to this branch. The new [actual local character map](actual_augmented_plat_local_critical_character_map.md) proves the primitive differential on any correctly marked stationary branch. The [absolute endpoint regulator theorem](actual_augmented_plat_endpoint_regulator.md) proves the complete-volume anchor at a regular correctly marked geometric critical point. A [generic framing theorem](actual_augmented_plat_regular_geometric_phase_chart.md) supplies a regular unfolded geometric candidate, but does not select its physical logarithmic sheet or a contributing quantum cycle. Thus the identities in (4) have a general classical proof with these hypotheses; their realization by the actual selected source remains part of the quantum problem. The [actual channel Hessian](actual_augmented_plat_channel_hessian.md) also has a general primitive normalization: H_(xi_i,xi_j) is -delta_ij 4pi i/tau_i, and the channel/magnetic mixed block vanishes. Its negative real part gives a local channel elimination at the geometric endpoint, while holding the magnetic variables as parameters. It supplies no nonzero cycle coefficient or magnetic asymptotic. ## 5. Preserved operator and Fourier routes The [complete source compiler](actual_augmented_plat_phase_compiler.md) and [all-color compiler](actual_mixed_augmented_plat_compiler.md) give explicit finite factorial sums, phases and generic confluence normals for every fixed plat. Their inverse measures retain their exponential profiles. No unknown local recoupling inverse remains. The [entire core function](actual_augmented_plat_entire_core_color_packet.md) also supplies an exact separately-even finite Fourier interpolation, including the odd endpoint. It does not supply a uniform complex asymptotic. If the required nonzero analytic corridor packet exists, its periodicity mirrors the same rate near the opposite cube face. The actual physical alias split therefore matters for the global gap. For each actual local q-Hahn column, the [negative-root theorem](actual_q_hahn_negative_root_source_polynomial.md) now proves a canonical slit-plane logarithm, and the [complex-action theorem](actual_q_hahn_selected_complex_action.md) proves its actual leading action on the physical Fourier arc. The [uniform amplitude theorem](actual_q_hahn_uniform_complex_amplitude.md) adds a nonzero prefactor with relative error O(1/N). The [magnetic corridor theorem](actual_q_hahn_magnetic_complex_corridor.md) continues the actual finite kernel in one magnetic variable while the pair degree and channel stay real and discrete. The subsequent [joint determinant](actual_q_hahn_joint_accretive_determinant.md) and [joint amplitude theorem](actual_q_hahn_joint_complex_amplitude.md) now continue pair degree and magnetic coordinate together on a fixed central domain, including folded channels, with an explicit selected local sheet. The channel remains an integer. The [common-framing criterion](actual_augmented_plat_physical_framing_criterion.md) states finite strict inequalities for simultaneous use on a plat; the [right-angled obstruction](actual_right_angled_selected_framing_obstruction.md) now proves that an all-central selected frame cannot exist for the actual certified right-angled cut. Generic geometric strip flags localize the weaker strict physical-support failures to exactly TWO factors, for arbitrary bridge width. Those facets can be prescribed, including the pair adjacent to the original marked physical edge. The [full physical packet](actual_q_hahn_full_physical_complex_packet.md) and [selected-factor corollary](actual_augmented_plat_selected_factor_localization.md) now put EVERY other ordinary factor in its actual selected physical packet, with no central-support hypothesis. The two exceptions can instead be placed together at one crossing-circle matching edge. The [selected local certificate](actual_augmented_plat_selected_local_certificate.md) remains a conditional local theorem; it does not establish a whole-source cycle or sum estimate. The [small-channel generic-normal estimate](actual_q_hahn_small_channel_generic_normals.md) and [exact partner collision](actual_q_hahn_partner_normal_collision.md) retain the original derivatives. The latter exposes additional individual normal poles, so a full-domain paired-normal estimate cannot be assumed. The [physical paired-normal theorem](actual_q_hahn_physical_partner_normal_bound.md) does prove polynomial relative cost on the whole complete physical grid, retaining the actual large partner and both parities. The [complex near-fold theorem](actual_q_hahn_near_fold_complex_partner_bound.md) now supplies subexponential relative cost on a fixed complex compact when (l-j) log N=o(N). A fixed nonzero scaled channel shift and a whole-source asymptotic remain open. Every fixed generic q jet of all physical columns and completed divided pairs is also controlled by the [physical generic-jet theorem](actual_q_hahn_physical_generic_jet_bound.md). Its forward/backward proof does not supply a completed boundary tensor norm. The full physical packet extends the complex near-fold bound to all fixed physical compacts, still with a shrinking scaled channel window. These local results are not a whole-source asymptotic. Outside the specified marked domain the endpoint quadratic has monodromy, so an unspecified analytic continuation alone cannot identify the selected geometric root. A controlled simultaneous continuation and a global cycle estimate remain necessary. Choosing the exceptional pair at a crossing-circle matching edge also gives the [exact marked four-port rewrite](actual_matching_edge_marked_four_port_block.md) of the COMPLETE-circle source. Its original row measure cancels the exponential factorial gauge, and the [positive scalar theorem](actual_matching_edge_racah_positive_scalar.md) controls every recoupling target and fixed generic jet. The [completed-projector formula](actual_matching_edge_completed_projector_block.md) also cancels the target scalar gauge and combines the collision pairs before taking the first normal, retaining their nilpotent part. The remaining native projector/complement costs are explicit but not yet sharply bounded by the geometric action. This is not the general mixed-color packet required for fixed long fillings. The [native-projector energy theorem](actual_matching_edge_native_projector_energy.md) now bounds every fixed generic operator derivative by a polynomial times its explicit magnetic energy, uniformly at both parities and all physical degrees. A simple midpoint channel proves that energy can itself be exponential. The remaining joint variational estimate must keep the actual shared wire variables and these energy terms; independent local maxima do not supply it. The [full folded boundary rate](actual_matching_edge_magnetic_energy_profile.md) is now computed by exact Plancherel and the actual selected endpoint polynomial. It remains valid in [all shrinking real fold windows](actual_matching_edge_shrinking_fold_native_energy.md). For arbitrary fixed skeletons, the [shared-cycle compiler](actual_matching_graph_shared_cycle_fourier_compiler.md) gives an exact bounded-flow source with coupled Fourier congruences and the original one-unit mark. Its [positive coefficients](actual_q_hahn_fourier_coefficient_variational.md) have a uniform interior variational rate. These source reductions retain every shared label and phase. They do not supply the general mixed-color packet, sharp joint geometric estimate or lower bound needed for the fixed-long-filling theorem. The [explicit positive partition](actual_matching_graph_positive_fourier_partition.md) now gives a polynomial-loss Cauchy upper bound retaining every shared flow and Fourier charge. Its sharp rate is not yet the hyperbolic volume: the [conditional radial-frame obstruction](actual_positive_fourier_radial_geometric_obstruction.md) prevents one proposed all-ordinary geometric reconstruction, without proving a numerical gap. The exact coherent source and the retained exceptional matching block remain the objects to estimate. The [full graph identity](general_matching_graph_full_normal_source.md) puts all folded labels and normals on the actual matching graph. The [reflection-double identity](actual_planar_three_port_reflection_double.md) removes the final gluing cancellation for specified three-port doubles, retaining the full source. Neither identity already bounds the internally coherent half-packets for arbitrary graphs. The [matching-graph geometry](general_augmented_plat_matching_geometry.md) constructs the actual complete complement and primitive markings from a labeled positive right-angled certificate. It also constructs a positive ideal triangulation. The [geometric endpoint theorem](actual_augmented_plat_geometric_channel_endpoint.md) locates the complete disk character at c=-2, the folded-channel endpoint, and retains its marked peripheral square root. This is necessary geometric information, not a proof of quantum selection. The [endpoint phase calculation](actual_central_endpoint_magnetic_phase_obstruction.md) also shows that a universal separate-leg positive normalization already fails at N=3. It leaves coherent resummation available. The [source-divisor extension](general_long_filling_source_divisor.md) allows a nonzero analytic source-density germ to vanish at the complete point. With the other packet, gap and geometric hypotheses proved, it yields the filling equality away from an analytic exceptional divisor, including density one of long slopes in each signed box. A peripheral monomial times a unit gives EVERY independently long signed slope. The general nonzero-germ version does not by itself prove the all-slopes conjecture (1). These results remove finite-source and geometric ambiguities. The principal remaining theorem is still a coherent asymptotic with the required global gap and the actual selected geometric period. The [arbitrary-width Conway extension](actual_conway_arbitrary_width_seeds.md) is retained as an application and a calibration of these interfaces. It does not settle (1) for all k-bridge diagrams. The full cube source, which lies beyond that grammar, remains one useful branching test, not the definition of the general target. ## 6. Literature coverage only Purcell's [highly twisted volume paper](https://research.monash.edu/en/publications/volumes-of-highly-twisted-knots-and-links/) states hyperbolicity and geometric volume bounds under diagrammatic hypotheses; those are not an original Kashaev volume-limit theorem. Van der Veen's [augmented KTG paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/0805.0094) states a volume conjecture result for its augmented knotted trivalent graphs and a containing-link corollary. Its abstract does not assert (1) for all independently long fillings of arbitrary fixed plats. These are coverage observations, not imported proofs or an exhaustive novelty claim. The definitions and source normalizations must still be compared before identifying any covered family.

title: The actual augmented plat as a cubic graph with a marked perfect matching
text: # The actual augmented plat as a cubic graph with a marked perfect matching 30 October 2026. This gives a geometry/topology interface for an arbitrary fixed 2k-plat, k>=2, rather than only a two-port Conway tree. Its input is the ACTUAL diagram, its designated crossing boxes and their retained half twists. The reversible cut produces a plane cubic graph Delta with a specified perfect matching D. A positive labeled right-angled ideal rectification certificate for Delta then gives the actual complete augmented complement, with volume 2 Vol(Q_Delta). The certificate is an explicit geometric hypothesis. This note does not prove its existence for every reduced plat, the growing-color source limit for that plat, or a generic auxiliary deformation from an unmarked polyhedron. It does identify the correct graph and exactly why the existing trivalent NC source theorem is only a subclass. Here k is the supplied plat width; no claim that this presentation realizes the knot's minimal bridge number is required. ## 1. Start with a literal diagram and its crossing disks Fix a 2k-plat word together with a disjoint collection of two-strand crossing boxes covering ALL crossings. The outside strands, original caps and cups have no remaining crossing. One may first take maximal twist regions, but the chosen boxes and their order are recorded data. Put a crossing circle around each box and retain its ORIGINAL twice- punctured spanning disk. Remove full twists, retaining epsilon_i in {0,+1,-1} as its half-twist sign. Full twist integers remain recorded in the peripheral collar marking when they are to be restored. For the cut first remove these half twists as well; their effects are restored by the explicit shaded pairings in section 4. The resulting flat diagram has main arcs in the projection sphere and perpendicular crossing circles. Let r be the number of crossing disks. Assume every main component meets at least one of them, so that the pieces outside the punctures are exactly 2r intervals pairing 4r labeled terminals. For a nontrivial knot with all its crossings in the designated boxes this requirement is automatic. An extra circle with no disk incidence must not be silently discarded. At disk i choose the four CYCLIC local labels C_i0,...,C_i3 so that its untwisted strands restore the pairs 0--1 and 2--3. This is a local crossing-disk chart; it is not an unrecorded permutation of the global plat endpoints. Its upper half disk has the two sides S_i0=(O_i,C_i1,C_i2), S_i1=(O_i,C_i3,C_i0). (1) The diagram's actual outside intervals, including all plat cups and caps, give a perfect matching of the C terminals. Two matched ends are the two ends of ONE actual main segment. The embedding and cyclic orders are retained, not just its abstract endpoint permutation. ## 2. Construct Delta and its marked matching without a geometry guess Give Delta one vertex v_i0 and v_i1 for each pair (1). Add the edge d_i=v_i0 v_i1 and mark it as a crossing-disk edge. For each actual outside main segment join the two vertices whose shaded triangles contain its two terminal labels. The incident edge order at each vertex is exactly the cyclic order in its triangle (1). Each vertex has one disk edge and two main-segment edges. Hence Delta is a plane CUBIC ribbon graph, and D={d_i} is a specified perfect matching, |V(Delta)|=2r, |E(Delta)|=3r. (2) The embedding follows by contracting the small shaded sectors to their centers and following the actual planar identity strips. This operation does not move an endpoint through another endpoint. Loops, parallel edges or repeated facial walks are recorded if the supplied diagram produces them. They are not repaired by an arbitrary graph isomorphism or by changing the knot diagram. The original bowtie boundary graph is the MEDIAL graph of Delta: * An ideal vertex x_e corresponds to an edge e of Delta. For e=d_i it is O_i, the crossing-circle semicircle. Otherwise it is the actual main segment represented by e. * The three edges incident to v give the shaded triangle T_v. * The other facial walks are the original white projection regions; their edge labels are the face walks of Delta. This identification follows at a main segment by concatenating its two oriented shaded sectors, and at O_i by its two half-disk sectors. These local rotations determine EVERY medial face cycle. If the graph is a cellular connected sphere embedding, Euler gives r+2 white faces; the cut then has 3r vertices, 6r edges and 3r+2 faces. These counts are checks of the labeled ribbon construction, not its topological proof. ## 3. A finite sufficient geometric certificate The required input Q_Delta is a convex three-dimensional ideal polyhedron with the following EXACT labeled incidence: 1. Its ideal vertices are distinct points x_e for e in E(Delta). 2. Its shaded faces are triangles T_v, with the three incident edge labels in the original cyclic order at v. 3. Its white faces F_f follow the original face walks of Delta. 4. Every edge separates one shaded and one white face, with dihedral angle pi/2. All indicated faces and edges are nondegenerate. A concrete certificate consists of future null vertex lifts, outward spacelike face normals, their incidence equalities, strict nonincident supporting inequalities, and the labeled convex-hull face cycles. Adjacent face normals have zero Lorentz product. Finite incidence and strict inequalities certify the asserted convex three-dimensional polyhedron. An unlabeled polyhedron, matching volume or matching cusp count is not a certificate for this diagram. This hypothesis automatically excludes degenerate graph data that cannot be the stated polyhedral boundary. It is uniform in k and r; there is no restriction to a trivalent source partition or to a tree of four-port metric cells. ## 4. The actual face quotient, including every half-twist sign Cut the actual flat augmented complement along its projection sphere. In each projection ball, each crossing-circle semicircle is boundary parallel by its original half disk. Drilling it and opening THAT half disk cancels the introduced handle in the explicit semicircle collar. The half disks are disjoint, so all cancellations give one cut ball in each half. Main segments on its boundary give ideal ends and do not add an interior handle. Its boundary is precisely the labeled medial sphere of section 2. By the certificate, this is also the oriented labeled boundary of Q_Delta. The boundary cell identification extends over the ball by radial extension after choosing interior points. Take two copies Q^+,Q^- with opposite abstract orientations. White faces glue across copies by their original projection labels. At an even disk glue within each copy, fixing O_i and matching C_i1 -> C_i0, C_i2 -> C_i3. (3) At an odd disk glue across the two copies: S_i0+ -> S_i1-: C_i1+ -> C_i3-, C_i2+ -> C_i0-, S_i1+ -> S_i0-: C_i3+ -> C_i1-, C_i0+ -> C_i2-. (4) In both lines the crossing-circle vertex maps to the same disk's vertex in the indicated copy. The reverse maps are inverses. For (4), rotating one side of the twice-punctured disk by ±pi sends (y,z) to (-y,-z), with the projection line z=0. It exchanges its two punctures AND the two half disks. This gives exactly (4) for either sign. The opposite signs retain different collar paths, differing by one full twist; they are not the same peripheral marking. Reversing these literal cuts recovers the original augmented plat exterior. Thus the quotient is the ACTUAL diagram with its original disk labels, main components and half-twist pattern. No assertion about all abstract cubic graphs being realized by a chosen plat is needed: Delta was constructed from that given plat. ## 5. Edge holonomy and complete cusps Every ideal vertex link of Q_Delta is a rectangle: four right-angled faces alternate shaded and white there. Its two opposite shaded sides have equal length. Scale its horosphere so that both have length one, independently at every ideal vertex. Consequently every shaded ideal triangle has its canonical length-one horocycle at each corner. Use the identical decoration in the second copy. Every prescribed shaded triangle map, including the corner exchange in (4), preserves these canonical horocycles. White maps preserve the copied decorations. At each boundary edge the disk partner is distinct from itself: the two triangles paired along a matching edge share only their marked vertex O_i. An alternating disk/white cycle has four pieces, for both (3) and (4), and has total angle 2pi. Here is also the pointwise holonomy check. The edge cycle fixes its two ideal endpoints and preserves the chosen horosphere at each. Its translation/dilation along the edge is therefore zero. Its rotation angle is the sum of the four right angles, namely 2pi. An orientation-preserving hyperbolic isometry fixing both endpoints is determined by these dilation and rotation parameters; the word is the identity. Thus there is no leftover edge translation hidden by an angle calculation alone. After a uniform horosphere shrink, the ideal links glue to finite Euclidean surfaces with no cone or dilation defect. The actual link-exterior cut identifies them as cusp tori. Their ends are complete standard hyperbolic cusps. The remaining part is compact, so the entire quotient is a complete finite-volume hyperbolic manifold. Its volume is Vol(S^3 minus L_Delta,D^epsilon)=2 Vol(Q_Delta). (5) This proves a conditional geometric theorem at EVERY fixed plat width. The hypothesis is the explicit labeled positive certificate, not an assertion that a polynomial stationary point must be geometric. The certificate also gives an actual POSITIVE ideal triangulation. Choose an ideal vertex a of Q_Delta. Triangulate every face not containing a by noncrossing diagonals, and subdivide each face that does contain a by its fan from a. Cone a to every triangle in the nonincident faces. Convexity makes these tetrahedra tile Q_Delta with disjoint interiors. Strict supporting inequalities put a strictly off every nonincident face plane, so each tetrahedron is nondegenerate with positive orientation. Use the identical face subdivisions in the second copy. All white subdivisions then match; shaded faces were already triangles. The actual quotient is therefore triangulated by positive ideal tetrahedra, with its complete edge and cusp equations inherited from the metric just proved. This is a constructive geometric triangulation, not an identification with a particular factorial source or an independently proposed potential. ## 6. Primitive crossing-circle paths are still local and explicit At any crossing-circle apex O_i put it at infinity. Its four adjacent white/shaded planes are vertical; their intersection on a horosphere is a rectangle. After a Euclidean similarity its other ideal vertices can be written (C0,C1,C2,C3)=(1,E,-1,-E), E=exp(2pi i x), 0<x<1/2. This x is a measured local geometric rectangle parameter, NOT yet a Newton source variable for a general plat. Put c=cot(pi x)>0. The actual two-white-face longitude and the collar meridians are lambda=-2(E+1), mu_0=E-1, mu_+=-2, mu_-=2E, mu_+-mu_-=lambda. (6) The elementary white and disk maps giving these translations are exactly the local maps (5) in the [half-partner cusp proof](actual_conway_half_twist_partner_geometry.md). Their use requires only this rectangle and the original disk pairing, not a Conway prism decomposition. The parallelogram area of each (mu,lambda) pair equals the area of the TWO actual cusp rectangles. Thus these are primitive disk-framed bases, with shapes tau_0=2ic, tau_+=2ic/(1+ic), tau_-=2ic/(1-ic). (7) The choice of + or - is the recorded geometric collar convention. Any proposed quantum variable must be calibrated against the actual braid/loop convention; a cusp Hessian does not select that convention. Further full twists retain their actual integer meridian shear. Equations (6)--(7) give the COMPLETE marking. They do not construct the general plat's mixed-source deformation or identify its action. The main-component test is also literal. Let sigma be the outside terminal matching. At disk i let kappa_i be (01)(23) for even parity and (02)(13) for odd parity, in the cyclic chart of section 1. The main components are exactly the connected components of the graph on the 4r terminals with the sigma edges and the kappa edges. Every vertex has degree two, counting parallel edges, so these are cycles. After all crossing circles are filled, the result is a KNOT precisely when this graph is connected. Adding full twists changes neither kappa nor this criterion. This is an exact test on the supplied diagram, not a claim that every parity pattern produces a knot. ## 7. The exact relation to the older NC rectified-core theorem The existing NC theorem starts with a different cubic graph Gamma: its 2b trivalent cup/cap vertices and its 3b physical EDGE coupons. Its crossing-circle diagram has the present matching graph Delta=Fisher(Gamma). Namely replace each vertex of Gamma by the triangle of its three ordered incident slots. The original edges of Gamma become the matching D; all other edges form those facial triangles. Thus |D|=3b and Delta\D is a union of 2b facial 3-cycles. The earlier construction of Q_Gamma plus 2b octahedra produces precisely this medial Delta boundary. Its formula 4b v8+2Vol(Q_Gamma) is consistent with (5), since its half-polyhedron has volume 2b v8+Vol(Q_Gamma). An arbitrary augmented plat does NOT automatically have this Fisher structure. Its matching complement can have other cycle lengths or nonfacial cycles. Even the crossing-circle count r need not be a multiple of three. For example the actual isolated h^4 compiler has r=4 and two nonmatching 4-cycles, so it cannot literally be a source with 3b edge circles and trivalent NC vertices. Its geometry was proved separately; it is not an instance of that NC theorem by relabeling. Even facial triangles alone would not certify the existing ORIGINAL NC source: its black/white ordering and its two noncrossing triple partitions must also match the actual cups and caps. The graph, matching, ribbon order and original marked source all matter. ## 8. What replaces a four-port tree in the general plat The full original quantum source is a planar Morse network of actual two-strand coupons, cups and caps. A sweep may have 2k active strands; coupons at different levels can share a physical strand. The finite operator product is therefore not a product of independently chosen commuting edge scalars or of unrelated theta evaluations. On the representation side a cutting sphere disjoint from the crossing circles and meeting 2m main strands carries the ORDERED puncture meridians H_1,...,H_(2m), their flags, and H_(2m)...H_1=I, modulo the actual common frame. A pants decomposition of that punctured sphere introduces internal curve holonomies and their gluing frames. Matching their traces alone loses the twist conjugators. These frames form a centralizer torsor: with ordered eigenflags the regular semisimple gluing group in PSL(2,C) is multiplicative, and the noncentral parabolic gluing group is additive. An SL(2) formulation also retains its central signs. The original braid word supplies the literal transport, as in the all-bridge Hurwitz presentation already proved in the repo. Thus a multiport replacement must preserve those marked sewing data and the full finite quantum source, including its first normals and recoupling coefficients. The present graph theorem supplies the actual complete geometric target. It does not provide the source's selected period, its nonzero amplitude, its whole-color gap, or the identification of a general mixed-source action with this marked geometric branch. ## 9. Coverage and the precise existence gap For coverage only, [Purcell's exposition](https://users.monash.edu/~jpurcell/papers/expos-auglinks.pdf) already describes fully augmented links by cubic graphs with dimers, and states hyperbolicity for a nonsplittable prime twist-reduced diagram with at least two twist regions. The broad geometric-triangulation statement for sufficiently long fillings also appears in [Ham--Purcell](https://users.monash.edu/~jpurcell/papers/HamPurcell_GeomTriang.pdf). No geometric existence or filling proof from those sources is used in sections 1--8, and no novelty of the cubic/dimer viewpoint is claimed. Hyperbolicity of the original knot alone does not certify a CHOSEN plat's augmented skeleton. A nugatory kink can be inserted in the diagram of the same hyperbolic knot; its designated crossing circle bounds a disk disjoint from the knot and gives a split added component. The chosen diagram and crossing regions require their own check. For the desired all-k-bridge, all-long-twist-regions theorem, the remaining geometry existence step is therefore explicit: construct or independently prove the positive labeled Q_Delta certificate for the actual reduced augmented skeleton. The quantum source/period and marked mixed-deformation steps are separate. None follows merely from calling the diagram hyperbolic, prime, or a plat. ## 10. Independent finite checks and their scope [The executable audit](../experiments/audit_general_augmented_plat_matching_geometry.py) constructs the original terminal intervals, their cubic marked graph, and the full ORIENTED medial face cycles in two independent ways. It checks 87 original Conway/compiler dictionaries, including the isolated h^s examples for 3<=s<=20, and 21 literal plat diagrams with 2<=k<=8. In every plat case all outside intervals and all upper/lower caps are retained; no free component is discarded. The 2k-plat test family has one odd layer joining the k original cap components in a chain, so the direct terminal test also gives a knot parity witness at each tested width. These finite checks audit the actual labels and construction. They do not infer a positive geometric certificate, twist reduction, or a quantum asymptotic from a graph. [Recorded results](../experiments/general_augmented_plat_matching_geometry_results.json). Independent analytical review of sections 1--8 and a fresh audit replay: PASS. The review checked the original half-disk ball cut, all oriented medial rotations, four-piece edge holonomy and cusp decoration, primitive collar paths, the literal filled-knot component test, and the exact Fisher-subclass restriction. It does not extend the stated positive-certificate hypothesis or supply a source asymptotic.

title: Boundary states and an exact meridian-framing correction
text: # Boundary states and an exact meridian-framing correction Research note, 25 October 2026. We use the existing charged AK tensor and the Andersen--Malusà annihilator convention. The independent preferred-longitude construction is proved in `preferred_longitude_cochains.md`; the Phi estimates and saddle argument are those already proved in `literature_state_volume.md`. This gives a uniform boundary-state theorem for the ordinary-fiber case, including singular face matrices. It permits a rational longitude shear of the intermediate spectral coordinate and corrects it explicitly. It does not assume that the shear coefficient is zero. ## 1. Hypotheses and the condition that remains Let a globally branched ideal triangulation of a knot exterior in S^3 have a complete positive geometric structure. The Fourier reduction gives N tetrahedral Phi factors and a d-dimensional allowed real shape space W=im S, where d=N-2k. Let A,B be N by N gluing matrices formed from N-1 independent edge rows and the full preferred-longitude row. The cochain theorem gives W=im B^T, rank B=d, L={ (t,s):t in W, s-Gt in W^perp }=ker(A|-B). The additional hypothesis for this note is rank B_ed=d-1. (1.1) It means the longitude increases the B rank. All proper charts satisfy (1.1), since then d=N and the full edge B rank is N-1. Singular charts can also satisfy it, as the exact 6_2 realization does. The case rank B_ed=d, in which the affine plane moves with longitude, is not silently included. Orient a meridian m and preferred longitude l with intersection(m,l)=1. By the audited cusp formula their eliminated rows obey A_m B_l^T-B_m A_l^T=-2. Fix the geometric logarithmic lifts, normalized so that both peripheral holonomies are zero at completeness. Carry every additive pi constant in eliminating the prime coordinates. ## 2. Rational spectral coordinate and its actual peripheral meaning By (1.1), e_N is in im B. There is a unique v in W such that Bv=2e_N. It is rational. Put p=S^T v and beta=B_m v/2. (2.1) The coefficient beta is not presumed integral or zero. It records a possible longitude shear of the intermediate meridian coordinate. First B_m^T is in W. Indeed the vertical part of L has dimension N-d. The vertical part of the edge isotropic space has dimension (N-1)-(d-1)=N-d and is contained in it, so these spaces coincide. The meridian pairs to zero with every edge row and thus annihilates this vertical space. This is precisely B_m^T in W. Write S^+=(S^T S)^(-1)S^T and b_r=S^+ B_r^T. Symplectic pairing with all completed gluing rows, together with their projected G identity, then proves (A_m-B_m G)S=-p^T, (A_l-B_l G)S=0, b_l^T p=2, b_m^T p=2beta. (2.2) For example the first identity follows by testing on every B^T c in W: the meridian pairing gives -2c_N, whereas v.B^T c=2c_N. No inverse of a singular B is used. Choose a rational strict angle structure theta0, in units of pi, whose lifted meridian and longitude are both zero. It exists: the geometric angle structure lies in this rational affine subspace and in its open positive polytope; rational points are dense there. This is an existence argument, not a claim that arbitrary prescribed peripheral lifts admit such a positive point. In radians put d0=pi*1-a0, C0=E c0, H=Q-P_+/2, W0=2Qd0-C0, y=i d0+S z. All coefficients and imaginary offsets are rational multiples of pi. For any balanced angle structure theta, its first-angle variation belongs to W under (1.1). One way to see this is to eliminate the double-prime variables from the full edge block: its projected solvability space has dimension N-[(N-1)-(d-1)]=d and contains W, hence equals W. Thus d_theta-d0=S eta_theta. The angle equations and the projected Gaussian identity further give S^T(W_theta-W0)=(lambda/2)p, p^T eta_theta=mu-beta*lambda, (2.3) where mu,lambda are the actual lifted angular meridian and longitude. For the first equality, B(W_theta-W0)=lambda*e_N and B has row space W. For the second, use the first identity of (2.2) in the meridian angle equation. The zero peripheral values at theta0 fix the affine constant. ## 3. An exact fiber of the existing tensor Keep the reduction constant c_X, including its three determinant Jacobians, and define I_b(z)=exp[(i y^T H y+W0^T y)/(2pi h)] product_j Phi_b(y_j/(2pi sqrt(h))), h=b^2/(1+b^2)^2, y=i d0+S z. Choose p_j nonzero. Positive Lebesgue disintegration defines J_old(h,x)=c_X/|p_j|*(2pi sqrt(h))^(-d) integral_(p^T z=x) I_b(z) dz_(others). (3.1) This includes the constant imaginary Gaussian term; it has not been removed without recording a phase. Use the contour corresponding to theta0, and its holomorphic continuation near the complete fiber. After rebasing a proper chart to S=I, with the same boundary coordinate and the same eliminated coordinate p_j, the earlier printed FAMED convention is J_print=sigma*p_j^2*J_old, where sigma=sign(det(script-A)*p_j). This explicit constant is the conversion already proved in the peripheral-phase note. It leaves the annihilator and volume limit unchanged. For singular charts the printed inverse-determinant formula is undefined, whereas the original charged tensor and (3.1) are defined. Let d_theta=pi*1-a, C_theta=E c and Theta_theta=C_theta.d_theta-d_theta^T Q d_theta, k(a,c)=a c/(4pi)+(a-c)/12-pi/24, K0(theta)=sum epsilon_j*k(a_j,c_j)-pi*N_+/12 +Theta_theta/(2pi), K_old(theta)=K0(theta)+(W_theta-W0).d0/(2pi). The exact charged Fourier and inversion identities now give Z_AK(theta;b)=exp(pi i N/12+i K_old(theta)/h) integral_(R+i(mu-beta*lambda)) J_old(h,x) exp(lambda*x/(4pi h)) dx. (3.2) Thus this function is recovered from a specifically normalized existing tensor, rather than selected as an arbitrary recurrence solution. Fourier--Laplace uniqueness applies on the strip supplied by strict angles. For fixed b, the charged factors and their derivatives have exponential tails. Their injective pullback to W, and then their fiber marginal, make J_old Schwartz with exponential tails on each smaller horizontal strip. Changing the rational reference within mu=lambda=0 only gives an explicit central phase. If W1,d1 are the new reference vectors, then W1-W0 annihilates W, p^T S^+(d1-d0)=0, and contour translation gives J1=exp[i*(W1-W0).d0/(2pi h)]J0. This phase is retained in the level; it does not change the boundary annihilator. ## 4. Exact classical equations and the geometric fiber Let F0 be the classical phase in the z coordinates of (3.1), and set g=(1/i)grad_z F0. For log z_shape=i*pi*1-y and log z_shape''=Log(1+exp y), direct differentiation gives g=S^T(G log z_shape+log z_shape'')-i k0, k0=S^T(pi*G*1+W0). The constant for any gluing or meridian row is exactly zero, because pi*G*1+W0=G a0+b0'', where b0'' is the reference double-prime angle vector. Substitution leaves A_r a0+B_r b0''-nu_r, its reference lifted holonomy. Consequently H_edge=b_edge^T g, H_l=b_l^T g, H_m=p^T z+b_m^T g. (4.1) At a constrained saddle grad F0=i*xi*p/2 these equations say H_l=xi, H_m=x+beta*xi. (4.2) Thus the actual intermediate coordinate is x=H_m-beta*H_l. No assumed meridian formula or presumed zero shear was used. At the complete geometric shapes g=0 and x=0. They lie on the affine plane y=i d0+W: subtract their gluing system from the reference angular system, then use the projection of ker(A|B), which is W. The geometric fiber has all imaginary y coordinates strictly between zero and pi. The real Hessian on its real tangent is negative definite. The uniform Phi remainder, global tail bound and complex saddle proof therefore give lim_(h->0+) -2pi h log|J_old(h,0)|=Vol(M). (4.3) ## 5. Converting to the true meridian by a Gaussian operator Use the boundary coordinate t=x/(2pi sqrt(h)) and P=(2pi i)^(-1)d/dt. For real beta define the existing Fourier/Gaussian polarization operator U_beta=exp(-2pi i beta P^2). Here Fourier transformation and multiplication by a Gaussian are the operators of Andersen--Kashaev, [arXiv:1409.1208v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/1409.1208v1), Section 6, specialized to A=R. Our multiplier definition specifies the particular shear and its square-root phase, whose identities are checked below. Its definition as a Fourier multiplier fixes its normalization and phase. For beta nonzero its kernel is (2i beta)^(-1/2) exp[pi i(t-t')^2/(2beta)], sqrt(2i beta)=sqrt(2|beta|)*exp(i*pi*sgn(beta)/4). This follows by one Fresnel Gaussian Fourier integral. It also proves U_(-beta)U_beta=I exactly, with no unspecified projective multiplier. For beta=0 use the identity operator. Define the meridian wavefunction by this change of polarization: J_mer(h,x)=1/(2pi sqrt(h)*sqrt(2i beta)) integral_R exp[i(x-x')^2/(8pi beta h)] J_old(h,x') dx', (5.1) when beta is nonzero, and J_mer=J_old otherwise. The real integral is absolutely convergent since J_old is Schwartz. Its analytic continuation to a small horizontal strip is controlled by its exponential tails. Fourier transformation proves the exact Laplace relation integral J_mer(h,x) exp(lambda*x/(4pi h)) dx =exp[i beta lambda^2/(8pi h)] integral J_old(h,x) exp(lambda*x/(4pi h)) dx. For rigor, first use real Fourier frequency. Both sides extend holomorphically to a frequency strip: a small contour shift in x' preserves the old exponential tail, even after its quadratic chirp, and gives an exponential tail for U_beta J_old as well. Analytic continuation gives the displayed Laplace identity near lambda=0. Combining with (3.2) replaces K_old by K_mer=K_old-beta*lambda^2/(8pi), and its contour is R+i*mu. The existing AK level ell=-4K_mer/pi therefore recovers J_mer from that normalized tensor. This proves an exact state identification with a recorded boundary polarization. It does not depend on the unproved assertion beta=0. For the Gaussian-corrected representation this assertion is local in the peripheral variables near the reference, with continuation wherever the stated strip bounds hold. No unproved global continuation through peripheral singularities is being assumed. ## 6. Volume survives this exact correction For beta nonzero, insert (3.1) into (5.1) and perform the real coarea disintegration. Its complete integral, with every scalar retained, is J_mer(h,x)=c_X*(2pi sqrt(h))^(-d-1)*(2i beta)^(-1/2) integral_R^d exp[i(x-p^T z)^2/(8pi beta h)] I_b(z) dz. At x=0 the geometric point is still critical, since p^T z_*=0. The additional classical term i*(p^T z)^2/(4beta) is a real quadratic times i, and adds nothing to the real Hessian on a horizontal real plane. The N Phi factors still supply a negative definite real Hessian. The imaginary contour shift from the rational reference to the geometric point keeps p^T z fixed, so the new chirp creates no extra growth during that deformation. The same uniform remainder, tail and Gaussian proof now applies in dimension d. Its Gaussian coefficient is nonzero. For beta=0 it applies on the original (d-1)-dimensional fiber. In both cases lim_(h->0+) -2pi h log|J_mer(h,0)|=Vol(M), (6.1) and J_mer is nonzero for sufficiently small h. Both normalizations have the same polynomial saddle scale h^(-1/2); the Gaussian correction does not hide an exponentially significant modulus. ## 7. The exact quantum torus and its annihilator In the Andersen--Malusà convention put q=exp(2pi i b^2), Q=exp(-2pi b t), E=exp(2pi b P), EQ=qQE. Fourier calculation, or the exact central commutator, gives U_beta E U_beta^(-1)=E, U_beta Q U_beta^(-1)=q^beta Q E^(2beta). (7.1) The central power q^beta is essential. For rational beta use the specified finite cover for the fractional E powers and the indicated exponential branch of q^beta. The direct finite-product and moment argument also applies to the integral in Section 6, so a minimal annihilator in the ordinary b-shift algebra exists after descent. Equation (7.1) transforms full quantum-torus annihilators, including nonmonomial peripheral factors. It does not assert preservation of minimal degree after localizing only the Q coefficients. A conjugated polynomial is an annihilator; the primitive minimal generator is a separate statement supplied by the direct existence proof. The new saddle has x=H_m and phase derivative i H_l/2. Therefore its classical branch is Q=exp(-H_m), E=exp(H_l/2). The geometric peripheral factor divides the classical symbol of its minimal annihilator by the proved uniform saddle argument. Q^(-1),E^2 are the PSL(2) eigenvalue ratios; SL(2) lift signs must still be recorded. No equality with the full classical A-polynomial or a Jones-defined AJ operator is assumed. This theorem removes the extra zero-framing hypothesis from the ordinary-fiber construction. It does not treat rank B_ed=d, construct complete geometric triangulations for all alternating knots, identify arbitrary triangulations by certified moves, or prove H-triangulation limits. Those parts of the original objective remain open. `audit_boundary_framing.py` checks the peripheral identities, a Gaussian image and its Laplace multiplier, and 405 quantum-torus multiplication identities before any specialization. The full audited figure-eight operator is transformed and recovered exactly by the inverse shear; all its generic peripheral coefficients are retained. The new framed polynomial is not asserted to have minimal E degree. For 6_2 it also matches this general construction to the previously recorded compact state, including its exact central factor exp(27pi i/(70h)). The subsequent `fourier_boundary_state.md` gives a single inverse-Fourier definition for both possible boundary ranks. It recovers this Gaussian correction exactly in the ordinary-fiber case and proves the volume limit when rank B_ed=d as well. The rank restriction in this note is therefore no longer needed in the combined theorem.

title: What the selected five-crossing proof does and does not generalize
text: # What the selected five-crossing proof does and does not generalize 28 October 2026. This is an independent audit of the proposed extension from the original selected 5_2 period to many bridges or long twist regions. The result below is an exact obstruction inside the ORIGINAL repeated crossing, rather than an arbitrary oscillatory example. It identifies why one useful quadrature theorem cannot simply be iterated after aggregating long twists. It is not an obstruction to the volume conjecture. ## 1. The genuinely reusable input The [five-crossing proof](five_two_selected_volume_proof.md) combines four different facts: * an exact finite whole-source transform; * a lattice-to-integral comparison with every endpoint retained; * global bounds for the selected contour and every quadrature correction; * the geometric action and a nonzero Gaussian coefficient. Only the second item currently has a local criterion that can be read directly from a general finite kernel. Section 5 of [the inner quadrature theorem](source_preserving_inner_quadrature.md) gives that criterion for a reflected factorial convolution with a quadratic Gaussian. The finite-height version is more general, but produces additional source contours instead of bounding them automatically. The arbitrary-plat reduction and positive gluing arguments supply classical equations and rigidity at arbitrary bridge number. They do not supply the exponential bounds for the finite quantum endpoint sources. Thus neither positive ideal shapes nor an acyclic classical bridge complex currently checks all four items for an infinite hyperbolic knot class. ## 2. An exact sector of an actual long twist Use the original equal-color crossing and its actual Borel fusion from [the whole-word theorem](actual_crossing_euler_completion_and_weight_source.md). Its relative coefficient, after retaining the common Cartan scalar kappa externally, is a_R/kappa = sum_(a+k<N) (-1)^k Q^(k(k-1)/2) x^(-a-2k) f^a e_k/F_a. The ideal (f) is two-sided. Hence the image of a literal p-fold crossing in the exact quotient by (f), for any integer p, is sum_k d_k^p e_k, d_k=(-1)^k Q^(k(k-1)/2) x^(-2k). Equivalently these are the actual degree-zero diagonal entries of C^(-1) R^p C/kappa^p. This is an exact matrix sector, not a semiclassical replacement of the full crossing. At the complete color x=-q^(-1), Q=q^2, d_k=(-1)^k Q^(k(k+1)/2). Let n=N-1. A normalized entire interpolation of these literal lattice values is B_(p,N)(z)=exp[pi i p z(z-n)/N]. (1) Indeed its exponent differs from the displayed d_k^p exponent by -2pi i p k, so (1) agrees at EVERY integer k. All ordinary linear lattice gauges have the form B_(p,N,ell)(z)=exp(2pi i ell z) B_(p,N)(z), ell in Z. (2) The quotient calculation does not permit replacing the original knot's whole cut by this sector alone. Its role here is to test a proposed universal local quadrature rule on an actual component of that kernel. ## 3. No linear lattice gauge removes the long-twist type For a=0,n and real t, |B_(p,N,ell)(a+it)| =exp[-pi {p(2a-n)/N+2ell} t]. (3) The largest absolute vertical exponent over the two endpoints and two directions is therefore exactly pi [ |p|(N-1)/N + 2|ell| ]. (4) In particular ell=0 is optimal, and its minimal type approaches pi|p|. This is a minimization over all the linear integer lattice gauges, not a failure to find a suitable gauge. More decisively, the actual endpoint numerator in finite Abel--Plana is explicit. The identities B(n-z)=B(z) and exp(2pi i ell n)=1 give B_ell(it)-B_ell(-it)-B_ell(n+it)+B_ell(n-it) =4 exp(-pi i p t^2/N) sinh(pi p n t/N) cosh(2pi ell t). (5) There is no hidden cancellation between the two endpoints. Dividing by exp(2pi t)-1, its absolute size at infinity is asymptotic, up to a fixed positive constant, to exp{ pi [|p|(N-1)/N+2|ell|-2] t }. (6) Consequently, whenever |p|(N-1)/N>2, no gauge (2) gives the absolutely convergent endpoint integral used in the reusable infinite-height quadrature theorem. For every fixed |p|>=3 this fails at every sufficiently large level. At equality the absolute integral still diverges; no claim about a conditionally regularized formula at that threshold is needed. This exact test includes both crossing signs and every level parity. The common Cartan scalar has no head-index dependence and changes none of (3)--(6). A zero-framing scalar external to a larger braid likewise does not change the endpoint vertical type. ## 4. What a long-twist theorem would have to do differently The subsequent [finite-mode quadrature theorem](finite_mode_source_quadrature_and_long_twists.md) now resolves this particular type obstruction constructively: retain an explicit O(|p|)-sized Fourier packet and an endpoint remainder which is O_p(1) at every level. Its far tail is exponentially small at height proportional to N. The modes and near endpoint correction remain present. The finite-height residue formula remains exact for (1), so this is not a prohibition on that method. It forces one to keep and control the extra contours. At height t=N h their endpoint growth after the Abel--Plana denominator has rate pi [ |p|(1-1/N)-2 ] h. Thus a bound that keeps h fixed while aggregating an arbitrarily long twist has a linearly growing adverse rate already in this actual sector. A valid large-twist argument may instead retain the individual crossings, use heights of order 1/|p|, or prove a different exact recoupling together with all its transformed endpoint sources. The present theorem does not decide which of those succeeds. Nor does the existence of a positive geometric triangulation bound these quantum endpoint terms. Any use of volume monotonicity must first identify the endpoints with specified original lower-complexity periods; an unidentified face of a factorial sum is not automatically the invariant of a drilled or smoothed link. The next genuinely structural theorem is therefore an endpoint transport and bound for a whole bridge move: express every finite-source boundary correction as a specified lower-complexity pointed period, with a proven rate below the geometric main period, uniformly over a diagram class. That is a concrete target suggested by the 5_2 error bound by the ORIGINAL figure-eight invariant. It has not yet been established for arbitrary plats, arbitrary alternating diagrams, or a nontrivial infinite family with unbounded bridge number. ## 5. Coverage, not proof input The primary abstract of Jun Murakami's [double-twist preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.00225) (v3 dated 2 May 2025) states a volume-conjecture result for double twist knots. The primary abstract of van der Veen's [Whitehead-chain paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0611181) states an infinite family of links. The latter is not a theorem about arbitrary many-bridge knots in S^3. The published [twist triangulation theorem](https://ems.press/journals/qt/articles/12209830) concerns the Teichmueller-TQFT volume conjecture; its abstract does not identify that state with the original Kashaev scalar. These are coverage checks only. No proof technique or theorem from those papers is used in (1)--(6). The strongest established original-knot output of the present selected finite-source mechanism remains its independently proved figure-eight and five-crossing prototypes. A broad-class theorem is a further task, not a consequence of continuity of the classical geometric point. [Exact original-matrix and vertical-type audit](../experiments/audit_twist_vertical_type_obstruction.py).

title: What capacity can and cannot select in the actual charged source
text: # What capacity can and cannot select in the actual charged source 28 October 2026. The exact original charged coefficient is a useful place to ask for a general lower bound. Three commonly proposed shortcuts do not supply one: ordinary half-plane stability, Lorentzian positivity after taking magnitudes, and a subexponential comparison with positive capacity. The last failure occurs in an actual nonzero source sector, uniformly in the level, after its already proved parallel-edge fusion. This is an obstruction to these particular methods, not to a further phase-aware fusion or to the volume conjecture. The source throughout is the specified functional in [the global charged-flow theorem](actual_global_charged_bridge_flow.md), with its [Fermat/nilpotent residue](actual_charged_socle_and_fermat_source.md). No scalar multiple of the invariant or replacement boundary functional is introduced. ## 1. The raw root blocks are not half-plane stable Let q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2, d=N-1. A genuine two-anchor block is B_L(X,Y)=product_(j=0)^(L-1)(alpha X-Q^j beta Y), alpha beta !=0, 2<=L<=d. (1) A homogeneous linear polynomial aX+bY, with ab nonzero, has no zero with Im X>0 and Im Y>0 if and only if b/a is positive real. Indeed a zero requires X=-(b/a)Y; two open half-planes through zero intersect unless the multiplier maps the upper half-plane exactly to the lower one. A product is stable only when every nonconstant factor is stable. After ANY nonzero diagonal changes X=cX', Y=eY', successive factor ratios in (1) still differ by Q. Since N>=3 here, Q is not positive real. Thus no such change makes (1), or a polynomial containing it, upper-half-plane stable. This also covers arbitrary complex diagonal changes, not just vertex phase gauges. Self-loop factors which have already become scalars or monomials are excluded from this statement. This does not rule out a different stable object obtained by an exact fusion. It prevents applying stable-polynomial coefficient inequalities directly to the original charged product. ## 2. Even the positive sine block is not Lorentzian The exact grouped expansion has positive magnitudes C_(L,k)=|[L choose k]_Q| =product_(j=1)^k sin(pi*(L-k+j)/N)/sin(pi*j/N). Put a_k=C_(L,k)/binom(L,k). Its successive ratios are a_k/a_(k-1) =sinc((L-k+1)*pi/N)/sinc(k*pi/N), (2) sinc(t)=sin(t)/t. On (0,pi), sinc is strictly decreasing: its derivative has numerator t cos t-sin t, whose derivative is -t sin t<0. As k increases in (2), the numerator increases and the denominator decreases. Hence a_k is strictly log-CONVEX at every interior index when L>=2. For a binary homogeneous polynomial with positive coefficients, the Lorentzian coefficient condition is log-concavity after division by binom(L,k). Thus the positive-sine block fails this condition. Already L=2 gives X^2+2 cos(pi/N)XY+Y^2: a nonpositive Hessian determinant would require the middle coefficient to be at least 2; here the determinant is positive. Ordinary positive coefficients have not restored the needed real-rooted or Lorentzian structure. ## 3. Logarithmic torus capacity forgets these root phases entirely For an actual product P_h of unit-modulus binary linear factors on DISTINCT anchor pairs, its Ronkin average is R_h(rho)=average_theta log|P_h(exp(rho+i theta))| =sum_factors max(rho_tail,rho_head). (3) To prove (3), integrate the relative angle of one linear factor. The mean of log|A-Be^(it)| is log max(|A|,|B|); for unequal moduli this follows by expanding log(1-z), and the equal-modulus value follows by an integrable limit. Linearity of the average then gives (3), irrespective of dependencies between the factor angles. If the charge d at every anchor is feasible, choose an endpoint for each factor giving that total charge. Each maximum in (3) dominates the chosen endpoint, so R_h(rho)-d sum_a rho_a >=0. At rho=0 equality holds. Consequently the logarithmic capacity exp inf_rho [R_h(rho)-d sum_a rho_a] is EXACTLY ONE in every feasible sector of this type. If self-loop factors occur, first evaluate them as an explicit scalar times a monomial. The same assertion holds after division by that scalar and subtraction of the monomial's charges; the scalar itself may carry an exponential action and is not omitted from the period. Nonzero selected coefficients in particular have feasible charge. This average is therefore not the exponential volume scale of the original source. It should not be confused with the supremum-over-angles Cauchy bound, or with a capacity which retains further phase information. ## 4. Positive capacity can exceed a surviving actual period exponentially Use the already proved uniform original-source family in [the anchor-phase and exact-fusion theorem](anchor_phase_cycles_and_exact_fusion.md): word=[1,-2,1,1,-2,-2], N=2r+1, h=(0,r,r,r,0,r). Its selected coefficient, INCLUDING every original closure block, is c_N=[X_0^d ... X_8^d]P_h=N q^(2-r^2). (4) The same theorem fuses its two parallel r-blocks into the complete d-block with every coefficient equal to one. Work AFTER this exact fusion. In the remaining flow description choose a=c=f=0, b=floor(r/2). These are feasible original source charges. The only nontrivial magnitude in this term is M_N=|[r choose floor(r/2)]_Q|. (5) Let P_h^+ mean the polynomial obtained from these fused grouped blocks by replacing their coefficient phases by one. It has positive coefficients. Its positive capacity is Cap_d(P_h^+)=inf_(x_a>0) P_h^+(x)/product_a x_a^d. The feasible term (5) contributes M_N product x_a^d. All other terms are nonnegative. Therefore, on EVERY radius, Cap_d(P_h^+) >= M_N. (6) Put J(t)=integral_0^t log(2 sin(pi*s))ds. Elementary endpoint splitting, followed by Riemann summation, gives uniformly for 0<=j<N log |(Q;Q)_j|=N J(j/N)+O(log N). Here r/N tends to 1/2 and b/N,(r-b)/N tend to 1/4. Since J(1/2)=0 and J(1/4)=-G/(2*pi), where G is Catalan's constant, log M_N=(G/pi)N+O(log N). (7) Combining (4)--(7) proves the genuine actual-source gap limsup_(odd N) (1/N)log[|c_N|/Cap_d(P_h^+)] <=-G/pi<0. (8) This family is a nonzero sector of a reduced alternating hyperbolic knot. Its phase curvature and feasibility were proved uniformly, not inferred from an isolated numerical level. For this length-one bridge diagram, all the original W_h factors have unit modulus, so an omitted clock normalizer is not causing (8). Equation (8) rules out a universal subexponential lower comparison between a surviving charged source coefficient and its positive capacity. It does NOT say this particular sector is a leading volume sector: its coefficient is polynomial in N, and its exponential loss is already explained by exact root correlations. It also does not exclude phase-aware capacities after further exact fusions. In particular the new source-exact full-length reproducing contractions and balanced star--triangle moves can change the positive majorant drastically. Equation (8) is not asserted to survive arbitrary such reorganizations. ## 5. The remaining possibility is genuinely phase-aware The finite-flat perfect pairing fixes the source functional; it does not force that functional to be large on a specified state. The calculation above gives a quantitative instance using the actual state and the actual source. A useful general theorem would have to retain the root-phase correlations, for example through exact local fusions followed by a source-compatible geometric contour. Taking magnitudes and invoking stability cannot replace that step. The new [defect-jet theorem](charged_star_triangle_defect_jets.md) makes this connection precise: on the unit-radius original anchor torus the source phase frequency is exactly (S_a-2d)/2, where S_a is incident factor degree. Balanced fusion removes a zero-frequency direction, while its bounded-defect extension retains a finite Fourier correction with polynomial cost. Macroscopic defects and the final global coefficient are still present. The audit here independently checks this phase identity on the actual unfused source graphs. Ordinary dominant-saddle Stokes persistence is consistent with this: in a proper deformation with a strictly highest-action saddle, its top action-graded coefficient is preserved against jumps involving only lower saddles. To use this observation here one still needs a NONZERO ORIGINAL-source coefficient in one chamber and control of singular/boundary competitors throughout the deformation. The positive constrained-lens reference chain supplies neither original cycle comparison by itself. Representation-volume rigidity at complete boundary-parabolic critical points also does not control an entire parameter path or its nonstationary boundaries. No general geometric lower bound or new knot class follows from this audit. Its constructive consequence is a restriction on methods: the exact phase-aware graph fusions address information which each of the three phase-blind shortcuts above loses. [Audit](../experiments/audit_general_charged_volume_selection.py): actual family metadata/source charges, exact small-level coefficients, the feasible positive term on arbitrary radii, the sine normalization inequalities, and the asymptotic rate in (7).

text: # General equality: proved scope and the remaining original-source problem 30 October 2026 update: the [complete signed augmented source](general_signed_augmented_source_volume.md) now has an all-level volume equality for every connected labeled right-angled certificate at arbitrary fixed width and every retained half-twist pattern. The [complete local marked-density theorem](actual_augmented_plat_local_marked_density.md) now proves nonzero fixed-channel source density and a nonzero local folded-channel Gaussian at BOTH level parities. It starts from the actual unrestricted root mark, so the complete-circle paired normal is already included. This is a complete-color local result; it does not assert a nonzero individual q-normal coefficient. The transverse magnetic Gaussian is nonzero per unit framing volume. The framing orbit and its coefficient in the original period are not integrated. The main unresolved theorem is GLOBAL: transport the original degree and magnetic cycle, retaining finite-head boundary terms and crossed poles; prove a nonzero geometric coefficient and control competing colors. A forbidden physical integer degree slice is identically zero, including genuine generic normals. Its magnetic contour alone cannot acquire a nonzero period just because the continued local packet is nonzero. The general long-twist volume equality remains OPEN. title: An explicit global Legendre contour and its source-preserving radial homotopy
text: # An explicit global Legendre contour and its source-preserving radial homotopy 28 October 2026. Every supplied positive complete ideal triangulation with the marked full-rank Lagrangian gluing rows has an explicit global contour on its positive angle polytope. On this contour the WHOLE imaginary action equals Rivin volume, including off-critical points. Its complex Jacobian is everywhere invertible. An explicit radial homotopy from the geometric fixed-radii chain preserves the leading period, with every boundary prism exponentially smaller. Gaussian Schur complements preserve the same positive half-plane structure. These are general contour constructions, not assumptions of noncancellation. They do not assert that the ORIGINAL quantum source has already been changed into this positive chart. The original figure-eight indefinite chart and the five-crossing bent-source calculation show why that last transport is substantive. No new knot invariant is defined here. ## 1. The marked positive chart and its explicit angle polytope Use the [positive quad-chart theorem](positive_quad_chart_and_actual_torus_signature.md). After its positive rotations, the marked gluing equations are A x+B y=c, B invertible, AB^t=BA^t, x_j=Log z_j, y_j=Log(1-1/z_j), Im z_j>0. Put C=B^(-1)A=C^t. At the complete meridian the retained constant c is purely imaginary. Write B^(-1)c=i kappa, with kappa real, and retain exactly the potential W(x)=sum_j Li_2(exp x_j)+(1/2)x^t(I-C)x +i(kappa-pi*1)^t x. (1) No imaginary constant is added. This is the marked potential whose complete critical value was calibrated in the quad-chart theorem. Put x=rho+i theta and gamma(theta)=kappa-C theta, beta(theta)=pi*1-theta-gamma(theta), P={theta:theta>0, beta(theta)>0, gamma(theta)>0}. (2) This is a convex bounded open polytope. It is the positive angle domain with the marked edge and meridian ANGLE equations imposed. The three angles in tetrahedron j are theta_j,beta_j, gamma_j.
