Under Mellin and Rees transport those endpoints and all irregular projectors remain present. This constructs an actual current/source map. It does not identify its coefficient class with the internal geometric Gaussian class. The final section isolates why the universal relative homotopy does not by itself prove that additional nonzero image. ## 1. Whole crossing couplings realize the actual index moments For each crossing in a fixed arbitrary b-strand word introduce a unit coupling `w_t`. Multiply its literal transfer-k coefficient by `w_t^k`, with its original positive or negative crossing convention. Equivalently use the actual factorial `P_Q(w_t Z_t)` or the appropriate inverse factorial, in its fixed Cartan/flip order. At `w_t=1` this is the original crossing. No braid identity away from that specialization is needed. Introduce `w_0^(n_cut)` at the cut. All these coupled crossings still conserve the integer sum of positions. Thus the cut matrix is diagonal term by term, including before its remaining finite internal sums. Consequently the original normalized-average cut equals normalized ordinary trace for the **entire weighted family**: F_N(w)=framing_line*(1/N)Tr_(H^tensor b) [(w_0^ncut tensor g_2 tensor ... tensor g_b) R_m^H(w_m)...R_1^H(w_1)]. (1) The original pivot, Cartan line, zero-framing scalar and full external modified dimension are retained. This is an exact finite polynomial in the weights. It is not an assumption of Ward closure of the coupled word. The [compact coherent source period](compact_coherent_source_period.md) therefore supplies its exact fixed compact cycle and star-trace calculus. Every weighted array and Green-current insertion below uses that same cycle. No identification of its coordinates with the internal geometric framing is assumed. Put `E_i=w_i partial_(w_i)`. Every actual moment polynomial `p(k_0,k_1,...,k_m)` is exactly `p(E_0,E_1,...,E_m)` applied to this family. In particular the actual Green binomials are `product_i binom(E_i,alpha_i)`. These are whole-function coupling identities, not guessed extensions of a Taylor jet. Here the closure is a knot: its braid permutation has one cycle. Following that cycle expresses every initial position as the cut position plus an integral linear combination of the crossing transfers. The intermediate positions are then integral affine functions of those same variables. Thus these weights account for every actual free-flow moment in the knot problem. For a link with several permutation cycles, retain one additional initial-position weight per other component before making that claim. ## 2. The exact Green currents are weight differential operators Use the actual Green currents of [the full certificate formula](full_certificate_framing_boundary.md). For any finite zero-extended array `f`, the generating transform is Z_w[f]=sum_k w^k f(k), Z_w[S_i f]=w_i^(-1)Z_w[f], Z_w[p(k)f]=p(E_w)Z_w[f]. (2) The first equality includes the shifted support and its endpoints. For the explicit Green word `i_1,...,i_n` representing `D^beta`, let `p_(m-1)` be its backward-difference moment polynomial. Then the generating current is exactly J_i(w)=-sum_beta A_beta sum_(m:i_m=i) p_(m-1)(E_w-e_i) product_(l=m+1)^n(w_(i_l)^(-1)-1) F_N(w). (3) The Euler operator in (3) acts on the **whole following product**, including its weight coefficients. Moving it to act on `F_N` alone would drop the actual index-shift correction. The global Green identity becomes the whole source identity (-1)^h A_alpha F_N(w) =sum_i(w_i^(-1)-1)J_i(w). (4) Thus the Koszul current complex of the actual zero-extended index differences maps strictly to the weight-current complex with differential given by the commuting factors `w_i^(-1)-1`. Equation (1) supplies its actual finite-word/source realization. Evaluation at `w=1` gives the original full scalar annihilation. ## 3. A relative functor for actual maps, including nonintertwining projectors Let an actual completed source space `V` carry its fixed Fock multiplication `T_V`. Define its relative source complex by delta_V f=((partial_sigma-T_V)f,f(0),f(1)). Its coefficients are completed so that `exp(sigma T_V)` is defined coefficientwise, as in the actual Mellin source theorem. For a continuous actual linear map `O:V->W` define the strict relative lift by O_rel(sigma)=exp(sigma T_W) O exp(-sigma T_V) in degree one and in the bulk of degree two. Its endpoint maps are `O` at zero and `exp(T_W)Oexp(-T_V)` at one. Direct differentiation proves delta_W O_rel=O_rel delta_V. (5) No commutation of `O` with the Fock operators is assumed. In particular this applies to every actual crossing and every head inclusion, projection and marked coupon. For composable maps one has exactly (O_2 O_1)_rel=(O_2)_rel(O_1)_rel. (6) Take `T_(V tensor W)=T_V tensor I+I tensor T_W`. The exponential then factors, so this transport also respects tensor products. Finite head objects and the scalar target have `T=0`; their actual pivotal caps and ordinary evaluation maps can be included without introducing an infinite trace. All finite head inclusions and projections remain explicit maps in this diagram. The actual transgression obeys the exact naturality formula L_W O_rel=O L_V. (7) It follows either by multiplying the integrand by `exp(-sigma T_W)` or directly from its two endpoint terms. Thus this is a strict relative source transport through a complete arbitrary word. ## 4. Actual moments and head projectors have explicit endpoint lifts On a block edge the actual number is `n=j+N T B`. Since `[n,T]=N T`, its relative lift is exactly n_rel=n-N sigma T. For every degree-h polynomial the lift is p(n)_rel=p(n-N sigma T), with the actual noncommutative operator order. It has sigma degree at most `h`, and its endpoint operators are `p(n)` and `p(n-NT)`. Multiedge polynomials and the actual transfer differences follow by the tensor product and composition laws. Hence this construction carries all the polynomial moments in (3), not only their constant part or a top-degree projection. The whole cut clock also has an exact formula. For `a=w^N`, (w^n)_rel=w^j exp[sigma(1-a)T] D_a, (D_a f)(t)=f(a t). (8) This includes every coupling derivative and its finite endpoint carry. Differentiating (8) at `w=1` recovers the displayed number lift, including its `-N sigma T` term. For the actual head projection `P=i pi_0`, `P T=0`. Therefore P_rel(sigma)=exp(sigma T)P, P_rel(0)=P, P_rel(1)=exp(T)P. (9) It is idempotent at every sigma because `P exp(sigma T)=P`. Every intermediate projector in a word has its own factor (9). It is not replaced by identity and is not asserted to be a quantum-group intertwiner. An explicit Cartan homotopy records its and every map's change: O_rel(sigma)-O =integral_0^sigma exp(t T_W) (T_W O-O T_V)exp(-t T_V)dt. (10) This retains the inserted current rather than declaring a source invariant. For polynomial moments its normal-ordered expression is finite; the crossings and projector exponentials remain whole functions in the specified completion. ## 5. Mellin, whole-R and Rees transport commute with this construction Under the actual Fock Mellin map `T_V` becomes multiplication by `u=Log U`; hence the endpoint in (9) is exactly `UP`. All co-source conjugations and normal rows in the Mellin theorem remain in (5)--(10). The exact normal-jet complex and its binomial endpoint terms are obtained by taking jets of these whole formulas. The Rees maps have the form `C=D_eta exp(-p u/d)`, so they commute with multiplication by `u`. They are therefore coefficientwise maps of these relative complexes. For an actual transformed internal projector, the lift is (C P C^(-1))_rel(sigma)=exp[(sigma-p/d)u]P, (11) with the head eta flags retained in non-diagonal coupons. Its endpoint is `exp[(1-p/d)u]P`, not a regular vacuum. The whole coupled crossings are exactly those of [the whole-R source factorization](rees_whole_crossing_source_factorization.md), with its parameter `t` now the actual transfer weight. Both its regular cyclic factor and its specified resonant/Cartan period are kept; no separate root value of an infinite factor is taken. Because the chosen source operators do not depend on the coupling weights, (5)--(7) commute with all Euler weight derivatives and Laurent weight factors in (3). Thus equations (1)--(4) transport to this actual relative/Fock/Mellin/Rees source diagram as exact cochain identities for a complete word, including every projector. This does not discard the actual two-wall word curvature. It is carried as an ordinary coefficient map in the same functor. The [constrained-word source construction](constrained_verma_word_source_extension.md) supplies a finite algebraic realization of those coefficients; this relative lift adds their endpoint/current coherence rather than replacing them. Its differentials, inclusions and retractions can all be lifted by (5), degree by degree. Their exact chain identities remain exact by (6); no commutation with the original Fock multiplication is presumed. ## 6. An exact whole-source resummation shows what remains Before taking any root limit, let the fully head-projected word be `O_beta(w)=i_b B_beta^H(w) p_b`. Under a common Rees conjugation its **whole** operator is exactly C_b O_beta(w) C_b^(-1) =exp[-sum_i p_i u_i/d] D_eta B_beta^H(w) D_eta^(-1) P_b. (12) Its relative version has `sigma` added to every displayed source exponent. This resums the complete product of cyclic factors, canonical periods and all internal projectors. It does not leave an independently adjustable regular cyclic vacuum. Applying the actual final source and co-source recovers the original weighted finite period, and hence every Green moment, exactly. But the coefficient in (12) is the original finite head word. The source exponent is irregular and the head flags remain. This identity does not evaluate the coefficient of its geometric stationary block. There is a precise homological limitation. The relative complex is equivalent by its explicit transgression to its original coefficient space in degree two. Therefore the functor (5)--(7) preserves coefficient classes; it does not turn an unknown map from the geometric Gaussian module into a nonzero one. To preserve the geometric horizontal generator, that coefficient map still has to be constructed through the irregular projectors (11)--(12). At the geometric end the exact two framing currents already computed in the full Green formula still have their marked endpoint/carry defect. The actual source diagram above specifies its own corresponding co-sources completely. What is not proved is that the Gaussian pushforward sends one set to the other with nonzero horizontal image. This is now a comparison of specified whole current/source objects, rather than an unspecified boundary normalization. No full scalar geometric factor or selected volume growth is concluded from this relative transport alone. The compact source construction supplies the actual global cycle for the weighted family (1) and currents (3). The next geometric pushforward must commute with its exact star product and current maps while controlling degeneration or escape of the critical family at the compactified polar divisor. That statement has not been proved here. [Exact relative-operator audit](../experiments/audit_relative_word_green_transport.py) and [results](../experiments/relative_word_green_transport_results.json) check the actual number and whole-clock lifts, Green binomial moments, internal projector and ordered word composition. The universal full Green formula is independently checked by [the free-shift audit](../experiments/audit_full_certificate_green.py).

title: Archived diagnostic: a coherent all-high Racah tail and a cotangent sum
text: # Archived diagnostic: a coherent all-high Racah tail and a cotangent sum **Current status, 29 October 2026:** the cotangent identity recorded here is now proved by the own finite Fourier argument in [the coherent-tail residue theorem](actual_coherent_racah_tail_fourier_residues.md). That theorem also proves polynomial first-normal bounds whenever the maximal face sum is repeated. General unique-maximal-face residuals and higher generic normal jets remain open. The text below is the preserved HISTORICAL DIAGNOSTIC, written before that proof. Its question marks and statements that a finite proof was missing describe that earlier checkpoint. The eleven-level numerical record has not been relabeled as a proof. 29 October 2026, earlier checkpoint. RESEARCH LEAD ONLY at that stage. The finite identity proposed below had been checked numerically at eleven specified levels. No finite proof, certified error bound, uniform normal estimate, or general partner-transport theorem was asserted at that checkpoint. ## 1. The actual generic normal being observed Fix an integer m>=1 and N=3m+1, D=N-1=3m, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, theta=pi/N, s_r=product_(u=1)^r 2sin(u theta). Start with the supported folded sextuple (m,m,m,m,m,m), and change ALL six spins to their partners D-m=2m. Use the SAME generic symmetric quantum integers [u]=(zeta^u-zeta^-u)/(zeta-zeta^-1) and seven-factorial sum S(zeta) as in the [proved common-phase and retained-normal theorem](actual_supported_racah_common_phase_and_normal_metric.md). For this all-high branch, every face sum is 6m and every opposite sum is 8m. Its true summation range is therefore 6m<=z<=8m. Remove the actual numerator zeros, before root evaluation: (-1)^D S(zeta)/[N]=C(zeta)+[2N]T(zeta). (1) Here C is the SINGLE term z=6m=2D, and T consists of the terms z=6m+1,...,8m with BOTH [N] and [2N] omitted from the numerator. All seven true denominator indices are <N. The functions C,T are analytic at q, and the elementary factorial reflection gives C(q)=N^2/s_(2m)^3=s_m^3/N, T(q)=-2sin(theta)N^2 sum_(k=0)^(2m-1) (-1)^k s_k/[s_(k+1)^4 s_(2m-1-k)^3]. (2) The tail is really present. In the coordinate t=log(zeta/q), dot[(-1)^D S/[N]](q)=dot C(q)+4N/(q-q^-1) T(q). (3) Consequently T(q) cannot be deleted merely because [2N](q)=0. The [all-partner value theorem](actual_racah_partner_reflection_identity.md) does not identify the derivatives in (3). ## 2. The observed formula and its exact checked scope The proposed finite identity is T(q)/C(q) ?= -3sin(theta) sum_(u=1)^m cot(u theta). (4) The question mark is intentional. The portable diagnostic checks EXACTLY the following previously probed values: m=1,2,3,4,6,8,12,16,24,32,48, N=4,7,10,13,19,25,37,49,73,97,145. Thus it checks both parities and several composite levels, but not every m<=48. Its working precision is 3N+60 decimal digits. At these levels the two sides agree to far more than forty decimal digits. This is numerical evidence, not an exact cyclotomic certificate. Some rounded values of the coherent ratio are N=4: -2.1213203435596, N=25: -7.5419628808584, N=49: -9.5541461519503, N=145: -12.801479315575. Taking absolute values INSIDE the alternating sum in (2) loses the cancellation. The diagnostic records this absolute-tail comparison separately. The observed large overestimate supplies no no-go theorem for the coherent sum and no proof of its growth rate. If (4) is eventually proved, elementary cotangent estimates would bound THIS T(q)/C(q) polynomially (in fact logarithmically). That would still be a special all-high family, not a theorem for every supported partner branch or for every normal order. ## 3. Higher-normal observations and a possible finite-proof route The same existing probe records i dot T(q)/C(q) and ddot T(q)/C(q), with no derivative of C in these ratios. These are computed from the actual omitted-zero factorial terms, not by differentiating (4). For a unit quantum integer the exact logarithmic derivatives at q are dot log[u]=-i[u cot(u theta)-cot(theta)], ddot log[u]=u^2 csc^2(u theta)-csc^2(theta). (5) Sum (5) over the numerator indices except N,2N and subtract the seven denominator sums. If the resulting real quantities for a tail term are L1,L2, its first derivative is -i L1 times the term and its second derivative is (L2-L1^2) times the term. The recorded values grow moderately at the checked levels; no asymptotic bound or all-order conclusion is inferred from that observation. A possible own finite-proof route is a parameter-differentiated cyclic terminating summation. The proved central cotangent identity in [the spectral/normal transport note](actual_partner_normal_transport.md#5-an-exact-central-normal-check-by-a-finite-product-derivative) comes from the OWN balanced Sears calculation followed by a finite product derivative. It motivates looking for an analogous finite transformation for (2). That analogy is a research direction, not a missing step silently supplied by a named summation formula. The current established scope remains the polynomial root spectral estimate and the tail-free generic-normal criterion. General bounds on live [2N] currents, their fixed jets, and coherent partner sewing remain open. Portable diagnostic: [script](../experiments/diagnose_all_high_racah_tail_cotangent.py) and [recorded results](../experiments/all_high_racah_tail_cotangent_diagnostic_results.json). Only mpmath is required. Status PASS_DIAGNOSTIC means the finite numerical comparisons passed, not that (4) is proved.

title: Historical research lead: generic four-port AW parameters (now completed)
text: # Historical research lead: generic four-port AW parameters (now completed) 29 October 2026. Completion update: the general actual source kernel and its exactly normalized seven-factorial conversion are now PROVED in [the generic all-port theorem](actual_general_four_port_single_racah_kernel.md). This historical research lead records the original parameter proposal; it is not an independent proof and does not add a positivity claim. The original proposal preserved a possible extension of the completed [physical tetrahedral source identity](actual_generic_trivalent_racah_source_identity.md). At that stage it was not a source formula or an asymptotic input; the generic gauge and normalization were still missing. They are now established in the linked theorem, with root positivity and energy estimates still explicitly separate. Use generic q, Q=q^2, and ordinary four-port spin labels a,b,c,d. The actual left and right intermediate ranges are e in [|a-b|,a+b] intersect [|c-d|,c+d], f in [|b-c|,b+c] intersect [|d-a|,d+a]. In the chamber c-d>=|a-b| put e_min=c-d, e_max=min(a+b,c+d), f_max=a+d, and n=f_max-f. A candidate for the finite operator parameters is A=q Q^(c-d), B=q Q^(b-a), C=q^-1 Q^(-c-d), D=q^-1 Q^(-a-b), z_e=q Q^e, kappa=q Q^(a+d), P=ABCD=Q^(-2(a+d)). (1) For the finite symmetric polynomial operator Lg(z)=u(z)[g(Qz)-g(z)]+u(z^-1)[g(Q^-1z)-g(z)], u(z)=product_(T=A,B,C,D)(1-Tz)/[(1-z^2)(1-Qz^2)], the eigenvalue polynomial is Lambda_n=(Q^-n-1)(1-PQ^(n-1)). There is an elementary EXACT arithmetic identity kappa[Lambda_n+1+P/Q] =q Q^f+q^-1 Q^-f, n=a+d-f. (2) The candidate forward coefficient vanishes at e_max, and the backward coefficient vanishes at e_min. This explains the expected support but does not identify the actual source recurrence. The specialization a=b=d_phys/2, c=a_source, d=b_source, f=d_phys/2 gives precisely the parameters and physical Casimir eigenvalue in the already PROVED generic six-head theorem. In that specialization the polynomial degree is b_source, and the affine operator scale is q^(d_phys+1)Q^b_source. This consistency check is not a general proof. At the proposal stage the remaining concrete steps were: prove the actual general Jacobi diagonal and off-diagonal product certificate from the typed Fricke relations; derive its diagonal source gauge from the true first-component-one Clebsch columns; and evaluate the actual endpoint coefficient to fix normalization. The existing [four-port kernel](actual_ordinary_four_port_recoupling_kernel.md) already provides a finite two-sum formula with the correct cups and cyclic clock, which would be the independent source to compare. All generic high channels and pole-canceling root normals must be retained before any specialization. Distinct spectra, formal matching of (2), or named polynomial symmetry alone do not prove this bridge. Those generic source/gauge/normalization steps, including the seven-factorial comparison and finite normal budget, are now supplied by the linked completion. The next open tasks concern coherent high-partner metric/jet transport and actual global source incidence, not this finite identity. This historical proposal remains available to distinguish the initial heuristic from its later proof.

title: Research routes and preserved ideas
text: # Research routes and preserved ideas The new exceptional-period route retains the exact generic Casimir polynomial, its canonical scalar action and general local character relation, the actual continuant resolvent period, strict-support Green estimates, and separate endpoint controls. Finite-propagation windows and the universal marked rectangle bound are retained with their limitations. The coherent Fourier phase and global ordinary Legendre chart remain complementary tools. These results do not replace the cube, positive sewing or other earlier routes, and do not yet prove the general contributing source period. 29 October 2026. This is a navigation and scope record, not a new proof or a replacement for the underlying notes. No route below is abandoned because another has advanced. “Proved” refers to the repository's internally reviewed research arguments; broader statements remain open. Start with the [current frontier](general_equality_frontier.md) and [pretzel-to-general strategy](pretzel_to_general_source_strategy.md). The objective remains the broad ORIGINAL-source equality with the ACTUAL hyperbolic volume, retaining the mark, normal terms and peripheral normalizations. A projected sector, local volume formula or upper bound is not a substitute for that objective. ## 1. Pretzels, belt stacks and the general filling mechanism The [complete augmented pretzel proof](actual_pretzel_coherent_circle_and_period_asymptotic.md) has an explicit sharp Fourier energy and a separate nonzero original period. The [width improvement](actual_pretzel_all_width_extension.md) and [geometric equality proof](actual_long_pretzel_casson_rivin_equality.md) give the stated independently long fixed signed fillings: odd pretzel widths >=9, and the specified two-component even-width links >=10. Widths 3,5,7 are not covered by that alias estimate. The [signed belt-stack assembly](actual_long_filled_octahedral_belt_stack_volume.md) is another full-source equality family, with any subset of auxiliary circles independently sufficiently long-filled and no minimum stack width. Its actual diagrams, peripheral words and component counts are part of the theorem. The reusable [general source filling transfer](general_original_source_long_filling_transfer.md) is CONDITIONAL on an actual nonzero even complex packet and an entire physical-color complement gap. The [general geometric theorem](general_source_regulator_hyperbolic_equality.md) identifies a genuinely marked nearby representation with the actual filled geometry. Neither theorem supplies missing quantum hypotheses for an arbitrary new graph. ## 2. Cube, shared cores and projected chains — preserved with their scope The cube is a concrete primitive-core test, not the asserted general answer. Its [actual rectified-core geometry](actual_nc_graph_rectified_core_geometry.md) has volume 16v8+2Vol(Q_cube); the extra shared-core term cannot be replaced by a product of local theta rates. The durable source chain of results is: * [Literal central cube reduction](actual_odd_central_cube_reflection_packet.md): exact original marked scalar N^12 S_N^8 phi(h^4), with all twelve channels fixed to the odd Steinberg channel and all phases retained. * [Positive cuboctahedral period](actual_positive_newton_cuboctahedral_period.md): the real positive sum has the actual Q_cube volume rate, identified by its explicit geometric tetrahedra. * [Four-rung packet](actual_cube_four_rung_positive_source.md): all four rung labels are summed, including paired normals. Eight cycle labels remain fixed. Its odd-level partial source has the same actual augmented-cube volume rate and a strict unfrozen-color gap. * [Two-boundary transfer and projected chains](actual_three_port_cauchy_transport_and_cube_kernel.md): an explicit coupled weighted-Cauchy kernel has the sharp cube-minus- theta norm increment. Typed iterations retain every rung sum but still fix 2+6k cycle labels and use odd levels. Full cube color summation, cancellation/dominance after removing those cycle projections, even-level cube growth and arbitrary primitive-core graphs remain OPEN. The [full-cube diagnostic](../experiments/diagnose_actual_full_cube_complete_circle_source.py) and [its data](../experiments/actual_full_cube_complete_circle_diagnostic_results.json) are preserved as complex128 finite diagnostics, not proofs of positivity, error control or a limit. The scope cautions already appear in the cube proof notes, README and frontier. The projected-chain note is linked explicitly here so it is not lost behind the shorter cube summaries. ## 3. Positive Conway expressions and Karamata-style variational growth The [actual positive Newton algebra](actual_positive_newton_multiplication.md) retains every root normal. Its genuine turn, multiplication and closures give a [whole-source positive Conway class](actual_positive_complete_circle_conway_trees.md), without cube channel projections. The [variational limit theorem](actual_positive_conway_variational_limit.md) proves an all-level limit as a concave ideal-angle maximum for each fixed robust expression. Exact integer support supplies the lower bound at every level, including boundary maxima. Its angle triples still need identification with the actual complement's face/edge incidence. Some expressions have polynomial growth; positivity does not imply hyperbolicity or volume equality. This route is preserved alongside the cube's more explicitly calibrated but projected result. ## 4. Fourier, weighted Cauchy and the distinct Tauberian idea The [Cauchy checkpoint](cauchy_metric_route_checkpoint.md) and [source-preserving weighted Fourier energy](actual_weighted_fourier_plat_energy.md) record actual metrics and their boundary costs. The [whole-support Gram theorem](actual_whole_support_boundary_gram_envelope.md) now gives polynomial local source cost on every supported triple, both parities. Exact [three-port source sewing](actual_nc_three_port_source_sewing.md) and its weighted packet retain correlated labels and the original mark. Sharp GLOBAL transported energy and nonzero geometric overlap are still separate requirements. The [turned-circle inertia obstruction](actual_turned_circle_reflection_inertia.md) shows why a positive face form does not automatically stay positive through a genuine change of pairing. The [Fourier-energy Tauberian criterion](actual_fourier_energy_tauberian_criterion.md) preserves a different use of the Karamata idea: a sharp positive Laplace singularity gives cumulative information, but a full every-level limit also requires cross-level control. That criterion is not silently assumed in the already proved direct pretzel asymptotic. ## 5. Pointed quantum A-structure and regulator torsors Keep the [A-polynomial/torsor status](a_polynomial_torsor_status.md), [intrinsic quantum norm torsor](intrinsic_quantum_a_norm_torsor.md) and [actual regulator-weighted transfer](actual_regulator_weighted_a_transfer.md). They retain the original affine source, normal period, lattice and marked peripheral data. A classical A-curve or an unpointed module alone does not select the original period or its absolute regulator. The explicit transfer calculation also shows that small off-diagonal mixing can become exponentially large after branch-dependent weighting. The general selected-period/regulator norm comparison and geometric survival remain open. These constructions and obstructions remain available; the explicit-family source proofs do not replace them. ## 6. Generic four-port kernels and actual local volume The [all-port single Racah kernel](actual_general_four_port_single_racah_kernel.md) is an exact generic source identity with its row/column normalization. The [positive scalar/normal theorem](actual_supported_racah_common_phase_and_normal_metric.md) and [hyperideal geometry theorem](actual_four_port_hyperideal_angle_volume.md) give a local quantum-volume law, uniformly over supported low-fold sextuples, including moving boundary colors. The positive face metric is essential; the bare sum has a different action. Full partner germs carry nonzero [2N] currents and the actual channel gauges may have poles before confluence. A useful full marked transport metric and the actual GLOBAL edge constraints remain to be established. The four local face supports alone maximize at an octahedral boundary, not at an interior manifold saddle. Relevant prior coverage is recorded separately in [the literature scope note](literature_hyperideal_racah_volume_coverage.md). The [full source-volume certificate](source_volume_casson_rivin_certificate.md) explains the final geometric requirement shared by these routes: stationarity on the entire actual edge/peripheral angle slice, followed by the decoration, winding and end-completion checks. Local formulas, restricted stationarity and matching volume constants do not replace it. Preservation audit: the links above were checked against the current files and scope statements. No existing research note or diagnostic was deleted, rewritten or downgraded by this index. It adds navigation only; there is no new proof or change in the claimed knot/link families here. ## 7. Common frames, two exceptional factors, and original generic normals The [joint ordinary-column theorem](actual_q_hahn_joint_complex_amplitude.md) and [finite selected-local certificate](actual_augmented_plat_selected_local_certificate.md) remain available with their domains and hypotheses. The [right-angled framing obstruction](actual_right_angled_selected_framing_obstruction.md) rules out making every original factor central and selected in one frame. Its generic two-facet refinement localizes the weaker physical-support failure to exactly two factors at any bridge width. Continuation of those factors, control outside the central domain and coherent recoupling remain possible routes; none is asserted to be completed. The [small-channel derivative bound](actual_q_hahn_small_channel_generic_normals.md) uses the original generic source. The [partner collision identity](actual_q_hahn_partner_normal_collision.md) retains its actual first normal and surviving tail, whose additional poles exclude an unrestricted individual-normal continuation. The accompanying [complex-growth exploration](../experiments/actual_partner_normal_complex_growth_exploration.json) is preserved as a diagnostic, not as a proved exponential lower bound. The subsequent [complex near-fold estimate](actual_q_hahn_near_fold_complex_partner_bound.md) controls the full paired normal on fixed complex compacts for (l-j) log N=o(N). The [matching-edge scalar](actual_matching_edge_racah_positive_scalar.md) and [marked four-port block](actual_matching_edge_marked_four_port_block.md) preserve another route: regroup the two exceptional factors at a crossing-circle edge, retain every target and the trace normal, and use the exact cancellation with the original complete-circle measure. Target/complement boundary estimates and the mixed-color/global cycle problem remain open. No existing route or diagnostic is removed. The [full physical ordinary packet](actual_q_hahn_full_physical_complex_packet.md) now removes the central-domain restriction on fixed compacts, with an explicit finite-level boundary correction. The [selected-factor corollary](actual_augmented_plat_selected_factor_localization.md) puts every ordinary factor except one chosen matching-edge pair on that actual selected packet. The two failures and the exact block remain; target/complement estimates and the global period do not follow from local selection. The [all-physical generic-jet theorem](actual_q_hahn_physical_generic_jet_bound.md) retains another complementary domain, with every fixed q derivative controlled on integer physical columns and divided pairs. The [completed target-projector identity](actual_matching_edge_completed_projector_block.md) removes the remaining target scalar factor and pairs the colliding channels generically. It retains the nilpotent term and the genuine first derivatives of the regular operators. Their native norms and the joint contraction remain separate estimates; the exact cancellation does not make those costs polynomial. The [native-energy theorem](actual_matching_edge_native_projector_energy.md) makes the operator cost explicit and proves that every fixed derivative adds only a polynomial factor. Its simple midpoint example has positive exponential growth, so the energy must remain in any global estimate. The shared-variable variational route is preserved; separate local maxima cannot replace the actual network constraints. The [Plancherel profile](actual_matching_edge_magnetic_energy_profile.md) and [real shrinking-fold theorem](actual_matching_edge_shrinking_fold_native_energy.md) now compute that full local cost. Its [local geometric interpretations](actual_native_magnetic_energy_local_geometry.md) include an octahedral degree block and a two-cube full cost, with the signed terms and phase conditions retained. The [shared-cycle source](actual_matching_graph_shared_cycle_fourier_compiler.md) makes the flow/Fourier route exact at arbitrary fixed width, and [coefficient duality](actual_q_hahn_fourier_coefficient_variational.md) supplies positive local variational data on its actual shared indices. The one exceptional geometric block and the global coherent route remain necessary subjects of study; a positive coefficient envelope alone has not resolved them. The [shared positive Fourier partition](actual_matching_graph_positive_fourier_partition.md) now gives that route an exact original-source Cauchy bound. The [radial reconstruction obstruction](actual_positive_fourier_radial_geometric_obstruction.md) records why one direct geometric interpretation fails under the right-angled certificate, without claiming a rate gap or discarding nonradial, boundary or exceptional-block approaches.

title: Residual Gaussian Ward currents and the cyclotomic source resonance
text: # Residual Gaussian Ward currents and the cyclotomic source resonance Research proof and audit, 27 October 2026. At COMPLETE color, the literal local currents and explicitly computed cut boundary rows give an all-order transverse Gaussian Ward ideal on the geometric framing torsor. It is a flat rank-one ideal, with the actual Gaussian amplitude as its nonzero horizontal generator. The original cut co-source has precisely the leading covariance required by the uniform Gaussian density. These formal statements do not identify the global finite framing contraction. An explicit cyclotomic resonance obstructs a naive extension to that source; keeping the whole power normal gives a separate exact divided-current/source comparison. ## 1. An explicit operator on the actual transverse block Use the actual independent flow coordinates of [the partial support theorem](partial_geometric_support_theorem.md). Keep two coordinates `chi=(chi_1,chi_2)` external, and contract the other `r=m-1` logarithmic coordinates `u` by the nondegenerate geometric Gaussian. Write `H=Log Q` and I=C_beta(H) exp(S/H) a(chi,u,H), Z(chi,H)=G_chi(I). All original characters, half-steps, pivots and base-only factors are kept. The normalized moment of a regular insertion is E_chi[h]=G_chi(h I)/Z(chi,H). (1) The denominator is a nonzero formal Gaussian block, not the selected finite knot scalar. After its recorded common exponential and base line are factored out, it is a formal unit. Thus every coefficient of (1) is recursively computable by Wick contraction and finite formal division, and is algebraic on the stated geometric/half-density cover. Compose the literal local currents in [the crossing-current note](local_r_ward_transfer_currents.md), keeping their multiplication insertions. Use the same unimodular integral closure solver as for the actual flow coordinates. Every resulting interior term has the explicit form h_(gamma,beta)(chi,u,H) T_chi^gamma S_u^beta I, where the shifts translate logarithmic coordinates by `H` times their displayed integer vectors. Transverse translation gives its exact Gaussian image E_(chi+H gamma)[S_u^(-beta)h_(gamma,beta)(chi,u,H)] T_chi^gamma Z. (2) The proof is the literal substitution `y=u+H beta`, with the critical point recentered at the unique corresponding branch. The insertion is shifted in the opposite direction; it may not be replaced by its unshifted value. External base substitution commutes with the finite Wick recursion. Summing (2) defines an explicit all-order residual difference operator for each composed current. It annihilates `Z` whenever the corresponding interior current identity is zero. Finite endpoint indicators remain their separate source terms; they have not been given a fictitious value in this interior completion. For the two full-tensor Hopf-adjoint combinations 2(ad_K-I)+2 ad_Ecal, ad_F+ad_Ecal, the already proved moment-map calculation gives the two cut-Borel principal fields `A(h_sl+2f_sl)` and `A(e_sl+f_sl)`. Formula (2) transports each term of their interior current equations. The marked `e,D` coupon is not Hopf invariant, so its cut boundary insertions must also be written and transported. The next section does this explicitly at complete color. The generic-M endpoint terms are retained and are not covered by the homogeneous complete-color assertion. ## 2. Gaussian covariance supplies genuine quantum corrections The map (1) is linear, not multiplicative. This matters even in the coherent all-level interior model. If `H_perp=S_uu` is the critical Hessian, direct quadratic Wick contraction gives E[fg]-E[f]E[g] =-H (partial_u f)^t H_perp^(-1)(partial_u g)+O(H^2), (3) for H-independent regular insertions, evaluated at the critical point. The sign comes from covariance `-H H_perp^(-1)` for the phase convention `exp(S/H)`. Cubic-phase and amplitude-drift terms cancel from this covariance at first order. Consequently replacing each coefficient of a product or bracket of Ward currents separately by its scalar expectation is incorrect. Formula (2), applied to the whole ordered term with all insertions, retains these corrections. This is different from the impossible product-preserving fixed-root matrix-to-scalar map. ## 3. The actual complete cut co-source matches the principal density The missing cut terms can be calculated directly, without postulating a Haar form. For `Phi(C)=Tr(e C)`, cyclicity gives the exact dual Hopf rows e_K=K^(-1)eK-e, e_E=K^(-1)eEcal-Ecal K^(-1)e, e_F=eF-KFeK^(-1). Thus `Phi((ad_K-I)C)=Tr(e_K C)` and similarly for the other two generators. The actual one-cut operator has diagonal support term by term, before the remaining internal sums, by total-index conservation. Only the diagonals of these rows contribute. Use `A=Q^a`, `k_a=xQ^(-a)`, `epsilon_a=M Q^(-a)-M^(-1)` for `1<=a<N`, and actual endpoints `epsilon_0=epsilon_N=0`. Direct multiplication gives (e_K)_aa=0, (e_F)_aa=(1-Q)A/N, (e_E)_aa=(Q-1)A/(N M x) +kappa(1_(a=N-1)-1_(a=0))/(N x). (3a) For example the E diagonal is `[epsilon_a/k_a-epsilon_(a+1)/k_(a+1)]/N`; the displayed two endpoint corrections are exactly what replacing the actual truncated edges by their interior formula would miss. At complete color `M=1,x=-q^(-1)`, these simplify exactly to (e_E)_aa=q(1-Q)A/N, (e_F)_aa=(1-Q)A/N. (3b) If the original scalar summand already includes its `1/N`, the boundary multiplication coefficients of the two displayed cut-Borel combinations are therefore b_1=2q(1-Q)A, b_2=(1+q)(1-Q)A. Both have `b_i/H -> -2A` as `H=Log Q` tends to zero. These are literal co-source contributions, not guessed scalar connection terms. Choosing the external pair to contain the actual cut index is always possible: its differential is nonzero on the framing torsor, and one more actual coordinate completes it to an etale pair. The matching geometric divergence is equally explicit. At `M=1` right multiplication of `F(r,s)=[r,1-r;s,-s]` by a row-stochastic frame change has fields X_a=r partial_r+s partial_s, X_b=(1-r)partial_r-s partial_s. The conjugation convention `delta G=[xi,G]` gives xi_1=A(h_sl+2f_sl)=-2X_b, xi_2=A(e_sl+f_sl)=X_a-X_b. Explicitly both traceless matrices have eigenvalue one on `(1,1)`. Subtracting `I` gives the row-sum-zero matrices with parameters `(a,b)=(0,2)` and `(-1,1)`, respectively, and normalized frame variation is `delta F=-F(xi-I)`. This checks the projective normalization and the signs in the two fields. For the actual cut density Omega_cut=-dr wedge ds/[s(1+s)], A_cut=1/(1+s), direct differentiation gives div_(Omega_cut)(xi_1)=div_(Omega_cut)(xi_2)=2 A_cut. Consequently the actual co-source terms satisfy the precise leading covariance identity Lie_(xi_i) Omega_cut+(b_i/H)|_(H=0) Omega_cut=0. (3c) The uniform Gaussian density is a nonzero base-only multiple of this form, so it obeys the same identity. This proves the principal source covariance with the original cut. It does not yet prove that all finite normal/endpoint insertions have the required all-order image. ## 4. The complete residual current ideal is a flat line ### The actual graph current and its first-order field Use the local current identities with the input/output operator order fixed in the crossing-current note. Pair adjacent edge insertions along the braid. Every reindexing is retained as its finite difference current. The elementary product rule is j T^v c-(T^(-v)j)c=(T^v-I)[(T^(-v)j)c]. It fixes the sign and placement of each resulting boundary multiplier. The actual pivotal caps cancel the matched Hopf-adjoint insertions; their remaining boundary is exactly the dual cut row computed in Section 3. The determinant-one flow solver expresses all translations in the independent actual flow coordinates. This gives scalar divergence identities with the boundary coefficients `b_i` included. A translation by an integer vector can be written as a sum of coordinate differences by telescoping its steps, so no nonintegral current is introduced. At COMPLETE color these are homogeneous equations on the original scalar array after the explicit boundary term is brought to the same side. Each multiplier is `N diag(e_h)`, since the scalar summand already contains `1/N`. At generic `M`, equation (3a) instead leaves the two specified kappa-endpoint currents. They must not be omitted by continuity from the complete value. Here is a direct principal-field proof, beyond just identifying the full End-space Hopf symbols. For a local observable h(q,T)=sum_v h_v(q,H) T^v, acting on a generating kernel `exp(S/H)a`, its first amplitude-derivative coefficient is sum_v h_v(q,0) exp(v dot p) v=partial_p h_cl. This follows by first-order Taylor expansion of each shifted amplitude. The right kernel action uses the opposite input translation; therefore its commutator gives the position velocities of the corresponding Hamiltonian field on the canonical graph. The zero-order first correction is carried by the current's amplitude and boundary terms; it is not used to determine these vector coefficients. At a crossing with actual update `q_out=P q_in+R k`, the transfer velocity is uniquely obtained from that crossing's two output velocities. For example, in the positive update `(a,b)->(b+k,a-k)` it is simultaneously `k_dot=c_dot-b_dot=a_dot-d_dot`; equality follows from conservation of the local total position. The negative update gives the same statement with the prescribed signs. Determine this velocity crossing by crossing, then compose. # Independent audit of the resolved framing and Gaussian boundary residue Audit, 27 October 2026. Sections 2--4.1 of [springer_centralizer_boundary_source.md](springer_centralizer_boundary_source.md) and Sections 3--6 of [compact_framing_gauge_and_boundary_residue.md](compact_framing_gauge_and_boundary_residue.md) pass this independent global-transition, normalization and scope check. No tests were rerun. ## 1. The actual framing torsor and its nonextendible centralizer The printed sections conjugate \(E_{12}\) to the two Springer matrices. Their ratio is \[ g_N^{-1}g_S= rac1v  egin{pmatrix}1&-1/(v\eta)\0&1\end{pmatrix}. \] Thus equality of the right-centralizer framings gives \(b_S=b_N+1/(v\eta)\), with the printed sign. The fibre-degree argument proves a genuine obstruction. At degree \(-1\), a coboundary has powers \(v^{\ge0}\) and \(v^{\le-2}\); it cannot supply \(v^{-1}\). At every nonnegative fibre degree, the north and south powers cover all Laurent powers, so the whole line bundle has no corresponding additive extension class. The elementary affine additive-descent calculation supplies the stated chart trivializations. This proves nonextension as an ordinary algebraic additive torsor; no asymptotic argument is involved. Renormalization \(a=-\eta b\) gives exactly \(a_S=v-v^2a_N\). The invertible matrix \[ g= egin{pmatrix}\eta&-a\\eta v&1-va\end{pmatrix}, \qquad\det g=\eta, \] recovers every projective frame on \(\eta
e0\); its south representative is \(-v\) times its north representative. Hence \(Y\setminus E_{m exc}\) is all \(PGL_2\), not only a birational open chart. At the boundary the matrix has rank one, the second flag is transverse to the retained first-column direction, and the original constant centralizer action vanishes. The line-bundle-valued translated action remains free, as stated. The elementary-modification lattice keeps an abstract noncentral meridian. It does not give a regular raw irreducible representation with central meridian. The separate escape argument is correct: irreducibility gives \(C_0
e0\), while \(\operatorname{Tr}[\mu_0,ho(g)]=2+C_0^2\). A regular raw limit with \(\mu	o I\) would contradict this constant commutator trace. The two displayed escape matrices have the stated \(t_c^{-1/2}\) and \((1-t_c)^{-1/2}\) terms. ## 2. Global logarithmic form and the exact Haar adapter Substitution \(b=-a/\eta\) gives \[ d\eta\wedge dv\wedge db =-d\log\eta\wedge dv\wedge da. \] Under the south transition, \(d\log\eta'=d\log\eta+2\,dv/v\); its extra term wedges to zero. Both this logarithmic form and its residue are therefore global. Its residue is \(-dv\wedge da=2\pi i\,\omega_I\), with the correct compact trace normalization. The canonical-bundle identities \(K_Y=O(2)\), \(O(E_{m exc})=O(-2)\), and \(K_Y(E_{m exc})=O\) agree with the explicit form. The actual bridge, rather than a guessed Haar measure, fixes the interior scalar: \[ v=p^{-1},\quad\eta=-sp,\quad b=(1-r)/s,\quad a=p(1-r). \] Its Jacobian is exactly \[ d\eta\wedge dv\wedge db=- rac{dr\wedge ds\wedge dp}{sp}. \] Consequently \[ \Omega_{m cut}\wedge d\log p = rac{H_G}{1-\eta v}. \] The adapter cannot be discarded in the interior. Its boundary value is one, which proves the printed residue without an adjustable numerical multiplier. On the already marked Gaussian phase and common base line, \(\Omega_{ eta,0}=c_ eta\Omega_{m cut}\) with \(c_ eta^2=-T_ eta/2
e0\). Keeping that recorded line gives \[  rac1{2\pi i}\operatorname{Res}_{E_{m exc}} (\Omega_{ eta,0}\wedge d\log p) =c_ eta\omega_I. \] Thus its principal associated-boundary class and compact residue period are nonzero. This uses the marked phase; it does not choose a sign from the identity of squares. ## 3. Physical and associated cycles remain distinct The logarithmic section \(r_*=1-\log A/(2\pi i)\) has the stated deck change \(-1\). Its relative centralizer jump is \(-1/s\), whose primitive co-source has residues \(+1\) at \(s=0\) and \(-1\) at \(s=-1\). The opposite sign of the absolute frame coordinate \((1-r)/s\) is explicitly retained. The exceptional divisor over all of \(X\) and the physical exponential section are different objects. On the latter, \(\eta=(1-e^{-2\pi iva})/v\); its intersections with the divisor are the integer \(va\) fibres, with the removable special rule at \(v=0\). The real compact physical cycle meets it at its two endpoint poles. This does not identify that physical cycle with the compact cycle used to pair the divisor residue. The notes correctly make no such identification. They also do not extend all higher Gaussian coefficients or unrestricted logarithmic Green currents. An unmarked \(\log\eta\) would make \(d\eta/\eta\) exact and erase the relative residue. The missing whole current/source pushforward, and its nonzero selected horizontal image, remain separate. The polynomial coherent clutch and its line weights are intrinsic source data; they are not asserted to be the actual quantum dressing of every geometric frame.

title: The resonant framing blowup and the actual peripheral line
text: # The resonant framing blowup and the actual peripheral line 27 October 2026. This note proves exact identities on the geometric framing chart of the ORIGINAL first-slot inverse-pair cut. The full ADO dimension cancels the chart's apparent first-order pole before specialization. The paired principal Gaussian line also extends. Neither statement constructs the required map from the actual finite source to a selected geometric period. One correction matters: the generic physical inverse-pair atom is `AC=M*b_h/b_(h+1)`. Its first boundary coefficient is `s*zeta`. The coefficient `s*zeta+a/2` belongs to the RAW prefix quotient `b_h/b_(h+1)`, which omits its physical factor M. Those expressions cannot be substituted for each other in a quantum-product boundary calculation. ## 1. Work on a geometric formal branch, before imposing level N Let R be a characteristic-zero formal discrete valuation ring with uniformizer epsilon, containing the marked geometric coefficients. Fix a meridian deformation with kappa=M-M^(-1)=epsilon*a, M(0)=1, p=1-epsilon*zeta, d=1-kappa*beta, t=r+beta*s=d/(epsilon*zeta). Here M is the unique formal root near one of M-M inverse=epsilon*a. The coefficients c,beta,s may vary regularly with epsilon; c and s are units at zero. All leading formulas below use their values at epsilon=0. We work where zeta and s*zeta+a are units. These are classical geometric coordinates, not a newly chosen finite source. The actual generic-M first-slot matrices, as fixed in [the checked meridian-germ appendix](universal_resonant_cut_word_audit.md), are F=[[r,1-r],[s,-kappa-s]], U=[[M-c*beta,kappa*beta-c*beta^2], [c,M^(-1)+c*beta]]. Set Delta=s+kappa*r. Exact substitution gives Delta=d*(s*zeta+a)/zeta. (1) In particular Delta is a unit on this chart, despite r having valuation minus one. Direct conjugation gives, for k=(F inverse U F)_11, k=M^(-1)+a*(epsilon*a+s)/(s*zeta+a) -c*d*p/[epsilon^2*zeta*(s*zeta+a)]. (2) For completeness, U-M inverse I is the rank-one product [kappa-c*beta;c]*(1,beta). Its conjugated (1,1) entry is [kappa*(kappa+s)+c*(d-t)]*t/Delta, which proves (2), without discarding any meridian term. The actual physical momentum is still -(F inverse U F)_12/(k-M^(-1))=p. The SECOND balanced physical position, denoted A_e to distinguish it from the reference cut coordinate A_cut, is A_e=M/k, epsilon^(-2)*A_e -> -zeta*(s*zeta+a)/c. (3) Thus its valuation is two on this unit chart. The reference coordinate remains A_cut=M/(M+s); the two coordinates must not be conflated. ## 2. The framing lattice extends although the scalar clock escapes The matrix F has determinant -Delta, a unit, and at least one entry of valuation minus one. Over R its Smith exponents are therefore (-1,+1). Equivalently Lambda=F^(-1)R^2 is a free rank-two lattice inside the framed representation space. For a geometric representation defined over R, every conjugated holonomy F inverse rho(g) F preserves Lambda. Also F*(1,1)^t=(1,-kappa)^t, so the marked inverse flag remains primitive. This proves flatness of the underlying geometric representation lattice, not a comparison with a quantum source lattice. There is a useful precise restriction on that comparison. The actual finite second position operator has relation B_e^N=1 on the complete root fiber. A multiplicative scalar specialization carrying B_e to the geometric A_e in (3) cannot preserve that relation: A_e^N has valuation 2N, whereas 1 has valuation zero. Multiplication by a unit does not change this discrepancy. Dividing A_e by epsilon squared changes the N-th-power relation by epsilon^(2N), which is precisely a factor that must be accounted for, rather than a harmless unit gauge. This excludes a regular scalar-clock substitution with the original norm relation. It does not exclude a linear period transform, a singular change of lattice with its determinant retained, or an irregular/nonlocal source comparison. Such a construction would still need to carry the actual word and selected source. ## 3. The actual dimension cancels the framing-form pole exactly At fixed M the invariant form already specified by the marked centralizer calculation is Omega_cut=-dr wedge ds/[Delta*(M+s)]. Treat epsilon and a as base parameters. Using (1) and dlog A_cut=-ds/(M+s), its exact expression is epsilon*Omega_cut =dlog A_cut wedge dzeta/[zeta*(s*zeta+a)]. (4) This is an algebraic identity, not a claim about a selected integration cycle or a uniform Gaussian expansion. Now retain the ORIGINAL dimension line, including its phase: d_N(M)=eta_N/u_N(M), eta_N=i^(N+3), u_N(M)=(M^N-M^(-N))/(M-M^(-1)). The quotient u_N is a Laurent polynomial with u_N(1)=N. With B=M^N its exact fraction-field expression is d_N/eta_N=kappa*B/(B^2-1). Consequently, before any limiting argument, (d_N/eta_N)*Omega_cut =a*B/(B^2-1) *dlog A_cut wedge dzeta/[zeta*(s*zeta+a)]. (5) The epsilon inverse pole in (4) cancels against the original peripheral line. The factor B squared minus one remains in (5). It cannot be deleted at a torsion value or used to replace the whole regular lattice by two separately undefined quotients. At M=1 the original polynomial formula gives d_N/eta_N=1/N. On the physical power graph epsilon=1/N and fixed a, the branch is M_N=exp(asinh(a/(2N))), B_N=exp(N*asinh(a/(2N))) -> exp(a/2). Thus the scalar in (5) tends to a/[2*sinh(a/2)] away from its remaining norm divisor. At a=0 its regular continuation is one, in agreement with the exact value (1/N)/epsilon=1. This verifies the peripheral normalization at this boundary. It does not identify the rest of a geometric density with the original quantum period. ## 4. Physical inverse-pair atoms and the first-order correction Let mu_M=[[M,1],[0,M inverse]] and u_h=(M^h-M^(-h))/kappa, a_h=(F inverse mu_M^h F)_11=M^h+s*u_h, b_h=(F inverse U*mu_M^h F)_11. The power identity gives (mu_M^h)'_21=s*u_h in the framed chart. Since U'_12=-p*(k-M inverse), we get the exact formula b_h=k*[M^h+(1-p)*s*u_h]+p*M^(-1)*s*u_h. (6) For the negative move carrying U left across the next reference meridian, the actual physical dictionary A_j=M*ell_previous/ell_next gives A=M*a_h/a_(h+1), B=M*a_(h+1)/b_(h+1), C=a_(h+1)*b_h/[b_(h+1)*a_h], AC=M*b_h/b_(h+1). (7) This is the generic-M extension of the complete formulas; the factors M in A,B and AC are forced by the signed Gauss/position dictionary. At the boundary M=1+epsilon*a/2+O(epsilon squared) and u_h=h+O(epsilon squared). Equation (2) has common leading coefficient `-c/[zeta*(s*zeta+a)]` at order epsilon minus two. From (6), b_h/b_(h+1)=1-epsilon*(s*zeta+a/2)+O(epsilon^2), AC=1-epsilon*s*zeta+O(epsilon^2). (8) The physical atom therefore has no additional a/2 term. Keeping only the raw prefix ratio would introduce a false half-shift into a proposed product or Gamma-profile normalization. No such quantum profile is established in this note. At completeness the five negative coefficient atoms A,C,1/B,AC,C/B have valuations (0,0,-2,0,-2). The same valuations hold on this generic blowup chart when their leading coefficients are units. The atom AC approaches one at order epsilon. Consequently the ordinary fixed-atom Gaussian expansion is not uniform here, even though the inverse-pair principal normal line below is regular. ## 5. The paired principal normal ratio extends The squared PRINCIPAL variable amplitudes from the actual balanced coefficients, with Y=M squared and all fixed phases retained separately, are a_-^2=C/(AB)*(1-AC)*(1-Y/B) /[(1-A)*(1-C)*(1-YC/B)], a_+^2=AB*(1-BC)*(1-Y/A) /[(1-B)*(1-C)*(1-YC/A)]. The inverse move uses (A',B',C')=(B/C,AC,1/C). Direct cancellation, valid before putting Y=1, proves a_-^2(A,B,C)*a_+^2(A',B',C')=-C^2/(1-C)^2. (9) The mixed Hessians are V_-=C/(1-C) and V_+(1/C)=-V_-. The added normal Hessian has determinant -V_- squared. Thus its squared principal amplitude divided by that determinant is EXACTLY one. On the unit chart C tends to A(0) inverse and V_- tends to 1/[A(0)-1], a unit. The inverse-pair PRINCIPAL normal line extends through this blowup after pairing. This does not say that the individual amplitudes, all higher coefficients, the open source, or the full quantum normal lattice extend in this Gaussian frame. Equation (8) explicitly shows an atom colliding with one. An all-order completed source transform would have to control that collision with its actual word data. ## 6. Critical-path implication and exact checks The actual full dimension supplies the precise first peripheral pole cancellation; no extra numerical normalization is available to choose here. The inverse-pair principal determinant also causes no additional unknown scalar. What remains is a source-compatible linear/irregular geometric period map at the resonance, proving that the original selected class has a nonzero geometric image, with subexponential coefficient and a sharp global norm estimate. The displayed cancellations do not prove those three assertions. [The symbolic audit](../experiments/audit_resonant_boundary_blowup.py) checks the raw conjugation, the whole dimension/form identity, the physical-versus-raw first-order correction, the generic inverse principal-amplitude identity, and the dimension polynomial through level twelve. Its [saved output](../experiments/resonant_boundary_blowup_results.json) is a verification of these identities, not evidence of a volume limit or a finite-source/geometric identification.

title: Rivin optimization, a regularized angle flow, and the quantum source
text: # Rivin optimization, a regularized angle flow, and the quantum source Research note, 26 October 2026, following the user's suggestion to use Rivin's geometrization and flow viewpoint. The classical geometric problem has a precise convex formulation. We give an exact constrained flow and prove global convergence when the triangulation is complete and positive geometric. We then identify the additional lift needed for the actual quantum period, retaining a newly computed paired source-normalization identity. The volume conjecture is not proved. This is not a replacement positive quantum state or a claim that real convexity determines the original finite period. Current source frontier (27 October): [exact complete Fourier localization](universal_resonant_fourier_source_completion.md) places the ORIGINAL period entirely at the resonant row; regular finite Fourier rows vanish exactly. The [all-strand Euler/Cauchy theorem](all_strand_euler_cauchy_cap.md) now expresses that original period as a specified finite coefficient or endpoint divided difference, with the whole word retained. Its [physical-clock equation](actual_fusion_right_euler_clock.md) has a nilpotent apparent denominator. The [full peripheral boundary calculation](resonant_boundary_blowup_and_actual_peripheral_line.md) proves the required first pole cancellation and corrects a raw-prefix half-shift. These provide exact inputs for the geometric comparison; Rivin uniqueness still does not prove its selected nonzero image or the sharp norm. The [critical-path audit](critical_path_to_original_volume_conjecture.md) keeps those three final gates open. ## 1. Existing scope and the correct optimization problem [Rivin, Combinatorial optimization in geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/9907032) explicitly develops linear programming and network-flow methods; the [journal abstract](https://doi.org/10.1016/S0196-8858(03)00093-9) states that scope. The triangulated Casson--Rivin formulation is stated in [Futer--Gueritaud, 1004.0440](https://arxiv.org/abs/1004.0440): linear angle equations define a convex polytope, and an interior critical point of volume gives the complete hyperbolic metric. [Luo--Yang, 1404.5365](https://arxiv.org/abs/1404.5365) uses the Fenchel dual of volume for decorated ideal metrics and curvature. For coverage of extended convergent flows on cusped triangulations, see the abstract of [Feng--Ge--Hua, 2009.05842](https://arxiv.org/abs/2009.05842). No published flow or rigidity proof is used as a premise below. For t tetrahedra let theta_(j,0),theta_(j,1),theta_(j,2)>0 be the angles on the three opposite edge pairs. Write C for the edge-incidence matrix: a column counts the two local edges in that pair, including multiplicity if their global edges coincide. The exact angle domain is A={theta>0: sum_(a=0)^2 theta_(j,a)=pi, C theta=2pi*1}. (1.1) Volume is strictly concave on A. The convex objective is its negative, rather than volume itself. An ideal triangulation alone does not guarantee an interior critical point. The positive complete triangulation from [the audited geometric input](ge_geometric_triangulation_audit.md) does supply one; this is where that input is decisive. ## 2. An exact flow-network representation Use a bipartite incidence graph with one node for each tetrahedron, one node for each global edge, and one arc for each of the six local edge occurrences, directed from its tetrahedron to its global edge. Give the arc the corresponding dihedral angle. Every tetrahedron has total outgoing flux 2pi; every global edge has total incoming flux 2pi. Impose equality of the two arcs belonging to each local opposite edge pair. These flow constraints are exactly (1.1), in both directions. This graph is derived from the dual cell complex: tetrahedra are dual vertices and global edges are dual faces. The opposite-pair equalities are additional local constraints. Deleting them would give a different transportation problem. Likewise the bare dual one-skeleton does not by itself record which original edges are encircled or the peripheral holonomies. Let A_0 be the full integer matrix of (1.1), and let B have columns forming a real basis of ker A_0. This description requires no invertible face-matrix chart. For quantum lattice applications one must retain the integral kernel and its peripheral marking as well; a real change of coordinates is not an integral saturation theorem. ## 3. Strict concavity and the geometric maximizer Set Lambda'(a)=-log(2sin a), Lambda(0)=0, and V(theta)=sum_j [Lambda(theta_j0)+Lambda(theta_j1) +Lambda(theta_j2)]. For alpha+beta+gamma=pi the negative Hessian in alpha,beta is [[cot alpha+cot gamma, cot gamma], [cot gamma, cot beta+cot gamma]]. (3.1) Its determinant is one and its first diagonal entry is sin beta/(sin alpha sin gamma)>0. Thus it is positive definite. This proves strict concavity on every affine angle domain. The existing [positive-factorial note](quantum_a_volume.md) already gives the independent stationary-point argument. Choose compatible cusp horospheres in a complete geometric triangulation. The truncated length of each global edge agrees across its incident tetrahedra. Summing the ideal Schlaefli identity gives dV=-(1/2)sum_e length_e d(total angle_e)=0 on the angle domain; changes of decorations cancel at ideal vertices. Hence its geometric angle point theta_* is stationary. Strict concavity makes it the unique global maximizer, with V(theta_*)=Vol(M). (3.2) This argument proves the direction needed here from the supplied geometric point. It does not assume that an arbitrary nonempty angle polytope has an interior maximizer. ### The same optimization generates the marked A-curve This also gives a precise connection to the requested torsor formulation. Actual R enters that lower channel at every level: deleting the excursions changes a central inverse-pair identity from 1 to sin^2(pi/(2N)) at even levels. No geometric Ward cancellation of those excursions or equality with a different high-color R is inferred. There is a positive selected-source bound in the [metric audit](frobenius_clock_and_internal_centralizer_map.md#7-the-selected-coupled-source-is-orthogonal-in-a-hybrid-metric): the Fr-coherent/flat-head metric makes the actual root controlled shift unitary, Fourier/N scalar-unitary, and the coupled original coupon an orthogonal projector of norm one. The previously computed exponential conditioning in the two-coherent-factor metric remains true. Neither norm choice removes the explicit source power above, nor supplies a growing-level bound for the geometric period. The remaining source-sensitive calculation is therefore on a specified class: transport the ACTUAL relative co-source and its normal/charged terms to the invariant gluing line, retaining this wall coefficient and all lower memory channels. The [whole translation/gluing test](whole_translation_gluing_source_test.md) records its six signed local norm characters and exact orbit pairing. Rivin's regular place supplies an algebraic evaluation point; the selected co-source value and regulator growth remain the theorem to prove. ## 31. Actual divided words now give a whole pole-free cut contraction The [whole Ward grid theorem](whole_high_color_ward_grid_contraction.md) uses genuine operators on D_(N(r+1)-1), with r=N for the selected high-color source: K, F, L=F^(N), H=(-1)^(Nr-1)[E^(N),F^(N)]. Both K and H are diagonal whole q-functions. At the root K separates head residues and H has eigenvalues r-2R, separating the repeated Fr blocks. Their appropriate inverse gaps are units. Ordinary F inside each head row and divided F along a block trunk give a connected grid. An explicit tree-flow primitive proves h delta=I-I*Tr/D, D=N(r+1), delta C=([K,C],[H,C],[F,C],[L,C]). This contracts the actual image Ward complex, with no division by 1-Q^N. Its root Hilbert--Schmidt norm is O(N^(3/2)) for r=N in the specified hybrid metric. For the original correlated coupon, whose functional norm is one there, it gives the exact whole row Phi-Tr/D=Phi h delta with the same polynomial bound. The earlier memory-Borel resonance has therefore become an explicit actual Cartan-current endpoint. It has not been set to zero on an unsummed or moment-inserted operator. The [divided current/closure theorem](actual_divided_ward_closure_and_green_caps.md) supplies that endpoint for every actual weighted braid word. For coupling-moment polynomial p it retains the exact finite differences Delta_t p, and the frozen pivotal cap contributes chi^(-1)ptr_K M_(Z^J). In particular taking normal derivatives after freezing the root pivot misses a supplied current. The new actual Cartan wall inverse is a rational unit before jets. Its coproduct and cap images keep the ordinary/divided mixed terms. The [full old-head memory closure](clebsch_hopf_closure_and_auxiliary_wall_homotopy.md) is also explicit: an auxiliary two-row Ward contraction kills the upper wall on the represented old-head operator algebra and carries the literal source with normalized auxiliary trace1/2. This proves a global cochain cancellation in that specific extension; it does not identify its source with the high-color or geometric ones. ## 32. The whole source itself is an actual norm-torsor trace The [Fermat-cover source theorem](whole_frobenius_source_fermat_trace.md) now constructs a source function from the ORIGINAL integral divided powers, rather than defining a new list of normal jets. On residue string s of high color m=N(N+1)-1 put L_s=m-s and P_s(q,t)=sum_(k=0)^N (-1)^[k(N-1+s)] {L_s choose kN}_q t^k. Here t is a source-flag parameter, not the knot meridian. On the marked N-th-root cover x^N=(-1)^(N-1+s)t the theorem proves P_s=(1/N)Tr product_(r=0)^(L_s-1)(1+q^(L_s-1-2r)x), Norm product = product_(r=0)^(L_s-1)(1+theta_s Z^(-r)t), theta_s=(-1)^s q^[N(L_s-1)], Z=Q^N. It separately specifies the norm-one cyclic factor and its trace. At the marked root the result is EXACTLY (1+t)^N, including the fractional head correction from its norm line. Its first normal is ell_s N t(1+t)^(N-1), where ell_s is the actual head connection already found in the Jackson current. The whole frozen cap response is Z^s P_s(q,t Z^N)/P_s(q,t). Its power factors and pairing units are retained throughout. There is also an exact power-parameter identity: the norm product is the identical finite Gaussian product at q_hat=-q^N, with q_hat^2=Z and q_hat=1 at the marked root. Its first logarithmic Z-derivative vanishes, while the selected source trace retains the middle-string ell_s term. Thus the supplied trace is additional pointed data, even in this explicit norm torsor; it is not recovered by replacing it with its norm. This is a finite algebraic identity, not a claim about a modular-group action or about the knot volume. The new coupons are related to the previously specified actual divided-exponential coupons by an explicit root-identity rational pair gauge, with every inserted operator conjugated. This is a whole algebraic construction of the finite source and its period mark. It does not replace the knot period by this source trace or prove its hyperbolic-volume rate. The remaining geometric map must carry these actual current, source, cap and norm data together. ## 33. Two actual physical cuts retain the whole framing input The [two-cut reconstruction](actual_two_cut_framing_port_reconstruction.md) now uses two literal diagram edge positions as a unimodular flow coordinate pair. Opening the second identity edge introduces no extra pivot or normalized trace. Its four-port tensor reconstructs the original scalar with the original factor 1/N. Its full port bands retain the true Hopf prefix currents; their off-diagonal source values cannot be replaced by the source on the double diagonal alone. The [whole Green/coherent map](two_cut_matrix_green_and_coherent_source.md) carries both shifts, every tail and corner, and both whole physical clocks to a global relative source. A bounded interior port shift also has a nonzero map through the same transverse Gaussian. The [independent audit](two_cut_port_band_current_audit.md) verifies these identities and the actual tensor tests. Neither theorem has yet identified the selected global framing cycle or its polar continuation. In relating geometric matrices to physical edge momenta, the actual developed-prefix conjugation remains necessary. ## 34. The whole quantum object retains its cyclotomic and period divisors The [actual atom theorem](unfolded_atom_cyclotomic_divisors_and_two_nome_source.md) now proves an exact source extension before taking quantum jets. For the ORIGINAL unfolded Ward factorial F(Q,z)=1/(z;Q)_infinity retain U independently and put R=F(Q,zU)/F(Q,z). At a fixed n-th root, Q=zeta_n exp(epsilon), the marked normal slope U=exp(t n epsilon) has the whole sectorial exceptional period R -> (1-z^n)^t. At the ACTUAL slope t=1 the exact finite Ward iteration already gives (z;Q)_n, whose root value is 1-z^n. First setting U=1 generically gives one and erases this source. Rational t gives the specified Kummer norm by an exact telescope, with all branch marks retained. This is fixed-level specialization, not a growing-level asymptotic interchange. The same proof constructs two-nome difference transports with multipliers 1-z and 1-y. Their exact root formula retains the actual norm-one cyclic source, its determinant half-power, and the continuous Heisenberg period. Both the original atom and this completion have accumulating singular data at the physical parameter origin, explicitly ruling out automatic meromorphic differential-line descent for these local objects. The [finite polar-character theorem](whole_selected_line_polar_character.md) remains sufficient if a WHOLE selected meromorphic line is separately constructed. Its pole primitive would give the volume rate directly. It is not a consequence of the local atoms; the actual program keeps their difference transports and cyclotomic/source divisors. Proving the corresponding global original-source descent and regulator norm remains necessary. The [whole finite transport realization](whole_two_period_transport_and_actual_coefficients.md) now places every actual crossing coefficient in this two-period object without replacing the knot state. Its first-period ratios are exactly the finite Pochhammer products, so the extra completion cancels. Finite contractions, every original cap/pivot/phase and all normal derivatives are preserved. The full peripheral factor is kept separately: its denominator 1-M^(2N) and the transport norm (M^2;Q)_N agree at a root but require the specified whole adapter before differentiation. Their logarithmic Q-normal difference is already -1/2 at N=2,M=1. The original power graph is not equated with the invariant dual-nome coordinate off the root. ## 35. The actual framing cover and cap have explicit whole source data The [prefix-adapted framing theorem](prefix_adapted_two_position_framing_cover.md) uses signed developed prefixes U,V, not a substituted local meridian. On the rank-one projector quadric the physical second clock is k=ell_U/ell_V. Together with the original cut clock it gives a cover of degree at most two, independently of braid length. The complete framing form is Omega=ell_V/(B D) dlog A wedge dlog B. Its field trace is generally nonzero. The exact reciprocal momentum deck still holds at completeness, and an actual prefix clock with its full q/M adapter realizes the normalized orientation insertion. More strongly the [identity-cap theorem](identity_cut_orientation_cover_and_marked_source.md) preserves the original source by a whole rational-form identity. For eta the actual second-port band variable, u=eta+eta^(-1), v=eta-eta^(-1), the source form is exactly F(eta)deta/(N eta) = [v F(eta)]du/[N(u^2-4)]. The original mark is eta=0 over u=infinity. The full finite tail, its endpoint correction and whole clock connection are explicit; no new odd-state source has been chosen. The principal geometric measure agrees, after the actual prefix adapter and a rational Jacobian, with dlog A wedge deta/eta. The same principal boundary calculation is a useful GEOMETRIC test: the independent geometric coordinate eta_geo=p_e^(-1) has a boundary at B=1 where the bare framing density has zero logarithmic residue on a regular chart. This is not an image of the original Fourier-band cap eta_F=0. A principal incidence or an equality of rational forms alone did not transport that source. The finite band/clock theorem and the actual polarization below retain the two variables independently and repair that distinction. The [finite framing-density source theorem](cyclic_framing_density_source.md) also computes its root filter exactly as gamma N lambda^(N-1)/(1-lambda^N)^2. Both lambda and gamma are intrinsic trace-word functions on the marked character/A-cover. The retained cyclic norm is 1-lambda^N. This exact source can have an exponential character even though the starting density is rational. Its identification with the actual Gaussian/source pairing is not assumed. ## 36. The first correction is absolutely exact but retains relative data The [first actual Gaussian correction](figure_eight_first_loop_cap_residue.md) now gives a characteristic-zero test on the figure-eight coefficient model with the literal two external positions (a_0,a_2). It retains the actual three-dimensional transverse complement, every closed pivot, color half-step and all twenty compact atoms. On the stated s=1 framing slice the complete coefficient z_1 is regular at BOTH candidate geometric boundary points. Each of its six Wick contributions separately has a double pole; all such poles cancel in the sum. All finite poles of z_1 occur at the two ramification points of the actual two-position projection, with order four and zero simple residue. An explicit rational Hermite primitive G satisfies G'=z_1 as an identity in the Riley function field. The pole at infinity and the full base-only line are separately retained. Absolute exactness does not determine the marked relative period. The two cap-point difference and the classical centralizer-step difference of G are both nonzero. Their normalized difference is unchanged by any base-only first-order unit and equals (295t-138)/112 for t^2-t+1=0. Thus a source-preserving quantum framing change has to carry the endpoint values of its primitive; it cannot erase them by declaring an exact form irrelevant. This is an exact prototype calculation guiding the general source theory. Its geometric momentum coordinate is not the independent finite band variable, and the residue calculation is not a pushforward of the original cap. No all-s or all-order conclusion is inferred. ## 37. Actual Fourier polarization reduces the remaining source to one index The [whole Fourier polarization](actual_two_cut_fourier_polarization_and_cap.md) now makes an actual change of basis on the second identity wire. Its Vandermonde inverse is retained before taking normal jets, with the exact forced connection, both endpoint carries and every original phase/peripheral factor. The first source keeps its full output row. Its raw partial array is Jtilde_(a,j)=sum_c T^V_(c,j;a,j), original period=(1/N)sum_(a,j)Jtilde_(a,j). At a root the inverse Fourier contributes 1/N inside Jtilde. Old physical b and its output offset are now summed internally; j is a genuine new external source coordinate. A double diagonal at the first cut would have removed that coordinate and is not the chosen source. The finite Fourier/alias theorem preserves all independent power characters on unwrapped current tails. The [geometric Fourier theorem](actual_fourier_polarized_geometric_normal_block.md) uses the original macroscopic open phase S_open+vt, not an unbounded extrapolation of bounded-band jets. The mixed Hessian along the old framing tangent is dLog p_e, so the enlarged transverse block is nondegenerate on the new chart. Complete discrete-faithful holonomy makes (A,p_e) birational on that framing torsor; generic old projection caustics disappear. The marked regulator action is unchanged. The [extended partial-support proof](partial_geometric_support_theorem.md) applies finite proper-coefficient linear algebra and least-moment repair to this SAME actual root partial family. Its constructed operator has a geometric A-factor before the final source sum. The auxiliary proper root lift and whole inverse Fourier normal germs are explicitly distinguished. Finally the [fixed-column source theorem](actual_one_index_fourier_source_and_ward_reduction.md) uses actual scalar root closure to remove the a average exactly: original period=sum_j Jtilde_(a_N,j). A generic rational phase gives a good interior sequence a_N and a nonzero phase-specialized partial operator on each marked residue class of levels. The actual whole Ward defect of this source change has a polynomially bounded primitive and is kept before differentiation; root equality is not falsely promoted to equality of all quantum-normal jets. The last selected source problem now has ONE exterior Fourier index. Its geometric survival and regulator norm still have to be proved. ## 38. A whole rigid source frame, a Möbius fiber, and an actual cancellation test There is now a literal algebraic answer for the finite boundary frame before jets.
